translations.translation: zuru karachi AllAhara nAme yini parama karuNAmaYa, ati daYAlu|
yAvatIYa prazaMsA AllAha tAAlAra yini sakala sRSTi jagatera pAlanakartA|
yini nitAnta meheravAna o daYAlu|
yini vicAra dinera mAlika|
AmarA ekamAtra teAmArai ivAdata kari evaM zudhumAtra teAmArai sAhAyya prArthanA kari|
AmAderake sarala patha dekhAo,
se samasta leAkera patha, yAderake tumi neYAmata dAna karecha| tAdera patha naYa, yAdera prati teAmAra gajava nAyila haYeche evaM yArA pathabhraSTa haYeche|
Alipha lAma mIma|
e sei kitAva yAte keAnai sandeha nei| patha pradarzanakArI paraheyagAradera janya,
yArA adekhA viSaYera upara vizvAsa sthApana kare evaM nAmAya pratiSThA kare| Ara Ami tAderake ye ruyI dAna karechi tA theke vyaYa kare

evaM yArA vizvAsa sthApana kareche sesava viSaYera upara yA kichu teAmAra prati avatIrNa haYeche evaM sesava viSaYera upara yA teAmAra pUrvavartIdera prati avatIrNa haYeche| Ara AkherAtake yArA nizcita vale vizvAsa kare|
tArAi nijedera pAlanakartAra pakSa theke supatha prApta, Ara tArAi yathArtha saphalakAma|
nizcitai yArA kAphera haYeche tAderake Apani bhaYa pradarzana karuna Ara nAi karuna tAte kichui Ase yAYa nA, tArA ImAna Anave nA|
AllAha tAdera antakaraNa evaM tAdera kAnasamUha vandha kare diYechena, Ara tAdera ceAkhasamUha pardAYa Dheke diYechena| Ara tAdera janya raYeche kaTheAra zAsti|
Ara mAnuSera madhye kichu leAka emana raYeche yArA vale, AmarA AllAha o parakAlera prati ImAna enechi athaca Adeৗ tArA ImAnadAra naYa|
tArA AllAha evaM ImAnadAragaNake dheA~kA deYa| athaca ete tArA nijederake chAr3A anya kAuke dheA~kA deYa nA athaca tArA tA anubhava karate pAre nA|
tAdera antaHkaraNa vyadhigrasta Ara AllAha tAdera vyadhi AreA vAr3iYe diYechena| vastutaH tAdera janya nirdhArita raYeche bhaYAvaha AyAva, tAdera mithyAcArera daruna|
Ara yakhana tAderake valA haYa ye, duniYAra vuke dAGgA-hAGgAmA sRSTi kareA nA, takhana tArA vale, AmarA teA mImAMsAra patha avalamvana karechi|
mane rekheA, tArAi hAGgAmA sRSTikArI, kintu tArA tA upalavdhi kare nA|

Ara yakhana tAderake valA haYa, anyAnyarA yebhAve ImAna eneche teAmarAo sebhAve ImAna Ana, takhana tArA vale, AmarAo ki ImAna Anava veAkAderai mata! mane rekheA, prakRtapakSe tArAi veAkA, kintu tArA tA veAjhe nA|

Ara tArA yakhana ImAnadAradera sAthe mize, takhana vale, AmarA ImAna enechi| AvAra yakhana tAdera zaYatAnadera sAthe ekAnte sAkSAt kare, takhana vale, AmarA teAmAdera sAthe raYechi| AmarA teA (musalamAnadera sAthe) upahAsa kari mAtra|
varaM AllAhai tAdera sAthe upahAsa karena| Ara tAderake tini cher3e diYechena yena tArA nijedera ahaMkAra o kumatalave haYarAna o perezAna thAke|
tArA se samasta leAka, yArA hedAYetera vinimaYe geAmarAhI kharida kare| vastutaH tArA tAdera e vyavasAYa lAbhavAna hate pAreni evaM tArA hedAYetao lAbha karate pAreni|

tAdera avasthA se vyaktira mata, ye leAka keAthAo Aguna jvAlAleA evaM tAra cAradikakAra savakichuke yakhana Aguna spaSTa kare tulaleA, Thika emani samaYa AllAha tAra cAradikera AleAke uThiYe nilena evaM tAderake andhakAre cher3e dilena| phale, tArA kichui dekhate pAYa nA|
tArA vadhira, mUka o andha| sutarAM tArA phire Asave nA|

Ara tAdera udAharaNa sesava leAkera mata yArA duryeAgapUrNa jhar3eA rAte patha cale, yAte thAke A~dhAra, garjana o vidyutcamaka| mRtyura bhaYe garjanera samaYa kAne AGgula diYe rakSA pete cAYa| athaca samasta kApherai AllAha kartRka pariveSThita|

vidyutAleAke yakhana sAmAnya AleAkita haYa, takhana kichuTA patha cale| AvAra yakhana andhakAra haYe yAYa, takhana ThA~Ya dA~r3iYe thAke| yadi AllAha icchA karena, tAhale tAdera zravaNazakti o dRSTizakti chiniYe nite pArena| AllAha yAvatIYa viSaYera upara sarvamaYa kSamatAzIla|
he mAnava samAja! teAmarA teAmAdera pAlanakartAra evAdata kara, yini teAmAdigake evaM teAmAdera pUrvavartIdigake sRSTi karechena| tAte AzA karA yAYa, teAmarA paraheyagArI arjana karate pArave|

ye pavitrasattA teAmAdera janya bhUmike vichAnA evaM AkAzake chAda svarUpa sthApana kare diYechena, Ara AkAza theke pAni varSaNa kare teAmAdera janya phala-phasala utpAdana karechena teAmAdera khAdya hisAve| ataeva, AllAhara sAthe teAmarA anya kAkeo samakakSa kareA nA| vastutaH esava teAmarA jAna|

etadasamparke yadi teAmAdera keAna sandeha thAke yA Ami AmAra vAndAra prati avatIrNa karechi, tAhale era mata ekaTi sUrA racanA kare niYe esa| teAmAdera sesava sAhAyyakArIderake saGge nAo-eka AllAhake chAr3A, yadi teAmarA satyavAdI haYe thAkeA|
Ara yadi tA nA pAra-avazya tA teAmarA kakhanao pArave nA, tAhale se deAyakhera Aguna theke rakSA pAoYAra ceSTA kara, yAra jvAlAnI have mAnuSa o pAthara| yA prastuta karA haYeche kApheradera janya|

Ara he navI (sAH), yArA ImAna eneche evaM satkAjasamUha kareche, Apani tAderake emana vehezatera susaMvAda dina, yAra pAdadeze naharasamUha pravAhamAna thAkave| yakhanai tArA khAvAra hiseve keAna phala prApta have, takhanai tArA valave, eteA avikala se phalai yA AmarA itipUrveo lAbha karechilAma| vastutaH tAderake ekai prakRtira phala pradAna karA have| evaM sekhAne tAdera janya zuddhacArinI ramaNIkUla thAkave| Ara sekhAne tArA anantakAla avasthAna karave|

AllAha pAka niHsandehe mazA vA tadurdhva vastu dvArA upamA peza karate lajjAveAdha karena nA| vastutaH yArA mumina tArA nizcitabhAve vizvAsa kare ye, tAdera pAlanakartA kartRka upasthApita e upamA sampUrNa nirbhUla o saThika| Ara yArA kAphera tArA vale, erUpa upamA upasthApane AllAhara matalavai vA ki chila| e dvArA AllAha tA’AlA anekake vipathagAmI karena, AvAra anekake saThika pathao pradarzana karena| tini anurUpa upamA dvArA asat vyaktivarga bhinna kAkeo vipathagAmI karena nA|

(vipathagAmI orAi) yArA AllAhara saGge aGgIkArAvaddha haoYAra para tA bhaGga kare evaM AllAha pAka yA avicchinna rAkhate nirdeza diYechena, tA chinna kare, Ara pRthivIra vuke azAnti sRSTi kare| orA yathArthai kSatigrasta|

kemana kare teAmarA AllAhara vyApAre kupharI avalamvana karacha? athaca teAmarA chile niSprANa| ataHpara tinii teAmAderake prANa dAna karechena, AvAra mRtyu dAna karavena| punarAYa teAmAderake jIvanadAna karavena| ataHpara tArai prati pratyAvartana karave|

tinii se sattvA yini sRSTi karechena teAmAdera janya yA kichu jamIne raYeche se samasta| tArapara tini maneAsaMyeAga karechena AkAzera prati| vastutaH tini tairI karechena sAta AsamAna| Ara AllAha sarvaviSaYe avahita|

Ara teAmAra pAlanakartA yakhana pherezatAdigake valalenaH Ami pRthivIte ekajana pratinidhi vAnAte yAcchi, takhana pherezatAgaNa valala, tumi ki pRthivIte emana kAuke sRSTi karave ye dAGgA-hAGgAmAra sRSTi karave evaM raktapAta ghaTAve? athaca AmarA niYata teAmAra guNakIrtana karachi evaM teAmAra pavitra sattAke smaraNa karachi| tini valalena, niHsandehe Ami jAni, yA teAmarA jAna nA|

Ara AllAha tA’AlA zikhAlena Adamake samasta vastu-sAmagrIra nAma| tArapara se samasta vastu-sAmagrIke pherezatAdera sAmane upasthApana karalena| ataHpara valalena, AmAke teAmarA eguleAra nAma vale dAo, yadi teAmarA satya haYe thAka|
tArA valala, tumi pavitra! AmarA keAna kichui jAni nA, tave tumi yA AmAdigake zikhiYecha (seguleA vyatIta) nizcaYa tumii prakRta jJAnasampanna, hekamataoYAlA|

tini valalena, he Adama, pherezatAderake vale dAo esavera nAma| tArapara yakhana tini vale dilena se savera nAma, takhana tini valalena, Ami ki teAmAderake valini ye, Ami AsamAna o yamInera yAvatIYa geApana viSaYa samparke khuva bhAla karei avagata raYechi? evaM sesava viSaYao jAni yA teAmarA prakAza kara, Ara yA teAmarA geApana kara!

evaM yakhana Ami hayarata Adama (AH)-ke sejadA karAra janya pherezatAgaNake nirdeza dilAma, takhanai ivalIsa vyatIta savAi sijadA karaleA| se (nirdeza) pAlana karate asvIkAra karala evaM ahaMkAra pradarzana karala| phale se kApheradera antarbhUkta haYe gela|

evaM Ami Adamake hukuma karalAma ye, tumi o teAmAra strI jAnnAte vasavAsa karate thAka evaM okhAne yA cAo, yekhAna theke cAo, paritRptisaha khete thAka, kintu e gAchera nikaTavartI haYeA nA| anyathAYa teAmarA yAlimadera antarbhUkta haYe par3ave|

anantara zaYatAna tAdera ubhaYake okhAna theke padaskhalita karechila| pare tArA ye sukha-svAcchandye chila tA theke tAderake vera kare dila evaM Ami valalAma, teAmarA neme yAo| teAmarA paraspara eke aparera zakra have evaM teAmAderake sekhAne kichukAla avasthAna karate have o lAbha saMgraha karate have|
ataHpara hayarata Adama (AH) svIYa pAlanakartAra kAcha theke kaYekaTi kathA zikhe nilena, ataHpara AllAha pAka tA~ra prati (karuNAbhare) lakSya karalena| nizcaYai tini mahA-kSamAzIla o asIma daYAlu|

Ami hukuma karalAma, teAmarA savAi nIce neme yAo| ataHpara yadi teAmAdera nikaTa AmAra pakSa theke keAna hedAYeta pau~che, tave ye vyakti AmAra se hedAYeta anusAre calave, tAra upara nA keAna bhaYa Asave, nA (keAna kAraNe) tArA cintAgrasta o santapta have|
Ara ye leAka tA asvIkAra karave evaM AmAra nidarzanaguleAke mithyA pratipanna karAra praYAsa pAve, tArAi have jAhAnnAmavAsI; antakAla sekhAne thAkave|

he vanI-isarAIlagaNa, teAmarA smaraNa kara AmAra se anugraha yA Ami teAmAdera prati karechi evaM teAmarA pUraNa kara AmAra sAthe kRta pratijJA, tAhale Ami teAmAderake pradatta pratizruti pUraNa karava| Ara bhaYa kara AmAkei|

Ara teAmarA se granthera prati vizvAsa sthApana kara, yA Ami avatIrNa karechi satyavaktA hiseve teAmAdera kAche| vastutaH teAmarA tAra prAthamika asvIkArakArI haYeA nA Ara AmAra AYAtera alpa mUlya dio nA| evaM AmAra (AyAva) theke vA~ca|
teAmarA satyake mithyAra sAthe miziYe dio nA evaM jAnA sattve satyake teAmarA geApana kareA nA|
Ara nAmAya kAYema kara, yAkAta dAna kara evaM nAmAye avanata hao tAdera sAthe, yArA avanata haYa|
teAmarA ki mAnuSake satkarmera nirdeza dAo evaM nijerA nijederake bhUle yAo, athaca teAmarA kitAva pATha kara? tavuo ki teAmarA cintA kara nA?
dhairyyara sAthe sAhAyya prArthanA kara nAmAyera mAdhyame| avazya tA yatheSTa kaThina| kintu se samasta vinaYI leAkadera pakSei tA sambhava|
yArA ekathA kheYAla kare ye, tAderake sammukhIna hate have svIYa paraoYAradegArera evaM tA~rai dike phire yete have|
he vanI-isarAIlagaNa! teAmarA smaraNa kara AmAra anugrahera kathA, yA Ami teAmAdera upara karechi evaM (smaraNa kara) se viSaYaTi ye, Ami teAmAderake uccamaryAdA dAna karechi samagra vizvera upara|

Ara se dinera bhaYa kara, yakhana keu kArao sAmAnya upakAre Asave nA evaM tAra pakSe keAna supArizao kavula have nA; kArao kAcha theke kSatipUraNao neYA have nA evaM tArA keAna rakama sAhAyyao pAve nA|

Ara (smaraNa kara) se samaYera kathA, yakhana Ami teAmAdigake muktidAna karechi pheraAunera leAkadera kavala theke yArA teAmAdigake kaThina zAsti dAna karata; teAmAdera putrasantAnaderake javAi karata evaM teAmAdera strIdigake avyAhati dita| vastutaH tAte parIkSA chila teAmAdera pAlanakartAra pakSa theke, mahA parIkSA|
Ara yakhana Ami teAmAdera janya sAgarake dvikhanDita karechi, ataHpara teAmAderake vA~ciYe diYechi evaM DuviYe diYechi pheraAunera leAkadigake athaca teAmarA dekhachile|
Ara yakhana Ami mUsAra sAthe oYAdA karechi calliza rAtrira ataHpara teAmarA geAvatsa vAniYe niYecha mUsAra anupasthitite| vastutaH teAmarA chile yAlema|
tArapara Ami tAteo teAmAderake kSamA kare diYechi, yAte teAmarA kRtajJatA svIkAra kare nAo|
Ara (smaraNa kara) yakhana Ami mUsAke kitAva evaM satya-mithyAra pArthakya vidhAnakArI nirdeza dAna karechi, yAte teAmarA sarala patha prApta hate pAra|

Ara yakhana mUsA tAra sampradAYake valala, he AmAra sampradAYa, teAmarA teAmAderai kSatisAdhana karecha ei geAvatsa nirmANa kare| kAjei ekhana taovA kara svIYa sraSTAra prati evaM nija nija prANa visarjana dAo| eTAi teAmAdera janya kalyANakara teAmAdera sraSTAra nikaTa| tArapara teAmAdera prati lakSya karA hala| niHsandehe tinii kSamAkArI, atyanta meheravAna|

Ara yakhana teAmarA valale, he mUsA, kasminakAleo AmarA teAmAke vizvAsa karava nA, yatakSaNa nA AmarA AllAhake (prakAzye) dekhate pAva| vastutaH teAmAdigake pAkar3Ao karala vidyut| athaca teAmarA tA pratyakSa karachile|
tArapara, mare yAvAra para teAmAdigake Ami tule dA~r3a kariYechi, yAte kare teAmarA kRtajJatA svIkAra kare nAo|

Ara Ami teAmAdera upara chAYA dAna karechi meghamAlAra dvArA evaM teAmAdera janya khAvAra pAThiYechi ’mAnnA’ o sAlaoYA’| sesava pavitra vastu teAmarA bhakSana kara, yA Ami teAmAderake dAna karechi| vastutaH tArA AmAra keAna kSati karate pAreni, varaM nijederai kSati sAdhana kareche|

Ara yakhana Ami valalAma, teAmarA praveza kara e nagarIte evaM ete yekhAne khuzI kheYe svAcchandye vicaraNa karate thAka evaM darajAra bhitara diYe praveza karAra samaYa sejadA kare Dhuka, Ara valate thAka-‘AmAdigake kSamA kare dAo’-tAhale Ami teAmAdera aparAdha kSamA karava evaM sat karmazIladerake atirikta dAnao karava|
ataHpara yAlemarA kathA pAlTe diYeche, yA kichu tAderake vale deYA haYechila tA theke| tArapara Ami avatIrNa karechi yAlemadera upara AyAva, AsamAna theke, nirdeza laMghana karAra kAraNe|

Ara mUsA yakhana nija jAtira janya pAni cAila, takhana Ami valalAma, svIYa yaSThira dvArA AghAta kara pAtharera upare| ataHpara tA theke pravAhita haYe ela vAraTi prasravaNa| tAdera sava geAtrai cine nila nija nija ghATa| AllAhara deYA riyika khAo, pAna kara Ara duniYAra vuke dAMgA-hAMgAmA kare ver3io nA|

Ara teAmarA yakhana valale, he mUsA, AmarA ekai dharanera khAdya-dravye kakhanao dhairyyadhAraNa karava nA| kAjei tumi teAmAra pAlanakartAra nikaTa AmAdera pakSe prArthanA kara, tini yena AmAdera janye emana vastusAmagrI dAna karena yA jamite utpanna haYa, tarakArI, kAkar3I, gama, masuri, pe~YAja prabhRti| mUsA (AH) valalena, teAmarA ki emana vastu nite cAo yA nikRSTa se vastura parivarte yA uttama? teAmarA keAna nagarIte upanIta hao, tAhalei pAve yA teAmarA kAmanA karacha| Ara tAdera upara AreApa karA hala lAJchanA o paramukhApekSitA| tArA AllAhara reASAnale patita haYe ghurate thAkala| emana haleA e janya ye, tArA AllAhara vidhi vidhAna mAnateA nA evaM navIganake anyAYabhAve hatyA karata| tAra kAraNa, tArA chila nApharamAna sImAlaMghakArI|

niHsandehe yArA musalamAna haYeche evaM yArA ihudI, nAsArA o sAveIna, (tAdera madhya theke) yArA ImAna eneche AllAhara prati o kiYAmata divasera prati evaM satkAja kareche, tAdera janya raYeche tAra saoYAva tAdera pAlanakartAra kAche| Ara tAdera keAnai bhaYa-bhIti nei, tArA duHkhitao have nA|

Ara Ami yakhana teAmAdera kAcha theke aGgIkAra niYechilAma evaM tura parvatake teAmAdera mAthAra upara tule dharechilAma ei vale ye, teAmAdigake ye kitAva deYA haYeche tAke dhara sudRr3habhAve evaM ete yA kichu raYeche tA mane rekheA yAte teAmarA bhaYa kara|
tArapareo teAmarA tA theke phire gecha| kAjei AllAhara anugraha o meheravAnI yadi teAmAdera upara nA thAkata, tave avazyai teAmarA dhavaMsa haYe yete|
teAmarA tAderake bhAlarUpe jenecha, yArA zanivArera vyApAre sImA laGghaNa karechila| Ami valechilAmaH teAmarA lAJchita vAnara haYe yAo|
ataHpara Ami e ghaTanAke tAdera samasAmaYika o paravartIdera janya dRSTAnta evaM AllAhabhIrudera janya upadeza grahaNera upAdAna kare diYechi|

yakhana mUsA (AH) svIYa sampradAYake valalenaH AllAha teAmAdera ekaTi garu javAi karate valechena| tArA valala, tumi ki AmAdera sAthe upahAsa karacha? mUsA (AH) valalena, mUrkhadera antarbhukta haoYA theke Ami AllAhara AzraYa prArthanA karachi|

tArA valala, tumi teAmAra pAlanakartAra kAche AmAdera janya prArthanA kara, yena seTira rUpa vizleSaNa karA haYa| mUsA (AH) valalena, tini valachena, seTA have ekaTA gAbhI, yA vRddha naYa evaM kumArIo naYa-vArdhakya o yeৗvanera mAjhAmAjhi vaYasera| ekhana AdiSTa kAja kare phela|
tArA valala, teAmAra pAlanakartAra kAche AmAdera janya prArthanA kara ye, tAra raGa kirUpa have? mUsA (AH) valalena, tini valechena ye, gAr3ha pItavarNera gAbhI-yA darzakadera camatkRta karave|
tArA valala, Apani prabhura kAche prArthanA karuna-tini vale dina ye, seTA kirUpa? kenanA, garu AmAdera kAche sAdRzyazIla mane haYa| inazAAllAha evAra AmarA avazyai pathaprApta hava|

mUsA (AH) valalena, ‘tini valena ye, e gAbhI bhUkarSaNa o jala secanera zrame abhyasta naYa-have niSkalaGka, nikhu~ta|’tArA valala, evAra saThika tathya enecha| ataHpara tArA seTA javAi karala, athaca javAi karave vale mane hacchila nA|
yakhana teAmarA ekajanake hatyA kare pare se samparke eke aparake abhiyukta karechile| yA teAmarA geApana karachile, tA prakAza kare deYA chila AllAhara abhiprAYa|
ataHpara Ami valalAmaH garura ekaTi khanDa dvArA mRtake AghAta kara| ebhAve AllAha mRtake jIvita karena evaM teAmAderake tA~ra nidarzaNa samUha pradarzana karena-yAte teAmarA cintA kara|

ataHpara e ghaTanAra pare teAmAdera antara kaThina haYe geche| tA pAtharera mata athavA tadapekSAo kaThina| pAtharera madhye emana o Ache; yA theke jharaNA pravAhita haYa, emanao Ache, yA vidIrNa haYa, ataHpara tA theke pAni nirgata haYa evaM emanao Ache, yA AllAhara bhaYe khasepar3ate thAke! AllAha teAmAdera kAjakarma samparke ve-khavara nana|

he musalamAnagaNa, teAmarA ki AzA kara ye, tArA teAmAdera kathAYa ImAna Anave? tAdera madhye ekadala chila, yArA AllAhara vANI zravaNa karata; ataHpara vujhe-zune tA parivartana kare dita evaM tArA tA avagata chila|

yakhana tArA musalamAnadera sAthe milita haYa, takhana valeH AmarA musalamAna haYechi| Ara yakhana parasparera sAthe nibhRte avasthAna kare, takhana vale, pAlanakartA teAmAdera janye yA prakAza karechena, tA ki tAdera kAche vale diccha? tAhale ye tArA e niYe pAlakartAra sAmane teAmAderake mithyA pratipanna karave| teAmarA ki tA upalavdhi kara nA?
tArA ki etaTukuo jAne nA ye, AllAha sesava viSaYao parijJAta yA tArA geApana kare evaM yA prakAza kare?
teAmAdera kichu leAka nirakSara| tArA mithyA AkAGkhA chAr3A AllAhara granthera kichui jAne nA| tAdera kAche kalpanA chAr3A kichui nei|

ataeva tAdera janye AphaseAsa! yArA nija hAte grantha lekhe evaM vale, eTA AllAhara pakSa theke avatIrNa-yAte era vinimaYe sAmAnya artha grahaNa karate pAre| ataeva tAdera prati AkSepa, tAdera hAtera lekhAra janya evaM tAdera prati AkSepa, tAdera upArjanera janye|

tArA valeH Aguna AmAdigake kakhanao sparza karave nA; kintu gaNAganati kaYekadina| vale dinaH teAmarA ki AllAhara kAcha theke keAna aGgIkAra peYecha ye, AllAha kakhanao tAra khelApha karavena nA-nA teAmarA yA jAna nA, tA AllAhara sAthe jur3e diccha|
hA~, ye vyakti pApa arjana kareche evaM se pApa tAke pariveSTita kare niYeche, tArAi deAyakhera adhivAsI| tArA sekhAnei cirakAla thAkave|
pakSAntare yArA ImAna eneche evaM satkAja kareche, tArAi jAnnAtera adhivAsI| tArA sekhAnei cirakAla thAkave|

yakhana Ami vanI-isarAIlera kAcha theke aGgIkAra nilAma ye, teAmarA AllAha chAr3A kArao upAsanA karave nA, pitA-mAtA, AtnIYa-svajana, etIma o dIna-daridradera sAthe sadvyavahAra karave, mAnuSake sat kathAvArtA valave, nAmAya pratiSThA karave evaM yAkAta deve, takhana sAmAnya kaYekajana chAr3A teAmarA mukha phiriYe nile, teAmarAi agrAhyakArI|

yakhana Ami teAmAdera kAcha theke aGgIkAra nilAma ye, teAmarA paraspara khunAkhuni karave nA evaM nijederake deza theke vahiskAra karave nA, takhana teAmarA tA svIkAra karechile evaM teAmarA tAra sAkSya dicchile|

ataHpara teAmarAi paraspara khunAkhuni karacha evaM teAmAderai ekadalake tAdera deza theke vahiskAra karacha| tAdera viruddhe pApa o anyAYera mAdhyame AkramaNa karacha| Ara yadi tArAi kArao vandI haYe teAmAdera kAche Ase, tave vinimaYa niYe tAdera mukta karacha| athaca tAdera vahiskAra karAo teAmAdera janya avaidha| tave ki teAmarA granthera kiYadaMza vizvAsa kara evaM kiYadaMza avizvAsa kara? yArA erUpa kare pArthiva jIvane dUgarti chAr3A tAdera Ara keAnai patha nei| kiYAmatera dina tAdera kaTheAratama zAstira dike pau~che deYA have| AllAha teAmAdera kAja-karma samparke ve-khavara nana|
erAi parakAlera vinimaYe pArthiva jIvana kraYa kareche| ataeva edera zAsti laghu have nA evaM erA sAhAyyao pAve nA|

avazyai Ami mUsAke kitAva diYechi| evaM tAra pare paryAYakrame rasUla pAThiYechi| Ami mariYama tanaYa IsAke suspaSTa meAjeyA dAna karechi evaM pavitra rUhera mAdhyame tAke zaktidAna karechi| ataHpara yakhanai keAna rasUla emana nirdeza niYe teAmAdera kAche eseche, yA teAmAdera mane bhAla lAgeni, takhanai teAmarA ahaMkAra karecha| zeSa paryanta teAmarA ekadalake mithyAvAdI valecha evaM ekadalake hatyA karecha|
tArA vale, AmAdera hRdaYa ardhAvRta| evaM tAdera kupharera kAraNe AllAha abhisampAta karechena| phale tArA alpai ImAna Ane|

yakhana tAdera kAche AllAhara pakSa theke kitAva ese pau~chAla, yA se viSaYera satyAYana kare, yA tAdera kAche raYeche evaM tArA pUrve karata| avazeSe yakhana tAdera kAche pau~chala yAke tArA cine rekhechila, takhana tArA tA asvIkAra kare vasala| ataeva, asvIkArakArIdera upara AllAhara abhisampAta|

yAra vinimaYe tArA nijedera vikri kareche, tA khuvai manda; yehetu tArA AllAha yA nayila karechena, tA asvIkAra kareche ei haThakAritAra daruna ye, AllAha svIYa vAndAdera madhye yAra prati icchA anugraha nAyila karena| ataeva, tArA kreAdhera upara kreAdha arjana kareche| Ara kApheradera janya raYeche apamAnajanaka zAsti|

yakhana tAderake valA haYa, AllAha yA pAThiYechena tA mene nAo, takhana tArA vale, AmarA mAni yA AmAdera prati avartINa haYeche| seTi chAr3A savaguleAke tArA asvIkAra kare| athaca e granthaTi satya evaM satyAYana kare ai granthera yA tAdera kAche raYeche| vale dina, tave teAmarA itipUrve paYagamvaradera hatyA karate kena yadi teAmarA vizvAsI chile?
suspaSTa mu’jeyAsaha mUsA teAmAdera kAche esechena| erapara tAra anupasthitite teAmarA geAvatsa vAniYecha| vAstavikai teAmarA atyAcArI|

Ara yakhana Ami teAmAdera kAcha theke pratizruti nilAma evaM tura parvatake teAmAdera upara tule dharalAma ye, zakta kare dhara, Ami yA teAmAdera diYechi Ara zeAna| tArA valala, AmarA zunechi Ara amAnya karechi| kupharera kAraNe tAdera antare geAvatsaprIti pAna karAneA haYechila| vale dina, teAmarA vizvAsI hale, teAmAdera se vizvAsa manda viSaYAdi zikSA deYa|
vale dina, yadi AkherAtera vAsasthAna AllAhara kAche ekamAtra teAmAdera janyai varAdda haYe thAke-anya leAkadera vAda diYe, tave mRtyu kAmanA kara, yadi satyavAdI haYe thAka|
kasminakAleo tArA mRtyu kAmanA karave nA aisava geAnAhara kAraNe, yA tAdera hAta pAThiYe diYeche| AllAha geAnAhagAradera samparke samyaka avagata raYechena|

Apani tAderake jIvanera prati savAra cAite, emanaki muzarikadera cAiteo adhika leAbhI dekhavena| tAdera pratyeke kAmanA kare, yena hAjAra vachara AYu pAYa| athaca erUpa AYu prApti tAderake zAsti theke rakSA karate pArave nA| AllAha dekhena yA kichu tArA kare|

Apani vale dina, ye keu jivarAIlera zatru haYa-yehetu tini AllAhara Adeze e kAlAma ApanAra antare nAyila karechena, yA satyAYanakArI tAdera sammukhastha kAlAmera evaM muminadera janya pathapradarzaka o susaMvAdadAtA|
ye vyakti AllAha tA~ra pherezatA o rasUlagaNa evaM jivarAIla o mikAIlera zatru haYa, nizcitai AllAha sesava kApherera zatru|
Ami ApanAra prati ujjvala nidarzanasamUha avatIrNa karechi| avAdhyarA vyatIta keu eguleA asvIkAra kare nA|
ki Azcarya, yakhana tArA keAna aGgIkAre Avaddha haYa, takhana tAdera ekadala tA chu~r3e phele, varaM adhikAMzai vizvAsa kare nA|

yakhana tAdera kAche AllAhara pakSa theke ekajana rasUla Agamana karalena-yini ai kitAvera satyAYana karena, yA tAdera kAche raYeche, takhana Ahale ketAvadera ekadala AllAhara granthake pazcAte nikSepa karala-yena tArA jAnei nA|

tArA ai zAstrera anusaraNa karala, yA sulAYamAnera rAjatva kAle zaYatAnarA AvRtti karata| sulAYamAna kuphara kareni; zaYatAnarAi kuphara karechila| tArA mAnuSake jAduvidyA evaM vAvela zahare hAruta o mAruta dui pherezatAra prati yA avatIrNa haYechila, tA zikSA dita| tArA ubhaYai ekathA nA vale kAuke zikSA dita nA ye, AmarA parIkSAra janya; kAjei tumi kAphera haYeA nA| ataHpara tArA tAdera kAcha theke emana jAdu zikhata, yaddvArA svAmI o strIra madhye viccheda ghaTe| tArA AllAhara Adeza chAr3A taddvArA kArao aniSTa karate pArata nA| yA tAdera kSati kare evaM upakAra nA kare, tArA tAi zikhe| tArA bhAlarUpe jAne ye, ye keu jAdu avalamvana kare, tAra janya parakAle keAna aMza nei| yAra vinimaYe tArA AtnavikraYa kareche, tA khuvai manda yadi tArA jAnata|
yadi tArA ImAna Anata evaM kheAdAbhIru hata, tave AllAhara kAcha theke uttama pratidAna peta| yadi tArA jAnata|
he mumina gaNa, teAmarA ‘rAYinA’ valeA nA-‘unayuranA’ vala evaM zunate thAka| Ara kApheradera janye raYeche vedanAdAYaka zAsti|

Ahale-kitAva o muzarikadera madhye yArA kAphera, tAdera manaHputa naYa ye, teAmAdera pAlanakartAra pakSa theke teAmAdera prati keAna kalyANa avatIrNa heAka| AllAha yAke icchA vizeSa bhAve svIYa anugraha dAna karena| AllAha mahAna anugrahadAtA|
Ami keAna AYAta rahita karale athavA vismRta kariYe dile tadapekSA uttama athavA tAra samaparyAYera AYAta AnaYana kari| tumi ki jAna nA ye, AllAha sava kichura upara zaktimAna?
tumi ki jAna nA ye, AllAhara janyai nabheAmanDala o bhUmanDalera Adhipatya? AllAha vyatIta teAmAdera keAna vandhu o sAhAyyakArI nei|

itipUrve mUsA (AH) yemana jijJAsita haYechilena, (musalamAnagana, ) teAmarAo ki teAmAdera rasUlake temani prazna karate cAo? ye keu ImAnera parivarte kuphara grahana kare, se sarala patha theke vicyuta haYe yAYa|

Ahale kitAvadera anekei pratihiMsAvazataH cAYa ye, musalamAna haoYAra para teAmAderake keAna rakame kAphera vAniYe deYa| tAdera kAche satya prakAzita haoYAra para (tArA eTA cAYa)| yAka teAmarA AllAhara nirdeza AsA paryanta tAdera kSamA kara evaM upekSA kara| nizcaYa AllAha sava kichura upara kSamatAvAna|
teAmarA nAmAya pratiSThA kara evaM yAkAta dAo| teAmarA nijera janye pUrve ye satkarma preraNa karave, tA AllAhara kAche pAve| teAmarA yA kichu kara, nizcaYa AllAha tA pratyakSa karena|
orA vale, ihudI athavA khrIsTAna vyatIta keu jAnnAte yAve nA| eTA odera manera vAsanA| vale dina, teAmarA satyavAdI hale, pramANa upasthita kara|
hA~, ye vyakti nijeke AllAhara uddezye samarpana kareche evaM se satkarmazIlao vaTe tAra janya tAra pAlanakartAra kAche puraskAra vaYeche| tAdera bhaYa nei evaM tArA cintitao have nA|

ihudIrA vale, khrIsTAnarA keAna bhittira uparei naYa evaM khrIsTAnarA vale, ihudIrA keAna bhittira uparei naYa| athaca orA savAi kitAva pATha kare! emanibhAve yArA mUrkha, tArAo odera matai ukti kare| ataeva, AllAha keYAmatera dina tAdera madhye phaYasAlA devena, ye viSaYe tArA matavireAdha karachila|

ye vyAkti AllAhara masajidasamUhe tA~ra nAma uccAraNa karate vAdhA deYa evaM seguleAke ujAr3a karate ceSTA kare, tAra cAite var3a yAlema Ara ke? edera pakSe masajidasamUhe praveza karA vidheYa naYa, avazya bhIta-santrasta avasthAYa| odera janya ihakAle lAJchanA evaM parakAle kaThina zAsti raYeche|
pUrva o pazcima AllArai| ataeva, teAmarA yedikei mukha pherAo, sedikei AllAha virAjamAna| nizcaYa AllAha sarvavyApI, sarvajJa|
tArA vale, AllAha santAna grahaNa karechena| tini teA esava kichu theke pavitra, varaM nabheAmanDala o bhUmanDale yA kichu raYeche savai tAra AjJAdhIna|
tini nabheAmanDala o bhUmanDalera udbhAvaka| yakhana tini keAna kArya sampAdanera sindhAnta nena, takhana seTike ekathAi valena, ‘haYe yAo’ tatkSaNAt tA haYe yAYa|

yArA kichu jAne nA, tArA vale, AllAha AmAdera saGge kena kathA valena nA? athavA AmAdera kAche keAna nidarzana kena Ase nA? emani bhAve tAdera pUrve yArA chila tArAo tAderai anurUpa kathA valeche| tAdera antara ekai rakama| nizcaYa Ami ujjvala nidarzanasamUha varNanA karechi tAdera janye yArA pratyaYazIla|
nizcaYa Ami ApanAke satyadharmasaha susaMvAdadAtA o bhIti pradarzanakArIrUpe pAThiYechi| Apani deAyakhavAsIdera samparke jijJAsita havena nA|

ihudI o khrISTAnarA kakhanai ApanAra prati santuSTa have nA, ye paryanta nA Apani tAdera dharmera anusaraNa karena| vale dina, ye patha AllAha pradarzana karena, tAi hala sarala patha| yadi Apani tAdera AkAGkhAsamUhera anusaraNa karena, ai jJAna lAbhera para, yA ApanAra kAche pau~cheche, tave keu AllAhara kavala theke ApanAra uddhArakArI o sAhAyyakArI nei|
Ami yAderake grantha dAna karechi, tArA tA yathAyathabhAve pATha kare| tArAi tatprati vizvAsa kare| Ara yArA tA avizvAsa kare, tArAi have kSatigrasta|
he vanI-isarAIla! AmAra anugrahera kathA smaraNa kara, yA Ami teAmAdera diYechi| Ami teAmAderake vizvAvAsIra upara zreSThatva dAna karechi|

teAmarA bhaYa kara sedinake, ye dina eka vyakti theke anya vyakti vindumAtra upakRta have nA, kArao kAcha theke vinimaYa gRhIta have nA, kAra o supAriza phalaprada have nA evaM tArA sAhAyya prApta o have nA|

yakhana ivrAhImake tA~ra pAlanakartA kaYekaTi viSaYe parIkSA karalena, ataHpara tini tA pUrNa kare dilena, takhana pAlanakartA valalena, Ami teAmAke mAnavajAtira netA karava| tini valalena, AmAra vaMzadhara thekeo! tini valalena AmAra aGgIkAra atyAcArIdera paryanta pau~chAve nA|

yakhana Ami kA’vA gRhake mAnuSera janye sammilana sthala o zAntira AlaYa karalAma, Ara teAmarA ivrAhImera dA~r3AneAra jAYagAke nAmAyera jAYagA vAnAo evaM Ami ivrAhIma o isamAIlake Adeza karalAma, teAmarA AmAra gRhake taoYAphakArI, avasthAnakArI o ruku-sejadAkArIdera janya pavitra rAkha|

yakhana ivrAhIma valalena, paraoYAradegAra! e sthAnake tumi zAntidhAna kara evaM era adhivAsIdera madhye yArA allAha o kiYAmate vizvAsa kare, tAderake phalera dvArA riyika dAna kara| valalenaH yArA avizvAsa kare, Ami tAderao kichudina phAYadA bheAga karAra suyeAga deva, ataHpara tAderake valapraYeAge deAyakhera AyAve Thele deveA; seTA nikRSTa vAsasthAna|
smaraNa kara, yakhana ivrAhIma o isamAIla kA’vAgRhera bhitti sthApana karachila| tArA deAYA karechilaH paraoYAradegAra! AmAdera theke kavula kara| nizcaYai tumi zravaNakArI, sarvajJa|

paraoYAradegAra! AmAdera ubhaYake teAmAra AjJAvaha kara evaM AmAdera vaMzadhara thekeo ekaTi anugata dala sRSTi kara, AmAdera hajvera rItinIti vale dAo evaM AmAdera kSamA kara| nizcaYa tumi taovA kavulakArI| daYAlu|

he paraoYAradegAra! tAdera madhye thekei tAdera nikaTa ekajana paYagamvara preraNa karuNa yini tAdera kAche teAmAra AYAtasamUha telAoYAta karavena, tAderake kitAva o hekamata zikSA divena| evaM tAdera pavitra karavena| nizcaYa tumii parAkramazAlI hekamataoYAlA|
ivrAhImera dharma theke ke mukha pherAYa? kintu se vyakti, ye nijeke veAkA pratipanna kare| nizcaYai Ami tAke pRthivIte maneAnIta karechi evaM se parakAle satkarmazIladera antarbhukta|
smaraNa kara, yakhana tAke tAra pAlanakartA valalenaH anugata hao| se valalaH Ami vizvapAlakera anugata halAma|

erai ochiYata kareche ivrAhIma tAra santAnadera evaM iYAkuvao ye, he AmAra santAnagaNa, nizcaYa AllAha teAmAdera janya e dharmake maneAnIta karechena| kAjei teAmarA musalamAna nA haYe kakhanao mRtyuvaraNa kareA nA|

teAmarA ki upasthita chile, yakhana iYAkuvera mRtyu nikaTavartI haYa? yakhana se santAnadera valalaH AmAra para teAmarA kAra evAdata karave? tArA valaleA, AmarA teAmAra pitR-puruSa ivrAhIma, isamAIla o isahAkera upAsyera evAdata karava| tini ekaka upAsya| AmarA savAi tA~ra AjJAvaha|
tArA chila eka sampradAYa-yArA gata haYe geche| tArA yA kareche, tA tAderai janye| tArA ki karata, se samparke teAmarA jijJAsita have nA|
tArA vale, teAmarA ihudI athavA khrISTAna haYe yAo, tavei supatha pAve| Apani valuna, kakhanai naYa; varaM AmarA ivrAhImera dharme Achi yAte vakratA nei| se muzarikadera antarbhukta chila nA|

teAmarA vala, AmarA ImAna enechi AllAhara upara evaM yA avatIrNa haYeche AmAdera prati evaM yA avatIrNa haYeche ivrAhIma, isamAIla, isahAka, iYAkuva evaM tadIYa vaMzadharera prati evaM mUsA, IsA, anyAnya navIke pAlanakartAra pakSa theke yA dAna karA haYeche, tatsamudaYera upara| AmarA tAdera madhye pArthakya kari nA| AmarA tA~rai AnugatyakArI|

ataeva tArA yadi ImAna Ane, teAmAdera ImAna AnAra mata, tave tArA supatha pAve| Ara yadi mukha phiriYe neYa, tave tArAi haThakAritAYa raYeche| sutarAM ekhana tAdera janye ApanAra pakSa theke AllAhai yatheSTa| tinii zravaNakArI, mahAjJAnI|
AmarA AllAhara raM grahaNa karechi| AllAhara raM era cAite uttama raM Ara kAra hate pAre?AmarA tA~rai evAdata kari|

Apani vale dina, teAmarA ki AmAdera sAthe AllAha samparke tarka karacha? athaca tinii AmAdera pAlanakartA evaM teAmAdera o pAlanakartA| AmAdera janye AmAdera karma teAmAdera janye teAmAdera karma| evaM AmarA tA~rai prati ekaniSTha|

athavA teAmarA ki valacha ye, nizcaYai ivrAhIma, isamAIla, isahAka, iYAkuva (AH) o tAdera santAnagana ihudI athavA khrISTAna chilena? Apani vale dina, teAmarA vezI jAna, nA AllAha vezI jAnena? tAra cAite atyAcArI ke, ye AllAhara pakSa theke tAra kAche pramANita sAkSyake geApana kare? AllAha teAmAdera karma samparke vekhavara nana|
se sampradAYa atIta haYe geche| tArA yA kareche, tA tAdera janye evaM teAmarA yA karacha, tA teAmAdera janye| tAdera karma samparke teAmAdera jijJesa karA have nA|
ekhana nirveAdherA valave, kise musalamAnadera phiriYe dila tAdera ai kevalA theke, yAra upara tArA chila? Apani valunaH pUrva o pazcima AllAharai| tini yAke icchA sarala pathe cAlAna|

emanibhAve Ami teAmAderake madhyapanthI sampradAYa karechi yAte kare teAmarA sAkSyadAtA hao mAnavamanDalIra janye evaM yAte rasUla sAkSyadAtA hana teAmAdera janya| Apani ye kevalAra upara chilena, tAke Ami ejanyai kevalA karechilAma, yAte ekathA pratIYamAna haYa ye, ke rasUlera anusArI thAke Ara ke piThaTAna deYa| nizcitai eTA kaTheAratara viSaYa, kintu tAdera janye naYa, yAderake AllAha pathapradarzana karechena| AllAha emana nana ye, teAmAdera ImAna naSTa kare devena| nizcaYai AllAha, mAnuSera prati atyanta snehazIla, karunAmaYa|

nizcaYai Ami ApanAke vAra vAra AkAzera dike tAkAte dekhi| ataeva, avazyai Ami ApanAke se kevalAra dikei ghuriYe deva yAke Apani pachanda karena| ekhana Apani masajidula-hArAmera dike mukha karuna evaM teAmarA yekhAnei thAka, sedike mukha kara| yArA Ahale-kitAva, tArA avazyai jAne ye, eTAi Thika pAlanakartAra pakSa theke| AllAha vekhavara nana, se samasta karma samparke yA tArA kare|

yadi Apani Ahale kitAvadera kAche samudaYa nidarzana upasthApana karena, tavuo tArA ApanAra kevalA mene neve nA evaM Apanio tAdera kevalA mAnena nA| tArAo eke anyera kevalA mAne nA| yadi Apani tAdera vAsanAra anusaraNa karena, se jJAnalAbhera para, yA ApanAra kAche pau~cheche, tave nizcaYa Apani avicArakArIdera antarbhukta havena|
Ami yAderake kitAva dAna karechi, tArA tAke cene, yemana kare cene nijedera putraderake| Ara nizcaYai tAdera ekaTi sampradAYa jene zune satyake geApana kare|
vAstava satya seTAi yA teAmAra pAlanakartA valena| kAjei tumi sandihAna haYeA nA|

Ara savAra janyai raYeche kevalA ekeka dike, ye dike se mukha kare (evAdata karave)| kAjei satkAje pratiyeAgitAmUlakabhAve egiYe yAo| yekhAnei teAmarA thAkave, AllAha avazyai teAmAderake samaveta karavena| nizcaYai AllAha sarva viSaYe kSamatAzIla|

Ara ye sthAna theke tumi vera hao, nijera mukha masajide hArAmera dike pherAo-niHsandehe eTAi haleA teAmAra pAlanakartAra pakSa theke nirdhArita vAstava satya| vastutaH teAmAra pAlanakartA teAmAdera kAryakalApa samparke anavahita nana|

Ara teAmarA yekhAna thekei veriYe Asa evaM yekhAnei avasthAna kara, sedikei mukha pherAo, yAte kare mAnuSera janya teAmAdera sAthe jhagar3A karAra avakAza nA thAke| avazya yArA avivecaka, tAdera kathA AlAdA| kAjei tAdera Apattite bhIta haYeA nA| AmAkei bhaYa kara| yAte Ami teAmAdera janye AmAra anugraha samUha pUrNa kare dei evaM tAte yena teAmarA saralapatha prApta hao|

yemana, Ami pAThiYechi teAmAderai madhya theke teAmAdera janye ekajana rasUla, yini teAmAdera nikaTa AmAra vANIsamuha pATha karavena evaM teAmAdera pavitra karavena; Ara teAmAdera zikSA devena kitAva o tA~ra tattvajJAna evaM zikSA devena emana viSaYa yA kakhaneA teAmarA jAnate nA|
sutarAM teAmarA AmAke smaraNa kara, Amio teAmAdera smaraNa rAkhaveA evaM AmAra kRtajJatA prakAza kara; akRtajJa haYeA nA|
he mumina gana! teAmarA dhairyya o nAmAyera mAdhyame sAhAyya prArthanA kara| nizcitai AllAha dhairyyazIladera sAthe raYechena|
Ara yArA AllAhara rAstAYa nihata haYa, tAdera mRta valeA nA| varaM tArA jIvita, kintu teAmarA tA vujha nA|
evaM avazyai Ami teAmAdigake parIkSA karava kichuTA bhaYa, kSudhA, mAla o jAnera kSati o phala-phasala vinaSTera mAdhyame| tave susaMvAda dAo savarakArIdera|
yakhana tArA vipade patita haYa, takhana vale, nizcaYa AmarA savAi AllAhara janya evaM AmarA savAi tA~rai sAnnidhye phire yAveA|
tArA se samasta leAka, yAdera prati AllAhara aphuranta anugraha o rahamata raYeche evaM esava leAkai hedAYeta prApta|

niHsandehe sAphA o mAraoYA AllAha tA’AlAra nidarzana guleAra anyatama| sutarAM yArA kA’vA ghare hajva vA omarAha pAlana kare, tAdera pakSe e duTite pradakSiNa karAte keAna deASa nei| varaM keu yadi svecchAYa kichu nekIra kAja kare, tave AllAha tA’AlAra avazyai tA avagata havena evaM tAra se Amalera saThika mulya devena|

nizcaYa yArA geApana kare, Ami yesava vistArita tathya evaM hedAYetera kathA nAyila karechi mAnuSera janya kitAvera madhye vistArita varNanA karAra parao; se samasta leAkera pratii AllAhara abhisampAta evaM anyAnya abhisampAtakArIgaNera o|
tave yArA taovA kare evaM varNita tathyAdira saMzeAdhana kare mAnuSera kAche tA varNanA kare deYa, se samasta leAkera taovA Ami kavula kari evaM Ami taovA kavulakArI parama daYAlu|
nizcaYa yArA kupharI kare evaM kAphera avasthAYai mRtyuvaraNa kare, se samasta leAkera prati AllAhara pherezatAganera evaM samagra mAnuSera lA’nata|
erA cirakAla e lA’natera mAjhei thAkave| tAdera upara theke AyAva kakhanao hAlakA karA have nA varaM erA virAma o pAve nA|
Ara teAmAdera upAsya ekaimAtra upAsya| tini chAr3A mahA karuNAmaYa daYAlu keu nei|

nizcaYai AsamAna o yamInera sRSTite, rAta o dinera vivartane evaM nadIte neৗkAsamUhera calAcale mAnuSera janya kalyANa raYeche| Ara AllAha tA’ AlA AkAza theke ye pAni nAyila karechena, taddvArA mRta yamInake sajIva kare tulechena evaM tAte char3iYe diYechena savarakama jIva-jantu| Ara AvahAoYA parivartane evaM meghamAlAra yA tA~rai hukumera adhIne AsamAna o yamInera mAjhe vicaraNa kare, nizcaYai se samasta viSaYera mAjhe nidarzana raYeche vuddhimAna sampradAYera janye|

Ara keAna leAka emanao raYeche yArA anyAnyake AllAhara samakakSa sAvyasta kare evaM tAdera prati temani bhAlavAsA peASaNa kare, yemana AllAhara prati bhAlavAsA haYe thAke| kintu yArA AllAhara prati ImAnadAra tAdera bhAlavAsA odera tulanAYa vahuguNa vezI| Ara katainA uttama ha’ta yadi e jAlemarA pArthiva keAna keAna AyAva pratyakSa karei upalavdhi kare nita ye, yAvatIYa kSamatA zudhumAtra AllAharai janya evaM AllAhara AyAvai savaceYe kaThinatara|
anusRtarA yakhana anusaraNakArIdera prati asantuSTa haYe yAve evaM yakhana AyAva pratyakSa karave Ara vicchinna haYe yAve tAdera pArasparika samasta samparka|

evaM anusArIrA valave, katainA bhAla hata, yadi AmAdigake pRthivIte phire yAvAra suyeAga deYA hata| tAhale AmarAo tAdera prati temani asantuSTa haYe yetAma, yemana tArA asantuSTa haYeche AmAdera prati| ebhAvei AllAha tA’AlA tAderake dekhAvena tAdera kRtakarma tAderake anutapta karAra janye| athaca, tArA kasminakAleo Aguna theke vera hate pArave nA|
he mAnava manDalI, pRthivIra hAlAla o pavitra vastu-sAmagrI bhakSana kara| Ara zaYatAnera padAGka anusaraNa kareA nA| se niHsandehe teAmAdera prakAzya zatru|
se teA e nirdezai teAmAdigake deve ye, teAmarA anyAYa o azlIla kAja karate thAka evaM AllAhara prati emana sava viSaYe mithyAreApa kara yA teAmarA jAna nA|

Ara yakhana tAderake keu vale ye, se hukumerai Anugatya kara yA AllAha tA’AlA nAyila karechena, takhana tArA vale kakhaneA nA, AmarA teA se viSaYerai anusaraNa karava| yAte AmarA AmAdera vApa-dAdAderake dekhechi| yadi o tAdera vApa dAdArA kichui jAnateA nA, jAnateA nA sarala pathao|

vastutaH ehena kApheradera udAharaNa emana, yena keu emana keAna jIvake AhavAna karache yA keAna kichui zeAne nA, hA~ka-DAka Ara citkAra chAr3A vadhira muka, evaM andha| sutarAM tArA kichui veAjhe nA|
he ImAnadAragaNa, teAmarA pavitra vastu sAmagrI AhAra kara, yeguleA Ami teAmAderake ruyI hisAve dAna karechi evaM zukariYA AdAYa kara AllAhara, yadi teAmarA tA~rai vandegI kara|

tini teAmAdera upara hArAma karechena, mRta jIva, rakta, zukara mAMsa evaM sesava jIva-jantu yA AllAha vyAtIta apara kAreA nAme utsarga karA haYa| avazya ye leAka ananyeApAYa haYe par3e evaM nApharamAnI o sImAlaGghanakArI nA haYa, tAra janya keAna pApa nei| niHsandehe AllAha mahAna kSamAzIla, atyanta daYAlu|

nizcaYa yArA sesava viSaYa geApana kare, yA AllAha kitAve nAyila karechena evaM sejanya alpa mUlya grahaNa kare, tArA Aguna chAr3A nijera peTe Ara kichui DhukAYa nA| Ara AllAha keYAmatera dina tAdera sAthe nA kathA valavena, nA tAdera pavitra karA have, vastutaH tAdera janye raYeche vedanAdAYaka AyAva|
erAi hala se samasta leAka, yArA hedAYetera vinimaYe geAmarAhI kharida kareche evaM (kharida kareche) kSamA o anugrahera vinimaYe AyAva| ataeva, tArA deAyakhera upara kemana dhairyya dhAraNakArI|
Ara eTA ejanye ye, AllAha nAyila karechena satyapUrNa kitAva| Ara yArA ketAvera mAjhe matavireAdha sRSTi kareche nizcaYai tArA jedera vazavartI haYe aneka dUre cale geche|

satkarma zudhu ei naYa ye, pUrva kiMvA pazcimadike mukha karave, varaM var3a satkAja hala ei ye, ImAna Anave AllAhara upara kiYAmata divasera upara, pherezatAdera upara evaM samasta navI-rasUlagaNera upara, Ara sampada vyaYa karave tA~rai mahavvate AtnIYa-svajana, etIma-misakIna, musAphira-bhikSuka o muktikAmI krItadAsadera janye| Ara yArA nAmAya pratiSThA kare, yAkAta dAna kare evaM yArA kRta pratijJA sampAdanakArI evaM abhAve, reAge-zeAke o yuddhera samaYa dhairyya dhAraNakArI tArAi hala satyAzraYI, Ara tArAi paraheyagAra|

he ImAnadAragana! teAmAdera prati nihatadera vyApAre kesAsa grahaNa karA vidhivaddha karA haYeche| svAdhIna vyakti svAdhIna vyaktira vadalAYa, dAsa dAsera vadalAYa evaM nArI nArIra vadalAYa| ataHpara tAra bhAiYera tarapha theke yadi kAuke kichuTA mApha kare deYA haYa, tave pracalita niYamera anusaraNa karave evaM bhAlabhAve tAke tA pradAna karate have| eTA teAmAdera pAlanakartAra tarapha theke sahaja evaM vizeSa anugraha| eraparao ye vyAkti vAr3AvAr3i kare, tAra janya raYeche vedanAdAYaka AyAva|
he vuddhimAnagaNa! kesAsera madhye teAmAdera janye jIvana raYeche, yAte teAmarA sAvadhAna hate pAra|

teAmAdera kAreA yakhana mRtyura samaYa upasthita haYa, se yadi kichu dhana-sampada tyAga kare yAYa, tave tAra janya osIYata karA vidhivaddha karA haleA, pitA-mAtA o nikaTAtnIYadera janya inasAphera sAthe paraheyagAradera janya e nirdeza jarurI|
yadi keu osIYata zeAnAra para tAte keAna rakama parivartana sAdhana kare, tave yArA parivartana kare tAdera upara era pApa patita have| nizcaYa AllAha tA’AlA savakichu zeAnena o jAnena|

yadi keu osIYatakArIra pakSa theke AzaMkA kare pakSapAtitvera athavA keAna aparAdhamUlaka siddhAntera evaM tAdera madhye mImAMsA kare deYa, tave tAra keAna geAnAha have nA| nizcaYa AllAha tA’AlA kSamAzIla, ati daYAlu|
he ImAnadAragaNa! teAmAdera upara reAjA pharaya karA haYeche, yerUpa pharaja karA haYechila teAmAdera pUrvavartI leAkadera upara, yena teAmarA paraheyagArI arjana karate pAra|

gaNanAra kaYekaTi dinera janya ataHpara teAmAdera madhye ye, asukha thAkave athavA saphare thAkave, tAra pakSe anya samaYe se reAjA pUraNa kare nite have| Ara eTi yAdera janya atyanta kaSTa dAYaka haYa, tArA era parivarte ekajana misakInake khAdyadAna karave| ye vyakti khuzIra sAthe satkarma kare, tA tAra janya kalyANa kara haYa| Ara yadi reAjA rAkha, tave teAmAdera janye vizeSa kalyANakara, yadi teAmarA tA vujhate pAra|

ramayAna mAsai hala se mAsa, yAte nAyila karA haYeche keAraAna, yA mAnuSera janya hedAYeta evaM satyapatha yAtrIdera janya suSpaSTa patha nirdeza Ara nyAYa o anyAYera mAjhe pArthakya vidhAnakArI| kAjei teAmAdera madhye ye leAka e mAsaTi pAve, se e mAsera reAyA rAkhave| Ara ye leAka asustha kiMvA musAphira avasthAYa thAkave se anya dine gaNanA pUraNa karave| AllAha teAmAdera janya sahaja karate cAna; teAmAdera janya jaTilatA kAmanA karena nA yAte teAmarA gaNanA pUraNa kara evaM teAmAdera hedAYeta dAna karAra daruna AllAha tA’AlAra mahattva varNanA kara, yAte teAmarA kRtajJatA svIkAra kara|

Ara AmAra vAndArA yakhana teAmAra kAche jijJesa kare AmAra vyApAre vastutaH Ami raYechi sannikaTe| yArA prArthanA kare, tAdera prArthanA kavula kare nei, yakhana AmAra kAche prArthanA kare| kAjei AmAra hukuma mAnya karA evaM AmAra prati niHsaMzaYe vizvAsa karA tAdera ekAnta kartavya| yAte tArA satpathe Asate pAre|

reAyAra rAte teAmAdera strIdera sAthe sahavAsa karA teAmAdera janya hAlAla karA haYeche| tArA teAmAdera paricchada evaM teAmarA tAdera paricchada| AllAha avagata raYechena ye, teAmarA AtnapratAraNA karachile, sutarAM tini teAmAderake kSamA karechena evaM teAmAdera avyAhati diYechena| ataHpara teAmarA nijedera strIdera sAthe sahavAsa kara evaM yA kichu teAmAdera janya AllAha dAna karechena, tA Aharana kara| Ara pAnAhAra kara yatakSaNa nA kAla rekhA theke bheArera zubhra rekhA pariSkAra dekhA yAYa| ataHpara reAyA pUrNa kara rAta paryanta| Ara yatakSaNa teAmarA etekApha avasthAYa masajide avasthAna kara, tatakSaNa paryanta strIdera sAthe mizeA nA| ei haleA AllAha kartRka ve~dhe deYA sImAnA| ataeva, era kAcheo yeo nA| emanibhAve varNanA karena AllAha nijera AYAta samUha mAnuSera janya, yAte tArA vA~cate pAre|
teAmarA anyAYabhAve eke aparera sampada bheAga kareA nA| evaM janagaNera sampadera kiYadaMza jene-zune pApa panthAYa AtnasAt karAra uddeze zAsana katRpakSera hAteo tule dio nA|

teAmAra nikaTa tArA jijJesa kare natuna cA~dera viSaYe| vale dAo ye eTi mAnuSera janya samaYa nirdhAraNa evaM hajvera samaYa Thika karAra mAdhyama| Ara pechanera dika diYe ghare praveza karAra madhye keAna nekI vA kalyANa nei| avazya nekI hala AllAhake bhaYa karAra madhye| Ara teAmarA ghare praveza kara darajA diYe evaM AllAhake bhaYa karate thAka yAte teAmarA nijedera vAsanAYa kRtakArya hate pAra|
Ara lar3Ai kara AllAhara oYAste tAdera sAthe, yArA lar3Ai kare teAmAdera sAthe| avazya kAreA prati vAr3AvAr3i kareA nA| nizcaYai AllAha sImAlaGghanakArIderake pachanda karena nA|

Ara tAderake hatyAkara yekhAne pAo sekhAnei evaM tAderake vera kare dAo sekhAna theke yekhAna theke tArA vera kareche teAmAderake| vastutaH phetanA phyAsAda vA dAGgA-hAGgAmA sRSTi karA hatyAra ceYeo kaThina aparAdha| Ara tAdera sAthe lar3Ai kareA nA masajidula hArAmera nikaTe yatakSaNa nA tArA teAmAdera sAthe sekhAne lar3Ai kare| avazya yadi tArA nijerAi teAmAdera sAthe lar3Ai kare| tAhale tAderake hatyA kara| ei hala kApheradera zAsti|
Ara tArA yadi virata thAke, tAhale AllAha atyanta daYAlu|

Ara teAmarA tAdera sAthe lar3Ai kara, ye paryanta nA phetanAra avasAna haYa evaM AllAhara dvIna pratiSThita haYa| ataHpara yadi tArA nivRta haYe yAYa tAhale kAreA prati keAna javaradasti nei, kintu yArA yAlema (tAdera vyApAre AlAdA)|

sammAnita mAsai sammAnita mAsera vadalA| Ara sammAna rakSA karArao vadalA raYeche| vastutaH yArA teAmAdera upara javara dasti kareche, teAmarA tAdera upara javaradasti kara, yemana javaradasti tArA kareche teAmAdera upara| Ara teAmarA AllAhake bhaYa kara evaM jene rAkha, yArA paraheyagAra, AllAha tAdera sAthe raYechena|
Ara vyaYa kara AllAhara pathe, tave nijera jIvanake dhvaMsera sammukhIna kareA nA| Ara mAnuSera prati anugraha kara| AllAha anugrahakArIderake bhAlavAsena|

Ara teAmarA AllAhara uddezye hajjva omarAha paripUrNa bhAve pAlana kara| yadi teAmarA vAdhA prApta hao, tAhale keAravAnIra janya yAkichu sahajalabhya, tAi teAmAdera upara dhArya| Ara teAmarA tatakSaNa paryanta mAthA munDana karave nA, yatakSaNa nA keAravANI yathAsthAne pauche yAve| yArA teAmAdera madhye asustha haYe par3ave kiMvA mAthAYa yadi keAna kaSTa thAke, tAhale tAra parivarte reAjA karave kiMvA khaYarAta deve athavA kuravAnI karave| Ara teAmAdera madhye yArA hajjva omarAha ekatre ekai sAthe pAlana karate cAo, tave yAkichu sahajalabhya, tA diYe kuravAnI karAi tAra upara kartavya| vastutaH yArA keAravAnIra pazu pAve nA, tArA hajjvera dinaguleAra madhye reAjA rAkhave tinaTi Ara sAtaTi reAyA rAkhave phire yAvAra para| ebhAve dazaTi reAyA pUrNa haYe yAve| e nirdezaTi tAdera janya, yAdera parivAra parijana masajidula hArAmera Aze-pAze vasavAsa kare nA| Ara AllAhake bhaYa karate thAka| sandehAtItabhAve jeneA ye, AllAhara AyAva var3ai kaThina|

hajjve kaYekaTi mAsa Ache suvidita| esava mAse ye leAka hajjvera paripUrNa niYata karave, tAra pakSe strIo sAthe nirAbharaNa haoYA jAYeja naYa| nA azeAbhana keAna kAja karA, nA jhAgar3A-vivAda karA hajjvera sei samaYa jAYeja naYa| Ara teAmarA yAkichu satkAja kara, AllAha teA jAnena| Ara teAmarA pAtheYa sAthe niYe nAo| niHsandehe sarveAttama pAtheYa hacche AllAhara bhaYa| Ara AmAke bhaYa karate thAka, he vuddhimAnagana!

teAmAdera upara teAmAdera pAlanakartAra anugraha anveSana karAYa keAna pApa nei| ataHpara yakhana taoYAphera janya phire Asave ArAphAta theke, takhana mAza‘ Are-hArAmera nikaTe AllAhake smaraNa kara| Ara tA~ke smaraNa kara temani kare, yemana teAmAdigake hedAYeta karA haYeche| Ara nizcaYai itipUrve teAmarA chile ajJa|
ataHpara taoYAphera janye drutagatite sekhAna theke phire Asa, yekhAna theke savAi phire| Ara AllAhara kAchei mAgapherAta kAmanA kara| nizcaYai AllAha kSamAkArI, karunAmaYa|

Ara ataHpara yakhana hajjvera yAvatIYa anuSThAnakriYAdi samApta kare sArave, takhana smaraNa karave AllAhake, yemana kare teAmarA smaraNa karate nijedera vApa-dAdAderake; varaM tAra ceYeo vezI smaraNa karave| tArapara aneke teA vale ye paraoYAdegAra! AmAdigake duniYAte dAna kara| athaca tAra janye parakAle keAna aMza nei|
Ara tAdera madhye keu keu vale-he paraoYAradegAra! AmAdigake dunaYAteo kalyANa dAna kara evaM AkherAteo kalyANa dAna kara evaM AmAdigake deAyakhera AyAva theke rakSA kara|
ederai janya aMza raYeche nijedera upArjita sampadera| Ara AllAha druta hisAva grahaNakArI|

Ara smaraNa kara AllAhake nirdiSTa saMkhyaka kaYekaTi dine| ataHpara ye leAka tAr3Ahur3A kare cale yAve zudhu du, dinera madhye, tAra janye keAna pApa nei| Ara ye leAka theke yAve tA~ra upara keAna pApa nei, avazya yArA bhaYa kare| Ara teAmarA AllAhake bhaYa karate thAka evaM nizcita jene rAkha, teAmarA savAi tAra sAmane samaveta have|

Ara emana kichu leAka rayeche yAdera pArthiva jIvanera kathAvArtA teAmAke camatkRta karave| Ara tArA sAkSya sthApana kare AllAhake nijera manera kathAra vyApAre| prakRtapakSe tArA kaThina jhagar3ATe leAka|
yakhana phire yAYa takhana ceSTA kare yAte sekhAne akalyANa sRSTi karate pAre evaM zasyakSetra o prANanAza karate pAre| AllAha phAsAda o dAGgA-hAGgAmA pachanda karena nA|
Ara yakhana tAke valA haYa ye, AllAhake bhaYa kara, takhana tAra pApa tAke ahaGkAre udvuddha kare| sutarAM tAra janye deAyakhai yatheSTa| Ara niHsandehe tA haleA nikRSTatara ThikAnA|
Ara mAnuSera mAjhe eka zreNIra leAka raYeche yArA AllAhara santuSTikalpe nijedera jAnera vAji rAkhe| AllAha halena tA~ra vAndAdera prati atyanta meheravAna|
he ImAnadAra gana! teAmarA paripUrNabhAve isalAmera antarbhukta haYe yAo evaM zaYatAnera padAMka anusaraNa kara nA| nizcita rUpe se teAmAdera prakAzya zatru|
ataHpara teAmAdera mAjhe pariskAra nirdeza ese geche vale jAnAra pareo yadi teAmarA padaskhalita hao, tAhale nizcita jene rekheA, AllAha, parAkramazAlI, vijJa|
tArA ki se dikei tAkiYe raYeche ye, meghera Ar3Ale tAdera sAmane Asavena AllAha o pherezatAgaNa? Ara tAtei sava mImAMsA haYe yAve| vastutaH savakAryakalApai AllAhara nikaTa giYe pau~chave|

vanI isarAIladigake jijJesa kara, tAderake Ami kata spaSTa nirdazanAvalI dAna karechi| Ara AllAhara neYAmata peৗche yAoYAra para yadi keu se neYAmatake parivartita kare deYa, tave AllAhara AyAva ati kaThina|

pArthiva jIvanera upara kApheradigake ummatta kare deYA haYeche| Ara tArA ImAnadAradera prati lakSya kare hAsAhAsi kare| pakSAntare yArA paraheyagAra tArA sei kApheradera tulanAYa keYAmatera dina atyanta uccamaryAdAYa thAkave| Ara AllAha yAke icchA sImAhIna ruyI dAna karena|

sakala mAnuSa ekai jAti sattAra antarbhukta chila| ataHpara AllAha tA’AlA paYagamvara pAThAlena susaMvAdadAtA o bhIti pradarzanakarI hisAve| Ara tA~dera sAthe avartINa karalena satya kitAva, yAte mAnuSera mAjhe vitarkamUlaka viSaYe mImAMsA karate pArena| vastutaH kitAvera vyApAre anya keu matabheda kareni; kintu pariSkAra nirdeza ese yAvAra para nijedera pArasparika jedavazataH tArAi kareche, yArA kitAva prApta haYechila| ataHpara AllAha ImAnadAraderake hedAYeta karechena sei satya viSaYe, ye vyApAre tArA matabheda lipta haYechila| AllAha yAke icchA, sarala patha vAtale dena|

teAmAdera ki ei dhAraNA ye, teAmarA jAnnAte cale yAve, athaca se leAkadera avasthA atikrama karani yArA teAmAdera pUrve atIta haYeche| tAdera upara eseche vipada o kaSTa| Ara emani bhAve ziharita hate haYeche yAte navI o tA~ra prati yArA ImAna enechila tAderake paryanta ekathA valate haYeche ye, kakhana Asave AllAhara sAhAyye! teAmarA zeAne nAo, AllAhara sAhAyye ekAntai nikaTavartI|

teAmAra kAche jijJesa kare, ki tArA vyaYa karave? vale dAo-ye vastui teAmarA vyaYa kara, tA have pitA-mAtAra janye, AtnIYa-Apanajanera janye, etIma-anAthadera janye, asahAYadera janye evaM musAphiradera janye| Ara teAmarA ye keAna satkAja karave, niHsandehe tA atyanta bhAlabhAvei AllAhara jAnA raYeche|

teAmAdera upara yuddha pharaya karA haYeche, athaca tA teAmAdera kAche apachandanIYa| pakSAntare teAmAdera kAche haYateA keAna ekaTA viSaYa pachandasai naYa, athaca tA teAmAdera janya kalyANakara| Ara haYateAvA keAna ekaTi viSaYa teAmAdera kAche pachandanIYa athaca teAmAdera janye akalyANakara| vastutaH AllAhai jAnena, teAmarA jAna nA|

sammAnita mAsa samparke teAmAra kAche jijJesa kare ye, tAte yuddha karA kemana? vale dAo ete yuddha karA bhISaNa var3a pApa| Ara AllAhara pathe prativandvakatA sRSTi karA evaM kupharI karA, masajide-hArAmera pathe vAdhA deYA evaM sekhAnakAra adhivAsIderake vahiskAra karA, AllAhara nikaTa tAra ceYeo var3a pApa| Ara dharmera vyApAre phetanA sRSTi karA narahatyA apekSAo mahA pApa| vastutaH tArA teA sarvadAi teAmAdera sAthe yuddha karate thAkave, yAte kare teAmAdigake dvIna theke phiriYe dite pAre yadi sambhava haYa| teAmAdera madhye yArA nijera dvIna theke phire dA~r3Ave evaM kAphera avasthAYa mRtyuvaraNa karave, duniYA o AkherAte tAdera yAvatIYa Amala vinaSTa haYe yAve| Ara tArAi haleA deAyakhavAsI| tAte tArA cirakAla vAsa karave|

Ara ete keAna sandehera avakAza nei ye, yArA ImAna eneche evaM yArA hijarata kareche Ara AllAhara pathe lar3Ai (jehAda) kareche, tArA AllAhara rahamatera pratyAzI| Ara AllAha hacchena kSamAkArI karunAmaYa|

tArA teAmAke mada o juYA samparke jijJesa kare| vale dAo, etadubhaYera madhye raYeche mahApApa| Ara mAnuSera janye upakAritAo raYeche, tave eguleAra pApa upakAritA apekSA aneka var3a| Ara teAmAra kAche jijJesa kare, ki tArA vyaYa karave? vale dAo, nijedera praYeAjanIYa vyaYera para yA vA~ce tAi kharaca karave| ebhAvei AllAha teAmAdera janye nirdeza suspaSTarUpe varNanA karena, yAte teAmarA cintA karate pAra|

duniYA o AkherAtera viSaYe| Ara teAmAra kAche jijJesa kare, etIma saMkrAnta hukuma| vale dAo, tAdera kAja-karma saThikabhAve guchiYe deYA uttama Ara yadi tAdera vyaYabhAra nijera sAthe miziYe nAo, tAhale mane karave tArA teAmAdera bhAi | vastutaH amaGgalakAmI o maGgalakAmIderake AllAha jAnena| AllAha yadi icchA karatena, tAhale teAmAdera upara jaTilatA AreApa karate pAratena| nizcaYai tini parAkramazAlI, mahAprajJa|

Ara teAmarA muzareka nArIderake viYe kareAnA, yatakSaNa nA tArA ImAna grahaNa kare| avazya musalamAna krItadAsI muzareka nArI apekSA uttama, yadio tAderake teAmAdera kAche bhAleA lAge| evaM teAmarA (nArIrA) keAna muzarekera saGge vivAha vandhane Avaddha haYeA nA, ye paryanta se ImAna nA Ane| ekajana musalamAna krItadAsao ekajana muzarekera tulanAYa aneka bhAla, yadio teAmarA tAdera dekhe meAhita hao| tArA deAyakhera dike AhvAna kare, Ara AllAha nijera hukumera mAdhyame AhvAna karena jAnnAta o kSamAra dike| Ara tini mAnuSake nijera nirdeza vAtale dena yAte tArA upadeza grahaNa kare|

Ara teAmAra kAche jijJesa kare hAYeya (Rtu) samparke| vale dAo, eTA azuci| kAjei teAmarA hAYeya avasthAYa strIgamana theke virata thAka| takhana paryanta tAdera nikaTavartI have nA, yatakSaNa nA tArA pavitra haYe yAYa| yakhana uttama rUpe parizuddha haYe yAve, takhana gamana kara tAdera kAche, yebhAve AllAha teAmAderake hukuma diYechena| nizcaYai AllAha taovAkArI evaM apavitratA theke yArA ve~ce thAke tAderake pachanda karena|

teAmAdera strIrA haleA teAmAdera janya zasya kSetra| teAmarA yebhAve icchA tAderake vyavahAra kara| Ara nijedera janya AgAmI dinera vyavasthA kara evaM AllAhake bhaYa karate thAka| Ara nizcitabhAve jene rAkha ye, AllAhara sAthe teAmAderake sAkSAta karatei have| Ara yArA ImAna eneche tAderake susaMvAda jAniYe dAo|

Ara nijedera zapathera janya AllAhara nAmake lakSyavastu vAnio nA mAnuSera sAthe keAna AcAra AcaraNa theke paraheyagArI theke evaM mAnuSera mAjhe mImAMsA kare deYA theke ve~ce thAkAra uddezye| AllAha savakichui zunena o jAnena|
teAmAdera nirarthaka zapathera janya AllAha teAmAderake dharavena nA, kintu sesava kasamera vyApAre dharavena, teAmAdera mana yAra pratijJA kareche| Ara AllAha hacchena kSamAkArI dhairyyazIla|
yArA nijedera strIdera nikaTa gamana karavenA vale kasama kheYe vase tAdera janya cAra mAsera avakAza raYeche ataHpara yadi pArasparika mila-miza kare neYa, tave AllAha kSAmAkArI daYAlu|
Ara yadi varjana karAra saMkalpa kare neYa, tAhale nizcaYai AllAha zravaNakArI o jJAnI|

Ara tAlAkaprAptA nArI nijeke apekSAYa rAkhave tina hAYeya paryanta| Ara yadi se AllAhara prati evaM AkherAta divasera upara ImAnadAra haYe thAke, tAhale AllAha yA tAra jarAYute sRSTi karechena tA lukiYe rAkhA jAYeja naYa| Ara yadi sadbhAva rekhe calate cAYa, tAhale tAderake phiriYe nevAra adhikAra tAdera svAmIrA saMrakSaNa kare| Ara puruSadera yemana strIdera upara adhikAra raYeche, temani bhAve strIderao adhikAra raYeche puruSadera upara niYama anuyAYI| Ara nArIradera opara puruSadera zreSThatva raYeche| Ara AllAha hacche parAkramazAlI, vijJa|

tAlAke-‘rAjaI’ ha’la duvAra paryanta tArapara haYa niYamAnuyAYI rAkhave, nA haYa sahRdaYatAra saGge varjana karave| Ara nijera deYA sampada theke kichu phiriYe neYA teAmAdera janya jAYeya naYa tAdera kAcha theke| kintu ye kSetre svAmI o strI ubhaYei e vyApAre bhaYa kare ye, tArA AllAhara nirdeza vajAYa rAkhate pArave nA, ataHpara yadi teAmAdera bhaYa haYa ye, tArA ubhaYei AllAhara nirdeza vajAYa rAkhate pArave nA, tAhale sekSetre strI yadi vinimaYa diYe avyAhati niYe neYa, tave ubhaYera madhye kAreArai keAna pApa nei| ei haleA AllAha kartRka nirdhArita sImA| kAjei eke atikrama kareA nA| vastutaH yArA AllAha kartRka nirdhArita sImA laGghana karave, tArAi jAlema|

tArapara yadi se strIke (tRtIYavAra) tAlAka deYA haYa, tave se strI ye paryanta tAke chAr3A apara keAna svAmIra sAthe viYe kare nA neve, tAra janya hAlAla naYa| ataHpara yadi dvitIYa svAmI tAlAka diYe deYa, tAhale tAdera ubhaYera janyai parasparake punarAYa viYe karAte keAna pApa nei| yadi AllAhara hukuma vajAYa rAkhAra icchA thAke| Ara ei haleA AllAha kartRka nirdhArita sImA; yArA upalavdhi kare tAdera janya esava varNanA karA haYa|

Ara yakhana teAmarA strIderake tAlAka diYe dAo, ataHpara tArA nirdhArita iddata samApta kare neYa, takhana teAmarA niYama anuyAYI tAderake rekhe dAo athavA sahAnubhutira sAthe tAderake mukta kare dAo| Ara teAmarA tAderake jvAlAtana o vAr3AvAr3i karAra uddezye ATake rekheA nA| Ara yArA emana karave, nizcaYai tArA nijederai kSati karave| Ara AllAhara nirdezake hAsyakara viSaYe pariNata kareA nA| AllAhara se anugrahera kathA smaraNa kara, yA teAmAdera upara raYeche evaM tAo smaraNa kara, ye kitAva o jJAnera kathA teAmAdera upara nAyila karA haYeche yAra dvArA teAmAderake upadeza dAna karA haYa| AllAhake bhaYa kara evaM jene rAkha ye, AllAha sarvaviSaYei jJAnamaYa|

Ara yakhana teAmarA strIderake tAlAka diYe dAo evaM tArapara tArAo nirdhArita iddata pUrna karate thAke, takhana tAderake pUrva svAmIdera sAthe pArasparika sammatira bhittite niYamAnuyAYI viYe karate vAdhAdAna kareA nA| e upadeza tAkei deYA hacche, ye AllAha o keYAmata dinera upara vizvAsa sthApana kareche| era madhye teAmAdera janya raYeche ekAnta parizuddhatA o aneka pavitratA| Ara AllAha jAnena, teAmarA jAna nA|

Ara santAnavatI nArIrA tAdera santAnaderake pUrna du’vachara dudha khAoYAve, yadi dudha khAoYAvAra pUrNa meYAda samApta karate cAYa| Ara santAnera adhikArI arthAt, pitAra upara haleA se samasta nArIra kheAra-peASera dAYitva pracalita niYama anuyAYI| kAuke tAra sAmarthAtirikta cApera sammukhIna karA haYa nA| Ara mAke tAra santAnera janya kSatigrasta karA yAve nA| evaM yAra santAna tAkeo tAra santAnera kAraNe kSatira sammukhIna karA yAve nA| Ara oYArisadera uparao dAYitva ei| tArapara yadi pitA-mAtA icchA kare, tAhale du’vacharera bhitarei nijedera pArasparika parAmarzakrame dudha chAr3iYe dite pAre, tAte tAdera keAna pApa nei, Ara yadi teAmarA keAna dhAtrIra dvArA nijera santAnaderake dudha khAoYAte cAo, tAhale yadi teAmarA sAvyastakRta pracalita vinimaYa diYe dAo tAteo keAna pApa nei| Ara AllAhake bhaYa kara evaM jene rekheA ye, AllAha teAmAdera yAvatIYa kAja atyanta bhAla karei dekhena|

Ara teAmAdera madhye yArA mRtyuvaraNa karave evaM nijedera strIderake cher3e yAve, takhana se strIdera kartavya haleA nijeke cAra mAsa daza dina paryanta apekSA kariYe rAkhA| tArapara yakhana iddata pUrNa kare neve, takhana nijera vyApAre nIti saGgata vyavasthA nile keAna pApa nei| Ara teAmAdera yAvatIYa kAjera vyApArei AllAhara avagati raYeche|

Ara yadi teAmarA AkAra iGgite se nArIra viYera paYagAma dAo, kiMvA nijedera mane geApana rAkha, tave tAteo teAmAdera keAna pApa nei, AllAha jAnena ye, teAmarA avazyai se nArIdera kathA ullekha karave| kintu tAdera sAthe viYe karAra geApana pratizruti diYe rekheA nA| avazya zarIYatera nirdhArita prathA anuyAYI keAna kathA sAvyasta kare neve| Ara nirdhArita iddata samApti paryAYe nA yAoYA avadhi viYe karAra keAna icchA kareA nA| Ara ekathA jene rekheA ye, teAmAdera mane ye kathA raYeche, AllAhara tA jAnA Ache| kAjei tA~ke bhaYa karate thAka| Ara jene rekheA ye, AllAha kSamAkArI o dhairyyazIla|

strIderake sparza karAra Age evaM keAna meAhara sAvyasta karAra pUrveo yadi tAlAka diYe dAo, tave tAteo teAmAdera keAna pApa nei| tave tAderake kichu kharaca deve| Ara sAmarthyavAnadera janya tAdera sAmarthya anuyAYI evaM kama sAmarthyavAnadera janya tAdera sAdhya anuyAYI| ye kharaca pracalita raYeche tA satkarmazIladera upara dAYitva|

Ara yadi meAhara sAvyasta karAra para sparza karAra pUrve tAlAka diYe dAo, tAhale ye, meAhara sAvyasta karA haYeche tAra ardheka diYe dite have| avazya yadi nArIrA kSamA kare deYa kiMvA viYera vandhana yAra adhikAre se (arthAt, svAmI) yadi kSamA kare deYa tave tA svatantra kathA| Ara teAmarA puruSarA yadi kSamA kara, tave tA have paraheyagArIra nikaTavartI| Ara pArasparika sahAnubhUtira kathA vismRta haYeA nA| nizcaYa teAmarA yA kichu kara AllAha sesavai atyanta bhAla kare dekhena|
samasta nAmAyera prati yatnavAna hao, vizeSa kare madhyavartI nAmAyera vyApAre| Ara AllAhara sAmane ekAnta Adavera sAthe dA~r3Ao|

ataHpara yadi teAmAdera kAreA vyApAre bhaYa thAke, tAhale padacArI avasthAtei par3e nAo athavA saoYArIra upare| tArapara yakhana teAmarA nirApattA pAve, takhana AllAhake smaraNa kara, yebhAve teAmAdera zekhAneA haYeche, yA teAmarA itipUrve jAnate nA|

Ara yakhana teAmAdera madhye yArA mRtyuvaraNa karave takhana strIdera ghara theke vera nA kare eka vachara paryanta tAdera kharacera vyApAre osiYata kare yAve| ataHpara yadi se strIrA nije theke veriYe yAYa, tAhale se nArI yadi nijera vyApAre keAna uttama vyavasthA kare, tave tAte teAmAdera upara keAna pApa nei| Ara AllAha hacchena parAkramazAlI vijJatA sampanna|
Ara tAlAkaprAptA nArIdera janya pracalita niYama anuyAYI kharaca deYA paraheyagAradera upara kartavya|
ebhAvei AllAha tA’AlA teAmAdera janya svIYa nirdeza varNanA karena yAte teAmarA tA vujhate pAra|

tumi ki tAderake dekhani, yArA mRtyura bhaYe nijedera ghara cher3e veriYe giYechilena? athaca tArA chila hAjAra hAjAra| tArapara AllAha tAderake valalena mare yAo| tArapara tAderake jIvita kare dilena| nizcaYai AllAha mAnuSera upara anugrahakArI| kintu adhikAMza leAka zukariYA prakAza kare nA|
AllAhara pathe lar3Ai kara evaM jene rAkha, niHsandehe AllAha savakichu jAnena, savakichu zunena|

emana ke Ache ye, AllAhake karaja deve, uttama karaja; ataHpara AllAha tAke dviguNa-vahuguNa vRddhi kare divena| AllAhai saMkeAcita karena evaM tinii prazastatA dAna karena evaM tA~rai nikaTa teAmarA savAi phire yAve|

mUsAra pare tumi ki vanI isarAIlera ekaTi dalake dekhani, yakhana tArA valeche nijedera navIra kAche ye, AmAdera janya ekajana vAdazAha nirdhArita kare dina yAte AmarA AllAhara pathe yuddha karate pAri| navI valalena, teAmAdera pratio ki emana dhAraNA karA yAYa ye, lar3Aira hukuma yadi haYa, tAhale takhana teAmarA lar3ave nA? tArA valala, AmAdera ki haYeche ye, AmarA AllAhara pathe lar3Ai karava nA| athaca AmarA vitAr3ita haYechi nijedera ghara-vAr3I o santAna-santati theke| ataHpara yakhana lar3AiYera nirdeza haleA, takhana sAmAnya kaYekajana chAr3A tAdera savAi ghure dA~r3AleA| Ara AllAha tA’AlA jAlemadera bhAla karei jAnena|

Ara tAderake tAdera navI valalena, nizcaYai AllAha tAlUtake teAmAdera janya vAdazAha sAvyasta karechena| tArA valate lAgala tA kemana kare haYa ye, tAra zAsana calave AmAdera upara| athaca rASTrakSamatA pAoYAra kSetre tAra ceYe AmAderai adhikAra vezI| Ara se sampadera dika diYeo sacchala naYa| navI valalena, nizcaYa AllAha teAmAdera upara tAke pachanda karechena evaM svAsthya o jJAnera dika diYe prAcurya dAna karechena| vastutaH AllAha tAkei rAjya dAna karena, yAke icchA| Ara AllAha halena anugraha dAnakArI evaM sava viSaYe avagata|

vanI-isarAIladerake tAdera navI AreA valalena, tAlUtera netRtvera cihna haleA ei ye, teAmAdera kAche ekaTA sinduka Asave teAmAdera pAlakartAra pakSa theke teAmAdera manera santuSTira nimitte| Ara tAte thAkave mUsA, hAruna evaM tA~dera santAnavargera parityakta kichu sAmagrI| sindukaTike vaYe Anave pherezatArA| teAmarA yadi ImAnadAra haYe thAka, tAhale ete teAmAdera janya nizcitai paripUrNa nidarzana raYeche|

ataHpara tAlUta yakhana sainya-sAmanta niYe verula, takhana valala, nizcaYa AllAha teAmAdigake parIkSA karavena ekaTi nadIra mAdhyame| sutarAM ye leAka sei nadIra pAni pAna karave se AmAra naYa| Ara ye, leAka tAra svAda grahaNa karaleA nA, nizcaYai se AmAra leAka| kintu ye leAka hAtera A~jalA bhare sAmAnya kheYe neve tAra deASaavazya temana gurutara have nA| ataHpara savAi pAna karala se pAni, sAmAnya kaYekajana chAr3A| pare tAlUta yakhana tA pAra haleA evaM tAra sAthe chila mAtra kaYekajana ImAnadAra, takhana tArA valate lAgala, Ajakera dine jAlUta evaM tAra senAvAhinIra sAthe yuddha karAra zakti AmAdera nei, yAdera dhAraNA chila ye, AllAhara sAmane tAdera ekadina upasthita hate have, tArA vAra vAra valate lAgala, sAmAnya dalai virATa dalera meAkAvelAYa jaYI haYeche AllAhara hukume| Ara yArA dhairyyazIla AllAha tAdera sAthe raYechena|

Ara yakhana tAlUta o tAra senAvAhinI zatrura sammukhIna hala, takhana valala, he AmAdera pAlanakartA, AmAdera mane dhairyya sRSTi kare dAo evaM AmAderake dRr3hapada rAkha-Ara AmAdera sAhAyya kara se kAphera jAtira viruddhe|

tArapara ImAnadArarA AllAhara hukume jAlUtera vAhinIke parAjita kare dila evaM dAuda jAlUtake hatyA karala| Ara AllAha dAudake dAna karalena rAjya o abhijJatA| Ara tAke yA cAilena zikhAlena| AllAha yadi ekajanake aparajanera dvArA pratihata nA karatena, tAhale geATA duniYA vidhvasta haYe yeteA| kintu vizvavAsIra prati AllAha ekAntai daYAlu, karuNAmaYa|
eguleA haleA AllAhara nidarzana, yA AmarA teAmAderake yathAyathabhAve zuniYe thAki| Ara Apani nizcitai AmAra rasUlagaNera antarbhukta|

ei rasUlagaNa-Ami tAdera kAuke kAreA upara maryAdA diYechi| tAdera madhye keu teA haleA tArA yAra sAthe AllAha kathA valechena, Ara kArao maryAdA uccatara karechena evaM Ami mariYama tanaYa IsAke prakRSTa mu’jeyA dAna karechi evaM tAke zakti dAna karechi ‘ruhUla kuddusa’ arthat jivarAIlera mAdhyame| Ara AllAha yadi icchA karatena, tAhale pariskAra nirdeza ese yAvAra para paYagamvaradera pechane yArA chila tArA lar3Ai karateA nA| kintu tAdera madhye matavireAdha sRSTi haYe geche| ataHpara tAdera keu teA ImAna eneche, Ara keu haYeche kAphera| Ara AllAha yadi icchA karatena, tAhale tArA paraspara lar3Ai karateA nA, kintu AllAha tAi karena, yA tini icchA karena|
he ImAnadAragaNa! Ami teAmAderake ye ruyI diYechi, sedina AsAra pUrvei teAmarA tA theke vyaYa kara, yAte nA Ache vecA-kenA, nA Ache supAriza kiMvA vandhutva| Ara kApherarAi haleA prakRta yAlema|

AllAha chAr3A anya keAna upAsya nei, tini jIvita, savakichura dhAraka| tA~ke tandrAo sparza karate pAre nA evaM nidrAo naYa| AsamAna o yamIne yA kichu raYeche, savai tA~ra| ke Acha emana, ye supAriza karave tA~ra kAche tA~ra anumati chAr3A? dRSTira sAmane kiMvA pichane yA kichu raYeche se savai tini jAnena| tA~ra jJAnasImA theke tArA keAna kichukei pariveSTita karate pAre nA, kintu yataTuku tini icchA karena| tA~ra siMhAsana samasta AsamAna o yamInake pariveSTita kare Ache| Ara seguleAke dhAraNa karA tA~ra pakSe kaThina naYa| tinii sarveAcca evaM sarvApekSA mahAna|

dvInera vyApAre keAna javaradasti vA vAdhya-vAdhakatA nei| niHsandehe hedAYAta geAmarAhI theke pRthaka haYe geche| ekhana yArA geAmarAhakArI ‘tAguta’derake mAnave nA evaM AllAhate vizvAsa sthApana karave, se dhAraNa kare niYeche sudRr3ha hAtala yA bhAMvAra naYa| Ara AllAha savai zunena evaM jAnena|

yArA ImAna eneche, AllAha tAdera abhibhAvaka| tAderake tini vera kare Anena andhakAra theke AleAra dike| Ara yArA kupharI kare tAdera abhibhAvaka hacche tAguta| tArA tAderake AleA theke vera kare andhakArera dike niYe yAYa| erAi haleA deAyakhera adhivAsI, cirakAla tArA sekhAnei thAkave|

tumi ki se leAkake dekhani, ye pAlanakartAra vyApAre vAdAnuvAda karechila ivrAhImera sAthe e kAraNe ye, AllAha se vyAktike rAjya dAna karechilena? ivrAhIma yakhana valalena, AmAra pAlanakartA halena tini, yini jIvana dAna karena evaM mRtyu ghaTAna| se valala, Ami jIvana dAna kari evaM mRtyu ghaTiYe thAki| ivrAhIma valalena, nizcaYai tini suryake udita karena pUrva dika theke evAra tumi tAke pazcima dika theke udita kara| takhana se kAphera hatabhamva haYe gela| Ara AllAha sImAlaMghaNakArI sampradAYake sarala patha pradarzana karena nA|

tumi ki se leAkake dekhani ye emana eka janapada diYe yAcchila yAra vAr3IgharaguleA bheGge chAdera upara par3e chila? valala, kemana kare AllAha maranera para eke jIvita karavena? ataHpara AllAha tAke mRta avasthAYa rAkhalena ekaza vachara| tArapara tAke uThAlena| valalena, kata kAla ebhAve chile? valala Ami chilAma, ekadina kiMvA ekadinera kichu kama samaYa| valalena, tA naYa; varaM tumi teA ekaza vachara chile| evAra ceYe dekha nijera khAvAra o pAnIYera dike-seguleA pace yAYa ni evaM dekha nijera gAdhATira dike| Ara Ami teAmAke mAnuSera janya dRSTAnta vAnAte ceYechi| Ara hAr3aguleAra dike ceYe dekha ye, Ami eguleAke kemana kare jur3e dei evaM seguleAra upara mAMsera AvaraNa pariYe dei| ataHpara yakhana tAra upara e avasthA prakAzita hala, takhana vale uThala-Ami jAni, niHsandehe AllAha sarva viSaYe kSamatAzIla|

Ara smaraNa kara, yakhana ivrAhIma valala, he AmAra pAlanakartA AmAke dekhAo, kemana kare tumi mRtake jIvita karave| valalena; tumi ki vizvAsa kara nA? valala, avazyai vizvAsa kari, kintu dekhate ejanye cAichi yAte antare prazAnti lAbha karate pAri| valalena, tAhale cAraTi pAkhI dhare nAo| pare seguleAke nijera peASa mAniYe nAo, ataHpara seguleAra dehera ekekaTi aMza vibhinna pAhAr3era upara rekhe dAo| tArapara seguleAke DAka; teAmAra nikaTa deৗr3e cale Asave| Ara jene rAkheA, nizcaYai AllAha parAkramazAlI, ati jJAna sampanna|

yArA AllAhara rAstAYa svIYa dhana sampada vyaYa kare, tAdera udAharaNa ekaTi vIjera mata, yA theke sAtaTi zISa janmAYa| pratyekaTi zISe ekaza kare dAnA thAke evaM AllAha yAra janya icchA karena vardhita kare dena| AllAha ati dAnazIla, sarvajJa|

yArA svIYa dhana sampada AllAhara rAstAYa vyaYa kare, erapara vyaYa karAra para se anugrahera kathA prakAza kare nA evaM kaSTao deYa nA, tAderai janye tAdera pAlanakartAra kAche raYeche puraskAra evaM tAdera keAna AzaMkA nei, tArA cintitao have nA|
namra kathA vale deYA evaM kSamA pradarzana karA ai dAna khaYarAta apekSA uttama, yAra pare kaSTa deYA haYa| AllAha tA’AlA sampadazAlI, sahiJcu|

he ImAnadAragaNa!teAmarA anugrahera kathA prakAza kare evaM kaSTa diYe nijedera dAna khaYarAta varavAda kareA nA se vyaktira mata ye nijera dhana-sampada leAka dekhAneAra uddezye vyaYa kare evaM AllAha o parakAlera prati vizvAsa rAkhe nA| ataeva, e vyAktira dRSTAnta ekaTi masRNa pAtharera mata yAra upara kichu mATi par3echila| ataHpara era upara pravala vRSTi varSita haleA, anantara tAke sampUrNa pariSkAra kare dila| tArA ai vastura keAna saoYAva pAYa nA, yA tArA upArjana kareche| AllAha kAphera sampradAYake patha pradarzana karena nA|

yArA AllAhara rAstAYa svIYa dhana-sampada vyaYa kare AllAhara santuSTi arjanera lakSye evaM nijera manake sudRr3ha karAra janye tAdera udAharaNa TilAYa avasthita vAgAnera mata, yAte pravala vRSTipAta haYa; ataHpara dviguNa phasala dAna kare| yadi emana pravala vRSTipAta nAo haYa, tave hAlkA varSaNai yatheSTa| AllAha teAmAdera kAjakarma yathArthai pratyakSa karena|

teAmAdera keu pachanda kare ye, tAra ekaTi khejura o AGgurera vAgAna have, era taladeza diYe nahara pravAhita have, Ara ete sarvaprakAra phala-phasala thAkave evaM se vArdhakye peৗchave, tAra durvala santAna santatio thAkave, ematAvasthAYa e vAgAnera ekaTi ghUrNivAYu Asave, yAte Aguna raYeche, anantara vAgAnaTi bhaSmIbhUta haYe yAve? emanibhAve AllAha tA’AlA teAmAdera janye nidarzanasamUha varnanA karena-yAte teAmarA cintA-bhAvanA kara|

he ImAnadAragaNa! teAmarA svIYa upArjana theke evaM yA Ami teAmAdera janye bhUmi theke utpanna karechi, tA theke utkRSTa vastu vyaYa kara evaM tA theke nikRSTa jinisa vyaYa karate manastha kareA nA| kenanA, tA teAmarA kakhanao grahaNa karave nA; tave yadi teAmarA ceAkha vandha kare niYe nAo| jene rekheA, AllAha abhAva mukta, prazaMsita|

zaYatAna teAmAderake abhAva anaTanera bhIti pradarzana kare evaM azlIlatAra Adeza deYa| pakSAntare AllAha teAmAderake nijera pakSa theke kSamA o vezI anugrahera oYAdA karena| AllAha prAcuryamaYa, suvijJa|
tini yAke icchA vizeSa jJAna dAna karena evaM yAke vizeSa jJAna dAna karA haYa, se prabhuta kalyANakara vastu prApta haYa| upadeza tArAi grahaNa kare, yArA jJAnavAna|
teAmarA ye khaYarAta vA sadvyaYa kara kiMvA keAna mAnata kara, AllAha nizcaYai sesava kichui jAnena| anyAYakArIdera keAna sAhAyyakArI nei|

yadi teAmarA prakAzye dAna-khaYarAta kara, tave tA katainA uttama| Ara yadi khaYarAta geApane kara evaM abhAvagrastadera diYe dAo, tave tA teAmAdera janye Arao uttama| AllAha tA’AlA teAmAdera kichu geAnAha dUra kare divena| AllAha teAmAdera kAja karmera khuva khavara rAkhena|

tAderake satpathe AnAra dAYa teAmAra naYa| varaM AllAha yAke icchA satpathe paricAlita karena| ye mAla teAmarA vyaYa kara, tA nija upAkArArthei kara| AllAhara santuSTi chAr3A anya keAna uddezye vyaYa kareA nA| teAmarA ye, artha vyaYa karave, tAra puraskAra pureApuri peYe yAve evaM teAmAdera prati anyAYa karA have nA|

khaYarAta ai sakala garIva leAkera janye yArA AllAhara pathe Avaddha haYe geche-jIvikAra sandhAne anyatra gheArApherA karate sakSama naYa| ajJa leAkerA yAJcA nA karAra kAraNe tAderake abhAvamukta mane kare| teAmarA tAderake tAdera lakSaNa dvArA cinave| tArA mAnuSera kAche kAkuti-minati kare bhikSA cAYa nA| teAmarA ye artha vyaYa karave, tA AllAha tA’AlA avazyai parijJAta|
yArA svIYa dhana-sampada vyaYa kare, rAtre o dine, geApane o prakAzye| tAdera janye tAdera saoYAva raYeche tAdera pAlanakartAra kAche| tAdera keAna AzaMGkA nei evaM tArA cintita o have nA|

yArA suda khAYa, tArA kiYAmate danDAYamAna have, yebhAve danDAYamAna haYa ai vyakti, yAke zaYatAna Asara kare meAhAviSTa kare deYa| tAdera e avasthAra kAraNa ei ye, tArA valecheH kraYa-vikraYa o teA suda neYArai mata! athaca AllA’ha tA’AlA kraYa-vikraYa vaidha karechena evaM suda hArAma karechena| ataHpara yAra kAche tAra pAlanakartAra pakSa theke upadeza eseche evaM se virata haYeche, pUrve yA haYe geche, tA tAra| tAra vyApAra AllAhara upara nirbharazIla| Ara yArA punarAYa suda neYa, tArAi deAyakhe yAve| tArA sekhAne cirakAla avasthAna karave|
AllAha tA’AlA sudake nizcihna karena evaM dAna khaYarAtake vardhita karena| AllAha pachanda karena nA keAna avizvAsI pApIke|

nizcaYai yArA vizvAsa sthApana kareche, satkAja kareche, nAmAya pratiSThita kareche evaM yAkAta dAna kareche, tAdera janye tAdera puraSkAra tAdera pAlanakartAra kache raYeche| tAdera keAna zaGkA nei evaM tArA duHkhita have nA|
he ImAnadAragaNa, teAmarA AllAhake bhaYa kara evaM sudera ye samasta vakeYA Ache, tA parityAga kara, yadi teAmarA ImAnadAra haYe thAka|

ataHpara yadi teAmarA parityAga nA kara, tave AllAha o tA~ra rasUlera sAthe yuddha karate prastuta haYe yAo| kintu yadi teAmarA taovA kara, tave teAmarA nijera mUladhana peYe yAve| teAmarA kArao prati atyAcAra kareA nA evaM keu teAmAdera prati atyAcAra karave nA|
yadi khAtaka abhAvagrastha haYa, tave tAke sacchalatA AsA paryanta samaYa deYA ucita| Ara yadi kSamA kare dAo, tave tA khuvai uttama yadi teAmarA upalavdhi kara|
ai dinake bhaYa kara, ye dina teAmarA AllAhara kAche pratyAvartita have| ataHpara pratyekei tAra karmera phala pureApuri pAve evaM tAdera prati keAna rUpa avicAra karA have nA|

he muminagaNa! yakhana teAmarA keAna nirdiSTa samaYera janye Rnera AdAna-pradAna kara, takhana tA lipivaddha kare nAo evaM teAmAdera madhye keAna lekhaka nyAYasaGgatabhAve tA likhe deve; lekhaka likhate asvIkAra karave nA| AllAha tAke yemana zikSA diYechena, tAra ucita tA likhe deYA| evaM Rna grahItA yena lekhAra viSaYa vale deYa evaM se yena svIYa pAlanakartA AllAhake bhaYa kare evaM lekhAra madhye vindumAtrao veza kama nA kare| ataHpara RNagrahItA yadi nirveAdha haYa kiMvA dUrvala haYa athavA nije lekhAra viSaYavastu vale dite akSama haYa, tave tAra abhibhAvaka nyAYasaGgatabhAve likhAve| dujana sAkSI kara, teAmAdera puruSadera madhye theke| yadi dujana puruSa nA haYa, tave ekajana puruSa o dujana mahilA| ai sAkSIdera madhya theke yAderake teAmarA pachanda kara yAte ekajana yadi bhule yAYa, tave ekajana anyajanake smaraNa kariYe deYa| yakhana DAkA haYa, takhana sAkSIdera asvIkAra karA ucita naYa| teAmarA eTA likhate alasatA kareAnA, tA cheATa heAka kiMvA var3a, nirdiSTa samaYa paryanta| e lipivaddha karaNa AllAhara kAche suvicArake adhika kAYema rAkhe, sAkSyake adhika susaMhata rAkhe evaM teAmAdera sandehe patita nA haoYAra pakSe adhika upayukta| kintu yadi kAravAra nagada haYa, paraspara hAte hAte AdAna-pradAna kara, tave tA nA likhale teAmAdera prati keAna abhiyeAga nei| teAmarA kraYa-vikraYera samaYa sAkSI rAkha| keAna lekhaka o sAkSIke kSatigrasta kareA nA| yadi teAmarA erUpa kara, tave tA teAmAdera pakSe pApera viSaYa| AllAhake bhaYa kara tini teAmAderake zikSA dena| AllAha sava kichu jAnena|

Ara teAmarA yadi pravAse thAka evaM keAna lekhaka nA pAo tave vandhakI vantu hastagata rAkhA ucita| yadi eke anyake vizvAsa kare, tave yAke vizvAsa karA haYa, tAra ucita anyera prApya parizeAdha karA evaM svIYa pAlanakartA AllAhake bhaYa kara! teAmarA sAkSya geApana kareA nA| ye keu tA geApana karave, tAra antara pApapUrNa have| teAmarA yA karA, AllAha se samparke khuva jJAta|

yA kichu AkAzasamUhe raYeche evaM yA kichu yamIne Ache, sava AllAharai| yadi teAmarA manera kathA prakAza kara kiMvA geApana kara, AllAha teAmAdera kAcha theke tAra hisAva nevena| ataHpara yAke icchA tini kSamA karavena evaM yAke icchA tini zAsti devena| AllAha sarvaviSaYe zaktimAna|

rasUla vizvAsa rAkhena ai samasta viSaYa samparke yA tA~ra pAlanakartAra pakSa theke tA~ra kAche avatIrNa haYeche evaM musalamAnarAo savAi vizvAsa rAkhe AllAhara prati, tA~ra pherezatAdera prati, tA~ra granthasamuhera prati evaM tA~ra paYagamvaragaNera prati| tArA vale AmarA tA~ra paYagamvaradera madhye keAna tAratamya karinA| tArA vale, AmarA zunechi evaM kavula karechi| AmarA teAmAra kSamA cAi, he AmAdera pAlanakartA| teAmArai dike pratyAvartana karate have|

AllAha kAuke tAra sAdhyAtIta keAna kAjera bhAra dena nA, se tAi pAYa yA se upArjana kare evaM tAi tAra upara vartAYa yA se kare| he AmAdera pAlanakartA, yadi AmarA bhule yAi kiMvA bhula kari, tave AmAderake aparAdhI kareA nA| he AmAdera pAlanakartA! evaM AmAdera upara emana dAYitva arpaNa kareA nA, yemana AmAdera pUrvavartIdera upara arpaNa karecha, he AmAdera prabhU! evaM AmAdera dvArA ai veAjhA vahana kario nA, yA vahana karAra zakti AmAdera nAi| AmAdera pApa meAcana kara| AmAderake kSamA kara evaM AmAdera prati daYA kara| tumii AmAdera prabhu| sutarAM kAphera sampradAYera viruddhe AmAdera ke sAhAyye kara|
Alipha lAma mIma|
AllAha chAr3A keAna upAsya nei, tini ciraJjIva, savakichura dhAraka|
tini ApanAra prati kitAva nAyila karechena satyatAra sAthe; yA satyAYana kare pUrvavartI kitAvasamuhera|

nAyila karechena tAorata o iJjila, e kitAvera pUrve, mAnuSera hedAYetera janye evaM avatIrNa karechena mImAMsA| niHsandehe yArA AllAhara AYAtasamUha asvIkAra kare, tAdera janye raYeche kaThina AyAva| Ara AllAha hacchena parAkramazIla, pratizeAdha grahaNakArI|
AllAhara nikaTa AsamAna o yamInera keAna viSaYai geApana nei|
tinii sei AllAha, yini teAmAdera AkRti gaThana karena mAYera garbhe, yemana tini ceYechena| tini chAr3A Ara keAna upAsya nei| tini pravala parAkramazIla, prajJAmaYa|
