tinii ApanAra prati kitAva nAyila karechena| tAte kichu AYAta raYeche suspaSTa, seguleAi kitAvera Asala aMza| Ara anyaguleA rUpaka| sutarAM yAdera antare kuTilatA raYeche, tArA anusaraNa kare phitnA vistAra evaM apavyAkhyAra uddeze tanmadhyekAra rUpakaguleAra| Ara seguleAra vyAkhyA AllAha vyatIta keu jAne nA| Ara yArA jJAne sugabhIra, tArA valenaH AmarA era prati ImAna enechi| ei savai AmAdera pAlanakartAra pakSa theke avatIrNa haYeche| Ara veAdhazakti sampannerA chAr3A apara keu zikSA grahaNa kare nA|
he AmAdera pAlanakartA! sarala patha pradarzanera para tumi AmAdera antarake satyalaMghane pravRtta kareAnA evaM teAmAra nikaTa theke AmAdigake anugraha dAna kara| tumii sava kichura dAtA|
he AmAdera pAlanakartA! tumi mAnuSake ekadina avazyai ekatrita karaveH ete keAnai sandeha nei| nizcaYa AllAha tA~ra oYAdAra anyathA karena nA|
yArA kuphurI kare, tAdera dhana-sampada o santAna-santati AllAhara sAmane kakhanao kAje Asave nA| Ara tArAi hacche deAyakhera indhana|

pheraAunera sampradAYa evaM tAdera pUrvavartIdera dhArA anuyAYIi tArA AmAra AYAtasamUhake mithyA pratipanna kareche| phale tAdera pApera kAraNe AllAha tAderake pAkar3Ao karechena Ara AllAhara AyAva ati kaThina|
kApheradigake vale dina, khuva zigagIrai teAmarA parAbhUta haYe deAyakhera dike hA~kiYe nIta have-seTA katai nA nikRSTatama avasthAna|

nizcaYai duTeA dalera meAkAvilAra madhye teAmAdera janya nidarzana chila| ekaTi dala AllAhara rAhe yuddha kare| Ara apara dala chila kApheradera erA svacakSe tAderake dviguna dekhachila| Ara AllAha yAke nijera sAhAyyera mAdhyame zakti dAna karena| erai madhye zikSanIYa raYeche dRSTi sampannadera janya|

mAnavakUlake meAhagrasta kareche nArI, santAna-santati, rAzikRta svarNa-reৗpya, cihnita azva, gavAdi pazurAji evaM kSeta-khAmArera mata AkarSaNIYa vastusAmagrI| esavai hacche pArthiva jIvanera bheAgya vastu| AllAhara nikaTai haleA uttama AzraYa|

valuna, Ami ki teAmAderake esavera cAiteo uttama viSaYera sandhAna valaveA?-yArA paraheyagAra, AllAhara nikaTa tAdera janye raYeche vehezata, yAra taladeze prasravaNa pravAhita-tArA sekhAne thAkave anantakAla| Ara raYeche paricchanna saGginIgaNa evaM AllAhara santuSTi| Ara AllAha tA~ra vAndAdera prati sudRSTi rAkhena|
yArA vale, he AmAdera pAlanakartA, AmarA ImAna enechi, kAjei AmAdera geAnAha kSamA kare dAo Ara AmAderake deAyakhera AyAva theke rakSA kara|
tArA dhairyyadhAraNakArI, satyavAdI, nirdeza sampAdanakArI, satpathe vyaYakArI evaM zeSarAte kSamA prArthanAkArI|
AllAha sAkSya diYechena ye, tA~ke chAr3A Ara keAna upAsya nei| pherezatAgaNa evaM nyAYaniSTha jJAnIgaNao sAkSya diYechena ye, tini chAr3A Ara keAna ilAha nei| tini parAkramazAlI prajJAmaYa|

niHsandehe AllAhara nikaTa grahaNayeAgya dvIna ekamAtra isalAma| evaM yAdera prati kitAva deYA haYeche tAdera nikaTa prakRta jJAna AsAra parao orA matavireAdhe lipta haYeche, zudhumAtra paraspara vidveSavazataH, yArA AllAhara nidarzanasamUhera prati kupharI kare tAdera jAnA ucita ye, nizcitarUpe AllAha hisAva grahaNe atyanta druta|

yadi tArA teAmAra sAthe vitarke avatIrNa haYa tave vale dAo, "Ami evaM AmAra anusaraNakArIgaNa AllAhara prati AtnasamarpaNa karechi|" Ara Ahale kitAvadera evaM nirakSaradera vale dAo ye, teAmarAo ki AtnasamarpaNa karecha? takhana yadi tArA AtnasamarpaNa kare, tave sarala patha prApta haleA, Ara yadi mukha ghuriYe neYa, tAhale teAmAra dAYitva haleA zudhu peৗche deYA| Ara AllAhara dRSTite raYeche sakala vAndA|

yArA AllAhara nidarzanAvalIke asvIkAra kare evaM paYagamvaragaNake hatyA kare anyAYabhAve, Ara sesava leAkake hatyA kare yArA nyAYaparAYaNatAra nirdeza deYa tAderake vedanAdAYaka zAstira saMvAda dina|
erAi haleA se leAka yAdera samagra Amala duniYA o AkherAta ubhaYaleAkei vinaSTa haYe geche| pakSAntare tAdera keAna sAhAyyakArIo nei|

Apani ki tAdera dekhenani, yArA kitAvera kichu aMza peYeche-AllAhara kitAvera prati tAdera AhavAna karA haYechila yAte tAdera madhye mImAMsA karA yAYa| ataHpara tAdera madhye ekadala tA amAnya kare mukha phiriYe neYa|
tA ejanya ye, tArA vale thAke ye, deAyakhera Aguna AmAdera sparza karave nA; tave sAmAnya hAte geAnA kaYekadinera janya sparza karate pAre| nijedera udbhAvita bhittihIna kathAYa tArA dheAkA kheYeche|

kintu takhana ki avasthA dA~r3Ave yakhana Ami tAderake ekadina samaveta karaveA ye dinera Agamane keAna sandeha nei Ara nijedera kRtakarma tAdera pratyekei pAve tAdera prApya pradAna meATei anyAYa karA have nA|

valuna iYA AllAha! tumii sArvabheৗma zaktira adhikArI| tumi yAke icchA rAjya dAna kara evaM yAra kAcha theke icchA rAjya chiniYe nAo evaM yAke icchA sammAna dAna kara Ara yAke icchA apamAne patita kara| teAmArai hAte raYeche yAvatIYa kalyANa| nizcaYai tumi sarva viSaYe kSamatAzIla|

tumi rAtake dinera bhetare praveza karAo evaM dinake rAtera bhetare praveza kariYe dAo| Ara tumii jIvitake mRtera bhetara theke vera kare Ana evaM mRtake jIvitera bhetara theke vera kara| Ara tumii yAke icchA vehisAva riyika dAna kara|

muminagana yena anya muminake cher3e kona kApherake vandhurUpe grahaNa nA kare| yArA erUpa karave AllAhara sAthe tAdera kona samparka thAkave nA| tave yadi teAmarA tAdera pakSa theke keAna aniSTera AzaGkA kara, tave tAdera sAthe sAvadhAnatAra sAthe thAkave AllAha tA’AlA tA~ra samparke teAmAdera satarka karechena| evaM savAi ke tA~ra kAche phire yete have|

vale dina, teAmarA yadi manera kathA geApana kare rAkha athavA prakAza kare dAo, AllAha se savai jAnate pArena| Ara AsamAna o jamine yA kichu Ache, sesava o tini jAnena| AllAha sarva viSaYe zaktimAna|

sedina pratyekei yA kichu se bhAla kAja kareche; ceAkhera sAmane dekhate pAve evaM yA kichu manda kAja kareche tAo, orA takhana kAmanA karave, yadi tAra evaM esava karmera madhye vyavadhAna durera hateA! AllAha tA~ra nijera samparke teAmAdera sAvadhAna karachena| AllAha tA~ra vAndAdera prati atyanta daYAlu|
valuna, yadi teAmarA AllAhake bhAlavAsa, tAhale AmAke anusaraNa kara, yAte AllAha o teAmAdigake bhAlavAsena evaM teAmAdigake teAmAdera pApa mArjanA kare dena| Ara AllAha halena kSamAkArI daYAlu|
valuna, AllAha o rasUlera Anugatya prakAza kara| vastutaH yadi tArA vimukhatA avalamvana kare, tAhale AllAha kApheradigake bhAlavAsena nA|
niHsandehe AllAha Adama (AH) nUha (AH) o ivrAhIma (AH) era vaMzadhara evaM emarAnera khAndAnake nirvAcita karechena|
yArA vaMzadhara chilena parasparera| AllAha zravaNakArI o mahAjJAnI|

emarAnera strI yakhana valaleA-he AmAra pAlanakartA! AmAra garbhe yA raYeche Ami tAke teAmAra nAme utsarga karalAma savAra kAcha theke mukta rekhe| AmAra pakSa theke tumi tAke kavula kare nAo, nizcaYai tumi zravaNakArI, sarvajJAta|

ataHpara yakhana tAke prasava karaleA valala, he AmAra pAlanakartA! Ami eke kanyA prasava karechi| vastutaH ki se prasava kareche AllAha tA bhAlai jAnena| sei kanyAra mata keAna putrai ye nei| Ara Ami tAra nAma rAkhalAma mAraiYAma| Ara Ami tAke o tAra santAnaderake teAmAra AzraYe samarpaNa karachi| abhizapta zaYatAnera kavala theke|

ataHpara tA~ra pAlanakartA tA~ke uttama bhAve grahaNa kare nilena evaM tA~ke pravRddhi dAna karalena-atyanta sundara pravRddhi| Ara tA~ke yAkAriYAra tattvAvadhAne samarpana karalena| yakhanai yAkAriYA meharAvera madhye tAra kache Asatena takhanai kichu khAvAra dekhate petena| jijJesa karatena "mAraiYAma! keAthA theke esava teAmAra kAche eleA?" tini valatena, "esava AllAhara nikaTa theke Ase| AllAha yAke icchA vehisAva riyika dAna karena|"
sekhAnei yAkAriYA tA~ra pAlanakartAra nikaTa prArthanA karalena| valalena, he, AmAra pAlanakartA! teAmAra nikaTa theke AmAke puta-pavitra santAna dAna kara-nizcaYai tumi prArthanA zravaNakArI|

yakhana tini kAmarAra bhetare nAmAye dA~r3iYechilena, takhana pherezatArA tA~ke Deke valalena ye, AllAha teAmAke susaMvAda dicchena iYAhaiYA samparke, yini sAkSya devena AllAhara nirdezera satyatA samparke, yini netA havena evaM nArIdera saMsparze yAvena nA, tini atyanta satkarmazIla navI havena|
tini valalena he pAlanakartA! kemana kare AmAra putra santAna have, AmAra ye vArdhakya ese geche, AmAra strIo ye vandhyA| valalena, AllAha emani bhAvei yA icchA kare thAkena|

tini valalena, he pAlanakartA AmAra janya kichu nidarzana dAo| tini valalena, teAmAra janya nidarzana haleA ei ye, tumi tina dina paryanta kArao sAthe kathA valave nA| tave izArA iGgate karate pArave evaM teAmAra pAlanakartAke adhika parimANe smaraNa karave Ara sakAla-sandhyA tA~ra pavitratA o mahimA gheASanA karave|
Ara yakhana pherezatA valala he mAraiYAma!, AllAha teAmAke pachanda karechena evaM teAmAke pavitra paricchanna kare diYechena| Ara teAmAke vizva nArI samAjera urdhve maneAnIta karechena|
he mAraiYAma! teAmAra pAlanakartAra upAsanA kara evaM rukukArIdera sAthe sejadA o ruku kara|

e haleA gAYevI saMvAda, yA Ami ApanAke pAThiYe thAki| Ara Apani teA tAdera kAche chilena nA, yakhana pratiyeAgitA karachila ye, ke pratipAlana karave mAraiYAmake evaM Apani tAdera kAche chilena nA, yakhana tArA jhagar3A karachileA|

yakhana pherezatAgaNa valaleA, he mAraiYAma AllAha teAmAke tA~ra eka vAnIra susaMvAda dicchena, yAra nAma haleA masIha-mAraiYAma-tanaYa IsA, duniYA o AkherAte tini mahAsammAnera adhikArI evaM AllAhara ghaniSThadera antarbhUkta|
yakhana tini mAYera keAle thAkavena evaM pUrNa vaYaska havena takhana tini mAnuSera sAthe kathA valavena| Ara tini satkarmazIladera antarbhukta havena|

tini valalena, paraoYAradegAra! kemana kare AmAra santAna have; AmAke teA keAna mAnuSa sparza kareni| valalena e bhAvei AllAha yA icchA sRSTi karena| yakhana keAna kAja karAra janya icchA karena takhana valena ye, ‘haYe yAo’ amani tA haYe yAYa|
Ara tAke tini zikhiYe devena kitAva, hikamata, taorAta, iJjila|

Ara vaNI isarAIladera janye rasUla hiseve tAke maneAnIta karavena| tini valalena nizcaYai Ami teAmAdera nikaTa teAmAdera pAlanakartAra pakSa theke esechi nidarzanasamUha niYe| Ami teAmAdera janya mATira dvArA pAkhIra AkRti tairI kare dei| tArapara tAte yakhana phutkAra pradAna kari, takhana tA ur3anta pAkhIte pariNata haYe yAYa AllAhara hukume| Ara Ami sustha kare tuli janmAndhake evaM zveta kuSTha reAgIke| Ara Ami jIvita kare dei mRtake AllAhara hukume| Ara Ami teAmAderake vale dei yA teAmarA kheYe Asa evaM yA teAmarA ghare rekhe Asa| ete prakRSTa nidarzana raYeche, yadi teAmarA vizvAsI hao|

Ara eTi pUrvavartI kitAva samuhake satyAYana kare, yemana taorAta| Ara tA ejanya yAte teAmAdera janya hAlAla kare dei keAna keAna vastu yA teAmAdera janya hArAma chila| Ara Ami teAmAdera nikaTa esechi teAmAdera pAlanakartAra nidarzanasaha| kAjei AllAhake bhaYa kara evaM AmAra anusaraNa kara|
nizcaYai AllAha AmAra pAlanakartA evaM teAmAderao pAlanakartA-tA~ra evAdata kara, eTAi haleA sarala patha|

ataHpara IsA (AH) yakhana vaNI isarAYIlera kupharI samparke upalavdhi karate pAralena, takhana valalena, kArA Ache AllAhara pathe AmAke sAhAyya karave? saGgI-sAthIrA valaleA, AmarA raYechi AllAhara pathe sAhAyyakArI| AmarA AllAhara prati ImAna enechi| Ara tumi sAkSI thAka ye, AmarA hukuma kavula kare niYechi|
he AmAdera pAlanakartA! AmarA se viSaYera prati vizvAsa sthApana karechi yA tumi nAyila karecha, AmarA rasUlera anugata haYechi| ataeva, AmAdigake mAnyakArIdera tAlikAbhukta kare nAo|
evaM kAphererA cakrAnta kareche Ara AllAhao keৗzala avalamvana karechena| vastutaH AllAha hacchena sarveAttama kuzalI|

Ara smaraNa kara, yakhana AllAha valavena, he IsA! Ami teAmAke niYe neveA evaM teAmAke nijera dike tule niveA-kApheradera theke teAmAke pavitra kare deveA| Ara yArA teAmAra anugata raYeche tAderake kiYAmatera dina paryanta yArA asvIkRti jJApana kare tAdera upara jaYI kare rAkhaveA| vastutaH teAmAdera savAike AmAra kAchei phire Asate have| takhana ye viSaYe teAmarA vivAda karate, Ami teAmAdera madhye tAra phaYasAlA kare deveA|
ataeva yArA kAphera haYeche, tAderake Ami kaThina zAsti deveA duniYAte evaM AkherAte-tAdera keAna sAhAyyakArI nei|
pakSAntare yArA ImAna eneche evaM satkAja kareche| tAdera prApya paripurNabhAve deYA have| Ara AllAha atyAcArIderake bhAlavAsena nA|
Ami teAmAderake par3e zunAi e samasta AYAta evaM nizcita varNanA|
niHsandehe AllAhara nikaTa IsAra dRSTAnta hacche Adamerai mateA| tAke mATi diYe tairI karechilena evaM tArapara tAke valechilena haYe yAo, saGge saGge haYe gelena|
yA teAmAra pAlakartA valena tAi hacche yathArtha satya| kAjei teAmarA saMzaYavAdI haYeA nA|

ataHpara teAmAra nikaTa satya saMvAda ese yAoYAra para yadi ei kAhinI samparke teAmAra sAthe keu vivAda kare, tAhale vala-eseA, AmarA Deke nei AmAdera putradera evaM teAmAdera putradera evaM AmAdera strIdera o teAmAdera strIdera evaM AmAdera nijedera o teAmAdera nijedera Ara tArapara cala AmarA savAi mile prArthanA kari evaM tAdera prati AllAhara abhisampAta kari yArA mithyAvAdI|
niHsandehe eTAi haleA satya bhASaNa| Ara eka AllAha chAr3A anya keAna ilAha nei| Ara AllAha; tinii halena parAkramazAlI mahAprAjJa|
tArapara yadi tArA grahaNa nA kare, tAhale pramAda sRSTikArIderake AllAha jAnena|

valunaH ‘he Ahale-kitAvagaNa! ekaTi viSaYera dike Asa-yA AmAdera madhye o teAmAdera madhye samAna-ye, AmarA AllAha chAr3A anya kArao ivAdata karava nA, tA~ra sAthe keAna zarIka sAvyasta karava nA evaM ekamAtra AllAhake chAr3A kAuke pAlanakartA vAnAva nA| tArapara yadi tArA svIkAra nA kare, tAhale vale dAo ye, ‘sAkSI thAka AmarA teA anugata|
he Ahale kitAvagaNa! kena teAmarA ivrAhImera viSaYe vAdAnuvAda kara? athaca taorAta o iJjila tA~ra parei nAyila haYeche| teAmarA ki vujha nA?
zeAna! itipUrve teAmarA ye viSaYe kichu jAnate, tAi niYe vivAda karate| ekhana AvAra ye viSaYe teAmarA kichui jAna nA, se viSaYe kena vivAda karacha?
ivrAhIma ihudI chilena nA evaM nAsArAo chilena nA, kiktu tini chilena ‘hAnIpha’ arthAt, sava mithyA dharmera prati vimukha evaM AtnasamarpaNakArI, evaM tini muzarika chilena nA|
mAnuSadera madhye yArA ivrAhImera anusaraNa karechila, tArA, Ara ei navI evaM yArA e navIra prati ImAna eneche tArA ivrAhImera ghaniSThatama-Ara AllAha hacchena muminadera vandhu|
keAna keAna Ahale-kitAvera AkAGkhA, yAte teAmAdera geAmarAha karate pAre, kintu tArA nijedera chAr3A anya kAukei geAmarAha kare nA| athaca tArA vujhate pAre nA|
he Ahale-kitAvagaNa, kena teAmarA AllAhara kAlAmake asvIkAra kara, athaca teAmarAi tA~ra pravaktA?
he Ahale kitAvagaNa, kena teAmarA satyake mithyAra sAthe saMmizraNa karacha evaM satyake geApana karacha, athaca teAmarA tA jAna|

Ara Ahale-kitAvagaNera ekadala valaleA, musalamAnagaNera upara yA kichu avartINa haYeche tAke dinera prathama bhAge mene nAo, Ara dinera zeSa bhAge asvIkAra kara, haYateA tArA mukha phiriYe nite pAre|

yArA teAmAdera dharmamate calave, tAdera chAr3A Ara kAuke vizvAsa karave nA| vale dina niHsandehe hedAYeta seTAi, ye hedAYeta AllAha karena| Ara esava kichu e janye ye, teAmarA yA lAbha karechile tA anya keu kena prApta have, kiMvA teAmAdera pAlanakartAra sAmane teAmAdera upara tArA kena pravala haYe yAve! vale dina, maryAdA AllAharai hAte; tini yAke icchA dAna karena evaM AllAha prAcuryamaYa o sarvajJa|
tini yAke icchA nijera vizeSa anugraha dAna karena| Ara AllAha mahA anugrahazIla|

keAna keAna Ahale kitAva emanao raYeche, teAmarA yadi tAdera kAche vahu dhana-sampada AmAnata rAkha, tAhaleo tA teAmAdera yathArIti parizeAdha karave| Ara teAdera madhye aneka emanao raYeche yArA ekaTi dInAra gacchita rAkhaleo pherata deve nA-ye paryanta nA tumi tAra mAthAra upara dA~r3Ate pArave| eTA ejanya ye, tArA vale rekheche ye, ummIdera adhikAra vinaSTa karAte AmAdera keAna pApa nei| Ara tArA AllAha samparke jene zunei mithyA vale|
ye leAka nija pratijJA pUrna karave evaM parahejagAra have, avazyai AllAha parahejagAraderake bhAlavAsena|

yArA AllAhara nAme kRta aGgIkAra evaM pratijJA sAmAnya mulye vikraYa kare, AkherAte tAdera kena aMza nei| Ara tAdera sAthe keYAmatera dina AllAha kathA valavena nA| tAdera prati (karuNAra) dRSTio devena nA| Ara tAderake parizuddhao karavena nA| vastutaH tAdera janya raYeche yantraNAdAYaka AyAva|

Ara tAdera madhye ekadala raYeche, yArA vikRta uccAraNe mukha vA~kiYe kitAva pATha kare, yAte teAmarA mane kara ye, tAra kitAva thekei pATha karache| athaca tArA yA AvRtti karache tA Adeৗ kitAva naYa| evaM tArA vale ye, esava kathA AllAhara tarapha theke Agata| athaca esava AllAhara tarapha theke prerita naYa| tArA vale ye, eTi AllAhara kathA athaca esava AllAhara kathA naYa| Ara tArA jene zune AllAharai prati mithyAreApa kare|

keAna mAnuSake AllAha kitAva, hekamata o navuoYata dAna karAra para se valave ye, ‘teAmarA AllAhake parihAra kare AmAra vAndA haYe yAo’-eTA sambhava naYa| varaM tArA valave, ‘teAmarA AllAhaoYAlA haYe yAo, yemana, teAmarA kitAva zikhAte evaM yemana teAmarA nijerA o par3ate|
tAchAr3A teAmAderake ekathA valAo sambhava naYa ye, teAmarA pherezatA o navIganake nijedera pAlanakartA sAvyasta kare nAo| teAmAdera musalamAna havAra para tArA ki teAmAderake kupharI zekhAve?

Ara AllAha yakhana navIganera kAcha theke asvIkAra grahana karalena ye, Ami yA kichu teAmAdera dAna karechi kitAva o jJAna evaM ataHpara teAmAdera nikaTa keAna rasUla Asena teAmAdera kitAvake satya vale deYAra janya, takhana se rasUlera prati ImAna Anave evaM tAra sAhAyya karave| tini valalena, ‘teAmarA ki aGgIkAra karacheA evaM ei zarte AmAra oYAdA grahaNa kare niYecha? tArA valaleA, ‘AmarA aGgIkAra karechi’| tini valalena, tAhale evAra sAkSI thAka| Ara Amio teAmAdera sAthe sAkSI railAma|
ataHpara ye leAka ei oYAdA theke phire dA~r3Ave, sei have nApharamAna|
tArA ki AllAhara dvInera parivarte anya dvIna tAlAza karache? AsamAna o yamIne yA kichu raYeche svecchAYa heAka vA anicchAYa heAka, tA~rai anugata have evaM tA~ra dikei phire yAve|

valuna, AmarA ImAna enechi AllAhara upara evaM yA kichu avatIrNa haYeche AmAdera upara, ivrAhIma, isamAIla, isahAka, iYAkuva evaM tA~dera santAnavargera upara Ara yA kichu peYechena mUsA o IsA evaM anyAnya navI rasUlagaNa tA~dera pAlanakartAra pakSa theke| AmarA tA~dera kAreA madhye pArthakya kari nA| Ara AmarA tA~rai anugata|
ye leAka isalAma chAr3A anya keAna dharma tAlAza kare, kasmiNakAleo tA grahaNa karA have nA evaM AkherAte se kSati grasta|

kemana kare AllAha emana jAtike hedAYeta dAna karavena, yArA ImAna AnAra para evaM rasUlake satya vale sAkSya deYAra para evaM tAdera nikaTa pramANa ese yAoYAra para kAphera haYeche| Ara AllAha jAlema sampradAYake hedAYeta dAna karena nA|
emana leAkera zAsti haleA AllAha, pherezatAgaNa evaM mAnuSa sakalerai abhisampAta|
sarvakSaNai tArA tAte thAkave| tAdera AyAva hAlakAo have nA evaM tAra eta avakAzao pAve nA|
kintu yArA ataHpara taovA kare neve evaM satkAja karave tArA vyatIta, nizcaYa AllAha kSamAzIla o parama daYAlU|
yArA ImAna AnAra para asvIkAra kareche evaM asvIkRtite vRddhi ghaTeche, kasmiNakAleo tAdera taovA kavula karA have nA| Ara tArA haleA geAmarAha|

yadi sArA pRthivI parimANa svarNao tAra parivarte deYA haYa, tavuo yArA kAphera haYeche evaM kAphera avasthAYa mRtyuvaraNa kareche tAdera taovA kavula karA have nA| tAdera janya raYeche yantraNAdAYaka AyAva! pakSAntare tAdera keAnai sAhAyyakArI nei|
kasmiNakAleo kalyANa lAbha karate pArave nA, yadi teAmAdera priYa vastu theke teAmarA vyaYa nA kara| Ara teAmarA yadi kichu vyaYa karave AllAha tA jAnena|

taorAta nAyila haoYAra pUrve iYAkuva yeguleA nijedera janya hArAma kare niYechilena, seguleA vyatIta samasta AhArya vastui vanI-isarAYIladera janya hAlAla chila| tumi vale dAo, teAmarA yadi satyavAdI haYe thAka| tAhale taorAta niYe eseA evaM tA pATha kara|
ataHpara AllAhara prati yArA mithyA AreApa kareche, tArAi yAlema sImAlaMghanakArI|
vala, ‘AllAha satya valechena| ekhana savAi ivrAhImera dharmera anugata haYe yAo, yini chilena ekaniSTha bhAve satyadharmera anusArI| tini muzarikadera antarbhukta chilena nA|
niHsandehe sarvaprathama ghara yA mAnuSera janye nirdhArita haYeche, seTAi hacche e ghara, yA makkAYa avasthita evaM sArA jAhAnera mAnuSera janya hedAYeta o varakatamaYa|

ete raYeche makAme ivrAhImera mata prakRSTa nidarzana| Ara ye, leAka era bhetare praveza kareche, se nirApattA lAbha kareche| Ara e gharera hajva karA haleA mAnuSera upara AllAhara prApya; ye leAkera sAmarthya raYeche e paryanta peৗchAra| Ara ye leAka tA mAne nA| AllAha sArA vizvera keAna kichurai pareAYA karena nA|
valuna, he Ahale kitAvagaNa, kena teAmarA AllAhara kitAva amAnya karacheA, athaca teAmarA yA kichu kara, tA AllAhara sAmanei raYeche|

valuna, he Ahale kitAvagaNa! kena teAmarA AllAhara pathe ImAnadAradigake vAdhA dAna kara-teAmarA tAdera dvInera madhye vakratA anupraveza karAneAra panthA anusandhAna kara, athaca teAmarA e pathera satyatA pratyakSa karacha| vastutaH AllAha teAmAdera kAryakalApa samparke anavagata nana|
he ImAnadAragaNa! teAmarA yadi Ahale kitAvadera keAna pherakAra kathA mAna, tAhale ImAna AnAra para tArA teAmAdigake kAphere pariNata kare deve|

Ara teAmarA kemana kare kAphera hate pAra, athaca teAmAdera sAmane pATha karA haYa AllAhara AYAta samUha evaM teAmAdera madhye raYechena AllAhara rasUla| Ara yArA AllAhara kathA dRr3habhAve dharave, tArA hedAYeta prApta have sarala pathera|
he ImAnadAragaNa! AllAhake yemana bhaYa karA ucit Thika temanibhAve bhaYa karate thAka| evaM avazyai musalamAna nA haYe mRtyuvaraNa kareA nA|

Ara teAmarA sakale AllAhara rajjuke sudRr3ha haste dhAraNa kara; paraspara vicchinna haYeA nA| Ara teAmarA se neYAmatera kathA smaraNa kara, yA AllAha teAmAdigake dAna karechena| teAmarA paraspara zatru chile| ataHpara AllAha teAmAdera mane samprIti dAna karechena| phale, ekhana teAmarA tA~ra anugrahera kAraNe paraspara bhAi bhAi haYecha| teAmarA eka agnikunDera pAr3e avasthAna karachile| ataHpara tA theke tini teAmAderake mukti diYechena| ebhAvei AllAha nijera nidarzanasamuha prakAza karena, yAte teAmarA hedAYeta prApta hate pAra|
Ara teAmAdera madhye emana ekaTA dala thAkA ucita yArA AhavAna jAnAve satkarmera prati, nirdeza deve bhAla kAjera evaM vAraNa karave anyAYa kAja theke, Ara tArAi haleA saphalakAma|
Ara tAdera mata haYeA nA, yArA vicchinna haYe geche evaM nidarzana samUha AsAra parao vireAdhitA karate zuru kareche-tAdera janye raYeche bhaYaGkara AyAva|

sedina keAna keAna mukha ujjvala have, Ara keAna keAna mukha have kAleA| vastutaH yAdera mukha kAleA have, tAdera valA have, teAmarA ki ImAna AnAra para kAphera haYe giYechile? evAra se kupharIra vinimaYe AyAvera AsvAda grahaNa kara|
Ara yAdera mukha ujjvala have, tArA thAkave rahamatera mAjhe| tAte tArA anantakAla avasthAna karave|
eguleA hacche AllAhara nirdeza, yA teAmAdigake yathAyatha pATha kare zunAneA hacche| Ara AllAha vizva jAhAnera prati utpIr3ana karate cAna nA|
Ara yA kichu AsamAna o yamIne raYeche se savai AllAhara evaM AllAhara pratii sava kichu pratyAvartanazIla|

teAmarAi hale sarveAttama ummata, mAnavajAtira kalyAnera janyei teAmAdera udbhava ghaTAneA haYeche| teAmarA satkAjera nirdeza dAna karave o anyAYa kAje vAdhA deve evaM AllAhara prati ImAna Anave| Ara Ahale-kitAvarA yadi ImAna AnateA, tAhale tA tAdera janya maGgalakara hateA| tAdera madhye kichu teA raYeche ImAnadAra Ara adhikAMzai haleA pApAcArI|
yatsAmAnya kaSTa deYA chAr3A tArA teAmAdera keAnai kSati karate pArave nA| Ara yadi tArA teAmAdera sAthe lar3Ai kare, tAhale tArA pazcAdapasaraNa karave| ataHpara tAdera sAhAyya karA have nA|

AllAhara pratizruti kiMvA mAnuSera pratizruti vyatita orA yekhAnei avasthAna kareche sekhAnei tAdera opara lAJchanA cApiYe deYA haYeche| Ara orA upArjana kareche AllAhara gayava| odera upara cApAneA haYeche galagrahatA| tA ejanye ye, orA AllAhara AYAtasamUhake anavarata asvIkAra kareche evaM navIganake anyAYabhAve hatyA kareche| tAra kAraNa, orA nApharamAnI kareche evaM sImA laMghana kareche|
tArA savAi samAna naYa| Ahale kitAvadera madhye kichu leAka emanao Ache yArA avicalabhAve AllAhara AYAtasamUha pATha kare evaM rAtera gabhIre tArA sejadA kare|

tArA AllAhara prati o kiYAmata divasera prati ImAna rAkhe evaM kalyANakara viSaYera nirdeza deYa; akalyANa theke vAraNa kare evaM satkAjera janya sAdhyamata ceSTA karate thAke| Ara erAi hala satkarmazIla|
tArA yesava satkAja karave, keAna avasthAtei seguleAra prati avajJA pradarzana karA have nA| Ara AllAha paraheyagAradera viSaYe avagata|
nizcaYa yArA kAphera haYa, tAdera dhana sampada o santAna-santati AllAhara sAmane kakhanao keAna kAje Asave nA| Ara tArAi haleA deAyakhera Agunera adhivAsI| tArA se Agune cirakAla thAkave|

e duniYAra jIvane yA kichu vyaYa karA haYa, tAra tulanA haleA jhar3eA hAoYAra mateA, yAte raYeche tuSArera zaitya, yA se jAtira zasyakSetre giYe legeche yArA nijera janya manda kareche| ataHpara seguleAke niHzeSa kare diYeche| vastutaH AllAha tAdera upara keAna anyAYa karenani, kintu tArA nijerAi nijedera upara atyAcAra karachila|

he ImAnadAragaNa! teAmarA mumina vyatIta anya kAuke antaraGgarUpe grahaNa kareA nA, tArA teAmAdera amaGgala sAdhane keAna kraTi kare nA-teAmarA kaSTe thAka, tAtei tAdera Ananda| zatrutAprasuta vidveSa tAdera mukhei phuTe vereAYa| Ara yA kichu tAdera mane lukiYe raYeche, tA AreA anekaguNa vezI jaghanya| teAmAdera janye nidarzana vizadabhAve varNanA kare deYA haleA, yadi teAmarA tA anudhAvana karate samartha hao|

dekha! teAmarAi tAdera bhAlavAsa, kintu tArA teAmAdera prati meATeo sadabhAva peASaNa kare nA| Ara teAmarA samasta kitAvei vizvAsa kara| athaca tArA yakhana teAmAdera sAthe ese mize, vale, AmarA ImAna enechi| pakSAntare tArA yakhana pRthaka haYe yAYa, takhana teAmAdera upara reASavazataH AGgula kAmar3Ate thAke| valuna, teAmarA AkreAze marate thAka| Ara AllAha manera kathA bhAlai jAnena|

teAmAdera yadi keAna maGgala haYa; tAhale tAdera khArApa lAge| Ara teAmAdera yadi amaGgala haYa tAhale Anandita haYa Ara tAte yadi teAmarA dhairyyadhAraNa kara evaM tAkaoYA avalamvana kara, tave tAdera pratAraNAYa teAmAdera keAnai kSati have nA| nizcaYai tArA yA kichu kare se samastai AllAhara AYatte raYeche|
Ara Apani yakhana parijanadera kAcha theke sakAla velA veriYe giYe muminagaNake yuddhera avasthAne vinyasta karalena, Ara AllAha sava viSaYei zeAnena evaM jAnena|
yakhana teAmAdera duTi dala sAhasa hArAvAra upakrama haleA, athaca AllAha tAdera sAhAyyakArI chilena, Ara AllAhara uparai bharasA karA muminadera ucita|
vastutaH AllAha vadarera yuddhe teAmAdera sAhAyya karechena, athaca teAmarA chile durvala| kAjei AllAhake bhaYa karate thAka, yAte teAmarA kRtajJa hate pAreA|
Apani yakhana valate lAgalena muminagaNake-teAmAdera janya ki yatheSTa naYa ye, teAmAdera sAhAyyArthe teAmAdera pAlanakartA AsamAna theke avatIrNa tina hAjAra pherezatA pAThAvena|

avazya teAmarA yadi savara kara evaM virata thAka Ara tArA yadi takhanai teAmAdera upara car3Ao haYa, tAhale teAmAdera pAlanakartA cihnita gheAr3Ara upara pA~ca hAjAra pherezatA teAmAdera sAhAyye pAThAte pArena|
vastutaH eTA teA AllAha teAmAdera susaMvAda dAna karalena, yAte teAmAdera mane ete sAntvanA Asate pAre| Ara sAhAyya zudhumAtra parAkrAnta, mahAjJAnI AllAharai pakSa theke,
yAte dhavaMsa kare dena keAna keAna kApherake athavA lAJchita kare dena-yena orA vaJcita haYe phire yAYa|
haYa AllAha tAdera kSamA karavena kiMvA tAderake AyAva devena| e vyApAre ApanAra keAna karaNIYa nAi| kAraNa tArA raYeche anyAYera upara|
Ara yA kichu AsamAna o yamIne raYeche, sesavai AllAhara| tini yAke icchA kSamA karavena, yAke icchA AyAva dAna karavena| Ara AllAha hacchena kSamAkArI, karuNAmaYa|
he ImAnadAragaNa! teAmarA cakravRddhi hAre suda kheYeA nA| Ara AllAhake bhaYa karate thAka, yAte teAmarA kalyANa arjana karate pAreA|
evaM teAmarA se Aguna theke ve~ce thAka, yA kApheradera janya prastuta karA haYeche|
Ara teAmarA Anugatya kara AllAha o rasUlera, yAte teAmAdera upara rahamata karA haYa|
teAmarA teAmAdera pAlanakartAra kSamA evaM jAnnAtera dike chuTe yAo yAra sImAnA hacche AsamAna o yamIna, yA tairI karA haYeche paraheyagAradera janya|
yArA svacchalatAYa o abhAvera samaYa vyaYa kare, yArA nijedera rAgake saMvaraNa kare Ara mAnuSera prati kSamA pradarzana kare, vastutaH AllAha satkarmazIladigakei bhAlavAsena|

tArA kakhanao keAna azlIla kAja kare phelale kiMvA keAna manda kAje jar3ita haYe nijera upara juluma kare phelale AllAhake smaraNa kare evaM nijera pApera janya kSamA prArthanA kare| AllAha chAr3A Ara ke pApa kSamA karavena? tArA nijera kRtakarmera janya haThakAritA pradarzana kare nA evaM jene-zune tAi karate thAke nA|
tAderai janya pratidAna haleA tAdera pAlanakartAra kSamA o jAnnAta, yAra taladeze pravAhita hacche prasravaNa yekhAne tArA thAkave anantakAla| yArA kAja kare tAdera janya katainA camatkAra pratidAna|
teAmAdera Age atIta haYeche aneka dharanera jIvanAcaraNa| teAmarA pRthivIte bhramaNa kara evaM dekha yArA mithyA pratipanna kareche tAdera pariNati ki haYeche|
ei haleA mAnuSera janya varNanA| Ara yArA bhaYa kare tAdera janya upadezavANI|
Ara teAmarA nirAza haYeA nA evaM duHkha kareA nA| yadi teAmarA mumina hao tave, teAmarAi jaYI have|

teAmarA yadi Ahata haYe thAka, tave tArAo teA temani Ahata haYeche| Ara e dinaguleAke Ami mAnuSera madhye pAlAkrame Avartana ghaTiYe thAki| ebhAve AllAha jAnate cAna kArA ImAnadAra Ara tini teAmAdera kichu leAkake zahIda hisAve grahaNa karate cAna| Ara AllAha atyAcArIderake bhAlavAsena nA|
Ara e kAraNe AllAha ImAnadAraderake pAka-sApha karate cAna evaM kApheraderake dhavaMsa kare dite cAna|
teAmAdera ki dhAraNA, teAmarA jAnnAte praveza karave? athaca AllAha ekhanao dekhenani teAmAdera madhye kArA jehAda kareche evaM kArA dhairyyazIla|
Ara teAmarA teA mRtyu AsAra Agei maraNa kAmanA karate, kAjei ekhana teA teAmarA tA ceAkhera sAmane upasthita dekhate pAccha|

Ara muhAmmada ekajana rasUla vai teA naYa! tA~ra pUrveo vahu rasUla ativAhita haYe gechena| tAhale ki tini yadi mRtyuvaraNa karena athavA nihata hana, tave teAmarA pazcAdapasaraNa karave? vastutaH keu yadi pazcAdapasaraNa kare, tave tAte AllAhara kichui kSati-vRddhi have nA| Ara yArA kRtajJa, AllAha tAdera saoYAva dAna karavena|

Ara AllAhara hukuma chAr3A keu marate pAre nA-sejanya ekaTA samaYa nirdhArita raYeche| vastutaH ye leAka duniYAYa vinimaYa kAmanA karave, Ami tAke tA duniYAtei dAna karava| pakSAntare-ye leAka AkherAte vinimaYa kAmanA karave, tA theke Ami tAke tAi deveA| Ara yArA kRtajJa tAderake Ami pratidAna deveA

Ara vahu navI chilena, yA~dera saGgI-sAthIrA tA~dera anuvartI haYe jehAda kareche; AllAhara pathe-tAdera kichu kaSTa haYeche vaTe, kintu AllAhara rAhe tArA hereo yAYani, klAntao haYani evaM dameo yAYani| Ara yArA savara kare, AllAha tAderake bhAlavAsena|

tArA Ara kichui valeni-zudhu valeche, he AmAdera pAlanakartA! meAcana kare dAo AmAdera pApa evaM yA kichu vAr3AvAr3i haYe geche AmAdera kAje| Ara AmAdigake dRr3ha rAkha evaM kApheradera upara AmAdigake sAhAyya kara|
ataHpara AllAha tAderake duniYAra saoYAva dAna karechena evaM yathArtha AkherAtera saoYAva| Ara yArA satkarmazIla AllAha tAderake bhAlavAsena|
he ImAnadAragaNa! teAmarA yadi kApheradera kathA zeAna, tAhale orA teAmAderake pechane phiriYe deve, tAte teAmarA kSatira sammukhINa haYe par3ave|
varaM AllAha teAmAdera sAhAyyakArI, Ara tA~ra sAhAyyai hacche uttama sAhAyya|

khuva zIghrai Ami kApheradera mane bhItira saJcAra karaveA| kAraNa, orA AllAhara sAthe aMzIdAra sAvyasta kare ye samparke keAna sanada avatIrNa karA haYani| Ara odera ThikAnA haleA deAyakhera Aguna| vastutaH jAlemadera ThikAnA atyanta nikRSTa|

Ara AllAha se oYAdAke satye pariNata karechena, yakhana teAmarA tA~rai nirdeze odera khatama karachile| emanaki yakhana teAmarA chatrabhaGga haYe par3eche o kartavya sthira karAra vyApAre vivAde lipta haYeche| Ara yA teAmarA cAite tA dekhAra para kRtaghnatA pradarzana karecha, tAte teAmAdera kAreA kAmya chila duniYA Ara kAreA vA kAmya chila AkherAta| ataHpara teAmAdigake sariYe dilena odera upara theke yAte teAmAdigake parIkSA karena| vastutaH tini teAmAdigake kSamA karechena| Ara AllAhara muminadera prati anugrahazIla|

Ara teAmarA upare uThe yAcchile evaM pechana dike phire tAkAcchile nA kAreA prati, athaca rasUla DAkachilena teAmAdigake teAmAdera pechana dika theke| ataHpara teAmAdera upara eleA zeAkera opare zeAka, yAte teAmarA hAta theke veriYe yAoYA vastura janya duHkha nA kara evaM yAra sammukhINa haccha sejanya vimarSa nA hao| Ara AllAha teAmAdera kAjera vyApAre avahita raYechena|

ataHpara teAmAdera upara zeAkera para zAnti avatIrNa karalena, yA chila tandrAra mata| se tandrAYa teAmAdera madhye keu keu jhimeAcchila Ara keu keu prANera bhaYe bhAvachila| AllAha samparke tAdera mithyA dhAraNA hacchila murkhadera mata| tArA valachila AmAdera hAte ki kichui karAra nei? tumi vala, savakichui AllAhara hAte| tArA yA kichu mane lukiYe rAkhe-teAmAra nikaTa prakAza kare nA se savao| tArA vale AmAdera hAte yadi kichu karAra thAkateA, tAhale AmarA ekhAne nihata hatAma nA| tumi vala, teAmarA yadi nijedera ghareo thAkate tavuo tArA avazyai veriYe Asata nijedera avasthAna theke yAdera mRtyu likhe deYA haYeche| teAmAdera vuke yA raYeche tAra parIkSA karA chila AllAhara icchA, Ara teAmAdera antare yA kichu raYeche tA pariSkAra karA chila tA~ra kAmya| AllAha manera geApana viSaYa jAnena|
teAmAdera ye duTi dala lar3AiYera dine ghure dA~r3iYechila zaYatAna tAderake vibhrAnta karechila, tAderai pApera daruna|

he ImANadAragaNa! teAmarA tAdera mata haYeA nA, yArA kAphera haYeche evaM nijedera bhAi vandhurA yakhana keAna abhiyAne vera haYa kiMvA jehAde yAYa, takhana tAdera samparke vale, tArA yadi AmAdera sAthe thAkateA, tAhale marateAo nA Ahatao hateA nA| yAte tArA e dhAraNA sRSTira mAdhyame saMzliSTadera mane anutApa sRSTi karate pAre| athaca AllAhai jIvana dAna karena evaM mRtyu dena| teAmAdera samasta kAjai, teAmarA yA kichui kara nA kena, AllAha savakichui dekhena|
Ara teAmarA yadi AllAhara pathe nihata hao kiMvA mRtyuvaraNa kara, teAmarA yA kichu saMgraha kare thAka AllAha tA’AlAra kSamA o karuNA se savakichura ceYe uttama|
Ara teAmarA mRtyui varaNa kara athavA nihatai hao, avazya AllAha tA’AlAra sAmanei samaveta have|

AllAhara rahamatei Apani tAdera janya keAmala hRdaYa haYechena pakSAntare Apani yadi rAga o kaThina hRdaYa hatena tAhale tArA ApanAra kAcha theke vicchinna haYe yeteA| kAjei Apani tAdera kSamA kare dina evaM tAdera janya mAgapherAta kAmanA karuna evaM kAje karme tAdera parAmarza karuna| ataHpara yakhana keAna kAjera siddhAnta grahaNa kare phelena, takhana AllAha tA’AlAra upara bharasA karuna AllAha tAoYAkkula kArIdera bhAlavAsena|

yadi AllAha teAmAdera sahAYatA karena, tAhale keu teAmAdera upara parAkrAnta hate pArave nA| Ara yadi tini teAmAdera sAhAyya nA karena, tave emana ke Ache, ye teAmAdera sAhAyya karate pAre? Ara AllAhara oparai musalamAnaganera bharasA karA ucita|

Ara keAna viSaYa geApana kare rAkhA navIra kAja naYa| Ara ye leAka geApana karave se kiYAmatera dina sei geApana vastu niYe Asave| ataHpara paripUrNabhAve pAve pratyeke, yA se arjana kareche| Ara tAdera prati keAna anyAYa karA have nA|
ye leAka AllAhara icchAra anugata, se ki ai leAkera samAna hate pAre, ye AllAhara reASa arjana kareche? vastutaH tAra ThikAnA hala deAyakha| Ara tA katainA nikRSTa avasthAna!
AllAhara nikaTa mAnuSera maryAdA vibhinna starera Ara AllAha dekhena yA kichu tArA kare|

AllAha ImAnadAradera upara anugraha karechena ye, tAdera mAjhe tAdera nijedera madhya theke navI pAThiYechena| tini tAdera janya tA~ra AYAtasamUha pATha karena| tAderake parizeAdhana karena evaM tAderake kitAva o kAjera kathA zikSA dena| vastutaH tArA chila pUrva thekei pathabhraSTa|

yakhana teAmAdera upara ekaTi musIvata ese peৗchAla, athaca teAmarA tAra pUrvei dviguNa kaSTe peৗche giYecha, takhana ki teAmarA valave, eTA keAthA theke ela? tAhale vale dAo, e kaSTa teAmAdera upara paucheche teAmArai pakSa theke| nizcaYai AllAha pratyeka viSaYera upara kSamatAzIla|
Ara yedina du’dala sainyera meAkAvilA haYeche; sedina teAmAdera upara yA Apatita haYeche tA AllAhara hukumei haYeche evaM tA ejanya ye, tAte ImAnadAradigake jAnA yAYa|

evaM tAderake yAte sanAkta karA yAYa yArA munAphika chila| Ara tAderake valA hala eseA, AllAhara rAhe lar3Ai kara kiMvA zatrudigake pratihata kara| tArA valechila, AmarA yadi jAnatAma ye, lar3Ai have, tAhale avazyai teAmAdera sAthe thAkatAma| se dina tArA ImAnera tulanAYa kupharIra kAchAkAchi chila| yA tAdera antare nei tArA nijera mukhe se kathAi vale vastutaH AllAha bhAlabhAve jAnena tArA yA kichu geApana kare thAke|

orA haleA ye sava leAka, yArA vase theke nijedera bhAidera samvaddhe vale, yadi tArA AmAdera kathA zunata, tave nihata hata nA| tAderake vale dina, evAra teAmAdera nijedera upara theke mRtyuke sariYe dAo, yadi teAmarA satyavAdI haYe thAka|
Ara yArA AllAhara rAhe nihata haYa, tAderake tumi kakhaneA mRta mane kareA nA| varaM tArA nijedera pAlanakartAra nikaTa jIvita o jIvikAprApta|

AllAha nijera anugraha theke yA dAna karechena tAra prekSite tArA Ananda udayApana karache| Ara yArA ekhanao tAdera kAche ese pau~cheni tAdera pechane tAdera janye Ananda prakAza kare| kAraNa, tAdera keAna bhaYa bhItio nei evaM keAna cintA bhAvanAo nei|
AllAhara neYAmata o anugrahera janye tArA Ananda prakAza kare evaM tA ebhAve ye, AllAha, ImAnadAradera zramaphala vinaSTa karena nA|
yArA Ahata haYe par3Ara pareo AllAha evaM tA~ra rasUlera nirdeza mAnya kareche, tAdera madhye yArA sat o paraheyagAra, tAdera janya raYeche mahAna saoYAva|

yAderake leAkerA valeche ye, teAmAdera sAthe meAkAvelA karAra janya leAkerA samAveza kareche vahu sAja-saraJjAma; tAdera bhaYa kara| takhana tAdera vizvAsa Arao dRr3hatara haYe yAYa evaM tArA vale, AmAdera janya AllAhai yatheSTa; katai nA camatkAra kAmiYAvIdAnakArI|
ataHpara phire ela musalamAnarA AllAhara anugraha niYe, tadera kichui aniSTa haleA nA| tArapara tArA AllAhara icchAra anugata hala| vastutaH AllAhara anugraha ati virATa|
erA ye raYeche, erAi hale zaYatAna, erA nijedera vandhudera vyApAre bhIti pradarzana kare| sutarAM teAmarA tAdera bhaYa kareA nA| Ara teAmarA yadi ImAnadAra haYe thAka, tave AmAke bhaYa kara|

Ara yArA kupharera dike dhAvita hacche tArA yena teAmAdigake cintAmvita kare nA teAle| tArA AllAha tA’AlAra keAna kichui aniSTa sAdhana karate pArave nA| AkherAte tAderake keAna kalyANa dAna nA karAi AllAhara icchA| vastutaH tAdera janye raYeche mahA zAsti|
yArA ImAnera parivarte kuphara kraYa kare niYeche, tArA AllAha tA’AlAra kichui kSatisAdhana karate pArave nA| Ara tAdera janya raYeche vedanAdAYaka zAsti|

kApherarA yena mane nA kare ye Ami ye, avakAza dAna kari, tA tAdera pakSe kalyANakara| Ami teA tAderake avakAza dei yAte kare tArA pApe unnati lAbha karate pAre| vastutaH tAdera janya raYeche lAJchanAjanaka zAsti|

nApAkake pAka theke pRthaka kare deYA paryanta AllAha emana nana ye, ImAnadAragaNake se avasthAtei rAkhavena yAte teAmarA raYecha, Ara AllAha emana nana ye, teAmAdigake gAYavera saMvAda devena| kintu AllAha svIYa rasUla gaNera madhye yAke icchA vAchAi kare niYechena| sutarAM AllAhara opara evaM tA~ra rasUlagaNera opara teAmarA pratyaYa sthApana kara| vastutaH teAmarA yadi vizvAsa o paraheyagArIra opara pratiSThita theke thAka, tave teAmAdera janye raYeche virATa pratidAna|

AllAha tAderake nijera anugrahe yA dAna karechena tAte yArA kRpaNatA kare ei kArpanya tAdera janya maGgalakara have vale tArA yena dhAraNA nA kare| varaM eTA tAdera pakSe ekAntai kSatikara pratipanna have| yAte tArA kArpanya kare se samasta dhana-sampadake kiYAmatera dina tAdera galAYa ver3I vAniYe parAneA have| Ara AllAha hacchena AsamAna o yamInera parama sattvAdhikArI| Ara yA kichu teAmarA kara; AllAha se samparke jAnena|

niHsandehe AllAha tAdera kathA zunechena, yArA valeche ye, AllAha hacchena abhAvagrasta Ara AmarA vittavAna! ekhana Ami tAdera kathA evaM yesava navIke tArA anyAYabhAve hatyA kareche tA likhe rAkhava, ataHpara valava, AsvAdana kara jvalanta Agunera AyAva|
e hala tArai pratiphala yA teAmarA itipUrve nijera hAte pAThiYecha| vastutaH AllAha vAndAdera prati atyAcAra karena nA|

se samasta leAka, yArA vale ye, AllAha AmAdigake emana keAna rasUlera opara vizvAsa nA karate vale rekhechena yatakSaNa nA tArA AmAdera nikaTa emana keAravAnI niYe Asavena yAke Aguna grAsa kare neve| tumi tAdera vale dAo, teAmAdera mAjhe AmAra pUrve vahu rasUla nidarzanasamUha evaM teAmarA yA AvdAra karecha tA niYe esechilena, takhana teAmarA kena tAderake hatyA karale yadi teAmarA satya haYe thAka|

tAchAr3A erA yadi teAmAke mithyA pratipanna kare, tave teAmAra pUrveo erA emana vahu navIke mithyA pratipanna kareche, yArA nidarzana samUha niYe esechilena| evaM enechilena sahIphA o pradIpta grantha|

pratyeka prANIke AsvAdana karate have mRtyu| Ara teAmarA kiYAmatera dina paripUrNa vadalA prApta have| tArapara yAke deAyakha theke dUre rAkhA have evaM jAnnAte praveza karAneA have, tAra kAryasiddhi ghaTave| Ara pArthiva jIvana dheA~kA chAr3A anya keAna sampada naYa|

avazya dhana-sampade evaM janasampade teAmAdera parIkSA have evaM avazya teAmarA zunave pUrvavartI Ahale kitAvadera kAche evaM muzarekadera kAche vahu azeAbhana ukti| Ara yadi teAmarA dhairyya dhAraNa kara evaM paraheyagArI avalamvana kara, tave tA have ekAnta satsAhasera vyApAra|

Ara AllAha yakhana Ahale kitAvadera kAcha theke pratijJA grahaNa karalena ye, tA mAnuSera nikaTa varNanA karave evaM geApana karave nA, takhana tArA se pratijJAke nijedera pechane phele rAkhala Ara tAra kenA-vecA karala sAmAnya mUlyera vinimaYe| sutarAM katai nA manda tAdera e vecA-kenA|

tumi mane kareA nA, yArA nijedera kRtakarmera upara Anandita haYa evaM nA karA viSaYera janya prazaMsA kAmanA kare, tArA AmAra nikaTa theke avyAhati lAbha kareche| vastutaH tAdera janye raYeche vedanAdAYaka AyAva|
Ara AllAhara janyai hala AsamAna o yaminera vAdazAhI| AllAhai sarva viSaYe kSamatAra adhikArI|
nizcaYa AsamAna o yamIna sRSTite evaM rAtri o dinera Avartane nidarzana raYeche veAdha sampanna leAkadera janye|

yA~rA dA~r3iYe, vase, o zAYita avasthAYa AllAhake smaraNa kare evaM cintA gaveSaNA kare AsamAna o jamina sRSTira viSaye, (tArA vale) paraoYAradegAra! esava tumi anarthaka sRSTi karani| sakala pavitratA teAmArai, AmAdigake tumi deAyakhera zAsti theke vA~cAo|
he AmAdera pAlanakartA! nizcaYa tumi yAke deAyakhe nikSepa karale tAke savasamaYe apamAnita karale; Ara jAlemadera janye teA sAhAyyakArI nei|

he AmAdera pAlanakartA! AmarA nizcitarUpe zunechi ekajana AhavAnakArIke ImAnera prati AhavAna karate ye, teAmAdera pAlanakartAra prati ImAna Ana; tAi AmarA ImAna enechi| he AmAdera pAlanakartA! ataHpara AmAdera sakala geAnAha mApha kara evaM AmAdera sakala deASatruTi dura kare dAo, Ara AmAdera mRtyu dAo neka leAkadera sAthe|
he AmAdera pAlanakartA! AmAderake dAo, yA tumi oYAdA karecha teAmAra rasUlagaNera mAdhyame evaM kiYAmatera dina AmAdigake tumi apamAnita kareA nA| nizcaYa tumi oYAdA khelApha kareA nA|

ataHpara tAdera pAlanakartA tAdera deAYA (ei vale) kavula kare nilena ye, Ami teAmAdera keAna parizramakArIra parizramai vinaSTa kari nA, tA se puruSa heAka kiMvA strIleAka| teAmarA paraspara eka| tArapara se samasta leAka yArA hijarata kareche, tAderake nijedera deza theke vera kare deoYA haYeche evaM tAdera prati utpIr3ana karA haYeche AmAra pathe evaM yArA lar3Ai kareche o mRtyuvaraNa kareche, avazyai Ami tAdera upara theke akalyANake apasArita karava| evaM tAderake praviSTa karava jAnnAte yAra taladeze nahara samUha pravAhita| ei haleA vinimaYa AllAhara pakSa theke| Ara AllAhara nikaTa raYeche uttama vinimaYa|
nagarIte kApheradera cAla-calana yena teAmAdigake dheA~kA nA deYa|
eTA haleA sAmAnya phAYadA-erapara tAdera ThikAnA have deAyakha| Ara seTi haleA ati nikRSTa avasthAna|

kintu yArA bhaYa kare nijedera pAlanakartAke tAdera janye raYeche jAnnAta yAra taladeze pravAhita raYeche prasravaNa| tAte AllAhara pakSa theke sadA ApyAYana calate thAkave| Ara yA AllAhara nikaTa raYeche, tA satkarmazIladera janye ekAntai uttama|

Ara Ahale kitAvadera madhye keu keu emanao raYeche, yArA AllAhara upara ImAna Ane evaM yA kichu teAmAra upara avatIrNa haYa Ara yA kichu tAdera upara avatIrNa haYeche seguleAra upara, AllAhara sAmane vinaYAvanata thAke evaM AllAh‌ra AYAtasamuhake svalpamulyera vinimaYe saodA kare nA, tArAi haleA se leAka yAdera janya pArizramika raYeche tAdera pAlanakartAra nikaTa| nizcaYai AllAha yathAzIghra hisAva cukiYe dena|
he ImAnadAnagaNa! dhairyya dhAraNa kara evaM meAkAvelAYa dRr3hatA avalamvana kara| Ara AllAhake bhaYa karate thAka yAte teAmarA teAmAdera uddezya lAbhe samartha hate pAra|

he mAnava samAja! teAmarA teAmAdera pAlanakartAke bhaYa kara, yini teAmAderake eka vyakti theke sRSTi karechena evaM yini tAra theke tAra saGgInIke sRSTi karechena; Ara vistAra karechena tAdera du’jana theke agaNita puruSa o nArI| Ara AllAhake bhaYa kara, yA~ra nAme teAmarA eke aparera nikaTa yAcaJjhA kare thAka evaM AtnIYa jJAtidera vyApAre satarkatA avalamvana kara| nizcaYa AllAha teAmAdera vyApAre sacetana raYechena|

etImaderake tAdera sampada vujhiYe dAo| khArApa mAlAmAlera sAthe bhAleA mAlAmAlera adala-vadala kareA nA| Ara tAdera dhana-sampada nijedera dhana-sampadera sAthe saMmizrita kare tA grAsa kareA nA| nizcaYa eTA var3ai manda kAja|

Ara yadi teAmarA bhaYa kara ye, etIma meYedera haka yathAthabhAve puraNa karate pArave nA, tave sesava meYedera madhye theke yAdera bhAla lAge tAdera viYe kare nAo dui, tina, kiMvA cAraTi paryanta| Ara yadi erUpa AzaGkA kara ye, tAdera madhye nyAYa saGgata AcaraNa vajAYa rAkhate pArave nA, tave, ekaTii athavA teAmAdera adhikArabhukta dAsIderake; etei pakSapAtitve jar3ita nA haoYAra adhikatara sambhAvanA|
Ara teAmarA strIderake tAdera meAhara diYe dAo khuzImane| tArA yadi khuzI haYe tA theke aMza cher3e deYa, tave tA teAmarA svAcchandye bheAga kara|
Ara ye sampadake AllAha teAmAdera jIvana-yAtrAra avalamvana karechena, tA arvAcInadera hAte tule dio nA| varaM tA theke tAderake khAoYAo, parAo evaM tAderake sAntanAra vAnI zeAnAo|

Ara etImadera prati vizeSabhAve najara rAkhave, ye paryanta nA tArA viYera vaYase pau~che| yadi tAdera madhye vuddhi-vivecanAra unmeSa A~ca karate pAra, tave tAdera sampada tAdera hAte arpana karate pAra| etImera mAla praYeAjanAtirikta kharaca kareA nA vA tArA var3a haYe yAve mane kare tAr3AtAr3i kheYe pheleA nA| yArA svacchala tArA avazyai etImera mAla kharaca karA theke virata thAkave| Ara ye abhAvagrasta se saGgata parimANa khete pAre| yakhana tAdera hAte tAdera sampada pratyArpaNa kara, takhana sAkSI rAkhave| avazya AllAhai hisAva neYAra vyApAre yatheSTa|
pitA-mAtA o AtnIYa-svajanadera parityakta sampattite puruSaderao aMza Ache evaM pitA-mAtA o AtnIYa-svajanadera parityakta sampattite nArIderao aMza Ache; alpa heAka kiMvA vezI| e aMza nirdhArita|
sampati vanTanera samaYa yakhana AtnIYa-svajana, etIma o misakIna upasthita haYa, takhana tA theke tAdera kichu khAiYe dAo evaM tAdera sAthe kichu sadAlApa kareA|
tAdera bhaYa karA ucita, yArA nijedera pazcAte durvala akSama santAna-santati cher3e gele tAdera janye tArAo AzaGkA kare; sutarAM tArA yena AllAhake bhaYa kare evaM saMgata kathA vale|
yArA etImadera artha-sampada anyAYabhAve khAYa, tArA nijedera peTe Agunai bharti kareche evaM sattvarai tArA agnite praveza karave|

AllAha teAmAderake teAmAdera santAnadera samparke Adeza karenaH ekajana puruSera aMza du’jana nArIra aMzera samAna| ataHpara yadi zudhu nArIi haYa du’-era adhika, tave tAdera janye ai mAlera tina bhAgera dui bhAga yA tyAga kare mare evaM yadi ekajanai haYa, tave tAra janye ardheka| mRtera pitA-mAtAra madhya theke pratyekera janye tyAjya sampattira chaYa bhAgera eka bhAga, yadi mRtera putra thAke| yadi putra nA thAke evaM pitA-mAtAi oYArisa haYa, tave mAtA pAve tina bhAgera eka bhAga| ataHpara yadi mRtera kaYekajana bhAi thAke, tave tAra mAtA pAve chaYa bhAgera eka bhAga ochiYyatera para, yA kare mareche kiMvA RNa parizeAdhera para| teAmAdera pitA o putrera madhye ke teAmAdera janye adhika upakArI teAmarA jAna nA| eTA AllAha kartRka nirdhArita aMza nizcaYa AllAha sarvajJa, rahasyavida|

Ara, teAmAdera have ardheka sampatti, yA cher3e yAYa teAmAdera strIrA yadi tAdera keAna santAna nA thAke| yadi tAdera santAna thAke, tave teAmAdera have eka-caturthAMza ai sampattira, yA tArA cher3e yAYa; ochiYyatera para, yA tArA kare evaM RNa parizeAdhera para| strIdera janye eka-caturthAMza have ai sampattira, yA teAmarA cher3e yAo yadi teAmAdera keAna santAna nA thAke| Ara yadi teAmAdera santAna thAke, tave tAdera janye have ai sampattira ATa bhAgera eka bhAga, yA teAmarA cher3e yAo ochiYyatera para, yA teAmarA kara evaM RNa parizeAdhera para| ye puruSera, tyAjya sampatti, tAra yadi pitA-putra kiMvA strI nA thAke evaM ei mRtera eka bhAi kiMvA eka veAna thAke, tave ubhaYera pratyeke chaYa-bhAgera eka pAve| Ara yadi tateAdhika thAke, tave tArA eka tRtIYAMza aMzIdAra have ochiYyatera para, yA karA haYa athavA RNera para ematAvasthAYa ye, aparera kSati nA kare| e vidhAna AllAhara| AllAha sarvajJa, sahanazIla|

eguleA AllAhara nirdhArita sImA| ye keu AllAha o rasUlera Adezamata cale, tini tAke jAnnAta samUhe praveza karAvena, yeguleAra taladeza diYe sreAtasvinI pravAhita have| tArA sekhAne cirakAla thAkave| e hala virATa sAphalya|
ye keu AllAha o rasUlera avAdhyatA kare evaM tAra sImA atikrama kare tini tAke Agune praveza karAvena| se sekhAne cirakAla thAkave| tAra janye raYeche apamAnajanaka zAsti|

Ara teAmAdera nArIdera madhye yArA vyabhicAriNI tAdera viruddhe teAmAdera madhya theke cAra jana puruSake sAkSI hiseve talava kara| ataHpara yadi tArA sAkSya pradAna kare tave saMzliSTaderake gRhe Avaddha rAkha, ye paryanta mRtyu tAderake tule nA neYa athavA AllAha tAdera janya anya keAna patha nirdeza nA karena|

teAmAdera madhya theke ye du’jana sei kukarme lipta haYa, tAderake zAsti pradAna kara| ataHpara yadi ubhaYe taovA kare evaM nijedera saMzeAdhana kare, tave tAdera theke hAta guTiYe nAo| nizcaYa AllAha taovA kavulakArI, daYAlu|

avazyai AllAha tAdera taovA kavula karavena, yArA bhUlavazataH manda kAja kare, ataHpara anativilamve taovA kare; erAi hala sesava leAka yAderake AllAha kSamA kare dena| AllAha mahAjJAnI, rahasyavida|

Ara emana leAkadera janya keAna kSamA nei, yArA manda kAja karatei thAke, emana ki yakhana tAdera kAreA mAthAra upara mRtyu upasthita haYa, takhana valate thAkeH Ami ekhana taovA karachi| Ara taovA nei tAdera janya, yArA kupharI avasthAYa mRtyuvaraNa kare| Ami tAdera janya yantraNAdAYaka zAsti prastuta kare rekhechi|

he ImANadAragaNa! valapUrvaka nArIderake uttarAdhikAre grahana karA teAmAdera janye hAlAla naYa evaM tAderake ATaka rekheA nA yAte teAmarA tAderake yA pradAna karecha tAra kiYadaMza niYe nAo; kintu tArA yadi keAna prakAzya azlIlatA kare! nArIdera sAthe sadbhAve jIvana-yApana kara| ataHpara yadi tAderake apachanda kara, tave haYata teAmarA emana eka jinisake apachanda karacha, yAte AllAha, aneka kalyANa rekhechena|

yadi teAmarA eka strIra sthale anya strI parivartana karate icchA kara evaM tAdera ekajanake pracura dhana-sampada pradAna kare thAka, tave tA theke kichui pherata grahaNa kareA nA| teAmarA ki tA anyAYabhAve o prakAzya geAnAhara mAdhyame grahaNa karave?
teAmarA kirUpe tA grahaNa karate pAra, athaca teAmAdera ekajana anya janera kAche gamana evaM nArIrA teAmAdera kAche theke sudRr3ha aGgIkAra grahaNa kareche|
ye nArIke teAmAdera pitA-pitAmaha vivAha kareche teAmarA tAdera vivAha kareA nA| kintu yA vigata haYe geche| eTA azlIla, gayavera kAja evaM nikRSTa AcaraNa|

teAmAdera janye hArAma karA haYeche teAmAdera mAtA, teAmAdera kanyA, teAmAdera veAna, teAmAdera phuphu, teAmAdera khAlA, bhrAtRkaNyA; bhaginIkaNyA teAmAdera se mAtA, yArA teAmAderake stanyapAna kariYeche, teAmAdera dudha-veAna, teAmAdera strIdera mAtA, teAmarA yAdera sAthe sahavAsa karecha se strIdera kanyA yArA teAmAdera lAlana-pAlane Ache| yadi tAdera sAthe sahavAsa nA kare thAka, tave e vivAhe teAmAdera keAna geAnAha nei| teAmAdera aurasajAta putradera strI evaM dui veAnake ekatre vivAha karA; kintu yA atIta haYe geche| nizcaYa AllAha kSamAkarI, daYAlu|

evaM nArIdera madhye tAdera chAr3A sakala sadhavA strIleAka teAmAdera janye niSiddha; teAmAdera dakSiNa hasta yAdera mAlika haYe yAYa-eTA teAmAdera janya AllAhara hukuma| ederake chAr3A teAmAdera janye sava nArI hAlAla karA haYeche, zarta ei ye, teAmarA tAderake svIYa arthera vinimaYe talava karave vivAha vandhane Avaddha karAra janya-vyabhicArera janya naYa| anantara tAdera madhye yAke teAmarA bheAga karave, tAke tAra nirdhArita haka dAna kara| teAmAdera keAna geAnAha have nA yadi nirdhAraNera para teAmarA paraspare sammata hao| nizcaYa AllAha suvijJa, rahasyavida|

Ara teAmAdera madhye ye vyakti svAdhIna musalamAna nArIke viYe karAra sAmarthya rAkhe nA, se teAmAdera adhikArabhukta musalima krItadAsIderake viYe karave| AllAha teAmAdera ImAna samparke bhAleAbhAve jJAta raYechena| teAmarA paraspara eka, ataeva, tAderake tAdera mAlikera anumatikrame viYe kara evaM niYama anuyAYI tAderake meAharAnA pradAna kara ematAvasthAYa ye, tArA vivAha vandhane Avaddha have-vyabhicAriNI kiMvA upa-pati grahaNakAriNI have nA| ataHpara yakhana tArA vivAha vandhane ese yAYa, takhana yadi keAna azlIla kAja kare, tave tAderake svAdhIna nArIdera ardheka zAsti bheAga karate have| e vyavasthA tAdera janye, teAmAdera madhye yArA vyabhicAre lipta haoYAra vyApAre bhaYa kare| Ara yadi savara kara, tave tA teAmAdera janye uttama| AllAha kSamAzIla, karuNAmaYa|
AllAha teAmAdera janye sava kichu pariSkAra varNanA kare dite cAna, teAmAdera pUrvavartIdera patha pradarzana karate cAna| evaM teAmAderake kSamA karate cAna, AllAha mahAjJAnI rahasyavida|
AllAha teAmAdera prati kSamAzIla hate cAna, evaM yArA kAmanA-vAsanAra anusArI, tArA cAYa ye, teAmarA patha theke aneka dUre vicyuta haYe par3a|
AllAha teAmAdera veAjhA hAlakA karate cAna| mAnuSa durvala sRjita haYeche|

he ImAnadAragaNa! teAmarA eke aparera sampada anyAYabhAve grAsa kareA nA| kevalamAtra teAmAdera parasparera sammatikrame ye vyavasA karA haYa tA vaidha| Ara teAmarA nijedera kAuke hatyA kareA nA| niHsandehe AllAha tA’AlA teAmAdera prati daYAlu|
Ara ye keu sImAlaGghana kiMvA julumera vazavartI haYe erUpa karave, tAke khuva zIghrai Agune nikSepa karA have| eTA AllAhara pakSe khuvai sahajasAdhya|

yeguleA samparke teAmAdera niSedha karA haYeche yadi teAmarA sesava var3a geAnAha guleA theke ve~ce thAkate pAra| tave Ami teAmAdera kraTi-vicyutiguleA kSamA kare deva evaM sammAna janaka sthAne teAmAdera praveza karAra|

Ara teAmarA AkAGkSA kareA nA emana sava viSaYe yAte AllAha tA’AlA teAmAdera ekera upara aparera zreSThatva dAna karechena| puruSa yA arjana kare seTA tAra aMza evaM nArI yA arjana kare seTA tAra aMza| Ara AllAhara kAche tA~ra anugraha prArthanA kara| niHsandehe AllAha tA’AlA sarva viSaYe jJAta|

pitA-mAtA evaM nikaTAtnIYagaNa yA tyAga kare yAna sesavera janyai Ami uttarAdhikArI nirdhAraNa kare diYechi| Ara yAdera sAthe teAmarA aGgIkArAvaddha haYecha tAdera prApya diYe dAo| AllAha tA’AlA niHsandehe sava kichui pratyakSa karena|

puruSerA nArIdera upara kRrtatvazIla e janya ye, AllAha ekera upara anyera vaiziSTya dAna karechena evaM e janya ye, tArA tAdera artha vyaYa kare| se mate nekakAra strIleAkagaNa haYa anugatA evaM AllAha yA hephAyatayeAgya kare diYechena leAka cakSura antarAleo tAra hephAyata kare| Ara yAdera madhye avAdhyatAra AzaGkA kara tAdera sadupadeza dAo, tAdera zayyA tyAga kara evaM prahAra kara| yadi tAte tArA vAdhya haYe yAYa, tave Ara tAdera janya anya keAna patha anusandhAna kareA nA| nizcaYa AllAha savAra upara zreSTha|

yadi tAdera madhye samparkaccheda haoYAra mata paristhitirai AzaGkA kara, tave svAmIra parivAra theke ekajana evaM strIra parivAra theke ekajana sAlisa niyukta karave| tArA ubhaYera mImAMsA cAile AllAha sarvajJa, savakichu avahita|

Ara upAsanA kara AllAhara, zarIka kareA nA tA~ra sAthe apara kAuke| pitA-mAtAra sAthe sat o sadaYa vyavahAra kara evaM nikaTAtnIYa, etIma-misakIna, prativezI, asahAYa musAphira evaM nijera dAsa-dAsIra pratio| nizcaYai AllAha pachanda karena nA dAmbhika-garvitajanake|

yArA nijerAo kArpanya kare evaM anyakeo kRpaNatA zikSA deYa Ara geApana kare se sava viSaYa yA AllAha tA’AlA tAderake dAna karechena svIYa anugrahe-vastutaH tairI kare rekhechi kApheradera janya apamAna janaka AyAva|

Ara se samasta leAka yArA vyaYa kare svIYa dhana-sampada leAka-dekhAneAra uddeze evaM yArA AllAhara upara ImAna Ane nA, ImAna Ane nA keYAmata divasera prati evaM zaYatAna yAra sAthI haYa se hala nikRSTatara sAthI|
Ara kii vA kSati hata tAdera yadi tArA ImAna Anata AllAhara upara keYAmata divasera upara evaM yadi vyaYa karata AllAha pradatta riyika theke! athaca AllAha, tAdera vyApAre yathArthabhAvei avagata|
nizcaYai AllAha kAreA prApya haka vindu-visargao rAkhena nA; Ara yadi tA satkarma haYa, tave tAke dviguNa kare dena evaM nijera pakSa theke vipula saoYAva dAna karena|
Ara takhana ki avasthA dA~r3Ave, yakhana Ami Deke Anava pratiTi ummatera madhya theke avasthA varNanAkArI evaM ApanAke DAkava tAdera upara avasthA varNanAkArIrUpe|
sedina kAmanA karave se samasta leAka, yArA kAphera haYechila evaM rasUlera nApharamAnI karechila, yena yamInera sAthe mize yAYa| kintu geApana karate pArave nA AllAhara nikaTa keAna viSaYa|

he ImANadAragaNa! teAmarA yakhana nezAgrasta thAka, takhana nAmAyera dhAre-kAcheo yeonA, yatakSaNa nA vujhate sakSama hao yA kichu teAmarA valacha, Ara (nAmAyera kAche yeo nA) pharaya geAsalera AvasthAYao yatakSaNa nA geAsala kare nAo| kintu musAphira avasthAra kathA svatantra Ara yadi teAmarA asustha haYe thAka kiMvA saphare thAka athavA teAmAdera madhya theke keu yadi prasrAva-pAYakhAnA theke ese thAke kiMvA nArI gamana kare thAke, kintu pare yadi pAniprApti sambhava nA haYa, tave pAka-pavitra mATira dvArA tAYAmmuma kare nAo-tAte mukhamanDala o hAtake ghaSe nAo| nizcaYai AllAha tA’AlA kSamAzIla|
tumi ki odera dekhani, yArA kitAvera kichu aMza prApta haYeche, (athaca) tArA pathabhraSTatA kharida kare evaM kAmanA kare, yAte teAmarAo AllAhara patha theke vibhrAnta haYe yAo|
athaca AllAha teAmAdera zatruderake yathArthai jAnena| Ara abhibhAvaka hisAve AllAhai yatheSTa evaM sAhAyyakArI hisAveo AllAhai yatheSTa|

keAna keAna ihudI tAra lakSya theke kathAra meAr3a ghur3iYe neYa evaM vale, AmarA zunechi kintu amAnya karachi| tArA AreA vale, zeAna, nA zeAnAra mata| mukha vA~kiYe dvInera prati tAcchilya pradarzanera uddeze vale, rAYenA’ (AmAdera rAkhAla)| athaca yadi tArA valata ye, AmarA zunechi o mAnya karechi evaM (yadi valata, ) zeAna evaM AmAdera prati lakSya rAkha, tave tAi chila tAdera janya uttama Ara seTAi chila yathArtha o saThika| kintu AllAha tAdera prati abhisampAta karechena tAdera kupharIra daruna| ataeva, tArA ImAna Anache nA, kintu ati alpasaMkhyaka|

he AsamAnI granthera adhikArIvRnda! yA kichu Ami avatIrNa karechi tAra upara vizvAsa sthApana kara, yA se granthera satyAYana kare evaM yA teAmAdera nikaTa raYeche pUrva theke| (vizvAsa sthApana kara) emana haoYAra Agei ye, Ami muche deva aneka cehArAke evaM ataHpara seguleAke ghuriYe deva pazcAt dike kiMvA abhisampAta karava tAdera prati yemana kare abhisampAta karechi AchahAve-sAvatera upara| Ara AllAhara nirdeza avazyai kAryakara have|

niHsandehe AllAha tAke kSamA karena nA, ye leAka tA~ra sAthe zarIka kare| tini kSamA karena era nimna paryAYera pApa, yAra janya tini icchA karena| Ara ye leAka aMzIdAra sAvyasta karala AllAhara sAthe, se yena apavAda AreApa karala|
tumi ki tAdeke dekhani, yArA nijederake pUta-pavitra vale thAke athaca pavitra karena AllAha yAke icchA tAkei? vastutaH tAdera upara sutA parimANa anyAYao have nA|
lakSya kara, kemana kare tArA AllAhara prati mithyA apavAda AreApa kare, athaca ei prakAzya pApai yatheSTa|

tumi ki tAderake dekhani, yArA kitAvera kichu aMza prApta haYeche, yArA mAnya kare pratimA o zaYatAnake evaM kApheraderake vale ye, erA musalamAnadera tulanAYa adhikatara sarala saThika pathe raYeche|
erA haleA se samasta leAka, yAdera upara lA’nata karechena AllAha tA’AlA svaYaM| vastutaH AllAha yAra upara lA’nata karena tumi tAra keAna sAhAyyakArI khu~je pAve nA|
tAdera kAche ki rAjyera keAna aMza Ache? tAhale ye erA kAukeo ekaTi tila parimANao deve nA|

nAki yAkichu AllAha tAderake svIYa anugrahe dAna karechena se viSaYera janya mAnuSake hiMsA kare| avazyai Ami ivrAhImera vaMzadharaderake kitAva o hekamata dAna karechilAma Ara tAderake dAna karechilAma vizAla rAjya|
ataHpara tAdera keu tAke mAnya kareche AvAra keu tAra kAcha theke dUre sare raYeche| vastutaH (tAdera janya) deAyakhera zikhAYita Agunai yatheSTa|

ete sandeha nei ye, AmAra nidarzana samuhera prati yesava leAka asvIkRti jJApana karave, Ami tAderake Agune nikSepa karava| tAdera cAmar3AguleA yakhana jvale-pur3e yAve, takhana AvAra Ami tA pAlaTe deva anya cAmar3A diYe, yAte tArA AyAva AsvAdana karate thAke| nizcaYai AllAha mahAparAkramazAlI, hekamatera adhikArI|

Ara yArA ImAna eneche evaM satkarma kareche, avazya Ami praviSTa karAva tAderake jAnnAte, yAra taladeze pravAhita raYeche nahara samUha| sekhAne tArA thAkave anantakAla| sekhAne tAdera janya thAkave pariSkAra-paricchanna strIgaNa| tAderake Ami praviSTa karava ghana chAYA nIr3e|

nizcaYai AllAha teAmAdigake nirdeza dena ye, teAmarA yena prApya AmAnatasamUha prApakadera nikaTa peৗche dAo| Ara yakhana teAmarA mAnuSera keAna vicAra-mImAMsA karate Arambha kara, takhana mImAMsA kara nyAYa bhittika| AllAha teAmAdigake sadupadeza dAna karena| nizcaYai AllAha zravaNakArI, darzanakArI|

he ImAnadAragaNa! AllAhara nirdeza mAnya kara, nirdeza mAnya kara rasUlera evaM teAmAdera madhye yArA vicAraka tAdera| tArapara yadi teAmarA keAna viSaYe vivAde pravRtta haYe par3a, tAhale tA AllAha o tA~ra rasUlera prati pratyarpaNa kara-yadi teAmarA AllAha o keYAmata divasera upara vizvAsI haYe thAka| Ara eTAi kalyANakara evaM pariNatira dika diYe uttama|

Apani ki tAderake dekhenani, yArA dAvI kare ye, yA ApanAra prati avartIrNa haYeche AmarA se viSaYera upara ImAna enechi evaM ApanAra pUrve yA avartINa haYeche| tArA vireAdhIYa viSaYake zaYatAnera dike niYe yete cAYa, athaca tAdera prati nirdeza haYeche, yAte tArA oke mAnya nA kare| pakSAntare zaYatAna tAderake pratArita kare pathabhraSTa kare phelate cAYa|
Ara yakhana Apani tAderake valavena, AllAhara nirdezera dike eseA-yA tini rasUlera prati nAyila karechena, takhana Apani munAphekadigake dekhavena, orA ApanAra kAcha theke sampUrNa bhAve sare yAcche|

ematAvasthAYa yadi tAdera kRtakarmera daruna vipada AreApita haYa, tave tAte ki hala! ataHpara tArA ApanAra kAche AllAhara nAme kasama kheYe kheYe phire Asave ye, maGgala o samprIti chAr3A AmAdera anya keAna uddezya chila nA|

erA haleA se samasta leAka, yAdera manera geApana viSaYa samparkeo AllAha tA’AlA avagata| ataeva, Apani oderake upekSA karuna evaM oderake sadupadeza diYe emana keAna kathA valuna yA tAdera janya kalyANakara|

vastutaH Ami ekamAtra ei uddezyei rasUla preraNa karechi, yAte AllAhara nirdezAnuyAYI tA~dera Adeza-niSedha mAnya karA haYa| Ara sesava leAka yakhana nijedera aniSTa sAdhana karechila, takhana yadi ApanAra kAche Asata ataHpara AllAhara nikaTa kSamA prArthanA karata evaM rasUlao yadi tAderake kSamA kariYe ditena| avazyai tArA AllAhake kSamAkArI, meheravAnarUpe peta|

ataeva, teAmAra pAlanakartAra kasama, se leAka ImAnadAra have nA, yatakSaNa nA tAdera madhye sRSTa vivAdera vyApAre teAmAke nyAYavicAraka vale mane nA kare| ataHpara teAmAra mImAMsAra vyApAre nijera mane keAna rakama saMkIrNatA pAve nA evaM tA hUSTacitte kavula kare neve|

Ara yadi Ami tAdera nirdeza ditAma ye, nijedera prANa dhvaMsa kare dAo kiMvA nijedera nagarI cher3e veriYe yAo, tave tArA tA karata nA; avazya tAdera madhye alpa kaYekajana| yadi tArA tAi kare yA tAdera upadeza deYA haYa, tave tA avazyai tAdera janya uttama eM tAderake nijera dharmera upara sudRr3ha rAkhAra janya tA uttama have|
Ara takhana avazyai Ami tAderake nijera pakSa theke mahAna saoYAva deva|
Ara tAderake sarala pathe paricAlita karava|

Ara ye keu AllAhara hukuma evaM tA~ra rasUlera hukuma mAnya karave, tAhale yA~dera prati AllAha neYAmata dAna karechena, se tA~dera saGgI have| tA~rA halena navI, chiddIka, zahIda o satkarmazIla vyaktivarga| Ara tAdera sAnnidhyai hala uttama|
eTA hala AllAha-pradatta mahattva| Ara AllAha yatheSTa parijJAta|
he ImAnadAragaNa! nijedera astra tule nAo evaM pRthaka pRthaka sainyadale kiMvA samavetabhAve veriYe par3a|
Ara teAmAdera madhye emanao keu keu raYeche, yArA avazya vilamva karave evaM teAmAdera upara keAna vipada upasthita hale valave, AllAha AmAra prati anugraha karechena ye, Ami tAdera sAthe yAini|

pakSAntare teAmAdera prati AllAhara pakSa theke keAna anugraha Asale tArA emana bhAve valate zuru karave yena teAmAdera madhye evaM tAdera madhye keAna mitratAi chila nA| (valave) hAYa, Ami yadi tAdera sAthe thAkatAma, tAhale Ami o ye saphalatA lAbha karatAma|

kAjei AllAhara kAche yArA pArthiva jIvanake AkherAtera parivarte vikri kare deYa tAdera jehAda karAi kartavya| vastutaH yArA AllAhara rAhe lar3Ai kare evaM ataHpara mRtyuvaraNa kare kiMvA vijaYa arjana kare, Ami tAderake mahApuNya dAna karava|

Ara teAmAdera ki hala ye, temArA AllAhara rAhe lar3Ai karacha nA durvala sei puruSa, nArI o zizudera pakSe, yArA vale, he AmAdera pAlanakartA! AmAdigake ei janapada theke niSkRti dAna kara; ekhAnakAra adhivAsIrA ye, atyAcArI! Ara teAmAra pakSa theke AmAdera janya pakSAlamvanakArI nirdhAraNa kare dAo evaM teAmAra pakSa theke AmAdera janya sAhAyyakArI nirdhAraNa kare dAo|

yArA ImAnadAra tArA ye, jehAda kare AllAhara rAhei| pakSAntare yArA kAphera tArA lar3Ai kare zaYatAnera pakSe sutarAM teAmarA jehAda karate thAka zaYatAnera pakSAlamvanakArIdera viruddhe, (dekhave) zaYatAnera cakrAnta ekAntai durvala|

tumi ki sesava leAkake dekhani, yAderake nirdeza deYA haYechila ye, teAmarA nijedera hAtake saMyata rAkha, nAmAya kAYema kara evaM yAkAta dite thAka? ataHpara yakhana tAdera prati jehAdera nirdeza deYA hala, tatkSaNAt tAdera madhye ekadala leAka mAnuSake bhaYa karate Arambha karala, yemana kare bhaYa karA haYa AllAhake| emana ki tAra ceYeo adhika bhaYa| Ara valate lAgala, hAYa pAlanakartA, kena AmAdera upara yuddha pharaja karale! AmAderake kena Arao kichukAla avakAza dAna karale nA| (he rasUla) tAderake vale dina, pArthiva phAYadA sImita| Ara AkherAta paraheyagAradera janya uttama| Ara teAmAdera adhikAra ekaTi sUtA parimAna o kharva karA have nA|

teAmarA yekhAnei thAka nA kena; mRtyu kintu teAmAderake pAkar3Ao karavei| yadi teAmarA sudRr3ha dUrgera bhetareo avasthAna kara, tavuo| vastutaH tAdera keAna kalyANa sAdhita hale tArA vale ye, eTA sAdhita haYeche AllAhara pakSa theke| Ara yadi tAdera keAna akalyANa haYa, tave vale, eTA haYeche teAmAra pakSa theke, vale dAo, esavai AllAhara pakSa theke| pakSAntare tAdera pariNati ki have, yArA kakhanao keAna kathA vujhate ceSTA kare nA|

ApanAra ye kalyANa haYa, tA haYa AllAhara pakSa theke Ara ApanAra ye akalyANa haYa, seTA haYa ApanAra nijera kAraNe| Ara Ami ApanAke pAThiYechi mAnuSera prati AmAra paYagAmera vAhaka hisAve| Ara AllAha sava viSaYei yatheSTa-savaviSaYai tA~ra sammukhe upasthita|
ye leAka rasUlera hukuma mAnya karave se AllAharai hukuma mAnya karala| Ara ye leAka vimukhatA avalamvana karala, Ami ApanAke (he muhAmmada), tAdera janya rakSaNAvekSaNakArI niyukta kare pAThAini|

Ara tArA vale, ApanAra Anugatya kari| ataHpara ApanAra nikaTa theke veriYe gelei tAdera madhya theke keu keu parAmarza kare rAtera velAYa se kathAra paripanthI yA tArA ApanAra sAthe valechila| Ara AllAha likhe nena, se sava parAmarza yA tArA kare thAke| sutarAM Apani tAdera vyApAre nispRhatA avalamvana karuna evaM bharasA karuna AllAhara upara, AllAha halena yatheSTa o kAryasampAdanakArI|
erA ki lakSya kare nA keAraAnera prati? pakSAntare eTA yadi AllAha vyatIta apara kArao pakSa theke hata, tave eteA avazyai vahu vaiparitya dekhate peta|

Ara yakhana tAdera kache pau~che keAna saMvAda zAnti-saMkrAnta kiMvA bhaYera, takhana tArA seguleAke raTiYe deYa| Ara yadi seguleA pau~che dita rasUla paryanta kiMvA tAdera zAsakadera paryanta, takhana anusandhAna kare dekhA yeta sesava viSaYa, yA tAte raYeche anusandhAna karAra mata| vastutaH AllAhara anugraha o karuNA yadi teAmAdera upara vidyamAna nA thAkata tave teAmAdera alpa katipaYa leAka vyatIta savAi zaYatAnera anusaraNa karate zuru karata!

AllAhara rAhe yuddha karate thAkuna, Apani nijera sattA vyatIta anya keAna viSaYera yimmAdAra nana! Ara Apani musalamAnaderake utsAhita karate thAkuna| zIghrai AllAha kApheradera zakti-sAmartha kharva kare devena| Ara AllAha zakti-sAmarthera dika diYe atyanta kaTheAra evaM kaThina zAstidAtA|

ye leAka satkAjera janya keAna supAriza karave, tA theke seo ekaTi aMza pAve| Ara ye leAka supAriza karave manda kAjera janye se tAra veAjhArao ekaTi aMza pAve| vastutaH AllAha sarva viSaYe kSamatAzIla|
Ara teAmAderake yadi keu deAYA kare, tAhale teAmarAo tAra janya deAYA kara; tAraceYe uttama deAYA athavA tArai mata phiriYe vala| nizcaYai AllAha sarva viSaYe hisAva-nikAza grahaNakArI|
AllAha vyatIta Ara keAneAi upAsya nei| avazyai tini teAmAderake samaveta karavena keYAmatera dina, ete vindumAtra sandeha nei| tAchAr3A AllAhara cAite vezI satya kathA Ara kAra have!

ataHpara teAmAdera ki hala ye, munAphikadera samparke teAmarA du’dala haYe gele? athaca AllAha tA’AlA tAderake ghuriYe diYechena tAdera manda kAjera kArane! teAmarA ki tAderake patha pradarzana karate cAo, yAderake AllAha pathabhraSTa karechena? AllAha yAke pathabhrAnta karena, tumi tAra janya keAna patha pAve nA|

tArA cAYa ye, tArA yemana kAphera, teAmarAo temani kAphera haYe yAo, yAte teAmarA evaM tArA sava samAna haYe yAo| ataeva, tAdera madhye kAuke vandhurUpe grahaNa kareA nA, ye paryanta nA tArA AllAhara pathe hijarata kare cale Ase| ataHpara yadi tArA vimukha haYa, tave tAderake pAkar3Ao kara evaM yekhAne pAo hatyA kara| tAdera madhye kAuke vandhurUpe grahaNa kareA nA evaM sAhAyyakArI vAnio nA|

kintu yArA emana sampradAYera sAthe milita haYa ye, teAmAdera madhye o tAdera madhye cukti Ache athavA teAmAdera kAche ebhAve Ase ye, tAdera antara teAmAdera sAthe evaM svajAtira sAtheo yuddha karate anicchuka| yadi AllAha icche karatena, tave teAmAdera upara tAderake pravala kare ditena| phale tArA avazyai teAmAdera sAthe yuddha karata| ataHpara yadi tArA teAmAdera theke pRthaka thAke teAmAdera sAthe yuddha nA kare evaM teAmAdera sAthe sandhi kare, tave AllAha teAmAdera ke tAdera viruddhe keAna patha denani|

ekhana tumi Arao eka sampradAYake pAve| tArA teAmAdera kAcheo svajAtira kAcheo evaM nirvighna haYe thAkate cAYa| yakhana tAderake phyAsAdera prati maneAniveza karAneA haYa, takhana tArA tAte nipatita haYa, ataeva tArA yadi teAmAdera theke nivRtta nA haYa, teAmAdera sAthe sandhi nA rAkhe evaM svIYa hastasamUhake virata nA rAkhe, tave teAmarA tAderake pAkar3Ao kara evaM yekhAne pAo hatyA kara| Ami tAdera viruddhe teAmAderake prakAzya yukti-pramANa dAna karechi|

musalamAnera kAja naYa ye, musalamAnake hatyA kare; kintu bhulakrame| ye vyakti musalamAnake bhUlakrame hatyA kare, se ekajana musalamAna krItadAsa mukta karave evaM rakta vinimaYa samarpana karave tAra svajanaderake; kintu yadi tArA kSamA kare deYa| ataHpara yadi nihata vyakti teAmAdera zatru sampradAYera antargata haYa, tave musalamAna krItadAsa mukta karave evaM yadi se teAmAdera sAthe cuktivaddha keAna sampradAYera antargata haYa, tave rakta vinimaYa samarpaNa karave tAra svajanaderake evaM ekajana musalamAna krItadAsa mukta karave| ataHpara ye vyakti nA pAYa, se AllAhara kAcha theke geAnAha mApha karAneAra janye uparyupuri dui mAsa reAyA rAkhave| AllAha, mahAjJAnI, prajJAmaYa|

ye vyakti svecchAkrame musalamAnake hatyA kare, tAra zAsti jAhAnnAma, tAtei se cirakAla thAkave| AllAha tAra prati kruddha haYechena, tAke abhisampAta karechena evaM tAra janye bhISaNa zAsti prastuta rekhechena|

he ImAnadAragaNa! teAmarA yakhana AllAhara pathe saphara kara, takhana yAcAi kare nio evaM ye, teAmAderake sAlAma kare tAke valeA nA ye, tumi musalamAna nao| teAmarA pArthiva jIvanera sampada anveSaNa kara, vastutaH AllAhara kAche aneka sampada raYeche| teAmarA o teA emani chile itipUrve; ataHpara AllAha teAmAdera prati anugraha karechena| ataeva, ekhana anusandhAna kare nio| nizcaYa AllAha teAmAdera kAja karmera khavara rAkhena|

gRhe upaviSTa musalamAna-yAdera keAna saGgata oyara nei evaM ai musalamAna yArA jAna o mAla dvArA AllAhara pathe jehAda kare,-samAna naYa| yArA jAna o mAla dvArA jehAda kare, AllAha tAdera padamaryAdA vAr3iYe diYechena gRhe upaviSTadera tulanAYa evaM pratyekera sAthei AllAha kalyANera oYAdA karechena| AllAha mujAhedInake upaviSTadera upara mahAna pratidAne zreSTha karechena|
eguleA tA~ra pakSa theke padamaryAdA, kSamA o karuNA; AllAha kSamAzIla o karuNAmaYa|

yArA nijera aniSTa kare, pherezatArA tAdera prANa haraNa kare vale, teAmarA ki avasthAYa chile? tArA valeH e bhUkhanDe AmarA asahAYa chilAma| pherezatArA valeH AllAhara pRthivI ki prazasta chila nA ye, teAmarA dezatyAga kare sekhAne cale yete? ataeva, edera vAsasthAna hala jAhAnnAma evaM tA atyanta manda sthAna|
kintu puruSa, nArI o zizudera madhye yArA asahAYa, tArA keAna upAYa karate pAre nA evaM pathao jAne nA|
ataeva, AzA karA yAYa, AllAha tAderake kSamA karavena| AllAha mArjanAkArI, kSamAzIla|

ye keu AllAhara pathe dezatyAga kare, se era vinimaYe aneka sthAna o sacchalatA prApta have| ye keu nija gRha theke vera haYa AllAha o rasUlera prati hijarata karAra uddeze, ataHpara mRtyumukhe patita haYa, tave tAra saoYAva AllAhara kAche avadhArita haYe yAYa| AllAha kSamAzIla, karuNAmaYa|

yakhana teAmarA keAna deza saphara kara, takhana nAmAye kichuTA hrAsa karale teAmAdera keAna geAnAha nei, yadi teAmarA AzaGkA kara ye, kApherarA teAmAderake uttyakta karave| nizcaYa kApherarA teAmAdera prakAzya zatru|

yakhana Apani tAdera madhye thAkena, ataHpara nAmAye dA~r3Ana, takhana yena ekadala dA~r3AYa ApanAra sAthe evaM tArA yena svIYa astra sAthe neYa| ataHpara yakhana tArA sejadA sampanna kare, takhana ApanAra kAcha theke yena sare yAYa evaM anya dala yena Ase, yArA nAmAya par3eni| ataHpara tArA yena ApanAra sAthe nAmAya par3e evaM AtmarakSAra hAtiYAra sAthe neYa| kApherarA cAYa ye, teAmarA keAna rUpe asatarka thAka, yAte tArA ekayeAge teAmAderake AkramaNa kare vase| yadi vRSTira kAraNe teAmAdera kaSTa haYa athavA teAmarA asustha hao tave svIYa astra parityAga karAYa teAmAdera keAna geAnAha nei evaM sAthe niYe nAo teAmAdera AtnarakSAra astra| nizcaYa AllAha kApheradera janye apamAnakara zAsti prastuta kare rekhechena|

ataHpara yakhana teAmarA nAmAya sampanna kara, takhana danDAYamAna, upaviSTa o zAYita avasthAYa AllAhake smaraNa kara| ataHpara yakhana vipadamukta haYe yAo, takhana nAmAya Thika kare par3a| nizcaYa nAmAya musalamAnadera upara pharaya nirdiSTa samaYera madhye|

tAdera pazcAddhAvane zaithilya kareA nA| yadi teAmarA AghAta prApta, tave tArAo teA teAmAdera matai haYeche AghAtaprApta evaM teAmarA AllAhara kAche AzA kara, yA tArA AzA kare nA| AllAha mahAjJAnI, prajJAmaYa|
nizcaYa Ami ApanAra prati satya kitAva avatIrNa karechi, yAte Apani mAnuSera madhye phaYasAlA karena, yA AllAha ApanAke hRdaYaGgama karAna| Apani vizvAsaghAtakadera pakSa theke vitarkakArI havena nA|
evaM AllAhara kAche kSamA prArthanA karuna| nizcaYa AllAha kSamAzIla, daYAlu|
yArA mane vizvAsa ghAtakatA peASaNa kare tAdera pakSa theke vitarka karavena nA| AllAha pachanda karena nA tAke, ye vizvAsa ghAtaka pApI haYa|

tArA mAnuSera kAche lajjita haYa evaM AllAhara kAche lajjita haYa nA| tini tAdera sAthe raYechena, yakhana tArA rAtre emana viSaYe parAmarza kare, yAte AllAha sammata nana| tArA yAkichu kare, savai AllAhara AYattAdhINa|
zunacha? teAmarA tAdera pakSa theke pArthiva jIvane vivAda karacha, ataHpara keYAmatera dine tAdera pakSa haYe AllAhara sAthe ke vivAda karave athavA ke tAdera kAryanirvAhI have|
ye geAnAha, kare kiMvA nijera aniSTa kare, ataHpara AllAhara kAche kSamA prArthanA kare, se AllAhake kSamAzIla, karuNAmaYa pAYa|
ye keu pApa kare, se nijera pakSei kare| AllAha mahAjJAnI, prajJAmaYa|
ye vyakti bhUla kiMvA geAnAha kare, ataHpara keAna niraparAdhera upara apavAda AreApa kare se nijera mAthAYa vahana kare jaghanya mithyA o prakAzya geAnAha|

yadi ApanAra prati AllAhara anugraha o karuNA nA hata, tave tAdera ekadala ApanAke pathabhraSTa karAra saMkalpa karei phelechila| tArA pathabhrAnta karate pAre nA kintu nijederakei evaM ApanAra keAna aniSTa karate pAre nA| AllAha ApanAra prati aizI grantha o prajJA avatIrNa karechena evaM ApanAke emana viSaYa zikSA diYechena, yA Apani jAnatena nA| ApanAra prati AllAhara karuNA asIma|

tAdera adhikAMza salA-parAmarza bhAla naYa; kintu ye salA-parAmarza dAna khaYarAta karate kiMvA satkAja karate kiMvA mAnuSera madhye sandhisthApana kalpe karateA tA svatantra| ye ekAja kare AllAhara santuSTira janye Ami tAke virATa chaoYAva dAna karava|

ye keu rasUlera viruddhAcAraNa kare, tAra kAche sarala patha prakAzita haoYAra para evaM sava musalamAnera anusRta pathera viruddhe cale, Ami tAke ai dikei pherAva ye dika se avalamvana kareche evaM tAke jAhAnnAme nikSepa karava| Ara tA nikRSTatara gantavyasthAna|
nizcaYa AllAha tAke kSamA karena nA, ye tA~ra sAthe kAuke zarIka kare| echAr3A yAke icchA, kSamA karena| ye AllAhara sAthe zarIka kare se sudUra bhrAntite patita haYa|
tArA AllAhake parityAga kare zudhu nArIra ArAdhanA kare evaM zudhu avAdhya zaYatAnera pUjA kare|
yAra prati AllAha abhisampAta karechena| zaYatAna valalaH Ami avazyai teAmAra vAndAdera madhya theke nirdiSTa aMza grahaNa karava|

tAderake pathabhraSTa karava, tAderake AzvAsa deva; tAderake pazudera karNa chedana karate valava evaM tAderake AllAhara sRSTa AkRti parivartana karate Adeza deva| ye keu AllAhake cher3e zaYatAnake vandhurUpe grahaNa kare, se prakAzya kSatite patita haYa|
se tAderake pratizruti deYa evaM tAderake AzvAsa deYa| zaYatAna tAderake ye pratizruti deYa, tA sava pratAraNA vai naYa|
tAdera vAsasthAna jAhAnnAma| tArA sekhAna theke keAthAo pAlAvAra jAYagA pAve nA|

yArA vizvAsa sthApana kareche evaM satkarma kareche, Ami tAderake udyAnasamUhe praviSTa karAva, yeguleAra taladeze naharasamUha pravAhita haYa| tArA cirakAla tathAYa avasthAna karave| AllAha pratizruti diYechena satya satya| AllAhara cAite adhika satyavAdI ke?
teAmAdera AzAra upara o bhitti naYa evaM Ahale-kitAvadera AzAra uparao nA| ye keu manda kAja karave, se tAra zAsti pAve evaM se AllAha chAr3A nijera keAna samarthaka vA sAhAyyakArI pAve nA|
ye leAka puruSa heAka kiMvA nArI, keAna satkarma kare evaM vizvAsI haYa, tave tArA jAnnAte praveza karave evaM tAdera prApya tila parimANa o naSTa have nA|

ye AllAhara nirdezera sAmane mastaka avanata kare satkAje niYeAjita thAke evaM ivrAhImera dharma anusaraNa kare, yini ekaniSTha chilena, tAra cAite uttama dharma kAra? AllAha ivrAhImake vandhurUpe grahaNa karechena|
yA kichu nabheAnDale Ache evaM yA kichu bhumanDale Ache, sava AllAharai| sava vastu AllAhara muSThi valaYe|

tArA ApanAra kAche nArIdera vivAhera anumati cAYa| vale dinaH AllAha teAmAderake tAdera samparke anumati dena evaM keAraAne teAmAderake yA yA pATa kare zunAneA haYa, tA ai sava pitRhInA-nArIdera vidhAna, yAdera ke teAmarA nirdhArita adhikAra pradAna kara nA athaca vivAha vandhane Avaddha karAra vAsanA rAkha| Ara akSama zizudera vidhAna ei ye, etImadera janye inasAphera upara kAYema thAka| teAmarA yA bhAla kAja karave, tA AllAha jAnena|

yadi keAna nArI svIYa svAmIra pakSa theke asadAcaraNa kiMvA upekSAra AzaMkA kare, tave paraspara keAna mImAMsA kare nile tAdera ubhaYera keAna geAnAha nAi| mImAMsA uttama| manera sAmane leAbha vidyamAna Ache| yadi teAmarA uttama kAja kara evaM kheAdAbhIru hao, tave, AllAha teAmAdera sava kAjera khavara rAkhena|

teAmarA kakhanao nArIderake samAna rAkhate pArave nA, yadio era AkAGkSI hao| ataeva, sampUrNa jhu~keo par3eA nA ye, ekajanake phele rAkha deAdulyamAna avasthAYa| yadi saMzeAdhana kara evaM kheAdAbhIru hao, tave AllAha kSamAzIla, karuNAmaYa|
yadi ubhaYei vicchinna haYe yAYa, tave AllAha svIYa prazastatA dvArA pratyekake amukhApekSI kare divena| AllAha suprazasta, prajJAmaYa|

Ara yA kichu raYeche AsamAna samUhe o yamIne savai AllAhara| vastutaH Ami nirdeza diYechi teAmAdera pUrvavartI granthera adhikArIderake evaM teAmAderake ye, teAmarA savAi bhaYa karate thAka AllAhake| yadi teAmarA tA nA mAna, tave jeneA, se sava kichui AllAha tA’AlAra yA kichu raYeche AsamAna samUhe o yamIne| Ara AllAha hacchena abhAvahIna, prasaMzita|
Ara AllAharai janye se savakichu yA kichu raYeche AsamAna samUhe o yamIne| AllAhai yatheSTa karmavidhAYaka|
he mAnavakUla, yadi AllAha teAmAderake sariYe teAmAdera jAYagAYa anya kAuke pratiSThita karena? vastutaH AllAhara se kSamatA raYeche|
ye keu duniYAra kalyANa kAmanA karave, tAra jene rAkhA praYeAjana ye, duniYA o AkherAtera kalyANa AllAharai nikaTa raYeche| Ara AllAha sava kichu zeAnena o dekhena|

he ImAnadAragaNa, teAmarA nyAYera upara pratiSThita thAka; AllAhara oYAste nyAYasaGgata sAkSyadAna kara, tAte teAmAdera nijera vA pitA-mAtAra athavA nikaTavartI AtnIYa-svajanera yadi kSati haYa tavuo| keu yadi dhanI kiMvA daridra haYa, tave AllAha tAdera zubhAkAGkhI teAmAdera cAite vezI| ataeva, teAmarA vicAra karate giYe ripura kAmanA-vAsanAra anusaraNa kareA nA| Ara yadi teAmarA ghuriYe-pe~ciYe kathA vala kiMvA pAza kATiYe yAo, tave AllAha teAmAdera yAvatIYa kAja karma samparkei avagata|
