he ImAnadAragaNa, AllAhara upara paripUrNa vizvAsa sthApana kara evaM vizvAsa sthApana kara tA~ra rasUlao tA~ra kitAvera upara, yA tini nAyila karechena svIYa rasUlera upara evaM sesamasta kitAvera upara, yeguleA nAyila karA haYechila itipUrve| ye AllAhara upara, tA~ra pherezatAdera upara, tA~ra kitAva samUhera upara evaM rasUlagaNera upara o kiYAmatadinera upara vizvAsa karave nA, se pathabhraSTa haYe vahu dUre giYe par3ave|

yArA ekavAra musalamAna haYe pare punarAYa kAphera haYe geche, AvAra musalamAna haYeche evaM AvAreA kAphera haYeche evaM kupharItei unnati lAbha kareche, AllAha tAderake nA kakhanao kSamA karavena, nA patha dekhAvena|
sesava munAphekake susaMvAda zuniYe dina ye, tAdera janya nirdhArita raYeche vedanAdAYaka AyAva|
yArA musalamAnadera varjana kare kApheraderake nijedera vandhu vAniYe neYa evaM tAderai kAche sammAna pratyAzA kare, athaca yAvatIYa sammAna zudhumAtra AllAharai janya|

Ara keAraAnera mAdhyame teAmAdera prati ei hukuma jAri kare diYechena ye, yakhana AllAha tA’ AlAra AYAtasamUhera prati asvIkRti jJApana o vidrupa hate zunave, takhana teAmarA tAdera sAthe vasave nA, yatakSaNa nA tArA prasaGgAntare cale yAYa| tA nA hale teAmarAo tAderai mata haYe yAve| AllAha deAyakhera mAjhe munApheka o kApheraderake ekai jAYagAYa samaveta karavena|

erA emani munApheka yArA teAmAdera kalyANa-akalyANera pratIkSAYa OMtpete thAke| ataHpara AllAhara icchAYa teAmAdera yadi keAna vijaYa arjita haYa, tave tArA vale, AmarAo ki teAmAdera sAthe chilAma nA? pakSAntare kApheradera yadi AMzika vijaYa haYa, tave vale, AmarA ki teAmAderake ghire rAkhini evaM musalamAnadera kavala theke rakSA karini? sutarAM AllAha teAmAdera madhye keYAmatera dina mImAMsA karavena evaM kichutei AllAha kApheraderake musalamAnadera upara vijaYa dAna karavena nA|

avazyai munAphekarA pratAraNA karache AllAhara sAthe, athaca tArA nijerAi nijedera pratArita kare| vastutaH tArA yakhana nAmAye dA~r3AYa takhana dA~r3AYa, ekAnta zithila bhAve leAka dekhAneAra janya| Ara tArA AllAhake alpai smaraNa kare|
erA deAdulyamAna avasthAYa jhulanta; edikeo naYa odikeo naYa| vastutaH yAke AllAha geAmarAha kare dena, tumi tAdera janya keAna pathai pAve nA keAthAo|
he ImAnadAragaNa! teAmarA kApheraderake vandhu vAnio nA musalamAnadera vAda diYe| teAmarA ki emanaTi kare nijera upara AllAhara prakAzya dalIla kAYema kare deve?
niHsandehe munAphekarA raYeche deAyakhera sarvanimna stare| Ara teAmarA tAdera janya keAna sAhAyyakArI kakhanao pAve nA|

avazya yArA taovA kare niYeche, nijedera avasthAra saMskAra kareche evaM AllAhara pathake sudRr3habhAve A~kar3e dhare AllAhara pharamAvaradAra haYeche, tArA thAkave musalamAnaderai sAthe| vastutaH AllAha zIghrai ImAnadAragaNake mahApUNya dAna karavena|
teAmAdera AyAva diYe AllAha ki karavena yadi teAmarA kRtajJatA prakAza kara evaM ImAnera upara pratiSThita thAka! Ara AllAha hacchena samucita mUlyadAnakArI sarvajJa|
AllAha keAna manda viSaYa prakAza karA pachanda karena nA| tave kAreA prati juluma haYe thAkale se kathA AlAdA| AllAha zravaNakArI, vijJa|
teAmarA yadi kalyANa kara prakAzyabhAve kiMvA geApane athavA yadi teAmarA AparAdha kSamA kare dAo, tave jeneA, AllAha nijeo kSamAkArI, mahAzaktizAlI|

yArA AllAha o tAra rasUlera prati asvIkRti jJApanakArI tadupari AllAha o rasUlera prati vizvAse tAratamya karate cAYa Ara vale ye, AmarA katakake vizvAsa kari kintu katakake pratyAkhyAna kari evaM erai madhyavartI keAna patha avalamvana karate cAYa|
prakRtapakSe erAi satya pratyAkhyAkArI| Ara yArA satya pratyAkhyAnakArI tAdera janya tairI kare rekhechi apamAnajanaka AyAva|

Ara yArA ImAna eneche AllAhara upara, tA~ra rasUlera upara evaM tA~dera kArao prati ImAna Anate giYe kAuke vAda deYani, zIghrai tAderake prApya saoYAva dAna karA have| vastutaH AllAha kSamAzIla daYAlu|

ApanAra nikaTa Ahale-kitAvarA Avedana jAnAYa ye, Apani tAdera upara AsamAna theke likhita kitAva avatIrNa kariYe niYe Asuna| vastutaH erA mUsAra kAche era ceYeo var3a jinisa ceYeche| valeche, ekevAre sAmanAsAmanibhAve AmAdera AllAhake dekhiYe dAo| ataeva, tAdera upara vajrapAta haYeche tAdera pApera daruna; ataHpara tAdera nikaTa suspaSTa pramANa-nidarzana prakAzita havAra pareo tArA geA-vatsake upAsyarUpe grahaNa karechila; tAo Ami kSamA kare diYechilAma evaM Ami mUsAke prakRSTa prabhAva dAna karechilAma|

Ara tAdera kAcha theke pratizruti nevAra uddezye Ami tAdera upara tUra parvatake tule dharechilAma evaM tAderake valechilAma, avanata mastake darajAYa DheAka| Ara valechilAma, zanivAra dina sImAlaMghana kareA nA| ebhAve tAdera kAcha theke dRr3ha aGgIkAra niYechilAma|

ataeva, tArA ye zAstiprApta haYechila, tA chila tAderai aGgIkAra bhaGgara janya evaM anyAYabhAve rasUlagaNake hatyA karAra kAraNe evaM tAdera ei uktira daruna ye, AmAdera hRdaYa Acchanna| avazya tA naYa, varaM kupharIra kAraNe svaYaM AllAha tAdera antarera upara meAhara e~Te diYechena| phale erA ImAna Ane nA kintu ati alpasaMkhyaka|
Ara tAdera kupharI evaM mariYamera prati mahA apavAda AreApa karAra kAraNe|

Ara tAdera ekathA valAra kAraNe ye, AmarA mariYama putra IsA masIhake hatyA karechi yini chilena AllAhara rasUla| athaca tArA nA tA~ke hatyA kareche, Ara nA zulIte car3iYeche, varaM tArA erUpa dhA~dhAYa patita haYechila| vastutaH tArA e vyApAre nAnA rakama kathA vale, tArA ekSetre sandehera mAjhe par3e Ache, zudhumAtra anumAna karA chAr3A tArA e viSaYe keAna khavarai rAkhe nA| Ara nizcaYai tA~ke tArA hatyA kareni|
varaM tA~ke uThiYe niYechena AllAha tA’AlA nijera kAche| Ara AllAha hacchena mahAparAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|
Ara Ahale-kitAvadera madhye yata zreNI raYeche tArA savAi ImAna Anave IsAra upara tAdera mRtyura pUrve| Ara keYAmatera dina tAdera janya sAkSIra upara sAkSI upasthita have|
vastutaH ihudIdera janya Ami hArAma kare diYechi vahu pUta-pavitra vastu yA tAdera janya hAlAla chila-tAdera pApera kAraNe evaM AllAhara pathe adhika parimANe vAdhA dAnera daruna|

Ara e kAraNe ye, tArA suda grahaNa karata, athaca e vyApAre niSedhAjJA AreApa karA haYechila evaM e kAraNe ye, tArA aparera sampada bheAga karateA anyAYa bhAve| vastuta; Ami kApheradera janya tairI kare rekhechi vedanAdAYaka AyAva|

kintu yArA tAdera madhye jJAnapakka o ImAnadAra, tArA tAo mAnya kare yA ApanAra upara avatIrNa haYeche evaM yA avatIrNa haYeche ApanAra pUrve| Ara yArA nAmAye anuvartitA pAlanakArI, yArA yAkAta dAnakArI evaM yArA AllAha o keYAmate AsthAzIla| vastutaH emana leAkaderake Ami dAna karaveA mahApuNya|

Ami ApanAra prati ohI pAThiYechi, yemana kare ohI pAThiYechilAma nUhera prati evaM se samasta navI-rasUlera prati yA~rA tA~ra pare prerita haYechena| Ara ohI pAThiYechi, isamAIla, ivrAhIma, isahAka, iYAkuva, o tA~ra santAvargera prati evaM IsA, AiYuva, iunUsa, hAruna o sulAYamAnera prati| Ara Ami dAudake dAna karechi yavura grantha|

echAr3A emana rasUla pAThiYechi yAdera itivRtta Ami ApanAke zuniYechi itipUrve evaM emana rasUla pAThiYechi yAdera vRttAnta ApanAke zeAnAini| Ara AllAha mUsAra sAthe katheApakathana karechena sarAsari|

susaMvAdadAtA o bhIti-pradarzanakArI rasUlagaNake preraNa karechi, yAte rasUlagaNera pare AllAhara prati apavAda AreApa karAra mata keAna avakAza mAnuSera janya nA thAke| AllAha pravala parAkramazIla, prAjJa|
AllAha ApanAra prati yA avatIrNa karechena tini ye tA sajJAnei karechena, se vyApAre AllAha nijeo sAkSI evaM pherezatAgaNao sAkSI| Ara sAkSI hisAve AllAhai yatheSTa|
yArA kupharI avalamvana kareche, evaM AllAhara pathe vAdhAra sRSTi kareche, tArA vibhrAntite sudUre patita haYeche|
yArA kupharI avalamvana kareche evaM satya cApA diYe rekheche, AllAha kakhanao tAdera kSamA karavena nA evaM sarala patha dekhAvena nA|
tAdera janya raYeche jAhAnnAmera patha| sekhAne tArA vAsa karave anantakAla| Ara emana karATA AllAhara pakSe sahaja|

he mAnavajAti! teAmAdera pAlanakartAra yathArtha vANI niYe teAmAdera nikaTa rasUla esechena, teAmarA tA mene nAo yAte teAmAdera kalyANa hate pAre| Ara yadi teAmarA tA nA mAna, jene rAkha AsamAnasamUhe o yamIne yA kichu raYeche se savakichui AllAhara| Ara AllAha hacchena sarvajJa, prAjJa|

he Ahale-kitAvagaNa! teAmarA dvInera vyApAre vAr3AvAr3i kareA nA evaM AllAhara zAne nitAnta saGgata viSaYa chAr3A keAna kathA valeA nA| niHsandehe mariYama putra masIha IsA AllAhara rasUla evaM tA~ra vANI yA tini preraNa karechena mariYamera nikaTa evaM rUha-tA~rai kAcha theke Agata| ataeva, teAmarA AllAhake evaM tAra rasUlagaNake mAnya kara| Ara ekathA valeA nA ye, AllAha tinera eka, ekathA parihAra kara; teAmAdera maGgala have| niHsandehe AllAha ekaka upAsya| santAna-santati haoYATA tA~ra yeAgya viSaYa naYa| yA kichu AsamAna samUha o yamIne raYeche savai tAra| Ara karmavidhAne AllAhai yatheSTa|

masIha AllAhara vAndA havena, tAte tAra keAna lajjAveAdha nei evaM ghaniSTha pherezatAderao nA| vastutaH yArA AllAhara dAsatve lajjAveAdha karave evaM ahaMkAra karave, tini tAdera savAike nijera kAche samaveta karavena|

ataHpara yArA ImAna eneche evaM satkAja kareche, tini tAderake paripUrNa saoYAva dAna karavena, varaM svIYa anugrahe AreA vezI devena| pakSAntare yArA lajjAveAdha kareche evaM ahaGkAra kareche tini tAderake devena vedanAdAYaka AyAva| AllAhake chAr3A tArA keAna sAhAyyakArI o samarthaka pAve nA|
he mAnavakula! teAmAdera paraoYAradegArera pakSa theke teAmAdera nikaTa sanada pau~che geche| Ara Ami teAmAdera prati prakRSTa AleA avatIrNa karechi|
ataeva, yArA AllAhara prati ImAna eneche evaM tAte dRr3hatA avalamvana kareche tini tAderake svIYa rahamata o anugrahera AotAYa sthAna devena evaM nijera dike AsAra mata sarala pathe tule devena|

mAnuSa ApanAra nikaTa phateAYA jAnate cAYa ataeva, Apani vale dina, AllAha teAmAdigake kAlAlAha era mIrAsa saMkrAnta suspaSTa nirdeza vAtale dicchena, yadi keAna puruSa mArA yAYa evaM tAra keAna santAnAdi nA thAke evaM eka veAna thAke, tave se pAve tAra parityAkta sampattira ardheka aMza evaM se yadi niHsantAna haYa, tave tAra bhAi tAra uttarAdhikArI have| tA dui veAna thAkale tAdera janya parityakta sampattira dui tRtIYAMza| pakSAntare yadi bhAi o veAna ubhaYai thAke, tave ekajana puruSera aMza dujana nArIra samAna| teAmarA vibhrAnta have AllAha teAmAdigake suspaSTa bhAve jAniYe dicchena| Ara AllAha hacchena sarva viSaYe parijJAta|

muminagaNa, teAmarA aGgIkArasamUha pUrna kara| teAmAdera janya catuSpada jantu hAlAla karA haYeche, yA teAmAdera kAche vivRta have tA vyatIta| kintu eharAma vAdhA~ avasthAYa zikArake hAlAla mane kareA nA! nizcaYa AllAha tA’AlA yA icchA karena, nirdeza dena|

he muminagaNa! hAlAla mane kareA nA AllAhara nidarzanasamUha evaM sammAnita mAsasamUhake evaM harame kuravAnIra janye nirdiSTa jantuke evaM aisava jantuke, yAdera galAYa kanThAbharaNa raYeche evaM aisava leAkake yArA sammAnita gRha abhimukhe yAcche, yArA svIYa pAlanakartAra anugraha o santuSTi kAmanA kare| yakhana teAmarA eharAma theke vera haYe Asa, takhana zikAra kara| yArA pavitra masajida theke teAmAderake vAdhA pradAna karechila, sei sampradAYera zutrutA yena teAmAderake sImAlaGghane prareAcita nA kare| satkarma o kheAdAbhItite eke anyera sAhAyya kara| pApa o sImAlaGghanera vyApAre eke anyera sahAYatA kareA nA| AllAhake bhaYa kara| nizcaYa AllAha tA’AlA kaTheAra zAstidAtA|

teAmAdera janye hArAma karA haYeche mRta jIva, rakta, zukarera mAMsa, yesava jantu AllAha chAr3A anyera nAme utsargakRta haYa, yA kanThareAdhe mArA yAYa, yA AghAta lege mArA yAYa, yA ucca sthAna theke patanera phale mArA yA, yA ziM era AghAte mArA yAYa evaM yAke hiMsra jantu bhakSaNa kareche, kintu yAke teAmarA yaveha karecha| ye jantu yajJavedIte yaveha karA haYa evaM yA bhAgya nirdhAraka zara dvArA vanTana karA haYa| esava geAnAhara kAja| Aja kApherarA teAmAdera dvIna theke nirAza haYe geche| ataeva tAderake bhaYa kareA nA varaM AmAke bhaYa kara| Aja Ami teAmAdera janye teAmAdera dvInake pUrnAGga kare dilAma, teAmAdera prati AmAra avadAna sampUrNa kare dilAma evaM isalAmake teAmAdera janye dvIna hiseve pachanda karalAma| ataeva ye vyAkti tIvra kSudhAYa kAtara haYe par3e; kintu keAna geAnAhara prati pravaNatA nA thAke, tave nizcaYai AllAha tA’AlA kSamAzIla|

tArA ApanAke jijJesa kare ye, ki vastu tAdera janye hAlAla? vale dina, teAmAdera janye pavitra vastusamUha hAlAla karA haYeche| yesava zikArI jantuke teAmarA prazikSaNa dAna kara zikArera prati preraNera janye evaM oderake ai paddhatite prazikSaNa dAo, yA AllAha teAmAderake zikSA diYechena| emana zikArI jantu ye zikArake teAmAdera janye dhare rAkhe, tA khAo evaM tAra upara AllAhara nAma uccAraNa kara| AllAhake bhaYa karate thAka| nizcaYa AllAha sattvara hisAva grahaNakArI|

Aja teAmAdera janya pavitra vastusamUha hAlAla karA hala| Ahale kitAvadera khAdya teAmAdera janye hAlAla evaM teAmAdera khAdya tAdera janya hAlAla| teAmAdera janye hAlAla satI-sAdhvI musalamAna nArI evaM tAdera satI-sAdhvI nArI, yAderake kitAva deYA haYeche teAmAdera pUrve, yakhana teAmarA tAderake meAharAnA pradAna kara tAderake strI karAra janye, kAmavAsanA caritArtha karAra janye kiMvA gupta preme lipta haoYAra janye naYa| ye vyakti vizvAsera viSaYa avizvAsa kare, tAra zrama viphale yAve evaM parakAle se kSatigrasta have|

he muminagaNa, yakhana tomarA nAmAyera janye uTha, takhana svIya় mukhamanDala o hastasamUha kanui paryanta dhauta kara, mAthA mucheha kara evaM padayugala giTasaha| yadi tomarA apavitra hao tave sArA deha pavitra kare nAo evaM yadi tomarA rugna hao, athavA pravAse thAka athavA tomAdera keu prasAva-pAya়khAnA sere Ase athavA tomarA strIdera sAthe sahavAsa kara, ataHpara pAni nA pAo, tave tomarA pavitra mATi dvArA tAya়Ammuma kare nAo-arthAt, svIya় mukha-manDala o hastadvaya় mATi dvArA muche phela| AllAha tomAderake asuvidhAya় phelate cAna nA; kintu tomAderake pavitra rAkhate cAna evaM tomAdera prati svIya় neya়Amata pUrNa karate cAna-yAte tomarA kRtajJAtA prakAza kara|

teAmarA AllAhara neYAmatera kathA smaraNa kara, yA teAmAdera prati avatIrNa haYeche evaM ai aGgIkArakeo yA teAmAdera kAcha theke niYechena, yakhana teAmarA valechileH AmarA zunalAma evaM mene nilAma| AllAhake bhaYa kara| nizcaYai AllAha antarera viSaYa samparke pureApuri khavara rAkhena|

he muminagaNa, teAmarA AllAhara uddeze nyAYa sAkSyadAnera vyApAre avicala thAkave evaM keAna sampradAYera zatrutAra kAraNe kakhanao nyAYavicAra parityAga kareA nA| suvicAra kara eTAi kheAdAbhItira adhika nikaTavartI| AllAhake bhaYa kara| teAmarA yA kara, nizcaYa AllAha se viSaYe khuva jJAta|
yArA vizvAsa sthApana kare, evaM satkarma sampAdana kare, AllAha tAderake kSamA o mahAna pratidAnera pratizruti diYechena|
yArA avizvAsa kare evaM AmAra nidarzanAvalIke mithyA vale, tAra deAyakhI|

he muminagaNa, teAmAdera prati AllAhara anugraha smaraNa kara, yakhana eka sampradAYa teAmAdera dike svIYa hasta prasArita karate saceSTa haYechila, takhana tini tAdera hasta teAmAdera theke pratihata kare dilena| AllAhake bhaYa kara evaM muminadera AllAhara uparai bharasA karA ucita|

AllAha vanI-isarAIlera kAcha theke aGgIkAra niYechilena evaM Ami tAdera madhya theke vAra jana sardAra niyukta karechilAma| AllAha vale dilenaH Ami teAmAdera saGge Achi| yadi teAmarA nAmAya pratiSThita kara, yAkAta dite thAka, AmAra paYagamvaradera prati vizvAsa rAkha, tA~dera sAhAyya kara evaM AllAhake uttama panthAYa Rna dite thAka, tave Ami avazyai teAmAdera geAnAha dura kare diva evaM avazyai teAmAderake udyAna samUhe praviSTa karava, yeguleAra taladeza diYe nijharinIsamUha pravAhita haYa| ataHpara teAmAdera madhya theke ye vyakti eraparao kAphera haYa, se nizcitai sarala patha theke vicyuta haYe par3e|

ataeva, tAdera aGgIkAra bhaGgera daruna Ami tAdera upara abhisampAta karechi evaM tAdera antarake kaTheAra kare diYechi| tArA kAlAmake tAra sthAna theke vicyuta kare deYa evaM tAderake ye upadeza deYA haYechila, tArA tA theke upakAra lAbha karAra viSaYaTi vismRta haYeche| Apani sarvadA tAdera keAna nA keAna pratAraNA samparke avagata hate thAkena, tAdera alpa kaYekajana chAr3A| ataeva, Apani tAderake kSamA karuna evaM mArjanA karuna| AllAha anugrahakArIderake bhAlavAsena|

yArA valeH AmarA nAchArA, Ami tAdera kAcha thekeo tAdera aGgIkAra niYechilAma| ataHpara tArAo ye upadeza prApta haYechila, tA theke upakAra lAbha karA bhule gela| ataHpara Ami keYAmata paryanta tAdera madhye pArasparika zatrutA o vidveSa saJcArita kare diYechi| avazeSe AllAha tAderake tAdera kRtakarma samparke avahita karavena|

he Ahale-kitAvagaNa! teAmAdera kAche AmAra rAsUla Agamana karechena! kitAvera yesava viSaYa teAmarA geApana karate, tini tAra madhya theke aneka viSaYa prakAza karena evaM aneka viSaYa mArjanA karena| teAmAdera kAche ekaTi ujjala jyeAti eseche evaM ekaTi samujjala grantha|

era dvArA AllAha yArA tA~ra santuSTi kAmanA kare, tAderake nirApattAra patha pradarzana karena evaM tAderake svIYa nirdeza dvArA andhakAra theke vera kare AleAra dike AnaYana karena evaM sarala pathe paricAlanA karena|

nizcaYa tArA kAphera, yArA vale, masIha ivane mariYamai AllAha| Apani jijJesa karuna, yadi tAi haYa, tave vala yadi AllAha masIha ivane mariYama, tA~ra jananI evaM bhUmanDale yArA Ache, tAdera savAike dhvaMsa karate cAna, tave emana kArao sAdhya Ache ki ye AllAhara kAcha theke tAderake vindumAtrao vA~cAte pAre? nabheAmanDala, bhumanDala o etadubhaYera madhye yA Ache, savakichura upara AllAha tA’AlAra Adhipatya| tini yA icchA sRSTi karena| AllAha savakichura upara zaktimAna|

ihudI o khrISTAnarA vale, AmarA AllAhara santAna o tA~ra priYajana| Apani valuna, tave tini teAmAderake pApera vinimaYe kena zAsti dAna karavena? varaM teAmArao anyAnya sRSTa mAnavera antarbhukta sAdhAraNa mAnuSa| tini yAke icchA kSamA karena evaM yAke icchA zAsti pradAna karena| nabheAmanDala, bhumanDala o etadubhaYera madhye yA kichu Ache, tAte AllAharai Adhipatya raYeche evaM tA~ra dikei pratyAvartana karate have|

he Ahale-kitAvagaNa! teAmAdera kAche AmAra rasUla AgamaNa karechena, yini paYagamvaradera viratira para teAmAdera kAche puGkhAnupuGkha varNanA karena-yAte teAmarA ekathA valate nA pAra ye, AmAdera kAche keAna susaMvAdadAtA o bhItipradarzaka Agamana kare ni| ataeva, teAmAdera kAche susaMvAdadAtA o bhIti pradarzaka Agamana karenani| ataeva, teAmAdera kAche susaMvAdadAtA o bhaYa pradarzaka ese gechena| AllAha savakichura upara zaktimAna|

yakhana mUsA svIYa sampradAYake valalenaH he AmAra sampradAYa, teAmAdera prati AllAhara neYAmata smaraNa kara, yakhana tini teAmAdera madhye paYagamvara sRSTi karechena, teAmAderake rAjyAdhipati karechena evaM teAmAderake emana jinisa diYechena, yA vizvajagatera kAuke denani|
he AmAra sampradAYa, pavitra bhumite praveza kara, yA AllAha teAmAdera janye nirdhArita kare diYechena evaM pechana dike pratyAvartana kareA nA| anyathAYa teAmarA kSatigrasta haYe par3ave|

tArA valalaH he mUsA, sekhAne ekaTi pravala parAkrAnta jAti raYeche| AmarA kakhanao sekhAne yAva nA, ye paryanta nA tArA sekhAna theke vera haYe yAYa| tArA yadi sekhAna theke vera haYe yAYa tave nizcitai AmarA praveza karava|’

kheAdAbhIrudera madhya theke du’vyakti valala, yAdera prati AllAha anugraha karechilenaH teAmarA tAdera upara AkramaNa kare darajAYa praveza kara| ataHpara teAmarA yakhana tAte paveza karave, takhana teAmarAi jaYI have| Ara AllAhara upara bharasA kara yadi teAmarA vizvAsI hao|
tArA valalaH he mUsA, AmarA jIvaneo kakhaneA sekhAne yAva nA, yatakSaNa tArA sekhAne thAkave| ataeva, Apani o ApanAra pAlanakartAi yAna evaM ubhaYe yuddha kare nina| AmarA teA ekhAnei vasalAma|
mUsA valalaH he AmAra pAlanakartA, Ami zudhu nijera upara o nijera bhAiYera upara kSamatA rAkhi| ataeva, Apani AmAdera madhye o e avAdhya sampradAYera madhye samparkaccheda karuna|
valalenaH e deza calliza vachara paryanta tAdera janye hArAma karA hala| tArA bhupRSThe udabhrAnta haYe phirave| ataeva, Apani avAdhya sampradAYera janye duHkha karavena nA|

Apani tAderake Adamera dui putrera vAstava avasthA pATha kare zunAna| yakhana tArA bhaYei kichu utsarga nivedana karechila, takhana tAdera ekajanera utsarga gRhIta haYechila evaM aparajanera gRhIta haYani| se valalaH Ami avazyai teAmAke hatyA karava| se valalaH AllAha dharmabhIrudera pakSa thekei teA grahaNa karena|
yadi tumi AmAke hatyA karate AmAra dike hasta prasArita kara, tave Ami teAmAke hatyA karate teAmAra dike hasta prasArita karava nA| kenanA, Ami vizvajagatera pAlanakartA AllAhake bhaYa kari|
Ami cAi ye, AmAra pApa o teAmAra pApa tumi nijera mAthAYa cApiYe nAo| ataHpara tumi deAyakhIdera antarbhUkta haYe yAo| eTAi atyAcArIdera zAsti|
ataHpara tAra antara tAke bhrAtRhatyAYa ududdha karala| anantara se tAke hatyA karala| phale se kSatigrastadera antarbhukta haYe gela|

AllAha eka kAka preraNa karalena| se mATi khanana karachila yAte tAke zikSA deYa ye, Apana bhrAtAra mRtadeha kibhAve AvRta karave| se valalaH AphaseAsa, Ami ki e kAkera samatulyao hate pAralAma nA ye, Apana bhrAtAra mRtadeha AvRta kari| ataHpara se anutApa karate lAgala|

e kAraNei Ami vanI-isalAIlera prati likhe diYechi ye, ye keu prANera vinimaYe prANa athavA pRthivIte anartha sRSTi karA chAr3A kAuke hatyA kare se yena sava mAnuSakei hatyA kare| evaM ye kArao jIvana rakSA kare, se yena savAra jIvana rakSA kare| tAdera kAche AmAra paYagamvaragaNa prakAzya nidarzanAvalI niYe esechena| vastutaH eraparao tAdera aneka leAka pRthivIte sImAtikrama kare|

yArA AllAha o tA~ra rasUlera sAthe saMgrAma kare evaM deze hAGgAmA sRSTi karate saceSTa haYa, tAdera zAsti hacche ei ye, tAderake hatyA karA have athavA zUlIte car3AneA have athavA tAdera hastapadasamUha viparIta dika theke keTe deYA have athavA deza theke vahiSkAra karA have| eTi hala tAdera janya pArthiva lAJchanA Ara parakAle tAdera janye raYeche kaTheAra zAsti|
kintu yArA teAmAdera grephatArera pUrve taovA kare; jene rAkha, AllAha kSamAkArI, daYAlu|
he muminagaNa! AllAhake bhaYa kara, tA~ra naikaTya anveSana kara evaM tA~ra pathe jehAda kara yAte teAmarA saphalakAma hao|

yArA kAphera, yadi tAdera kAche pRthivIra samudaYa sampada evaM tatsaha Arao tadanurUpa sampada thAke Ara eguleA vinimaYe diYe kiYAmatera zAsti theke paritrAna pete cAYa, tavuo tAdera kAcha theke tA kavula karA have nA| tAdera janye yantranAdAYaka zAsti raYeche|
tArA deAyakhera Aguna theke vera haYe Asate cAive kintu tA theke vera hate pArave nA| tArA cirasthAYI zAsti bheAga karave|
ye puruSa curi kare evaM ye nArI curi kare tAdera hAta keTe dAo tAdera kRtakarmera sAjA hiseve| AllAhara pakSa theke huziYArI| AllAha parAkrAnta, jJAnamaYa|
ataHpara ye taovA kare svIYa atyAcArera para evaM saMzeAdhita haYa, nizcaYa AllAha tAra taovA kavula karena| nizcaYa AllAha kSamAzIla, daYAlu|
tumi ki jAna nA ye AllAhara nimittei nabheAmanDala o bhUmanDalera Adhipatya| tini yAke icchA zAsti dena evaM yAke icchA kSamA karena| AllAha savakichura upara kSamatAvAna|

he rasUla, tAdera janye duHkha karavena nA, yArA deৗr3e giYe kuphare patita haYa; yArA mukhe valeH AmarA musalamAna, athaca tAdera antara musalamAna naYa evaM yArA ihudI; mithyAvalAra janye tArA guptacara vRtti kare| tArA anyadalera guptacara, yArA ApanAra kAche Aseni| tArA vAkyake svasthAna theke parivartana kare| tArA valeH yadi teAmarA e nirdeza pAo, tave kavula kare nio evaM yadi e nirdeza nA pAo, tave virata thekeA| AllAha yAke pathabhraSTa karate cAna, tAra janye AllAhara kAche Apani kichu karate pAravena nA| erA emanii ye, AllAha edera antarake pavitra karate cAna nA| tAdera janye raYeche duniYAte lAJchanA evaM parakAle virATa zAsti|

erA mithyA valAra janye guptacaravRtti kare, hArAma bhakSaNa kare| ataeva, tArA yadi ApanAra kAche Ase, tave haYa tAdera madhye phaYasAlA kare dina, nA haYa tAdera vyApAre nirlipta thAkuna| yadi tAdera theke nirlipta thAkena, tave tAdera sAdhya nei ye, ApanAra vindumAtra kSati karate pAre| yadi phaYasAlA karena, tave nyAYabhAve phaYasAlA karuna| nizcaYa AllAha suvicArakArIderake bhAlavAsena|
tArA ApanAke kemana kare vicAraka niYeAga karave athaca tAdera kAche taorAta raYeche| tAte AllAhara nirdeza Ache| ataHpara erA pechana dike mukha phiriYe neYa| tArA kakhanao vizvAsI naYa|

Ami taorAta avartIrna karechi| ete hedAYAta o AleA raYeche| AllAhara AjJAvaha paYagamvara, daraveza o AlemarA era mAdhyame ihudIderake phaYasAlA ditena| kenanA, tAderake e kheAdAYI granthera dekhAzeAnA karAra nirdeza deYA haYechila evaM tA~rA era rakSaNAvekSaNe niyukta chilena| ataeva, teAmarA mAnuSake bhaYa kareA nA evaM AmAke bhaYa kara evaM AmAra AYAta samUhera vinimaYe svalpamUlye grahaNa kareA nA, yesava leAka AllAha yA avatIrNa karechena, tadanuyAYI phAYasAlA kare nA, tArAi kAphera|

Ami e granthe tAdera prati likhe diYechi ye, prANera vinimaYe prANa, cakSura vinimaYe cakSu, nAkera vinimaYe nAka, kAnera vinimaYe kAna, dA~tera vinimaYe dA~ta evaM yakhama samUhera vinimaYe samAna yakhama| ataHpara ye kSamA kare, se geAnAha theke pAka haYe yAYa| yesava leAka AllAha yA avatIrNa karechena, tadanuyAYI phaYasAlA kare nA tArAi jAlema|

Ami tAdera pechane mariYama tanaYa IsAke preraNa karechi| tini pUrvavartI grantha taorAtera satyAYanakArI chilena| Ami tA~ke iJjila pradAna karechi| ete hedAYAta o AleA raYeche| eTi pUrvavatI grantha taorAtera satyAYana kare patha pradarzana kare evaM eTi kheAdAbhIrudera janye hedAYeta upadeza vAnI|
iJjilera adhikArIdera ucita, AllAha tAte yA avatIrNa karechena| tadAnuyAYI phaYasAlA karA| yArA AllAha yA avatIrNa karechena, tadanuyAYI phaYasAlA kare nA, tArAi pApAcArI|

Ami ApanAra prati avatIrNa karechi satyagrantha, yA pUrvavatI grantha samUhera satyAYanakArI evaM seguleAra viSaYavastura rakSaNAvekSaNakArI| ataeva, Apani tAdera pAraspArika vyApArAdite AllAha yA avatIrNa karechena, tadanuyAYI phaYasAlA karuna evaM ApanAra kAche ye satpatha eseche, tA cher3e tAdera pravRttira anusaraNa karavena nA| Ami teAmAdera pratyekake ekaTi Aina o patha diYechi| yadi AllAha cAitena, tave teAmAdera savAike eka ummata kare ditena, kintu erUpa karenani-yAte teAmAderake ye dharma diYechena, tAte teAmAdera parIkSA nena| ataeva, deৗr3e kalyANakara viSaYAdi arjana kara| teAmAdera savAike AllAhara kAche pratyAvartana karate have| ataHpara tini avahita karavena se viSaYa, yAte teAmarA matavireAdha karate|

Ara Ami Adeza karachi ye, Apani tAdera pArasparika vyApArAdite AllAha yA nAyila karechena tadanuyAYI phaYasAlA karuna; tAdera pravRttira anusaraNa karavena nA evaM tAdera theke satarka thAkuna-yena tArA ApanAke emana keAna nirdeza theke vicyuta nA kare, yA AllAha ApanAra prati nAyila karechena| anantara yadi tAra mukha phiriYe neYa, tave jene nina, AllAha tAderake tAdera geAnAhera kichu zAsti ditei ceYechena| mAnuSera madhye anekei nApharamAna|
tArA ki jAheliYAta Amalera phaYasAlA kAmanA kare? AllAha apekSA vizvAsIdera janye uttama phaYasAlAkArI ke?

he mumiNagaNa! teAmarA ihudI o khrISTAnaderake vandhu hisAve grahaNa kareA nA| tArA eke aparera vandhu| teAmAdera madhye ye tAdera sAthe vandhutva karave, se tAderai antarbhukta| AllAha jAlemaderake patha pradarzana karena nA|

vastutaH yAdera antare reAga raYeche, tAderake Apani dekhavena, deৗr3e giYe tAderai madhye praveza kare| tArA valeH AmarA AzaGkA kari, pAche nA AmarA keAna durghaTanAYa patita hai| ataeva, sedina dure naYa, yedina AllAha tA’AlA vijaYa prakAza karavena athavA nijera pakSa theke keAna nirdeza devena-phale tArA svIYa geApana maneAbhAvera janye anutapta have|
musalamAnarA valaveH erAi ki sesava leAka, yArA AllAhara nAme pratijJA karata ye, AmarA teAmAdera sAthe Achi? tAdera kRtakarmasamUha viphala haYe geche, phale tArA kSatigrasta haYe Ache|

he muminagaNa, teAmAdera madhye ye svIYa dharma theke phire yAve, acire AllAha emana sampradAYa sRSTi karavena, yAderake tini bhAlavAsavena evaM tArA tA~ke bhAlavAsave| tArA musalamAnadera prati vinaYa-namra have evaM kApheradera prati kaTheAra have| tArA AllAhara pathe jehAda karave evaM keAna tiraskArakArIra tiraskAre bhIta have nA| eTi AllAhara anugraha-tini yAke icchA dAna karena| AllAha prAcurya dAnakArI, mahAjJAnI|
teAmAdera vandhu teA AllAha tA~ra rasUla evaM muminavRnda-yArA nAmAya kAYema kare, yAkAta deYa evaM vinamra|
Ara yArA AllAha tA~ra rasUla evaM vizvAsIderake vandhurUpe grahaNa kare, tArAi AllAhara dala evaM tArAi vijaYI|

he muminagaNa, Ahale kitAvadera madhya theke yArA teAmAdera dharmake upahAsa o khelA mane kare, tAderake evaM anyAnya kApherake vandhu rUpe grahaNa kareA nA| AllAhake bhaYa kara, yadi teAmarA ImAnadAra hao|
Ara yakhana teAmarA nAmAyera janye AhavAna kara, takhana tArA eke upahAsa o khelA vale mane kare| kAraNa, tArA niveArdha|

valunaH he Ahale kitAvagaNa, AmAdera sAthe teAmAdera echAr3A ki zatrutA ye, AmarA vizvAsa sthApana karechi AllAhara prati, AmAdera upara avatIrNa granthera prati evaM pUrve avatIrNa granthera prati| Ara teAmAdera adhikAMzai nApharamAna|

valunaH Ami teAmAderake vali, tAdera madhye kAra manda pratiphala raYeche AllAhara kAche? yAdera prati AllAha abhisampAta karechena, yAdera prati tini kreAdhAmvita haYechena, yAdera katakake vAnara o zukare rUpAntarita kare diYechena evaM yArA zaYatAnera ArAdhanA kareche, tArAi maryAdAra dika diYe nikRSTatara evaM satyapatha thekeo aneka dUre|

yakhana tArA teAmAdera kAche Ase takhana vale dAoH AmarA vizvAsa sthApana karechi| athaca tArA kuphara niYe esechila evaM kuphara niYei prasthAna kareche| tArA yA geApana karata, AllAha tA khuva jAnena|
Ara Apani tAdera anekake dekhavena ye, deৗr3e deৗr3e pApe, sImAlaGghane evaM hArAma bhakSane patita haYa| tArA atyanta manda kAja karache|
daraveza o AlemarA kena tAderake pApa kathA valate evaM hArAma bhakSaNa karate niSedha kare nA? tArA khuvai manda kAja karache|

Ara ihudIrA valeH AllAhara hAta vandha haYe geche| tAderai hAta vandha heAka| ekathA valAra janye tAdera prati abhisampAta| varaM tA~ra ubhaYa hasta ummukta| tini yerUpa icchA vyaYa karena| ApanAra prati palanakartAra pakSa theke ye kAlAma avartINa haYeche, tAra kAraNe tAdera anekera avAdhyatA o kuphara parivardhita have| Ami tAdera parasparera madhye keYAmata paryanta zatrutA o vidveSa saJcArita kare diYechi| tArA yakhanai yuddhera Aguna prajvalita kare, AllAha tA nirvApita kare dena| tArA deze azAnti utpAdana kare ver3AYa| AllAha azAnti o vizRGkhalA sRSTikArIderake pachanda karena nA|
Ara yadi Ahale-kitAvarA vizvAsa sthApana karata evaM kheAdAbhIti avalamvana karata, tave Ami tAdera manda viSaYasamUha kSamA kare ditAma evaM tAderake neYAmatera udyAnasamUhe praviSTa karatAma|

yadi tArA taorAta, iJjila evaM yA pratipAlakera pakSa theke tAdera prati avatIrNa haYeche, pureApuri pAlana karata, tave tArA upara theke evaM pAYera nIca theke bhakSaNa karata| tAdera kichusaMkhyaka leAka satpathera anugAmI evaM anekei manda kAja kare yAcche|

he rasUla, peৗche dina ApanAra pratipAlakera pakSa theke ApanAra prati yA avatIrNa haYeche| Ara yadi Apani erUpa nA karena, tave Apani tA~ra paYagAma kichui peৗchAlena nA| AllAha ApanAke mAnuSera kAcha theke rakSA karavena| nizcaYa AllAha kApheraderake patha pradarzana karena nA|

vale dinaH he Ahale kitAvagaNa, teAmarA keAna pathei nao, ye paryanta nA teAmarA taorAta, iJjila evaM ye grantha teAmAdera pAlanakartAra pakSa theke teAmAdera prati avatIrNa haYeche tAo pureApuri pAlana nA kara| ApanAra pAlanakartAra kAcha theke ApanAra prati yA avartINa haYeche, tAra kAraNe tAdera anekera avAdhyatA o kuphara vRddhi pAve| ataeva, e kAphera sampradAYera janye duHkha karavena nA|

nizcaYa yArA musalamAna, yArA ihudI, chAveYI vA khrISTAna, tAdera madhye yArA vizvAsa sthApana kare AllAhara prati, kiYAmatera prati evaM satkarma sampAdana kare, tAdera keAna bhaYa nei evaM tArA duHkhita have nA|

Ami vanI-isarAIlera kAcha theke aGgIkAra niYechilAma evaM tAdera kAche aneka paYagamvara preraNa kare chilAma| yakhanai tAdera kAche keAna paYagamvara emana nirdeza niYe Asata yA tAdera mane cAita nA, takhana tAdera anekera prati tArA mithyAreApa karata evaM anekake hatyA kare phelata|

tArA dhAraNA kareche ye, keAna aniSTa have nA| phale tArA Arao andha o vadhira haYe gela| ataHpara AllAha tAdera taovA kavula karalena| eraparao tAdera adhikAMzai andha o vadhira haYe raila| AllAha dekhena tArA yA kichu kare|

tArA kAphera, yArA vale ye, marimaYa-tanaYa masIha-i AllAha; athaca masIha valena, he vaNI-isarAIla, teAmarA AllAhara evAdata kara, yini AmAra pAlana kartA evaM teAmAderao pAlanakartA| nizcaYa ye vyakti AllAhara sAthe aMzIdAra sthira kare, AllAha tAra janye jAnnAta hArAma kare dena| evaM tAra vAsasthAna haYa jAhAnnAma| atyAcArIdera keAna sAhAyyakArI nei|

nizcaYa tArA kAphera, yArA valeH AllAha tinera eka; athaca eka upAsya chAr3A keAna upAsya nei| yadi tArA svIYa ukti theke nivRtta nA haYa, tave tAdera madhye yArA kuphare aTala thAkave, tAdera upara yantranAdAYaka zAsti patita have|
tArA AllAhara kAche taovA kare nA kena evaM kSamA prArthanA kare nA kena? AllAha ye kSamAzIla, daYAlu|

mariYama-tanaYa masIha rasUla chAr3A Ara kichu nana| tA~ra pUrve aneka rasUla atikrAnta haYechena Ara tAra jananI ekajana olI| tA~rA ubhaYei khAdya bhakSaNa karatena| dekhuna, Ami tAdera janye kirUpa yukti-pramANa varnanA kari, AvAra dekhuna, tArA ulTA keAna dike yAcche|
vale dinaH teAmarA ki AllAha vyatIta emana vastura evAdata kara ye, teAmAdera apakAra vA upakAra karAra kSamatA rAkhe nA? athaca AllAha sava zunena o jAnena|

valunaH he Ahale kitAvagana, teAmarA svIYa dharme anyAYa vAr3AvAr3i kareA nA evaM ete ai sampradAYera pravRttira anusaraNa kareA nA, yArA pUrve pathabhraSTa haYeche evaM anekake pathabhraSTa kareche| tArA sarala patha theke vicyuta haYe par3eche|
vanI-isalAIlera madhye yArA kAphera, tAderake dAuda o mariYamatanaYa IsAra mukhe abhisampAta karA haYeche| eTA ekAraNe ye, tArA avAdhyatA karata evaM sImA laMghana karata|
tArA parasparake manda kAje niSedha karata nA, yA tArA karata| tArA yA karata tA avazyai manda chila

Apani tAdera anekake dekhavena, kApheradera sAthe vandhutva kare| tArA nijedera janya yA pAThiYeche tA avazyai manda| tA ei ye, tAdera prati AllAha kreAdhAnvita haYechena evaM tArA cirakAla AyAve thAkave|
yadi tArA AllAhara prati o rasUlera prati avatIrNa viSaYera prati vizvAsa sthApana karata, tave kApheraderake vandhurUpe grahaNa karata nA| kintu tAdera madhye anekei durAcAra|

Apani sava mAnuSera cAite musalamAnadera adhika zatru ihudI o muzarekaderake pAvena evaM Apani savAra cAite musalamAnadera sAthe vandhutve adhika nikaTavartI tAderake pAvena, yArA nijederake khrISTAna vale| era kAraNa ei ye, khrISTAnadera madhye Alema raYeche, daraveza raYeche evaM tArA ahaGkAra kare nA|

Ara tArA rasUlera prati yA avatIrNa haYeche, tA yakhana zune, takhana Apani tAdera ceAkha azru sajala dekhate pAvena; e kAraNe ye, tArA satyake cine niYeche| tArA valeH he AmAdera prati pAlaka, AmarA musalamAna haYe gelAma| ataeva, AmAderakeo mAnyakArIdera tAlikAbhukta kare nina|

AmAdera ki oyara thAkate pAre ye, AmarA AllAhara prati evaM ye satya AmAdera kAche eseche, tatprati vizvAsa sthApana karava nA evaM e AzA karaveA nA ye, Amadera pratipAlaka AmAderake sat leAkadera sAthe praviSTa karavena?
ataHpara tAderake AllAha e uktira pratidAna svarUpa emana udyAna divena yAra taladeze nirjhariNIsamUha pravAhita have| tArA tanmadhye cirakAla avasthAna karave| eTAi satkarmazIladera pratidAna|
yArA kAphera haYeche evaM AmAra nidarzanAvalIke mithyA valeche, tArAi deAyakhI|
he muminagaNa, teAmarA aisava susvAdu vastu hArAma kareA nA, yeguleA AllAha teAmAdera janya hAlAla karechena evaM sImA atikrama kareA nA| nizcaYa AllAha sImA atikramakArIderake pachanda karena nA|
AllAha tA’YAlA yesava vastu teAmAderake diYechena, tanmadhya theke hAlAla o pavitra vastu khAo evaM AllAhake bhaYa kara, yAra prati teAmarA vizvAsI|

AllAha teAmAderake pAkar3Ao karena nA teAmAdera anarthaka zapathera janye; kintu pAkar3Ao karena ai zapathera janye yA teAmarA majavuta kare vAdha| ataeva, era kAphapharA ei ye, dazajana daridrake khAdya pradAna karave; madhyama zrenIra khAdya yA teAmarA svIYa parivArake diYe thAka| athavA, tAderake vastu pradAna karave athavA, ekajana krItadAsa kiMvA dAsI mukta kare dive| ye vyakti sAmarthya rAkhe nA, se tina dina reAyA rAkhave| eTA kAphapharA teAmAdera zapathera, yakhana zapatha karave| teAmarA svIYa zapathasamUha rakSA kara emanibhAve AllAha teAmAdera janya svIYa nirdeza varNanA karena, yAte teAmarA kRtajJatA svIkAra kara|
he muminagaNa, ei ye mada, juYA, pratimA evaM bhAgya-nirdhAraka zarasamUha esava zaYatAnera apavitra kArya vai teA naYa| ataeva, eguleA theke ve~ce thAka-yAte teAmarA kalyANaprApta hao|

zaYatAna teA cAYa, mada o juYAra mAdhyame teAmAdera parasparera mAjhe zutrutA o vidveSa saJcArita kare dite evaM AllAhara smaraNa o nAmAya theke teAmAderake virata rAkhate| ataeva, teAmarA ekhana o ki nivRtta have?
teAmarA AllAhara anugata hao, rasUlera anugata hao evaM AtmarakSA kara| kintu yadi teAmarA vimukha hao, tave jene rAkha, AmAra rasUlera dAYitva prakAzya pracAra vai kichu naYa|

yArA vizvAsa sthApana kareche evaM satkarma kareche, tArA pUrve yA bhakSaNa kareche, se janya tAdera keAna geAnAha nei yakhana bhaviSyatera janye saMyata haYeche, vizvAsa sthApana kareche evaM satkarma sampAdana kareche| erapara saMyata thAke evaM vizvAsa sthApana kare| erapara saMyata thAke evaM satkarma kare| AllAha satkarmIderake bhAlavAsena|

he muminagaNa, AllAha teAmAderake emana kichu zikArera mAdhyame parIkSA karavena, ye zikAra paryanta teAmAdera hAta o varzA sahajei peৗchate pArave-yAte AllAha vujhate pArena ye, ke tAke adRzyabhAve bhaYakare| ataeva, ye vyakti erapara sImA atikrama karave, tAra janya yantranAdAYaka zAsti raYeche|

muminagaNa, teAmarA eharAma avasthAYa zikAra vadha kareA nA| teAmAdera madhye ye jenezune zikAra vadha karave, tAra upara vinimaYa oYAjeva have, yA samAna have ai jantura, yAke se vadha kareche| du’jana nirbharayeAgya vyakti era phaYasAlA karave-vinimaYera jantuTi utsarga hiseve kAvAYa peৗchAte have| athavA tAra upara kAphaphArA oYAjeva-kaYekajana daridrake khAoYAneA athavA tAra samaparimANa reAyA rAkhate yAte se svIYa kRtakarmera pratiphala AsvAdana kare| yA haYe geche, tA AllAha mApha karechena| ye punarAYa e kAnDa karave, AllAha tAra kAcha theke pratizeAdha nivena| AllAha parAkrAnta, pratizeAdha grahaNe sakSama|

teAmAdera janya samudrera zikAra o sumudrera khAdya hAlAla karA haYeche teAmAdera upakArArthe evaM teAmAdera eharAmakArIdera janye hArAma karA haYeche sthala zikAra yatakSaNa eharAma avasthAYa thAka| AllAhake bhaYa kara, yAra kAche teAmarA ekatrita have|

AllAha sammAnita gRha kAvAke mAnuSera sthItizIlatAra kAraNa karechena evaM sammAnita mAsasamUke, hArAma keAravAnIra jantuke o yAdera galAYa AvaraNa raYeche| era kAraNa ei ye, yAte teAmarA jene nAo ye, AllAha nabheAmanDala o bhumanDalera sava kichu jAnena evaM AllAha sarva viSaYe mahAjJAnI|
jene nAo, nizcaYa AllAha kaTheAra zAsti dAtA o nizcaYa AllAha kSamAzIla-daYAlU|
rasUlera dAYitva zudhu peৗchiYe deoYA| AllAha jAnena, yA kichu teAmarA prakAzye kara evaM yA kichu geApana kara|
vale dinaH apavitra o pavitra samAna naYa, yadio apavitrera prAcurya teAmAke vismita kare| ataeva, he vuddhimAnagaNa, AllAhake bhaYa kara-yAte teAmarA mukti pAo|

he mumiNagana, emana kathAvArtA jijJesa kareA nA, yA teAmAdera kAche parivyakta hale teAmAdera khArApa lAgave| yadi keAraAna avataraNakAle teAmarA esava viSaYa jijJesa kara, tave tA teAmAdera janye prakAza karA have| atIta viSaYa AllAha kSamA karechena AllAha kSamAzIla, sahanazIla|
erUpa kathA vArtA teAmAdera purve eka sampradAYa jijJesa karechila| era para tArA esava viSaYe avizvAsI haYe gela|
AllAha ‘vahirA’ ‘sAYevA’ ‘osIlA’ evaM ‘hAmI’ ke zarIYatasiddha karenani| kintu yArA kAphera, tArA AllAhara upara mithyA apavAda AreApa kare| tAdera adhikAMzerai viveka vuddhi nei|

yakhana tAderake valA haYa ye, AllAhara nAyilakRta vidhAna evaM rasUlera dike esa, takhana tArA vale, AmAdera janye tAi yatheSTa, yAra upara AmarA AmAdera vApa-dAdAke peYechi| yadi tAdera vApa dAdArA keAna jJAna nA rAkhe evaM hedAYeta prApta nA haYa tavuo ki tArA tAi karave?

he muminagaNa, teAmarA nijedera cintA kara| teAmarA yakhana satpathe raYecha, takhana keu pathabhrAnta hale tAte teAmAdera keAna kSati nAi| teAmAdera savAike AllAhara kAche phire yete have| takhana tini teAmAderake vale devena, yA kichu teAmarA karate|

he, muminagaNa, teAmAdera madhye yakhana kArao mRtyu upasthita haYa, takhana ochiYata karAra samaYa teAmAdera madhya theke dharmaparAYana dujanake sAkSI rekheA| teAmarA saphare thAkale evaM se avasthAYa teAmAdera mRtyu upasthita hale teAmarA teAmAdera chAr3Ao du vyaktike sAkSI rekheA| yadi teAmAdera sandeha haYa, tave ubhaYake nAmAyera para thAkate valave| ataHpara ubhaYei AllAhara nAme kasama khAve ye, AmarA e kasamera vinimaYe keAna upakAra grahaNa karate cAi nA, yadio keAna AtnIYao haYa evaM AllAhara sAkSya AmarA geApana karava nA| ematAvasthAYa kaTheAra geAnAhagAra hava|

ataHpara yadi jAnA yAYa ye, ubhaYa osi keAna geAnAhe jar3ita raYeche, tave yAdera viruddhe geAnAha haYechila, tAdera madhya theke mRtu vyaktira nikaTatama du’vyakti tAdera sthalAbhiSikta have| ataHpara AllAhara nAme kasama khAve ye, avazyai AmAdera sAkSya tAdera sAkSyara cAite adhika satya evaM AmarA sImA atikrama karini| ematAvasthAYa AmarA avazyai atyAcArI hava|

eTi e viSaYera nikaTatama upAYa ye, tArA ghaTanAke saThikabhAve prakAza karave athavA AzaGkA karave ye, tAdera kAcha theke kasama neYAra para AvAra kasama cAoYA have| AllAhake bhaYa kara evaM zuna, AllAha durAcArIderake patha-pradarzana karavena nA|
yedina AllAha sava paYagamvarake ekatrita karavena, ataHpara valavena teAmarA ki uttara peYechile? tA~rA valavenaH AmarA avagata nai, Apanii adRzya viSaYe mahAjJAnI|

yakhana AllAha valavenaH he IsA ivane mariYama, teAmAra prati o teAmAra mAtAra prati AmAra anugraha smaraNa kara, yakhana Ami teAmAke pavitra AtmAra dvArA sAhAyya karechi| tumi mAnuSera sAthe kathA valate keAle thAkateo evaM pariNata vaYaseo evaM yakhana Ami teAmAke grantha, pragAr3ha jJAna, taorAta o iJjila zikSA diYechi evaM yakhana tumi kAdAmATi diYe pAkhIra pratikRtira mata pratikRti nirmANa karate AmAra Adeze, ataHpara tumi tAte phu~ dite; phale tA AmAra Adeze pAkhI haYe yeta evaM tumi AmAra Adeze janmAndha o kuSTareAgIke nirAmaYa kare dite evaM yakhana Ami vanI-isarAIlake teAmA theke nivRtta rekhechilAma, yakhana tumi tAdera kAche pramANAdi niYe esechile, ataHpara tAdera madhye yArA kAphera chila, tArA valalaH eTA prakAzya jAdu chAr3A kichui naYa|

Ara yakhana Ami hAoYArIdera mane jAgrata karalAma ye, AmAra prati evaM AmAra rasUlera prati vizvAsa sthApana kara, takhana tArA valate lAgala, AmarA vizvAsa sthApana karalAma evaM Apani sAkSI thAkuna ye, AmarA anugatyazIla|

yakhana hAoYArIrA valalaH he mariYama tanaYa IsA, ApanAra pAlanakartA ki erUpa karate pArena ye, AmAdera janye AkAza theke khAdyabharti khAJcA avataraNa kare devena? tini valalenaH yadi teAmarA ImAnadAra hao, tave AllAhake bhaYa kara|
tArA valalaH AmarA tA theke khete cAi; AmAdera antara paritRpta have; AmarA jene neva ye, Apani satya valechena evaM AmarA sAkSyadAtA haYe yAva|

IsA ivane mariYama valalenaH he AllAha AmAdera pAlanakartA AmAdera prati AkAza theke khAdyabharti khAJcA avataraNa karuna| tA AmAdera janye arthAt, AmAdera prathama o paravartI savAra janye AnandeAtsava have evaM ApanAra pakSa theke ekaTi nidarzana have| Apani AmAdera ruyI dina| Apanii zreSTa ruyIdAtA|
AllAha valalenaH nizcaYa Ami se khAJcA teAmAdera prati avataraNa karava| ataHpara ye vyAkti era pareo akRtajJa have, Ami tAke emana zAsti deva, ye zAsti vizvajagatera apara kAuke deva nA|

yakhana AllAha valalenaH he IsA ivane mariYama! tumi ki leAkaderake vale diYechile ye, AllAhake cher3e AmAke o AmAra mAtAke upAsya sAvyasta kara? IsA valavena; Apani pavitra! AmAra janye zeAbhA pAYa nA ye, Ami emana kathA vali, yA valAra keAna adhikAra AmAra nei| yadi Ami vale thAki, tave Apani avazyai parijJAta; Apani teA AmAra manera kathA o jAnena evaM Ami jAni nA yA ApanAra mane Ache| nizcaYa Apanii adRzya viSaYe jJAta|

Ami teA tAderake kichui valini, zudhu se kathAi valechi yA Apani valate Adeza karechilena ye, teAmarA AllAhara dAsatva avalamvana kara yini AmAra o teAmAdera pAlanakartA Ami tAdera samparke avagata chilAma yatadina tAdera madhye chilAma| ataHpara yakhana Apani AmAke leAkAntarita karalena, takhana theke Apanii tAdera samparke avagata raYechena| Apani sarvaviSaYe pUrNa parijJAta|
yadi Apani tAderake zAsti dena, tave tArA ApanAra dAsa evaM yadi Apani tAderake kSamA karena, tave Apanii parAkrAnta, mahAvijJa|

AllAha valalenaH Ajakera dine satyavAdIdera satyavAditA tAdera upakAre Asave| tAdera janye udyAna raYeche, yAra taladeze nirjharinI pravAhita have; tArA tAtei cirakAla thAkave| AllAha tAdera prati santuSTa| eTii mahAna saphalatA|
nabheAmanDala, bhUmanDala evaM etadubhaYe avasthita savakichura Adhipatya AllAharai| tini savakichura upara kSamatAvAna|

sarvavidha prazaMsA AllAharai janya yini nabheAmanDala o bhUmanDala sRSTi karechena evaM andhakAra o AleAra udbhava karechena| tathApi kApherarA svIYa pAlanakartAra sAthe anyAnyake samatulya sthira kare|
tinii teAmAderake mATira dvArA sRSTi karechena, ataHpara nirdiSTakAla nirdhAraNa karechena| Ara apara nirdiSTakAla AllAhara kAche Ache| tathApi teAmarA sandeha kara|
tinii AllAha nabheAmanDale evaM bhUmanDale| tini teAmAdera geApana o prakAzya viSaYa jAnena evaM teAmarA yA kara tAo avagata|
tAdera kAche tAdera pratipAlakera nidarzanAvalI theke keAna nidarzana Aseni; yAra prati tArA vimukha haYa nA|
ataeva, avazya tArA satyake mithyA valeche yakhana tA tAdera kAche eseche| vastutaH acirei tAdera kAche ai viSaYera saMvAda Asave, yAra sAthe tArA upahAsa karata|

tArA ki dekheni ye, Ami tAdera purve kata sampradAYake dhvaMsa kare diYechi, yAderake Ami pRthivIte emana pratiSThA diYechilAma, yA teAmAderake deini| Ami AkAzake tAdera upara anavarata vRSTi varSaNa karate diYechi evaM tAdera taladeze nadI sRSTi kare diYechi, ataHpara Ami tAderake tAdera pApera kAraNe dhvaMsa kare diYechi evaM tAdera pare anya sampradAYa sRSTi karechi|
yadi Ami kAgaje likhita keAna viSaYa tAdera prati nAyila karatAma, ataHpara tArA tA sahaste sparza karata, tavuo avizvAsIrA ekathAi valata ye, eTA prakAzya jAdu vai kichu naYa|

tArA Arao vale ye, tA~ra kAche keAna pherezatA kena preraNa karA hala nA? yadi Ami keAna pherezatA preraNa karatAma, tave geATA vyApAraTAi zeSa haYe yeta| ataHpara tAderake sAmAnyao avakAza deoYA hatanA|
yadi Ami keAna pherezatAke rasUla kare pAThAtAma, tave se mAnuSera AkArei hata| eteo ai sandehai karata, yA ekhana karache|
nizcaYai ApanAra pUrvavartI paYagamvaragaNera sAtheo upahAsa karA haYeche| ataHpara yArA tA~dera sAthe upahAsa karechila, tAderake ai zAsti veSTana kare nila, yA niYe tArA upahAsa karata|
vale dinaH teAmarA pRthivIte paribhramaNa kara, atapara dekha, mithyAreApa kArIdera pariNAma ki haYeche?

jijJesa karuna, nabheAmanDala o bhumanDale yA Ache, tAra mAlika ke? vale dinaHAllAha| tini anukampA pradarzanake nija dAYitve lipivaddha kare niYechena| tini avazyai teAmAderake keYAmatera dina ekatrita karavena| era Agamane keAna sandeha nei| yArA nijedera ke kSatigrasta kareche, tArAi vizvAsa sthApana kare nA|
yA kichu rAta o dine sthiti lAbha kare, tA~rai| tinii zreAtA, mahAjJAnI|

Apani vale dinaH Ami ki AllAha vyatIta-yini nabheAmanDala o bhumanDalera sraSTA evaM yini savAike AhArya dAnakarena o tA~ke keu AhArya dAna kare nA aparake sAhAyyakArI sthira karava? Apani vale dinaH Ami AdiSTa haYechi ye, sarvAgre Amii AjJAvaha hava| Apani kadAca aMzIvAdIdera antarbhukta havena nA|
Apani valuna, Ami AmAra pratipAlakera avAdhya hate bhaYa pAi kenanA, Ami ekaTi mahAdivasera zAstike bhaYa kari|
yAra kAcha theke aidina e zAsti sariYe neoYA have, tAra prati AllAhara anukampA have| eTAi virATa sAphalya|
Ara yadi AllAha teAmAke keAna kaSTa dena, tave tini vyatIta tA apasAraNakArI keu nei| pakSAntare yadi teAmAra maGgala karena, tave tini savakichura upara kSamatAvAna|
tinii parAkrAnta svIYa vAndAdera upara| tinii jJAnamaYa, sarvajJa|

Apani jijJesa karunaH sarvavRhat sAkSyadAtA ke? vale dinaH AllAha AmAra o teAmAdera madhye sAkSI| AmAra prati e keAraAna avartIrNa haYeche-yAte Ami teAmAderake evaM yAdera kAche e keAraAna pau~che savAike bhIti pradarzana kari| teAmarA ki sAkSya dAo ye, AllAhara sAthe anyAnya upAsyao raYeche? Apani vale dinaH Ami erUpa sAkSya deva nA| vale dinaH tinii ekamAtra upAsya; Ami avazyai teAmAdera ziraka theke mukta|
yAderake Ami kitAva dAna karechi, tArA tAke cine, yemana tAdera santAnaderake cine| yArA nijederake kSatira madhye pheleche, tArA vizvAsa sthApana karave nA|
Ara ye, AllAhara prati apavAda AreApa kare athavA tA~ra nidarzanAvalIke mithyA vale, tAra cAite var3a jAlema ke? nizcaYa jAlemarA saphalakAma have nA|
Ara yedina Ami tAdera savAike ekatrita karava, ataHpara yArA ziraka karechila, tAdera valavaH yAderake teAmarA aMzIdAra vale dhAraNA karate, tArA keAthAYa?
ataHpara tAdera keAna aparicchannatA thAkave nA; tave eTukui ye tArA valave AmAdera pratipAlaka AllAhara kasama, AmarA muzarika chilAma nA|
dekhateA, kibhAve mithyA valache nijedera vipakSe? evaM yesava viSaYa tArA ApanAra prati michAmichi racanA karata, tA savai udhAo haYe geche|

tAdera keu keu ApanAra dike kAna lAgiYe thAke| Ami tAdera antarera upara AvaraNa rekhe diYechi yAte eke nA vujhe evaM tAdera kAne veAjhA bhare diYechi| yadi tArA sava nidarzana avaleAkana kare tavuo seguleA vizvAsa karave nA| emanaki, tArA yakhana ApanAra kAche jhagar3A karate Ase, takhana kApherarA valeH eTi purvavartIdera kicchAkAhinI vai teA naYa|
tArA e theke vAdhA pradAna kare evaM e theke palAYana kare| tArA nijederake dhvaMsa kareche, kintu vujhache nA|

Ara Apani yadi dekhena, yakhana tAderake deAyakhera upara dA~r3a karAneA have! tArA valaveH katai nA bhAla hata, yadi AmarA punaH prerita hatAma; tA hale AmarA svIYa pAlanakartAra nidarzanasamUhe mithyAreApa karatAma nA evaM AmarA vizvAsIdera antarbhukta haYe yetAma|
evaM tArA iti pUrve yA geApana karata, tA tAdera sAmane prakAza haYe par3eche| yadi tArA punaH prerita haYa, tavuo tAi karave, yA tAderake niSedha karA haYechila| nizcaYa tArA mithyAvAdI|
tArA valeH AmAdera e pArthiva jIvanai jIvana| AmAderake punarAYa jIvita hate have nA|

Ara yadi Apani dekhena; yakhana tAderake pratipAlakera sAmane dA~r3a karAneA have| tini valavenaH eTA ki vAstava satya naYa? tArA valaveH ha~yA AmAdera pratipAlakera kasama| tini valavenaH ataeva, svIYa kupharera kAraNe zAsti AsvAdana kara|

nizcaYa tArA kSatigrasta, yArA AllAhara sAkSAtke mithyA mane kareche| emanaki, yakhana kiYAmata tAdera kAche akasmAt ese yAve, tArA valaveH hAYa AphaseAsa, era vyApAre AmarA katai nA kraTi karechi| tAra svIYa veAjhA svIYa pRSThe vahana karave| zune rAkha, tArA ye veAjhA vahana karave, tA nikRSTatara veAjhA|
pArthiva jIvana krIr3A o keৗtuka vyatIta kichui naYa| parakAlera AvAsa paraheyagAradera janye zreSTatara| teAmarA ki vujha nA?
AmAra jAnA Ache ye, tAdera ukti ApanAke duHkhita kare| ataeva, tArA ApanAke mithyA pratipanna kare nA, varaM jAlemarA AllAhara nidarzanAvalIke asvIkAra kare|

ApanAra pUrvavartI aneka paYagamvarake mithyA valA haYeche| tA~rA ete chavara karechena| tAdera kAche AmAra sAhAyya pau~che paryanta tArA niryAtita haYechena| AllAhara vAnI keu parivartana karate pAre nA| ApanAra kAche paYagamvaradera kichu kAhinI pau~cheche|

Ara yadi tAdera vimukhatA ApanAra pakSe kaSTakara haYa, tave Apani yadi bhUtale keAna sur3aGga athavA AkAze keAna sir3i anusandhAna karate samartha hana, ataHpara tAdera kAche keAna ekaTi meAjeyA Anate pArena, tave niYe Asuna| AllAha icchA karale savAike sarala pathe samaveta karate pAratena| ataeva, Apani nirveAdhadera antarbhukta havena nA|
tArAi mAne, yArA zravaNa kare| AllAha mRtaderake jIvita kare utthita karavena| ataHpara tArA tA~rai dike pratyAvartita have|
tArA valeH tAra prati tAra pAlanakartAra pakSa theke keAna nidarzana avatIrNa haYani kena? vale dinaH AllAha nidarzana avataraNa karate pUrna sakSama; kintu tAdera adhikAMzai jAne nA|

Ara yata prakAra prANI pRthivIte vicaraNazIla raYeche evaM yata prakAra pAkhI du’ DAnAyeAge ur3e ver3AYa tArA savAi teAmAdera matai ekekaTi zreNI| Ami keAna kichu likhate chAr3ini| ataHpara savAi svIYa pratipAlakera kAche samaveta have|
yArA AmAra nidarzanasamUhake mithyA vale, tArA andhakArera madhye mUka o vadhira| AllAha yAke icchA pathabhraSTa karena evaM yAke icchA sarala pathe paricAlita karena|
valuna, valateA dekhi, yadi teAmAdera upara AllAhara zAsti patita haYa kiMvA teAmAdera kAche kiYAmata ese yAYa, tave teAmarA ki AllAha vyatIta anyake DAkave yadi teAmarA satyavAdI hao|
varaM teAmarA teA tA~kei DAkave| ataHpara ye vipadera janye tA~ke DAkave, tini icchA karale tA durao kare dena| yAderake aMzIdAra karacha, takhana tAderake bhule yAve|
Ara Ami ApanAra pUrvavartI ummatadera pratio paYagamvara preraNa karechilAma| ataHpara Ami tAderake abhAva-anaTana o reAga-vyadhi dvArA pAkar3Ao karechilAma yAte tArA kAkuti minati kare|

ataHpara tAdera kAche yakhana AmAra AyAva Asala, takhana kena kAkuti-minati karala nA? vastutaH tAdera antara kaTheAra haYe gela evaM zaYatAna tAdera kAche suzeAbhita kare dekhAla, ye kAja tArA karachila|

ataHpara tArA yakhana ai upadeza bhule gela, yA tAderake deYA haYechila, takhana Ami tAdera sAmane sava kichura dvAra ummukta kare dilAma| emanaki, yakhana tAderake pradatta viSaYAdira janye tArA khuva garvita haYe par3ala, takhana Ami akasmAt tAderake pAkar3Ao karalAma| takhana tArA nirAza haYe gela|
ataHpara jAlemadera mUla zikar3a kartita hala| samasta prazaMsA AllAharai janye, yini vizvajagatera pAlanakartA|

Apani valunaH vala teA dekhi, yadi AllAha teAmAdera kAna o ceAkha niYe yAna evaM teAmAdera antare meAhara e~Te dena, tave evaM teAmAdera AllAha vyatIta emana upAsya ke Ache, ye teAmAderake eguleA ene deve? dekha, Ami kibhAve ghuriYe-phiriYe nidarzanAvalI varNanA kari| tathApi tArA vimukha hacche|
vale dinaH dekhateA, yadi AllAhara zAsti, Akasmika kiMvA prakAzye teAmAdera upara Ase, tave jAlema, sampradAYa vyatIta ke dhvaMsa have?
Ami paYagamvaraderake preraNa kari nA, kintu susaMvAdAtA o bhIti pradarzakarUpe ataHpara ye vizvAsa sthApana kare evaM saMzeAdhita haYa, tAdera keAna zaGkA nei evaM tArA duHkhita have nA|
yArA AmAra nidarzanAvalIke mithyA vale, tAderake tAdera nApharamAnIra kAraNe AyAva sparza karave|

Apani valunaH Ami teAmAderake vali nA ye, AmAra kAche AllAhara bhAnDAra raYeche| tAchAr3A Ami adRzya viSaYa avagatao nai| Ami emana vali nA ye, Ami pherezatA| Ami teA zudhu ai ohIra anusaraNa kari, yA AmAra kAche Ase| Apani vale dinaH andha o cakSumAna ki samAna hate pAre? teAmarA ki cintA kara nA?

Apani e keAraAna dvArA tAderake bhaYa-pradarzana karuna, yArA AzaGkA kare svIYa pAlanakartAra kAche ematAvasthAYa ekatrita haoYAra ye, tAdera keAna sAhAyyakArI o supArizakArI have nA-yAte tArA geAnAha theke ve~ce thAke|

Ara tAderake vitAr3ita karavena nA, yArA sakAla-vikAla svIYa pAlakartAra evAdata kare, tA~ra santuSTi kAmanA kare| tAdera hisAva vindumAtrao ApanAra dAYitve naYa evaM ApanAra hisAva vindumAtrao tAdera dAYitve naYa ye, Apani tAderake vitAr3ita karavena| natuvA Apani avicArakArIdera antarbhUkta haYe yAvena|

Ara ebhAvei Ami kichu leAkake kichu leAka dvArA parIkSAYa phelechi yAte tArA vale ye, ederakei ki AmAdera savAra madhya theke AllAha svIYa anugraha dAna karechena? AllAha ki kRtajJadera samparke suparijJAta nana?

Ara yakhana tArA ApanAra kAche Asave yArA AmAra nidarzanasamUhe vizvAsa kare, takhana Apani vale dinaH teAmAdera upara zAnti varSita heAka| teAmAdera pAlanakartA rahamata karA nija dAYitve likhe niYechena ye, teAmAdera madhye ye keu ajJatAvazataH keAna manda kAja kare, anantara erapare taovA kare neYa evaM sat haYe yAYa, tave tini atyanta kSamAzIla, karuNAmaYa|
Ara emanibhAve Ami nidarzanasamUha vistArita varNanA kari-yAte aparAdhIdera patha suspaSTa haYe uThe|

Apani vale dinaH AmAke tAdera evAdata karate niSedha karA haYeche, teAmarA AllAhake cher3e yAdera evAdata kara| Apani vale dinaH Ami teAmAdera khuzImata calaveA nA| kenanA, tAhale Ami pathabhrAnta haYe yAva evaM supathagAmIdera antarbhukta hava nA|

Apani vale dinaH AmAra kAche pratipAlakera pakSa theke ekaTi pramANa Ache evaM teAmarA tAra prati mithyAreApa karecha| teAmarA ye vastu zIghra dAvI karacha, tA AmAra kAche nei| AllAha chAr3A kAreA nirdeza cale nA| tini satya varNanA karena evaM tinii zreSThatama mImAMsAkArI|
Apani vale dinaH yadi AmAra kAche tA thAkata, yA teAmarA zIghra dAvI karacha, tave AmAra o teAmAdera pArasparika vivAda kavei cuke yeta| AllAha jAlemadera samparke yatheSTa parimANe avahita|

tA~ra kAchei adRzya jagatera cAvi raYeche| e guleA tini vyatIta keu jAne nA| sthale o jale yA Ache, tinii jAnena| keAna pAtA jhare nA; kintu tini tA jAnena| keAna zasya kaNA mRttikAra andhakAra aMze patita haYa nA evaM keAna Ardra o zuska dravya patita haYa nA; kintu tA sava prakAzya granthe raYeche|
tinii rAtri velAYa teAmAderake karAYatta kare nena evaM yA kichu teAmarA dinera velAYa kara, tA jAnena| ataHpara teAmAderake divase sammukhita karena-yAte nirdiSTa oYAdA pUrNa haYa|

anantara tA~rai dike teAmAdera pratyAvartana| ataHpara teAmAderake vale divena, yA kichu teAmarA karachile| tinii svIYa vAndAdera upara pravala| tini preraNa karena teAmAdera kAche rakSaNAvekSaNakArI| emana ki, yakhana teAmAdera kArao mRtyu Ase takhana AmAra prerita pherezatArA tAra AtmA hastagata kare neYa|
ataHpara savAike satyikAra prabhu AllAhara kAche pau~chAneA have| zune rAkha, phaYasAlA tA~rai evaM tini druta hisAva grahaNa karavena|

Apani valunaH ke teAmAderake sthala o jalera andhakAra theke uddhAra karena, yakhana teAmarA tA~ke vinItabhAve o geApane AhavAna kara ye, yadi Apani AmAdera ke e theke uddhAra kare nena, tave AmarA avazyai kRtajJadera antarbhukta haYe yAva|
Apani vale dinaH AllAha teAmAderake tA theke mukti dena eva sava duHkha-vipada theke| tathApi teAmarA zeraka kara|

Apani valunaH tinii zaktimAna ye, teAmAdera upara keAna zAsti upara dika theke athavA teAmAdera padatala theke preraNa karavena athavA teAmAderake dale-upadale vibhakta kare savAike mukheAmukhI kare divena evaM ekake anyera upara AkramaNera svAda AsvAdana karAvena| dekha, Ami kemana ghuriYe-phiriYe nidarzanAvalI varNanA kari yAte tArA vujhe neYa|
ApanAra sampradAYa eke mithyA valache, athaca tA satya| Apani vale dinaH Ami teAmAdera upara niYeAjita nai|
pratyeka khavarera ekaTi samaYa nirdiSTa raYeche evaM acirei teAmarA tA jene nive|

yakhana Apani tAderake dekhena, yArA AmAra AYAta samUhe chidrAnveSaNa kare, takhana tAdera kAcha theke sare yAna ye paryanta tArA anya kathAYa pravRtta nA haYa, yadi zaYatAna ApanAke bhUliYe deYa tave smaraNa haoYAra para jAlemadera sAthe upavezana karavena nA|
edera yakhana vicAra karA have takhana paraheyagAradera upara era keAna prabhAva par3ave nA; kintu tAdera dAYitva upadeza dAna karA yAte orA bhIta haYa|

tAderake parityAga karuna, yArA nijedera dharmake krIr3A o keৗtukarUpe grahaNa kareche evaM pArthiva jIvana yAderake dheA~kAYa phele rekheche| keAraAna dvArA tAderake upadeza dina, yAte keu svIYa karme emana bhAve grephatAra nA haYe yAYa ye, AllAha vyatIta tAra keAna sAhAyyakArI o supArizakArI nei evaM yadi tArA jagatera vinimaYao pradAna kave, tavu tAdera kAcha theke tA grahaNa karA have nA| ekAi svIYa karme jar3ita haYe par3eche| tAdera janye uttapta pAni evaM yantraNAdAYaka zAsti raYeche-kupharera kAraNe|

Apani vale dinaH AmarA ki AllAha vyatIta emana vastuke AhavAna karava, ye AmAdera upakAra karate pAre nA evaM kSatio karate pAre nA evaM AmarA ki pazcAtpade phire yAva, erapara ye, AllAha AmAderake patha pradarzana karechena? ai vyaktira mata, yAke zaYatAnarA vanabhumite vipathagAmI kare diYeche-se udabhrAnta haYe gheArApherA karache| tAra sahacararA tAke pathera dike Deke valacheH Asa, AmAdera kAche| Apani vale dinaH nizcaYa AllAhara pathai supatha| AmarA AdiSTa haYechi yAte svIYa pAlanakartA AjJAvaha haYe yAi|
evaM tA ei ye, nAmAya kAYema kara evaM tA~ke bhaYa kara| tA~ra sAmanei teAmarA ekatrita have|

tinii saThikabhAve nabheAmanDala sRSTi karechena| yedina tini valavenaH haYe yA, ataHpara haYe yAve| tA~ra kathA satya| yedina ziGgAYa phutkAra karA have, sedina tA~rai Adhipatya have| tini adRzya viSaYe evaM pratyakSa viSaYe jJAta| tinii prajJAmaYa, sarvajJa|
smaraNa kara, yakhana ivrAhIma pitA Ayarake valalenaH tumi ki pratimA samUhake upAsya mane kara? Ami dekhate pAcchi ye, tumi o teAmAra sampradAYa prakAzya pathabhraSTa|
Ami erUpa bhAvei ivrAhImake nabheAmanDala o bhumanDalera atyAzcarya vastusamUha dekhAte lAgalAma-yAte se dRr3ha vizvAsI haYe yAYa|

anantara yakhana rajanIra andhakAra tAra upara samAcchanna hala, takhana se ekaTi tArakA dekhate pela, valalaH ihA AmAra pratipAlaka| ataHpara yakhana tA astamita hala takhana valalaH Ami astagAmIderake bhAlavAsi nA|

ataHpara yakhana candrake jhalamala karate dekhala, valalaH eTi AmAra pratipAlaka| anantara yakhana tA adRzya haYe gela, takhana valala yadi AmAra pratipAlaka AmAke patha-pradarzana nA karena, tave avazyai Ami vibhrAnta sampradAYera antarbhukta haYe yAva|

ataHpara yakhana sUryake cakacaka karate dekhala, valalaH eTi AmAra pAlanakartA, eTi vRhattara| atapara yakhana tA Duve gela, takhana valala he AmAra sampradAYa, teAmarA yesava viSaYake zarIka kara, Ami osava theke mukta|
Ami eka mukhI haYe svIYa Anana ai sattAra dike karechi, yini nabheAmanDala o bhumanDala sRSTi karechena evaM Ami muzareka nai|

tA~ra sAthe tAra sampradAYa vitarka karala| se valalaH teAmarA ki AmAra sAthe AllAhara ekatvavAda samparke vitarka karacha; athaca tini AmAke patha pradarzana karechena| teAmarA yAderake zarIka kara, Ami tAderake bhaYa kari nA tave AmAra pAlakartAi yadi keAna kaSTa dite cAna| AmAra pAlanakartAi pratyeka vastuke svIYa jJAna dvArA veSTana kare Achena| teAmarA ki cintA kara nA?

yAderake teAmarA AllAhara sAthe zarIka kare rekhecha, tAderake kirUpe bhaYa kara, athaca teAmarA bhaYa kara nA ye, teAmarA AllAhara sAthe emana vastuke zarIka karacha, yAdera samparke AllAha teAmAdera prati keAna pramANa avatIrNa karenani| ataeva, ubhaYa sampradAYera madhye zAsti lAbhera adhika yeAgya ke, yadi teAmarA jJAnI haYe thAka|
yArA ImAna Ane evaM svIYa vizvAsake zerekIra sAthe mizrita kare nA, tAdera janyei zAnti evaM tArAi supathagAmI|
eTi chila AmAra yukti, yA Ami ivrAhImake tA~ra sampradAYera vipakSe pradAna karechilAma| Ami yAke icchA maryAdAYa samunnata kari| ApanAra pAlanakartA prajJAmaYa, mahAjJAnI

Ami tA~ke dAna karechi isahAka evaM eYAkuva| pratyekakei Ami patha pradarzana karechi evaM pUrve Ami nUhake patha pradarzana karechi-tA~ra santAnadera madhye dAuda, seAlAYamAna, Aiuva, iusupha, mUsA o hArunake| emanibhAve Ami satkarmIderake pratidAna diYe thAki|
Ara o yAkAriYA, iYAhiYA, IsA evaM iliYAsake| tArA savAi puNyavAnadera antarbhukta chila|
evaM isamAIla, iYAsA, iunUsa, lUtake pratyekakei Ami sArA vizvera upara geৗravAmvita karechi|
Ara o tAdera kichu saMkhyaka pitRpuruSa, santAna-santati o bhrAtAderake; Ami tAderake maneAnIta karechi evaM sarala patha pradarzana karechi|
eTi AllAhara hedAYeta| svIYa vAndAdera madhye yAke icchA, epathe cAlAna| yadi tArA zerekI karata, tave tAdera kAja karma tAdera janye vyartha haYe yeta|
tAderakei Ami grantha, zarIYata o navuYata dAna karechi| ataeva, yadi erA ApanAra navuYata asvIkAra kare, tave era janye emana sampradAYa nirdiSTa karechi, yArA ete avizvAsI have nA|

erA emana chila, yAderake AllAha patha pradarzana karechilena| ataeva, Apanio tAdera patha anusaraNa karuna| Apani vale dinaH Ami teAmAdera kAche era janye keAna pArizramika cAi nA| eTi sArA vizvera janye ekaTi upadezamAtra|

tArA AllAhake yathArtha mUlyAYana karate pAreni, yakhana tArA valalaH AllAha keAna mAnuSera prati keAna kichu avatIrNa karenani| Apani jijJesa karunaH ai grantha ke nAyila kareche, yA mUsA niYe esechila? yA jyeAtivizeSa evaM mAnava manDalIra janye heAdAYetasvarUpa, yA teAmarA vikSiptapatre rekhe leAkadera janye prakAza karacha evaM vahulAMzake geApana karacha| teAmAderake emana aneka viSaYa zikSA deYA haYeche, yA teAmarA evaM teAmAdera pUrvapuruSarA jAnateA nA| Apani vale dinaH AllAha nAyila karechena| ataHpara tAderake tAdera krIr3AmUlaka vRttite vyApRta thAkate dina|

e keAraAna emana grantha, yA Ami avatIrna karechi; varakatamaYa, pUrvavartI granthera satyatA pramANakArI evaM yAte Apani makkAvAsI o pAzvavartIderake bhaYa pradarzana karena| yArA parakAle vizvAsa sthApana kare tArA era prati vizvAsa sthApana kare evaM tAra svIYa nAmAya saMrakSaNa kare|

ai vyaktira cAite var3a jAlema ke have, ye AllAhara prati mithyA AreApa kare athavA valeH AmAra prati ohI avatIrNa haYeche| athaca tAra prati keAna ohI Aseni evaM ye dAvI kare ye, Amio nAyila kare dekhAcchi yemana AllAha nAyila karechena| yadi Apani dekhena yakhana jAlemarA mRtyu yantraNAYa thAke evaM pherezatArA svIYa hasta prasArita kare vale, vera kara svIYa AtmA! adya teAmAderake avamAnanAkara zAsti pradAna karA have| kAraNa, teAmarA AllAhara upara asatya valate evaM tA~ra AYAta samUha theke ahaMkAra karate|

teAmarA AmAra kAche niHsaGga haYe esecha, Ami prathamavAra teAmAderake sRSTi karechilAma| Ami teAderake yA diYechilAma, tA pazcAtei rekhe esecha| Ami teA teAmAdera sAthe teAmAdera supArizakArIdera ke dekhachi nA| yAdera samparke teAmAdera dAvI chila ye, tArA teAmAdera vyApAre aMzIdAra| vAstuvikai teAmAdera parasparera samparka chinna haYe geche evaM teAmAdera dAvI udhAo haYe geche|
nizcaYa AllAhai vIja o A~Ti theke aGkura sRSTikArI; tini jIvitake mRta theke vera karena o mRtake jIvita theke vera karena| tini AllAha ataHpara teAmarA keAthAYa vibhrAnta haccha?
tini prabhAta razmira unmeSaka| tini rAtrike ArAmadAYaka karechena evaM sUrya o candrake hisevera janya rekhechena| eTi parAkrAnta, mahAjJAnIra nirdhAraNa|
tinii teAmAdera janya nakSatrapuJja sRjana karechena yAte teAmarA sthala o jalera andhakAre patha prApta hao| nizcaYa yArA jJAnI tAdera janye Ami nirdezanAvalI vistArita varNanA kare diYechi|

tinii teAmAdera ke eka vyakti theke sRSTi karechena| anantara ekaTi hacche teAmAdera sthAYI ThikAnA o ekaTi hacche gacchita sthala| nizcaYa Ami pramANAdi vistArita bhAve varNanA kare diYechi tAdera janye, yArA cintA kare|

tinii AkAza theke pAni varSaNa karechena ataHpara Ami era dvArA sarvaprakAra udbhida utpanna karechi, ataHpara Ami e theke savuja phasala nirgata karechi, yA theke yugma vIja utpanna kari| khejurera kA~di theke guccha vera kari, yA nuYe thAke evaM AGgurera vAgAna, yaYatuna, AnAra paraspara sAdRzyayukta evaM sAdRzyahIna| vibhinna gAchera phalera prati lakSya kara yakhana seuguleA phalanta haYa evaM tAra paripakkatAra prati lakSya kara| nizcaYa e guleAte nidarzana raYeche ImAnadAradera janye|

tArA jinaderake AllAhara aMzIdAra sthira kare; athaca tAderake tinii sRsTi karechena| tArA ajJatAvazataH AllAhara janye putra o kanyA sAvyasta kare niYeche| tini pavitra o samunnata, tAdera varnanA theke|
tini nabheAmanDala o bhUmanDalera Adi sraSTA| kirUpe AllAhara putra hate pAre, athaca tA~ra keAna saGgI nei? tini yAvatIYa kichu sRSTi karechena| tini sava vastu samparke suvijJa|
tinii AllAha teAmAdera pAlanakartA| tini vyatIta keAna upAsya nei| tinii sava kichura sraSTA| ataeva, teAmarA tA~rai evAdata kara| tini pratyeka vastura kAryanirvAhI|
dRSTisamUha tA~ke pete pAre nA, avazya tini dRSTisamUhake pete pArena| tini atyanta sukSadarzI, suvijJa|

teAmAdera kAche teAmAdera pAlanakartAra pakSa theke nidarzanAvalI ese geche| ataeva, ye pratyakSa karave, se nijerai upakAra karave evaM ye andha have, se nijerai kSati karave| Ami teAmAdera paryavekSaka nai|
emani bhAve Ami nidarzanAvalI ghuriYe-phiriYe varNanA kari yAte tArA nA vale ye, Apani teA par3e niYechena evaM yAte Ami eke sudhIvRndera janye khuva parivyakta kare dei|
Apani patha anusaraNa karuna, yAra Adeza pAlanakartAra pakSa theke Ase| tini vyatIta keAna upAsya nei evaM muzarikadera tarapha theke mukha phiriYe nina|
yadi AllAha cAitena tave tArA zeraka karata nA| Ami ApanAke tAdera saMrakSaka karini evaM Apani tAdera kAryanirvAhI nana|

teAmarA tAderake manda valeA nA, yAdera tArA ArAdhanA kare AllAhake cher3e| tAhale tArA dhRSTatA kare ajJatAvazataH AllAhake manda valave| emanibhAve Ami pratyeka sampradAYera dRSTite tAdera kAja karma suzeAbhita kare diYechi| ataHpara svIYa pAlanakartAra kAche tAderake pratyAvartana karate have| takhana tini tAderake vale devena yA kichu tArA karata|

tArA jeAra diYe AllAhara kasama khAYa ye, yadi tAdera kAche keAna nidarzana Ase, tave avazyai tArA vizvAsa sthApana karave| Apani vale dinaH nidarzanAvalI teA AllAhara kAchei Ache| he musalamAnagaNa, teAmAderake ke valala ye, yakhana tAdera kAche nidarzanAvalI Asave, takhana tArA vizvAsa sthApana karavei?
Ami ghuriYe diva tAdera antara o dRSTike, yemana-tArA era prati prathamavAra vizvAsa sthApana kareni evaM Ami tAderake tAdera avAdhyatAYa udabhrAnta cher3e diva|

Ami yadi tAdera kAche pherezatAderake avatAraNa karatAma evaM tAdera sAthe mRtarA kathAvArtA valata evaM Ami sava vastuke tAdera sAmane jIvita kare ditAma, tathApi tArA kakhanao vizvAsa sthApanakArI naYa; kintu yadi AllAha cAna| kintu tAdera adhikAMzai murkha|

emanibhAve Ami pratyeka navIra janye zatru karechi zaYatAna, mAnava o jinake| tArA dheA~kA deYAra janye eke aparake kArukAryakhacita kathAvArtA zikSA deYa| yadi ApanAra pAlanakartA cAitena, tave tArA e kAja karata nA|

ataeva, Apani tAderake evaM tAdera mithyApavAdake mukta cher3e dina yAte kArukAryakhacita vAkyera prati tAdera mana AkRSTa haYa yArA parakAle vizvAsa kare nA evaM tArA ekeo pachanda kare neYa evaM yAte aisava kAja kare, yA tArA karache|

tave ki Ami AllAha vyatIta anya keAna vicAraka anusandhAna karava, athaca tinii teAmAdera prati vistArita grantha avatIrna karechena? Ami yAderake grantha pradAna karechi, tArA nizcita jAne ye, eTi ApanAra prati pAlakera pakSa theke satyasaha avartIrna haYeche| ataeva, Apani saMzaYakArIdera antarbhukta havena nA|
ApanAra pratipAlakera vAkya pUrNa satya o suSama| tA~ra vAkyera keAna parivartanakArI nei| tinii zravaNakArI, mahAjJAnI|

Ara yadi Apani pRthivIra adhikAMza leAkera kathA mene nena, tave tArA ApanAke AllAhara patha theke vipathagAmI kare deve| tArA zudhu alIka kalpanAra anusaraNa kare evaM sampUrNa anumAna bhittika kathAvArtA vale thAke|
ApanAra pratipAlaka tAdera samparke khuva jJAta raYechena, yArA tA~ra patha theke vipathagAmI haYa evaM tini tAderakeo khuva bhAla kare jAnena, yArA tA~ra pathe anugamana kare|
ataHpara ye jantura upara AllAhara nAma uccArita haYa, tA theke bhakSaNa kara yadi teAmarA tA~ra vidhAnasamUhe vizvAsI hao|

keAna kAraNe teAmarA emana jantu theke bhakSaNa karave nA, yAra upara AllAhara nAma uccArita haYa, athaca AllAha ai sava jantura vizada vivaraNa diYechena, yeguleAke teAmAdera janye hArAma karechena; kintu seguleAo teAmAdera janye hAlAla, yakhana teAmarA nirupAYa haYe yAo| aneka leAka svIYa bhrAnta pravRtti dvArA nA jene vipathagAmI karate thAke| ApanAra pratipAlaka sImAtikrama kArIderake yathArthai jAnena|
teAmarA prakAzya o pracchanna geAnAha parityAga kara| nizcaYa yArA geAnAha kareche, tArA atisatvara tAdera kRtakarmera zAsti pAve|

yesava jantura upara AllAhara nAma uccArita haYa nA, seguleA theke bhakSaNa kareA nA; e bhakSaNa karA geAnAha| nizcaYa zaYatAnarA tAdera vandhuderake pratyAdeza kare-yena tArA teAmAdera sAthe tarka kare| yadi teAmarA tAdera Anugatya kara, teAmarAo muzareka haYe yAve|

Ara ye mRta chila ataHpara Ami tAke jIvita karechi evaM tAke emana ekaTi AleA diYechi, yA niYe se mAnuSera madhye calApherA kare| se ki ai vyaktira samatulya hate pAre, ye andhakAre raYeche-sekhAna theke vera hate pArache nA? emanibhAve kApheradera dRSTite tAdera kAjakarmake suzeAbhita kare deYA haYeche|

Ara emanibhAve Ami pratyeka janapade aparAdhIdera janya kichu sardAra niYeAga karechi-yena tArA sekhAne cakrAnta kare| tAdera se cakrAnta tAdera nijedera viruddhei; kintu tArA tA upalavdhi karate pAre nA|

yakhana tAdera kAche keAna AYAta pau~che, takhana vale, AmarA kakhanai mAnava nA ye paryanta nA AmarAo tA pradatta hai, yA AllAhara rasUlagaNa pradatta haYechena| AllAha e viSaYe supArijJAta ye, keAthAYa svIYa paYagAma preraNa karate have| yArA aparAdha karache, tArA atisatvara AllAhara kAche peৗche lAJchanA o kaTheAra zAsti pAve, tAdera cakrAntera kAraNe|

ataHpara AllAha yAke patha-pradarzana karate cAna, tAra vakSake isalAmera janye ummukta kare dena evaM yAke vipathagAmI karate cAna, tAra vakSake saMkIrNa atyadhika saMkIrNa kare dena-yena se savege AkAze AreAhaNa karache| emani bhAve yArA vizvAsa sthApana kare nA| AllAha tAdera upara AyAva varSana karena|
Ara eTAi ApanAra pAlanakartAra sarala patha| Ami upadeza grahaNakArIdera janye AYAtasamUha puGkhAnupuGkha varnanA karechi|
tAdera janyei tAdera pratipAlakera kAche nirApattAra gRha raYeche evaM tini tAdera vandhu tAdera karmera kAraNe|

yedina AllAha savAike ekatrita karavena, he jina sampradAYa, teAmarA mAnuSadera madhye anekake anugAmI kare niYecha| tAdera mAnava vandhurA valaveH he AmAdera pAlanakartA, AmarA paraspare parasparera mAdhyame phala lAbha karechi| Apani AmAdera janye ye samaYa nirdhAraNa karechilena, AmarA tAte upanIta haYechi| AllAha valavenaH Aguna hala teAmAdera vAsasthAna| tathAYa teAmarA cirakAla avasthAna karave; kintu yakhana cAivena AllAha| nizcaYa ApanAra pAlanakartA prajJAmaYa, mahAjJAnI|
emanibhAve Ami pApIderake eke aparera sAthe yukta kare deva tAdera kAjakarmera kAraNe|

he jvina o mAnava sampradAYa, teAmAdera kAche ki teAmAdera madhya theke paYagamvaragaNa Agamana kareni? yA~rA teAmAderake AmAra vidhAnAvalI varNanA karatena evaM teAmAderake Ajakera e dinera sAkSAtera bhIti pradarzana karatena? tArA valaveH AmarA svIYa geAnAha svIkAra kare nilAma| pArthiva jIvana tAderake pratArita kareche| tArA nijedera viruddhe svIkAra kare niYeche ye, tArA kAphera chila|
eTA e janye ye, ApanAra pratipAlaka keAna janapadera adhivAsIderake julumera kAraNe dhvaMsa karena nA ematAvasthAYa ye, tathAkAra adhivAsIrA ajJa thAke|
pratyekera janye tAdera karmera AnupAtika maryAdA Ache evaM ApanAra pratipAlaka tAdera karma samparke vekhavara nana|

ApanAra pratipAlaka amukhApekSI, karuNAmaYa| tini icchA karale teAmAdera savAike uccheda kare divena evaM teAmAdera para yAke icchA teAmAdera sthale abhiSikta karavena; yemana teAmAderake anya eka sampradAYera vaMzadhara theke sRSTi karechena|
ye viSaYera oYAdA teAmAdera sAthe karA haYa, tA avazyai Agamana karave evaM teAmarA akSama karate pArave nA|
Apani vale dinaH he AmAra sampradAYa, teAmarA svasthAne kAja kare yAo, Amio kAja kari| acirei jAnate pArave ye, pariNAma gRha ke lAbha kare| nizcaYa jAlemarA suphalaprApta have nA|

AllAha yesava zasyakSetra o jIvajantu sRSTi karechena, seguleA theke tArA eka aMza AllAhara janya nirdhAraNa kare ataHpara nija dhAraNA anusAre vale eTA AllAhara evaM eTA AmAdera aMzIdAradera| ataHpara ye aMza tAdera aMzIdAradera, tA teA AllAhara dike pau~che nA evaM yA AllAhara tA tAdera upAsyadera dike peৗche yAYa| tAdera vicAra katai nA manda|

emanibhAve aneka muzarekera dRSTite tAdera upAsyarA santAna hatyAke suzeAbhita kare diYeche yena tArA tAderake vinaSTa kare deYa evaM tAdera dharmamatake tAdera kAche vibhrAnta kare deYa| yadi AllAha cAitena, tave tArA e kAja karata nA| ataeva, Apani tAderake evaM tAdera managar3A vulike parityAga karuna|

tArA valeH esava catuSpada jantu o zasyakSetra niSiddha| AmarA yAke icchA kari, se chAr3A eguleA keu khete pArave nA, tAdera dhAraNA anusAre| Ara kichusaMkhyaka catuSpada jantura piThe AreAhana hArAma karA haYeche evaM kichu saMkhyaka catuSpada jantura upara tArA bhrAnta dhAranA vazataH AllAhara nAma uccAraNa kare nA, tAdera managar3A vulira kAraNe, acirei tini tAdera ke zAsti divena|

tArA valeH esava catuSpada jantura peTe yA Ache, tA vizeSa bhAve AmAdera puruSadera janye evaM AmAdera mahilAdera janye tA hArAma| yadi tA mRta haYa, tave tAra prApaka hisAve savAi samAna| acirei tini tAderake tAdera varNanAra zAsti divena| tini prajJAmaYa, mahAjJAnI|

nizcaYa tArA kSatigrasta haYeche, yArA nija santAnaderake nirvuddhitAvazataH keAna pramANa chAr3Ai hatyA kareche evaM AllAha tAderake yesava diYechilena, seguleAke AllAhara prati bhrAnta dhAraNA peASaNa kare hArAma kare niYeche| nizcitai tArA pathabhraSTa haYeche evaM supathagAmI haYani|

tinii udyAna samUha sRSTi kareche-tAo, yA mAcAra upara tule deYA haYa, evaM yA mAcAra upara teAlA haYa nA evaM kharjura vRkSa o zasyakSetra yesavera svAdaviziSTa evaM yaYatuna o AnAra sRSTi karechena-eke anyera sAdRzyazIla evaM sAdRzyahIna| eguleAra phala khAo, yakhana phalanta haYa evaM haka dAna kara kartanera samaYe evaM apavyaYa kareA nA| nizcaYa tini apavyaYIderake pachanda karena nA|

tini sRSTi karechena catuSpada jantura madhye veAjhA vahanakArIke evaM kharvAkRtike| AllAha teAmAderake yA kichu diYechena, tA theke khAo evaM zaYatAnera padAGka anusaraNa kareA nA| se teAmAdera prakAzya zatru|

sRSTi karechena ATaTi nara o mAdI| bher3Ara madhye dui prakAra o chAgalera madhye dui prakAra| jijJesa karuna, tini ki ubhaYa nara hArAma karechena, nA ubhaYa mAdIke? nA yA ubhaYa mAdIra peTe Ache? teAmarA AmAke pramANasaha vala, yadi teAmarA satyavAdI hao|

sRSTi karechena uTera madhye dui prakAra evaM garura madhye dui prakAra| Apani jijJesa karunaH tini ki ubhaYa nara hArAma karechena, nA ubhaYa mAdIke, nA yA ubhaYa mAdIra peTe Ache? teAmarA ki upasthita chile, yakhana AllAha e nirdeza diYechilena? ataeva se vyakti apekSA vezI atyacArI ke, ye AllAha samparke mithyA dhAraNA peASana kare yAte kare mAnuSake vinA pramANe pathabhraSTa karate pAre? nizcaYa AllAha atyAcArI sampradAYake pathapradarzana karena nA|

Apani vale dinaH yA kichu vidhAna ohIra mAdhyame AmAra kAche pau~cheche, tanmadhye Ami keAna hArAma khAdya pAi nA keAna bhakSaNakArIra janye, yA se bhakSaNa kare; kintu mRta athavA pravAhita rakta athavA zukarera mAMsa eTA apavitra athavA avaidha; yaveha karA jantu yA AllAha chAr3A anyera nAme utsarga karA haYa| atapara ye kSudhAYa kAtara haYe par3e ematAvasthAYa ye avAdhyatA kare nA evaM sImAlaGgana kare nA, nizcaYa ApanAra pAlanakartA kSamAzIla daYAlu|

ihudIdera janye Ami pratyeka nakhaviziSTa jantu hArAma karechilAma evaM chAgala o garu theke etadubhaYera carvi Ami tAdera janye hArAma karechilAma, kintu ai carvi, yA pRSTe kiMvA antre saMyukta thAke athavA asthira sAthe milita thAke| tAdera avAdhyatAra kAraNe Ami tAderake e zAsti diYechilAma| Ara Ami avazyai satyavAdI|
yadi tArA ApanAke mithyavAdI vale, tave vale dinaH teAmAra pratipAlaka suprazasta karuNAra mAlika| tA~ra zAsti aparAdhIdera upara theke Talave nA|

ekhana muzarekarA valaveH yadi AllAha icchA karatena, tave nA AmarA ziraka karatAma, nA AmAdera vApa dAdArA evaM nA AmarA keAna vastuke hArAma karatAma| emanibhAve tAdera pUrvavartIrA mithyAreApa kareche, emana ki tArA AmAra zAsti AsvAdana kareche| Apani valunaH teAmAdera kAche ki keAna pramANa Ache yA AmAderake dekhAte pAra| teAmarA zudhumAtra AndAjera anusaraNa kara evaM teAmarA zudhu anumAna kare kathA vala|
Apani vale dinaH ataeva, paripUrna yukti AllAharai| tini icchA karale teAmAdera savAike patha pradarzana karatena|

Apani valunaH teAmAdera sAkSIderake Ana, yArA sAkSya deYa ye, AllAha tA’AlA eguleA hArAma karechena| yadi tArA sAkSya deYa, tave Apani e sAkSya grahaNa karavena nA evaM tAdera kupravRttira anusaraNa karavena nA, yArA AmAra nirdezAvalIke mithyA vale, yArA parakAle vizvAsa kare nA evaM yArA svIYa pratipAlakera samatulya aMzIdAra kare|

Apani valunaH esa, Ami teAmAderake aisava viSaYa pATha kare zunAi, yeguleA teAmAdera pratipAlaka teAmAdera janye hArAma karechena| tA ei ye, AllAhara sAthe keAna kichuke aMzIdAra kareA nA, pitA-mAtAra sAthe sadaYa vyavahAra kareA svIYa santAnaderake dAridryera kAraNe hatyA kareA nA, Ami teAmAderake o tAderake AhAra dei, nirlajjatAra kAcheo yeYeA nA, prakAzya heAka kiMvA aprakAzya, yAke hatyA karA AllAha hArAma karechena, tAke hatyA kareA nA; kintu nyAYabhAve| teAmAderake e nirdeza diYechena, yena teAmarA vujha|

etImadera dhanasampadera kAcheo yeYeA nA; kintu uttama panthAYa ye paryanta se vaYaHprApta nA haYa| ojana o mApa pUrNa kara nyAYa sahakAre| Ami kAuke tAra sAdhyera atIta kaSTa dei nA| yakhana teAmarA kathA vala, takhana suvicAra kara, yadio se AtnIYao haYa| AllAhara aGgIkAra pUrNa kara|

teAmAderake e nirdeza diYechena, yena teAmarA upadeza grahaNa kara| nizcita eTi AmAra sarala patha| ataeva, e pathe cala evaM anyAnya pathe caleA nA| tA hale sesava patha teAmAderake tA~ra patha theke vicchinna kare dive| teAmAderake e nirdeza diYechena, yAte teAmarA saMyata hao|

ataHpara Ami mUsAke grantha diYechi, satkarmIdera prati neYAmatapUrNa karAra janye, pratyeka vastura vizada vivaraNera janye, heAdAYAtera janye evaM karuNAra janye-yAte tArA svIYa pAlanakartAra sAthe sAkSAte vizvAsI haYa|
eTi emana ekaTi grantha, yA Ami avatIrNa karechi, khuva maGgalamaYa, ataeva, era anusaraNa kara evaM bhaYa kara-yAte teAmarA karuNAprApta hao|
e janye ye, kakhanao teAmarA valate zuru karaH grantha teA kevala AmAdera pUrvavartI du'sampradAYera pratii avatIrNa haYeche evaM AmarA seguleAra pATha o paThana samparke kichui jAnatAma nA|
