kiMvA valate zuru karaH yadi AmAdera prati keAna grantha avatIrNa hata, AmarA edera cAite adhika pathaprApta hatAma| ataeva, teAmAdera pAlanakartAra pakSa theke teAmAdera kAche suSpaSTa pramANa, hedAYeta o rahamata ese geche| ataHpara se vyaktira cAite adhika anAcArI ke have, ye AllAhara AYAta samUhake mithyA vale evaM gA vA~ciYe cale| ati sattvara Ami tAderake zAsti deva| yArA AmAra AYAta samUha theke gA vA~ciYe cale-jaghanya zAsti tAdera gA vA~cAneAra kAraNe|

tArA zudhu e viSaYera dike ceYe Ache ye, tAdera kAche pherezatA Agamana karave kiMvA ApanAra pAlanakartA Agamana karavena athavA ApanAra pAlanakartAra keAna nirdeza Asave| yedina ApanAra pAlanakartAra keAna nidarzana Asave, sedina emana keAna vyaktira vizvAsa sthApana tAra janye phalaprasU have nA, ye pUrva theke vizvAsa sthApana kareni kiMvA svIYa vizvAsa anuyAYI keAnarUpa satkarma kareni| Apani vale dinaH teAmarA pathera dike ceYe thAka, AmarAo pathera dike tAkiYe railAma|

nizcaYa yArA svIYa dharmake khanDa-vikhanDa kareche evaM aneka dala haYe geche, tAdera sAthe ApanAra keAna samparka nei| tAdera vyApAra AllAha tA'AYAlAra nikaTa samarpita| ataHpara tini vale devena yA kichu tArA kare thAke|
ye ekaTi satkarma karave, se tAra dazaguNa pAve evaM ye, ekaTi manda kAja karave, se tAra samAna zAstii pAve| vastutaH tAdera prati juluma karA have nA|
Apani vale dinaH AmAra pratipAlaka AmAke sarala patha pradarzana karechena ekAgracitta ivrAhImera vizuddha dharma| se aMzIvAdIdera antarbhUkta chila nA|
Apani valunaH AmAra nAmAya, AmAra keAravANI evaM AmAra jIvana o marana vizva-pratipAlaka AllAharai janye|
tA~ra keAna aMzIdAra nei| Ami tAi AdiSTa haYechi evaM Ami prathama AnugatyazIla|

Apani valunaH Ami ki AllAha vyatIta anya pratipAlaka kheA~java, athaca tinii savakichura pratipAlaka? ye vyakti keAna geAnAha kare, tA tArai dAYitve thAke| keu aparera veAjhA vahana karave nA| ataHpara teAmAderake savAike pratipAlakera kAche pratyAvartana karate have| anantara tini teAmAderake vale divena, yesava viSaYe teAmarA vireAdha karate|

tinii teAmAderake pRthivIte pratinidhi karechena evaM eke anyera upara maryAdA samunnata karechena, yAte teAmAderake e viSaYe parIkSA karena, yA teAmAderake diYechena| ApanAra pratipAlaka druta zAsti dAtA evaM tini atyanta kSamAzIla, daYAlu|
Alipha, lAma, mIma, cheAYAda|

eTi ekaTi grantha, yA ApanAra prati avatIrNa haYeche, yAte kare Apani era mAdhyame bhIti-pradarzana karena| ataeva, eTi peৗche dite ApanAra mane keAnarUpa saMkIrNatA thAkA ucita naYa| Ara eTii vizvAsIdera janye upadeza|
teAmarA anusaraNa kara, yA teAmAdera prati pAlakera pakSa theke avatIrNa haYeche evaM AllAhake vAda diYe anya sAthIdera anusaraNa kareA nA|
Ara teAmarA alpai upadeza grahaNa kara| aneka janapadake Ami dhvaMsa kare diYechi| tAdera kAche AmAra AyAva rAtri velAYa peৗcheche athavA dviprahare vizrAmarata avasthAYa|
anantara yakhana tAdera kAche AmAra AyAva upasthita haYa, takhana tAdera kathA ei chila ye, tArA valalaH nizcaYa AmarA atyAcArI chilAma|
ataeva, Ami avazyai tAderake jijJesa karava yAdera kAche rasUla prerita haYechila evaM Ami avazyai tAderake jijJesa karava rasUlagaNake|
ataHpara Ami svajJAne tAdera kAche avasthA varNanA karava| vastutaH Ami anupasthita teA chilAma nA|
Ara sedina yathArthai ojana have| ataHpara yAdera pAllA bhArI have, tArAi saphalakAma have|
evaM yAdera pAllA hAlkA have, tArAi emana have, yArA nijedera kSati kareche| kenanA, tArA AmAra AYAta samUha asvIkAra karateA|
Ami teAmAderake pRthivIte ThAi diYechi evaM teAmAdera jIvikA nirdiSTa kare diYechi| teAmarA alpai kRtajJatA svIkAra kara|

Ara Ami teAmAderake sRSTi karechi, erapara AkAra-avaYava, tairI karechi| ataHpara Ami pherezatAderake valachi-Adamake sejadA kara takhana savAi sejadA kareche, kintu ivalIsa se sejadAkArIdera antarbhUkta chila nA|

AllAha valalenaH Ami yakhana nirdeza diYechi, takhana teAke kise sejadA karate vAraNa karala? se valalaH Ami tAra cAite zreSTa| Apani AmAke Aguna dvArA sRSTi karechena evaM tAke sRSTi karechena mATira dvArA|
valalena tui ekhAna theke yA| ekhAne ahaMkAra karAra keAna adhikAra teAra nAi| ataeva tui vera haYe yA| tui hInatamadera antarbhukta|
se valalaH AmAke keYAmata divasa paryanta avakAza dina|
AllAha valalenaH teAke samaYa deYA hala|
se valalaH Apani AmAke yemana udabhrAnta karechena, Amio avazya tAdera janye ApanAra sarala pathe vase thAkaveA|
erapara tAdera kAche Asava tAdera sAmanera dika theke, pechana dika theke, DAna dika theke evaM vAma dika theke| Apani tAdera adhikAMzake kRtajJa pAvena nA|
AllAha valalenaH vera haYe yA ekhAna theke lAJchita o apamAnita haYe| tAdera ye keu teAra pathecalave, nizcaYa Ami teAdera savAra dvArA jAhAnnAma pUrNa kare diva|
he Adama tumi evaM teAmAra strI jAnnAte vasavAsa kara| ataHpara sekhAna theke yA icchA khAo tave e vRkSera kAche yeYeAnA tAhale teAmarA geAnAhagAra haYe yAve|

ataHpara zaYatAna ubhaYake prareAcita karala, yAte tAdera aGga, yA tAdera kAche geApana chila, tAdera sAmane prakAza kare deYa| se valalaH teAmAdera pAlanakartA teAmAderake e vRkSa theke niSedha karenani; tave tA e kAraNe ye, teAmarA nA AvAra pherezatA haYe yAo-kiMvA haYe yAo cirakAla vasavAsakArI|
se tAdera kAche kasama kheYe valalaH Ami avazyai teAmAdera hitAkAGkhI|

ataHpara pratAraNApUrvaka tAderake sammata kare phelala| anantara yakhana tArA vRkSa AsvAdana karala, takhana tAdera lajjAsthAna tAdera sAmane khule gela evaM tArA nijera upara vehezatera pAtA jar3Ate lAgala| tAdera pratipAlaka tAderake Deke valalenaH Ami ki teAmAderake e vRkSa theke niSedha karini evaM valini ye, zaYatAna teAmAdera prakAzya zatru|

tArA ubhaYe valalaH he AmAdera pAlanakartA AmarA nijedera prati julama karechi| yadi Apani AmAderake kSamA nA karena evaM AmAdera prati anugraha nA karena, tave AmarA avazyai avazyai dhvaMsa haYe yAva|
AllAha valalenaH teAmarA neme yAo| teAmarA eka aparera zatru| teAmAdera janye pRthivIte vAsasthAna Ache evaM ekaTi nirdiSTa meYAda paryanta phala bheAga Ache|
valalenaH teAmarA sekhAnei jIvita thAkave, sekhAnei mRtyuvarana karave evaM sekhAna thekei punaruGkhita have|

he vanI-Adama Ami teAmAdera janye peAzAka avartINa karechi, yA teAmAdera lajjAsthAna AvRta kare evaM avartINa karechi sAja sajjAra vastra evaM paraheyagArIra peAzAka, eTi sarveAttama| eTi AllAhara kudarateraanyatama nidarzana, yAte tArA cintA-bhAvanA kare|

he vanI-Adama zaYatAna yena teAmAderake vibhrAnta nA kare; yemana se teAmAdera pitAmAtAke jAnnAta theke vera kare diYeche ematAvasthAYa ye, tAdera peAzAka tAdera theke khuliYe diYechi-yAte tAderake lajjAsthAna dekhiYe deYa| se evaM tAra dalavala teAmAderake dekhe, yekhAna theke teAmarA tAderake dekha nA| Ami zaYatAnaderake tAdera vandhu kare diYechi, yArA vizvAsa sthApana kare nA|

tArA yakhana keAna manda kAja kare, takhana vale AmarA vApa-dAdAke emani karate dekhechi evaM AllAhao AmAderake e nirdezai diYechena| AllAha mandakAjera Adeza dena nA| emana kathA AllAhara prati kena AreApa kara, yA teAmarA jAna nA|

Apani vale dinaH AmAra pratipAlaka suvicArera nirdeza diYechena evaM teAmarA pratyeka sejadAra samaYa svIYa mukhamanDala seAjA rAkha evaM tA~ke khA~Ti AnugatyazIla haYe DAka| teAmAderake prathame yemana sRSTi karechena, punarvArao sRjita have|

ekadalake patha pradarzana karechena evaM ekadalera janye pathabhraSTatA avadhArita haYe geche| tArA AllAhake cher3e zaYatAnaderake vandhu hisAve grahaNa kareche evaM dhAraNA kare ye, tArA satpathe raYeche|
he vanI-Adama! teAmarA pratyeka nAmAyera samaYa sAjasajjA paridhAna kare nAo, khAo o pAna kara evaM apavyaYa kareA nA| tini apavyaYIderake pachanda karena nA|

Apani valunaH AllAhara sAja-sajjAke, yA tini vAndAdera janye sRSTi karechena evaM pavitra khAdravastusamUhake ke hArAma kareche? Apani valunaH esava neYAmata Asale pArthiva jIvane muminadera janye evaM kiYAmatera dina khA~TibhAve tAderai janye| emanibhAve Ami AYAtasamUha vistArita varNanA kari tAdera janye yArA vujhe|

Apani vale dinaH AmAra pAlanakartA kevalamAtra azlIla viSaYasamUha hArAma karechena yA prakAzya o aprakAzya evaM hArAma karechena geAnAha, anyAYa-atyAcAra AllAhara sAthe emana vastuke aMzIdAra karA, tini yAra keAna, sanada avatIrNa karenani evaM AllAhara prati emana kathA AreApa karA, yA teAmarA jAna nA|
pratyeka sampradAYera ekaTi meYAda raYeche| yakhana tAdera meYAda ese yAve, takhana tArA nA eka muhurta piche yete pArave, Ara nA egiYe Asate pArave|

he vanI-Adama, yadi teAmAdera kAche teAmAderai madhya theke paYagamvara Agamana kare teAmAderake AmAra AYAta samUha zunAYa, tave ye vyakti saMyata haYa evaM satkAja avalamvana kare, tAdera keAna AzaGkA nei evaM tArA duHkhita have nA|
yArA AmAra AYAtasamUhake mithyA valave evaM tA theke ahaMkAra karave, tArAi deAyakhI evaM tathAYa cirakAla thAkave|

ataHpara ai vyaktira cAite adhika jAlema ke, ye AllAhara prati mithyA AreApa kare athavA tAra nirdezAvalIke mithyA vale? tArA tAdera granthe likhita aMza peYe yAve| emana ki, yakhana tAdera kAche AmAra prerita pherazatArA prANa neoYAra janye peৗche, takhana tArA vale; tArA keAthAYa gela, yAdera ke teAmarA AllAha vyatIta AhavAna karate? tArA uttara deveH AmAdera kAcha theke udhAo haYe geche, tArA nijedera samparke svIkAra karave ye, tArA avazyai kAphera chila|

AllAha valavenaH teAmAdera pUrve jina o mAnavera yesava sampradAYa cale geche, tAdera sAthe teAmarAo deAyakhe yAo| yakhana eka sampradAYa praveza karave; takhana anya sampradAYake abhisampAta karave| emanaki, yakhana tAte savAi patita have, takhana paravartIrA pUrvavartIdera samparke valaveH he AmAdera pratipAlaka erAi AmAderake vipathagAmI karechila| ataeva, Apani tAderake dviguNa zAsti dina| AllAha valavena pratyekerai dviguNa; teAmarA jAna nA|
pUrvavartIrA paravartIderake valaveH tAhale AmAdera upara teAmAdera keAna zreSThatva nei ataeva, zAsti AsvAdana kara svIYa karmera kAraNe|

nizcaYai yArA AmAra AYAtasamUhake mithyA valeche evaM eguleA theke ahaMkAra kareche, tAdera janye AkAzera dvAra ummukta karA have nA evaM tArA jAnnAte praveza karave nA| ye paryanta nA sUcera chidra diYe uTa praveza kare| Ami emanibhAve pApIderake zAsti pradAna kari|
tAdera janye narakAgnira zayyA raYeche evaM upara theke cAdara| Ami emanibhAve jAlemaderake zAsti pradAna kari|
yArA vizvAsa sthApana kareche evaM satkarma kareche Ami kAuke tAra sAmarthyera cAite vezI veAjhA dei nA| tArAi jAnnAtera adhivAsI| tArA tAtei cirakAla thAkave|

tAdera antare yA kichu duHkha chila, Ami tA vera kare deva| tAdera taladeza diYe nirjharaNI pravAhita have| tArA valaveH AllAha zeAkara, yini AmAderake e paryanta peৗchiYechena| AmarA kakhanao patha petAma nA, yadi AllAha AmAderake patha pradarzana nA karatena| AmAdera pratipAlakera rasUla AmAdera kAche satyakathA niYe esechilena| AoYAja AsaveH eTi jAnnAta| teAmarA era uttarAdhikArI hale teAmAdera karmera pratidAne|

jAnnAtIrA deAyakhIderake Deke valaveH AmAdera sAthe AmAdera pratipAlaka ye oYAdA karechilena, tA AmarA satya peYechi| ataeva, teAmarAo ki teAmAdera pratipAlakera oYAdA satya peYecha? tArA valaveH hyA~| ataHpara ekajana gheASaka ubhaYera mAjhakhAne gheASaNA karaveH AllAhara abhisampAta jAlemadera upara|
yArA AllAhara pathe vAdhA dita evaM tAte vakratA anveSaNa karata| tArA parakAlera viSaYeo avizvAsI chila|

ubhaYera mAjhakhAne ekaTi prAcIra thAkave evaM ArAphera upare aneka leAka thAkave| tArA pratyekake tAra cihna dvArA cine neve| tArA jAnnAtIderake Deke valaveH teAmAdera upara zAnti varSita heAka| tArA takhanao jAnnAte praveza karave nA, kintu praveza karAra vyApAre AgrahI have|
yakhana tAdera dRSTi deAyakhIdera upara par3ave, takhana valaveH he AmAdera pratipAlaka, AmAderake e jAlemadera sAthI kareA nA|
ArAphavAsIrA yAderake tAdera cihna dvArA cinave, tAderake Deke valave teAmAdera dalavala o auddhatya teAmAdera keAna kAje Aseni|
erA ki tArAi; yAdera samparke teAmarA kasama kheYe valate ye, AllAha edera prati anugraha karavena nA| praveza kara jAnnAte| teAmAdera keAna AzaGkA nei evaM teAmarA duHkhita have nA|

deAyakhIrA jAnnAtIderake Deke valaveH AmAdera upara sAmAnya pAni nikSepa kara athavA AllAha teAmAderake ye ruyI diYechena, tA thekei kichu dAo| tArA valaveH AllAha ei ubhaYa vastu kApheradera janye niSiddha karechena,

tArA svIYa dharmake tAmAzA o khelA vAniYe niYechila evaM pArthiva jIvana tAdera ke dheAkAYa phele rekhechila| ataeva, Ami Ajake tAderake bhule yAva; yemana tArA e dinera sAkSAtke bhule giYechila evaM yemana tArA AYAtasamUhake avizvAsa karata|
Ami tAdera kAche grantha peৗchiYechi, yA Ami svIYa jJAne vistArita varNanA karechi, yA pathapradarzaka evaM muminadera janye rahamata|

tArA ki ekhana e apekSAYai Ache ye, era viSaYavastu prakAzita heAka? yedina era viSaYavastu prakAzita have, sedina pUrve yArA eke bhUle giYechila, tArA valaveH vAstavikai AmAdera pratipAlakera paYagamvaragaNa satyasaha Agamana karechilena| ataeva, AmAdera janye keAna supArizakArI Ache ki ye, supAriza karave athavA AmAderake punaH preraNa karA hale AmarA pUrve yA karatAma tAra viparIta kAja kare AsatAma| nizcaYa tArA nijederake kSatigrasta kareche| tArA managar3A yA valata, tA udhAo haYe yAve|

nizcaYa teAmAdera pratipAlaka AllAha| tini nabheAmanDala o bhUmanDalake chaYa dine sRSTi karechena| ataHpara Arazera upara adhiSTita haYechena| tini pariYe dena rAtera upara dinake ematAvasthAYa ye, dina deৗr3e rAtera pichane Ase| tini sRSTi karechena sUrya, candra o nakSatra deৗr3a svIYa Adezera anugAmI| zune rekha, tA~rai kAja sRSTi karA evaM Adeza dAna karA| AllAha, varakatamaYa yini vizvajagatera pratipAlaka|
teAmarA svIYa pratipAlakake DAka, kAkuti-minati kare evaM saMgeApane| tini sImA atikramakArIderake pachanda karena nA|
pRthivIke kusaMskAramukta o Thika karAra para tAte anartha sRSTi kareA nA| tA~ke AhavAna kara bhaYa o AzA sahakAre| nizcaYa AllAhara karuNA satkarmazIladera nikaTavartI|

tinii vRSTira pUrve susaMvAdavAhI vAYu pAThiYe dena| emanaki yakhana vAYurAzi pAnipUrna meghamAlA vaYe Ane, takhana Ami e meghamAlAke ekaTi mRta zaharera dike hA~kiYe dei| ataHpara e megha theke vRSTi dhArA varSaNa kari| ataHpara pAni dvArA sava rakamera phala utpanna kari| emani bhAve mRtaderake vera karava-yAte teAmarA cintA kara|

ye zahara utkRSTa, tAra phasala tAra pratipAlakera nirdeze utpanna haYa evaM yA nikRSTa tAte alpai phasala utpanna haYa| emanibhAve Ami AYAtasamUha ghuriYe phiriYe varNanA kari kRtajJa sampradAYera janye|

nizcaYa Ami nUhake tAra sampradAYera prati pAThiYechi| se valalaH he AmAra sampradAYa, teAmarA AllAhara evAdata kara| tini vyatIta teAmAdera keAna upAsya nei| Ami teAmAdera janye ekaTi mahAdivasera zAstira AzaGkA kari|
tAra sampradAYera sardArarA valalaH AmarA teAmAke prakAzya pathabhraSTatAra mAjhe dekhate pAcchi|
se valalaH he AmAra sampradAYa, Ami kakhanao bhrAnta nai; kintu Ami vizvapratipAlakera rasUla|
teAmAderake pratipAlakera paYagAma pau~chAi evaM teAmAderake sadupadeza dei| Ami AllAhara pakSa theke emanasava viSaYa jAni, yeguleA teAmarA jAna nA|

teAmarA ki AzcaryaveAdha karacha ye, teAmAdera kAche teAmAdera pratipAlakera pakSa theke teAmAdera madhya thekei ekajanera vAcanika upadeza eseche yAte se teAmAderake bhIti pradarzana kare, yena teAmarA saMyata hao evaM yena teAmarA anugRhIta hao|
ataHpara tArA tAke mithyA pratipanna karala| Ami tAke evaM neৗkAsthita leAkaderake uddhAra karalAma evaM yArA mithyAreApa karata, tAderake DuviYe dilAma| nizcaYa tArA chila andha|
Ada sampradAYera kAche preraNa karechi tAdera bhAi hudake| se valalaH he AmAra sampradAYa, teAmarA AllAhara evAdata kara| tini vyatita teAmAdera keAna upAsya nei|
tAra sampradAYera sardararA valalaH AmarA teAmAke nirveAdha dekhate pAcchi evaM AmarA teAmAke mithyAvAdI mane kari|
se valalaH he AmAra sampradAYa, Ami meATei nirveAdha nai, varaM Ami vizva pratipAlakera prerita paYagamvara|
teAmAdera ke pratipAlakera paYagAma pau~chAi evaM Ami teAmAdera hitAkAGkSI vizvasta|

teAmarA ki Azcaryyavodha karacha ye, teAmAdera kAche teAmAdera pAlanakartAra pakSa theke teAmAdera madhya thekei ekajanera vAcanika upadeza eseche yAte se teAmAderake bhIti pradarzana kare| teAmarA smaraNa kara, yakhana AllAha teAmAderake kaome nUhera para sardAra karechena evaM teAmAdera dehera vistRti vezI karechena| teAmarA AllAhara neYAmatasamUha smaraNa kara-yAte teAmAdera maGgala haYa|

tArA valalaH tumi ki AmAdera kAche ejanye esecha ye AmarA eka AllAhara evAdata kari evaM AmAdera vApa-dAdA yAdera pUjA karata, tAderake cher3e dei? ataeva niYe Asa AmAdera kAche yAddvArA AmAderake bhaYa dekhAccha, yadi tumi satyavAdI hao|

se valalaH avadhArita haYe geche teAmAdera upara teAmAdera pratipAlakera pakSa theke zAsti o kreAdha| AmAra sAthe aisava nAma samparke kena tarka karacha, yeguleA teAmarA o teAmAdera vApa-dAdArA rekheche| AllAha edera keAna manda avartINa karenani| ataeva apekSA kara| Amio teAmAdera sAthe apekSA karachi|
anantara Ami tAke o tAra saGgIderake svIYa anugrahe rakSA karalAma evaM yArA AmAra AYAtasamUhe mithyAreApa karata tAdera mUla keTe dilAma| tArA mAnyakArI chila nA|

sAmuda sampradAYera kAche preraNa karechi tAdera bhAi sAlehake| se valalaH he AmAra sampradAYa, teAmarA AllAhara evAdata kara| tini vyatita teAmAdera keAna upAsya nei| teAmAdera kAche teAmAdera pratipAlakera pakSa theke ekaTi pramANa ese geche| eTi AllAhara uSTI teAmAdera janye pramANa| ataeva eke cher3e dAo, AllAhara bhumite car3e ver3Ave| eke asatbhAve sparza karave nA| anyathAYa teAmAderake yantranAdAYaka zAsti pAkar3Ao karave|

teAmarA smaraNa kara, yakhana teAmAderake Ada jAtira pare sardAra karechena; teAmAderake pRthivIte ThikAnA diYechena| teAmarA narama mATite aTTAlikA nirmAna kara evaM parvata gAtra khanana kare prakeASTha nirmANa kara| ataeva AllAhara anugraha smaraNa kara evaM pRthivIte anartha sRSTi kareA nA|

tAra sampradAYera dAmbhika sardArarA ImAnadAra dAridraderake jijJesa karalaH teAmarA ki vizvAsa kara ye sAleha ke tAra pAlanakartA preraNa karechena; tArA valala AmarA teA tAra AnIta viSaYera prati vizvAsI|
dAmbhikarA valalaH teAmarA ye viSaYe vizvAsa sthApana karecha, AmarA tAte asvIkRta|
ataHpara tArA uSTrIke hatyA karala evaM svIYa pratipAlakera Adeza amAnya karala| tArA valalaH he chAleha, niYe esa yaddvArA AmAderake bhaYa dekhAte, yadi tumi rasUla haYe thAka|
ataHpara pAkar3Ao karala tAderake bhUmikampa| phale sakAla velAYa nija nija gRhe upur3a haYe par3e raila|

chAleha tAdera kAcha theke prasthAna karaleA evaM valalaH he AmAra sampradAYa, Ami teAmAdera kAche svIYa pratipAlakera paYagAma peৗchiYechi evaM teAmAdera maGgala kAmanA karechi kintu teAmarA maGgalakAGkhIderake bhAlavAsa nA|
evaM Ami lUtake preraNa karechi| yakhana se svIYa sampradAYake valalaH teAmarA ki emana azlIla kAja karacha, yA teAmAdera pUrve sArA vizvera keu kareni?
teAmarA teA kAmavazataH puruSadera kAche gamana kara nArIderake cher3e| varaM teAmarA sImA atikrama karecha|
tA~ra sampradAYa e chAr3A keAna uttara dila nA ye, vera kare dAo ederake zahara theke| erA khuva sAdhu thAkate cAYa|
ataHpara Ami tAke o tA~ra parivAra parijanake vA~ciYe dilAma, kintu tAra strI| se tAdera madhyei raYe gela, yArA raYe giYechila|
Ami tAdera upara prastara vRSTi varSaNa karalAma| ataeva, dekha geAnAhagAradera pariNati kemana haYeche|

Ami mAdaiYAnera prati tAdera bhAi zeAYAYevake preraNa karechi| se valalaH he AmAra sampradAYa! teAmarA AllAhara evAdata kara| tini vyatIta teAmAdera keAna upAsya nei| teAmAdera kAche teAmAdera pratipAlakera pakSa theke pramANa ese geche| ataeva teAmarA mApa o ojana pUrna kara evaM mAnuSake tAdera dravyadi kama diYeA nA evaM bhupRSTera saMskAra sAdhana karAra para tAte anartha sRSTi kareA nA| ei hala teAmAdera janye kalyANakara, yadi teAmarA vizvAsI hao|

teAmarA pathe ghATe e kAraNe vase thekeA nA ye, AllAha vizvAsIderake humaki dive, AllAhara pathe vAdhA sRSTi karave evaM tAte vakratA anusandhAna karave| smaraNa kara, yakhana teAmarA saMkhyAYa alpa chile ataHpara AllAha teAmAderake adhika karechena evaM lakSya kara kirUpa azubha pariNati haYeche anarthakArIdera|

Ara yadi teAmAdera ekadala ai viSaYera prati vizvAsa sthApana kare yA niYe Ami prerita haYechi evaM ekadala vizvAsa sthApana kare yA niYe Ami prerita haYechi evaM ekadala vizvAsa sthApana nA kare, tave chavara kara ye paryanta AllAha AmAdera madhye mImAMsA nA kare dena| tinii zreSTa mImAMsAkArI|

tAra sampradAYera dAmbhika sardArarA valalaH he zeAYAYeva, AmarA avazyai teAmAke evaM teAmAra sAthe vizvAsa sthApanakArIderake zahara theke vera kare deva athavA teAmarA AmAdera dharme pratyAvartana karave| zeAYAYeva valalaH AmarA apachanda karaleo ki?

AmarA AllAhara prati mithyA apavAdakArI haYe yAva yadi AmarA teAmAdera dharme pratyAvartana kari, athaca tini AmAderake e theke mukti diYechena| AmAdera kAja naYa e dharme pratyAvartana karA, kintu AmAdera prati pAlaka AllAha yadi cAna| AmAdera pratipAlaka pratyeka vastuke svIYa jJAna dvArA veSTana kare Achena| AllAhara pratii AmarA bharasA karechi| he AmAdera pratipAlaka AmAdera o AmAdera sampradAYera madhye phaYasAlA kare chila yathArtha phaYasAlA| Apanii zreSTatama phasalA phaYasAlAkArI|
tAra sampradAYera kAphera sardArarA valalaH yadi teAmarA zeAYAYevera anusaraNa kara, tave nizcitai kSatigrasta have|
anantara pAkar3Ao karala tAderake bhUmikampa| phale tArA sakAla velAYa gRha madhye upur3a haYe par3e raila|
zeAYAYevera prati mithyAreApakArIrA yena keAna dina sekhAne vasavAsai kareni| yArA zeAYAYevera prati mithyAreApa karechila, tArAi kSatigrastha hala|

anantara se tAdera kAcha theke prasthAna karala evaM valalaH he AmAra sampradAYa, Ami teAmAderake pratipAlakera paYagAma peৗche diYechi evaM teAmAdera hita kAmanA karechi| ekhana Ami kApheradera janye kena duHkha karava|
Ara Ami keAna janapade keAna navI pAThAini, tave (ematAvasthAYa) ye pAkar3Ao karechi se janapadera adhivAsIdigake kaSTa o kaTheAratAra madhye, yAte tArA zithila haYe par3e|

ataHpara akalyANera sthale tA kalyANe vadale diYeche| emanaki tArA aneka ver3e giYechi evaM valate zuru kareche, AmAdera vApa-dAdAdera uparao emana Ananda-vedanA eseche| ataHpara Ami tAderake pAkar3Ao karechi emana AkasmikabhAve ye tArA Terao pAYani|

Ara yadi se janapadera adhivAsIrA ImAna Anata evaM paraheyagArI avalamvana karata, tave Ami tAdera prati AsamAnI o pArthiva neYAmata samUha ummukta kare ditAma| kintu tArA mithyA pratipanna kareche| sutarAM Ami tAderake pAkar3Ao karechi tAdera kRtakarmera vadalAte|
ekhanao ki ei janapadera adhivAsIrA e vyApAre nizcinta ye, AmAra AyAva tAdera upara rAtera velAYa ese par3ave athaca takhana tArA thAkave ghume acetana|
Ara ei janapadera adhivAsIrA ki nizcinta haYe par3eche ye, tAdera upara AmAra AyAva dinera velAte ese par3ave athaca tArA takhana thAkave khelA-dhulAYa matta|
tArA ki AllAhara pAkar3AoYera vyApAre nizcinta haYe geche? vastutaH AllAhara pAkar3Ao theke tArAi nizcinta hate pAre, yAdera dhvaMsa ghaniYe Ase|

tAdera nikaTa ki ekathA prakAzita haYani, yArA uttArAdhikAra lAbha kareche| sekhAnakAra leAkadera dhvaMsaprApta havAra para yadi Ami icchA karatAma, tave tAderake tAdera pApera daruna pAkar3Ao kare phelatAma| vastutaH Ami meAhara e~Te diYechi tAdera antarasamUhera upara| kAjei erA zunate pAYa nA|

eguleA hala se sava janapada yAra kichu vivaraNa Ami ApanAke avahita karachi| Ara nizcitai odera kAche peৗchechilena rasUla nidarzana sahakAre| ataHpara kasminakAlao erA ImAna AnavAra chila nA, tArapare yA tAra itipUrve mithyA vale pratipanna kareche| ebhAvei AllAha kApheradera antare meAhara e~Te dena|
Ara tAdera adhikAMza leAkakei Ami pratijJA vAstavAYanakArIrUpe pAini; varaM tAdera adhikAMzake peYechi hukuma amAnyakArI|

ataHpara Ami tAdera pare mUsAke pAThiYechi nidarzanAvalI diYe pherAuna o tAra sabhAsadadera nikaTa| vastutaH orA tA~ra meAkAvelAYa kupharI kareche| sutarAM ceYe dekha, ki pariNati haYeche anAcArIdera|
Ara mUsA valalena, he pherAuna, Ami vizva-pAlanakartAra pakSa theke Agata rasUla|

AllAhara pakSa theke ye satya eseche, tAra vyatikrama kichu nA valAra vyApAre Ami sudRr3ha| Ami teAmAdera paraoYAradegArera nidarzana niYe esechi| sutarAM tumi vanI isarAIladerake AmAra sAthe pAThiYe dAo|
se valala, yadi tumi keAna nidarzana niYe ese thAka, tAhale tA upasthita kara yadi tumi satyavAdI haYe thAka|
takhana tini nikSepa karalena nijera lAThikhAnA evaM tAtkSaNAt tA jalajyAnta eka ajagare rUpAntarita haYe gela|
Ara vera karalena nijera hAta evaM tA saGge saGge darzakadera ceAkhe dhavadhave ujjvala dekhAte lAgala|
pherAunera sAGga-pAGgarA valate lAgala, nizcaYa leAkaTi vijJa-yAdukara|
se teAmAdigake teAmAdera deza theke vera kare dite cAYa| e vyApAre teAmAdera ki mata?
tArA valala, Apani tAke o tAra bhAike avakAza dAna karuna evaM zahare vandare leAka pAThiYe dina leAkadera samaveta karAra janya|
yAte tArA parAkASThAsampanna vijJa yAdukaradera ene samaveta kare|
vastutaH yAdukararA ese pherAunera kAche upasthita hala| tArA valala, AmAdera janye ki keAna pArizramika nirdhArita Ache, yadi AmarA jaYalAbha kari?
se valala, hyA~ evaM avazyai teAmarA AmAra nikaTavartI leAka haYe yAve|
tArA valala, he mUsA! haYa tumi nikSepa kara athavA AmarA nikSepa karachi|
tini valalena, teAmarAi nikSepa kara| yakhana tArA nikSepa karala takhana leAkadera ceAkhaguleAke vAdhiYe dila, bhIta-santrasta kare tulala evaM mahAyAdu pradarzana karala|
tArapara Ami ohIyeAge mUsAke valalAma, evAra nikSepa kara teAmAra lAThikhAnA| ataeva saGge saGge tA se samudaYake gilate lAgala, yA tArA vAniYechila yAdu vale|
sutarAM ebhAve prakAza haYe gela satya viSaYa evaM bhula pratipanna haYe gela yA kichu tArA karechila|
sutarAM tArA sekhAnei parAjita haYe gela evaM atIva lAJchita hala|
evaM yAdukararA sejadAYa par3e gela|
valala, AmarA ImAna Anachi mahA vizvera paraoYAradegArera prati|
yini mUsA o hArunera paraoYAradegAra|

pherAuna valala, teAmarA ki (tAhale) AmAra anumati deYAra Agei ImAna Anale! eTA pratAraNA, yA teAmarA e nagarIte pradarzana karale| yAte kare e zaharera adhivAsIdigake zahara theke vera kare dite pAra| sutarAM teAmarA zIghrai vujhate pArave|
avazyai Ami keTe deva teAmAdera hAta o pA viparIta dika theke| tArapara teAmAdera savAike zUlIte car3iYe mArava|
tArA valala, AmAderake teA mRtyura para nijedera paraoYAradegArera nikaTa phire yetei have|

vastutaH AmAdera sAthe teAmAra zatrutA teA e kAraNei ye, AmarA ImAna enechi AmAdera paraoYAradegArera nidarzanasamUhera prati yakhana tA AmAdera nikaTa pau~cheche| he AmAdera paraoYAradegAra AmAdera janya dhairyyera dvAra khule dAo evaM AmAderake musalamAna hisAve mRtyu dAna kara|

pherAunera sampradAYera rsadArarA valala, tumi ki emani cher3e deve mUsA o tAra sampradAYake| dezamaYa hai-cai karAra janya evaM teAmAke o teAmAra deva-devIke vAtila kare devAra janya| se valala, Ami ekhani hatyA karava tAdera putra santAnadigake; Ara jIvita rAkhava meYederake| vastutaH AmarA tAdera upara pravala|

mUsA valalena tAra kaomake, sAhAyya prArthanA kara AllAhara nikaTa evaM dhairyya dhAraNa kara| nizcaYai e pRthivI AllAhara| tini nijera vAndAdera madhye yAke icchA era uttarAdhikArI vAniYe dena evaM zeSa kalyANa muttAkIdera janyai nirdhArita raYeche|

tArA valala, AmAdera kaSTa chila teAmAra AsAra pUrve evaM teAmAra AsAra pare| tini valalena, teAmAdera paraoYAradegAra zIghrai teAmAdera zakradera dhvaMsa kare devena evaM teAmAderake deze pratinidhitva dAna karavena| tArapara dekhavena, teAmarA kemana kAja kara|
tArapara Ami pAkar3Ao karechi-pherAunera anusArIderake durbhikSera mAdhyame evaM phala phasalera kSaYa-kSatira mAdhyame yAte kare tArA upadeza grahaNa kare|

ataHpara yakhana zubhadina phire Ase, takhana tArA valate Arambha kare ye, eTAi AmAdera janya upayeAgI| Ara yadi akalyANa ese upasthita haYa tave tAte mUsAra evaM tA~ra saGgIdera alakSaNa vale abhihita kare| zune rAkha tAdera alakSaNa ye, AllAharai eleme raYeche, athaca erA jAne nA|
tArA Arao valate lAgala, AmAdera upara jAdu karAra janya tumi ye nidarzanai niYe Asa nA kena AmarA kintu teAmAra upara ImAna Anachi nA|
sutarAM Ami tAdera upara pAThiYe dilAma tuphAna, paGgapAla, ukuna, vyAGa o rakta prabhRti vahuvidha nidarzana ekera para eka| tArapareo tArA garva karate thAkala| vastutaH tArA chila aparAdhapravaNa|

Ara tAdera upara yakhana keAna AyAva par3e takhana vale, he mUsA AmAdera janya teAmAra paraoYAradegArera nikaTa se viSaYe deAYA kara yA tini teAmAra sAthe oYAdA kare rekhechena| yadi tumi AmAdera upara theke e AyAva sariYe dAo, tave avazyai AmarA ImAna Anava teAmAra upara evaM teAmAra sAthe vanI-isarAIladerake yete deva|
ataHpara yakhana Ami tAdera upara theke AyAva tule nitAma nirdhArita ekaTi samaYa paryanta-yekhAna paryanta tAderake peৗchAneAra uddezya chila, takhana tar3ighar3i tArA pratizruti bhaGga karata|
sutarAM Ami tAdera kAche theke vadalA niYe nilAma-vastutaH tAderake sAgare DuviYe dilAma| kAraNa, tArA mithyA pratipanna karechila AmAra nidarzanasamUhake evaM tatprati anIhA pradarzana karechila|

Ara yAderake durvala mane karA hata tAderakeo Ami uttarAdhikAra dAna karechi e bhukhanDera pUrva o pazcima aJcalera yAte Ami varakata sannihita rekhechi evaM paripUrNa haYe geche teAmAra pAlanakartAra pratizruta kalyANa vanI-isarAIladera janya tAdera dhairyyadhAraNera daruna| Ara dhvaMsa kare diYeche se savakichu yA tairI karechila pherAuna o tAra sampradAYa evaM dhvaMsa karechi yA kichu tArA suucca nirmANa karechila|

vastutaH Ami sAgara pAra kare diYechi vanI-isarAIladigake| takhana tArA emana eka sampradAYera kAche giYe peৗchAla, yArA svahastanirmita mUrtipujAYa niYeAjita chila| tArA valate lAgala, he mUsA; AmAdera upAsanAra janyao tAdera mUrtira matai ekaTi mUrti nirmANa kare dina| tini valalena, teAmAdera madhye var3ai ajJatA raYeche|
erA ye, kAje niYeAjita raYeche tA dhvaMsa have evaM yA kichu tArA kareche tA ye bhula!
tini valalena, tAhale ki AllAhake chAr3A teAmAdera janya anya keAna upAsya anusandhAna karava, athaca tinii teAmAdigake sArA vizve zreSThatva dAna karechena|

Ara se samaYera kathA smaraNa kara, yakhana Ami teAmAderake pherAunera leAkadera kavala theke mukti diYechi; tArA teAmAderake dita nikRSTa zAsti, teAmAdera putra-santAnadera mere phelata evaM meYedera vA~ciYe rAkhata| ete teAmAdera prati teAmAdera paraoYAradegArera virATa parIkSA raYeche|

Ara Ami mUsAke pratizruti diYechi triza rAtrira evaM seguleAke pUrna karechi AreA daza dvArA| vastutaH ebhAve calliza rAtera meYAda pUrNa haYe geche| Ara mUsA tA~ra bhAi hArunake valalena, AmAra sampradAYe tumi AmAra pratinidhi hisAve thAka| tAdera saMzeAdhana karate thAka evaM hAGgAmA sRSTikArIdera pathe caleA nA|

tArapara mUsA yakhana AmAra pratizruta samaYa anuyAYI ese hAyira halena evaM tA~ra sAthe tAra paraoYAradegAra kathA valalena, takhana tini valalena, he AmAra prabhu, teAmAra dIdAra AmAke dAo, yena Ami teAmAke dekhate pAi| tini valalena, tumi AmAke kasminakAleo dekhate pAve nA, tave tumi pAhAr3era dike dekhate thAka, seTi yadi svasthAne da~r3iYe thAke tave tumio AmAke dekhate pAve| tArapara yakhana tAra paraoYAradagAra pAhAr3era upara Apana jyeAtira vikiraNa ghaTAlena, seTike vidhvasta kare dilena evaM mUsA ajJAna haYe par3e gelena| ataHpara yakhana tA~ra jJAna phire ela; valalena, he prabhu! teAmAra sattA pavitra, teAmAra daravAre Ami taovA karachi evaM Amii sarvaprathama vizvAsa sthApana karachi|

(paraoYAradegAra) valalena, he mUsA, Ami teAmAke AmAra vArtA pAThAneAra evaM kathA valAra mAdhyame leAkadera upara viziSTatA dAna karechi| sutarAM yA kichu Ami teAmAke dAna karalAma, grahaNa kara evaM kRtajJa thAka|

Ara Ami teAmAke paTe likhe diYechi sarvaprakAra upadeza o vistArita sava viSaYa| ataeva, eguleAke dRr3habhAve dhAraNa kara evaM svajAtike era kalyANakara viSaYasamUha dRr3hatAra sAthe pAlanera nirdeza dAo|zIghrai Ami tomAdera dekhAva kAphiradera vAsasthAna|

Ami AmAra nidarzanasamUha hate tAderake phiriYe rAkhi, yArA pRthivIte anyAYabhAve garva kare| yadi tArA samasta nidarzana pratyakSa kare phele, tavuo tA vizvAsa karave nA| Ara yadi hedAYetera patha dekhe, tave se patha grahaNa kare nA| athaca geAmarAhIra patha dekhale tAi grahaNa kare neYa| era kAraNa, tArA AmAra nidarzanasamUhake mithyA vale mane kareche evaM tA theke vekhavara raYe geche|
vastutaH yArA mithyA jeneche AmAra AYAtasamUke evaM AkherAtera sAkSAtake, tAdera yAvatIYa kAjakarma dhvaMsa haYe geche| temana vadalAi se pAve yemana Amala karata|

Ara vAniYe nila mUsAra sampradAYa tAra anupasthitite nijedera alaMkArAdira dvArA ekaTi vAchura tA theke verucchila ‘hAmvA hAmvA’ zavda| tArA ki ekathAo lakSya karala nA ye, seTi tAdera sAthe kathAo valache nA evaM tAderake keAna pathao vAtale dicche nA! tArA seTike upAsya vAniYe nila| vastutaH tArA chila jAlema|

ataHpara yakhana tArA anutapta hala evaM vujhate pArala ye, AmarA nizcitai geAmarAha haYe par3echi, takhana valate lAgala, AmAdera prati yadi AmAdera paraoYAradegAra karuNA nA karena, tave avazyai AmarA dhvaMsa haYe yAva|

tArapara yakhana mUsA nija sampradAYe phire elena rAgAmvita o anutapta avasthAYa, takhana valalena, AmAra anupasthitite teAmarA AmAra ki nikRSTa pratinidhitvaTAi nA karecha| teAmarA nija paraoYAradegArera hukuma theke ki tAr3Ahur3A kare phelale evaM se takhatIguleA chu~r3e phele dilena evaM nijera bhAiYera mAthAra cula cepe dhare nijera dike TAnate lAgalena| bhAi valalena, he AmAra mAYera putra, leAkaguleA ye AmAke durvala mane karala evaM AmAke ye mere phelAra upakrama karechila| sutarAM AmAra upara Ara zatrudera hAsio nA| Ara AmAke jAlimadera sArite ganya kareA nA|
mUsA valalena, he AmAra paraoYAradegAra, kSamA kara AmAke Ara AmAra bhAike evaM AmAderake teAmAra rahamatera antarbhukta kara| tumi ye sarvAdhika karuNAmaYa|
avazya yArA geAvatsake upAsya vAniYe niYeche, tAdera upara tAdera paraoYAradegArera pakSa theke pArthiva e jIvanei gayava o lAJjanA ese par3ave| emani Ami apavAda AreApakArIderake zAsti diYe thAki|
Ara yArA manda kAja kare, tArapare taovA kare neYa evaM ImAna niYe Ase, tave nizcaYai teAmAra paraoYAradegAra taovAra para avazya kSamAkArI, karuNAmaYa|

tArapara yakhana mUsAra rAga par3e gela, takhana tini takhatIguleA tule nilena| Ara yA kichu tAte lekhA chila, tA chila se samasta leAkera janya hedAYeta o rahamata yArA nijedera paraoYAradegArake bhaYa kare|

Ara mUsA veche nilena nijera sampradAYa theke sattara jana leAka AmAra pratizruta samaYera janya| tArapara yakhana tAderake bhUmikampa pAkar3Ao karala, takhana valalena, he AmAra paraoYAradegAra, tumi yadi icchA karate, tave tAderake Agei dhvaMsa kare dite evaM AmAkeo| AmAderake ki se karmera kAraNe dhvaMsa karacha, yA AmAra sampradAYera nirveAdha leAkerA kareche? esavai teAmAra parIkSA; tumi yAke icchA ete patha bhraSTa karave evaM yAke icchA saralapathe rAkhave| tumi ye AmAdera rakSaka-sutarAM AmAderake kSamA kare dAo evaM AmAdera upara karunA kara| tAchAr3A tumii teA sarvAdhika kSamAkArI|

Ara pRthivIte evaM AkherAte AmAdera janya kalyANa likhe dAo| AmarA teAmAra dike pratyAvartana karachi| AllAha tA’AlA valalena, AmAra AyAva tArai upara parivyApta| sutarAM tA tAdera janya likhe deva yArA bhaYa rAkhe, yAkAta dAna kare evaM yArA AmAra AYatasamuhera upara vizvAsa sthApana kare|

sesamasta leAka, yArA Anugatya avalamvana kare e rasUlera, yini ummI navI, yA~ra samparke tArA nijedera kAche rakSita taorAta o iJjile lekhA dekhate pAYa, tini tAderake nirdeza dena satkarmera, vAraNa karena asatkarma theke; tAdera janya yAvatIYa pavitra vastu hAlAla gheASanA karena o niSiddha karena hArAma vastusamUha evaM tAdera upara theke se veAjhA nAmiYe dena evaM vandItva apasAraNa karena yA tAdera upara vidyamAna chila| sutarAM yesava leAka tA~ra upara ImAna eneche, tA~ra sAhacarya avalamvana kareche, tA~ke sAhAyya kareche evaM se nUrera anusaraNa kareche yA tAra sAthe avatIrNa karA haYeche, zudhumAtra tArAi nijedera uddezya saphalatA arjana karate pereche|

vale dAo, he mAnava manDalI| teAmAdera savAra prati Ami AllAha prerita rasUla, samagra AsamAna o yamIne tAra rAjatva| ekamAtra tA~ke chAr3A Ara kAreA upAsanA naYa| tini jIvana o mRtyu dAna karena| sutarAM teAmarA savAi vizvAsa sthApana kareA AllAhara upara tA~ra prerita ummI navIra upara, yini vizvAsa rAkhena AllAhara evaM tA~ra samasta kAlAmera upara| tA~ra anusaraNa kara yAte sarala pathaprApta hate pAra|
vastutaH mUsAra sampradAYe ekaTi dala raYeche yArA satyapatha nirdeza kare evaM se matei vicAra kare thAke|

Ara Ami pRthaka pRthaka kare diYechi tAdera vAra jana pitAmahera santAnaderake virATa virATa dale, evaM nirdeza diYechi musAke, yakhana tAra kAche tAra sampradAYa pAni cAila ye, svIYa yaSTira dvArA AghAta kara e pAtharera upara| ataHpara era bhetara theke phuTe vera hala vAraTi prasravaNa| pratiTi geAtra cine nila nija nija ghA~Ti| Ara Ami chAYA dAna karalAma tAdera upara meghera evaM tAdera janya avatIrna karalAma mAnnA o sAlaoYA| ye paricchanna vastuta jIvikArUpe Ami teAmAdera diYechi, tA theke teAmarA bhakSaNa kara| vastutaH tArA AmAra keAna kSati kareni, varaM kSati kareche nijederai|

Ara yakhana tAdera prati nirdeza hala ye, teAmarA e nagarIte vasavAsa kara evaM khAo tA theke yekhAna theke icchA evaM vala, AmAdera kSamA karuna| Ara darajA diYe praveza kara praNata avasthAYa| tave Ami kSamA kare deva teAmAdera pApasamuha| avazya Ami satkarmIdigake atirikta dAna karava|
anantara jAlemarA ete anya zavda vadale dila tAra parivarte, yA tAderake valA haYechila| sutarAM Ami tAdera upara AyAva pAThiYechi AsamAna theke tAdera apakarmera kAraNe|

Ara tAdera kAche se janapadera avasthA samparke jijJesa kara yA chila nadIra tIre avasthita| yakhana zanivAra dinera nirdezera vyApAre sImAtikrama karate lAgala, yakhana Asate lAgala mAchaguleA tAdera kAche zanivAra dina pAnira upara, Ara yedina zanivAra hata nA, Asata nA| ebhAve Ami tAderake parIkSA karechi| kAraNa, tArA chila nApharamAna|

Ara yakhana tAdera madhye theke eka sampradAYa valala, kena se leAkadera sadupadeza dicchena, yAderake AllAha dhvaMsa kare dite cAna kiMvA AyAva dite cAna kaThina AyAva? se valalaH teAmAdera pAlanakartAra sAmane deASa phurAvAra janya evaM ejanya yena tArA bhIta haYa|

ataHpara yakhana tArA sesava viSaYa bhule gela, yA tAderake veAjhAneA haYechila, takhana Ami sesava leAkake mukti dAna karalAma yArA manda kAja theke vAraNa karata| Ara pAkar3Ao karalAma, geAnAhagAraderake nikRSTa AyAvera mAdhyame tAdera nA-pharamAnIra daruna|
tArapara yakhana tArA egiYe yete lAgala se karme yA theke tAdera vAraNa karA haYechila, takhana Ami nirdeza dilAma ye, teAmarA lAJchita vAnara haYe yAo|

Ara se samaYera kathA smaraNa kara, yakhana teAmAra pAlanakartA saMvAda diYechena ye, avazyai keYAmata divasa paryanta ihudIdera upara emana leAka pAThAte thAkavena yArA tAderake nikRSTa zAsti dAna karate thAkave| niHsandehe teAmAra pAlanakartA zIghra zAsti dAnakArI evaM tini kSamAzIla, daYAlu|

Ara Ami tAderake vibhakta kare diYechi dezamaYa vibhinna zrenIte, tAdera madhye kichu raYeche bhAla Ara kichu raYeche anya rakama! tAchAr3A Ami tAderake parIkSA karechi bhAla o mandera mAdhyame yAte tArA phire Ase|

tArapara tAdera pechane eseche kichu apadArtha, yArA uttarAdhikArI haYeche kitAvera; tArA nikRSTa pArthiva upakaraNa AharaNa karache evaM valache, AmAdera kSamA kare deYA have| vastutaH emani dharanera upakaraNa yadi AvAreA tAdera sAmane upasthita haYa, tave tAo tule neve| tAdera kAchatheke kitAve ki aGgIkAra neYA haYani ye, AllAhara prati satya chAr3A kichu valave nA? athaca tArA se savai pATha kareche, yA tAte lekhA raYeche| vastutaH AkherAtera AlaYa bhItadera janya uttama-teAmarA ki tA veAjha nA?
Ara yesava leAka sudRr3habhAve kitAvake A~kar3e thAke evaM nAmAya pratiSThA kare nizcaYai Ami vinaSTa karava nA satkarmIdera saoYAva|

Ara yakhana Ami tule dharalAma pAhAr3ake tAdera upare sAmiYAnAra mata evaM tArA bhaYa karate lAgala ye, seTi tAdera upara par3ave, takhana Ami valalAma, dhara, yA Ami teAmAdera diYechi, dRr3habhAve evaM smaraNa rekheA yA tAte raYeche, yena teAmarA vA~cate pAra|

Ara yakhana teAmAra pAlanakartA vanI Adamera pRSTadeza theke vera karalena tAdera santAnaderake evaM nijera upara tAderake pratijJA karAlena, Ami ki teAmAdera pAlanakartA nai? tArA valala, avazyai, AmarA aGgIkAra karachi| AvAra nA keYAmatera dina valate zuru kara ye, e viSaYaTi AmAdera jAnA chila nA|

athavA valate zuru kara ye, aMzIdAritvera prathA teA AmAdera vApa-dAdArA udbhAvana karechila AmAdera pUrvei| Ara AmarA halAma tAdera pazcAtvartI santAna-santati| tAhale ki se karmera janya AmAderake dhvaMsa karavena, yA pathabhraSTarA kareche?
vastutaH ebhAve Ami viSaYasamUha savistAre varNanA kari, yAte tArA phire Ase|

Ara Apani tAderake zuniYe dina, se leAkera avasthA, yAke Ami nijera nidarzanasamUha dAna karechilAma, athaca se tA parihAra kare veriYe geche| Ara tAra pechane legeche zaYatAna, phale se pathabhraSTadera antarbhUkta haYe par3eche|

avazya Ami icchA karale tAra maryAdA vAr3iYe ditAma se sakala nidarzanasamUhera deৗlate| kintu se ye adhaHpatita evaM nijera ripura anugAmI haYe raila| sutarAM tAra avasthA hala kukurera mata; yadi tAke tAr3A kara tavuo hA~pAve Ara yadi cher3e dAo tavuo hA~pAve| e hala sesava leAkera udAharaNa; yArA mithyA pratipanna kareche AmAra nidarzanasamUhake| ataeva, Apani vivRta karuna esava kAhinI, yAte tArA cintA kare|
tAdera udAharaNa ati nikRSTa, yArA mithyA pratipanna kareche AmAra AYAta samUhake evaM tArA nijederai kSati sAdhana kareche|
yAke AllAha patha dekhAvena, sei pathaprApta have| Ara yAke tini patha bhraSTa karavena, se have kSatigrasta|

Ara Ami sRSTi karechi deAyakhera janya vahu jvina o mAnuSa| tAdera antara raYeche, tAra dvArA vivecanA kare nA, tAdera ceAkha raYeche, tAra dvArA dekhe nA, Ara tAdera kAna raYeche, tAra dvArA zeAne nA| tArA catuSpada jantura mata; varaM tAdera ceYeo nikRSTatara| tArAi hala gAphela, zaithilyaparAYaNa|
Ara AllAhara janya raYeche sava uttama nAma| kAjei se nAma dharei tA~ke DAka| Ara tAderake varjana kara, yArA tA~ra nAmera vyApAre vA~kA pathe cale| tArA nijedera kRtakarmera phala zIghrai pAve|
Ara yAderake Ami sRSTi karechi, tAdera madhye emana eka dala raYeche yArA satya patha dekhAYa evaM se anuyAYI nyAYavicAra kare|
vastutaH yArA mithyA pratipanna kareche AmAra AYAtasamUhake, Ami tAderake kramAnvaYe pAkar3Ao karava emana jAYagA theke, yAra samparke tAdera dhAraNAo have nA|
vastutaH Ami tAderake Dhila diYe thAki| niHsandehe AmAra keৗzala sunipuNa|
tArA ki lakSya kareni ye, tAdera saGgI leAkaTira mastiSke keAna vikRti nei? tini teA bhIti pradarzanakArI prakRSTabhAve|

tArA ki pratyakSa kareni AkAza o pRthivIra rAjya samparke evaM yA kichu sRSTi karechena AllAha tA’AlA vastu sAmagrI theke evaM e vyApAre ye, tAdera sAthe kRta oYAdAra samaYa nikaTavartI haYe eseche? vastutaH erapara kisera upara ImAna Anave?
AllAha yAke pathabhraSTa karena| tAra keAna pathapradarzaka nei| Ara AllAha tAderake tAdera duSTAmIte matta avastAYa cher3e diYe rAkhena|

ApanAke jijJesa kare, keYAmata kakhana anuSThita have? vale dina era khavara teA AmAra pAlanakartAra kAchei raYeche| tinii tA anAvRta kare dekhAvena nirdhArita samaYe| AsamAna o yamInera janya seTi ati kaThina viSaYa| yakhana tA teAmAdera upara Asave ajAntei ese yAve| ApanAke jijJesa karate thAke, yena Apani tAra anusandhAne lege Achena| vale dina, era saMvAda vizeSa kare AllAhara nikaTai raYeche| kintu tA adhikAMza leAkai upalavdhi kare nA|

Apani vale dina, Ami AmAra nijera kalyANa sAdhanera evaM akalyANa sAdhanera mAlika nai, kintu yA AllAha cAna| Ara Ami yadi gAYavera kathA jene nite pAratAma, tAhale vahu maGgala arjana kare nite pAratAma, phale AmAra keAna amaGgala kakhanao hate pArata nA| Ami teA zudhumAtra ekajana bhIti pradarzaka o susaMvAdadAtA ImAnadAradera janya|

tinii se sattA yini teAmAdigake sRSTi karechena ekaTi mAtra sattA theke; Ara tAra thekei tairI karechena tAra jeAr3A, yAte tAra kAche svasti pete pAre| ataHpara puruSa yakhana nArIke AvRta karala, takhana, se garbhavatI hala| ati hAlakA garbha| se tAi niYe calApherA karate thAkala| tArapara yakhana veAjhA haYe gela, takhana ubhaYei AllAhake DAkala yini tAdera pAlanakartA ye, tumi yadi AmAdigake sustha o bhAla dAna kara tave AmarA teAmAra zukariYA AdAYa karava|
ataHpara tAderake yakhana sustha o bhAla dAna karA hala, takhana dAnakRta viSaYe tAra aMzIdAra tairI karate lAgala| vastutaH AllAha tAdera zarIka sAvyasta karA theke vahu urdhe|
tArA ki emana kAuke zarIka sAvyasta kare, ye ekaTi vastuo sRSTi kareni, varaM tAderake sRSTi karA haYeche|
Ara tArA, nA tAdera sAhAyya karate pAre, nA nijera sAhAyya karate pAre|
Ara teAmarA yadi tAderake AhavAna kara supathera dike, tave tArA teAmAdera AhavAna anuyAYI calave nA| tAderake AhavAna jAnAneA kiMvA nIrava thAkA ubhaYaTii teAmAdera janya samAna|

AllAhake vAda diYe teAmarA yAderake DAka, tArA savAi teAmAdera matai vAndA| ataeva, teAmarA yAderake DAka, takhana tAdera pakSeo teA teAmAdera se DAka kavula karA ucita yadi teAmarA satyavAdI haYe thAka?

tAdera ki pA Ache, yadvArA tArA calApherA kare, kiMvA tAdera ki hAta Ache, yadvArA tArA dhare| athavA tAdera ki ceAkha Ache yadvArA tArA dekhate pAYa kiMvA tAdera ki kAna Ache yadvArA zunate pAYa? vale dAo, teAmarA DAka teAmAdera aMzIdAradigake, ataHpara AmAra amaGgala kara evaM AmAke avakAza dio nA|
AmAra sahAYa teA halena AllAha, yini kitAva avatIrNa karechena| vastuta; tinii sAhAyya karena satkarmazIla vAndAdera|
Ara teAmarA tA~ke vAda diYe yAderake DAka tArA nA teAmAdera keAna sAhAyya karate pArave, nA nijedera AtnarakSA karate pArave|
Ara tumi yadi tAderake supathe AhavAna kara, tave tArA tA kichui zunave nA| Ara tumi teA tAdera dekhachai, teAmAra dike tAkiYe Ache, athaca tArA kichui dekhate pAcche nA|
Ara kSamA karAra abhyAsa gar3e teAla, satkAjera nirdeza dAo evaM mUrkha jAheladera theke dUre sare thAka|
Ara yadi zaYatAnera prareAcanA teAmAke prareAcita kare, tAhale AllAhara zaraNApanna hao tinii zravaNakArI, mahAjJAnI|
yAdera mane bhaYa raYeche, tAdera upara zaYatAnera Agamana ghaTAra sAthe sAthei tArA satarka haYe yAYa evaM takhanai tAdera vivecanAzakti jAgrata haYe uThe|
pakSAntare yArA zaYatAnera bhAi, tAderake se kramAgata pathabhraSTa tAra dike niYe yAYa ataHpara tAte keAna kamati kare nA|

Ara yakhana Apani tAdera nikaTa keAna nidarzana niYe nA yAna, takhana tArA vale, Apani nijera pakSa theke kena amukaTi niYe Asalena nA, takhana Apani vale dina, Ami teA se matei cali ye hukuma AmAra nikaTa Ase AmAra paraoYAradegArera kAcha theke| eTA bhAvavAra viSaYa teAmAdera paraoYAradegArera pakSa theke evaM hedAYeta o rahamata sesava leAkera janya yArA ImAna eneche|
Ara yakhana keAraAna pATha karA haYa, takhana tAte kAna lAgiYe rAkha evaM nizcupa thAka yAte teAmAdera upara rahamata haYa|
Ara smaraNa karate thAka svIYa pAlanakartAke Apana mane krandanarata o bhIta-santrasta avasthAYa evaM emana svare yA citkAra kare valA apekSA kama; sakAle o sandhyAYa| Ara ve-khavara thekeA nA|
nizcaYai yArA teAmAra paraoYAradegArera sAnnidhye raYechena, tArA tA~ra vandegIra vyApAre ahaGkAra karena nA evaM smaraNa karena tA~ra pavitra sattAke; Ara tA~kei sejadA karena|

ApanAra kAche jijJesa kare, ganImatera hukuma| vale dina, gaNImatera mAla hala AllAhara evaM rasUlera| ataeva, teAmarA AllAhake bhaYa kara evaM nijedera avasthA saMzeAdhana kare nAo| Ara AllAha evaM tA~ra rasUlera hukuma mAnya kara, yadi ImAnadAra haYe thAka|

yArA ImAnadAra, tArA emana ye, yakhana AllAhara nAma neYA haYa takhana bhIta haYe par3e tAdera antara| Ara yakhana tAdera sAmane pATha karA haYa kAlAma, takhana tAdera ImAna ver3e yAYa evaM tArA svIYa paraoYAra degArera prati bharasA peASaNa kare|
se samasta leAka yArA nAmAya pratiSThA kare evaM Ami tAderake ye ruyI diYechi tA theke vyaYa kare|
tArAi hala satyikAra ImAnadAra! tAdera janya raYeche svIYa paraoYAradegArera nikaTa maryAdA, kSamA evaM sammAnajanaka ruyI|
yemana kare teAmAke teAmAra paraoYAradegAra ghara theke vera karechena nyAYa o satkAjera janya, athaca ImAnadAradera ekaTi dala (tAte) sammata chila nA|
tArA teAmAra sAthe vivAda karachila satya o nyAYa viSaYe, tA prakAzita havAra para; tArA yena mRtyura dike dhAvita hacche dekhate dekhate|

Ara yakhana AllAha du’Ti dalera ekaTira vyApAre teAmAdera sAthe oYAdA karechilena ye, seTi teAmAdera hastagata have, Ara teAmarA kAmanA karachile yAte keAna rakama kanTaka nei, tAi teAmAdera bhAge Asuka; athaca AllAha cAitena satyake svIYa kAlAmera mAdhyame satye pariNata karate evaM kApheradera mUla kartana kare dite,
yAte kare satyake satya evaM mithyAke mithyA pratipanna kare dena, yadio pApIrA asantuSTa haYa|

teAmarA yakhana phariYAda karate Arambha karechile svIYa paraoYAradegArera nikaTa, takhana tini teAmAdera phariYAdera maJjurI dAna karalena ye, Ami teAmAdigake sAhAyya karava dhArAvahikabhAve Agata hAjAra pherezatAra mAdhyame|

Ara AllAha teA zudhu susaMvAda dAna karalena yAte teAmAdera mana Azvasta hate pAre| Ara sAhAyya AllAhara pakSa theke chAr3A anya kAreA pakSa theke hate pAre nA| niHsandehe AllAha mahAzaktira adhikArI hekamata oYAlA|

yakhana tini AreApa karena teAmAdera upara tandrAcchanna tA nijera pakSa theke teAmAdera prazAntira janya evaM teAmAdera upara AkAza theke pAni avataraNa karena, yAte teAmAdigake pavitra kare dena evaM yAte teAmAdera theke apasArita kare dena zaYatAnera apavitratA| Ara yAte kare surakSita kare dite pArena teAmAdera antarasamUhake evaM tAte yena sudRr3ha kare dite pArena teAmAdera pA guleA|

yakhana nirdeza dAna karena pherezatAdigake teAmAdera paraoYAradegAra ye, Ami sAthe raYechi teAmAdera, sutarAM teAmarA musalamAnadera cittasamUhake dhIrasthira kare rAkha| Ami kApheradera mane bhItira saJcAra kare deva| kAjei gardAnera upara AghAta hAna evaM tAderake kATa jeAr3AYa jeAr3AYa|
yehetu tArA avAdhya haYeche AllAha evaM tA~ra rasUlera, sejanya ei nirdeza| vastutaH ye leAka AllAha o rasUlera avAdhya haYa, niHsandehe AllAhara zAsti atyanta kaTheAra|
ApAtataH vartamAna e zAsti teAmarA AsvAdana kare nAo evaM jene rAkha ye, kApheradera janya raYeche deAyakhera AyAva|
he ImAnadAragaNa, teAmarA yakhana kApheradera sAthe mukheAmukhI have, takhana pazcAdapasaraNa karave nA|

Ara ye leAka sedina tAdera theke pazcAdapasaraNa karave, avazya ye lar3AiYera keৗzala parivartanakalpe kiMvA ye nija sainyadera nikaTa AzraYa nite Ase se vyatIta anyarA AllAhara gayava sAthe niYe pratyAvartana karave| Ara tAra ThikAnA hala jAhAnnAma| vastutaH seTA hala nikRSTa avasthAna|

sutarAM teAmarA tAderake hatyA karani, varaM AllAhai tAderake hatyA karechena| Ara tumi mATira muSThi nikSepa karani, yakhana tA nikSepa karechile, varaM tA nikSepa karechilena AllAha svaYaM yena ImAnadAradera prati ehasAna karate pArena yathArthabhAve| niHsandehe AllAha zravaNakArI; parijJAta|
eTAteA gela, Ara jene rekheA, AllAha nasyAt kare devena kApheradera samasta kalA-keৗzala|

teAmarA yadi mImAMsA kAmanA kara, tAhale teAmAdera nikaTa mImAMsA peৗche geche| Ara yadi teAmarA pratyAvartana kara, tave tA teAmAdera janya uttama evaM teAmarA yadi tAi kara, tave Ami o temani karava| vastutaH teAmAdera keAnai kAje Asave nA teAmAdera dala-vala, tA yata vezIi heAka| jene rekha AllAha raYechena ImAnadAradera sAthe|
he ImAnadAragaNa, AllAha o tA~ra rasUlera nirdeza mAnya kara evaM zeAnAra para tA theke vimukha haYeA nA|
Ara tAdera antarbhukta haYeA nA, yArA vale ye, AmarA zunechi, athaca tArA zeAnenA|
niHsandehe AllAha tA’AlAra nikaTa samasta prANIra tulanAYa tArAi mUka o vadhira, yArA upaladdhi kare nA|
vastutaH AllAha yadi tAdera madhye kichumAtra zubha cintA jAnatena, tave tAderake zuniYe ditena| Ara ekhanai yadi tAdera zuniYe dena, tave tArA mukha ghuriYe pAliYe yAve|

he ImAnadAragaNa, AllAha o tA~ra rasUlera nirdeza mAnya kara, yakhana teAmAdera se kAjera prati AhavAna karA haYa, yAte raYeche teAmAdera jIvana| jene rekheA, AllAha mAnuSera evaM tAra antarera mAjhe antarAYa haYe yAna| vastutaH teAmarA savAi tA~rai nikaTa samaveta have|
Ara teAmarA emana phAsAda theke ve~ce thAka yA vizeSataH zudhu tAdera upara patita have nA yArA teAmAdera madhye jAlema evaM jene rekha ye, AllAhara AyAva atyanta kaTheAra|

Ara smaraNa kara, yakhana teAmarA chile alpa, parAjita avasthAYa par3echile deze; bhIta-sastrastra chile ye, teAmAdera nA anyerA cheA~ mere niYe yAYa| ataHpara tini teAmAdigake AzraYera ThikAnA diYechena, svIYa sAhAyyera dvArA teAmAdigake zakti dAna karechena evaM paricchanna jIvikA diYechena yAte teAmarA zukariYA AdAYa kara|
he ImAnadAragaNa, kheYAnata kareAnA AllAhara sAthe o rasUlera sAthe evaM kheYAnata kareA nA nijedera pArasparika AmAnate jene-zune|
Ara jene rAkha, teAmAdera dhana-sampada o santAna-santati akalyANera sammukhInakArI| vastutaH AllAhara nikaTa raYeche mahA saoYAva|

he ImAnadAragaNa teAmarA yadi AllAhake bhaYa karate thAka, tave teAmAdera madhye phaYasAlA kare devena evaM teAmAdera theke teAmAdera pApake sariYe devena evaM teAmAdera kSamA karavena| vastutaH AllAhara anugraha atyanta mahAna|

Ara kAphererA yakhana pratAraNA karata ApanAke vandI athavA hatyA karAra uddezye kiMvA ApanAke vera kare deYAra janya takhana tArA yemana chalanA karata temani, AllAhao chalanA karatena| vastutaH AllAhara chalanA savaceYe uttama|
Ara keu yakhana tAdera nikaTa AmAra AYAtasamUha pATha kare tave vale, AmarA zunechi, icchA karale AmarAo emana valate pAri; e teA pUrvavartI itikathA chAr3A Ara kichui naYa|

tAchAr3A tArA yakhana valate Arambha kare ye, iYA AllAha, ei yadi teAmAra pakSa theke (Agata) satya dvIna haYe thAke, tave AmAdera upara AkAza theke prastara varSaNa kara kiMvA AmAdera upara vedanAdAYaka AyAva nAyila kara|

athaca AllAha kakhanai tAdera upara AyAva nAyila karavena nA yatakSaNa Apani tAdera mAjhe avasthAna karavena| tAchAr3A tArA yatakSaNa kSamA prArthanA karate thAkave AllAha kakhanao tAdera upara AyAva devena nA|

Ara tAdera madhye emana ki viSaYa raYeche, yAra phale AllAha tAdera upara AyAva dAna karavena nA| athaca tArA masajide-hArAme yete vAdhAdAna kare, athaca tAdera se adhikAra nei| era adhikAra teA tAderai raYeche yArA paraheyagAra| kintu tAdera adhikAMzai se viSaYe avahita naYa|
Ara kA’vAra nikaTa tAdera nAmAya valate zisa deYA Ara tAli vAjAneA chAr3A anya keAna kichui chila nA| ataeva, evAra nijedera kRta kupharIra AyAvera svAda grahaNa kara|

niHsandehe yesava leAka kAphera, tArA vyaYa kare nijedera dhana-sampada, yAte kare vAdhAdAna karate pAre AllAhara pathe| vastutaH ekhana tArA AreA vyaYa karave| tArapara tAi tAdera janya AkSepera kAraNa haYe evaM zeSa paryanta tArA here yAve| Ara yArA kAphera tAderake deAyakhera dike tAr3iYe niYe yAoYA have|

yAte pRthaka kare dena AllAha apavitra o nA-pAkake pavitra o pAka theke| Ara yAte ekaTira para ekaTike sthApana kare samaveta stupe pariNata karena evaM pare deAyakhe nikSepa karena| erAi hala kSatigrasta|
tumi vale dAo, kApheraderake ye, tArA yadi virata haYe yAYa, tave yA kichu ghaTe geche kSamA have yAve| pakSAntare AvArao yadi tAi kare, tave purvavartIdera patha nirdhArita haYe geche|

Ara tAdera sAthe yuddha karate thAka yatakSaNa nA bhrAnti zeSa haYe yAYa; evaM AllAhara samasta hukuma pratiSThita haYe yAYa| tArapara yadi tArA virata haYe yAYa, tave AllAha tAdera kAryakalApa lakSya karena|
Ara tArA yadi nA mAne, tave jene rAkha, AllAha teAmAdera samarthaka; evaM katai nA camatkAra sAhAyyakArI|

Ara e kathAo jene rAkha ye, keAna vastu-sAmagrIra madhya theke yA kichu teAmarA ganImata hisAve pAve, tAra eka paJcamAMza hala AllAhara janya, rasUlera janya, tA~ra nikaTAtnIYa-svajanera janya evaM etIma-asahAYa o musAphiradera janya; yadi teAmAdera vizvAsa thAke AllAhara upara evaM se viSaYera upara yA Ami AmAra vAndAra prati avatIrNa karechi phaYasAlAra dine, yedina sammukhIna haYe yAYa ubhaYa senAdala| Ara AllAha sava kichura uparai kSamatAzIla|

Ara yakhana teAmarA chile samarAGganera e prAnte Ara tArA chila se prAnte athaca kAphelA teAmAdera theke nIce neme giYechila| ematAvasthAYa yadi teAmarA pArasparika aGgIkArAvaddha hate, tave teAmarA eka saGge se oYAdA pAlana karate pArate nA| kintu AllAha tA’AlA emana eka kAja karate ceYechilena, yA nirdhArita haYe giYechila yAte se sava leAka nihata haoYAra chila, pramANa pratiSThAra para evaM yAdera vA~cAra chila, tArA ve~ce thAke pramANa pratiSThAra para| Ara nizcitai AllAha zravaNakArI, vijJa|

AllAha yakhana teAmAke svapne sesava kApherera parimANa alpa kare dekhAlena; vezI kare dekhAle teAmarA kApuruSatA avalamvana karate evaM kAjera velAYa vipada sRSTi karate| kintu AllAha vA~ciYe diYechena| tini ati uttamabhAvei jAnena; yA kichu antare raYeche|

Ara yakhana teAmAderake dekhAlena se sainyadala meAkAvelAra samaYa teAmAdera ceAkhe alpa evaM teAmAderake dekhAlena tAdera ceAkhe vezI, yAte AllAha se kAja kare nite pArena yA chila nirdhArita| Ara sava kAjai AllAhara nikaTa giYe peৗchAYa|
he ImAnadAragaNa, teAmarA yakhana keAna vAhinIra sAthe saMghAte lipta hao, takhana sudRr3ha thAka evaM AllAhake adhika parimANe smaraNa kara yAte teAmarA uddezye kRtakArya hate pAra|

Ara AllAha tA’AlAra nirdeza mAnya kara evaM tA~ra rasUlera| tAchAr3A teAmarA paraspare vivAde lipta haio nA| yadi tA kara, tave teAmarA kApuruSa haYe par3ave evaM teAmAdera prabhAva cale yAve| Ara teAmarA dhairyyadhAraNa kara| nizcaYai AllAha tA'AlA raYechena dhairyyazIladera sAthe|

Ara tAdera mata haYe yeYeA nA, yArA veriYeche nijedera avasthAna theke garvitabhAve evaM leAkaderake dekhAvAra uddeze| Ara AllAhara pathe tArA vAdhA dAna karata| vastutaH AllAhara AYatve raYeche se samasta viSaYa yA tArA kare|

Ara yakhana sudRzya kare dila zaYatAna tAdera dRSTite tAdera kAryakalApake evaM valala ye, Ajakera dine keAna mAnuSai teAmAdera upara vijaYI hate pArave nA Ara Ami halAma teAmAdera samarthaka, ataHpara yakhana sAmanAsAmanI hala ubhaYa vAhinI takhana se ati druta pAYe pechane dike pAliYe gela evaM valala, Ami teAmAdera sAthe nA-Ami dekhachi, yA teAmarA dekhacha nA; Ami bhaYa kari AllAhake| Ara AllAhara AyAva atyanta kaThina|

yakhana meAnAphekarA valate lAgala evaM yAdera antara vyAdhigrasta, erA nijedera dharmera upara garvita| vastutaH yArA bharasA kare AllAhara upara, se nizcinta, kenanA AllAha ati parAkramazIla, suvijJa|
Ara yadi tumi dekha, yakhana pherezatArA kApheradera jAna kavaja kare; prahAra kare, tAdera mukhe evaM tAdera pazcAdadeze Ara vale, jvalanta AyAvera svAda grahaNa kara|
ei haleA se savera vinimaYa yA teAmarA teAmAdera pUrve pAThiYecha nijera hAte| vastutaH eTi e janya ye, AllAha vAndAra upara yuluma karena nA|

yemana, rIti raYeche pherAunera anusArIdera evaM tAdera pUrve yArA chila tAdera vyApAre ye, erA AllAhara nirdezera prati asvIkRti jJApana kareche evaM sejanya AllAha tA’AlA tAdera pAkar3Ao karechena tAderai pApera daruna| niHsandehe AllAha mahAzaktizAlI, kaThina zAstidAtA|

tAra kAraNa ei ye, AllAha kakhanao parivartana karena nA, se sava neYAmata, yA tini keAna jAtike dAna karechilena, yatakSaNa nA se jAti nijei parivartita kare deYa nijera janya nirdhArita viSaYa| vastutaH AllAha zravaNakArI, mahAjJAnI|

yemana chila rIti pherAunera vaMzadhara evaM yArA tAdera pUrve chila, tArA mithyA pratipanna karechila svIYa pAlanakartAra nidarzanasamUhake| ataHpara Ami tAderake dhvaMsa kare diYechi tAdera pApera daruna evaM DuviYe merechi pherAunera vaMzadharaderake| vastutaH erA savAi chila yAlema|
samasta jIvera mAjhe AllAhara nikaTa tArAi savaceYe nikRSTa, yArA asvIkArakArI haYeche ataHpara Ara ImAna Aneni|
yAdera sAthe tumi cukti karecha tAdera madhya theke ataHpara prativAra tArA nijedera kRtacukti laMghana kare evaM bhaYa kare nA|
sutarAM yadi kakhaneA tumi tAderake yuddhe peYe yAo, tave tAdera emana zAsti dAo, yena tAdera uttarasUrirA tAi dekhe pAliYe yAYa; tAderao yena zikSA haYa|

tave keAna sampradAYera dheA~kA deYAra vyApAre yadi teAmAdera bhaYa thAke, tave tAdera cukti tAdera dikei chu~r3e phele dAo emanabhAve yena haYe yAo teAmarAo tArA samAna| nizcaYai AllAha dheAkAvAja, pratArakake pachanda karena nA|
Ara kApherarA yena ekA yA mane nA kare ye, tArA ve~ce geche; kakhanao erA AmAke parizrAnta karate pArave nA|

Ara prastuta kara tAdera sAthe yuddhera janya yAi kichu saMgraha karate pAra nijera zakti sAmarthyera madhye theke evaM pAlita gheAr3A theke, yena prabhAva par3e AllAhara zutrudera upara evaM teAmAdera zatrudera upara Ara tAderake chAr3A anyAnyadera upara o yAderake teAmarA jAna nA; AllAha tAderake cenena| vastutaH yA kichu teAmarA vyaYa karave AllAhara rAhe, tA teAmarA paripUrNabhAve phire pAve evaM teAmAdera keAna haka apUrNa thAkave nA|
Ara yadi tArA sandhi karate Agraha prakAza kare, tAhale tumio se dikei AgrahI hao evaM AllAhara upara bharasA kara| niHsandehe tini zravaNakArI; parijJAta|
pakSAntare tArA yadi teAmAke pratAraNA karate cAYa, tave teAmAra janya AllAhai yatheSTa, tinii teAmAke zakti yugiYechena svIYa sAhAyye o musalamAnadera mAdhyame|

Ara prIti saJcAra karechena tAdera antare| yadi tumi sesava kichu vyaYa kare phelate, yA kichu yamInera vuke raYeche, tAdera mane prIti saJcAra karate pArate nA| kintu AllAha tAdera mane prIti saJcAra karechena| niHsandehe tini parAkramazAlI, sukeৗzalI|
he navI, ApanAra janya evaM yesava musalamAna ApanAra sAthe raYeche tAdera savAra janya AllAha yatheSTa|

he navI, Apani musalamAnagaNake utsAhita karuna jehAdera janya| teAmAdera madhye yadi viza jana dRr3hapada vyakti thAke, tave jaYI have du’zara meAkAvelAYa| Ara yadi teAmAdera madhye thAke ekaza leAka, tave jaYI have hAjAra kApherera upara theke tAra kAraNa orA jJAnahIna|

ekhana veAjhA hAlakA kare diYechena AllAha tA’AlA teAmAdera upara evaM tini jene niYechena ye, teAmAdera madhya dUrvalatA raYeche| kAjei teAmAdera madhye yadi dRr3hacitta ekaza leAka vidyamAna thAke, tave jaYI have du’zara upara| Ara yadi teAmarA eka hAjAra hao tave AllAhara hukuma anuyAYI jaYI have du’hAjArera upara Ara AllAha raYechena dRr3hacitta leAkadera sAthe|

navIra pakSe ucita naYa vandIdigake nijera kAche rAkhA, yatakSaNa nA dezamaYa pracura raktapAta ghaTAve| teAmarA pArthiva sampada kAmanA kara, athaca AllAha cAna AkherAta| Ara AllAha hacchena parAkramazAlI hekamataoYAlA|
yadi ekaTi viSaYa nA hata yA pUrva thekei AllAha likhe rekhechena, tAhale teAmarA yA grahaNa karacha sejanya virATa AyAva ese peৗchAta|
sutarAM teAmarA khAo ganImata hisAve teAmarA ye paricchanna o hAlAla vastu arjana karecha tA theke| Ara AllAhake bhaYa karate thAka| nizcaYai AllAha kSamAzIla, meheravAna|

he navI, tAderake vale dAo, yArA teAmAra hAte vandI haYe Ache ye, AllAha yadi teAmAdera antare keAna rakama maGgalacintA raYeche vale jAnena, tave teAmAderake tAra ceYe vahuguNa vezI dAna karavena yA teAmAdera kAcha theke vinimaYe neYA haYeche| tAchAr3A teAmAderake tini kSamA kare divena| vastutaH AllAha kSamAzIla, karuNAmaYa|
Ara yadi tArA teAmAra sAthe pratAraNA karate cAYa-vastutaH tArA AllAhara sAtheo itipUrve pratAraNA kareche, ataHpara tini tAderake dhariYe diYechena| Ara AllAha sarvaviSaYe parijJAta, sukeৗzalI|

ete keAna sandeha nei ye, yArA ImAna eneche, deza tyAga kareche, svIYa jAna o mAla dvArA AllAhara rAhe jehAda kareche evaM yArA tAderake AzraYa o sAhAyya sahAYatA diYeche, tArA eke aparera sahAYaka| Ara yArA ImAna eneche kintu deza tyAga kareni tAdera vandhutve teAmAdera praYeAjana nei yatakSaNa nA tArA dezatyAga kare| avazya yadi tArA dharmIYa vyApAre teAmAdera sahAYatA kAmanA kare, tave tAdera sAhAyya karA teAmAdera kartavya| kintu teAmAdera sAthe yAdera sahayeAgI cukti vidyamAna raYeche, tAdera meAkAvelAYa naYa| vastutaH teAmarA yA kichu kara, AllAha sesavai dekhena|
Ara yArA kAphera tArA pArasparika sahayeAgI, vandhu| teAmarA yadi emana vyavasthA nA kara, tave dAGgA-hAGgAmA vistAra lAbha karave evaM dezamaYa var3ai akalyANa have|

Ara yArA ImAna eneche, nijedera ghara-vAr3I cher3eche evaM AllAhara rAhe jehAda kareche evaM yArA tAderake AzraYa diYeche, sAhAyya-sahAYatA kareche, tA~rA haleA satyikAra musalamAna| tA~dera janye raYeche, kSamA o sammAnajanaka ruyI|

Ara yArA ImAna eneche paravartI paryAYe evaM ghara-vAr3I cher3eche evaM teAmAdera sAthe sammilita haYe jehAda kareche, tArAo teAmAderai antarbhukta| vastutaH yArA AtnIYa, AllAhara vidhAna mate tArA paraspara vezI hakadAra| nizcaYai AllAha yAvatIYa viSaYe sakSama o avagata|
samparkaccheda karA hala AllAha o tA~ra rasUlera pakSa theke sei muzarikadera sAthe, yAdera sAthe teAmarA cuktivaddha haYechile|
ataHpara teAmarA paribhramaNa kara e deze cAra mAsakAla| Ara jene rekheA, teAmarA AllAhake parAbhUta karate pArave nA, Ara nizcaYai AllAha kApheradigake lAJchita kare thAkena|

Ara mahAna hajvera dine AllAha o tA~ra rasUlera pakSa theke leAkadera prati gheASaNA kare deYA hacche ye, AllAha muzarekadera theke dAYitva mukta evaM tA~ra rasUlao| avazya yadi teAmarA taovA kara, tave tA, teAmAdera janyeo kalyANakara, Ara yadi mukha pherAo, tave jene rekheA, AllAhake teAmarA parAbhUta karate pArave nA| Ara kApheraderake marmAntika zAstira susaMvAda dAo|

tave ye muzarikadera sAthe teAmarA cukti vaddha, ataparaH yArA teAmAdera vyApAre keAna truTi kareni evaM teAmAdera viruddhe kAuke sAhAyyao kareni, tAdera sAthe kRta cuktike tAdera deYA meYAda paryanta pUraNa kara| avazyai AllAha sAvadhAnIdera pachanda karena|

ataHpara niSiddha mAsa ativAhita hale muzarikadera hatyA kara yekhAne tAdera pAo, tAdera vandI kara evaM avareAdha kara| Ara pratyeka ghA~Tite tAdera sandhAne OMt pete vase thAka| kintu yadi tArA taovA kare, nAmAya kAYema kare, yAkAta AdAYa kare, tave tAdera patha cher3e dAo| nizcaYa AllAha ati kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

Ara muzarikadera keu yadi teAmAra kAche AzraYa prArthanA kare, tave tAke AzraYa deve, yAte se AllAhara kAlAma zunate pAYa, ataHpara tAke tAra nirApada sthAne peৗche deve| eTi ejanye ye erA jJAna rAkhe nA|

muzarikadera cukti AllAhara nikaTa o tA~ra rasUlera nikaTa kirUpe valavat thAkave| tave yAdera sAthe teAmarA cukti sampAdana karecha masajidula-hArAmera nikaTa| ataeva, ye paryanta tArA teAmAdera janye sarala thAke, teAmarAo tAdera janya sarala thAka| niHsandehera AllAha sAvadhAnIdera pachanda karena|

kirUpe? tArA teAmAdera upara jaYI hale teAmAdera AtnIYatAra o aGgIkArera keAna maryAdA deve nA| tArA mukhe teAmAdera santuSTa kare, kintu tAdera antarasamUha tA asvIkAra kare, Ara tAdera adhikAMza pratizruti bhaGgakArI|
tArA AllAhara AYAta samUha naganya mulye vikraYa kare, ataHpara leAkadera nivRta rAkhe tA~ra patha theke, tArA yA kare calache, tA ati nikRSTa|
tArA maryAdA deYa nA keAna musalamAnera kSetre AtnIYatAra, Ara nA aGgIkArera| Ara tArAi sImAlaMghanakArI|
avazya tArA yadi taovA kare, nAmAya kAYema kare Ara yAkAta AdAYa kare, tave tArA teAmAdera dvInI bhAi| Ara Ami vidhAnasamUhe jJAnI leAkadera janye sarvastare rvaNanA kare thAki|
Ara yadi bhaGga kare tArA tAdera zapatha pratizrutira para evaM vidrupa kare teAmAdera dvIna samparke, tave kuphara pradhAnadera sAthe yuddha kara| kAraNa, edera kena zapatha nei yAte tArA phire Ase|

teAmarA ki sei dalera sAthe yuddha karave nA; yArA bhaGga kareche nijedera zapatha evaM saGkalpa niYeche rasUlake vahiskArera? Ara erAi prathama teAmAdera sAthe vivAdera sUtrapAta kareche| teAmarA ki tAdera bhaYa kara? athaca teAmAdera bhaYera adhikatara yeAgya halena AllAha, yadi teAmarA mumina hao|
yuddha kara odera sAthe, AllAha teAmAdera haste tAdera zAsti devena| tAdera lAJchita karavena, tAdera viruddhe teAmAdera jaYI karavena evaM musalamAnadera antarasamUha zAnta karavena|
evaM tAdera manera kSeAbha dUra karavena| Ara AllAha yAra prati icchA kSamAzIla have, AllAha sarvajJa, prajJAmaYa|

teAmarA ki mane kara ye, teAmAdera cher3e deYA have emani, yatakSaNa nA AllAha jene nevena teAmAdera ke yuddha kareche evaM ke AllAha, tA~ra rasUla o musalamAnadera vyatIta anya kAuke antaraGga vandhurUpe grahaNa karA theke virata raYeche| Ara teAmarA yA kara se viSaYe AllAha savizeSa avahita|
muzarikarA yeAgyatA rAkhe nA AllAhara masajida AvAda karAra, yakhana tArA nijerAi nijedera kupharIra svIkRti dicche| edera Amala varavAda have evaM erA Agune sthAYIbhAve vasavAsa karave|

niHsandehe tArAi AllAhara masajida AvAda karave yArA ImAna eneche AllAhara prati o zeSa dinera prati evaM kAYema kareche nAmAya o AdAYa kare yAkAta; AllAha vyatIta Ara kAuke bhaYa kare nA| ataeva, AzA karA yAYa, tArA hedAYeta prAptadera antarbhUkta have|

teAmarA ki hAjIdera pAni saravarAha o masajidula-hArAma AvAdakaraNake sei leAkera samAna mane kara, ye ImAna rAkhe AllAha o zeSa dinera prati evaM yuddha kareche AllAhara rAhe, erA AllAhara dRSTite samAna naYa, Ara AllAha jAlema leAkadera hedAYeta karena nA|
yArA ImAna eneche, deza tyAga kareche evaM AllAhara rAhe nijedera jAna o mAla diYe jehAda kareche, tAdera var3a maryAdA raYeche AllAhara kAche Ara tArAi saphalakAma|
tAdera susaMvAda dicchena tAdera paraoYAradegAra svIYa daYA o santeASera evaM jAnnAtera, sekhAne Ache tAdera janya sthAYI zAnti|
tathAYa tArA thAkave ciradina| niHsandehe AllAhara kAche Ache mahApuraskAra|

he ImAnadAragaNa! teAmarA svIYa pitA o bhAidera abhibhAvakarUpe grahaNa kareA nA, yadi tArA ImAna apekSA kupharake bhAlavAse| Ara teAmAdera yArA tAdera abhibhAvakarUpe grahaNa kare tArA sImAlaMghanakArI|

vala, teAmAdera nikaTa yadi teAmAdera pitA teAmAdera santAna, teAmAdera bhAi teAmAdera patnI, teAmAdera geAtra teAmAdera arjita dhana-sampada, teAmAdera vyavasA yA vandha haYe yAoYAra bhaYa kara evaM teAmAdera vAsasthAna-yAke teAmarA pachanda kara-AllAha, tA~ra rasUla o tA~ra rAhe jehAda karA theke adhika priYa haYa, tave apekSA kara, AllAhara vidhAna AsA paryanta, Ara AllAha phAseka sampradAYake hedAYeta karena nA|

AllAha teAmAdera sAhAyya karechena aneka kSetre evaM heAnAinera dine, yakhana teAmAdera saMkhyadhikya teAmAdera praphulla karechila, kintu tA teAmAdera keAna kAje Aseni evaM pRthivI prazasta haoYA satteo teAmAdera janya saMkucita haYechila| ataHpara pRSTha pradarzana kare palAYana karechile|

tArapara AllAha nAyila karena nijera pakSa theke sAntvanA, tA~ra rasUla o muminadera prati evaM avatIrNa karena emana senAvAhinI yAdera teAmarA dekhate pAoni| Ara zAsti pradAna karena kApheradera evaM eTi hala kApheradera karmaphala|
erapara AllAha yAdera prati icchA taovAra taophIka devena, Ara AllAha atIva kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

he ImAnadAragaNa! muzarikarA teA apavitra| sutarAM e vacharera para tArA yena masajidula-hArAmera nikaTa nA Ase| Ara yadi teAmarA dAridryera AzaMkA kara, tave AllAha cAile nija karunAYa bhaviSyate teAmAdera abhAvamukta kare devena| niHsandehe AllAha sarvajJa, prajJAmaYa|

teAmarA yuddha kara Ahale-kitAvera ai leAkadera sAthe, yArA AllAha o reAja hAzare ImAna rAkhe nA, AllAha o tA~ra rasUla yA hArAma kare diYechena tA hArAma kare nA evaM grahaNa kare nA satya dharma, yatakSaNa nA karajeAr3e tArA jiyiYA pradAna kare|

ihudIrA vale oyAira AllAhara putra evaM nAsArArA vale ‘masIha AllAhara putra’| e hacche tAdera mukhera kathA| erA pUrvavartI kApheradera mata kathA vale| AllAha edera dhvaMsa karuna, erA keAna ulTA pathe cale yAcche|

tArA tAdera panDita o saMsAra-virAgIdigake tAdera pAlanakartArUpe grahaNa kareche AllAha vyatIta evaM mariYamera putrakeo| athaca tArA AdiSTa chila ekamAtra mAvudera evAdatera janya| tini chAr3A keAna mAvuda nei, tArA tA~ra zarIka sAvyasta kare, tAra theke tini pavitra|
tArA tAdera mukhera phutkAre AllAhara nUrake nirvApita karate cAYa| kintu AllAha avazyai tA~ra nUrera pUrNatA vidhAna karavena, yadio kApherarA tA aprItikara mane kare|
tinii preraNa karechena Apana rasUlake hedAYeta o satya dvIna sahakAre, yena e dvInake aparApara dvInera upara jaYayukta karena, yadio muzarikarA tA aprItikara mane kare|

he ImAnadAragaNa! panDita o saMsAravirAgIdera aneke leAkadera mAlAmAla anyAYabhAve bheAga kare calache evaM AllAhara patha theke leAkadera nivRta rAkhache| Ara yArA svarNa o rUpA jamA kare rAkhe evaM tA vyaYa kare nA AllAhara pathe, tAdera kaTheAra AyAvera susaMvAda zuniYe dina|

se dina jAhAnnAmera Agune tA uttapta karA have evaM tAra dvArA tAdera lalATa, pArzva o pRSThadezake dagdha karA have (sedina valA have), eguleA yA teAmarA nijedera janye jamA rekhechile, sutarAM ekSaNe AsvAda grahaNa kara jamA kare rAkhAra|

nizcaYa AllAhara vidhAna o gananAYa mAsa vAraTi, AsamAnasamUha o pRthivI sRSTira dina theke| tanmadhye cAraTi sammAnita| eTii supratiSThita vidhAna; sutarAM era madhye teAmarA nijedera prati atyAcAra kareA nA| Ara muzarikadera sAthe teAmarA yuddha kara samavetabhAve, yemana tArAo teAmAdera sAthe yuddha kare yAcche samavetabhAve| Ara mane rekheA, AllAha muttAkInadera sAthe raYechena|

ei mAsa pichiYe deYAra kAja kevala kupharIra mAtrA vRddhi kare, yAra phale kApheragaNa geAmarAhIte patita haYa| erA hAlAla kare neYa eke eka vachara evaM hArAma kare neYa anya vachara, yAte tArA gaNanA pUrNa kare neYa AllAhara niSiddha mAsaguleAra| ataHpara hAlAla kare neYa AllAhara hArAmakRta mAsaguleAke| tAdera mandakAjaguleA tAdera janye zeAbhanIYa kare deYA hala| Ara AllAha kAphera sampradAYake hedAYeta karena nA|

he ImAnadAragaNa, teAmAdera ki hala, yakhana AllAhara pathe vera havAra janye teAmAdera valA haYa, takhana mATi jar3iYe dhara, teAmarA ki AkherAtera parivarte duniYAra jIvane parituSTa haYe gele? athaca AkherAtera tulanAYa duniYAra jIvanera upakaraNa ati alpa|
yadi vera nA hao, tave AllAha teAmAdera marmantuda AyAva devena evaM apara jAtike teAmAdera sthalAbhiSikta karavena| teAmarA tA~ra keAna kSati karate pArave nA, Ara AllAha sarvaviSaYe zaktimAna|

yadi teAmarA tAke (rasUlake) sAhAyya nA kara, tave mane rekheA, AllAha tAra sAhAyya karechilena, yakhana tAke kApherarA vahiSkAra karechila, tini chilena du’janera ekajana, yakhana tArA guhAra madhye chilena| takhana tini Apana saGgIke valalena viSanna haYeA nA, AllAha AmAdera sAthe Achena| ataHpara AllAha tAra prati svIYa sAntanA nAyila karalena evaM tA~ra sAhAyye emana vAhinI pAThAlena, yA teAmarA dekhani| vastutaH AllAha kApheradera mAthA nIcu kare dilena Ara AllAhara kathAi sadA samunnata evaM AllAha parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|
teAmarA vera haYe par3a svalpa vA pracura saraJjAmera sAthe evaM jehAda kara AllAhara pathe nijedera mAla o jAna diYe, eTi teAmAdera janye ati uttama, yadi teAmarA vujhate pAra|

yadi Azu lAbhera sambhAvanA thAkateA evaM yAtrApathao saMkSipta hateA, tave tArA avazyai ApanAra sahayAtrI hateA, kintu tAdera nikaTa yAtrApatha sudIrgha mane hala| Ara tArA emanai zapatha kare valave, AmAdera sAdhya thAkale avazyai teAmAdera sAthe vera hatAma, erA nijerAi nijedera vinaSTa karache, Ara AllAha jAnena ye, erA mithyAvAdI|
AllAha ApanAke kSamA karuna, Apani kena tAdera avyAhati dilena, ye paryanta nA ApanAra kAche pariSkAra haYe yeta satyavAdIrA evaM jene nitena mithyAvAdIdera|
AllAha o reAja keYAmatera prati yAdera ImAna raYeche tArA mAla o jAna dvArA jehAda karA theke ApanAra kAche avyAhati kAmanA karave nA, Ara AllAha sAvadhAnIdera bhAla jAnena|
niHsandehe tArAi ApanAra kAche avyAhati cAYa, yArA AllAha o reAja keYAmate ImAna rAkhe nA evaM tAdera antara sandehagrasta haYe par3eche, sutarAM sandehera Avarte tArA ghurapAka kheYe caleche|

Ara yadi tArA vera havAra saMkalpa nita, tave avazyai kichu saraJjAma prastuta karateA| kintu tAdera utthAna AllAhara pachanda naYa, tAi tAdera nivRta rAkhalena evaM Adeza hala vasA leAkadera sAthe teAmarA vase thAka|

yadi teAmAdera sAthe tArA vera hata, tave teAmAdera aniSTa chAr3A Ara kichu vRddhi karateA nA, Ara azva chuTAteA teAmAdera madhye vibheda sRSTira uddeze| Ara teAmAdera mAjhe raYeche tAdera guptacara| vastutaH AllAha yAlimadera bhAlabhAvei jAnena|

tArA pUrve thekei vibheda sRSTira suyeAga sandhAne chila evaM ApanAra kAryasamUha ulTA-pAlTA kare dicchila| zeSa paryanta satya pratizruti ese gela evaM jaYI hala AllAhara hukuma, ye avasthAYa tArA mandaveAdha karala|
Ara tAdera keu vale, AmAke avyAhati dina evaM pathabhraSTa karavena nA| zeAne rAkha, tArA teA pUrva thekei pathabhraSTa evaM niHsandehe jAhAnnAma ei kApheradera pariveSTana kare raYeche|
ApanAra keAna kalyANa hale tArA mandaveAdha kare evaM keAna vipada upasthita hale tArA vale, AmarA pUrva thekei nijedera kAja sAmale niYechi evaM phire yAYa ullasita mane|
Apani valuna, AmAdera kAche kichui pau~chave nA, kintu yA AllAha AmAdera janya rekhechena; tini AmAdera kAryanirvAhaka| AllAhara uparai muminadera bharasA karA ucita|

Apani valuna, teAmarA teA teAmAdera janye duTi kalyANera ekaTi pratyAzA kara; Ara AmarA pratyAzAYa Achi teAmAdera janye ye, AllAha teAmAdera AyAva dAna karuna nijera pakSa theke athavA AmAdera haste| sutarAM teAmarA apekSA kara, AmarAo teAmAdera sAthe apekSamANa|
Apani valuna, teAmarA icchAYa artha vyaYa kara vA anicchAYa, teAmAdera theke tA kakhaneA kavula have nA, teAmarA nApharamAnera dala|
tAdera artha vyaYa kavula nA haoYAra echAr3A Ara keAna kAraNa nei ye, tArA AllAha o tA~ra rasUlera prati avizvAsI, tArA nAmAye Ase alasatAra sAthe vyaYa kare saGkucita mane|
sutarAM tAdera dhana-sampada o santAna-santati yena ApanAke vismita nA kare| AllAhara icchA hala eguleA dvArA duniYAra jIvane tAdera AyAve nipatita rAkhA evaM prANaviYeAga haoYA kupharI avasthAYa|
tArA AllAhara nAme halapha kare vale ye, tArA teAmAderai antarbhukta, athaca tArA teAmAdera antarbhUkta naYa, avazya tArA teAmAdera bhaYa kare|
tArA keAna AzraYasthala, keAna guhA vA mAthA geA~jAra ThAi pele sedike palAYana karave drutagatite|
tAdera madhye emana leAkao raYeche yArA sadakA vanTane ApanAke deASArUpa kare| era theke kichu pele santuSTa haYa evaM nA pele vikSuvdha haYa|

katai nA bhAla hata, yadi tArA santuSTa hata AllAha o tAra rasUlera upara evaM valata, AllAhai AmAdera janye yatheSTa, AllAha AmAdera devena nija karuNAYa evaM tA~ra rasUlao, AmarA zudhu AllAhakei kAmanA kari|

yAkAta hala kevala phakira, misakIna, yAkAta AdAYa kArI o yAdera citta AkarSaNa praYeAjana tAde haka evaM tA dAsa-muktira janye-RNa grastadera janya, AllAhara pathe jehAdakArIdera janye evaM musAphiradera janye, ei hala AllAhara nirdhArita vidhAna| AllAha sarvajJa, prajJAmaYa|

Ara tAdera madhye keu keu navIke kleza deYa, evaM vale, e leAkaTi teA kAnasarvasva| Apani vale dina, kAna haleo teAmAderai maGgalera janya, AllAhara upara vizvAsa rAkhe evaM vizvAsa rAkhe musalamAnadera kathAra upara| vastutaH teAmAdera madhye yArA ImAnadAra tAdera janya tini rahamatavizeSa| Ara yArA AllAhara rasUlera prati kutsA raTanA kare, tAdera janya raYeche vedanAdAYaka AyAva|
teAmAdera sAmane AllAhara kasama khAYa yAte teAmAdera rAyI karate pAre| avazya tArA yadi ImAnadAra haYe thAke, tave AllAhake evaM tA~ra rasUlake rAyI karA atyanta jarurI|
tArA ki ekathA jene neYani ye, AllAhara sAthe evaM tA~ra rasUlera sAthe ye meAkAvelA kare tAra janye nirdhArita raYeche deAyakha; tAte sava samaYa thAkave| eTii hala mahA-apamAna|

munAphekarA e vyApAre bhaYa kare ye, musalamAnadera upara nA emana keAna sUrA nAyila haYa, yAte tAdera antarera geApana viSaYa avahita karA have| sutarAM Apani vale dina, ThATTA-vidrapa karate thAka; AllAha tA avazyai prakAza karavena yAra vyApAre teAmarA bhaYa karacha|

Ara yadi tumi tAdera kAche jijJesa kara, tave tArA valave, AmarA teA kathAra kathA valachilAma evaM keৗtuka karachilAma| Apani valuna, teAmarA ki AllAhara sAthe, tA~ra hukuma AhakAmera sAthe evaM tA~ra rasUlera sAthe ThATTA karachile?

chalanA kara nA, teAmarA ye kAphera haYe gecha ImAna prakAza karAra para| teAmAdera madhye keAna keAna leAkake yadi Ami kSamA kare deio, tave avazya kichu leAkake AyAvao deva| kAraNa, tArA chila geAnAhagAra|

munApheka nara-nArI savArai gatividhi ekarakama; zikhAYa manda kathA, bhAla kathA theke vAraNa kare evaM nija muTheA vandha rAkhe| AllAhake bhule geche tAra, kAjei tinio tAdera bhUle gechena niHsandehe munAphekarAi nApharamAna|

oYAdA karechena AllAha, munApheka puruSa o munApheka nArIdera evaM kApheradera janye deAyakhera Agunera-tAte par3e thAkave sarvadA| seTAi tAdera janye yatheSTa| Ara AllAha tAdera prati abhisampAta karechena evaM tAdera janye raYeche sthAYI AyAva|

yemana kare teAmAdera pUrvavartI leAkerA teAmAdera ceYe vezI chila zaktite evaM dhana-sampadera o santAna-santatira adhikArIo chila vezI; ataHpara upakRta haYeche nijedera bhAgera dvArA AvAra teAmarA phAYadA uThiYecha teAmAdera bhAgera dvArA-yemana kare teAmAdera pUrvavartIrA phAYadA uThiYechila nijedera bhAgera dvArA| Ara teAmarAo valacha tAderai calana anuyAYI| tArA chila se leAka, yAdera AmalasamUha niHzeSita haYe geche duniYA o AkherAte| Ara tArAi haYeche kSatira sammukhIna|

tAdera saMvAda ki edera kAne ese pau~chAYani, yArA chila tAdera pUrve; nUhera A’dera o sAmudera sampradAYa evaM ivrAhImera sampradAYera evaM mAdaiYAnavAsIdera? evaM sesava janapadera yeguleAke ulTe deYA haYechila? tAdera kAche esechilena tAdera navI pariSkAra nirdeza niYe| vastutaH AllAha teA emana chilena nA ye, tAdera upara juluma karatena, kintu tArA nijerAi nijedera upara juluma karateA|

Ara ImAnadAra puruSa o ImAnadAra nArI eke aparera sahAYaka| tArA bhAla kathAra zikSA deYa evaM manda theke virata rAkhe| nAmAya pratiSThA kare, yAkAta deYa evaM AllAha o tA~ra rasUlera nirdeza anuyAYI jIvana yApana kare| ederai upara AllAha tA’AlA daYA karavena| nizcaYai AllAha parAkramazIla, sukeৗzalI|

AllAha ImAnadAra puruSa o ImAnadAra nArIdera pratizruti diYechene kAnana-kuJjera, yAra taladeze pravAhita haYa prasravaNa| tArA se guleArai mAjhe thAkave| Ara esava kAnana-kuJje thAkave paricchanna thAkAra ghara| vastutaH e samudaYera mAjhe savaceYe var3a hala AllAhara santuSTi| eTii hala mahAna kRtakAryatA|
he navI, kApheradera sAthe yuddha karuna evaM munAphekadera sAthe tAdera sAthe kaTheAratA avalamvana karuna| tAdera ThikAnA hala deAyakha evaM tAhala nikRSTa ThikAnA|
