tArA kasama khAYa ye, AmarA valini, athaca niHsandehe tArA valeche kupharI vAkya evaM musalamAna havAra para asvIkRtijJApanakArI haYeche| Ara tArA kAmanA karechila emana vastura yA tArA prApta haYani| Ara esava tArai pariNati chila ye, AllAha o tA~ra rasUla tAderake sampadazAlI kare diYechilena nijera anugrahera mAdhyame| vastutaH erA yadi taovA kare neYa, tave tAdera janya maGgala| Ara yadi tA nA mAne, tave tAdera ke AyAva devena AllAha tA’AlA, vedanAdAYaka AyAva duniYA o AkherAte| ataeva, vizvacarAcare tAdera janya keAna sAhAyyakArI-samarthaka nei|
tAdera madhye keu keu raYeche yArA AllAha tA’AlAra sAthe oYAdA karechila ye, tini yadi AmAdera prati anugraha dAna karena, tave avazyai AmarA vyaYa karava evaM satkarmIdera antarbhukta haYe thAkava|
ataHpara yakhana tAderake svIYa anugrahera mAdhyame dAna karA haYa, takhana tAte kArpaNya kareche evaM kRta oYAdA theke phire geche tA bheGge diYe|

tArapara erai pariNatite tAdera antare kapaTatA sthAna kare niYeche sedina paryanta, yedina tAra tA~ra sAthe giYe milave| tA ejanya ye, tArA AllAhara sAthe kRta oYAdA laMghana karechila evaM ejanye ye, tArA mithyA kathA valateA|
tArA ki jene neYani ye, AllAha tAdera rahasya o zalA-parAmarza samparke avagata evaM AllAha khuva bhAla karei jAnena samasta geApana viSaYa?

se samasta leAka yArA bhatrsanA-vidrUpa kare sesava musalamAnadera prati yArA mana khule dAna-khaYarAta kare evaM tAdera prati yAdera kichui nei zudhumAtra nijera parizramalavda vastu chAr3A| ataHpara tAdera prati ThATTA kare| AllAha tAdera prati ThATTA karechena evaM tAdera janya raYeche vedanAdAYaka AyAva|

tumi tAdera janya kSamA prArthanA kara Ara nA kara| yadi tumi tAdera janya sattara vArao kSamAprArthanA kara, tathApi kakhaneAi tAderake AllAha kSamA karavena nA| tA ejanya ye, tArA AllAhake evaM tA~ra rasUlake asvIkAra kareche| vastutaH AllAha nA-phAramAnaderake patha dekhAna nA|

pechane theke yAoYA leAkerA AllAhara rasUla theke vicchinna haYe vase thAkate pere Ananda lAbha kareche; Ara jAna o mAlera dvArA AllAhara rAhe jehAda karate apachanda kareche evaM valeche, ei garamera madhye abhiyAne vera haYeA nA| vale dAo, uttApe jAhAnnAmera Aguna pracanDatama| yadi tAdera vivecanA zakti thAkata|
ataeva, tArA sAmAnya hese nika evaM tArA tAdera kRtakarmera vadalAte aneka vezI kA~dave|

vastutaH AllAha yadi teAmAke tAdera madhya theke keAna zreNIvizeSera dike phiriYe niYe yAna evaM ataHpara tArA teAmAra kAche abhiyAne vereAvAra anumati kAmanA kare, tave tumi valeA ye, teAmarA kakhaneA AmAra sAthe vereAve nA evaM AmAra pakSa haYe keAna zatrura sAthe yuddha karave nA, teAmarA teA prathamavAre vase thAkA pachanda karecha, kAjei pechane par3e thAkA leAkadera sAthei vase thAka|

Ara tAdera madhya theke kAreA mRtyu hale tAra upara kakhanao nAmAya par3avena nA evaM tAra kavare dA~r3Avena nA| tArA teA AllAhara prati asvIkRti jJApana kareche evaM rasUlera pratio| vastutaH tArA nA-pharamAna avasthAYa mRtyu varaNa kareche|

Ara vismita haYeA nA tAdera dhana sampada o santAna-santutira daruna| AllAha teA ei cAna ye, e savera kAraNe tAderake AyAvera bhetare rAkhavena duniYAYa evaM tAdera prANa nirgata haoYA paryanta yena tArA kApherai thAke|

Ara yakhana nAyila haYa keAna sUrA ye, teAmarA ImAna Ana AllAhara upara, tA~ra rasUlera sAthe ekAtna haYe; takhana vidAYa kAmanA kare tAdera sAmarthyavAna leAkerA evaM vale AmAdera avyAhati dina, yAte AmarA (niskriYabhAve) vase thAkA leAkadera sAthe theke yete pAri|
tArA pechane par3e thAkA leAkadera sAthe theke yete pere Anandita haYeche evaM meAhara e~Te deYA haYeche tAdera antarasamUhera upara| vastutaH tArA veAjhe nA|

kintu rasUla evaM sesava leAka yArA ImAna eneche, tA~ra sAthe tArA yuddha kareche nijedera jAna o mAlera dvArA| tAderai janya nirdhArita raYeche kalyANasamUha evaM tArAi muktira lakSye upanIta haYeche|
AllAha tAdera janya tairI kare rekhechena kAnana-kuJja, yAra taladeze pravAhita raYeche prasravaNa| tArA tAte vAsa karave anantakAla| eTAi hala virATa kRtakAryatA|

Ara chalanAkArI veduIna leAkerA eleA, yAte tAdera avyAhati lAbha hate pAre evaM nivRtta thAkate pAre tAderai yArA AllAha o rasUlera sAthe mithyA vale chila| evAra tAdera upara zIgrai Asave vedanAdAYaka AyAva yArA kAphera|

dUrvala, rugna, vyaYabhAra vahane asamartha leAkadera janya keAna aparAdha nei, yakhana tArA manera dika theke pavitra have AllAha o rasUlera sAthe| nekakAradera upara abhiyeAgera keAna patha nei| Ara AllAha hacchena kSamAkArI daYAlu|

Ara nA Ache tAdera upara yArA eseche teAmAra nikaTa yena tumi tAdera vAhana dAna kara evaM tumi valecha, AmAra kAche emana keAna vastu nei ye, tAra upara teAmAdera saoYAra karAva takhana tArA phire geche athaca takhana tAdera ceAkha diYe azru vaitechila e duHkhe ye, tArA emana keAna vastu pAcche nA yA vyaYa karave|

abhiyeAgera patha teA tAdera vyApAre raYeche, yArA teAmAra nikaTa avyAhati kAmanA kare athaca tArA sampadazAlI| yArA pechane par3e thAkA leAkadera sAthe thAkate pere Anandita haYeche| Ara AllAha meAhara e~Te diYechena tAdera antarasamUhe| vastutaH tArA jAnateo pAreni|

tumi yakhana tAdera kAche phire Asave, takhana tArA teAmAdera nikaTa chala-chutA niYe upasthita have; tumi valeA, chala kAreA nA, Ami kakhaneA teAmAdera kathA zunava nA; AmAke AllAha tA’AlA teAmAdera avasthA samparke avahita kare diYechena| Ara ekhana teAmAdera karma AllAhai dekhavena evaM tA~ra rasUla| tArapara teAmarA pratyAvartita have sei geApana o AgeApana viSaYe avagata sattAra nikaTa| tinii teAmAdera vAtale devena yA teAmarA karachile|

ekhana tArA teAmAra sAmane AllAhara kasama khAve, yakhana tumi tAdera kAche phire yAve, yena tumi tAdera kSamA kare dAo| sutarAM tumi tAdera kSamA kara-niHsandehe erA apavitra evaM tAdera kRtakarmera vadalA hisAve tAdera ThikAnA haleA deAyakha|
tArA teAmAra sAmane kasama khAve yAte tumi tAdera prati rAyI haYe yAo| ataeva, tumi yadi rAyI haYe yAo tAdera prati tavu AllAha tA’AlA rAyI havena nA, e nApharamAna leAkadera prati|

veduinarA kuphara o meAnAphekIte atyanta kaTheAra haYe thAke evaM erA sesava nIti-kAnuna nA zekhArai yeAgya yA AllAha tA’AlA tA~ra rasUlera upara nAyila karechena| vastutaH AllAha sava kichui jAnena evaM tini atyanta kuzalI|

AvAra keAna keAna veduina emana o raYeche yArA nijedera vyaYa karAke jarimAnA vale ganya kare evaM teAmAra upara keAna durdina Ase kinA se apekSAYa thAke| tAderai upara durdina Asuka| Ara AllAha hacchena zravaNakArI, parijJAta|

Ara keAna keAna veduina hala tArA, yArA ImAna Ane AllAhara upara, keYAmata dinera upara evaM nijedera vyaYake AllAhara naikaTya evaM rasUlera deAYA lAbhera upAYa vale gaNya kare| jeneA! tAi hala tAdera kSetre naikaTya| AllAha tAderake nijera rahamatera antarbhUkta karavena| nizcaYai AllAha kSamAzIla, karunAmaYa|

Ara yArA sarvaprathama hijaratakArI o AnachAradera mAjhe purAtana, evaM yArA tAdera anusaraNa kareche, AllAha se samasta leAkadera prati santuSTa haYechena evaM tArAo tA~ra prati santuSTa haYeche| Ara tAdera janya prastuta rekhechena kAnana-kuJja, yAra taladeza diYe pravAhita prasravaNasamUha| sekhAne tArA thAkave cirakAla| eTAi hala mahAna kRtakAryatA|

Ara kichu kichu teAmAra Aza-pAzera munApheka evaM kichu leAka madInAvAsI kaTheAra munAphekIte anar3ha| tumi tAdera jAna nA; Ami tAdera jAni| Ami tAderake AyAva dAna karava du’vAra, tArapara tAderake niYe yAoYA have mahAna AyAvera dike|

Ara keAna keAna leAka raYeche yArA nijedera pApa svIkAra kareche, tArA mizrita kareche ekaTi nekakAja o anya ekaTi vadakAja| zIghrai AllAha haYata tAderake kSamA kare devena| niHsandehe AllAha kSamAzIla karuNAmaYa|

tAdera mAlAmAla theke yAkAta grahaNa kara yAte tumi seguleAke pavitra karate evaM seguleAke varakatamaYa karate pAra era mAdhyame| Ara tumi tAdera janya deAYA kara, niHsandehe teAmAra deAYA tAdera janya sAntvanA svarUpa| vastutaH AllAha savakichui zeAnena, jAnena|
tArA ki ekathA jAnate pAreni ye, AllAha nijei svIYa vAndAdera taovA kavula karena evaM yAkAta grahaNa karena? vastutaH AllAhai taovA kavulakArI, karuNAmaYa|

Ara tumi vale dAo, teAmarA Amala kare yAo, tAra paravartIte AllAha dekhavena teAmAdera kAja evaM dekhavena rasUla o musalamAnagaNa| tAchAr3A teAmarA zIgrai pratyAvartita have tA~ra sAnnidhye yini geApana o prakAzya viSaYe avagata| tArapara tini jAniYe devena teAmAderake yA karate|

AvAra aneka leAka raYeche yAdera kAjakarma AllAhara nirdezera upara sthagita raYeche; tini haYa tAdera AyAva devena nA haYa tAdera kSamA kare devena| vastutaH AllAha sava kichui jJAta, vijJatAsampanna|

Ara yArA nirmANa kareche masajida jidera vaze evaM kupharIra tAr3anAYa muminadera madhye vibheda sRsTira uddezye evaM ai leAkera janya ghATi svarUpa ye pUrva theke AllAha o tA~ra rasUlera sAthe yuddha kare Asache, Ara tArA avazyai zapatha karave ye, AmarA kevala kalyANai ceYechi| pakSAntare AllAha sAkSI ye, tArA savAi mithyuka|

tumi kakhaneA sekhAne dAr3Ave nA, tave ye masajidera bhitti rAkhA haYeche tAkaoYAra upara prathama dina theke, seTii teAmAra dA~r3AvAra yeAgya sthAna| sekhAne raYeche emana leAka, yArA pavitratAke bhAlavAse| Ara AllAha pavitra leAkadera bhAlavAsena|
ye vyAkti svIYa gRhera bhitti rekheche keAna gartera kinArAYa yA dhvase par3Ara nikaTavartI evaM ataHpara tA oke niYe deAyakhera Agune patita haYa| Ara AllAha jAlemadera patha dekhAna nA|
tAdera nirmita gRhaTi tAdera antare sadA sandehera udreka kare yAve ye paryanta nA tAdera antaraguleA ceৗcira haYe yAYa| Ara AllAha sarvajJa prajJAmaYa|

AllAha kraYa kare niYechena musalamAnadera theke tAdera jAna o mAla ei mUlye ye, tAdera janya raYeche jAnnAta| tArA yuddha kare AllAhara rAheH ataHpara mAre o mare| taorAta, iJjila o keAraAne tini e satya pratizrutite avicala| Ara AllAhara ceYe pratizruti rakSAYa ke adhika? sutarAM teAmarA Anandita hao se lena-denera upara, yA teAmarA karacha tA~ra sAthe| Ara e hala mahAna sAphalya|

tArA taovAkArI, evAdatakArI, zeAkarageAyAra, (duniYAra sAthe) samparkacchedakArI, ruku o sijadA AdAYakArI, satkAjera Adeza dAnakArI o manda kAja theke nivRtakArI evaM AllAhara deoYA sImAsamUhera hephAyatakArI| vastutaH susaMvAda dAo ImAnadAraderake|
navI o muminera ucita naYa muzarekadera mAgapherAta kAmanA kare, yadio tArA AtnIYa heAka ekathA suspaSTa haoYAra para ye tArA deAyakhI|

Ara ivrAhIma kartRka svIYa pitAra mAgapherAta kAmanA chila kevala sei pratizrutira kAraNe, yA tini tAra sAthe karechilena| ataHpara yakhana tA~ra kAche ekathA prakAza pela ye, se AllAhara zatru takhana tAra sAthe samparka chinna kare nilena| niHsandehe ivrAhIma chilena var3a keAmala hRdaYa, sahanazIla|

Ara AllAha keAna jAtike hedAYeta karAra para pathabhraSTa karena nA yatakSaNa nA tAdera janya pariSkArabhAve vale dena sesava viSaYa yA theke tAdera ve~ce thAkA darakAra| niHsandehe AllAha sava viSaYe oYAkephahAla|
nizcaYa AllAharai janya AsamAnasamUha o yamInera sAmrAjya| tinii jindA karena o mRtyu ghaTAna, Ara AllAha vyatIta teAmAdera janya keAna sahAYao nei, keAna sAhAyyakArIo nei|

AllAha daYAzIla navIra prati evaM muhAjira o AnasAradera prati, yArA kaThina mahUrte navIra saGge chila, yakhana tAdera eka dalera antara phire yAoYAra upakrama haYechila| ataHpara tini daYAparavaza hana tAdera prati| niHsandehe tini tAdera prati daYAzIla o karunAmaYa|

evaM apara tinajanake yAderake pechane rAkhA haYechila, yakhana pRthivI vistRta haoYA satveo tAdera janya saGkucita haYe gela evaM tAdera jIvana dUrvisaha haYe uThaleA; Ara tArA vujhate pAraleA ye, AllAha vyatIta Ara keAna AzraYasthala nei-ataHpara tini sadaYa halena tAdera prati yAte tArA phire Ase| niHsandehe AllAha daYAmaYa karuNAzIla|
he ImAnadAragaNa, AllAhake bhaYa kara evaM satyavAdIdera sAthe thAka|

madInAvAsI o pAzvavartI pallIvAsIdera ucita naYa rasUlullAhara saGga tyAga kare pechane theke yAoYA evaM rasUlera prANa theke nijedera prANake adhika priYa mane karA| eTi ejanya ye, AllAhara pathe ye tRSNA, klAnti o kSudhA tAdera sparza kare evaM tAdera emana padakSepa yA kApheradera mane kreAdhera kAraNa haYa Ara zatrudera pakSa theke tArA yA kichu prApta haYa-tAra pratyekaTira parivarte tAdera janya likhita haYe neka Amala| niHsandehe AllAha satkarmazIla leAkadera haka naSTa karena nA|
Ara tArA alpa-vistara yA kichu vyaYa kare, yata prAntara tArA atikrama kare, tA savai tAdera nAme lekhA haYa, yena AllAha tAdera kRtakarmasamUhera uttama vinimaYa pradAna karena|

Ara samasta muminera abhiyAne vera haoYA saGgata naYa| tAi tAdera pratyeka dalera ekaTi aMza kena vera haleA nA, yAte dvInera jJAna lAbha kare evaM saMvAda dAna kare svajAtike, yakhana tArA tAdera kAche pratyAvartana karave, yena tArA vA~cate pAre|
he ImAnadAragaNa, teAmAdera nikaTavartI kApheradera sAthe yuddha cAliYe yAo evaM tArA teAmAdera madhye kaTheAratA anubhava karuka Ara jene rAkha, AllAha muttAkIdera sAthe raYechena|

Ara yakhana keAna sUrA avatIrNa haYa, takhana tAdera keu keu vale, e sUrA teAmAdera madhyekAra ImAna kataTA vRddhi karaleA? ataeva yArA ImAnadAra, e sUrA tAdera ImAna vRddhi kareche evaM tArA Anandita haYeche|
vastutaH yAdera antare vyAdhi raYeche eTi tAdera kaluSera sAthe AreA kaluSa vRddhi kareche evaM tArA kAphera avasthAYai mRtyu varaNa karaleA|
tArA ki lakSya kare nA, prati vachara tArA du’ekavAra viparyasta hacche, athaca, tArA eraparao taovA kare nA kiMvA upadeza grahaNa kare nA|

Ara yakhanai keAna sUrA avatIrNa haYa, takhana tArA eke anyera dike tAkAYa ye, keAna musalamAna teAmAdera dekhache ki-nA-ataHpara sare par3e| AllAha odera antarake satya vimukha kare diYechena! nizcaYai tArA nirveAdha sampradAYa|
teAmAdera kAche eseche teAmAdera madhya thekei ekajana rasUla| teAmAdera duHkha-kaSTa tAra pakSe duHsaha| tini teAmAdera maGgalakAmI, muminadera prati snehazIla, daYAmaYa|
e sattveo yadi tArA vimukha haYe thAke, tave vale dAo, AllAhai AmAra janya yatheSTa, tini vyatIta Ara kAreA vandegI nei| Ami tA~rai bharasA kari evaM tinii mahAna Arazera adhipati|
Alipha-lAma-ra, eguleA hekamatapUrNa kitAvera AYAta|

mAnuSera kAche ki Azcarya lAgache ye, Ami ohI pAThiYechi tAderai madhya theke ekajanera kAche yena tini mAnuSake satarka karena evaM susaMvAda zuniYe dena ImanAdAragaNake ye, tA~dera janya satya maryAdA raYeche tA~dera pAlanakartAra kAche| kApherarA valate lAgala, niHsandehe e leAka prakAzya yAdukara|

nizcaYai teAmAdera pAlanakartA AllAha yini tairI karechena AsamAna o yamInake chaYa dine, ataHpara tini Arazera upara adhiSThita haYechena| tini kArya paricAlanA karena| keu supAriza karate pAve nA tave tA~ra anumati chAr3A inii AllAha teAmAdera pAlanakartA| ataeva, teAmarA tA~rai evAdata kara| teAmarA ki kichui cintA kara nA?

tA~ra kAchei phire yete have teAmAdera savAike, AllAhara oYAdA satya, tinii sRSTi karena prathamavAra AvAra punarvAra tairI karavena tAderake vadalA deYAra janya yArA ImAna eneche evaM neka kAja kareche inasAphera sAthe| Ara yArA kAphera haYeche, tAdera pAna karate have phuTanta pAni evaM bheAga karate have yantranAdAYaka AyAva e janye ye, tArA kupharI karachila|

tinii se mahAna sattA, yini vAniYechena suryake ujjala AleAkamaYa, Ara candrake snigdha AleA vitaraNakArIrUpe evaM ataHpara nirdhArita karechena era janya manayila samUha, yAte kare teAmarA cinate pAra vacharaguleAra saMkhyA o hisAva| AllAha ei samasta kichu emanitei sRSTi karenani, kintu yathArthatAra sAthe| tini prakAza karena lakSaNasamUha se samasta leAkera janya yAdera jJAna Ache|
nizcaYai rAta-dinera parivartanera mAjhe evaM yA kichu tini sRSTi karechena AsamAna o yamIne, savai hala nidarzana sesava leAkera janya yArA bhaYa kare|
avazyai yesava leAka AmAra sAkSAt lAbhera AzA rAkhe nA evaM pArthiva jIvana niYei utphulla raYeche, tAtei prazAnti anubhava kareche evaM yArA AmAra nirdazanasamUha samparke vekhavara|
emana leAkadera ThikAnA hala Aguna sesavera vadalA hisAve yA tArA arjana karachila|

avazya yesava leAka ImAna eneche evaM satkAja kareche, tAderake hedAYeta dAna karavena tAdera pAlanakartA, tAdera ImAnera mAdhyame| emana susamaYa kAnana-kuJjera prati yAra taladeze pravAhita haYa prasravaNasamUha|
sekhAne tAdera prArthanA hala ‘pavitra teAmAra sattA he AllAha’| Ara zubhecchA hala sAlAma Ara tAdera prArthanAra samApti haYa, ‘samasta prazaMsA vizvapAlaka AllAhara janya’ vale|

Ara yadi AllAha tA’AlA mAnuSake yathAzIghra akalyANa pau~che dena yatazIghra tAra kAmanA kare, tAhale tAdera AzAi zeSa kare dite hata| sutarAM yAdera mane AmAra sAkSAtera AzA nei, Ami tAderake tAdera duSTumite vyativyasta cher3e diYe rAkhi|

Ara yakhana mAnuSa kaSTera sammukhIna haYa, zuYe vase, dA~r3iYe AmAke DAkate thAke| tArapara Ami yakhana tA theke mukta kare dei, se kaSTa yakhana cale yAYa takhana mane haYa kakhaneA keAna kaSTerai sammukhIna haYe yena AmAke DAkeini| emanibhAve manaHputa haYeche nirbhaYa leAkadera yA tArA kareche|

avazya teAmAdera pUrve vahu dalake dhvaMsa kare diYechi, takhana tArA jAlema haYe geche| athaca rasUla tAdera kAcheo esava viSaYera prakRSTa nirdeza niYe esechilena| kintu kichutei tArA ImAna Anala nA| emanibhAve Ami zAsti diYe thAki pApi sampradAYake|
ataHpara Ami teAmAderake yamIne tAdera para pratinidhi vAniYechi yAte dekhate pAri teAmarA ki kara|

Ara yakhana tAdera kAche AmAra prakRSTa AYAta samUha pATha karA haYa, takhana se samasta leAka vale, yAdera AzA nei AmAra sAkSAtera, niYe eseA keAna keAraAna eTi chAr3A, athavA eke parivartita kare dAo| tAhale vale dAo, eke nijera pakSa theke parivartita karA AmAra kAja naYa| Ami se nirdezerai Anugatya kari, yA AmAra kAche Ase| Ami yadi svIYa paraoYAradegArera nApharamAnI kari, tave kaThina divasera AyAvera bhaYa kari|

vale dAo, yadi AllAha cAitena, tave Ami eTi teAmAdera sAmane par3atAma nA, Ara nAivA tini teAmAdereke avahita karatena e samparke| kAraNa Ami teAmAdera mAjhe itipUrveo ekaTA vaYasa ativAhita karechi| tArapareo ki teAmarA cintA karave nA?
ataHpara tAra ceYe var3a jAlema, ke have, ye AllAhara prati apavAda AreApa kareche kiMvA tA~ra AYAtasamUhake mithyA vale abhihita karache? kasminakAleo pApIdera keAna kalyANa haYa nA|

Ara upAsanA kare AllAhake vAda diYe emana vastura, yA nA tAdera keAna kSatisAdhana karate pAre, nA lAbha evaM vale, erA teA AllAhara kAche AmAdera supArizakArI| tumi vala, teAmarA ki AllAhake emana viSaYe avahita karacha, ye samparke tini avahita nana AsamAna o yamInera mAjhe? tini putaHpavitra o mahAna se samasta theke yAke teAmarA zarIka karacha|

Ara samasta mAnuSa ekai ummatabhukta chila, pare pRthaka haYe geche| Ara ekaTi kathA yadi teAmAra paraoYAradegArera pakSa theke pUrva nirdhArita nA haYe yeta; tave tArA ye viSaYe vireAdha karache tAra mImAMsA haYe yeta|
vastutaH tArA vale, tA~ra kAche tA~ra paraoYAradegArera pakSa theke keAna nirdeza ela nA kena? vale dAo gAYevera kathA AllAhai jAnena| Ami o teAmAdera sAthe apekSAYa railAma|

Ara yakhana Ami AsvAdana karAi svIYa rahamata se kaSTera para, yA tAdera bheAga karate haYechila, takhanai tArA AmAra zaktimattAra mAjhe nAnA rakama chalanA tairI karate Arambha karave| Apani vale dina, AllAha savaceYe druta kalA-keৗzala tairI karate pArena| nizcaYai AmAdera pherezatArA likhe rAkhe teAmAdera chala-cAturI|

tinii teAmAdera bhramana karAna sthale o sAgare| emanaki yakhana teAmarA neৗkAsamUhe AreAhaNa karale Ara tA leAkajanake anukUla hAoYAYa vaYe niYe calala evaM tAte tArA Anandita hala, neৗkAguleAra upara ela tIvra vAtAsa, Ara sarvadika theke seguleAra upara Dheu Asate lAgala evaM tArA jAnate pArala ye, tArA avaruddha haYe par3eche, takhana DAkate lAgala AllAhake tA~ra evAdate niHsvArtha haYe yadi tumi AmAderake e vipada theke uddhAra kare teAla, tAhale niHsandehe AmarA kRtajJa thAkava|

tArapara yakhana tAderake AllAha vA~ciYe dilena, takhanai tArA pRthivIte anAcAra karate lAgala anyAYa bhAve| he mAnuSa! zeAna, teAmAdera anAcAra teAmAderai upara par3ave| pArthiva jIvanera suphala bheAga kare nAo-ataHpara AmAra nikaTa pratyAvartana karate have| takhana Ami vAtale deva, yA kichu teAmarA karate|

pArthiva jIvanera udAharaNa temani, yemani Ami AsamAna theke pAni varSana karalAma, pare tA milita saMmizrita haYe tA theke yamInera zyAmala udbhida veriYe ela yA mAnuSa o jIva-janturA kheYe thAke| emanaki yamIna yakhana seৗndarya suSamAYa bhare uThaleA Ara yamInera adhikartArA bhAvate lAgala, eguleA AmAdera hAte Asave, haThAt kare tAra upara AmAra nirdeza ela rAtre kiMvA dine, takhana seguleAke keTe stupAkAra kare dila yena kAla o ekhAne keAna AvAda chila nA| emanibhAve Ami kheAlAkhuli varNanA kare thAki nidarzaNasamUha se samasta leAkadera janya yArA lakSya kare|
Ara AllAha zAnti-nirApattAra AlaYera prati AhavAna jAnAna evaM yAke icchA saralapatha pradarzana karena|

yArA satkarma kareche tAdera janya raYeche kalyANa evaM tArao ceYe vezI| Ara tAdera mukhamanDalake AvRta karave nA malinatA kiMvA apamAna| tArAi hala jAnnAtavAsI, etei tArA vasavAsa karate thAkave anantakAla|

Ara yArA saJcaYa kareche akalyANa asat karmera vadalAYa se parimANa apamAna tAdera cehArAke AvRta kare phelave| keu nei tAderake vA~cAte pAre AllAhara hAta theke| tAdera mukhamanDala yena Dheke deYA haYeche AdhA~ra rAtera TukareA diYe| erA hala deAyakhavAsI| erA etei thAkave anantakAla|

Ara yedina Ami tAdera savAike samaveta karava; Ara yArA zeraka karata tAderake valavaH teAmarA evaM teAmAdera zarIkarA nija nija jAYagAYa dA~r3iYe yAo-ataHpara tAderake pArasparika vicchinna kare deva, takhana tAdera zarIkarA valave, teAmarA teA AmAdera upAsanA-vandegI karani|
vastutaH AllAha AmAdera o teAmAdera mAjhe sAkSI hisAve yatheSTa| AmarA teAmAdera vandegI samparke jAnatAma nA|

sekhAne pratyeke yAcAi kare nite pArave yA kichu se itipUrve karechila evaM AllAhara prati pratyAvartana karave yini tAdera prakRta mAlika, Ara tAdera kAcha theke dUre yete thAkave yArA mithyA valata|

tumi jijJesa kara, ke ruyI dAna kare teAmAderake AsamAna theke o yamIna theke, kiMvA ke teAmAdera kAna o ceAkhera mAlika? tAchAr3A ke jIvitake mRtera bhetara theke vera karena evaM keivA mRtake jIvitera madhya theke vera karena? ke karena karma sampAdanera vyavasthApanA? takhana tArA vale uThave, AllAha! takhana tumi valeA tArapareo bhaYa karacha nA?
ataeva, e AllAhai teAmAdera prakRta pAlanakartA| Ara satya prakAzera pare (udabhrAnta ghurAra mAjhe) ki raYeche geAmarAhI chAr3A? sutarAM keAthAYa ghuracha?
emanibhAve sapramANita haYe geche teAmAra paraoYAradegArera vANI sesava nApharamAnera vyApAre ye, erA ImAna Anave nA|

vala, Ache ki keu teAmAdera zarIkadera mAjhe ye sRSTi ke paYadA karate pAre evaM AvAra jIvita karate pAre? vala, AllAhai prathamavAra sRSTi karena evaM ataHpara tAra punarudbhava karavena| ataeva, keAthAYa ghurapAka khAcche?

jijJesa kara, Ache ki keu teAmAdera zarIkadera madhye ye satya-saThika patha pradarzana karave? vala, AllAhai satya-saThika patha pradarzana karena, sutarAM emana ye leAka saThika patha dekhAve tAra kathA mAnya karA kiMvA ye leAka nije nije patha khu~je pAYa nA, tAke patha dekhAneA kartavya| ataeva, teAmAdera ki hala, kemana teAmAdera vicAra?
vastutaH tAdera adhikAMzai zudhu AndAja-anumAnera upara cale, athaca AndAja-anumAna satyera velAYa keAna kAjei Ase nA| AllAha bhAla karei jAnena, tArA yA kichu kare|

Ara keAraAna se jinisa naYa ye, AllAha vyatIta keu tA vAniYe neve| avazya eTi pUrvavartI kAlAmera satyAYana kare evaM se samasta viSaYera vizleSaNa dAna kare yA teAmAra prati deYA haYeche, yAte keAna sandeha nei-teAmAra vizvapAlanakartAra pakSa theke|
mAnuSa ki vale ye, eTi vAniYe enecha? vale dAo, teAmarA niYe eseA ekaTii sUrA, Ara Deke nAo, yAderake nite sakSama hao AllAha vyatIta, yadi teAmarA satyavAdI haYe thAka|

kintu kathA hala ei ye, tArA mithyA pratipanna karate Arambha kareche yAke vujhate, tArA akSama| athaca ekhaneA era vizleSaNa Aseni| emanibhAve mithyA pratipanna kareche tAdera pUrvavartIrA| ataeva, lakSya kare dekha, kemana haYeche pariNati|
Ara tAdera madhye keu keu keAraAnake vizvAsa karave evaM keu keu vizvAsa karave nA| vastutaH teAmAra paraoYAradegAra yathArthai jAnena durAcAradigake|

Ara yadi teAmAke mithyA pratipanna kare, tave vala, AmAra janya AmAra karma, Ara teAmAdera janya teAmAdera karma| teAmAdera dAYa-dAYitva nei AmAra karmera upara evaM AmArao dAYa-dAYitva nei teAmarA yA kara sejanya|
tAdera keu keu kAna rAkhe teAmAdera prati; tumi vadhiraderake ki zeAnAve yadi tAdera viveka-vuddhi nA thAke!
AvAra tAdera madhye keu keu teAmAdera prati dRSTinivaddha rAkhe; tumi andhaderake ki patha dekhAve yadi tArA meATeo dekhate nA pAre|
AllAha juluma karena nA mAnuSera upara, varaM mAnuSa nijei nijera upara juluma kare|

Ara yedina tAderake samaveta karA have, yena tArA avasthAna kareni, tave dinera ekadanDa ekajana aparajanake cinave| niHsandehe kSatigrasta haYeche yArA mithyA pratipanna kareche AllAhara sAthe sAkSAtake evaM saralapathe Aseni|

Ara yadi Ami dekhAi teAmAke se oYAdAsamUhera madhya theke keAna kichu yA Ami tAdera sAthe karechi, athavA teAmAke mRtyudAna kari, yAheAka, AmAra kAchei tAderake pratyAvartana karate have| vastutaH AllAha se samasta karmera sAkSI yA tArA kare|
Ara pratyeka sampradAYera ekekajana rasUla raYeche| yakhana tAdera kAche tAdera rasUla nyAYadanDasaha upasthita hala, takhana Ara tAdera upara juluma haYa nA|
tArA AreA vale, e oYAdA kave Asave, yadi teAmarA satyavAdI haYe thAka?

tumi vala, Ami AmAra nijera kSati kiMvA lAbherao mAlika nai, kintu AllAha yA icchA karena| pratyeka sampradAYera janyai ekekaTi oYAdA raYeche, yakhana tAdera se oYAdA ese pau~che yAve, takhana nA ekadanDa pechane sarate pArave, nA sAmane phasakAte pArave,|
tumi vala, AcchA dekha teA dekhi, yadi teAmAdera upara tAra AyAva rAtArAti athavA dinera velAYa ese pau~che yAYa, tave era Age pApIrA ki karave?
tAhale ki AyAva saMghaTita haYe yAvAra para era prati vizvAsa karave? ekhana svIkAra karale? athaca teAmarA erai tAkAdA karate?
ataHpara valA have, geAnAhagAradigake, bheAga karate thAka ananta AyAva-teAmarA yA kichu karate tAra tAi pratiphala|
Ara teAmAra kAche saMvAda jijJesa kare, eTA ki satya? vale dAo, avazyai AmAra paraoYAradegArera kasama eTA satya| Ara teAmarA parizrAnta kare dite pArave nA|

vastutaH yadi pratyeka geAnAhagArera kAche eta parimANa thAke yA Ache samagra yamInera mAjhe, Ara avazyai yadi seguleA nijera muktira vinimaYe dite cAive Ara geApane geApane anutApa karave, yakhana AyAva dekhave| vastutaH tAdera janya siddhAnta have nyAYasaGgata evaM tAdera upara julama have nA|
zune rAkha, yA kichu raYeche AsamAnasamUhe o yamIne savai AllAhara| zune rAkha, AllAhara pratizruti satya| tave anekei jAne nA|
tinii jIvana o maraNa dAna karena evaM tA~rai kAche pratyAvartana karate have|
he mAnavakula, teAmAdera kAche upadezavAnI eseche teAmAdera paraoYAradegArera pakSa theke evaM antarera reAgera nirAmaYa, hedAYeta o rahamata musalamAnadera janya|
vala, AllAhara daYA o meheravANIte| sutarAM erai prati tAdera santuSTa thAkA ucit| eTii uttama se samudaYa theke yA saJcaYa karacha|

vala, AcchA nijei lakSya kare dekha, yA kichu AllAha teAmAdera janya riyika hisAve avatIrNa karechena, teAmarA seguleAra madhya theke keAnaTAke hArAma Ara keAnaTAke hAlAla sAvyasta karecha? vala, teAmAdera ki AllAha nirdeza diYechena, nAki AllAhara upara apavAda AreApa karacha?
Ara AllAhara prati mithyA apavAda AreApakArIdera ki dhAraNA keYAmata samparke? AllAha teA mAnuSera prati anugrahai karena, kintu anekei kRtajJatA svIkAra kare nA|

vastutaH ye keAna avasthAtei tumi thAka evaM keAraAnera ye keAna aMza thekei pATha karA kiMvA ye keAna kAjai teAmarA kara athaca Ami teAmAdera nikaTe upasthita thAki yakhana teAmarA tAte AtnaniYeAga kara| Ara teAmAra paraoYAradegAra theke geApana thAke nA ekaTi kanAo, nA yamInera evaM nA AsamAnera| nA era ceYe kSudra keAna kichu Ache, nA var3a yA ei prakRSTa kitAve nei|
mane rekheA yArA AllAhara vandhu, tAdera nA keAna bhaYa bhIti Ache, nA tArA cintAnvita have|
yArA ImAna eneche evaM bhaYa karate raYeche|
tAdera janya susaMvAda pArthiva jIvane o parakAlIna jIvane| AllAhara kathAra kakhaneA hera-phera haYa nA| eTAi hala mahA saphalatA|
Ara tAdera kathAYa duHkha niYeA nA| Asale samasta kSamatA AllAhara| tinii zravaNakArI, sarvajJa|

zunacha, AsamAnasamUhe o yamIne yA kichu raYeche savai AllAhara| Ara erA yArA AllAhake vAda diYe zarIkadera upAsanAra pechane par3e Ache-tA Asale kichui naYa| erA nijerai kalpanAra pechane par3e raYeche evaM echAr3A Ara kichu naYa ye, erA vuddhi khATAcche|

tini teAmAdera janya tairI karechena rAta, yAte kare teAmarA tAte prazAnti lAbha karate pAra, Ara dina diYechena darzana karAra janya| niHsandehe ete nidarzana raYeche se sava leAkera janya yArA zravaNa kare|

tArA vale, AllAha putra sAvyasta kare niYechena-tini pavitra, tini amukhApekSI| yAkichu raYeche AsamAna samUhe o yamIne savai tA~ra| teAmAdera kAche tAra keAna sanada nei| kena teAmarA AllAhara prati mithyAreApa kara-yAra keAna sanadai teAmAdera kAche nei?
vale dAo, yArA erUpa kare tArA avyAhati pAYa nA|
pArthivajIvane sAmAnyai lAbha, ataHpara AmAra nikaTa pratyAvartana karate have| takhana Ami tAderake AsvAdana karAva kaThina AyAva-tAderai kRta kupharIra vadalAte|

Ara tAderake zuniYe dAo nUhera avasthA yakhana se svIYa sampradAYake valala, he AmAra sampradAYa, yadi teAmAdera mAjhe AmAra avasthiti evaM AllAhara AYAtasamUhera mAdhyame nasIhata karA bhArI vale mane haYe thAke, tave Ami AllAhara upara bharasA karachi| ekhana teAmarA savAi mile nijeradera karma sAvyasta kara evaM ete teAmAdera zarIkaderake samaveta kare nAo, yAte teAmAdera mAjhe nijedera kAjera vyApAre keAna sandeha-saMzaYa nA thAke| ataHpara AmAra samparke yA kichu karAra kare phela evaM AmAke avyAhati dio nA|

tAraparao yadi vimukhatA avalamvana kara, tave Ami teAmAdera kAche keAna rakama vinimaYa kAmanA kari nA| AmAra vinimaYa hala AllAhara dAYitve| Ara AmAra prati nirdeza raYeche yena Ami Anugatya avalamvana kari|

tAraparao erA mithyA pratipanna karala| sutarAM tAke evaM tAra sAthe neৗkAYa yArA chila tAdera ke vA~ciYe niYechi evaM yathAsthAne AvAda karechi| Ara tAderake DuviYe diYechi yArA AmAra kathAke mithyA pratipanna kareche| sutarAM lakSya kara, kemana pariNati ghaTeche tAdera yAderake bhIti pradarzana karA haYechila|

anantara Ami nUhera pare vahu navI-rasUla pAThiYechi tAdera sampradAYera prati| tArapara tAdera kAche tArA prakAzya dalIla-pramANa upasthApana kareche, kintu tAdera dvArA emanaTi haYani ye, ImAna Anave se vyApAre, yAke tArA itipUrve mithyA pratipanna karechila| ebhAvei Ami meAhara e~Te dei sImAlaMghanakArIdera antarasamUhera upara|
ataHpara tAdera pechane pAThiYechi Ami mUsA o hArunake, pherAuna o tAra sardArera prati svIYa nirdezAvalI sahakAre| athaca tArA ahaMkAra karate Arambha kareche|
vastutaH tArA chila geAnAhagAra| tArapara AmAra pakSa theke yakhana tAdera kAche satya viSaYa upasthita hala, takhana valate lAgaleA, eguleA teA prakAzya yAdu|
mUsA valala, satyera vyApAre ekathA valacha, tA teAmAdera kAche pau~chAra para? eki yAdu? athaca yArA yAdukara, tArA saphala hate pAre nA|

tArA valala, tumi ki AmAderake se patha theke phiriYe dite esecha yAte AmarA peYechi AmAdera vApa-dAdAderake? Ara yAte teAmarA duijana edezera sardArI peYe yete pAra? AmarA teAmAderake kichutei mAnava nA|
Ara pherAuna valala, AmAra kAche niYe esa sudakSa yAdukaradigake|
tArapara yakhana yAdukararA ela, mUsA tAderake valala, nikSepa kara, teAmarA yA kichu nikSepa kare thAka|
ataHpara yakhana tArA nikSepa karala, mUsA valala, yA kichu teAmarA enecha tA savai yAdu-evAra AllAha esava bhanDula kare dicchena| niHsandehe AllAha duskarmIdera karmake suSThutA dAna karena nA|
AllAha satyake satye pariNata karena svIYa nirdeze yadio pApIdera tA manaHputa naYa|

Ara keu ImAna Anala nA mUsAra prati tA~ra kaomera katipaYa vAlaka chAr3A-pherAuna o tAra sardAradera bhaYe ye, erA nA AvAra keAna vipade phele deYa| pherAuna dezamaYa kartRetvera zikhare AreAhaNa karechila| Ara se tAra hAta cher3e rekhechila|
Ara mUsA valala, he AmAra sampradAYa, teAmarA yadi AllAhara upara ImAna ene thAka, tave tArai upara bharasA kara yadi teAmarA pharamAvaradAra haYe thAka|
takhana tArA valala, AmarA AllAhara upara bharasA karechi| he AmAdera pAlanakartA, AmAdera upara e jAlema kaomera zakti parIkSA kario nA|
Ara AmAderake anugraha kare chAr3iYe dAo ei kApheradera kavala theke|

Ara Ami nirdeza pAThAlAma mUsA evaM tAra bhAiYera prati ye, teAmarA teAmAdera jAtira janya misarera mATite vAsa sthAna nirdhAraNa kara| Ara teAmAdera gharaguleA vAnAve kevalAmukhI kare evaM nAmAya kAYema kara Ara yArA ImAnadAra tAderake susaMvAda dAna kara|

mUsA valala, he AmAra paraoYAradegAra, tumi pherAunake evaM tAra sardAraderake pArthava jIvanera Ar3amvara dAna karecha, evaM sampada dAna karecha-he AmAra paraoYAradegAra, e janyai ye tArA teAmAra patha theke vipathagAmI karava! he AmAra paraoYAradegAra, tAdera dhana-sampada dhvaMsa kare dAo evaM tAdera antaraguleAke kATheAra kare dAo yAte kare tArA tatakSaNa paryanta ImAna nA Ane yatakSaNa nA vedanAdAYaka AyAva pratyakSa kare neYa|
valalena, teAmAdera deAYA maJjura haYeche| ataeva teAmarA dujana aTala thAkeA evaM tAdera pathe caleA nA yArA ajJa|

Ara vanI-isarAIlake Ami pAra kare diYechi nadI| tArapara tAdera pazcAddhAvana kareche pherAuna o tAra senAvAhinI, durAcAra o vAr3AvAr3ira uddeze| emanaki yakhana tArA Duvate Arambha karala, takhana valala, evAra vizvAsa kare nicchi ye, keAna mA’vuda nei tA~ke chAr3A yA~ra upara ImAna eneche vanI-isarAIlarA| vastutaH Amio tA~rai anugatadera antarbhukta|
ekhana ekathA valacha! athaca tumi itipUrve nA-pharamAnI karachile| evaM pathabhraSTaderai antarbhukta chile|
ataeva Ajakera dine vA~ciYe dicchi Ami teAmAra dehake yAte teAmAra pazcAdavartIdera janya nidarzana hate pAre| Ara niHsandehe vahu leAka AmAra mahAzaktira prati lakSya kare nA|

Ara Ami vanI-isarAIladigake dAna karechi uttama sthAna evaM tAderake AhArya diYechi pavitra-paricchanna vastu-sAmagrI| vastutaH tAdera madhye matavireAdha haYani yatakSaNa nA tAdera kAche ese peৗcheche saMvAda| niHsandehe teAmAra paraoYAradegAra tAdera mAjhe mImAMsA kare devena keYAmatera dina; ye vyApAre tAdera mAjhe matavireAdha haYechila

sutarAM tumi yadi se vastu samparke keAna sandehera sammukhIna haYe thAka yA teAmAra prati Ami nAyila karechi, tave tAderake jijJesa kareA yArA teAmAra pUrva theke kitAva pATha karache| ete keAna sandeha nei ye, teAmAra paraoYAradegArera nikaTa theke teAmAra nikaTa satya viSaYa eseche| kAjei tumi kasminakAleo sandehakArI haYeA nA|
evaM tAdera antarbhuktao haYeA nA yArA mithyA pratipanna kareche AllAhara vANIke| tAhale tumio akalyANe patita haYe yAve|
yAdera vyApAre teAmAra paraoYAradegArera siddhAnta nirdhArita haYe geche tArA ImAna Anave nA|
yadi tAdera sAmane samasta nidarzanAvalI ese upasthita haYa tavuo yatakSaNa nA tArA dekhate pAYa vedanAdAYaka AyAva|

sutarAM keAna janapada kena emana hala nA yA ImAna eneche ataHpara tAra se ImAna grahaNa haYeche kalyANakara? avazya iunusera sampradAYera kathA AlAdA| tArA yakhana ImAna Ane takhana Ami tule nei tAdera upara theke apamAnajanaka AyAva-pArthiva jIvane evaM tAdera ke kalyANa peৗchAi eka nidhArita samaYa paryanta|
Ara teAmAra paraoYAradegAra yadi cAitena, tave pRthivIra vuke yArA raYeche, tAdera savAi ImAna niYe Asate samavetabhAve| tumi ki mAnuSera upara javaradastI karave ImAna AnAra janya?
Ara kAreA ImAna AnA hate pAre nA, yatakSaNa nA AllAhara hukuma haYa| pakSAntare tini apavitratA AreApa karena yArA vuddhi praYeAga kare nA tAdera upara|
tAhale Apani vale dina, ceYe dekha teA AsamAnasamuhe o yamIne ki raYeche| Ara keAna nidarzana evaM keAna bhItiprardazanai keAna kAje Ase nA sesava leAkera janya yArA mAnya kare nA|
sutarAM ekhana Ara emana kichu nei, yAra apekSA karave, kintu sesava dinera matai dina, yA atIta haYe geche era pUrve| Apani valuna; ekhana patha dekha; Amio teAmAdera sAthe patha ceYe railAma|
ataHpara Ami vA~ciYe nei nijera rasUlagaNake evaM tAderake yArA ImAna eneche emanibhAve| ImAnadAradera vA~ciYe neYA AmAra dAYitvao vaTe|

vale dAo-he mAnavakula, teAmarA yadi AmAra dvInera vyApAre sandihAna haYe thAka, tave (jeneA) Ami tAdera evAdata kari nA yAdera evAdata teAmarA kara AllAha vyatIta| kintu Ami evAdata kari AllAha ta’YAlAra, yini tule nena teAmAderake| Ara AmAra prati nirdeza haYeche yAte Ami ImAnadAradera antarbhukta thAki|
Ara yena seAjA dvInera prati mukha kari sarala haYe evaM yena muzarekadera antarbhukta nA hai|
Ara nirdeza haYeche AllAha vyatIta emana kAuke DAkave nA, ye teAmAra bhAla karave nA mandao karave nA| vastutaH tumi yadi emana kAja kara, tAhale takhana tumio jAlemadera antarbhukta haYe yAve|

Ara AllAha yadi teAmAra upara keAna kaSTa AreApa karena tAhale keu nei tA khanDAvAra mata tA~ke chAr3A| pakSAntare yadi tini kichu kalyANa dAna karena, tave tAra meheravAnIke rahita karAra matao keu nei| tini yAra prati anugraha dAna karate cAna svIYa vAndAdera madhye tAkei dAna karena; vastuta; tinii kSamAzIla daYAlu|

vale dAo, he mAnavakula, satya teAmAdera kAche pau~che geche teAmAdera paraoYAradegArera tarapha theke| emana ye keu pathe Ase sepatha prApta haYa svIYa maGgalera janya| Ara ye vibhrAnta ghurate thAke, se svIYa amaGgalera janya vibhrAnta avasthAYa ghurate thAkave| anantara Ami teAmAdera upara adhikArI nai|
Ara tumi cala se anuyAYI yemana nirdeza Ase teAmAra prati evaM savara kara, yatakSaNa nA phaYasAlA karena AllAha| vastutaH tini hacchena sarveAttama phaYasAlAkArI|
Alipha, lA-ma, rA; eTi emana eka kitAva, yAra AYAta samUha supratiSThita ataHpara savistAre varNita eka mahAjJAnI, sarvajJa sattAra pakSa hate|
yena teAmarA AllAha vyatIta anya kAreA vandegI nA kara| nizcaYa Ami teAmAdera prati tA~rai pakSa hate satarkakArI o susaMvAda dAtA|

Ara teAmarA nijedera pAlanakartA samIpe kSamA prArthanA kara| anantara tA~rai prati maneAniveza kara| tAhale tini teAmAderake nirdiSTa samaYa paryanta utkRSTa jIvaneApakaraNa dAna karavena evaM adhika AmalakArIke vezI kare devena Ara yadi teAmarA vimukha hate thAka, tave Ami teAmAdera upara eka mahA divasera AyAvera AzaGkA karachi|
AllAhara sAnnidhyei teAmAderake phire yete have| Ara tini sava kichura upara kSamatAvAna|

jene rAkha, nizcaYai tArA nijedera vakSadeza ghuriYe deYa yena AllAhara nikaTa hate lukAte pAre| zuna, tArA takhana kApar3e nijederake AcchAdita kare, tini takhanao jAnena yA kichu tArA cupisAre vale Ara prakAzyabhAve vale| nizcaYa tini jAnena yA kichu antara samUhe nihita raYeche|
Ara pRthivIte keAna vicaraNazIla nei, tave savAra jIvikAra dAYitva AllAha niYechena tini jAnena tArA keAthAYa thAke evaM keAthAYa samApita haYa| savakichui eka suvinyasta kitAve raYeche|

tinii AsamAna o yamIna chaYa dine tairI karechena, tA~ra Araza chila pAnira upare, tini teAmAderake parIkSA karate cAna ye, teAmAdera madhye ke savaceYe bhAla kAja kare| Ara yadi Apani tAderake valena ye, "nizcaYa teAmAderake mRtyura pare jIvita oThAneA have, takhana kAphererA avazya vale eTA teA spaSTa yAdu!";

Ara yadi Ami eka nirdhArita meYAda paryanta tAdera AyAva sthagita rAkhi, tAhale tArA nizcaYai valave keAna jinise AyAva ThekiYe rAkhache? zune rAkha, yedina tAdera upara AyAva ese par3ave, sedina kintu tA phire yAoYAra naYa; tArA ye vyApAre upahAsa karata tAi tAderake ghire phelave|
Ara avazyai yadi Ami mAnuSake AmAra rahamatera AsvAda grahaNa karate dei, ataHpara tA tAra theke chiniYe nei; tAhale se hatAza o kRtaghna haYa|
Ara yadi tAra upara Apatita duHkha kaSTera pare tAke sukhabheAga karate dei, tave se valate thAke ye, AmAra amaGgala dUra haYe geche, Ara se Anande AtnahArA haYa, ahaGkAre uddata haYe par3e|
tave yArA dhairyyadhAraNa kareche evaM satkArya kareche tAdera janya kSamA o virATa pratidAna raYeche|

Ara sambhavataH aisava AhakAma yA ohIra mAdhyame teAmAra nikaTa pAThAneA haYa, tAra kichu aMza varjana karave? evaM ete mana cheATa kare vasave? tAdera e kathAYa ye, tA~ra upara keAna dhana-bhAnDAra kena avatIrNa haYani? athavA tA~ra sAthe keAna pherezatA Aseni kena? tumiteA zudhu satarkakArI mAtra; Ara sava kichurai dAYitvabhAra teA AllAhai niYechena|
tArA ki vale? keAraAna tumi tairI karecha? tumi vala, tave teAmarAo anurUpa dazaTi sUrA tairI kare niYe Asa evaM AllAha chAr3A yAke pAra Deke nAo, yadi teAmAdera kathA satya haYe thAke|

ataHpara tArA yadi teAmAdera kathA puraNa karate apAraga haYa; tave jene rAkha, eTi AllAhara elama dvArA avatIrNa haYeche; AreA ekIna kare nAo ye, AllAha vyatIta anya keAna mAvuda nei| ataeva, ekhana ki teAmarA Atnasamarpana karave?
ye vyakti pArthivajIvana o tAra cAkacikyai kAmanA kare, haYa Ami tAdera duniYAtei tAdera Amalera pratiphala bheAga kariYe deva evaM tAte tAdera prati kichumAtra kamati karA haYa nA|
erAi hala sesava leAka AkherAte yAdera janya Aguna chAr3A nei| tArA ekhAne yA kichu karechila savai varavAda kareche; Ara yA kichu upArjana karechila, savai vinaSTa hala|

AcchA vala teA, ye vyakti tAra prabhura suspaSTa pathe raYeche, Ara sAthe sAthe AllAhara tarapha theke ekaTi sAkSIo vartamAna raYeche evaM tAra pUrvavartI mUsA (AH) era kitAvao sAkSI yA chila pathanirdezaka o rahamata svarUpa, (tini ki anyAnyera samAna) ataeva tA~rA keAraAnera prati ImAna Anena| Ara aisava dalaguli ye keu tA asvIkAra kare, deAyakhai have tAra ThikAnA| ataeva, Apani tAte keAna sandehe thAkavena nA| niHsandehe tA ApanAra pAlanakartAra pakSa hate dhruva satya; tathApi anekei tA vizvAsa kare nA|

Ara tAdera ceYe var3a yAlema ke hate pAre, yArA AllAhara prati mithyAreApa kare| esava leAkake tAdera pAlanakartAra sAkSAta sammUkhIna karA have Ara sAkSigaNa valate thAkave, erAi aisava leAka, yArA tAdera pAlanakartAra prati mithyAreApa karechila| zune rAkha, yAlemadera upara AllAhara abhisampAta raYeche|
yArA AllAhara pathe vAdhA deYa, Ara tAte vakratA khuje ver3AYa, erAi AkharAtake asvIkAra kare|
tArA pRthivIteo AllAhake apAraga karate pArave nA evaM AllAha vyatIta tAdera keAna sAhAyyakArIo nei, tAdera janya dviguNa zAsti raYeche; tArA zunate pArata nA evaM dekhateo peta nA|
erA se leAka, yArA nijerAi nijederake kSatigrasta kareche, Ara erA yA kichu mithyA mA’vuda sAvyasta karechila, tA savai tAdera theke hAriYe geche|
AkherAte erAi have sarvAdhika kSatigrastha keAna sandeha nei|
nizcaYai yArA ImAna eneche o satkAja kareche evaM svIYa pAlanakartAra samIpe vinati prakAza kareche tArAi vehezatavAsI, sekhAnei tArA cirakAla thAkave|
ubhaYa pakSera dRSTAnta hacche yemana andha o vadhira evaM ye dekhate pAYa o zunate pAYa ubhaYera avasthA ki eka samAna? tavuo teAmarA ki bheve dekha nA?
Ara avazyai Ami nUha (AH) ke tA~ra jAtira prati preraNa karechi, (tini valalena) nizcaYa Ami teAmAdera janya prakAzya satarkakArI|
teAmarA AllAha vyatIta kAreA evAdata karave nA| nizcaYa Ami teAmAdera vyApAre eka yantraNAdAYaka dinera AyAvera bhaYa karachi|

takhana tA~ra kaomera kAphera pradhAnarA valala AmarA teA ApanAke AmAdera mata ekajana mAnuSa vyatIta Ara kichu mane kari nA; Ara AmAdera madhye yArA itara o sthula-vuddhisampanna tArA vyatIta kAuke teA ApanAra Anugatya karate dekhi nA evaM AmAdera upara ApanAdera kena prAdhAnya dekhi nA, varaM ApanArA savAi mithyAvAdI vale AmArA mane kari|

nUha (AH) valalena-he AmAra jAti! dekha teA Ami yadi AmAra pAlanakartAra pakSa hate spaSTa dalIlera upara thAka, Ara tini yadi tA~ra pakSa hate AmAke rahamata dAna kare thAkena, tArapareo tA teAmAdera ceAkhe nA par3e, tAhale Ami ki uhA teAmAdera upara teAmAdera icchAra viruddhei cApiYe dite pAri?

Ara he AmAra jAti! Ami teA ejanya teAmAdera kAche keAna artha cAi nA; AmAra pArizramika teA AllAhara jimmAYa raYeche| Ami kintu ImAnadAradera tAr3iYe dite pAri nA| tArA avazyai tAdera pAlanakartAra sAkSAta lAbha karave| varaJca teAmAderai Ami ajJa sampradAYa dekhachi|
Ara he AmAra jAti! Ami yadi tAdera tAr3iYe dei tAhale AmAke AllAha hate rehAi deve ke? teAmarA ki cintA kare dekha nA?

Ara Ami teAmAderake vali nA ye, AmAra kAche AllAhara bhAnDAra raYeche evaM ekathAo vali nA ye, Ami gAYavI khavarao jAni; ekathAo vali nA ye, Ami ekajana pherezatA; Ara teAmAdera dRSTite yArA lAJchita AllAha tAdera keAna kalyANa dAna karavena nA| tAdera manera kathA AllAha bhAla karei jAnena| sutarAM emana kathA valale Ami anyAYa kArI hava|

tArA valala-he nUha! AmAdera sAthe Apani tarka karechena evaM aneka kalaha karechena| ekhana ApanAra sei AyAva niYe Asuna, ye samparke Apani AmAdigake satarka karechena, yadi Apani satyavAdI haYe thAkena|
tini valena, uhA teAmAdera kAche AllAhai Anavena, yadi tini icchA karena takhana teAmarA pAliYe tA~ke apAraga karate pArave nA|
Ara Ami teAmAdera nasIhata karate cAileo tA teAmAdera janya phalaprasU have nA, yadi AllAha teAmAderake geAmarAha karate cAna; tinii teAmAdera pAlanakartA evaM tA~ra kAchei teAmAdera phire yete have|
tArA ki vale? Apani keAraAna racanA kare enechena? Apani vale dina Ami yadi racanA kare ene thAki, tave se aparAdha AmAra, Ara teAmarA yesava aparAdha kara tAra sAthe AmAra keAna samparka nei|
Ara nUha (AH) era prati ohI preraNa karA haleA ye, yArA itimadhyei ImAna eneche tAdera chAr3A ApanAra jAtira anya keu ImAna AnavenA etaeva tAdera kAryakalApe vimarSa havena nA|
Ara Apani AmAra sammukhe AmArai nirdeza meAtAveka ekaTi neৗkA tairI karuna evaM pApiSThadera vyApAre AmAke keAna kathA valavena nA| avazyai tArA Duve marave|

tini neৗkA tairI karate lAgalena, Ara tA~ra kaomera netRsthAnIYa vyaktirA yakhana pArzva diYe yeta, takhana tA~ke vidrupa karata| tini valalena, teAmarA yadi AmAdera upahAsa kare thAka, tave teAmarA yemana upahAsa karacha AmarAo tadrupa teAmAdera upahAsa karachi|
ataHpara acirei jAnate pArave-lAJchanAjanaka AyAva kAra upara Ase evaM cirasthAYI AyAva kAra upara avataraNa kare|

avazeSe yakhana AmAra hukuma ese pau~chAla evaM bhupRSTha ucchasita haYe uThala, Ami valalAmaH sarvaprakAra jeAr3Ara duTi kare evaM yAdera upare pUrvAhnei hukuma haYe geche tAdera vAdi diYe, ApanAra parijanavarga o sakala ImAnadAragaNake neৗkAYa tule nina| valAvAhulya ati alpasaMkhyaka leAkai tA~ra sAthe ImAna enechila|
Ara tini valalena, teAmarA ete AreAhana kara| AllAhara nAmei era gati o sthiti| AmAra pAlanakartA ati kSamAparAYana, meheravAna|

Ara neৗkAkhAni tAdera vahana kare calala parvata pramANa taraGgamAlAra mAjhe, Ara nUha (AH) tA~ra putrake DAka dilena Ara se sare raYechila, tini valalena, priYa vatsa! AmAdera sAthe AreAhana kara evaM kApheradera sAthe thekeA nA|

se valala, Ami acirei keAna pAhAr3e AzraYa neva, yA AmAke pAni hate rakSA karave| nUha (AH) vallena Ajakera dine AllAhara hukuma theke keAna rakSAkArI nei| ekamAtra tini yAke daYA karavena| emana samaYa ubhaYera mAjhe taraGga Ar3Ala haYe dA~r3Ala, phale se nimajjita hala|

Ara nirdeza deYA hala-he pRthivI! teAmAra pAni gile phela, Ara he AkAza, kSAnta hao| Ara pAni hrAsa karA hala evaM kAja zeSa haYe gela, Ara judI parvate neৗkA bhir3ala evaM gheASanA karA hala, durAtnA kApherarA nipAta yAka|
Ara nUha (AH) tA~ra pAlanakartAke Deke valalena-he paraoYAradegAra, AmAra putra teA AmAra parijanadera antarbhukta; Ara ApanAra oYAdAo niHsandehe satya Ara Apanii sarvApekSA vijJa phaYasAlAkArI|

AllAha valena, he nUha! nizcaYa se ApanAra parivArabhukta naYa| nizcai se durAcAra! sutarAM AmAra kAche emana darakhAsta karavena nA, yAra khavara Apani jAnena nA| Ami ApanAke upadeza dicchi ye, Apani ajJadera dalabhukta havena nA|

nUha (AH) valena-he AmAra pAlanakartA AmAra yA jAnA nei emana keAna darakhAsta karA hate Ami ApanAra kAchei AzraYa prArthanA karachi| Apani yadi AmAke kSamA nA karena, daYA nA karena, tAhale Ami kSatigrasta hava|

hukuma hala-he nUha (AH)! AmAra pakSa hate nirApattA evaM ApanAra nijera o saGgIYa sampradAYagulira upara varakata sahakAre avataraNa karuNa| Ara anyAnya yesava sampradAYa raYeche Ami tAdera keo upakRta hate deva| ataHpara tAdera upara AmAra daruna AyAva Apatita have|

eTi gAYavera khavara, Ami ApanAra prati ohI prerana karachi| itipUrve eTA ApanAra evaM ApanAra jAtira jAnA chila nA| Apani dhairyyadhAraNa karuna| yArA bhaYa kare cale, tAdera pariNAma bhAla, sandeha nei|
Ara Ada jAtira prati Ami tAdera bhAi hudake preraNa karechi; tini valena-he AmAra jAti, AllAhara vandegI kara, tini bhinna teAmAdera keAna mAvuda nei, teAmarA savAi mithyA AreApa karacha|
he AmAra jAti! Ami ejanya teAmAdera kAche keAna majurI cAi nA; AmAra majurI tA~rai kAche yini AmAke paYadA karechena; tavu teAmarA kena veAjha nA?

Ara he AmAra kaoma! teAmAdera pAlana kartAra kAche teAmarA kSamA prArthanA kara, ataHpara tA~rai prati maneAniveza kara; tini AsamAna theke teAmAdera upara vRSTi dhArA preraNa karavena evaM teAmAdera zaktira upara zakti vRddhi karavena, teAmarA kintu aparAdhIdera mata vimukha haYeA nA|
tArA valala-he huda, tumi AmAdera kAche keAna pramANa niYe Asa nAi, AmarA teAmAra kathAYa AmAdera deva-devIdera varjana karate pAri nA Ara AmarA teAmAra prati ImAna AnaYanakArIo nai|

varaM AmarAo teA vali ye, AmAdera keAna devatA teAmAra upare zeAcanIYa bhUta cApiYe diYeche| huda valalena-Ami AllAhake sAkSI karechi Ara teAmAo sAkSI thAka ye, AmAra keAna samparka nAi tA~dera sAthe yAdera ke teAmarA zarika karacha;
tAke chAr3A, teAmarA savAi mile AmAra aniSTa karAra praYAsa cAlAo, ataHpara AmAke keAna avakAza dio nA|

Ami AllAhara upara nizcita bharasA karechi yini AmAra evaM teAmAdera paraoYAradegAra| pRthivIra vuke vicaraNakArI emana keAna prANI nAi yA tA~ra rpUNa AYattAdhIna naYa| AmAra pAlakartAra sarala pathe sandeha nei|

tathApi yadi teAmarA mukha pherAo, tave Ami teAmAderake tA peৗchiYechi yA AmAra kAche teAmAdera prati prerita haYeche; Ara AmAra pAlanakartA anya keAna jAtike teAmAdera sthalAbhiSikta karavena, Ara teAmarA tA~ra kichui vigar3Ate pArave nA; nizcaYai AmAra paraoYAradegArai pratiTi vastura hephAjatakArI|
Ara AmAra Adeza yakhana upasthita hala, takhana Ami nija rahamate huda evaM tA~ra saGgI ImAnadAragaNake paritrANa kari evaM tAderake eka kaThina zAsti theke rakSA kari|
e chila Ada jAti, yArA tAdera pAlanakartAra AYAtake amAnya kareche, Ara tadIYa rasUlagaNera avAdhyatA kareche evaM pratyeka uddhata vireAdhIdera Adeza pAlana kareche|
e duniYAYa tAdera pichane pichane lA’nata raYeche evaM keYAmatera dineo; jene rAkha, Ada jAti tAdera pAlanakartAke asvIkAra kareche, hudera jJAti Ada jAtira prati abhisampAta raYeche jene rAkha|

Ara sAmuda jAti prati tAdera bhAi sAleha ke preraNa kari; tini valalena, he AmAra jAti| AllAhara vandegI kara, tini chAr3A teAmAdera keAna upAsya nAi| tinii yamIna hate teAmAderake paYadA karechena, tanmadhye teAmAderake vasati dAna karechena| ataeva; tA~ra kAche kSamA prArthanA kara ataHpara tA~rai dike phire cala AmAra pAlanakartA nikaTei Achena, kavula kare thAkena; sandeha nei|

tArA valala-he sAleha, itipUrve teAmAra kAche AmAdera var3a AzA chila| AmAdera vApa-dAdA yA pUjA karata tumi ki AmAderake tAra pUjA karate niSedha kara? kintu yAra prati tumi AmAdera AhavAna jAnAccha AmAdera tAte emana sandeha raYeche ye, mana meATei sAYa dicche nA|

sAleha valalena-he AmAra jAti! teAmarA ki mane kara, Ami yadi AmAra pAlanakartAra pakSa hate vuddhi vivecanA lAbha kare thAki Ara tini yadi AmAke nijera tarapha hate rahamata dAna kare thAkena, ataHpara Ami yadi tA~ra avAdhya hai tave tAra theke ke AmAYa rakSA karave? teAmarA teA AmAra kSati chAr3A kichui vRddhi karate parave nA

Ara he AmAra jAti! AllAhara e uSTrITi teAmAdera janya nidarzana, ataeva tAke AllAhara yamIne vicaraNa kare khete dAo, evaM tAke mandabhAve sparzao karave nA| natuvA ati satvara teAmAderake AyAva pAkar3Ao karave|
tavu tArA uhAra pA keTe dila| takhana sAleha valalena-teAmarA nijedera gRhe tinaTi dina upabheAga kare nAo| ihA emana oYAdA yA mithyA have nA|

ataHpara AmAra AyAva yakhana upasthita hala, takhana Ami sAlehake o tadIYa saGgI ImAnadAragaNake nija rahamate uddhAra kari, evaM sedinakAra apamAna hate rakSA kari| nizcaYa teAmAra pAlanakartA tini sarvazaktimAna parAkramazAlI|
Ara bhaYaGkara garjana pApiSThadera pAkar3Ao karala, phale bheAra hate nA hatei tArA nija nija gRhasamUhe upura haYe par3e raila|
yena tA~rA keAnadinai sekhAne chila nA| jene rAkha, nizcaYa sAmuda jAti tAdera pAlanakartAra prati asvIkAra karechila| AreA zune rAkha, sAmuda jAtira janya abhizApa raYeche|
Ara avazyai AmAra prerita pherezatArA ivrAhImere kAche susaMvAda niYe esechila tArA valala sAlAma, tinio valalena-sAlAma| ataHpara alpakSaNera madhyei tini ekaTi bhunA karA vAchura niYe elena!

kintu yakhana dekhalena ye, AhAryyera dike tAdera hasta prasArita hacche nA, takhana tini sandhigdha halena evaM mane mane tA~dera samparke bhaYa anubhava karate lAgalena| tArA valala-bhaYa pAvena nA| AmarA lUtera kaomera prati prerita haYechi|
tA~ra strIo nikaTei dAr3iYechila, se hese phelala| ataHpara Ami tAke isahAkera janmera sukhavara dilAma evaM isahAkera parera iYAkuverao|
se valala-ki durbhAgya AmAra! Ami santAna prasava karava? athaca Ami vArdhakyera zeSa prAnte ese upanIta haYechi Ara AmAra svAmIo vRddha, eteA bhArI Azcarya kathA|
tArA valala-tumi AllAhara hukuma samparke vismaYaveAdha karacha? he gRhavAsIrA, teAmAdera upara AllAhara rahamata o prabhuta varakata raYeche| nizcaYa AllAha prazaMsita mahimAmaYa|
ataHpara yakhana ivrAhIma (AH) era AtaGka dUra hala evaM tini susaMvAda prApta halena, takhana tini AmAra sAthe tarka zuru karalena kaome lUta samparke|
ivrAhIma (AH) var3ai dhairyyazIla, keAmala antara, AllAhamukhI sandeha nei|
ivrAhIma, ehena dhAraNA parihAra kara; teAmAra pAlanakartAra hukuma ese geche, evaM tAdera upara se AyAva avazyai Apatita have, yA kakhaneA pratihata havAra naYa|
Ara yakhana AmAra prerita pherezatAgaNa lUta (AH) era nikaTa upasthita hala| takhana tA~dera Agamane tini ducintAgrasta halena evaM tini valate lAgalena, Aja atyanta kaThina dina|

Ara tA~ra kaomera leAkerA svataHsphurtabhAve tAra (gRha) pAne chuTe Asate lAgala| pUrva thekei tArA ku-karme tatpara chila| lUta (AH) valalena-he AmAra kaoma, e AmAra kanyArA raYeche, erA teAmAdera janya adhika pavitratamA| sutarAM teAmarA AllAhake bhaYa kara evaM atithidera vyApAre AmAke lajjita kareA nA, teAmAdera madhye ki keAna bhAla mAnuSa nei|
tArA valala u tumi teA jAnai, teAmAra kanyAdera niYe AmAdera keAna garaja nei| Ara AmarA ki cAi, tAo tumi avazyai jAna|
lUta (AH) valalena-hAYa, teAmAdera viruddhe yadi AmAra zakti thAkata athavA Ami keAna sUdRr3ha AzraYa grahaNa karate sakSama hatAma|

mehamAna pherezatAgana valala-he lUta (AH) AmarA teAmAdera pAlanakartAra pakSa hate prerita pherezatA| erA kakhaneA teAmAra dike pau~chAte pArave nA| vyasa tumi kichuTA rAta thAkate thAkate nijera leAkajana niYe vAire cale yAo| Ara teAmAdera keu yena pichane phire nA tAkAYa| kintu teAmAra strI nizcaYa tAra uparao tA Apatita have, yA odera upara Apatita have| bheAra velAi tAdera pratizrutira samaYa, bheAra ki khuva nikaTe naYa?
avazeSe yakhana AmAra hukuma ese pau~chAla, takhana Ami ukta janapadake uparake nIce kare dilAma evaM tAra upara stare stare kA~kara pAthara varSaNa karalAma|
yAra pratiTi teAmAra pAlanakartAra nikaTa cihnita chila| Ara sei pApiSThadera theke khuva dUreo naYa|

Ara mAdaiYAnavAsIdera prati tAdera bhAi zeAYAYeva (AH) ke preraNa karechi| tini valalena-he AmAra kaoma! AllAhara vandegI kara, tini chAr3A AmAdera keAna mAvuda nAi| Ara parimApe o ojane kama dio nA, Aja Ami teAmAderake bhAla avasthAYai dekhachi, kintu Ami teAmAdera upara emana ekadinera AyAvera AzaGkA karachi yedinaTi pariveSTanakArI|
Ara he AmAra jAti, nyAYaniSThAra sAthe ThikabhAve parimApa kara o ojana dAo evaM leAkadera jinisapatre keAnarUpa kSati kareA nA, Ara pRthivIte phAsAda kare ver3Ave nA|
AllAha pradatta uddhRtta teAmAdera janya uttama, yadi teAmarA ImAnadAra hao, Ara Ami teA teAmAdera upara sadA paryavekSaNakArI nai|

tArA valala-he zeAYAYeva (AH) ApanAra nAmAya ki ApanAke ihAi zikSA deYa ye, AmarA aisava upAsyaderake parityAga karava AmAdera vApa-dAdArA yAdera upAsanA karata? athavA AmAdera dhana-sampade icchAmata yA kichu kare thAki, tA cher3e deva? Apani teA ekajana khAsa mahat vyakti o satpathera pathika|

zeAYAYeva (AH) valalena-he dezavAsI, teAmarA ki mane kara! Ami yadi AmAra paraoYAradegArera pakSa hate suspaSTa dalIlera upara kAYema thAki Ara tini yadi nijera tarapha hate AmAke uttama riyika dAna kare thAkena, (tave ki Ami tA~ra hukuma amAnya karate pAri?) Ara Ami cAi nA ye teAmAderake yA chAr3Ate cAi pare nijei se kAje lipta hava, Ami teA yathAsAdhya zeAdharAte cAi| AllAhara madada dvArAi kintu kAja haYe thAke, Ami tA~ra uparai nirbhara kari evaM tA~rai prati phire yAi|
Ara he AmAra jAti! AmAra sAthe jida kare teAmarA nUha vA huda athavA sAleha (AH) era kaomera mata nijedera upara AyAva Deke Anave nA| Ara lUtera jAti teA teAmAdera theke khuva dUre naYa|
Ara teAmAdera pAlanakartAra kAche mArjanA cAo evaM tA~rai pAne phire eseA nizcaYai AmAra paraoYAradegAra khuvai meheravAna atisnehamaYa|

tArA valala-he zeAYAYeva (AH) Apani yA valechena tAra aneka kathAi AmarA vujhi nAi, AmArA teA ApanAke AmAdera madhye dUrvala vyakti rUpe mane kari| ApanAra bhAi vandhurA nA thAkale AmarA ApanAke prastarAghAte hatyA karatAma| AmAdera dRSTite Apani keAna maryAdAvAna vyakti nana|

zeAYAYeva (AH) valena-he AmAra jAti, AmAra bhAi vandhurA ki teAmAdera kAche AllAhara ceYe prabhAvazAlI? Ara teAmarA tAke vismRta haYe pechane phele rekhecha, nizcaYa teAmAdera kAryakalApa AmAra pAlanakartAra AYatte raYeche|

Ara he AmAra jAti, teAmarA nija sthAne kAja kare yAo, Amio kAja karachi, acirei jAnate pArave kAra upara apamAnakara AyAva Ase Ara ke mithyAvAdI? Ara teAmarAo apekSAYa thAka, Amio teAmAdera sAthe apekSAYa railAma|

Ara AmAra hukuma yakhana ela, Ami zeAYAYeva (AH) o tA~ra saGgI ImAnadAragaNake nija rahamate rakSA kari Ara pApiSThadera upara vikaTa garjana patita haleA| phale bheAra nA hatei tArA nijedera ghare upur3a haYe par3e raila|
yena tArA sekhAne kakhaneA vasavAsai kare nAi| jene rAkha, sAmudera prati abhisampAtera mata mAdaiYAnavAsIra upareo abhisampAta|
Ara Ami mUsA (AH) ke preraNa kari AmAra nidarzanAdi o suspaSTa sanadasaha;
pherAuna o tAra pAriSadavargera kAche, tavuo tArA pherAunera hukume calate thAke, athaca pherAunera keAna kathA nyAYa saGgata chila nA|
keYAmatera dina se tAra jAtira leAkadera Age Age thAkave evaM tAderake jAhAnnAmera Agune pau~che dive| Ara seTA atIva nikRSTa sthAna, sekhAne tArA peৗ~cheche||
Ara e jagateo tAdera pechane lAnata raYeche evaM kiYAmatera dineo; atyanta jaghanya pratiphala, yA tArA peYeche|
e hacche kaYekaTi janapadera sAmAnya itivRtta, yA Ami ApanAke zeAnAcchi| tanmadhye keAna keAnaTi ekhanao vartamAna Ache Ara keAna keAnaTira zikar3a keTe deYA haYeche|

Ami kintu tAdera prati juluma kari nAi varaM tArA nijerAi nijera upara avicAra kareche| phale AllAhake vAda diYe tArA yesava mAvudake DAkateA ApanAra pAlanakartAra hukuma yakhana ese par3ala, takhana keu keAna kAje Asala nA| tArA zudhu viparyaYai vRddhi karala|
Ara teAmAra paraoYAradegAra yakhana keAna pApapUrNa janapadake dharena, takhana emanibhAvei dhare thAkena| nizcaYa tA~ra pAkar3Ao khuvai mArAtnaka, var3ai kaTheAra|
nizcaYa ihAra madhye nidarzana raYeche emana pratiTi mAnuSera janya ye AkherAtera AyAvake bhaYa kare| uhA emana ekadina, ye dina sava mAnuSei samaveta have, sedinaTi ye hAyirera dina|
Ara Ami ye uhA vilamvita kari, tA zudhu ekaTi oYAdAra kAraNe yA nirdhArita raYeche|
yedina tA Asave sedina AllAhara anumati chAr3A keu keAna kathA valate pAre nA| ataHpara kichu leAka have hatabhAgya Ara kichu leAka seৗbhAgyavAna|
ataeva yArA hatabhAgya tArA deAyakhe yAve, sekhAne tArA ArtanAda o citkAra karate thAkave|
tArA sekhAne cirakAla thAkave, yatadina AsamAna o yamIna vartamAna thAkave| tave teAmAra pratipAlaka anya kichu icchA karale bhinna kathA| nizcaYa teAmAra paraoYAradegAra yA icchA karate pArena|

Ara yArA seৗbhAgyavAna tArA vehezatera mAjhe, sekhAnei ciradina thAkave, yatadina AsamAna o yamIna vartamAna thAkave| tave teAmAra prabhu anya kichu icchA karale bhinna kathA| e dAnera dhArAvAhikatA kakhaneA chinna haoYAra naYa|

ataeva, tArA yesavera upAsanA kare tumi se vyApAre keAnarUpa dheA~kAYa par3ave nA| tAdera pUrvavartI vApa-dAdArA yemana pUjA upAsanA karata, erAo temana karache| Ara nizcaYa Ami tAderake AyAvera bhAga kichu mAtrao kama nA karei pureApuri dAna karaveA|

Ara Ami mUsA (AH)-ke avazyai kitAva diYechilAma ataHpara tAte vireAdha sRSTi hala; valAvAhulya teAmAra pAlanakartAra pakSa hate, ekaTi kathA yadi Agei valA nA hata, tAhale tAdera madhye cur3Anta phaYasAlA haYe yeta tArA e vyApAre emanai sandeha pravaNa ye, kichutei nizcita hate pArache nA|
Ara yata leAkai heAka nA kena, yakhana samaYa have, teAmAra prabhu tAdera sakalerai Amalera pratidAna pureApuri dAna karavena| nizcaYa tini tAdera yAvatIYa kAryakalApera khavara rAkhena|

ataeva, tumi evaM teAmAra sAthe yArA taovA kareche savAi seAjA pathe cale yAo-yemana teAmAYa hukuma deYA haYeche evaM sImA laGghana karave nA, teAmarA yA kichu karacha, nizcaYa tini tAra prati dRSTi rAkhena|
Ara pApiSThadera prati jhu~kave nA| natuvA teAmAderakeo Agune dharave| Ara AllAha vyatIta teAmAdera keAna vandhu nAi| ataeva keAthAo sAhAyya pAve nA|
Ara dinera dui prAntei nAmAya Thika rAkhave, evaM rAtera prAntabhAge pUrNa kAja avazyai pApa dUra kare deYa, yArA smaraNa rAkhe tAdera janya eTi eka mahA smAraka|
Ara dhairyyadhAraNa kara, nizcaYai AllAha pUNyavAnadera pratidAna vinaSTa karena nA|

kAjei, teAmAdera pUrvavatI jAti gulira madhye emana satkarmazIla kena raila nA, yArA pRthivIte viparyaYa sRSTi karate vAdhA dita; tave muSTimeYa leAka chila yAderake Ami tAdera madhya hate rakSA karechi| Ara pApiSTharA teA bheAga vilAse matta chila yAra sAmagrI tAderake yatheSTa deYA haYechila| Asale tArA chila mahA aparAdhI|
Ara teAmAra pAlanakartA emana nana ye, janavasatiguleAke anyAYabhAve dhvaMsa kare devena, sekhAnakAra leAkerA satkarmazIla haoYA sattveo|
Ara teAmAra pAlanakartA yadi icchA karatena, tave avazyai sava mAnuSake ekai jAtisattAYa parinata karate pAratena Ara tArA vibhinna bhAge vibhakta hateA nA|

teAmAra pAlanakartA yAdera upara rahamata karechena, tArA vyatIta savAi ciradina matabheda karatei thAkave evaM ejanyai tAderake sRSTi karechena| Ara teAmAra AllAhara kathAi pUrNa hala ye, avazyai Ami jAhAnnAmake jvina o mAnuSa dvArA ekayeAge bharti karava|
Ara Ami rasUlagaNera sava vRttAntai teAmAke valachi, yaddvArA teAmAra antarake majavuta karachi| Ara ebhAve teAmAra nikaTa mahAsatya evaM ImAnadAradera janya nasIhata o svaraNIYa viSaYavastu eseche|
Ara yArA ImAna Ane nA, tAderake vale dAo ye, teAmarA nija nija avasthAYa kAja kare yAo AmarAo kAja kare yAi|
evaM teAmarAo apekSA kare thAka, AmarAo apekSAYa railAma|

Ara AllAhara kAchei Ache AsamAna o yamInera geApana tathya; Ara sakala kAjera pratyAvartana tA~rai dike; ataeva, tA~rai vandegI kara evaM tA~ra upara bharasA rAkha, Ara teAmAdera kAryakalApa samvandhe teAmAra pAlanakartA kintu ve-khavara nana|
Alipha-lA-ma-rA; eguleA suspaSTa granthera AYAta|
Ami eke AravI bhASAYa keAraAna rUpe avatIrNa karechi, yAte teAmarA vujhate pAra|
Ami teAmAra nikaTa uttama kAhinI varNanA karechi, yemate Ami e keAraAna teAmAra nikaTa avatIrNa karechi| tumi era Age avazyai e vyApAre anavahitadera antarbhUkta chile|
yakhana iusupha pitAke valalaH pitA, Ami svapne dekhechi egAraTi nakSatrake| suryake evaM candrake| Ami tAderake AmAra uddeze sejadA karate dekhechi|
tini valalenaH vatsa, teAmAra bhAidera sAmane e svapna varNanA kareA nA| tAhale tArA teAmAra viruddhe cakrAnta karave| nizcaYa zaYatAna mAnuSera prakAzya|

emanibhAve teAmAra pAlanakartA teAmAke maneAnIta karavena evaM teAmAke vANIsamUhera nigur3ha tattva zikSA devena evaM pUrNa karavena svIYa anugraha teAmAra prati o iYAkuva parivAra-parijanera prati; yemana itipUrve teAmAra pitRpuruSa ivrAhIma o isahAkera prati pUrNa karechena| nizcaYa teAmAra pAlanakartA atyanta jJAnI, prajJAmaYa|
avazya iusupha o tA~ra bhAidera kAhinIte jijJAsudera janye nidarzanAvalI raYeche|
yakhana tArA valalaH avazyai iusupha o tA~ra bhAi AmAdera pitAra kAche AmAdera cAite adhika priYa athaca AmarA ekaTA saMhata zakti vizeSa| nizcaYa AmAdera pitA spaSTa bhrAntite raYechena|
hatyA kara iusuphake kiMvA phele Asa tAke anya keAna sthAne| ete zudhu teAmAdera pratii teAmAdera pitAra maneAyeAga niviSTa have evaM erapara teAmarA yeAgya vivecita haYe thAkave|
tAdera madhya theke ekajana valala, teAmarA iusupha ke hatyA kareA nA, varaM phele dAo tAke andhakUpe yAte keAna pathika tAke uThiYe niYe yAYa, yadi teAmAdera kichu karatei haYa|
tArA valalaH pitAH vyApAra ki, Apani iusuphera vyApAre AmAderake vizvAsa karena nA? AmarA teA tAra hitAkAMkhI|
AgAmIkAla tAke AmAdera sAthe preraNa karuna-tRptisaha khAve evaM khelAdhulA karave evaM AmarA avazyai tAra rakSaNAvekSana karava|
tini valalenaH AmAra duzcintA haYa ye, teAmarA tAke niYe yAve evaM Ami AzaGkA kari ye, vyAghra tA~ke kheYe phelave evaM teAmarA tAra dika theke gAphela thAkave|
tArA valalaH AmarA ekaTi bhArI dala thAkA sattveo yadi vyAghra tAke kheYe phele, tave AmarA savai hArAlAma|

ataHpara tArA yakhana tAke niYe calala evaM andhakUpe nikSepa karate ekamata hala evaM Ami tAke iGgita karalAma ye, tumi tAderake tAdera e kAjera kathA valave ematAvasthAYa ye, tArA teAmAke cinave nA|
tArA rAtera velAYa kA~date kA~date pitAra kAche ela|

tArA valalaH pitAH AmarA deৗr3a pratiyeAgitA karate giYechilAma evaM iusuphake AsavAva-patrera kAche rekhe giYechilAma| ataHpara tAke vAghe kheYe pheleche| Apani teA AmAderake vizvAsa karavena nA, yadio AmarA satyavAdI|

evaM tArA tAra jAmAYa kRtrima rakta lAgiYe Anala| valalenaH eTA kakhanai naYa; varaM teAmAdera mana teAmAderake ekaTA kathA sAjiYe diYeche| sutarAM ekhana chavara karAi zreYa| teAmarA yA varNanA karacha, se viSaYe ekamAtra AllAhai AmAra sAhAyya sthala|

evaM ekaTi kAphelA ela| ataHpara tAdera pAni saMgrAhakake preraNa karala| se vAlati phelala| valalaH ki Anandera kathA| e teA ekaTi kizeAra tArA tAke panyadravya gaNya kare geApana kare phelala| AllAha khuva jAnena yA kichu tArA karechila|
orA tAke kama mUlye vikri kare dila ganAguNati kaYeka derahAma evaM tA~ra vyApAre nirAsakta chila|

misare ye vyakti tAke kraYa karala, se tAra strIke valalaH eke sammAne rAkha| sambhavataH se AmAdera kAche Asave athavA AmarA tAke putrarUpe grahaNa kare neva| emanibhAve Ami iusuphake edeze pratiSThita karalAma evaM e janye ye tAke vAkyAdira pUrNa marma anudhAvanera paddhati viSaYe zikSA dei| AllAha nija kAje pravala thAkena, kintu adhikAMza leAka tA jAne nA|
yakhana se pUrNa yeৗvane peৗche gela, takhana tAke prajJA o vyutpatti dAna karalAma| emananibhAve Ami satkarmaparAYaNaderake pratidAna dei|

Ara se ye mahilAra ghare chila, ai mahilA tAke phusalAte lAgala evaM darajAsamUha vandha kare dila| se mahilA valalaH zuna! teAmAke valachi, edike Asa, se valalaH AllAha rakSA karuna; teAmAra svAmI AmAra mAlika| tini AmAke sayatne thAkate diYechena| nizcaYa sImA laMghanakArIgaNa saphala haYa nA|

nizcaYa mahilA tAra viSaYe cintA karechila evaM seo mahilAra viSaYe cintA karata| yadi nA se svIYa pAlanakartAra mahimA avaleAkana karata| emanivAve haYeche, yAte Ami tAra kAcha theke manda viSaYa o nilajja viSaYa sariYe dei| nizcaYa se AmAra maneAnIta vAndAdera ekajana|

tArA ubhaYe chuTe darajAra dike gela evaM mahilA iusuphera jAmA pichana dika theke chi~r3e phelala| ubhaYe mahilAra svAmIke darajAra kAche pela| mahilA valalaH ye vyakti teAmAra parijanera sAthe kukarmera icchA kare, tAke kArAgAre pAThAneA athavA anya keAna yantraNAdAYaka zAsti deYA chAr3A tAra Ara ki zAsti hate pAre?

iusupha (AH) valalena, sei AmAke AtmasaMvaraNa nA karate phusaliYeche| mahilAra parivAre janaika sAkSI dila ye, yadi tAra jAmA sAmanera dika theke chinna thAke, tave mahilA satyavAdinI evaM se mithyAvAdi|
evaM yadi tAra jAmA pechanera dika theke chinna thAke, tave mahilA mithyAvAdinI evaM se satyavAdI|
ataHpara gRhasvAmI yakhana dekhala ye, tAra jAmA pechana dika theke chinna, takhana se valala, nizcaYa eTA teAmAdera chalanA| niHsandehe teAmAdera chalanA khuvai mArAtnaka|
iusupha e prasaGaga chAr3a! Ara he nArI, e pApera janya kSamA prArthanA kara niHsandehe tumi-i pApAcArinI|

nagare mahilArA valAvali karate lAgala ye, AyIyera strI svIYa geAlAmake kumatalava caritArtha karAra janya phusalAYa| se tAra preme ummatta haYe geche| AmarA teA tAke prakAzya bhrAntite dekhate pAcchi|

yakhana se tAdera cakrAnta zunala, takhana tAderake Deke pAThAla evaM tAdera janye ekaTi bheAja sabhAra AYeAjana karala| se tAdera pratyekake ekaTi churi diYe valalaH iusupha edera sAmane cale esa| yakhana tArA tAke dekhala, hatabhamva haYe gela evaM Apana hAta keTe phelala| tArA valalaH kakhanai naYa e vyakti mAnava naYa| e teA keAna mahAna pherezatA|

mahilA valalaH e ai vyakti, yAra janye teAmarA AmAke bhatrsanA karachile| Ami orai mana jaYa karate ceYechilAma| kintu se nijeke nivRtta rekheche| Ara Ami yA Adeza dei, se yadi tA nA kare, tave avazyai se kArAgAre prerita have evaM lAJcita have|

iusupha valalaH he pAlanakartA tArA AmAke ye kAjera dike AhavAna kare, tAra cAite Ami kArAgArai pachanda kari| yadi Apani tAdera cakrAnta AmAra upara theke pratihata nA karena, tave Ami tAdera prati AkRSTa haYe par3ava evaM ajJadera antarbhUkta haYe yAva|
ataHpara tAra pAlanakartA tAra deAYA kavula kare nilena| ataHpara tAdera cakrAnta pratihata karalena| nizcaYa tini sarvazreAtA o sarvajJa|
ataHpara esava nidarzana dekhAra para tArA tAke kichudina kArAgAre rAkhA samIcIna mane karala|

tA~ra sAthe kArAgAre dujana yuvaka praveza karala| tAdera ekajana valalaH Ami svapne dekhalAma ye, Ami mada niGar3Acchi| aparajana valalaH Ami dekhalAma ye, nija mAthAYa ruTi vahana karachi| tA theke pAkhI ThukariYe khAcche| AmAdera ke era vyAkhyA valuna| AmarA ApanAke satkarmazIla dekhate pAcchi|

tini valalenaH teAmAderake pratyaha ye khAdya deYA haYa, tA teAmAdera kAche AsAra Agei Ami tAra vyAkhyA vale deva| e jJAna AmAra pAlanakartA AmAke zikSA diYechena| Ami aisava leAkera dharma parityAga karechi yArA AllAhara prati vizvAsa sthApana kare nA evaM parakAle avizvAsI|

Ami Apana pitRpuruSa ivrAhIma, isahAka o iYAkuvera dharma anusaraNa karachi| AmAdera janya zeAbhA pAYa nA ye, keAna vastuke AllAhara aMzIdAra kari| eTA AmAdera prati evaM anya sava leAkera prati AllAhara anugraha| kinta adhikAMza leAka anugraha svIkAra kare nA|
he kArAgArera saGgIrA! pRthaka pRthaka aneka upAsya bhAla, nA parAkramazAlI eka AllAha?

teAmarA AllAhake cher3e nichaka kataguleA nAmera evAdata kara, seguleA teAmarA evaM teAmAdera vApa-dAdArA sAvyasta kare niYeche| AllAha edera keAna pramANa avatIrNa karenani| AllAha chAr3A kArao vidhAna devAra kSamatA nei| tini Adeza diYechena ye, tini vyatIta anya kArao evAdata kareA nA| eTAi sarala patha| kintu adhikAMza leAka tA jAne nA|

he kArAgArera saGgIrA! teAmAdera ekajana Apana prabhuke madyapAna karAve evaM dvitIYajana, tAke zule car3AneA have| ataHpara tAra mastaka theke pAkhI AhAra karave| teAmarA ye, viSaYe jAnAra AgrahI tAra siddhAnta haYe geche|

ye vyakti samparke dhAraNA chila ye, se mukti pAve, tAke iusupha vale dilaH Apana prabhura kAche AmAra AleAcanA karave| ataHpara zaYatAna tAke prabhura kAche AleAcanAra kathA bhuliYe dila| phale tA~ke kaYeka vachara kArAgAre thAkate hala|

vAdazAha valalaH Ami svapne dekhalAma, sAtaTi meATAtAjA gAbhI-ederake sAtaTi zIrNa gAbhI kheYe yAcche evaM sAtaTi savuja zISa o anyaguleA zuSka| he pariSadavarga! teAmarA AmAke AmAra svapnera vyAkhyA vala, yadi teAmarA svapnera vyAkhyAYa pAradarzI haYe thAka|
tArA valalaH eTA kalpanAprasUta svapna| erUpa svapnera vyAkhyA AmAdera jAnA nei|
du’jana kArAruddhera madhya theke ye vyakti mukti peYechila evaM dIrghakAla para smaraNa hale, se valala, Ami teAmAderake era vyAkhyA valachi| teAmarA AmAke preraNa kara|

se tathAYa pau~che valalaH he iusupha! he satyavAdI! sAtaTi meATAtAjA gAbhI-tAderake khAcche sAtaTi zIrNa gAbhI evaM sAtaTi savuja zIrSa o anyaguleA zuSka; Apani AmAderake e svapna samparke pathanirdeza pradAna karunaH yAte Ami tAdera kAche phire giYe tAdera avagata karAte pAri|
valalaH teAmarA sAta vachara uttama rUpe cASAvAda karave| ataHpara yA kATave, tAra madhye ye sAmAnya parimANa teAmarA khAve tA chAr3A avaziSTa zasya zISa sameta rekhe deve|
evaM erapare Asave dUrbhikSera sAta vachara; teAmarA e dinera janye yA rekhechile, tA kheYe yAve, kintu alpa parimANa vyatIta, yA teAmarA tule rAkhave|
era parei Asave ekavachara-ete mAnuSera upara vRSTi varSita have evaM ete tArA rasa niGar3Ave|
vAdazAha valalaH phire yAo teAmAdera prabhura kAche evaM jijJesa kara tAke ai mahilAra svarUpa ki, yArA svIYa hasta kartana karechila! AmAra pAlanakartA teA tAdera chalanA savai jAnena|

vAdazAha mahilAderake valalenaH teAmAdera hAla-hAkikata ki, yakhana teAmarA iusuphake AtmasaMvaraNa theke phusaliYechile? tArA valalaH AllAha mahAna, AmarA tAra samparke manda kichu jAni nA| AyIya-patmi valalaH ekhana satya kathA prakAza haYe geche| Amii tAke AtmasaMvaraNa theke phusaliYechilAma evaM se satyavAdI|
iusupha valalenaH eTA ejanya, yAte AyIya jene neYa ye, Ami geApane tAra sAthe vizvAsaghAtakatA karini| Arao ei ye, AllAha vizvAsaghAtakadera pratAraNAke egute dena nA|
Ami nijeke nirdeASa vali nA| nizcaYa mAnuSera mana manda karmapravaNa kintu se naYa-AmAra pAlanakartA yAra prati anugraha karena| nizcaYa AmAra pAlanakartA kSamAzIla, daYAlu|

vAdazAha valalaH tAke AmAra kAche niYe eseA| Ami tAke nijera vizvasta sahacara kare rAkhava| ataHpara yakhana tAra sAthe matavinimaYa karala, takhana valalaH nizcaYai Apani AmAra kAche Aja theke vizvasta hisAve maryAdAra sthAna lAbha karechena|
iusupha valalaH AmAke dezera dhana-bhAnDAre niyukta karuna| Ami vizvasta rakSaka o adhika jJAnavAna|

emanibhAve Ami iusuphake se dezera vuke pratiSThA dAna karechi| se tathAYa yekhAne icchA sthAna kare nite pArata| Ami svIYa rahamata yAke icchA peৗche dei evaM Ami pUNyavAnadera pratidAna vinaSTa kari nA|
evaM ai leAkadera janya parakAle pratidAna uttama yArA ImAna eneche o satarkatA avalamvana kare|
iusuphera bhrAtArA Agamana karala, ataHpara tAra kAche upasthita hala| se tAderake cinala evaM tArA tAke cinala nA|

evaM se yakhana tAderake tAdera rasada prastuta kare dila, takhana se valalaH teAmAdera vaimAtreYa bhAike AmAra kAche niYe eseA| teAmarA ki dekha nA ye, Ami purA mApa dei evaM mehamAnaderake uttama samAdAra kari?
ataHpara yadi tAke AmAra kAche nA Ana, tave AmAra kAche teAmAdera keAna varAddha nei evaM teAmarA AmAra kAche Asate pArave nA|
tArA valalaH AmarA tAra samparke tAra pitAke sammata karAra ceSTA karava evaM AmAderake ekAja karatei have|
evaM se bhRtyaderake valalaH tAdera paNyamUlya tAdera rasada-patrera madhye rekhe dAo-sambhavataH tArA gRhe pau~che tA vujhate pArave, sambhavataH tArA punarvAra Asave|

tArA yakhana tAdera pitAra kAche phire ela takhana valalaH he AmAdera pitA, AmAdera janye khAdya zasyera varAdda niSiddha karA haYeche| ataeva Apani AmAdera bhAike AmAdera sAthe preraNa karuna; yAte AmarA khAdya zasyera varAdda Anate pAri evaM AmarA avazyai tAra pureApuri hephAyata karava|
valalena, Ami tAra samparke teAmAderake ki serUpa vizvAsa karava, yemana itipUrve tAra bhAi samparke vizvAsa karechilAma? ataeva AllAha uttama hephAyatakArI evaM tinii sarvAdhika daYAlu|

evaM yakhana tArA AsavAvapatra khulala, takhana dekhate pela ye, tAderake tAdera panyamulya pherata deYA haYeche| tArA valalaH he AmAdera pitA, AmarA Ara ki cAite pAri| ei AmAdera pradatta panyamUlya, AmAderake pherata deYA haYeche| ekhana AmarA AvAra AmAdera parivAravargera janye rasada Anava evaM AmAdera bhAiYera dekhAzeAnA karava evaM eka eka uTera varAdda khAdyazasya AmarA atirikta Anava| ai varAdda sahaja|

valalena, tAke tatakSaNa teAmAdera sAthe pAThAva nA, yatakSaNa teAmarA AmAke AllAhara nAme aGgIkAra nA dAo ye, tAke avazyai AmAra kAche pau~che deve; kintu yadi teAmarA savAi ekAntai asahAYa nA haYe yAo| ataHpara yakhana savAi tA~ke aGgIkAra dila, takhana tini valalenaH AmAdera madhye yA kathAvArtA haleA se vyApAre AllAhai madhyastha railena|

iYAkuva valalenaH he AmAra vatsagaNa! savAi ekai pravezadvAra diYe yeYeA nA, varaM pRthaka pRthaka darajA diYe praveza kareA| AllAhara keAna vidhAna theke Ami teAmAderake rakSA karate pAri nA| nirdeza AllAharai cale| tA~rai upara Ami bharasA kari evaM tA~rai upara bharasA karA ucita bharasAkArIdera|

tArA yakhana pitAra kathAmata praveza karala, takhana AllAhara vidhAnera viruddhe tA tAdera vA~cAte pArala nA| kintu iYAkuvera siddhAnte tA~ra manera ekaTi vAsanA chila, yA tini pUrNa karechena| evaM tini teA AmAra zekhAneA viSaYa avagata chilena| kintu aneka mAnuSa avagata naYa|
yakhana tArA iusuphera kAche upasthita hala, takhana se Apana bhrAtAke nijera kAche rAkhala| valalaH nizcai Ami teAmAra saheAdara| ataeva tAdera kRtakarmera janye duHkha kareA nA|

ataHpara yakhana iusupha tAdera rasadapatra prastuta kare dila, takhana pAnapAtra Apana bhAiYera rasadera madhye rekhe dila| ataHpara ekajana gheASaka Deke valalaH he kAphelAra leAkajana, teAmarA avazyai ceAra|
tArA odera dike mukha kare valalaH teAmAdera ki hAriYeche?
tArA valalaH AmarA vAdazAhara pAnapAtra hAriYechi evaM ye keu eTA ene deve se eka uTera veAjhA parimANa mAla pAve evaM Ami era yAmina|
tArA valalaH AllAhara kasama, teAmarA teA jAna, AmarA anartha ghaTAte edeze Asini evaM AmarA kakhanao ceAra chilAma nA|
tArA valalaH yadi teAmarA mithyAvAdI hao, tave ye, curi kareche tAra ki zAsti?
tArA valalaH era zAsti ei ye, yAra rasadapatra theke tA pAoYA yAve, era pratidAne se dAsatve yAve| AmarA yAlemaderake ebhAvei zAsti dei|

ataHpara iusupha Apana bhAidera thalera pUrve tAdera thale tallAzI zuru karalena| avazeSe sei pAtra Apana bhAiYera thalera madhya theke vera karalena| emanibhAve Ami iusuphake keৗzala zikSA diYechilAma| se vAdazAhara Aine Apana bhAike kakhanao dAsatve dite pArata nA, ki| AllAha yadi icchA karena| Ami yAke icchA, maryAdAYa unnIta kari evaM pratyeka jJAnIra upare Ache adhikatara eka jJAnIjana|

tArA valate lAgalaH yadi se curi kare thAke, tave tAra eka bhAio itipUrve curi karechila| takhana iusupha prakRta vyApAra nijera mane rAkhalena evaM tAderake jAnAlena nA| mane mane valalenaH teAmarA leAka hisAve nitAnta manda evaM AllAha khuva jJAta raYechena, yA teAmarA varNanA karacha;
tArA valate lAgalaH he AyIya, tAra pitA Achena, yini khuvai vRddha vaYaska| sutarAM Apani AmAdera ekajanake tAra vadale rekhe dina| AmarA ApanAke anugrahazIla vyaktidera ekajana dekhate pAcchi|
tini valalenaH yAra kAche AmarA AmAdera mAla peYechi, tAke chAr3A Ara kAuke grephatAra karA theke AllAha AmAdera rakSA karuna| tA hale teA AmarA nizcitai anyAYakArI haYe yAva|

ataHpara yakhana tArA tA~ra kAcha theke nirAza haYe gela, takhana parAmarzera janye ekhAne vasala| tAdera jyeSTha bhAi valalaH teAmarA ki jAna nA ye, pitA teAmAdera kAcha theke AllAhara nAme aGgIkAra niYechena evaM pUrve iusuphera vyApAreo teAmarA anyAYa karecheA? ataeva Ami teA kichutei edeza tyAga karava nA, ye paryanta nA pitA AmAke Adeza dena athavA AllAha AmAra pakSe keAna vyavasthA kare dena| tinii sarveAttama vyavasthApaka|
teAmarA teAmAdera pitAra kAche phire yAo evaM valaH pitA ApanAra chele curi kareche| AmarA tAi vale dilAma, yA AmAdera jAnA chila evaM adRzya viSaYera prati AmAdera lakSya chila nA|
jijJesa karuna ai janapadera leAkaderake yekhAne AmarA chilAma evaM ai kAphelAke, yAdera sAthe AmarA esechi| nizcitai AmarA satya valachi|
tini valalenaH kichui nA, teAmarA managar3A ekaTi kathA niYei esecha| ekhana dhairyyadhAraNai uttama| sambhavataH AllAha tAdera savAike ekasaGge AmAra kAche niYe Asavena tini suvijJa, prajJAmaYa|
evaM tAdera dika theke tini mukha phiriYe nilena evaM valalenaH hAYa AphaseAsa iusuphera janye| evaM duHkhe tA~ra cakSudvaYa sAdA haYe gela| evaM asahanIYa manastApe tini chilena kliSTa|
tArA valate lAgalaH AllAhara kasama Apani teA iusuphera smaraNa theke nivRta havena nA, ye paryanta maraNapanna nA haYe yAna kiMvA mRtavaraNa nA karena
tini valalenaH Ami teA AmAra duHkha o asthiratA AllAhara samIpei nivedana karachi evaM AllAhara pakSa theke Ami yA jAni, tA teAmarA jAna nA|
vatsagaNa! yAo, iusupha o tAra bhAike tAlAza kara evaM AllAhara rahamata theke nirAza haYeA nA| nizcaYa AllAhara rahamata theke kAphera sampradAYa, vyatIta anya keu nirAza haYa nA|

ataHpara yakhana tArA iusuphera kAche pau~chala takhana valalaH he AyIya, AmarA o AmAdera parivAravarga kaSTera sammukhIna haYe par3echi evaM AmarA aparyApta pu~ji niYe esechi| ataeva Apani AmAdera pureApuri varAdda dina evaM AmAdera ke dAna karuna| AllAha dAtAderake pratidAna diYe thAkena|
iusupha valalenaH teAmAdera jAnA Ache ki, yA teAmarA iusupha o tAra bhAiYera sAthe karecha, yakhana teAmarA apariNAmadarzI chile?

tArA valala, tave ki tumii iusupha! valalenaH Amii iusupha evaM e hala AmAra saheAdara bhAi| AllAha AmAdera prati anugraha karechena| nizcaYa ye tAkaoYA avalamvana kare evaM savara kare, AllAha ehena satkarmazIladera pratidAna vinaSTa karena nA|
tArA valalaH AllAhara kasama, AmAdera cAite AllAha teAmAke pachanda karechena evaM AmarA avazyai aparAdhI chilAma|
valalena, Aja teAmAdera viruddhe keAna abhiyeAga nei| AllAha teAmAdera ke kSamA karuna| tini sava meheravAnadera cAite adhika meheravAna|
teAmarA AmAra e jAmATi niYe yAo| eTi AmAra pitAra mukhamanDalera upara rekhe dio, ete tA~ra dRSTi zakti phire Asave| Ara teAmAdera parivAravargera savAike AmAra kAche niYe esa|
yakhana kAphelA raoYAnA hala, takhana tAdera pitA valalenaH yadi teAmarA AmAke aprakRtistha nA vala, tave valiH Ami nizcitarUpei iusuphera gandha pAcchi|
leAkerA valalaH AllAhara kasama, Apani teA sei purAneA bhrAntitei par3e Achena|

ataHpara yakhana susaMvAdadAtA pau~chala, se jAmATi tA~ra mukhe rAkhala| amani tini dRSTi zakti phire pelena| valalenaH Ami ki teAmAderake valini ye, Ami AllAhara pakSa theke yA jAni teAmarA tA jAna nA?
