tArA valalaH pitA AmAdera aparAdha kSamA karAna| nizcaYa AmarA aparAdhI chilAma|
valalena, satvarai Ami pAlanakartAra kAche teAmAdera janya kSamA cAiva| nizcaYa tini kSamAzIla, daYAlU|
ataHpara yakhana tArA iusuphera kAche pau~chala, takhana iusupha pitA-mAtAke nijera kAche jAYagA dilena evaM valalenaH AllAha cAhena teA zAnti citte misare praveza karuna|

evaM tini pitA-mAtAke siMhAsanera upara vasAlena evaM tArA savAi tA~ra sAmane sejadAvanata hala| tini valalenaH pitA e hacche AmAra itipUrvekAra svapnera varNanA AmAra pAlanakartA eke satye pariNata karechena evaM tini AmAra prati anugraha karechena| AmAke jela theke vera karechena evaM ApanAderake grAma theke niYe esechena, zaYatAna AmAra o AmAra bhAidera madhye kalaha sRSTi kare deYAra para| AmAra pAlanakartA yA cAna, keৗzale sampanna karena| nizcaYa tini vijJa, prajJAmaYa|

he pAlanakartA Apani AmAke rASTrakSamatAo dAna karechena evaM AmAke vibhinna tAtparya saha vyAkhyA karAra vidyA zikhiYe diYechena| he nabheAmanDala o bhU-manDalera sraSTA, Apanii AmAra kAryanirvAhI ihakAla o parakAle| AmAke isalAmera upara mRtyudAna karuna evaM AmAke svajanadera sAthe milita karuna|
eguleA adRzyera khavara, Ami ApanAra kAche preraNa kari| Apani tAdera kAche chilena nA, yakhana tArA svIYa kAja sAvyasta karachila evaM cakrAnta karachila|
Apani yatai cAna, adhikAMza leAka vizvAsakArI naYa|
Apani era janye tAdera kAche keAna vinimaYa cAna nA| eTA teA sArA vizvera janye upadeza vai naYa|
aneka nidarzana raYeche nabheAmanDale o bhu-manDale yeguleAra upara diYe tArA patha atikrama kare evaM tArA esavera dike maneAniveza kare nA|
aneka mAnuSa AllAhara prati vizvAsa sthApana kare, kintu sAthe sAthe zirakao kare|
tArA ki nirbhIka haYe geche e viSaYe ye, AllAhara AyAvera keAna vipada tAderake AvRta kare phelave athavA tAdera kAche haThAt keYAmata ese yAve, athaca tArA Terao pAve nA?
vale dinaH ei AmAra patha| Ami AllAhara dike vujhe sujhe dAoYAta dei Ami evaM AmAra anusArIrA| AllAha pavitra| Ami aMzIvAdIdera antarbhukta nai|

ApanAra pUrve Ami yatajanake rasUla kare pAThiYechi, tArA savAi puruSai chila janapadavAsIdera madhya theke| Ami tA~dera kAche ohI preraNa karatAma| tArA ki deza-videza bhramaNa kare nA, yAte dekhe nita kirUpa pariNati haYeche tAdera yArA pUrve chila? saMyamakArIdera janye parakAlera AvAsai uttama| tArA ki ekhanao veAjhe nA?

emanaki yakhana paYagamvaragaNa nairAzye patita haYe yetena, emanaki erUpa dhAraNA karate zuru karatena ye, tAdera anumAna vujhi mithyAYa pariNata haoYAra upakrama haYechila, takhana tAdera kAche AmAra sAhAyya peৗche| ataHpara Ami yAdera ceYechi tArA uddhAra peYeche| AmAra zAsti aparAdhI sampradAYa theke pratihata haYa nA|

tAdera kAhinIte vuddhimAnadera janya raYeche pracura zikSaNIYa viSaYa, eTA keAna managar3A kathA naYa, kintu yArA vizvAsa sthApana kare tAdera janye pUrvekAra kAlAmera samarthana evaM pratyeka vastura vivaraNa rahamata o hedAYeta|
Alipha-lAma-mIma-rA; eguleA kitAvera AYAta| yA kichu ApanAra pAlanakartAra pakSa theke avatIrNa haYeche, tA satya| kintu adhikAMza mAnuSa ete vizvAsa kare nA|

AllAha, yini urdhvadeze sthApana karechena AkAzamanDalIke stambha vyatIta| teAmarA seguleA dekha| ataHpara tini Arazera upara adhiSThita haYechena| evaM sUrya o candrake karme niYeAjita karechena| pratyeke nirdiSTa samaYa meAtAveka Avartana kare| tini sakala viSaYa paricAlanA karena, nidarzanasamUha prakAza karena, yAte teAmarA svIYa pAlanakartAra sAthe sAkSAta samvandhe nizcita vizvAsI hao|

tinii bhumanDalake vistRta karechena evaM tAte pAhAr3a parvata o nada-nadI sthApana karechena evaM pratyeka phalera madhye du’du prakAra sRSTi kare rekhechena| tini dinake rAtri dvArA AvRta karena| ete tAdera janye nidarzaNa raYeche, yArA cintA kare|

evaM yamine vibhinna zasya kSetra raYeche-ekaTi aparaTira sAthe saMlagna evaM AGgurera vAgAna Ache Ara zasya o khajjura raYeche-ekaTira mUla aparaTira sAthe milita evaM kataka milita naYa| eguleA ke ekai pAni dvArA seca karA haYa| Ara Ami svAde ekaTike aparaTira cAite utkRSTatara kare dei| eguleAra madhye nidarzaNa raYeche tAdera janya yArA cintA bhAvanA kare|

yadi Apani vismaYera viSaYa cAna, tave tAdera ekathA vismaYakara ye, AmarA yakhana mATi haYe yAva, takhanao ki natuna bhAve sRjita hava? erAi svIYa pAlanakartAra sattAYa avizvAsI haYe geche, edera gardAnei leৗha-zRMkhala par3ave evaM erAi deAyakhI erA tAte cirakAla thAkave|

erA ApanAra kAche maGgalera parivarte druta amaGgala kAmanA kare| tAdera pUrve anurUpa aneka zAstiprApta janageASThI atikrAnta haYeche| ApanAra pAlanakartA mAnuSake tAdera anyAYa satveo kSamA karena evaM ApanAra pAlanakartA kaThina zAstidAtA o vaTe|
kApherarA valeH tA~ra prati tA~ra pAlanakartAra pakSa theke keAna nidarzana avatIrNa hala nA kena? ApanAra kAja teA bhaYa pradarzana karAi evaM pratyeka sampradAYera janye pathapradarzaka haYeche|
AllAha jAnena pratyeka nArI yA garbhadhAraNa kare evaM garbhAzaYe yA saGkucita o vardhita haYa| evaM tA~ra kAche pratyeka vasturai ekaTA parimANa raYeche|
tini sakala geApana o prakAzya viSaYa avagata, maheAttama, sarveAcca maryAdAvAna|
teAmAdera madhye keu geApane kathA valuka vA tA sazavde prakAza karuka, rAtera andhakAre se AtnageApana karuka vA prakAzya divAleAke vicaraNa karuka, savAi tA~ra nikaTa samAna|

tA~ra pakSa theke anusaraNakArI raYeche tAdera agre evaM pazcAte, AllAhara nirdeze tArA odera hephAyata kare| AllAha keAna jAtira avasthA parivartana karena nA, ye paryanta nA tArA tAdera nijedera avasthA parivartana kare| AllAha yakhana keAna jAtira upara vipada cAna, takhana tA rada haoYAra naYa evaM tini vyatIta tAdera keAna sAhAyyakArI nei|
tinii teAmAderake vidyut dekhAna bhaYera janye evaM AzAra janye evaM ukSita karena ghana meghamAlA|

tA~ra prazaMsA pATha kare vajra evaM sava pherezatA, sabhaYe| tini vajrapAta karena, ataHpara yAke icachA, tAke tA dvArA AghAta karena; tathApi tArA AllAha samparke vitanDA kare, athaca tini mahAzaktizAlI|

satyera AhavAna ekamAtra tA~rai evaM tAke chAr3A yAderake DAke, tArA tAdera keAna kAje Ase nA; odera dRSTAnta serUpa, yemana keu du’ hAta pAnira dike prasArita kare yAte pAni tAra mukhe pau~che yAYa| athaca pAni keAna samaYa pau~chAve nA| kApheradera yata AhavAna tAra savai pathabhraSTatA|
AllAhake sejadA kare yA kichu nabheAmanDale o bhUmanDale Ache icchAYa athavA anicchAYa evaM tAdera praticchAYAo sakAla-sandhyAYa|

jijJesa karuna nabheAmanDala o bhumanDalera pAlanakartA ke? vale dinaH AllAha! valunaH tave ki teAmarA AllAha vyatIta emana abhibhAvaka sthira karecha, yArA nijedera bhAla-mandera o mAlika naYa? valunaH andha cakSuSmAna ki samAna haYa? athavA keAthAo ki andhakAra o AleA samAna haYa| tave ki tArA AllAhara janya emana aMzIdAra sthira kareche ye, tArA kichu sRSTi kareche, yemana sRSTi karechena AllAha? ataHpara tAdera sRSTi erUpa vibhrAnti ghaTiYeche? valunaH AllAhai pratyeka vastura sraSTA evaM tini ekaka, parAkramazAlI|

tini AkAza theke pAni varSaNa karena| ataHpara sreAtadhArA pravAhita hate thAke nija nija parimANa anuyAYI| ataHpara sreAtadhArA sphIta phenArAzi upare niYe Ase| evaM alaGkAra athavA taijasapatrera janye ye vastuke Agune uttapta kare, tAteo temani phenArAzi thAke| emani bhAve AllAha satya o asatyera dRSTAnta pradAna karena| ataeva, phenA teA zukiYe khatama haYe yAYa evaM yA mAnuSera upakAre Ase, tA jamite avaziSTa thAke| AllAha emanibhAve dRSTAntasamUha varNanA karena|

yArA pAlanakartAra Adeza pAlana kare, tAdera janya uttama pratidAna raYeche evaM yArA Adeza pAlana kare nA, yadi tAdera kAche jagatera savakichu thAke evaM tAra sAthe tAra samaparimANa Arao thAke, tave savai nijedera muktipaNa svarUpa diYe deve| tAdera janye raYeche kaTheAra hisAva| tAdera AvAsa have jAhAnnAma| seTA katainA nikRSTa avasthAna|
ye vyakti jAne ye, yA kichu pAlanakartAra pakSa theke ApanAra prati avartIrNa haYeche tA satya se ki ai vyaktira samAna, ye andha? tArAi veAjhe, yArA veAdhazakti sampanna|
erA emana leAka, yArA AllAhara pratizruti pUrNa kare evaM aGgIkAra bhaGga kare nA|
evaM yArA vajAYa rAkhe ai samparka, yA vajAYa rAkhate AllAha Adeza diYechena evaM svIYa pAlanakartAke bhaYa kare evaM kaTheAra hisAvera AzaGkA rAkhe|

evaM yArA svIYa pAlanakartAra santuSTira janye savara kare, nAmAya pratiSTA kare Ara Ami tAderake yA diYechi, tA theke geApane o prakAzya vyaYa kare evaM yArA mandera viparIte bhAla kare, tAdera janye raYeche parakAlera gRha|
tA hacche vasavAsera vAgAna| tAte tArA praveza karave evaM tAdera satkarmazIla vApa-dAdA, svAmI-strI o santAnerA| pherezatArA tAdera kAche Asave pratyeka darajA diYe|
valaveH teAmAdera savarera kAraNe teAmAdera upara zAnti varSita heAka| Ara teAmAdera e pariNAma-gRha katai nA camatkAra|

evaM yArA AllAhara aGgIkArake dRr3ha o pAkA-peAkta karAra para tA bhaGga kare, AllAha ye, samparka vajAYa rAkhate Adeza karechena, tA chinna kare evaM pRthivIte azAnti sRSTi kare, orA ai samasta leAka yAdera janye raYeche abhisampAta evaM odera janye raYeche kaThina AyAva|
AllAha yAra janye icchA ruyI prazasta karena evaM saMkucita karena| tArA pArthiva jIvanera prati mugdha| pArthivajIvana parakAlera sAmane ati sAmAnya sampada vai naYa|

kApherarA valeH tA~ra prati tA~ra pAlanakartAra pakSa theke keAna nidarzana kena avatIrNa haleA nA? vale dina, AllAha yAke icchA pathabhraSTa karena evaM ye, maneAniveza kare, tAke nijera dike pathapradarzana karena|
yArA vizvAsa sthApana kare evaM tAdera antara AllAhara yikira dvArA zAnti lAbha kare; jene rAkha, AllAhara yikira dvArAi antara samUha zAnti pAYa|
yArA vizvAsa sthApana kare evaM satkarma sampAdana kare, tAdera janye raYeche susaMvAda evaM maneArama pratyAvartaNasthala|

emanibhAve Ami ApanAke ekaTi ummatera madhye preraNa karechi| tAdera pUrve aneka ummata atikrAnta haYeche| yAte Apani tAderake ai nirdeza zuniYe dena, yA Ami ApanAra kAche preraNa karechi| tathApi tArA daYAmaYake asvIkAra kare| valunaH tinii AmAra pAlanakartA| tini vyatIta kArao upAsanA nAi| Ami tA~ra uparai bharasA karechi evaM tA~ra dikei AmAra pratyAvartaNa|

yadi keAna keAraAna emana hata, yAra sAhAyye pAhAr3a calamAna haYa athavA yamIna khanDita haYa athavA mRtarA kathA vale, tave ki hata? varaM sava kAja teA AllAhara hAte| ImAnadArarA ki e vyApAre nizcita naYa ye, yadi AllAha cAitena, tave sava mAnuSake satpathe paricAlita karatena? kApherarA tAdera kRtakarmera kAraNe sava samaYa AghAta pete thAkave athavA tAdera gRhera nikaTavartI sthAne AghAta neme Asave, ye, paryanta AllAhara oYAdA nA Ase| nizcaYa AllAha oYAdAra khelApha karena nA|
ApanAra pUrve kata rAsUlera sAthe ThATTA karA haYeche| ataHpara Ami kApheraderake kichu avakAza diYechi|, era para tAderake pAkar3Ao karechi| ataeva kemana chila AmAra zAsti|

orA pratyekei ki mAthAra upara sva sva kRtakarma niYe danDAYamAna naYa? evaM tArA AllAhara janya aMzIdAra sAvyasta kare| valuna; nAma vala athavA khavara dAo pRthivIra emana kichu jinisa samparke yA tini jAnena nA? athavA asAra kathAvArtA valacha? varaM suzeAbhita karA haYeche kApheradera janye tAdera pratAraNAke evaM tAderake satpatha theke vAdhA dAna karA haYeche| AllAha yAke pathabhraSTa karena, tAra keAna patha pradarzaka nei|
duniYAra jIvanei edera janya raYeche AyAva evaM ati avazya AkherAtera jIvana kaTheAratama| AllAhara kavala theke tAdera keAna rakSAkArI nei|

paraheyagAradera janye pratizruta jAnnAtera avasthA ei ye, tAra nimne nirjhariNIsamUha pravAhita haYa| tAra phalasamUha cirasthAYI evaM chAYAo| eTA tAdera pratidAna, yArA sAvadhAna haYeche evaM kApheradera pratiphala agni|

evaM yAderake Ami grantha diYechi, tArA ApanAra prati yA avatIrNa haYeche, tajjanye Anandita haYa evaM keAna keAna dala era keAna keAna viSaYa asvIkAra kare| valuna, AmAke erUpa Adezai deYA haYeche ye, Ami AllAhara evAdata kari| evaM tA~ra sAthe aMzIdAra nA kari| Ami tA~ra dikei dAoYAta dei evaM tA~ra kAchei AmAra pratyAvartana|

emanibhAvei Ami e keAraAnake AravI bhASAYa nirdezarUpe avatIrNa karechi| yadi Apani tAdera pravRttira anusaraNa karena ApanAra kAche jJAna pau~chAra para, tave AllAhara kavala theke ApanAra nA keAna sAhAyyakArI Ache evaM nA keAna rakSAkArI|

ApanAra pUrve Ami aneka rasUla preraNa karechi evaM tA~derake patnI o santAna-santati diYechi| keAna rasUlera emana sAdhya chila nA ye AllAhara nirdeza chAr3A keAna nidarzana upasthita kare| pratyekaTi oYAdA likhita Ache|
AllAha yA icchA miTiYe dena evaM vahAla rAkhena evaM mUlagrantha tA~ra kAchei raYeche|
Ami tAdera sAthe ye oYAdA karechi, tAra keAna ekaTi yadi ApanAke dekhiYe dei kiMvA ApanAke uThiYe nei, tAte ki ApanAra dAYitva teA peৗche deYA evaM AmAra dAYitva hisAva neYA|
tArA ki dekhe nA ye, Ami tAdera dezake caturdika theke samAne saGkucita kare Asachi? AllAha nirdeza dena| tA~ra nirdezake pazcAte nikSepakArI keu nei| tini druta hisAva grahaNa karena|

tAdera pUrve yArA chila, tArA cakrAnta kareche| Ara sakala cakrAnta teA AllAhara hAtei Ache| tini jAnena pratyeka vyakti yA kichu kare| kApherarA jene neve ye, para jIvanera AvAsasthala kAdera janya raYeche|
kApherarA valeH Apani prerita vyakti nana| vale dina, AmAra o teAmAdera madhye prakRSTa sAkSI hacchena AllAha evaM ai vyakti, yAra kAche granthera jJAna Ache|

Alipha-lAma-rA; eTi ekaTi grantha, yA Ami ApanAra prati nAyila karechi-yAte Apani mAnuSake andhakAra theke AleAra dike vera kare Anena-parAkrAnta, prazaMsAra yeAgya pAlanakartAra nirdeze tA~rai pathera dike|
tini AllAha; yini nabheAmanDala o bhU-manDalera savakichura mAlika| kApheradera janye vipada raYeche, kaTheAra AyAva;
yArA parakAlera cAite pArthiva jIvanake pachanda kare; AllAhara pathe vAdhA dAna kare evaM tAte vakratA anveSaNa kare, tArA patha bhule dUre par3e Ache|

Ami sava paYagamvarakei tAdera svajAtira bhASAbhASI karei preraNa karechi, yAte tAderake pariSkAra veAjhAte pAre| ataHpara AllAha yAke icchA, pathaHbhraSTa karena evaM yAke icchA satpatha pradarzana karena| tini parAkrAnta, prajJAmaYa|

Ami mUsAke nidarzanAvalI saha preraNa karechilAma ye, svajAtike andhakAra theke AleAra dike AnaYana evaM tAderake AllAhara dinasamUha smaraNa karAna| nizcaYa ete pratyeka dhairyazIla kRtajJera janye nidarzanAvalI raYeche|

yakhana mUsA svajAtike valalenaH teAmAdera prati AllAhara anugraha smaraNa kara yakhana tini teAmAderake pherAunera sampradAYera kavala theke mukti dena| tArA teAmAderake atyanta nikRSTa dharanera zAsti dita, teAmAdera chelederake hatyA karata evaM teAmAdera meYederake jIvita rAkhata| evaM ete teAmAdera pAlanakartAra pakSa theke virATa parIkSA haYechila|
yakhana teAmAdera pAlanakartA gheASaNA karalena ye, yadi kRtajJatA svIkAra kara, tave teAmAderake Arao deva evaM yadi akRtajJa hao tave nizcaYai AmAra zAsti have kaTheAra|
evaM mUsA valalenaH teAmarA evaM pRthivIra savAi yadi kupharI kara, tathApi AllAha amukhApekSI, yAvatIYa gunera AdhAra|

teAmAdera kAche ki teAmAdera pUrvavartI kaome nUha, Ada o sAmudera evaM tAdera paravartIdera khavara peৗcheni? tAdera viSaYe AllAha chAr3A Ara keu jAne nA| tAdera kAche tAdera paYagamvara pramAnAdi niYe Agamana karena| ataHpara tArA nijedera hAta nijedera mukhe rekhe diYeche evaM valeche, yA kichu saha teAmAderake preraNa karA haYeche, AmarA tA mAni nA evaM ye pathera dike teAmarA AmAderake dAoYAta dAo, se samparke AmAdera mane sandeha Ache, yA AmAderake utkanThAYa phele rekheche|

tAdera paYagamvaragaNa valechilenaH AllAha samparke ki sandeha Ache, yini nabheAmanDala o bhumanDalera sraSTA? tini teAmAderake AhavAna karena yAte teAmAdera kichu gunAha kSamA karena evaM nirdiSTa meYAda paryanta teAmAdera samaYa dena| tArA valataH teAmarA teA AmAdera matai mAnuSa! teAmarA AmAderake ai upAsya theke virata rAkhate cAo, yAra evAdata AmAdera pitRpuruSagaNa karata| ataeva teAmarA keAna suspaSTa pramANa AnaYana kara|

tAdera paYagamvara tAderake valenaH AmArAo teAmAdera mata mAnuSa, kintu AllAha vAndAdera madhya theke yAra upare icchA, anugraha karena| AllAhara nirdeza vyatIta teAmAdera kAche pramANa niYe AsA AmAdera kAja naYa; ImAnadAradera AllAhara upara bharasA karA cAi|

AmAdera AllAhara upara bharasA nA karAra ki kAraNa thAkate pAre, athaca tini AmAderake AmAdera patha vale diYechena| teAmarA AmAderake ye pIr3ana karecha, tajjanye AmarA savara karava| bharasAkArigaNera AllAhara uparai bharasA karA ucita|

kApherarA paYagamvaragaNake valechilaH AmarA teAmAderake deza theke vera kare deva athavA teAmarA AmAdera dharme phire Asave| takhana tAdera kAche tAdera pAlanakartA ohI preraNa karalena ye, Ami jAlimaderake avazyai dhvaMsa kare deva|
tAdera para teAmAderake deze AvAda karava| eTA ai vyakti pAYa, ye AmAra sAmane danDAYamAna haoYAke evaM AmAra AyAvera oYAdAke bhaYa kare|
paYagamvaragaNa phaYasAlA cAite lAgalena evaM pratyeka avAdhya, haThakArI vyartha kAma hala|
tAra pechane deAyakha raYeche| tAte pU~ja mizAneA pAni pAna karAneA have|
DheAka gile tA pAna karave| evaM galAra bhitare praveza karate pArave nA| prati dika theke tAra kAche mRtyu Agamana karave evaM se marave nA| tAra pazcAteo raYeche kaTheAra AyAva|

yArA svIYa pAlanakartAra sattAra avizvAsI tAdera avasthA ei ye, tAdera karmasamUha chAibhasmera mata yAra upara diYe pravala vAtAsa vaYe yAYa dhUlijhar3era dina| tAdera upArjanera keAna aMzai tAdera karatalagata have nA| eTAi duravartI pathabhraSTatA|
tumi ki dekhani ye, AllAha nabheAmanDala o bhumanDala yathAvidhi sRSTi karechena? yadi tini icchA karena, tave teAmAderake viluptite niYe yAvena evaM natuna sRSTi AnaYana karavena|
eTA AllAhara pakSe meATei kaThina naYa|

savAi AllAhara sAmane danDAYamAna have evaM durvalerA var3aderake valaveH AmarA teA teAmAdera anusArI chilAma-ataeva, teAmarA AllAhara AyAva theke AmAderake kichumAtra rakSA karave ki? tArA valaveH yadi AllAha AmAderake satpatha dekhAtena, tave AmarA avazyai teAmAdera ke satpatha dekhAtAma| ekhana teA AmAdera dhairyyacyuta hai kiMvA savara kari-savai AmAdera janye samAna AmAdera rehAi nei|

yakhana sava kAjera phAYasalA haYe yAve, takhana zaYatAna valaveH nizcaYa AllAha teAmAderake satya oYAdA diYechilena evaM Ami teAmAdera sAthe oYAdA karechi, ataHpara tA bhaGga karechi| teAmAdera upara teA AmAra keAna kSamatA chila nA, kintu etaTuku ye, Ami teAmAderake Dekechi, ataHpara teAmarA AmAra kathA mene niYecha| ataeva teAmarA AmAke bhatrsanA kareA nA evaM nijederakei bhatrsanA kara| Ami teAmAdera uddhAre sAhAyyakArI nai| evaM teAmarAo AmAra uddhAre sAhAyyakArI nao| iteApUrve teAmarA AmAke ye AllAhara zarIka karechile, Ami tA asvIkAra kari| nizcaYa yArA jAlema tAdera janye raYeche yantraNAdAYaka zAsti|

evaM yArA vizvAsa sthApaNa kare evaM satkarma sampAdana kare tAderake emana udyAne praveza karAneA have, yAra pAdadeza diYe nirjharinI samUha pravAhita have tArA tAte pAlanakartAra nirdeze anantakAla thAkave| yekhAne tAdera sambhASaNa have sAlAma|
tumi ki lakSya kara nA, AllAha tA’AlA kemana upamA varNanA karechenaH pavitra vAkya haleA pavitra vRkSera mata| tAra zikar3a majavuta evaM zAkhA AkAze utthita|
se pAlanakartAra nirdeze aharaha phala dAna kare| AllAha mAnuSera janye dRSTAnta varNaNA karena-yAte tArA cintA-bhAvanA kare|
evaM neAMrA vAkyera udAharaNa haleA neAMrA vRkSa| eke mATira upara theke upar3e neYA haYeche| era keAna sthiti nei|
AllAha tA’AlA muminaderake majavuta vAkya dvArA majavuta karena| pArthivajIvane evaM parakAle| evaM AllAha jAlemaderake pathabhraSTa karena| AllAha yA icchA, tA karena|
tumi ki tAdera ke dekhani, yArA AllAhara neYAmatake kuphare pariNata kareche evaM sva-jAtike sammukhIna kareche dhvaMsera AlaYe|
deAyakhera? tArA tAte praveza karave seTA katai nA manda AvAsa|
evaM tArA AllAhara janye samakakSa sthira kareche, yAte tArA tAra patha theke vicyuta kare deYa| valunaH majA upabheAga kare nAo| ataHpara teAmAderake agnira dikei phire yete have|

AmAra vAndAderake vale dina yArA vizvAsa sthApana kareche, tArA nAmAya kAYema rAkhuka evaM AmAra deYA riyika theke geApane o prakAzye vyaYa karuka aidina AsAra Age, yedina keAna vecA kenA nei evaM vandhutvao nei|

tinii AllAha, yini nabheAmanDala o bhumanDala sRjana karechena evaM AkAza theke pAni varSaNa kare ataHpara tA dvArA teAmAdera janye phalera riyika utpanna karechena evaM neৗkAke teAmAdera AjJAvaha karechena, yAte tA~ra Adeze samudre calA pherA kare evaM nada-nadIke teAmAdera sevAYa niYeAjita karechena|
evaM teAmAdera sevAYa niYeAjita karechena sUryake evaM candrake sarvadA eka niYame evaM rAtri o divAke teAmAdera kAje lAgiYechena|
ye sakala vastu teAmarA ceYecha, tAra pratyekaTi thekei tini teAmAderake diYechena| yadi AllAhara neYAmata gaNanA kara, tave guNe zeSa karate pArave nA| nizcaYa mAnuSa atyanta anyAYakArI, akRtajJa|
yakhana ivrAhIma valalenaH he pAlanakartA, e zaharake zAntimaYa kare dina evaM AmAke o AmAra santAna santatike mUrti pUjA theke dUre rAkhuna|
he pAlanakartA, erA aneka mAnuSake vipathagAmI kareche| ataeva ye AmAra anusaraNa kare, se AmAra evaM keu AmAra avAdhyatA karale nizcaYa Apani kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

he AmAdera pAlanakartA, Ami nijera eka santAnake teAmAra pavitra gRhera sannikaTe cASAvAdahIna upatyakAYa AvAda karechi; he AmAdera pAlanakartA, yAte tArA nAmAya kAYema rAkhe| ataHpara Apani kichu leAkera antarake tAdera prati AkRSTa karuna evaM tAderake phalAdi dvArA ruyI dAna karuna, sambhavataH tArA kRtajJatA prakAza karave
he AmAdera pAlanakartA, Apani teA jAnena AmarA yA kichu geApane kari evaM yA kichu prakAzya kari| AllAhara kAche pRthivIte o AkAze keAna kichui geApana naYa|
samasta prazaMsA AllAharai, yini AmAke ei vArdhakye isamAIla o isahAka dAna karechena nizcaYa AmAra pAlanakartA deAYA zravaNa karena|
he AmAra pAlanakartA, AmAke nAmAya kAYemakArI karuna evaM AmAra santAnadera madhye thekeo| he AmAdera pAlanakartA, evaM kavula karuna AmAdera deAYA|
he AmAdera pAlanakartA, AmAke, AmAra pitA-mAtAke evaM sava muminake kSamA karuna, yedina hisAva kAYema have|
jAlemarA yA kare, se samparke AllAhake kakhanao vekhavara mane kareA nA tAderake teA ai dina paryanta avakAza diYe rekhechena, yedina cakSusamUha vispheArita have|
tArA mastaka upare tule bhIta-vihavala citte deৗr3Ate thAkave| tAdera dike tAdera dRSTi phire Asave nA evaM tAdera antara ur3e yAve|

mAnuSake ai dinera bhaYa pradarzana karuna, yedina tAdera kAche AyAva Asave| takhana jAlemarA valaveH he AmAdera pAlanakartA, AmAderake sAmAnya meYAda paryanta samaYa dina, yAte AmarA ApanAra AhavAne sAr3A dite evaM paYagamvaragaNera anusaraNa karate pAri| teAmarA ki iteApUrve kasama khete nA ye, teAmAderake duniYA theke yete have nA?

teAmarA tAdera vAsabhUmitei vasavAsa karate, yArA nijedera upara juluma kareche evaM teAmAdera jAnA haYe giYechila ye, Ami tAdera sAthe kirUpa vyavahAra karechi evaM Ami teAmAderake odera sava kAhinIi varNanA karechi|
tArA nijedera madhye bhISaNa cakrAnta kare niYeche evaM AllAhara sAmane rakSita Ache tAdera ku-cakrAnta| tAdera kuTakeৗzala pAhAr3a TaliYe deYAra mata have nA|
ataeva AllAhara prati dhAraNA kareA nA ye, tini rasUlagaNera sAthe kRta oYAdA bhaGga karavena nizcaYa AllAha parAkramazAlI, pratizeAdha grahaNakArI|
yedina parivartita karA have e pRthivIke anya pRthivIte evaM parivartita karA have AkAza samUhake evaM leAkerA parAkramazAlI evaM AllAhara sAmane peza have|
tumi aidina pApIderake paraspare zRMkhalA vaddha dekhave|
tAdera jAmA have dAhya AlakAtarAra evaM tAdera mukhamanDalake Aguna Acchanna kare phelave|
yAte AllAha pratyekake tAra kRtakarmera pratidAna dena| nizcaYa AllAha druta hisAva grahaNakArI|
eTA mAnuSera ekaTi saMvAdanAmA evaM yAte etadvArA bhIta haYa evaM yAte jene neYa ye, upAsya tinii-ekaka; evaM yAte vuddhimAnarA cintA-bhAvanA kare|
Alipha-lA-ma-rA; eguleA paripUrNa grantha o suspaSTa keAraAnera AYAta|
keAna samaYa kApherarA AkAGkSA karave ye, ki camatkAra hata, yadi tArA musalamAna hata|
Apani cher3e dina tAderake, kheYe nika evaM bheAga kare nika evaM AzAYa vyApRta thAkuka| ati satvara tArA jene neve|
Ami keAna janapada dhavaMsa karini; kinta tAra nirdiSTa samaYa likhita chila|
keAna sampradAYa tAra nirdiSTa samaYera agre yAYa nA evaM pazcAte thAke nA|
tArA valalaH he ai vyakti, yAra prati keAraAna nAyila haYeche, Apani teA ekajana ummAda|
yadi Apani satyavAdI hana, tave AmAdera kAche pherezatAderake Anena nA kena?
Ami pherezatAderake ekamAtra phAYasAlAra janyei nAyila kari| takhana tAderake avakAza deYA have nA|
Ami svaYaM e upadeza grantha avatAraNa karechi evaM Ami nijei era saMrakSaka|
Ami ApanAra pUrve pUrvavartI sampradAYera madhye rasUla preraNa karechi|
odera kAche emana keAna rasUla Asenani, yAdera sAthe orA ThATTAvidrUpa karate thAkeni|
emanibhAve Ami e dharanera AcaraNa pApIdera antare vaddhamUla kare dei|
orA era prati vizvAsa karave nA| pUrvavartIdera emana rIti cale Asache|
yadi Ami odera sAmane AkAzera keAna darajAo khule dei Ara tAte orA dinabhara AreAhaNa o karate thAke|
tavuo orA ekathAi valave ye, AmAdera dRSTira vibhrATa ghaTAneA haYeche nA varaM AmarA yAdugrasta haYe par3echi|
nizcaYa Ami AkAze rAzicakra sRSTi karechi evaM tAke darzakadera janye suzeAbhita kare diYechi|
Ami AkAzake pratyeka vitAr3ita zaYatAna theke nirApada kare diYechi|
kintu ye curi kare zune pAlAYa, tAra pazcAddhAvana kare ujjvala ulkApinDa|
Ami bhu-pRSThake vistRta karechi evaM tAra upara parvatamAlA sthApana karechi evaM tAte pratyeka vastu suparimitabhAve utpanna karechi|
Ami teAmAdera janye tAte jIvikAra upakarana sRSTi karachi evaM tAdera janyeo yAdera annadAtA teAmarA nao|
AmAra kAche pratyeka vastura bhAnDAra raYeche| Ami nirdiSTa parimAnei tA avataraNa kari|
Ami vRSTigarbha vAYu paricAlanA kari ataHpara AkAza theke pAni varSaNa kari, erapara teAmAderake tA pAna karAi| vastutaH teAmAdera kAche era bhAnDAra nei|
Amii jIvanadAna kari, mRtyudAna kari evaM Amii cur3Anta mAlikAnAra adhikArI|
Ami jene rekhechi teAmAdera agragAmIderake evaM Ami jene rekhechi pazcAdagAmIderake|
ApanAra pAlanakartAi tAderake ekatrita kare Anavena| nizcaYa tini prajJAvAna, jJAnamaYa|
Ami mAnavake pacA kardama theke tairI vizuska ThanaThane mATi dvArA sRSTi karechi|
evaM jinake era Age lu era Agunera dvArA sRjita karechi|
Ara ApanAra pAlanakartA yakhana pherezatAderake valalenaH Ami pacA kardama theke tairI vizuSka ThanaThane mATi dvArA sRSTa ekaTi mAnava jAtira pattana karava|
ataHpara yakhana tAke ThikaThAka kare neva evaM tAte AmAra rUha theke pha~uka deva, takhana teAmarA tAra sAmane sejadAYa par3e yeYeA|
takhana pherezatArA savAi mile sejadA karala|
kintu ivalIsa-se sejadAkArIdera antarbhUkta hate svIkRta hala nA|
AllAha valalenaH he ivalisa, teAmAra ki haleA ye tumi sejadAkArIdera antarbhUkta hate svIkRta hale nA?
valalaH Ami emana nai ye, ekajana mAnavake sejadA karava, yAke Apani pacA kardama theke tairI ThanaThane vizuSka mATi dvArA sRSTi karechena|
AllAha valalenaH tave tumi ekhAna theke vera haYe yAo| tumi vitAr3ita|
evaM teAmAra prati nyAYa vicArera dina paryanta abhisampAta|
se valalaH he AmAra pAlanakartA, Apani AmAke punarutthAna divasa paryanta avakAza dina|
AllAha valalenaH teAmAke avakAza deYA hala|
sei avadhArita samaYa upasthita haoYAra dina paryanta|
se valalaH he AmAra palanakartA, Apani yemana AmAke patha bhraSTa karechena, Amio tAdera savAike pRthivIte nAnA seৗndarye AkRSTa karava evaM tAdera savAike patha bhraSTha kare deva|
ApanAra maneAnIta vAndAdera vyatIta|
AllAha valalenaH eTA AmA paryanta seAjA patha|
yArA AmAra vAndA, tAdera upara teAmAra keAna kSamatA nei; kintu pathabhrAntadera madhya theke yArA teAmAra pathe cale|
tAdera savAra nirdhArita sthAna hacche jAhAnnAma|
era sAtaTi darajA Ache| pratyeka darajAra janye eka ekaTi pRthaka dala Ache|
nizcaYa kheAdAbhIrurA vAgAna o nirjharinIsahUhe thAkave|
valA haveH eguleAte nirApattA o zAnti sahakare praveza kara|
tAdera antare ye kreAdha chila, Ami tA dUra kare deva| tArA bhAi bhAiYera mata sAmanA-sAmani Asane vasave|
sekhAne tAdera meATei kaSTa have nA evaM tArA sekhAna theke vahiskRta have nA|
Apani AmAra vAndAderake jAniYe dina ye, Ami atyanta kSamAzIla daYAlu|
evaM ihAo ye, AmAra zAstii yantranAdAYaka zAsti|
Apani tAderake ivrAhImera mehamAnadera avasthA zuniYe dina|
yakhana tArA tA~ra gRhe Agamana karala evaM valalaH sAlAma| tini valalenaH AmarA teAmAdera vyApAre bhIta|
tArA valalaH bhaYa karavena nA| AmarA ApanAke ekajana jJAnavAna chele-santAnera susaMvAda dicchi|
tini valalenaH teAmarA ki AmAke ematAvasthAYa susaMvAda diccha, yakhana Ami vArdhakye peৗche gechi?
tArA valalaH AmarA ApanAke satya su-saMvAda dicchi! ataeva Apani nirAza havena nA|
tini valalenaH pAlanakartAra rahamata theke pathabhraSTarA chAr3A ke nirAza haYa?
tini valalenaH ataHpara teAmAdera pradhAna uddezya ki he AllAhara preritagaNa?
tArA valalaH AmarA ekaTi aparAdhI sampradAYera prati prerita haYechi|
kintu lUtera parivAra-parijana| AmarA avazyai tAdera savAike vA~ciYe neva|
tave tAra strI| AmarA sthira karechi ye, se theke yAoYAdera dalabhUkta have|
ataHpara yakhana preritarA lUtera gRhe peৗchala|
tini valalenaH teAmarA teA aparicita leAka|
tArA valalaH nA varaM AmarA ApanAra kAche ai vastu niYe esechi, ye samparke tArA vivAda karata|
evaM AmarA ApanAra kAche satya viSaYa niYe esechi evaM AmarA satyavAdI|

ataeva Apani zeSarAtre parivArera sakalake niYe cale yAna evaM Apani tAdera pazcAdanusaraNa karavena nA evaM ApanAdera madhye keu yena pichana phire nA dekhe| ApanArA yekhAne Adeza prApta hacchena sekhAne yAna|
Ami lUtake e viSaYa parijJAta kare dei ye, sakAla halei tAderake samule vinAza kare deYA have|
zaharavAsIrA Ananda-ullAsa karate karate peৗchala|
lUta valalenaH tArA AmAra mehamAna| ataeva AmAke lAJchita kareA nA|
teAmarA AllAhake bhaYa kara evaM AmAra iyayata naSTa kareA nA|
tAra valalaH AmarA ki ApanAke jagatdvAsIra samarthana karate niSedha karini|
tini valalenaH yadi teAmarA ekAnta kichu karatei cAo, tave AmAra kanyArA upasthita Ache|
ApanAra prANera kasama, tArA Apana nezAYa pramatta chila|
ataHpara suryeAdaYera samaYa tAderake pracanDa ekaTi zavda ese pAkar3Ao karala|
ataHpara Ami janapadaTike ulTe dilAma evaM tAdera upara kaGkarera prasthara varSaNa karalAma|
nizcaYa ete cintAzIladera janye nidarzanAvalI raYeche|
janapadaTi seAjA pathe avasthita raYeche|
nizcaYa ete ImAnadAradera janye nidarzaNa Ache|
nizcaYa gahIna vanera adhivAsIrA pApI chila|
ataHpara Ami tAdera kAcha theke pratizeAdha niYechi| ubhaYa vasti prakAzya rAstAra upara avasthita|
nizcaYa hijarera vAsindArA paYagamvaragaNera prati mithyAreApa kareche|
Ami tAderake nijera nidarzanAvalI diYechi| ataHpara tArA eguleA theke mukha phiriYe neYa|
tArA pAhAr3e nizcinte ghara kheAdAi karata|
ataHpara eka pratyuSe tAdera upara ekaTA zavda ese AghAta karala|
takhana keAna upakAre Asala nA yA tArA upArjana karechila|
Ami nabheAmanDala, bhumanDala evaM etadubhaYera madhyavartI yA Ache tA tAtparyahIna sRSTi karini| keYAmata avazyai Asave| ataeva parama audAsInyera sAthe odera kriYAkarma upakSeA karuna|
nizcaYa ApanAra pAlanakartAi sraSTA, sarvajJa|
Ami ApanAke sAtaTi vAra vAra paThitavya AYAta evaM mahAna keAraAna diYechi|
Apani cakSu tule ai vastura prati dekhavena nA, yA Ami tAdera madhye kaYeka prakAra leAkake bheAga karAra janye diYechi, tAdera janye cintita havena nA Ara ImAnadAradera janye svIYa vAhu nata karuna|
Ara valunaH Ami prakAzya bhaYa pradarzaka|
yemana Ami nAyila karechi yArA vibhinna mate vibhakta tAdera upara|
yArA keAraAnake khanDa khanDa kareche|
ataeva ApanAra pAlanakartAra kasama, Ami avazyai odera savAike jijJAsAvAda karava|
odera kAjakarma samparke|
ataeva Apani prakAzye zuniYe dina yA ApanAke Adeza karA haYa evaM muzarikadera paraoYA karavena nA|
vidrupakArIdera janye Ami ApanAra pakSa theke yatheSTa|
yArA AllAhara sAthe anya upAsya sAvyasta kare| ataeva atisattara tArA jene neve|
Ami jAni ye Apani tAdera kathAvartAYa hateAdyama haYe par3ena|
ataeva Apani pAlanakartAra seৗndarya smaraNa karuna evaM sejadAkArIdera antarbhUkta haYe yAna|
evaM pAlanakartAra evAdata karuna, ye paryanta ApanAra kAche nizcita kathA nA Ase|
AllAhara nirdeza ese geche| ataeva era janye tAr3Ahur3A kareA nA| orA yesava zarIka sAvyasta karache sesava theke tini pavitra o vahu urdhve|
tini svIYa nirdeze vAndAdera madhye yAra kAche icchA, nirdezasaha pherezatAderake ei marme nAyila karena ye, huziYAra kare dAo, Ami chAr3A keAna upAsya nei| ataeva AmAke bhaYa kara|
yini yathAvidhi AkAzarAji o bhU-manDala sRSTi karechena| tArA yAke zarIka kare tini tAra vahu urdhve|
tini mAnavake eka pheATA vIrya theke sRSTi karechena| etadasatveo se prakAzya vitanDAkArI haYe geche|
catuSpada jantuke tini sRSTi karechena| ete teAmAdera janye zIta vastrera upakaraNa Ache| Ara aneka upakAra haYeche evaM kichu saMkhyakake teAmarA AhArye pariNata kare thAka|
edera dvArA teAmAdera sammAna haYa, yakhana vikAle cAraNabhUmi theke niYe Asa evaM sakAle cAraNa bhUmite niYe yAo|
erA teAmAdera veAjhA emana zahara paryanta vahana kare niYe yAYa, yekhAne teAmarA prANAntakara parizraۦma vyatIta peৗchAte pArate nA| nizcaYa teAmAdera prabhu atyanta daYAdra, parama daYAlu|
teAmAdera AreAhaNera janye evaM zeAbhAra janye tini gheAr3A, khaccara o gAdhA sRSTi karechena| Ara tini emana jinisa sRSTi karena yA teAmarA jAna nA|
sarala patha AllAha paryanta peৗche evaM pathaguleAra madhye kichu vakra pathao raYeche| tini icchA karale teAmAdera savAike satpathe paricAlita karate pAratena|
tini teAmAdera janye AkAza theke pAni varSaNa karechena| ei pAni theke teAmarA pAna kara evaM e thekei udbhida utpanna haYa, yAte teAmarA pazucAraNa kara|
e pAni dvArA teAmAdera janye utpAdana karena phasala, yaYatuna, khejura, AGgura o sarvaprakAra phala| nizcaYa ete cintAzIladera janye nidarzana raYeche|
tinii teAmAdera kAje niYeAjita karechena rAtri, dina, sUrya evaM candrake| tArakAsamUha tA~rai vidhAnera karme niYeAjita raYeche| nizcaYai ete veAdhazaktisampannadera janye nidarzanAvalI raYeche|
teAmAdera janye pRthivIte yesava raM-veraGera vastu char3iYe diYechena, seguleAte nidarzana raYeche tAdera janye yArA cintA-bhAvanA kare|

tinii kAje lAgiYe diYechena samudrake, yAte tA theke teAmarA tAjA mAMsa khete pAra evaM tA theke vera karate pAra paridheYa alaGkAra| tumi tAte jalayAna samUhake pAni cire calate dekhave evaM yAte teAmarA AllAhara kRpA anveSaNa kara evaM yAte tAra anugraha svIkAra kara|
evaM tini pRthivIra upara veAjhA rekhechena ye, kakhaneA yena tA teAmAderake niYe hele-dule nA par3e evaM nadI o patha tairI karechena, yAte teAmarA patha pradarzita hao|
evaM tini patha nirNaYaka vahu cihna sRSTi karechena, evaM tArakA dvArA o mAnuSa pathera nirdeza pAYa|
yini sRSTi kare, tini ki se leAkera samatulya ye sRSTi karate pAre nA? teAmarA ki cintA karave nA?
yadi AllAhara neYAmata gaNanA kara, zeSa karate pArave nA| nizcaYa AllAha kSamAzIla, daYAlu|
AllAha jAnena yA teAmarA geApana kara evaM yA teAmarA prakAza kara|
evaM yArA AllAhake cher3e anyadera DAke, orA teA keAna vastui sRSTi kare nA; varaM orA nijerAi sRjita|
tArA mRta-prANahIna evaM kave punarutthita have, jAne nA|
AmAdera ilAha ekaka ilAha| anantara yArA parajIvane vizvAsa kare nA, tAdera antara satyavimukha evaM tArA ahaMkAra pradarzana kareche|
niHsandehe AllAha tAdera geApana o prakAzya yAvatIYa viSaYe avagata| nizcitai tini ahaMkArIdera pachanda karena nA|
yakhana tAderake valA haYaH teAmAdera pAlanakartA ki nAyila karechena? tArA valeH pUrvavartIdera kisasA-kAhinI|
phale keYAmatera dina orA pUrNamAtrAYa vahana karave odera pApabhAra evaM pApabhAra tAderao yAderake tArA tAdera ajJatAhetu vipathagAmI kare zune nAo, khuvai nikRSTa veAjhA yA tArA vahana kare|

nizcaYa cakrAnta kareche tAdera pUrvavartIrA, ataHpara AllAha tAdera cakrAntera imAratera bhittimUle AghAta karechilena| erapara upara theke tAdera mAthAYa chAda dhvase par3e geche evaM tAdera upara AyAva eseche yekhAna theke tAdera dhAraNA chila nA|

ataHpara keYAmatera dina tini tAderake lAJchita karavena evaM valavenaH AmAra aMzIdArarA keAthAYa, yAdera vyApAre teAmarA khuva haThakAritA karate? yArA jJAnaprApta haYechila tArA valaveH nizcaYai Ajakera dine lAJchanA o durgati kApheradera janye,

pherezatArA tAdera jAna ematAavasthAYa kavaja kare ye, tArA nijedera upara yuluma kareche| takhana tArA anugatya prakAza karave ye, AmarA teA keAna manda kAja karatAma nA| ha~yA nizcaYa AllAha savaviSaYa avagata Achena, yA teAmarA karate|
ataeva, jAhAnnAmera darajasamUhe praveza kara, etei anantakAla vAsa kara| Ara ahaMkArIdera AvAsasthala katai nikRSTa|

paraheyagAraderake valA haYaH teAmAdera pAlanakartA ki nAyila karechena? tArA valeH mahAkalyANa| yArA e jagate satkAja kare, tAdera janye kalyANa raYeche evaM parakAlera gRha Arao uttama| paraheyagAradera gRha ki camatkAra?
sarvadA vasavAsera udyAna, tArA yAte praveza karave| era pAdadeze diYe sreAtasvinI pravAhita haYa tAdera janye tAte tA-i raYeche, yA tArA cAYa emanibhAve pratidAna devena AllAhara paraheyagAraderake,
pherezatA yAdera jAna kavaja karena tAdera pavitra thAkA avasthAYa| pherezatArA valeH teAmAdera prati zAnti varSita heAka| teAmarA yA karate, tAra pratidAne jAnnAte praveza kara|

kApherarA ki ekhana apekSA karache ye, tAdera kAche pherezatArA Asave kiMvA ApanAra pAlanakartAra nirdeza peৗchave? tAdera pUrvavartIrA emanai karechila| AllAha tAdera prati avicAra karenani; kintu tArA svaYaM nijedera prati juluma karechila|
sutarAM tAdera manda kAjera zAsti tAderai mAthAYa Apatita haYeche evaM tArA ye ThATTA vidrupa karata, tAi ulTe tAdera upara par3eche|

muzarikarA valalaH yadi AllAha cAitena, tave AmarA tA~ke chAr3A kArao evAdata karatAma nA evaM AmAdera pitRpuruSerAo karata nA evaM tA~ra nirdeza chAr3A keAna vastui AmarA hArAma karatAma nA| tAdera pUrvavartIrA emanai kareche| rAsUlera dAYitva teA zudhumAtra suspaSTa vANI peৗchiYe deYA|

Ami pratyeka ummatera madhyei rAsUla preraNa karechi ei marme ye, teAmarA AllAhara evAdata kara evaM tAguta theke nirApada thAka| ataHpara tAdera madhye kichu saMkhyakake AllAha hedAYeta karechena evaM kichu saMkhyakera janye vipathagAmitA avadhArita haYe gela| sutarAM teAmarA pRthivIte bhramaNa kara evaM dekha mithyAreApakArIdera kirUpa pariNati haYeche|
Apani tAderake supathe Anate AgrahI haleo AllAha yAke vipathagAmI karena tini tAke patha dekhAna nA evaM tAdera keAna sAhAyyakArI o nei|
tArA AllAhara nAme kaTheAra zapatha kare ye, yAra mRtyu haYa AllAha tAke punarujjIvita karavena nA| avazyai era pAkApeAkta oYAdA haYe geche| kintu, adhikAMza leAka jAne nA|
tini punarujjIvita karavenai, yAte ye viSaYe tAdera madhye matAnaikya chila tA prakAza karA yAYa evaM yAte kAphererA jene neYa ye, tArA mithyAvAdI chila|
Ami yakhana keAna kichu karAra icchA kari; takhana tAke kevala etaTukui vali ye, haYe yAo,| sutarAM tA haYe yAYa|
yArA niryAtita haoYAra para AllAhara janye gRhatyAga kareche, Ami avazyai tAderake duniYAte uttama AvAsa deva evaM parakAlera puraskAra teA sarvAdhika; hAYa! yadi tArA jAnata|
yArA dRr3hapada raYeche evaM tAdera pAlanakartAra upara bharasA kareche|
ApanAra pUrveo Ami pratyAdezasaha mAnavakei tAdera prati preraNa karechilAma ataeva jJAnIderake jijJesa kara, yadi teAmAdera jAnA nA thAke;

preraNa karechilAma tAderake nidarzanAvalI o avatIrNa granthasaha evaM ApanAra kAche Ami smaraNikA avatIrNa karechi, yAte Apani leAkadera sAmane aisava viSaYa vivRta karena, ye guleA teAdera prati nAyila karA haYeche, yAte tArA cintA-bhAvanA kare|
yArA kucakra kare, tArA ki e viSaYe bhaYa kare nA ye, AllAha tAderake bhUgarbhe vilIna kare divena kiMvA tAdera kAche emana jAYagA theke AyAva Asave yA tAdera dhAraNAtIta|
kiMvA calApherAra madhyei tAderake pAkar3Ao karave, tArA teA tA vyartha karate pArave nA|
kiMvA bhIti pradarzanera para tAderake pAkar3Ao karavena? teAmAdera pAlanakartA teA atyanta namra, daYAlu|
tArA ki AllAhara sRjita vastu dekhe nA, yAra chAYA AllAhara prati vinItabhAve sejadAvanata theke DAna o vAma dike jhu~ke par3e|
AllAhake sejadA kare yA kichu nabheAmanDale Ache evaM yA kichu bhumanDale Ache evaM pherezatAgaNa; tArA ahaMkAra kare nA|
tArA tAdera upara parAkramazAlI tAdera pAlanakartAke bhaYa kare evaM tArA yA Adeza pAYa, tA kare
AllAha valalenaH teAmarA dui upAsya grahaNa kareA nA upAsya teA mAtra ekajanai| ataeva AmAkei bhaYa kara|
yA kichu nabheAmanDala o bhumanDale Ache tA tA~rai evAdata karA zAzvata kartavya| teAmarA ki AllAha vyatIta kAuke bhaYa karave?
teAmAdera kAche ye samasta neYAmata Ache, tA AllAharai pakSa theke| ataHpara teAmarA yakhana duHkhe-kaSTe patita hao takhana tA~rai nikaTa kAnnAkATi kara|
erapara yakhana AllAha teAmAdera kaSTa durIbhUta kare dena, takhanai teAmAdera ekadala svIYa pAlanakartAra sAthe aMzIdAra sAvyasta karate thAke|
yAte ai neYAmata asvIkAra kare, yA Ami tAderake diYechi| ataeva majA bheAga kare nAo-satvarai teAmarA jAnate pArave|

tArA AmAra deYA jIvaneApakaraNa theke tAdera janye ekaTi aMza nirdhArita kare, yAdera keAna khavarai tArA rAkhe nA| AllAhara kasama, teAmarA ye apavAda AreApa karacha, se samparke avazyai jijJAsita have|
tArA AllAhara janye kanyA santAna nirdhAraNa kare-tini pavitra mahimAnvita evaM nijedera janye orA tAi sthira kare yA orA cAYa|
yakhana tAdera kAuke kanyA santAnera susaMvAda deYA haYa, takhana tArA mukha kAla haYe yAYa evaM asahya manastApe kliSTa hate thAke|

tAke zeAnAneA susaMvAdera duHkhe se leAkadera kAcha theke mukha lukiYe thAke| se bhAve, apamAna sahya kare tAke thAkate deve, nA tAke mATira nIce pute phelave| zune rAkha, tAdera phaYasAlA khuvai nikRSTa|
yArA parakAla vizvAsa kare nA, tAdera udAharaNa nikRSTa evaM AllAhara udAharaNai mahAna, tini parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|

yadi AllAha leAkaderake tAdera anyAYa kAjera kAraNe pAkar3Ao karatena, tave bhupRSThe calamAna keAna kichukei chAr3atena nA| kintu tini pratizruti samaYa paryanta tAderake avakAza dena| ataHpara nirdhArita samaYe yakhana tAdera mRtyu ese yAve, takhana eka muhurtao vilamvita kiMvA tarAmvita karate pArave nA|

yA nijedera mana cAYa nA tArai tArA AllAhara janye sAvyasta kare evaM tAdera jihavA mithyA varNanA kare ye, tAdera janye raYeche kalyANa| svataHsiddha kathA ye, tAdera janye raYeche Aguna evaM tAderakei sarvAgre nikSepa karA have|

AllAhara kasama, Ami ApanAra pUrve vibhinna sampradAYe rAsUla preraNa karechi, ataHpara zaYatAna tAderake karma samUha zeAbhanIYa kare dekhiYeche| Aja sei tAdera abhibhAvaka evaM tAdera janye raYeche yantraNAdAYaka zAsti|

Ami ApanAra prati e janyei grantha nAyila karechi, yAte Apani sarala patha pradarzanera janye tAdera ke pariSkAra varNanA kare dena, ye viSaYe tArA matavireAdha karache evaM ImAnadArake kSamA karAra janye|
AllAha AkAza theke pAni varSaNa karechena, tadvArA yamInake tAra mRtyura para punarjIvita karechena| nizcaYa ete tAdera janye nidarzana raYeche, yArA zravaNa kare|

teAmAdera janye catuspada jantudera madhye cintA karAra avakAza raYeche| Ami teAmAderake pAna karAi tAdera udarasthita vastusamuhera madhye theke geAvara o rakta niHsRta dugdha yA pAnakArIdera janye upAdeYa|
evaM khejura vRkSa o AGgura phala theke teAmarA madhya o uttama khAdya tairI kare thAka, ete avazyai veAdhazakti sampanna sampradAYera janye nidarzana raYeche|
ApanAra pAlanakartA madhu makSikAke Adeza dilenaH parvatagAhre, vRkSa evaM u~cu cAle gRha tairI kara,

erapara sarvaprakAra phala theke bhakSaNa kara evaM Apana pAlanakartAra ummukta patha samUhe calamAna hao| tAra peTa theke vibhinna raGe pAnIYa nirgata haYa| tAte mAnuSera janye raYeche reAgera pratikAra| nizcaYa ete cintAzIla sampradAYera janye nidarzana raYeche|

AllAha teAmAderake sRSTi karechena erapara teAmAdera mRtyudAna karena| teAmAdera madhye keu keu peৗche yAYa jarAgrasta akarmanya vaYase, phale yA kichu tArA jAnata se samparke tArA sajJAna thAkave nA| nizcaYa AllAha su-vijJa sarvazaktimAna|

AllAha tA’AlA jIvaneApakaraNe teAmAdera ekajanake anyajanera cAite zreSTatva diYechena| ataeva yAderake zreSThatva deYA haYeche, tArA tAdera adhInastha dAsa-dAsIderake svIYa jIvikA theke emana kichu deYa nA, yAte tArA e viSaYe tAdera samAna haYe yAve| tave ki tArA AllAhara neYAmata asvIkAra kare|

AllAha teAmAdera janye teAmAderai zreNI theke jeAr3A paYadA karechena evaM teAmAdera yugala theke teAmAderake putra o peৗtrAdi diYechena evaM teAmAderake uttama jIvaneApakaraNa dAna karechena| ataeva tArA ki mithyA viSaYe vizvAsa sthApana kare evaM AllAhara anugraha asvIkAra kare?
tArA AllAha vyatIta emana vastura ivAdata kare, ye tAdera janye bhumanDala o nabheAmanDala theke sAmAnya ruyI deoYAra o adhikAra rAkhe nA evaM mukti o rAkhe nA|
ataeva, AllAhara keAna sadRza sAvyasta kareA nA, nizcaYa AllAha jAnena evaM teAmarA jAna nA|

AllAha ekaTi dRSTAnta varNanA karechena, aparera mAlikAnAdhIna geAlAmera ye, keAna kichura upara zakti rAkhe nA evaM emana ekajana yAke Ami nijera pakSa theke camatkAra ruyI diYechi| ataeva, se tA theke vyaYa kare geApane o prakAzye ubhaYe ki samAna haYa? sava prazaMsA AllAhara, kintu aneka mAnuSa jAne nA|

AllAha ArekaTi dRSTAnta varNanA karechena, du’vyaktira, ekajana veAvA keAna kAja karate pAre nA| se mAlikera upara veAjhA| yedike tAke pAThAYa, keAna saThika kAja kare Ase nA| se ki samAna have ai vyaktira, ye nyAYa vicArera Adeza kare evaM sarala pathe kAYema raYeche|

nabheAmanDala o bhUmanDalera geApana rahasya AllAhara kAchei raYeche| kiYAmatera vyApAraTi teA emana, yemana ceAkhera palaka athavA tAra cAiteo nikaTavartI| nizcaYa AllAha sava kichura upara zaktimAna|
AllAha teAmAderake teAmAdera mAYera garbha theke vera karechena| teAmarA kichui jAnate nA| tini teAmAderake karNa, cakSu o antara diYechena, yAte teAmarA anugraha svIkAra kara|
tArA ki ur3anta pAkhIke dekhe nA? eguleA AkAzera antarIkSe AjJAdhIna raYeche| AllAha chAr3A keu eguleAke Agale rAkhe nA| nizcaYa ete vizvAsIdera janye nidarzanavalI raYeche|

AllAha kare diYechena teAmAdera gRhake avasthAnera jAYagA evaM catuspada jantura cAmar3A dvArA karechena teAmAra janye tA~vura vyavasthA| teAmarA eguleAke sapharakAle o avasthAna kAle pAo| bher3Ara pazama, uTera vAvari cula o chAgalera leAma dvArA kata AsavAvapatra o vyavahArera sAmagrI tairI karechena eka nirdiSTa samaYa paryanta|

AllAha teAmAdera janye sRjita vastu dvArA chAYA kare diYechena evaM pAhAr3a samUhe teAmAdera janye Atna geApanera jAYagA karechena evaM teAmAdera janye peAzAka tairI kare diYechena, yA teAmAderake grISma evaM vipadera samaYa rakSA kare| emanibhAve tini teAmAdera prati svIYa anugrahera pUrNatA dAna karena, yAte teAmarA AtnasamarpaNa kara|
ataHpara yadi tArA pRSTha pradarzana kare, tave ApanAra kAja hala suspaSTa bhAve peৗche deYA mAtra|
tArA AllAhara anugraha cine, erapara asvIkAra kare evaM tAdera adhikAMzai akRtajJa|
yedina Ami pratyeka ummata theke ekajana varNanAkArI dA~r3a karAva, takhana kApheraderake anumati deYA have nA evaM tAdera taovA o grahaNa karA have nA|
yakhana jAlemarA AyAva pratyakSa karave, takhana tAdera theke tA laghu karA have nA evaM tAderake keAna avakAza deYA have nA|

muzarikarA yakhana ai sava vastuke dekhave, yesavake tArA AllAhara sAthe zarIka sAvyasta karechila, takhana valaveH he AmAdera pAlanakartA erAi tArA yArA AmAdera zerekIra upAdAna, teAmAke cher3e AmarA yAderake DAkatAma| takhana orA tAderake valaveH teAmarA mithyAvAdI|
sedina tArA AllAhara sAmane Atnasamarpana karave evaM tArA ye mithyA apavAda dita tA vismRta have|
yArA kAphera haYeche evaM AllAhara pathe vAdhA sRSTi kareche, Ami tAderake AyAvera para AyAva vAr3iYe deva| kAraNa, tArA azAnti sRSTi karata|

sedina pratyeka ummatera madhye Ami ekajana varNanAkArI dA~r3a karAva tAdera vipakSe tAdera madhya thekei evaM tAdera viSaYe ApanAke sAkSI svarUpa upasthApana karava| Ami ApanAra prati grantha nAyila karechi yeTi emana ye tA pratyeka vastura suspaSTa varNanA, hedAYeta, rahamata evaM musalamAnadera janye susaMvAda|

AllAha nyAYaparAYaNatA, sadAcaraNa evaM AtnIYa-svajanake dAna karAra Adeza dena evaM tini azlIlatA, asaGgata kAja evaM avAdhyatA karate vAraNa karena| tini teAmAdera upadeza dena yAte teAmarA smaraNa rAkha|
AllAhara nAme aGgIkAra karAra para se aGgIkAra pUrNa kara evaM pAkApAki kasama karAra para tA bhaGga kareA nA, athaca teAmarA AllAhake jAmina karecha| teAmarA yA kara AllAha tA jAnena|

teAmarA ai mahilAra mata haYeA nA, ye parizramera para kATA sUtA TukareA TukareA kare chir3e phele, teAmarA nijedera kasamasamUhake pArasparika pravaJcanAra vAhAnA rUpe grahaNa kara ejanye ye, anya dala apekSA eka dala adhika kSamatAvAna haYe yAYa| etadvArA teA AllAha zudhu teAmAdera parIkSA karena| AllAha avazyai kiYAmatera dina prakAza kare devena, ye viSaYe teAmarA kalaha karate|
AllAha icchA karale teAmAdera savAike eka jAti kare dite pAratena, kintu tini yAke icchA vipathagAmI karena evaM yAke icchA patha pradarzana karena| teAmarA yA kara se viSaYe avazyai jijJAsita have|

teAmarA svIYa kasamasamUhake pArasparika kalaha dvandvera vAhAnA kareA nA| tA hale dRr3habhAve pratiSThita haoYAra para pA phasake yAve evaM teAmarA zAstira svAda AsvAdana karave e kAraNe ye, teAmarA AmAra pathe vAdhA dAna karecha evaM teAmAdera kaTheAra zAsti have|
teAmarA AllAhara aGgIkArera vinimaYe sAmAnya mUlya grahaNa kareA nA| nizcaYa AllAhara kAche yA Ache, tA uttama teAmAdera janye, yadi teAmarA jJAnI hao|

teAmAdera kAche yA Ache niHzeSa haYe yAve evaM AllAhara kAche yA Ache, kakhanao tA zeSa have nA| yArA savara kare, Ami tAderake prApya pratidAna deva tAdera uttama karmera pratidAna svarUpa yA tArA karata|
ye satkarma sampAdana kare evaM se ImANadAra, puruSa heAka kiMvA nArI Ami tAke pavitra jIvana dAna karava evaM pratidAne tAderake tAdera uttama kAjera kAraNe prApya puraSkAra deva yA tArA karata|
ataeva, yakhana Apani keAraAna pATha karena takhana vitAr3ita zaYatAna theke AllAhara AzraYa grahaNa karuna|
tAra Adhipatya cale nA tAdera upara yArA vizvAsa sthApana kare evaM Apana pAlana kartAra upara bharasA rAkhe|
tAra Adhipatya teA tAdera uparai cale, yArA tAke vandhu mane kare evaM yArA tAke aMzIdAra mAne|

evaM yakhana Ami eka AYAtera sthale anya AYAta upasthita kari evaM AllAha yA avatIrNa karena tinii se samparke bhAla jAnena; takhana tArA valeH Apani teA managar3A ukti karena; varaM tAdera adhikAMza leAkai jAne nA|
valuna, eke pavitra pherezatA pAlanakartAra pakSa theke nizcita satyasaha nAyila karechena, yAte muminaderake pratiSThita karena evaM eTA musalamAnadera janye patha nirdeza o su-saMvAda svarUpa|
Ami teA bhAlabhAvei jAni ye, tArA valeH tAke janaika vyakti zikSA deYa| yAra dike tArA iGgita kare, tAra bhASA teA AravI naYa evaM e keAraAna pariSkAra AravI bhASAYa|
yArA AllAhara kathAYa vizvAsa kare nA, tAderake AllAha patha pradarzana karena nA evaM tAdera janye raYeche yantraNAdAYaka zAsti|
mithyA kevala tArA racanA kare, yArA AllAhara nidarzane vizvAsa kare nA evaM tArAi mithyAvAdI|

yAra upara javaradasti karA haYa evaM tAra antara vizvAse aTala thAke se vyatIta ye keu vizvAsI haoYAra para AllAhate avizvAsI haYa evaM kupharIra janya mana ummukta kare deYa tAdera upara Apatita have AllAhara gayava evaM tAdera janye raYeche zAsti|
eTA e janye ye, tArA pArthiva jIvanake parakAlera cAite priYa mane kareche evaM AllAha avizvAsIderake patha pradarzana karena nA|
erAi tArA, AllAha tA’YAlA ederai antara, karNa o cakSura upara meAhara mere diYechena evaM erAi kAnDa jJAnahIna|
valAvAhulya parakAle erAi kSati grasta have|
yArA duHkha-kaSTa bheAgera para dezatyAgI haYeche ataHpara jehAda kareche, nizcaYa ApanAra pAlanakartA esava viSaYera pare avazyai kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|
yedina pratyeka vyakti Atna-samarthane saoYAla jaoYAva karate karate Asave evaM pratyeka vyakti tAdera kRtakarmera pUrNa phala pAve evaM tAdera upara juluma karA have nA|

AllAha dRSTAnta varNanA karechena ekaTi janapadera, yA chila nirApada o nizcinta, tathAYa pratyeka jAYagA theke Asata pracura jIvaneApakaraNa| ataHpara tArA AllAhara neYAmatera prati akRtajJatA prakAza karala| takhana AllAha tAderake tAdera kRtakarmera kAraNe svAda AsvAdana karAlena, kSudhA o bhItira|
tAdera kAche tAdera madhya thekei ekajana rAsUla Agamana karechilena| anantara orA tA~ra prati mithyAreApa karala| takhana AyAva ese tAdarake pAkar3Ao karala evaM nizcitai orA chila pApAcArI|
ataeva, AllAha teAmAderake yesava hAlAla o pavitra vastu diYechena, tA teAmarA AhAra kara evaM AllAhara anugrahera janye kRtajJatA prakAza kara yadi teAmarA tA~rai evAdatakArI haYe thAka|

avazyai AllAha teAmAdera janye hArAma karechena rakta, zukarera mAMsa evaM yA javAi kAle AllAha chAr3A anyera nAma uccAraNa karA haYeche| ataHpara keu sImAlaGghana kArI nA haYe nirupAYa haYe par3ale tave, AllAha kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

teAmAdera mukha theke sAdhAranataH yesava mithyA vera haYe Ase temani kare teAmarA AllAhara viruddhe mithyA apavAda AreApa kare vala nA ye, eTA hAlAla evaM oTA hArAma| nizcaYa yArA AllAhara viruddhe mithyA AreApa kare, tAdera maGgala have nA|
yatsAmAnya sukha-sambheAga bheAga kare nika| tAdera janye yantranAdAYaka zAsti raYeche|
ihudIdera janye Ami teA kevala tAi hArAma karechilAma yA itipUrve ApanAra nikaTa ullekha karechi| Ami tAdera prati keAna juluma karini, kintu tArAi nijedera upara juluma karata|
anantara yArA ajJatAvazataH manda kAja kare, ataHpara taovA kare evaM nijeke saMzeAdhana kare neYa, ApanAra pAlanakartA esavera pare tAdera janye avazyai kSamAzIla, daYAlu|
nizcaYa ivrAhIma chilena eka sampradAYera pratIka, savakichu theke mukha phiriYe eka AllAharai anugata evaM tini zerakakArIdera antarbhukta chilena nA|
tini tA~ra anugrahera prati kRtajJatA prakAzakArI chilena| AllAha tA~ke maneAnIta karechilena evaM sarala pathe paricAlita karechilena|
Ami tA~ke duniYAte dAna karechi kalyANa evaM tini parakAleo satkarmazIladera antarbhUkta|
ataHpara ApanAra prati pratyAdeza preraNa karechi ye, ivrAhImera dvIna anusaraNa karuna, yini ekaniSTha chilena evaM zirakakArIdera antarbhUkta chilena nA|

zanivAra dina pAlana ye, nirdhAraNa karA haYechila, tA tAdera janyei yArA ete matavireAdha karechila| ApanAra pAlanakartA kiYAmatera dina tAdera madhye phaYasAlA karavena ye viSaYe tArA matavireAdha karata|

Apana pAlanakartAra pathera prati AhavAna karuna jJAnera kathA vujhiYe o upadeza zuniYe uttamarUpe evaM tAdera sAthe vitarka karuna pachanda yukta panthAYa| nizcaYa ApanAra pAlanakartAi ai vyakti samparke vizeSa bhAve jJAta raYechena, ye tA~ra patha theke vicyuta haYe par3eche evaM tinii bhAla jAnena tAderake, yArA saThika pathe Ache|
Ara yadi teAmarA pratizeAdha grahaNa kara, tave ai parimANa pratizeAdha grahaNa karave, ye parimANa teAmAderake kaSTa deYA haYa| yadi savara kara, tave tA savarakArIdera janye uttama|
Apani savara karavena| ApanAra savara AllAhara janya vyatIta naYa, tAdera janye duHkha karavena nA evaM tAdera cakrAntera kAraNe mana cheATa karavena nA|
nizcaYa AllAha tAdera saGge Achena, yArA paraheyagAra evaM yArA satkarma kare|

parama pavitra o mahimAmaYa sattA tini, yini svIYa vAndAke rAtri velAYa bhramaNa kariYechilena masajide hArAma theke masajide AkasA paryAnta-yAra cAra dike Ami paryApta varakata dAna karechi yAte Ami tA~ke kudaratera kichu nidarzana dekhiYe dei| nizcaYai tini parama zravaNakArI o darzanazIla|
Ami mUsAke kitAva diYechi evaM seTike vanI-isarAIlera janye hedAYete pariNata karechi ye, teAmarA AmAke chAr3A kAuke kAryanivAhI sthira kareA nA|
teAmarA tAdera santAna, yAderake Ami nUhera sAthe saoYAra kariYechilAma| nizcaYa se chila kRtajJa vAndA|
Ami vanI isarAIlake kitAve pariSkAra vale diYechi ye, teAmarA pRthivIra vuke duvAra anartha sRSTi karave evaM atyanta var3a dharanera avAdhyatAYa lipta have|

ataHpara yakhana pratizruti sei prathama samaYaTi ela, takhana Ami teAmAdera viruddhe preraNa karalAma AmAra kaTheAra yeAddhA vAndAderake| ataHpara tArA pratiTi janapadera AnAce-kAnAce paryanta char3iYe par3ala| e oYAdA pUrNa haoYArai chila|

ataHpara Ami teAmAdera janye tAdera viruddhe pAlA ghuYiYe dilAma, teAmAderake dhana-sampada o putrasantAna dvArA sAhAyya karalAma evaM teAmAderake janasaMkhyAra dika diYe ekaTA virATa vAhinIte pariNata karalAma|

teAmarA yadi bhAla kara, tave nijederai bhAla karave evaM yadi manda kara tave tAo nijedera janyei| erapara yakhana dvitIYa se samaYaTi ela, takhana anya vAndAderake preraNa karalAma, yAte teAmAdera mukhamanDala vikRta kare deYa, Ara masajide Dhuke par3e yemana prathamavAra Dhukechila evaM yekhAnei jaYI haYa, sekhAnei pureApuri dhvaMsayajJa cAlAYa|
haYata teAmAdera pAlanakartA teAmAdera prati anugraha karavena| kintu yadi punarAYa tadrUpa kara, Amio punarAYa tAi karava| Ami jAhAnnAmake kApheradera janye kaYedakhAnA karechi|
ei keAraAna emana patha pradarzana kare, yA sarvAdhika sarala evaM satkarma parAYaNa muminaderake susaMvAda deYa ye, tAdera janye mahA puraskAra raYeche|
evaM yArA parakAle vizvAsa kare nA, Ami tAdera janye yantraNAdAYaka zAsti prastuta karechi|
mAnuSa yebhAve kalyANa kAmanA kare, sebhAvei akalyANa kAmanA kare| mAnuSa teA khuvai drutatA priYa|

Ami rAtri o dinake duTi nidarzana karechi| ataHpara nisprabha kare diYechi rAtera nidarzana evaM dinera nidarzanake dekhAra upayeAgI karechi, yAte teAmarA teAmAdera pAlanakartAra anugraha anveSaNa kara evaM yAte teAmarA sthira karate pAra vacharasamUhera gaNanA o hisAva evaM Ami sava viSaYake vistArita bhAve varNanA karechi|
Ami pratyeka mAnuSera karmake tAra grIvalagna kare rekhechi| keYAmatera dina vera kare dekhAva tAke ekaTi kitAva, yA se kheAlA avasthAYa pAve|
pATha kara tumi teAmAra kitAva| Aja teAmAra hisAva grahaNera janye tumii yatheSTa|

ye keu satpathe cale, tArA nijera maGgalera janyei sat pathe cale| Ara ye pathabhraSTa haYa, tArA nijera amaGgalera janyei patha bhraSTa haYa| keu aparera veAjhA vahana karave nA| keAna rAsUla nA pAThAneA paryanta Ami kAukei zAsti dAna kari nA|

yakhana Ami keAna janapadake dhvaMsa karAra icchA kari takhana tAra avasthApanna leAkaderake uddhuddha kari ataHpara tArA pApAcAre mete uThe| takhana se janageASTIra upara Adeza avadhArita haYe yAYa| ataHpara Ami tAke uThiYe AchAr3a dei|
nUhera para Ami aneka ummatake dhvaMsa karechi| ApanAra pAlanakartAi vAndAdera pApAcArera saMvAda jAnA o dekhAra janye yatheSTa|
ye keu ihakAla kAmanA kare, Ami sesava leAkake yA icchA sattvara diYe dei| ataHpara tAdera janye jAhAnnAma nirdhAraNa kari| orA tAte nindita-vitAr3ita avasthAYa praveza karave|
Ara yArA parakAla kAmanA kare evaM mumina avasthAYa tAra janya yathAyatha ceSTA-sAdhanA kare, emana leAkadera ceSTA svIkRta haYe thAke|
ederake evaM oderake pratyekake Ami ApanAra pAlanakartAra dAna peৗche dei evaM ApanAra pAlakartAra dAna avadhArita|
dekhuna, Ami tAdera ekadalake aparera upara kibhAve zreSThatva dAna karalAma| parakAla teA nizcaYai martavAYa zreSTha evaM phayIlate zreSThatama|
sthira kareA nA AllAhara sAthe anya keAna upAsya| tAhale tumi nindita o asahAYa haYe par3ave|

teAmAra pAlanakartA Adeza karechena ye, tA~ke chAr3A anya kArao evAdata kareA nA evaM pitA-mAtAra sAthe sadva-vyavahAra kara| tAdera madhye keu athavA ubhaYei yadi teAmAra jIvaddazAYa vArdhakye upanIta haYa; tave tAderake ‘uha’ zavdaTio valeA nA evaM tAderake dhamaka dio nA evaM vala tAderake ziSThAcArapUrNa kathA|
tAdera sAmane bhAlavAsAra sAthe, namrabhAve mAthA nata kare dAo evaM valaH he pAlanakartA, tAdera ubhaYera prati rahama kara, yemana tArA AmAke zaizavakAle lAlana-pAlana karechena|
teAmAdera pAlanakartA teAmAdera mane yA Ache tA bhAlai jAnena| yadi teAmarA sat hao, tave tini taovAkArIdera janye kSamAzIla|
AtnIYa-svajanake tAra haka dAna kara evaM abhAvagrasta o musAphirakeo| evaM kichutei apavyaYa kareA nA|
nizcaYa apavyaYakArIrA zaYatAnera bhAi| zaYatAna svIYa pAlanakartAra prati atizaYa akRtajJa|
evaM teAmAra pAlanakartAra karuNAra pratyAzAYa apekSAmAna thAkAkAle yadi keAna samaYa tAderake vimukha karate haYa, takhana tAdera sAthe namrabhAve kathA vala|
tumi ekevAre vyaYa-kuSTha haYeAnA evaM ekevAre mukta hastao haYeA nA| tAhale tumi tiraskRti, niHsva haYe vase thAkave|
nizcaYa teAmAra pAlakartA yAke icchA adhika jIvaneApakaraNa dAna karena evaM tinii tA saMkucitao kare dena| tinii tA~ra vAndAdera samparke bhAleAbhAve avahita,-sava kichu dekhachena|
dAridrera bhaYe teAmAdera santAnaderake hatyA kareA nA| tAderake evaM teAmAderake Amii jIvaneApakaraNa diYe thAki| nizcaYa tAderake hatyA karA mArAtnaka aparAdha|
Ara vyabhicArera kAcheo yeYeA nA| nizcaYa eTA azlIla kAja evaM manda patha|

se prANake hatyA kareA nA, yAke AllAha hArAma karechena; kintu nyAYabhAve| ye vyakti anyAYabhAve nihata haYa, Ami tAra uttarAdhikArIke kSamatA dAna kari| ataeva, se yena hatyAra vyApAre sImA laGghana nA kare| nizcaYa se sAhAyyaprApta|

Ara, etimera mAlera kAcheo yeYeA nA, ekamAtra tAra kalyANa AkAMkhA chAr3A; saMzliSTa vyaktira yeৗvane padArpana karA paryanta evaM aGgIkAra pUrna kara| nizcaYa aGgIkAra samparke jijJAsAvAda karA have|
mepe deYAra samaYa pUrNa mApe deve evaM saThika dA~r3ipAlAYa ojana karave| eTA uttama; era pariNAma zubha|
ye viSaYe teAmAra keAna jJAna nei, tAra pichane par3eA nA| nizcaYa kAna, cakSu o antaHkaraNa edera pratyekaTii jijJAsita have|
pRthivIte dambhabhare padacAraNA kareA nA| nizcaYa tumi teA bhU pRSThake kakhanai vidIrNa karate pArave nA evaM uccatAYa tumi kakhanai parvata pramANa hate pArave nA|
e savera madhye yeguleA mandakAja, seguleA teAmAra pAlanakartAra kAche apachandanIYa|

eTA ai hikamatera antarbhUkta, yA ApanAra pAlanakartA ApanAke ohI mAraphata dAna karechena| AllAhara sAthe anya keAna upAsya sthira karavena nA| tAhale abhiyukta o AllAhara anugraha theke vitAr3ita avasthAYa jAhAnnAme nikSipta havena|
teAmAdera pAlanakartA ki teAmAdera janye putra santAna nirdhArita karechena evaM nijera janye pherezatAderake kanyArUpe grahaNa karechena? nizcaYa teAmarA gurutara garhita kathAvArtA valacha|
Ami ei keAraAne nAnAbhAve vujhiYechi, yAte tArA cintA kare| athaca ete tAdera kevala vimukhatAi vRddhi pAYa|
valunaH tAdera kathAmata yadi tA~ra sAthe anyAnya upAsya thAkata; tave tArA Arazera mAlika paryanta peৗchAra patha anveSana karata|
tini nehAYeta pavitra o mahimAnvita evaM tArA yA vale thAke tA theke vahu urdhve|

sapta AkAza o pRthivI evaM eguleAra madhye yAkichu Ache samasta kichu tA~rai pavitratA o mahimA gheASaNA kare| evaM emana kichu nei yA tAra saprazaMsa pavitratA o mahimA gheASanA kare nA| kintu tAdera pavitratA, mahimA gheASaNA teAmarA anudhAvana karate pAra nA| nizcaYa tini ati sahanazIla, kSamAparAYaNa|
yakhana Apani keAraAna pATha karena, takhana Ami ApanAra madhye o parakAle avizvAsIdera madhye pracchanna pardA phele dei|

Ami tAdera antarera upara AvaraNa rekhe dei, yAte tArA eke upalavdhi karate nA pAre evaM tAdera karNakuhare veAjhA cApiYe dei| yakhana Apani keAraAne pAlanakartAra ekatva AvRtti karena, takhana o anIhAvazataH orA pRSTa pradarzana kare cale yAYa|

yakhana tArA kAna pete ApanAra kathA zeAne, takhana tArA kena kAna pete tA zeAne, tA Ami bhAla jAni evaM eo jAni geApane AleAcanAkAle yakhana jAlemarA vale, teAmarA teA eka yAdugrastha vyaktira anusaraNa karacha|
dekhuna, orA ApanAra janye kemana upamA deYa| orA pathabhraSTa haYeche| ataeva, orA patha pete pAre nA|
tArA valeH yakhana AmarA asthite pariNata o cUrNa vicUrNa haYe yAva, takhanao ki natuna kare sRjita haYe utthita hava?
valunaH teAmarA pAthara haYe yAo kiMvA leAhA|

athavA emana keAna vastu, yA teAmAdera dhAraNAYa khuvai kaThina; tathApi tArA valaveH AmAdera ke purnavAra ke sRSTi karave| valunaH yini teAmAderake prathamavAra sRjana karechena| ataHpara tArA ApanAra sAmane mAthA nAr3ave evaM valaveH eTA kave have? valunaH have, sambhavataH zrIghrai|
yedina tini teAmAderake AhavAna karavena, ataHpara teAmarA tA~ra prazaMsA karate karate cale Asave| evaM teAmarA anumAna karave ye, sAmAnya samaYai avasthAna karechile|
AmAra vAndAderake vale dina, tArA yena yA uttama emana kathAi vale| zaYatAna tAdera madhye saMgharSa vAdhAYa| nizcaYa zaYatAna mAnuSera prakAzya zatru|

teAmAdera pAlanakartA teAmAdera samparke bhAlabhAve jJAta Achena| tini yadi cAna, teAmAdera prati rahamata karavena kiMvA yadi cAna, teAmAdera AyAva divena| Ami ApanAke odera savAra tattvAvadhAYaka rUpe preraNa karini|

ApanAra pAlanakartA tAdera samparke bhAlabhAve jJAta Achena, yArA AkAzasamUhe o bhupRSThe raYeche| Ami teA kataka paYagamvarake kataka paYagamvarera upara zreSThatva dAna karechi evaM dAudake yavura dAna karechi|
valunaH AllAha vyatIta yAderake teAmarA upAsya mane kara, tAderake AhavAna kara| athaca orA teA teAmAdera kaSTa dura karAra kSamatA rAkhe nA evaM tA parivartanao karate pAre nA|

yAderake tArA AhavAna kare, tArA nijerAi teA tAdera pAlanakartAra naikaTya lAbhera janya madhyastha tAlAza kare ye, tAdera madhye ke naikaTyazIla| tArA tA~ra rahamatera AzA kare evaM tA~ra zAstike bhaYa kare| nizcaYa ApanAra pAlanakartAra zAsti bhaYAvaha|
emana keAna janapada nei, yAke Ami keYAmata divasera pUrve dhvaMsa karava nA athavA yAke kaTheAra zAsti deva nA| eTA teA granthe lipivaddha haYe geche|

pUrvavartIgaNa katRka nidarzana asvIkAra karAra phalei AmAke nidarzanAvalI preraNa theke virata thAkate haYeche| Ami tAderake veAjhAvAra janye sAmudake uSTrI diYechilAma| ataHpara tArA tAra prati juluma karechila| Ami bhIti pradarzanera uddezei nidarzana preraNa kari|

evaM smaraNa karuna, Ami ApanAke vale diYechilAma ye, ApanAra pAlanakartA mAnuSake pariveSTana kare rekhechena evaM ye dRzya Ami ApanAke dekhiYechi tAo keAraAne ullekhita abhizapta vRkSa kevala mAnuSera parIkSAra janye| Ami tAderake bhaYa pradarzana kari| kintu ete tAdera avAdhyatAi Arao vRddhi pAYa|

smaraNa kara, yakhana Ami pherezatAderake valalAmaH Adamake sejadA kara, takhana ivalIsa vyatIta savAi sejadAYa par3e gela| kintu se valalaH Ami ki emana vyaktike sejadA karava, yAke Apani mATira dvArA sRSTi karechena?

se valalaH dekhuna teA, enA se vyakti, yAke Apani AmAra cAiteo ucca mAryAdA diYe diYechena| yadi Apani AmAke keYAmata divasa paryanta samaYa dena, tave Ami sAmAnya saMkhyaka chAr3A tAra vaMzadharaderake samUle naSTa kare deva|
AllAha valenaH cale yA, ataHpara tAdera madhya theke ye teAra anugAmI have, jAhAnnAmai have tAdera savAra zAsti-bharapura zAsti|

tui satyacyuta kare tAdera madhya theke yAke pArisa svIYa AoYAya dvArA, svIYa azvAreAhI o padAtika vAhinI niYe tAderake AkramaNa kara, tAdera artha-sampada o santAna-santatite zarIka haYe yA evaM tAderake pratizruti de| chalanA chAr3A zaYatAna tAderake keAna pratizruti deYa nA|
AmAra vAndAdera upara teAra keAna kSamatA nei ApanAra pAlanakartA yatheSTa kAryanirvAhI|
teAmAdera pAlanakartA tinii, yini teAmAdera janye samudre jalayAna cAlanA karena, yAte teAmarA tAra anugraha anveSana karate pAreA| niH sandehe tini teAmAdera prati parama daYAlU|

yakhana samudre teAmAdera upara vipada Ase, takhana zudhu AllAha vyatIta yAderake teAmarA AhavAna kare thAka tAderake teAmarA vismRta haYe yAo| ataHpara tini yakhana teAmAderake sthale bhir3iYe uddhAra kare nena, takhana teAmarA mukha phiriYe nAo| mAnuSa var3ai akRtajJa|

teAmarA ki e viSaYe nizcinta raYecha ye, tini teAmAderake sthalabhAge keAthAo bhUgarbhastha karavena nA| athavA teAmAdera upara prastara varSaNakArI ghurNijhar3a preraNa karavena nA, takhana teAmarA nijedera janye keAna karmavidhAYaka pAve nA|

athavA teAmarA ki e viSaYe nizcinta ye, tini teAmAderake ArekavAra samudre niYe yAvena nA, ataHpara teAmAdera janye mahA jhaTikA preraNa karavena nA, ataHpara akRtajJatAra zAstisvarUpa teAmAderake nimajjata karavena nA, takhana teAmarA AmAra viruddhe e viSaYe sAhAyyakArI kAuke pAve nA|

nizcaYa Ami Adama santAnake maryAdA dAna karechi, Ami tAderake sthale o jale calAcalera vAhana dAna karechi; tAderake uttama jIvaneApakaraNa pradAna karechi evaM tAderake aneka sRSTa vastura upara zreSThatva dAna karechi|

smaraNa kara, yedina Ami pratyeka dalake tAdera netAsaha AhavAna karava, ataHpara yAderake tAdera DAna hAte AmalanAmA deYA have, tArA nijedera AmalanAmA pATha karave evaM tAdera prati sAmAnya parimANao juluma have nA|
ye vyakti ihakAle andha chila se parakAleo andha evaM adhikatara pathabhrAnta|

tArA teA ApanAke haTiYe dite cAcchila ye viSaYa Ami ApanAra prati ohIra mAdhyame yA preraNa karechi tA theke ApanAra padaGkhalana ghaTAneAra janye tArA cur3Anta ceSTA kareche, yAte Apani AmAra prati kichu mithyA samvandhayukta karena| ete saphala hale tArA ApanAke vandhurUpe grahaNa kare nita|
Ami ApanAke dRr3hapada nA rAkhale Apani tAdera prati kichuTA jhu~kei par3atena|
takhana Ami avazyai ApanAke ihajIvane o parajIvane dviguNa zAstira AsvAdana karAtAma| e samaYa Apani AmAra meAkAvilAYa keAna sAhAyyakArI petena nA|
tArA teA ApanAke e bhukhanDa theke utkhAta kare dite cur3Anta ceSTA karechila yAte ApanAke ekhAna theke vahiskAra kare deYA yAYa| takhana tArAo ApanAra para sekhAne alpa kAlai mAtra Tike thAkata|
ApanAra pUrve Ami yata rasUla preraNa karechi, tAdera kSetreo erUpa niYama chila| Apani AmAra niYamera keAna vyatikrama pAvena nA|
sUrya Dhale par3Ara samaYa theke rAtrira andhakAra paryanta nAmAya kAYema karuna evaM phajarera keAraAna pAThao| nizcaYa phajarera keAraAna pATha mukheAmukhi haYa|
rAtrira kichu aMza keAraAna pATha saha jAgrata thAkuna| eTA ApanAra janye atirikta| haYata vA ApanAra pAlanakartA ApanAke meAkAme mAhamude pau~chAvena|
valunaH he pAlanakartA! AmAke dAkhila karuna satyarUpe evaM AmAke vera karuna satyarUpe evaM dAna karuna AmAke nijera kAcha theke rASTrIYa sAhAyya|
valunaH satya eseche evaM mithyA vilupta haYeche| nizcaYa mithyA vilupta haoYArai chila|
Ami keAraAne emana viSaYa nAyila kari yA reAgera sucikitsA evaM muminera janya rahamata| geAnAhagAradera teA ete zudhu kSatii vRddhi pAYa|
Ami mAnuSake neYAmata dAna karale se mukha phiriYe neYa evaM ahaMkAre dure sare yAYa; yakhana tAke keAna aniSTa sparza kare, takhana se ekevAre hatAza haYe par3e|
valunaH pratyekei nija rIti anuyAYI kAja kare| ataHpara ApanAra pAlanakartA vizeSa rUpe jAnena, ke sarvApekSA nirbhUla pathe Ache|
tArA ApanAke rUha samparke jijJesa kare| vale dinaH rUha AmAra pAlanakartAra Adeza ghaTita| e viSaYe teAmAderake sAmAnya jJAnai dAna karA haYeche|

Ami icchA karale ApanAra kAche ohIra mAdhame yA preraNa karechi tA avazyai pratyAhAra karate pAratAma| ataHpara Apani nijera janye tA AnaYanera vyApAre AmAra meAkAvilAYa keAna dAYitva vahanakArI pAvena nA|
e pratyAhAra nA karA ApanAra pAlanakartAra meheravAnI| nizcaYa ApanAra prati tA~ra karuNA virATa|
valunaH yadi mAnava o jvina ei keAraAnera anurUpa racanA kare AnaYanera janye jar3eA haYa, evaM tArA parasparera sAhAyyakArI haYa; tavuo tArA kakhanao era anurUpa racanA kare Anate pArave nA|
Ami ei keAraAne mAnuSake vibhinna upakAra dvArA sava rakama viSaYavastu vujhiYechi| kintu adhikAMza leAka asvIkAra nA kare thAkeni|
evaM tArA valeH AmarA kakhanao ApanAke vizvAsa karava nA, ye paryanta nA Apani bhUpRSTha theke AmAdera janye ekaTi jharaNA pravAhita kare dina|
athavA ApanAra janye khejurera o AGgurera ekaTi vAgAna have, ataHpara Apani tAra madhye nirjharinIsamUha pravAhita kare devena|
athavA Apani yemana vale thAkena, temanibhAve AmAdera upara AsamAnake khanDa-vikhanDa kare phele devena athavA AllAha o pherezatAderake AmAdera sAmane niYe Asavena|

athavA ApanAra keAna seAnAra tairI gRha have athavA Apani AkAze AreAhaNa karavena evaM AmarA ApanAra AkAze AreAhaNake kakhanao vizvAsa karavanA, ye paryanta nA Apani avatIrNa karena AmAdera prati eka grantha, yA AmarA pATha karava| valunaH pavitra mahAna AmAra pAlanakartA, ekajana mAnava, ekajana rasUla vai Ami ke?
AllAha ki mAnuSake paYagamvara kare pAThiYechena? tAdera ei uktii mAnuSake ImAna AnaYana theke virata rAkhe, yakhana tAdera nikaTa Ase hedAYeta|
valunaH yadi pRthivIte pherezatArA svacchande vicaraNa karata, tave Ami AkAza theke keAna pherezatAkei tAdera nikaTa paYagAmvara kare preraNa karatAma|
valunaH AmAra o teAmAdera madhye satya pratiSThAkArI hiseve AllAhai yatheSTa| tini teA svIYa vAndAdera viSaYe khavara rAkhena o dekhena|

AllAha yAke patha pradarzana karena, sei teA saThika patha prApta evaM yAke patha bhraSTa karena, tAdera janye Apani AllAha chAr3A keAna sAhAyyakArI pAvena nA| Ami keYAmatera dina tAdera samaveta karava tAdera mukhe bhara diYe calA avasthAYa, andha avasthAYa, muka avasthAYa evaM vadhira avasthAYa| tAdera AvAsasthala jAhAnnAma| yakhanai nirvApita haoYAra upakrama have Ami takhana tAdera janye agni Arao vRddhi kare diva|
eTAi tAdera zAsti| kAraNa, tArA AmAra nidarzanasamUha asvIkAra kareche evaM valecheH AmarA yakhana asthite pariNata o curNa-vicurNa haYe yAva, takhanao ki AmarA natunabhAve sRjita haYe utthita hava?

tArA ki dekheni ye, ye AllAha AsamAna o yamina sRjita karechena, tini tAdera mata mAnuSao punarAYa sRSTi karate sakSama? tini tAdera janye sthira karechena ekaTi nirdiSTa kAla, ete keAna sandeha nei; ataHpara jAlemarA asvIkAra chAr3A kichu kareni|
valunaH yadi AmAra pAlanakartAra rahamatera bhAnDAra teAmAdera hAte thAkata, tave vyaYita haYe yAoYAra AzaGkAYa avazyai tA dhare rAkhate| mAnuSa teA atizaYa kRpaNa|
Apani vaNI-isarAIlake jijJesa karuna, Ami mUsAke naYaTi prakAzya nidarzana dAna karechi| yakhana tini tAdera kAche Agamana karena, pherAuna tAke valalaH he mUsA, AmAra dhAranAYa tumi teA jAdugrastha|
tini valalenaH tumi jAna ye, AsamAna o yamInera pAlanakartAi esava nidarzanAvalI pratyakSa pramANasvarUpa nAyila karechena| he pherAuna, AmAra dhAraNAYa tumi dhvaMsa hate calecheA|
ataHpara se vanI isarAIlake deza theke utkhAta karate cAila, takhana Ami tAke o tAra saGgIdera savAike nimajjata kare dilAma|
tArapara Ami vanI isalAIlake valalAmaH e deze teAmarA vasavAsa kara| ataHpara yakhana parakAlera oYAdA vAstavAYita have, takhana teAmAdera ke jar3eA kare niYe upasthita hava|
Ami satyasaha e keAraAna nAyila karechi evaM satya saha eTA nAyila haYeche| Ami teA ApanAke zudhu susaMvAdAtA o bhaYapradarzaka karei preraNa karechi|
Ami keAraAnake yaticihna saha pRthaka pRthakabhAve pAThera upayeAgI karechi, yAte Apani eke leAkadera kAche dhIre dhIre pATha karena evaM Ami eke yathAyatha bhAve avatIrNa karechi|
valunaH teAmarA keAraAnake mAnya kara athavA amAnya kara; yArA era pUrva theke elema prApta haYeche, yakhana tAdera kAche era telAoYAta karA haYa, takhana tArA natamastake sejadAYa luTiYe par3e|
evaM valeH AmAdera pAlanakartA pavitra, mahAna| niHsandehe AmAdera pAlakartAra oYAdA avazyai pUrNa have|
tArA krandana karate karate natamastake bhumite luTiYe par3e evaM tAdera vinaYabhAva AreA vRddhi pAYa|

valunaH AllAha vale AhavAna kara kiMvA rahamAna vale, ye nAmei AhavAna kara nA kena, sava sundara nAma tA~rai| Apani nijera nAmAya AdAYakAle svara uccagrAse niYe giYe par3avena nA evaM niHzavdeo par3avena nA| etadubhaYera madhyamapanthA avalamvana karuna|

valunaH samasta prazaMsA AllAhara yini nA keAna santAna rAkhena, nA tA~ra sArvabheৗmatve keAna zarIka Ache evaM yini durdazAgrasta hana nA, ye kAraNe tA~ra keAna sAhayyakArIra praYeAjana hate pAre| sutarAM Apani sa-sambhrame tA~ra mAhAtna varNanA karate thAkuna|
sava prazaMsA AllAhara yini nijera vAndAra prati e grantha nAyila karechena evaM tAte keAna vakratA rAkhenani|

eke supratiSThita karechena yA AllAhara pakSa theke ekaTi bhISaNa vipadera bhaYa pradarzana kare evaM muminaderake yArA satkarma sampAdana kare-tAderake susaMvAda dAna kare ye, tAdera janye uttama pratidAna raYeche|
tArA tAte cirakAla avasthAna karave|
evaM tAderake bhaYa pradarzana karAra janye yArA vale ye, AllAhara santAna raYeche|
e samparke tAdera keAna jJAna nei evaM tAdera pitRpuruSaderao nei| kata kaThina tAdera mukhera kathA| tArA yA vale tA teA savai mithyA|
yadi tArA ei viSaYavastura prati vizvAsa sthApana nA kare, tave tAdera pazcAte sambhavataH Apani paritApa karate karate nijera prANa nipAta karavena|
Ami pRthivIstha sava kichuke pRthivIra janye zeAbhA karechi, yAte leAkadera parIkSA kari ye, tAdera madhye ke bhAla kAja kare|
evaM tAra upara yAkichu raYeche, avazyai tA Ami udbhidazUnya mATite pariNata kare deva|
Apani ki dhAraNA karena ye, guhA o gartera adhivAsIrA AmAra nidarzanAvalIra madhye vismaYakara chila?

yakhana yuvakarA pAhAr3era guhAYa AzraYagrahaNa kare takhana deAA kareH he AmAdera pAlanakartA, AmAderake nijera kAcha theke rahamata dAna karuna evaM AmAdera janye AmAdera kAja saThikabhAve pUrNa karuna|
takhana Ami kaYeka vacharera janye guhAYa tAdera kAnera upara nidrAra pardA phele dei|
ataHpara Ami tAderake punaratthita kari, ekathA jAnAra janye ye, dui dalera madhye keAna dala tAdera avasthAnakAla samparke adhika nirNaYa karate pAre|

ApanAra kAche tAdera itivRttAnta saThikabhAve varNanA karachi| tArA chila kaYekajana yuvaka| tArA tAdera pAlanakartAra prati vizvAsa sthApana karechila evaM Ami tAdera satpathe calAra zakti vAr3iYe diYechilAma|

Ami tAdera mana dRr3ha karechilAma, yakhana tArA uThe dA~r3iYechila| ataHpara tArA valalaH AmAdera pAlanakartA AsamAna o yamInera pAlanakartA AmarA kakhanao tAra parivarte anya keAna upAsyake AhavAna karava nA| yadi kari, tave tA atyanta garhita kAja have|

erA AmAderai sva-jAti, erA tA~ra parivarte aneka upAsya grahaNa kareche| tArA edera samparke prakAzya pramANa upasthita kare nA kena? ye AllAha samparke mithyA udbhAvana kare, tAra cAite adhika geAnAhagAra Ara ke?

teAmarA yakhana tAdera theke pRthaka hale evaM tArA AllAhara parivarte yAdera evAdata kare tAdera theke, takhana teAmarA guhAYa AzraYagrahaNa kara| teAmAdera pAlanakartA teAmAdera janye daYA vistAra karavena evaM tini teAmAdera janya teAmAdera kAja karmake phalaprasu karAra vyavasthA karavena|

tumi sUryake dekhave, yakhana udita haYa, tAdera guhA theke pAza keTe DAna dike cale yAYa evaM yakhana asta yAYa, tAdera theke pAza keTe vAmadike cale yAYa, athaca tArA guhAra prazasta catvare avasthita| eTA AllAhara nidarzanAvalIra anyatama| AllAha yAke satpathe cAlAna, sei satpatha prApta evaM tini yAke pathabhraSTa karena, Apani kakhanao tAra janye pathapradarzanakArI o sAhAyyakArI pAvena nA|

tumi mane karave tArA jAgrata, athaca tArA nidrita| Ami tAderake pArzva parivartana karAi DAna dike o vAma dike| tAdera kukura chila sAmanera pA duTi guhAdvAre prasArita kare| yadi tumi u~ki diYe tAderake dekhate, tave pechana phire palAYana karate evaM tAdera bhaYe AtaMka grasta haYe par3ate|

Ami emani bhAve tAderake jAgrata karalAma, yAte tArA paraspara jijJAsAvAda kare| tAdera ekajana valalaH teAmarA katakAla avasthAna karecha? tAdera keu valalaH ekadina athavA ekadinera kichu aMza avasthAna karachi| keu keu valalaH teAmAdera pAlanakartAi bhAla jAnena teAmarA katakAla avasthAna karecha| ekhana teAmAdera ekajanake teAmAdera ei mudrAsaha zahare preraNa kara; se yena dekhe keAna khAdya pavitra| ataHpara tA theke yena kichu khAdya niYe Ase teAmAdera janya; se yena namratA sahakAre yAYa o kichutei yena teAmAdera khavara kAuke nA jAnAYa|
tArA yadi teAmAdera khavara jAnate pAre, tave pAthara mere teAmAderake hatyA karave, athavA teAmAderake tAdera dharme phiriYe neve| tAhale teAmarA kakhanai sAphalya lAbha karave nA|

emanibhAve Ami tAdera khavara prakAza kare dilAma, yAte tArA jJAta haYa ye, AllAhara oYAdA satya evaM keYAmate keAna sandeha nei| yakhana tArA nijedera kartavya viSaYe paraspara vitarka karachila, takhana tArA valalaH tAdera upara seৗdha nirmANa kara| tAdera pAlanakartA tAdera viSaYe bhAla jAnena| tAdera kartavya viSaYe yAdera mata pravala hala, tArA valalaH AmarA avazyai tAdera sthAne masajida nirmAna karava|

ajJAta viSaYe anumAnera upara bhitti kare ekhana tArA valaveH tArA chila tina jana; tAdera caturthaTi tAdera kukura| ekathAo valave; tArA pA~ca jana| tAdera chaSThaTi chila tAdera kukura| Arao valaveH tArA chila sAta jana| tAdera aSTamaTi chila tAdera kukura| valunaH AmAra pAlanakartA tAdera saMkhyA bhAla jAnena| tAdera khavara alpa leAkai jAne| sAdhAraNa AleAcanA chAr3A Apani tAdera samparke vitarka karavena nA evaM tAdera avasthA samparke tAdera kAuke jijJAsAvAda o karavena nA|
Apani keAna kAjera viSaYe valavena nA ye, seTi Ami AgAmI kAla karava|

‘AllAha icchA karale’ valA vyatireke| yakhana bhule yAna, takhana ApanAra pAlanakartAke smaraNa karuna evaM valunaH AzA kari AmAra pAlanakartA AmAke era cAiteo nikaTatama satyera patha nirdeza karavena|
tAdera upara tAdera guhAYa tinaza vachara, atirikta Arao naYa vachara ativAhita haYeche|

valunaH tArA katakAla avasthAna kareche, tA AllAhai bhAla jAnena| nabheAmanDala o bhumanDalera adRzya viSaYera jJAna tA~rai kAche raYeche| tini kata camatkAra dekhena o zeAnena| tini vyatIta tAdera janya keAna sAhAyyakArI nei| tini kAuke nija kartRtve zarIka karena nA|
ApanAra prati ApanAra pAlanakartAra ye, kitAva pratyAdiSTa karA haYeche, tA pATha karuna| tA~ra vAkya parivartana karAra keu nAi| tA~ke vyatIta Apani kakhanai keAna AzraYa sthala pAvena nA|

Apani nijeke tAdera saMsarge Avaddha rAkhuna yArA sakAla o sandhyAYa tAdera pAlanakartAke tA~ra santuSTi arjanera uddezye AhavAna kare evaM Apani pArthiva jIvanera seৗndarya kAmanA kare tAdera theke nijera dRSTi phiriYe nevena nA| yAra manake AmAra smaraNa theke gAphela kare diYechi, ye, nijera pravRttira anusaraNa kare evaM yAra kArya kalApa hacche sImA atikrama karA, Apani tAra anugatya karavena nA|

valunaH satya teAmAdera pAlanakartAra pakSa theke Agata| ataeva, yAra icchA, vizvAsa sthApana karuka evaM yAra icchA amAnya karuka| Ami jAlemadera janye agni prastuta kare rekhechi, yAra veSTanI tAdera ke pariveSTana kare thAkave| yadi tArA pAnIYa prArthanA kare, tave pu~jera nyAYa pAnIYa deYA have yA tAdera mukhamanDala dagdha karave| kata nikRSTa pAnIYa evaM khuvai manda AzraYa|
yArA vizvAsa sthApana kare evaM satkarma sampAdana kare Ami satkarmazIladera puraskAra naSTa kari nA|
