tAderai janye Ache vasavAsera jAnnAta| tAdera pAdadeze pravAhita haYa naharasamUha| tAdera tathAYa svarNa-kaMkane alaMkRta karA have evaM tArA pAtalA o meATA rezamera savuja kApara paridhAna karave ematAvasthAYa ye, tArA siMhAsane samAsIna have| camatkAra pratidAna evaM kata uttama AzraYa|

Apani tAdera kAche du vyaktira udAharaNa varNanA karuna| Ami tAdera ekajanake duTi AGgurera vAgAna diYechi evaM e du’Tike kharjura vRkSa dvArA pariveSTita karechi evaM du era mAjhakhAne karechi zasyakSetra|
ubhaYa vAgAnai phaladAna kare evaM tA theke kichui hrAsa karata nA evaM ubhaYera phA~ke phA~ke Ami nahara pravAhita karechi|
se phala pela| ataHpara kathA prasaGge saGgIke valalaH AmAra dhana-sampada teAmAra cAite vezI evaM janavale Ami adhika zaktizAlI|
nijera prati juluma kare se tAra vAgAne praveza karala| se valalaH AmAra mane haYa nA ye, e vAgAna kakhanao dhvaMsa haYe yAve|
evaM Ami mane kari nA ye, keYAmata anuSThita have| yadi kakhanao AmAra pAlanakartAra kAche AmAke pau~che deYA haYa, tave sekhAne era cAite utkRSTa pAva|
tAra saGgI tAke kathA prasaGge valalaH tumi tA~ke asvIkAra karacha, yini teAmAke sRSTi karechena mATi theke, ataHpara vIrya theke, ataHpara rpUnAGga karechena teAmAke mAnavAkRtite?
kintu Ami teA ekathAi vali, AllAhai AmAra pAlanakartA evaM Ami kAuke AmAra pAlanakartAra zarIka mAni nA|

yadi tumi AmAke dhane o santAne teAmAra cAite kama dekha, tave yakhana tumi teAmAra vAgAne praveza karale, takhana ekathA kena valale nA; AllAha yA cAna, tAi haYa| AllAhara deYA vyatIta keAna zakti nei|

AzAkari AmAra pAlakartA AmAke teAmAra vAgAna apekSA utkRSTatara kichu devena evaM tAra (teAmAra vAgAnera) upara AsamAna theke Aguna preraNa karavena| ataHpara sakAla velAYa tA pariSkAra maYadAna haYe yAve|
athavA sakAle tAra pAni zukiYe yAve| ataHpara tumi tA tAlAza kare Anate pArave nA|

ataHpara tAra sava phala dhvaMsa haYe gela evaM se tAte yA vyaYa karechila, tAra janya sakAle hAta kacaliYe AkSepa karate lAgala| vAganaTi kAThasaha pur3e giYechila| se valate lAgalaH hAYa, Ami yadi kAuke AmAra pAlanakartAra sAthe zarIka nA karatAma|
AllAha vyatIta tAke sAhAyya karAra keAna leAka hala nA evaM se nijeo pratikAra karate pArala nA|
erUpa kSetre sava adhikAra satya AllAhara| tArai puraskAra uttama evaM tArai pradatta pratidAna zreSTha|

tAdera kAche pArthiva jIvanera upamA varNanA karuna| tA pAnira nyAYa, yA Ami AkAza theke nAyila kari| ataHpara era saMmizraNe zyAmala savuja bhUmija latA-pAtA nirgata haYa; ataHpara tA emana zuska curNa-vicurNa haYa ye, vAtAse ur3e yAYa| AllAha e savakichura upara zaktimAna|
dhanaizvarya o santAna-santati pArthiva jIvanera seৗndarya evaM sthAYI satkarmasamUha ApanAra pAlanakartAra kAche pratidAna prApti o AzA lAbhera janye uttama|
yedina Ami parvatasamUhake paricAlanA karava evaM Apani pRthivIke dekhavena ekaTi ummukta prAntara evaM Ami mAnuSake ekatrita karava ataHpara tAdera kAuke chAr3ava nA|

tArA ApanAra pAlanakartAra sAmane peza have sArivaddha bhAve evaM valA haveH teAmarA AmAra kAche ese gecha; yemana teAmAderake prathama vAra sRSTi karechilAma| nA, teAmarA teA valate ye, Ami teAmAdera janye keAna pratizruta samaYa nirdiSTa karava nA|

Ara AmalanAmA sAmane rAkhA have| tAte yA Ache; tAra kAraNe Apani aparAdhIderake bhIta-santrasta dekhavena| tArA valaveH hAYa AphaseAsa, e kemana AmalanAmA| e ye cheATa var3a keAna kichui vAda deYani-savai ete raYeche| tArA tAdera kRtakarmake sAmane upasthita pAve| ApanAra pAlanakartA kArao prati juluma karavena nA|

yakhana Ami pherezatAderake valalAmaH Adamake sejadA kara, takhana savAi sejadA karala ivalIsa vyatIta| se chila jinadera ekajana| se tAra pAlanakartAra Adeza amAnya karala| ataeva teAmarA ki AmAra parivarte tAke evaM tAra vaMzadharake vandhurUpe grahaNa karacha? athaca tArA teAmAdera zatru| eTA jAlemadera janye khuvai nikRSTa vadala|
nabheAmanDala o bhumanDalera sRjanakAle Ami tAderake sAkSya rAkhini evaM tAdera nijedera sRjanakAleo nA| evaM Ami emanao nai ye, vibhrAnta kArIderake sAhAyyakArIrUpe grahaNa karaveA|

yedina tini valavenaH teAmarA yAderake AmAra zarIka mane karate tAderake DAka| tArA takhana tAderake DAkave, kintu tArA e AhavAne sAr3A deve nA| Ami tAdera madhyasthale rekhe deva ekaTi mRtyu gahavara|
aparAdhIrA Aguna dekhe veAjhe neve ye, tAderake tAte patita hate have evaM tArA tA theke rAstA parivartana karate pArave nA|
nizcaYa Ami e keAraAne mAnuSake nAnAbhAve vibhinna upamAra dvArA AmAra vANI vujhiYechi| mAnuSa sava vastu theke adhika tarkapriYa|

hedAYeta AsAra para e pratIkSAi zudhu mAnuSake vizvAsa sthApana karate evaM tAdera pAlanakartAra kAche kSamA prArthanA karate virata rAkhe ye, kakhana Asave tAdera kAche pUrvavartIdera rItinIti athavA kakhana Asave tAdera kAcheAyAva sAmanAsAmani|

Ami rAsUlaganake susaMvAda dAtA o bhaYa pradarzana kArIrUpei preraNa kari evaM kApherarAi mithyA avalamvane vitarka kare, tA dvArA satyake vyartha kare deYAra uddezye evaM tArA AmAra nidarzanAvalIo yadvArA tAderake bhaYa pradarzana karA haYa, seguleAke ThATTArUpe grahaNa kareche|

tAra cAite adhika jAlema ke, yAke tAra pAlanakartAra kAlAma dvArA veAjhAneA haYa, ataHpara se tA theke mukha phiriYe neYa evaM tAra pUrvavartI kRtakarmasamUha bhule yAYa? Ami tAdera antarera upara pardA rekhe diYechi, yena tA nA veAjhe evaM tAdera kAne raYeche vadhiratAra veAjhA| yadi Apani tAderake satpathera prati dAoYAta dena, tave kakhanai tArA satpathe Asave nA|

ApanAra pAlanakartA kSamAzIla, daYAlu, yadi tini tAderake tAdera kRtakarmera janye pAkar3Ao karena tave tAdera zAsti tvarAmvita karatena, kintu tAdera janya raYeche ekaTi pratizruta samaYa, yA theke tArA sare yAoYAra jAYagA pAve nA|
esava janapadao tAderake Ami dhaMsa kare diYechi, yakhana tArA jAlema haYe giYechila evaM Ami tAdera dhvaMsera janye ekaTi pratizruta samaYa nirdiSTa karechilAma|
yakhana mUsA tA~ra yuvaka (saGgI) ke valalenaH dui samudrera saGgamasthale nA peৗchA paryanta Ami Asava nA athavA Ami yuga yuga dhare calate thAkava|
ataHpara yakhana tA~rA dui sumudrera saGgamasthale peৗchAlena, takhana tA~rA nijedera mAchera kathA bhule gelena| ataHpara mAchaTi samudre sur3aGga patha sRSTi kare neme gela|
yakhana tA~rA se sthAnaTi atikrama kare gelena, mUsA saGgI ke valalenaH AmAdera nAzatA Ana| AmarA ei saphare parizrAnta haYe par3echi|

se valalaH Apani ki lakSya karechena, AmarA yakhana prastara khanDe AzraYa niYechilAma, takhana Ami mAchera kathA bhule giYechilAma| zaYatAnai AmAke ekathA smaraNa rAkhate bhuliYe diYechila| mAchaTi Azcarya janaka bhAve samudre nijera patha kare niYeche|
mUsA valalenaH AmarA teA e sthAnaTii khu~jachilAma| ataHpara tA~rA nijedera cihna dhare phire calalena|
ataHpara tA~rA AmAra vAndAdera madhye emana ekajanera sAkSAta pelena, yAke Ami AmAra pakSa theke rahamata dAna karechilAma o AmAra pakSa theke diYechilAma eka vizeSa jJAna|
mUsA tA~ke valalenaH Ami ki e zarte ApanAra anusaraNa karate pAri ye, satyapathera ye jJAna ApanAke zekhAneA haYeche, tA theke AmAke kichu zikSA devena?
tini valalenaH Apani AmAra sAthe kichutei dhairyyadhAraNa kare thAkate pAravena nA|
ye viSaYa veAjhA ApanAra AYattAdhIna naYa, tA dekhe Apani dhairyyadhAraNa karavena kemana kare?
mUsA valalenaH AllAha cAhena teA Apani AmAke dhairyyazIla pAvena evaM Ami ApanAra keAna Adeza amAnya karava nA|
tini valalenaH yadi Apani AmAra anusaraNa karenai tave keAna viSaYe AmAke prazna karavena nA, ye paryanta nA Ami nijei se samparke ApanAke kichu vali|

ataHpara tArA calate lAgalaH avazeSe yakhana tArA neৗkAYa AreAhaNa karala, takhana tini tAte chidra kare dilena| mUsA valalenaH Apani ki era AreAhIderake DuviYe deYAra janye ete chidra kare dilena? nizcaYai Apani ekaTi gurutara manda kAja karalena|
tini valalenaH Ami ki valini ye, Apani AmAra sAthe kichutei dhairyya dharate pAravena nA?
mUsA valalenaH AmAke AmAra bhulera janye aparAdhI karavena nA evaM AmAra kAje AmAra upara kaTheAratA AreApa karavena nA|

ataHpara tArA calate lAgala| avazeSe yakhana ekaTi vAlakera sAkSAta pelena, takhana tini tAke hatyA karalena| mUsA valalena? Apani ki ekaTi nispApa jIvana zeSa kare dilena prANera vinimaYa chAr3Ai? nizcaYai Apani teA eka gurutara anyAYa kAja karalena|
tini valalenaH Ami ki valini ye, Apani AmAra sAthe dhairyya dhare thAkate pAravena nA|
mUsA valalenaH erapara yadi Ami ApanAke keAna viSaYe prazna kari, tave Apani AmAke sAthe rAkhavena nA| Apani AmAra pakSa theke abhiyeAga mukta haYe gechena|

ataHpara tArA calate lAgala, avazeSe yakhana ekaTi janapadera adhivAsIdera kAche peৗche tAdera kAche khAvAra cAila, takhana tArA tAdera atitheYatA karate asvIkAra karala| ataHpara tArA sekhAne ekaTi pataneAmmukha prAcIra dekhate pelena, seTi tini seAjA kare dA~r3a kariYe dilena| mUsA valalenaH Apani icchA karale tAdera kAcha theke era pArizramika AdAYa karate pAratena|
tini valalenaH ekhAnei AmAra o ApanAra madhye samparkaccheda hala| ekhana ye viSaYe Apani dhairyya dharate pArenani, Ami tAra tAtparya vale dicchi|

neৗkATira vyApAre-seTi chila kaYekajana daridra vyaktira| tArA samudre jIvikA anveSana karata| Ami icchA karalAma ye, seTike kraTiyukta kare dei| tAdera aparadike chila eka vAdazAha| se valapraYeAge pratyekaTi neৗkA chiniYe nita|
vAlakaTira vyApAra tAra pitA-mAtA chila ImAnadAra| Ami AzaGkA karalAma ye, se avAdhyatA o kuphara dvArA tAderake prabhAvita karave|
ataHpara Ami icchA karalAma ye, tAdera pAlanakartA tAderake mahattara, tAra cAite pavitratAYa o bhAlavAsAYa ghaniSThatara ekaTi zreSTha santAna dAna karuka|

prAcIrera vyApAra-seTi chila nagarera dujana pitRhIna vAlakera| era nIce chila tAdera guptadhana evaM tAdera pitA chila satkarma parAYana| sutarAM ApanAra pAlanakartA dAYavazataH icchA karalena ye, tArA yeৗvane padArpana karuka evaM nijedera guptadhana uddhAra karuka| Ami nija mate eTA karini| Apani ye viSaYe dhairyyadhAraNa karate akSama haYechilena, ei hala tAra vyAkhyA|
tArA ApanAke yulakAranAina samparke jijJAsA kare| valunaH Ami teAmAdera kAche tA~ra kichu avasthA varNanA karava|
Ami tAke pRthivIte pratiSThita karechilAma evaM pratyeka viSaYera kAryeApakaraNa dAna karechilAma|
ataHpara tini eka kAryeApakaraNa avalamvana karalena|

avazeSe tini yakhana suryera astAcale peৗchalena; takhana tini suryake eka paGkila jalAzaYe asta yete dekhalena evaM tini sekhAne eka sampradAYake dekhate pelena| Ami valalAma, he yulakAranAina! Apani tAderake zAsti dite pArena athavA tAderake sadaYabhAve grahaNa karate pArena|
tini valalenaH ye keu sImAlaGghanakArI have Ami tAke zAsti deva| ataHpara tini tA~ra pAlanakartAra kAche phire yAvena| tini tAke kaTheAra zAsti devena|
evaM ye vizvAsa sthApana kare o satkarma kare tAra janya pratidAna raYeche kalyANa evaM AmAra kAje tAke sahaja nirdeza deva|
ataHpara tini eka upAYa avalamvana karalena|
avazeSe tini yakhana sUryera udaYAcale peৗchalena, takhana tini tAke emana eka sampradAYera upara udaYa hate dekhalena, yAdera janye sUryatApa theke AtnarakSAra keAna Ar3Ala Ami sRSTi karini|
prakRta ghaTanA emanii| tAra vRttAnta Ami samyaka avagata Achi|
AvAra tini eka patha dharalena|
avazeSe yakhana tini dui parvata pracIrera madhyasthale peৗchalena, takhana tini sekhAne eka jAtike pelena, yArA tA~ra kathA ekevArei vujhate pArachila nA|

tArA valalaH he yulakAranAina, iYAjuja o mAjuja deze azAnti sRSTi kareche| Apani valale AmarA ApanAra janye kichu kara dhArya karava ei zarte ye, Apani AmAdera o tAdera madhye ekaTi prAcIra nirmANa kare devena|
tini valalenaH AmAra pAlanakartA AmAke ye sAmarthya diYechena, tAi yatheSTa| ataeva, teAmarA AmAke zrama diYe sAhAyya kara| Ami teAmAdera o tAdera madhye ekaTi sudRr3ha prAcIra nirmANa kare deva|

teAmarA AmAke leAhAra pAta ene dAo| avazeSe yakhana pAhAr3era madhyavartI phA~kA sthAna pUrNa haYe gela, takhana tini valalenaH teAmarA hA~pare dama dite thAka| avazeSe yakhana tA Agune pariNata hala, takhana tini valalenaH teAmarA galita tAmA niYe esa, Ami tA era upare Dhele dei|
ataHpara iYAjuja o mAjuja tAra upare AreAhaNa karate pArala nA evaM tA bheda karate o sakSama hala nA|
yulakAranAina valalenaH eTA AmAra pAlanakartAra anugraha| yakhana AmAra pAlanakartAra pratizruta samaYa Asave, takhana tini eke cUrNa-vicUrNa kare devena evaM AmAra pAlanakartAra pratizruti satya|
Ami sedina tAderake dale dale taraGgera AkAre cher3e deva evaM ziGgAYa phu~tkAra deYA have| ataHpara Ami tAdera savAike ekatrita kare Anava|
sedina Ami kApheradera kAche jAhAnnAmake pratyakSa bhAve upasthita karava|
yAdera cakSusamUhera upara pardA chila AmAra smaraNa theke evaM yArA zunateo sakSama chila nA|
kApherarA ki mane kare ye, tArA AmAra parivarte AmAra vAndAderake abhibhAvaka rUpe grahaNa karave? Ami kApheradera abhyarthanAra janye jAhAnnAmake prastuta kare rekhechi|
valunaH Ami ki teAmAderake sesava leAkera saMvAda deva, yArA karmera dika diYe khuvai kSatigrasta|
tArAi se leAka, yAdera praceSTA pArthivajIvane vibhrAnta haYa, athaca tArA mane kare ye, tArA satkarma kareche|

tArAi se leAka, yArA tAdera pAlanakartAra nidarzanAvalI evaM tA~ra sAthe sAkSAtera viSaYa asvIkAra kare| phale tAdera karma niSphala haYe yAYa| sutarAM keYAmatera dina tAdera janya Ami keAna gurutva sthira karava nA|
jAhAnnAma-eTAi tAdera pratiphala; kAraNa, tArA kAphera haYeche evaM AmAra nidarzanAvalI o rasUlagaNake vidrUpera viSaYa rUpe grahaNa kareche|
yArA vizvAsa sthApana kare o satkarma sampAdana kare, tAdera abhyarthanAra janye Ache jAnnAtula pheradAusa|
sekhAne tArA cirakAla thAkave, sekhAna theke sthAna parivartana karate cAive nA|

valunaH AmAra pAlanakartAra kathA, lekhAra janye yadi samudrera pAni kAli haYa, tave AmAra pAlanakartAra kathA, zeSa haoYAra Agei se samudra niHzeSita haYe yAve| sAhAyyArthe anurUpa ArekaTi samudra ene dileo|

valunaH Ami o teAmAdera matai ekajana mAnuSa, AmAra prati pratyAdeza haYa ye, teAmAdera ilAhai ekamAtra ilAha| ataeva, ye vyakti tAra pAlanakartAra sAkSAta kAmanA kare, se yena, satkarma sampAdana kare evaM tAra pAlanakartAra evAdate kAuke zarIka nA kare|
kApha-hA-iYA-Aina-sAda
eTA ApanAra pAlanakartAra anugrahera vivaraNa tA~ra vAndA yAkAriYAra prati|
yakhana se tA~ra pAlanakartAke AhavAna karechila nibhRte|
se valalaH he AmAra pAlanakartA AmAra asthi vaYasa-bhArAvanata haYeche; vArdhakye mastaka suzubhra haYeche; he AmAra pAlanakartA! ApanAke Deke Ami kakhanao viphalamaneAratha haini|
Ami bhaYa kari AmAra para AmAra svageAtrake evaM AmAra strI vandhyA; kAjei Apani nijera pakSa theke AmAke eka jana kartavya pAlanakArI dAna karuna|
se AmAra sthalAbhiSikta have iYAkuva vaMzera evaM he AmAra pAlanakartA, tAke karuna santeASajanaka|
he yAkAriYA, Ami teAmAke eka putrera susaMvAda dicchi, tAra nAma have iYAhaiYA| itipUrve ei nAme Ami kArao nAma karaNa karini|
se valalaH he AmAra pAlanakartA kemana kare AmAra putra have athaca AmAra strI ye vandhyA, Ara Amio ye vArdhakyera zeSa prAnte upanIta|
tini valalenaH emanitei have| teAmAra pAlanakartA vale diYechenaH eTA AmAra pakSe sahaja| Ami teA purve teAmAke sRSTi karechi evaM tumi kichui chile nA|
se valalaH he AmAra pAlanakartA, AmAke ekaTi nirdazana dina| tini valalena teAmAra nidarzana ei ye, tumi sustha avasthAYa tina dina mAnuSera sAthe kathAvArtA valave nA|
ataHpara se kakSa theke vera haYe tAra sampradAYera kAche ela evaM iGgite tAderake sakAla sandhyAYa AllAhake smaraNa karate valalaH
he iYAhaiYA dRr3hatAra sAthe ei grantha dhAraNa kara| Ami tAke zaizavei vicAravuddhi dAna karechilAma|
evaM nijera pakSa theke Agraha o pavitratA diYechi| se chila paraheyagAra|
pitA-mAtAra anugata evaM se uddhata, nApharamAna chila nA|
tAra prati zAnti-yedina se janmagrahaNa kare evaM yedina mRtyuvaraNa karave evaM yedina jIvitAvasthAYa punarutthita have|
ei kitAve mAraiYAmera kathA varNanA karuna, yakhana se tAra parivArera leAkajana theke pRthaka haYe pUrvadike eka sthAne AzraYa nila|
ataHpara tAdera theke nijeke Ar3Ala karAra janye se pardA karaleA| ataHpara Ami tAra kAche AmAra rUha preraNa karalAma, se tAra nikaTa purNa mAnavAkRtite AtnaprakAza karala|
mAraiYAma valalaH Ami teAmA theke daYAmaYera AzraYa prArthanA kari yadi tumi AllAhabhIru hao|
se valalaH Ami teA zudhu teAmAra pAlanakartA prerita, yAte teAmAke eka pavitra putra dAna kare yAva|
mariiYAma valalaH kirUpe AmAra putra have, yakhana keAna mAnava AmAke sparza kareni evaM Ami vyabhicAriNIo kakhanao chilAma nA?

se valalaH emanitei have| teAmAra pAlanakartA valechena, eTA AmAra janye sahaja sAdhya evaM Ami tAke mAnuSera janye ekaTi nidarzana o AmAra pakSa theke anugraha svarUpa karate cAi| eTA teA eka sthirIkRta vyApAra|
ataHpara tini garbhe santAna dhAraNa karalena evaM tatsaha eka dUravartI sthAne cale gelena|
prasava vedanA tA~ke eka khejura vRkSa-mUle AzraYa nite vAdhya karala| tini valalenaH hAYa, Ami yadi keAnarUpe era pUrve mare yetAma evaM mAnuSera smRti theke vilupta haYe, yetAma!
ataHpara pherezatA tAke nimnadika theke AoYAya dilena ye, tumi duHkha kareA nA| teAmAra pAlanakartA teAmAra pAYera talAYa ekaTi nahara jAri karechena|
Ara tumi nijera dike khejura gAchera kAnDe nAr3A dAo, tA theke teAmAra upara supakka khejura patita have|

yakhana AhAra kara, pAna kara evaM cakSu zItala kara| yadi mAnuSera madhye kAuke tumi dekha, tave vale dioH Ami AllAhara uddeze reAyA mAnata karachi| sutarAM Aja Ami kichutei keAna mAnuSera sAthe kathA valava nA|
ataHpara tini santAnake niYe tAra sampradAYera kAche upasthita halena| tArA valalaH he mAraiYAma, tumi ekaTi aghaTana ghaTiYe vasecha|
he hArUNa-bhAginI, teAmAra pitA asat vyakti chilena nA evaM teAmAra mAtAo chila nA vyabhicArinI|
ataHpara tini hAte santAnera dike iGgita karalena| tArA valalaH ye keAlera zizu tAra sAthe AmarA kemana kare kathA valava?
santAna valalaH Ami teA AllAhara dAsa| tini AmAke kitAva diYechena evaM AmAke navI karechena|
Ami yekhAnei thAki, tini AmAke varakatamaYa karechena| tini AmAke nirdeza diYechena, yatadina jIvita thAki, tatadina nAmAya o yAkAta AdAYa karate|
evaM jananIra anugata thAkate evaM AmAke tini uddhata o hatabhAgya karenani|
AmAra prati sAlAma yedina Ami janmagrahaNa karechi, yedina mRtyuvaraNa karava evaM yedina punarujjIvita haYe utthita hava|
ei mAraiYAmera putra IsA| satyakathA, ye samparke leAkerA vitarka kare|
AllAha emana nana ye, santAna grahaNa karavena, tini pavitra o mahimAmaYa sattA, tini yakhana keAna kAja karA siddhAnta karena, takhana ekathAi valenaH hao evaM tA haYe yAYa|
tini Arao valalenaH nizcaYa AllAha AmAra pAlanakartA o teAmAdera pAlanakartA| ataeva, teAmarA tAra evAdata kara| eTA sarala patha|
ataHpara tAdera madhye dalaguleA pRthaka pRthaka patha avalamvana karala| sutarAM mahAdivasa AgamanakAle kApheradera janye dhvaMsa|
sedina tArA ki camatkAra zunave evaM dekhave, yedina tArA AmAra kAche Agamana karave| kintu Aja jAlemarA prakAzya vibhrAntite raYeche|
Apani tAderake paritApera divasa samparke huziYAra kare dina yakhana sava vyApArera mImAMsA haYe yAve| ekhana tArA anavadhAnatAYa Ache evaM tArA vizvAsa sthApana karache nA|
Amii cur3Anta mAlikAnAra adhikArI hava pRthivIra evaM tAra upara yArA Ache tAdera evaM AmArai kAche tArA pratyAvartita have|
Apani ei kitAve ivrAhImera kathA varNanA karuna| nizcaYa tini chilena satyavAdI, navI|
yakhana tini tAra pitAke valalenaH he AmAra pitA, ye zeAne nA, dekhe nA evaM teAmAra keAna upakAre Ase nA, tAra evAdata kena kara?
he AmAra pitA, AmAra kAche emana jJAna eseche; yA teAmAra kAche Aseni, sutarAM AmAra anusaraNa kara, Ami teAmAke sarala patha dekhAva|
he AmAra pitA, zaYatAnera evAdata kareA nA| nizcaYa zaYatAna daYAmaYera avAdhya|
he AmAra pitA, Ami AzaGkA kari, daYAmaYera ekaTi AyAva teAmAke sparza karave, ataHpara tumi zaYatAnera saGgI haYe yAve|

pitA valalaH ye ivrAhIma, tumi ki AmAra upAsyadera theke mukha phiriYe niccha? yadi tumi virata nA hao, Ami avazyai prastarAghAte teAmAra prANanAza karava| tumi ciratare AmAra kAcha theke dUra haYe yAo|
ivrAhIma valalenaH teAmAra upara zAnti heAka, Ami AmAra pAlanakartAra kAche teAmAra janye kSamA prArthanA karava| nizcaYa tini AmAra prati meheravAna|
Ami parityAga karachi teAmAderake evaM teAmarA AllAha vyatIta yAdera evAdata kara tAderake; Ami AmAra pAlanakartAra evAdata karava| AzA kari, AmAra pAlanakartAra evAdata kare Ami vaJcita hava nA|
ataHpara tini yakhana tAderake evaM tAra AllAha vyatIta yAdera evAdata karata, tAdera savAike parityAga karalena, takhana Ami tAke dAna karalAma isahAka o iYAkuva evaM pratyekake navI karalAma|
Ami tAderake dAna karalAma AmAra anugraha evaM tAderake dilAma samucca sukhyAti|
ei kitAve mUsAra kathA varNanA karuna, tini chilena maneAnIta evaM tini chilena rAsUla, navI|
Ami tAke AhavAna karalAma tUra pAhAr3era DAna dika theke evaM gur3hatattva AleAcanAra uddeze tAke nikaTavartI karalAma|
Ami nija anugrahe tA~ke dAna karalAma tA~ra bhAi hArunake navIrUpe|
ei kitAve isamAIlera kathA varNanA karuna, tini pratizruti pAlane satyAzraYI evaM tini chilena rasUla, navI|
tini tA~ra parivAravargake nAmAya o yAkAta AdAYera nirdeza ditena evaM tini tA~ra pAlanakartAra kAche pachandanIYa chilena|
ei kitAve idrIsera kathA AleAcanA karuna, tini chilena satyavAdI navI|
Ami tAke ucce unnIta karechilAma|

erAi tArA-navIgaNera madhya theke yAderake AllAha tA’AlA neYAmata dAna karechena| erA Adamera vaMzadhara evaM yAderake Ami nUhera sAthe neৗkAYa AreAhana kariYechilAma, tAdera vaMzadhara, evaM ivrAhIma o isarAIlera vaMzadhara evaM yAderake Ami patha pradarzana karechi o maneAnIta karechi, tAdera vaMzeAdbhUta| tAdera kAche yakhana daYAmaYa AllAhara AYAtasamUha pATha karA hata, takhana tArA sejadAYa luTiYe par3ata evaM krandana karata|
ataHpara tAdera pare ela apadArtha paravartIrA| tArA nAmAya naSTa karala evaM kupravRttira anuvartI hala| sutarAM tArA acirei pathabhraSTatA pratyakSa karave|
kintu tArA vyatIta, yArA taovA kareche, vizvAsa sthApana kareche| sutarAM tArA jAnnAte praveza karave evaM tAdera upara keAna juluma karA have nA|
tAdera sthAYI vasavAsa have yAra oYAdA daYAmaYa AllAha tA~ra vAndAderake adRzyabhAve diYechena| avazyai tA~ra oYAdAra tArA pau~chAve|
tArA sekhAne sAlAma vyatIta keAna asAra kathAvArtA zunave nA evaM sekhAne sakAla-sandhyA tAdera janye ruyI thAkave|
eTA ai jAnnAta yAra adhikArI karava AmAra vAndAdera madhye paraheyagAraderake|

(jivrAila valalaH) Ami ApanAra pAlanakartAra Adeza vyatIta avataraNa kari nA, yA AmAdera sAmane Ache, yA AmAdera pazcAte Ache evaM yA e dui-era madhyasthale Ache, savai tA~ra evaM ApanAra pAlanakartA vismRta haoYAra nana|
tini nabheAmanDala, bhUmanDale etadubhaYera madhyavartI savAra pAlanakartA| sutarAM tA~rai vandegI karuna evaM tAte dRr3ha thAkuna Apani ki tA~ra samanAma kAuke jAnena?
mAnuSa valeH AmAra mRtyu hale para Ami ki jIvita avasthAYa punarutthita hava?
mAnuSa ki smaraNa kare nA ye, Ami tAke iti pUrve sRSTi karechi evaM se takhana kichui chila nA|
sutarAM ApanAra pAlanakartAra kasama, Ami avazyai tAderake evaM zaYatAnaderake ekatre samaveta karava, ataHpara avazyai tAderake natajAnu avasthAYa jAhAnnAmera cArapAze upasthita karava|
ataHpara pratyeka sampradAYera madhye ye daYAmaYa AllAhara sarvAdhika avAdhya Ami avazyai tAke pRthaka kare neva|
ataHpara tAdera madhye yArA jAhAnnAme pravezera adhika yeAgya, Ami tAdera viSaYe bhAleAbhAve jJAta Achi|
teAmAdera madhye emana keu nei ye tathAYa peৗchave nA| eTA ApanAra pAlanakartAra anivArya phAYasAlA|
ataHpara Ami paraheyagAraderake uddhAra karava evaM jAlemaderake sekhAne natajAnu avasthAYa cher3e deva|
yakhana tAdera kAche AmAra suspaSTa AYAtasamUha telAoYAta karA haYa, takhana kApherarA muminaderake valeH dui dalera madhye keAnaTi martavAYa zreSTha evaM kAra majalisa uttama?
tAdera pUrve kata mAnava geASThIke Ami vinAza karechi, tArA tAdera cAite sampade o jA~ka-jamake zreSTha chila|

valuna, yArA pathabhraSTatAYa Ache, daYAmaYa AllAha tAderake yatheSTa avakAza devena; emanaki avazeSe tArA pratyakSa karave ye viSaYe tAderake oYAdA deYA hacche, tA AyAva heAka athavA keYAmatai heAka| sutarAM takhana tArA jAnate pArave ke martavAYa nikRSTa o dalavale dUrvala|
yArA satpathe cale AllAha tAdera pathaprApti vRddhi karena evaM sthAYI satkarmasamUha teAmAra pAlanakartAra kAche saoYAvera dika diYe zreSTha evaM pratidAna hiseveo zreSTa|
Apani ki tAke lakSya karechena ye, AmAra nidarzanAvalIte vizvAsa kare nA evaM valeH AmAke artha-sampada o santAna-santati avazyai deYA have|
se ki adRzya viSaYa jene pheleche, athavA daYAmaYa AllAhara nikaTa theke keAna pratizruti prApta haYeche?
nA, eTA Thika naYa| se yA vale Ami tA likhe rAkhava evaM tAra zAsti dIrghAYita karate thAkava|
se yA vale, mRtyura para Ami tA niYe neva evaM se AmAra kAche Asave ekAkI|
tArA AllAha vyatIta anyAnya ilAha grahaNa kareche, yAte tArA tAdera janye sAhAyyakArI haYa|
kakhanai naYa, tArA tAdera evAdata asvIkAra karave evaM tAdera vipakSe cale yAve|
Apani ki lakSya karenani ye, Ami kApheradera upara zaYatAnaderake cher3e diYechi| tArA tAderake vizeSabhAve (mandakarme) utsAhita kare|
sutarAM tAdera vyApAre Apani tAr3Ahur3A karavena nA| Ami teA tAdera gaNanA pUrNa karachi mAtra|
sedina daYAmaYera kAche paraheyagAraderake atithirUpe samaveta karava,
evaM aparAdhIderake pipAsArta avasthAYa jAhAnnAmera dike hA~kiYe niYe yAva|
ye daYAmaYa AllAhara kAcha theke pratizruti grahaNa kareche, se vyatIta Ara keu supAriza karAra adhikArI have nA|
tArA valeH daYAmaYa AllAha santAna grahaNa karechena|
nizcaYa teAmarA teA eka adbhuta kAnDa karecha|
haYa teA era kAraNei ekhanai nabheAmanDala pheTe par3ave, pRthivI khanDa-vikhanDa have evaM parvatamAlA cUrNa-vicurNa have|
e kAraNe ye, tArA daYAmaYa AllAhara janye santAna AhavAna kare|
athaca santAna grahaNa karA daYAmaYera janya zeAbhanIYa naYa|
nabheAmanDala o bhU-manDale keu nei ye, daYAmaYa AllAhara kAche dAsa haYe upasthita have nA|
tA~ra kAche tAdera parisaMkhyAna raYeche evaM tini tAderake gaNanA kare rekhechena|
keYAmatera dina tAdera savAi tA~ra kAche ekAkI avasthAYa Asave|
yArA vizvAsa sthApana kare evaM satkarma sampAdana kare, tAderake daYAmaYa AllAha bhAlavAsA devena|
Ami keAraAnake ApanAra bhASAYa sahaja kare diYechi, yAte Apani era dvArA paraheyagAraderake susaMvAda dena evaM kalahakArI sampradAYake satarka karena|
tAdera pUrve Ami kata mAnavageASThIke dhvaMsa karechi| Apani ki tAdera kAhArao sAr3A pAna, athavA tAdera kSInatama AoYAya o zunate pAna?
teAYA-hA
ApanAke kleza devAra janya Ami ApanAra prati keAraAna avatIrNa karini|
kintu tAderai upadezera janya yArA bhaYa kare|
eTA tA~ra kAcha theke avatIrNa, yini bhUmanDala o samucca nabheAmanDala sRSTi karechena|
tini parama daYAmaYa, Araze samAsIna haYechena|
nabheAmanDale, bhumanDale, etadubhaYera madhyavartI sthAne evaM sikta bhUgarbhe yA Ache, tA tA~rai|
yadi tumi uccakanTheo kathA vala, tini teA gupta o tadapekSAo gupta viSaYavastu jAnena|
AllAha tini vyatIta keAna upAsya ilAha nei| sava seৗndaryamanDita nAma tA~rai|
ApanAra kAche mUsAra vRttAnta pau~cheche ki|

tini yakhana Aguna dekhalena, takhana parivAravargake valalenaH teAmarA ekhAne avasthAna kara Ami Aguna dekhechi| sambhavataH Ami tA theke teAmAdera kAche kichu Aguna jAliYe Anate pArava athavA Agune peৗche pathera sandhAna pAva|
ataHpara yakhana tini Agunera kAche peৗchalena, takhana AoYAja Asala he mUsA,
Amii teAmAra pAlanakartA, ataeva tumi jutA khule phela, tumi pavitra upatyakA tuYAYa raYecha|
evaM Ami teAmAke maneAnIta karechi, ataeva yA pratyAdeza karA hacche, tA zunate thAka|
Amii AllAha Ami vyatIta keAna ilAha nei| ataeva AmAra evAdata kara evaM AmAra smaraNArthe nAmAya kAYema kara|
keYAmata avazyai Asave, Ami tA geApana rAkhate cAi; yAte pratyekei tAra karmAnuyAYI phala lAbha kare|
sutarAM ye vyakti keYAmate vizvAsa rAkhe nA evaM nija khAhezera anusaraNa kare, se yena teAmAke tA theke nivRtta nA kare| nivRtta hale tumi dhvaMsa haYe yAve|
he mUsA, teAmAra DAnahAte oTA ki?
tini valalenaH eTA AmAra lAThi, Ami era upara bhara dei evaM era dvArA AmAra chAgapAlera janye vRkSapatra jher3e pheli evaM ete AmAra anyAnya kAja o cale|
AllAha valalenaH he mUsA, tumi oTA nikSepa kara|
ataHpara tini tA nikSepa karalena, amani tA sApa haYe chuTAchuTi karate lAgala|
AllAha valalenaH tumi tAke dhara evaM bhaYa kareA nA, Ami ekhani eke pUrvAvasthAYa phiriYe deva|
teAmAra hAta vagale rAkha, tA vera haYe Asave nirmala ujjvala haYe anya eka nidarzana rUpe; keAna deASa chAr3Ai|
eTA ejanye ye, Ami AmAra virATa nidarzanAvalIra kichu teAmAke dekhAi|
pherAunera nikaTa yAo, se dAruNa uddhata haYe geche|
mUsA valalenaH he AmAra pAlanakartA AmAra vakSa prazasta kare dina|
evaM AmAra kAja sahaja kare dina|
evaM AmAra jihavA theke jar3atA dUra kare dina|
yAte tArA AmAra kathA vujhate pAre|
evaM AmAra parivAravargera madhya theke AmAra ekajana sAhAyyakArI kare dina|
AmAra bhAi hArunake|
tAra mAdhyame AmAra keAmara majavuta karuna|
evaM tAke AmAra kAje aMzIdAra karuna|
yAte AmarA vezI kare ApanAra pavitratA o mahimA gheASanA karate pAri|
evaM vezI parimANe ApanAke smaraNa karate pAri|
Apani teA AmAdera avasthA savai dekhachena|
AllAha valalenaH he mUsA, tumi yA ceYecha tA teAmAke deYA hala|
Ami teAmAra prati Arao ekavAra anugraha karechilAma|
yakhana Ami teAmAra mAtAke nirdeza diYechilAma yA ataHpara varNita hacche|

ye, tumi (mUsAke) sinduke rAkha, ataHpara tA dariYAYa bhAsiYe dAo, ataHpara dariYA tAke tIre Thele deve| tAke AmAra zakra o tAra zakra uThiYe neve| Ami teAmAra prati mahavvata saJcArita karechilAma AmAra nijera pakSa theke, yAte tumi AmAra dRSTira sAmane prati pAlita hao|

yakhana teAmAra bhaginI ese valalaH Ami ki teAmAderake vale deva ke tAke lAlana pAlana karave| ataHpara Ami teAmAke teAmAra mAtAra kAche phiriYe dilAma, yAte tAra cakSu zItala haYa evaM duHkha nA pAYa| tumi eka vyaktike hatyA karechile, ataHpara Ami teAmAke ei duzcintA theke mukti dei; Ami teAmAke aneka parIkSA karechi| ataHpara tumi kaYeka vachara mAdaiYAna vAsIdera madhye avasthAna karechile; he mUsA, ataHpara tumi nirdhArita samaYe esecha|
evaM Ami teAmAke AmAra nijera janya tairI kare niYechi|
tumi o teAmAra bhAi AmAra nidarzanAvalIsaha yAo evaM AmAra smaraNe zaithilya kareA nA|
teAmarA ubhaYe pheraAunera kAche yAo se khuva uddhata haYe geche|
ataHpara teAmarA tAke namra kathA vala, haYateA se cintA-bhAvanA karave athavA bhIta have|
tArA valalaH he AmAdera pAlanakartA, AmarA AzaGkA kari ye, se AmAdera prati juluma karave kiMvA uttejita haYe uThave|
AllAha valalenaH teAmarA bhaYa kareA nA, Ami teAmAdera sAthe Achi, Ami zuni o dekhi|

ataeva teAmarA tAra kAche yAo evaM valaH AmarA ubhaYei teAmAra pAlanakartAra prerita rasUla, ataeva AmAdera sAthe vanI isarAIlake yete dAo evaM tAderake nipIr3ana kareA nA| AmarA teAmAra pAlanakartAra kAcha theke nidarzana niYe teAmAra kAche Agamana karechi| evaM ye satpatha anusaraNa kare, tAra prati zAnti|
AmarA ohI lAbha karechi ye, ye vyakti mithyAreApa kare evaM mukha phiriYe neYa, tAra upara AyAva par3ave|
se valalaH tave he mUsA, teAmAdera pAlanakartA ke?
mUsA valalenaH AmAdera pAlanakartA tini, yini pratyeka vastuke tAra yeAgya AkRti dAna karechena, ataHpara pathapradarzana karechena|
pherAuna valalaH tAhale atIta yugera leAkadera avasthA ki?
mUsA valalenaH tAdera khavara AmAra pAlanakartAra kAche likhita Ache| AmAra pAlanakartA bhrAnta hana nA eM vismRtao hana nA|
tini teAmAdera janye pRthivIke zayyA karechena evaM tAte calAra patha karechena, AkAza theke vRSTi varSaNa karechena evaM tA dvArA Ami vibhinna prakAra udbhida utpanna karechi|
teAmarA AhAra kara evaM teAmAdera catuspada jantu carAo| nizcaYa ete viveka vAnadera janye nidarzana raYeche|
e mATi thekei Ami teAmAderake sRjana karechi, etei teAmAderake phiriYe diva evaM punarAYa e thekei Ami teAmAderake utthita karava|
Ami pherAunake AmAra sava nidarzana dekhiYe diYechi, ataHpara se mithyA AreApa kareche evaM amAnya kareche|
se valalaH he mUsA, tumi ki yAdura jeAre AmAderake deza theke vahiSkAra karAra janye Agamana karecha?

ataeva, AmarAo teAmAra meAkAvelAYa teAmAra nikaTa anurUpa yAdu upasthita karava| sutarAM AmAdera o teAmAra madhye ekaTi oYAdAra dina Thika kara, yAra khelApha AmarAo karava nA evaM tumio karave nA ekaTi pariSkAra prAntare|
mUsA valalaH teAmAdera oYAdAra dina utsavera dina evaM pUrvAhne leAkajana samaveta have|
ataHpara pherAuna prasthAna karala evaM tAra sava kalAkeৗzala jamA karala ataHpara upasthita hala|

mUsA (AH) tAderake valalenaH durbhAgya teAmAdera; teAmarA AllAhara prati mithyA AreApa kareA nA| tAhale tini teAmAderake AyAva dvArA dhvaMsa kare devena| ye mithyA udabhAvana kare, sei viphala maneAratha haYeche|
ataHpara tArA tAdera kAje nijedera madhye vitarka karala evaM geApane parAmarza karala|
tArA valalaH ei duijana nizcitai yAdukara, tArA tAdera yAdu dvArA teAmAderake teAmAdera deza theke vahiskAra karate cAYa evaM teAmAdera utkRSTa jIvana vyavasthA rahita karate cAYa|
ataeva, teAmarA teAmAdera kalAkeৗzala susaMhata kara, ataHpara sArivaddha haYe Asa| Aja ye jaYI have, sei saphalakAma have|
tArA valalaH he mUsA, haYa tumi nikSepa kara, nA haYa AmarA prathame nikSepa kari|
mUsA valalenaH varaM teAmarAi nikSepa kara| tAdera yAdura prabhAve haThAt tA~ra mane hala, yena tAdera raziguleA o lAThiguleA cuTAchuTi karache|
ataHpara mUsA mane mane kichuTA bhIti anubhava karalena|
Ami valalAmaH bhaYa kareA nA, tumi vijaYI have|
teAmAra DAna hAte yA Ache tumi tA nikSepa kara| eTA yA kichu tArA kareche tA grAsa kare phelave| tArA yA kareche tA teA kevala yAdukarera kalAkeৗzala| yAdukara yekhAnei thAkuka, saphala have nA|
ataHpara yAdukararA sejadAYa par3e gela| tArA valalaH AmarA hAruna o mUsAra pAlanakartAra prati vizvAsa sthApana karalAma|

pherAuna valalaH AmAra anumati dAnera pUrvei? teAmarA ki tAra prati vizvAsa sthApana karale; dekhachi sei teAmAdera pradhAna, se teAmAderake yAdu zikSA diYeche| ataeva Ami avazyai teAmAdera hastapada viparIta dika theke kartana karava evaM Ami teAmAderake kharjura vRkSera kAnDe zUle car3Ava evaM teAmarA nizcita rUpei jAnate pArave AmAdera madhye kAra AyAva kaTheAratara evaM adhikSaNa sthAYI|

yAdukararA valalaH AmAdera kAche ye, suspaSTa pramANa eseche tAra upara evaM yini AmAdera ke sRSTi karechena, tA~ra upara AmarA kichutei teAmAke prAdhAnya deva nA| ataeva, tumi yA icchA karate pAra| tumi teA zudhu ei pArthiva jIvanei yA karAra karave|
AmarA AmAdera pAlanakartAra prati vizvAsa sthApana karechi yAte tini AmAdera pApa evaM tumi AmAderake ye yAdu karate vAdhya karecha, tA mArjanA karena| AllAha zreSTha o cirasthAYI|
nizcaYai ye tAra pAlanakartAra kAche aparAdhI haYe Ase, tAra janya raYeche jAhAnnAma| sekhAne se marave nA evaM vA~caveo nA|
Ara yArA tA~ra kAche Ase emana ImAnadAra haYe yAYa satkarma sampAdana kareche, tAdera janye raYeche suucca martavA|
vasavAsera emana puSpeAdyAna raYeche yAra taladeze diYe nirjhariNIsamUha pravAhita haYa| sekhAne tArA cirakAla thAkave eTA tAderai puraskAra, yArA pavitra haYa|

Ami mUsA prati ei marme ohI karalAma ye, AmAra vAndAderake niYe rAtriyeAge vera haYe yAo evaM tAdera janye samudre zuSkapatha nirmANa kara| pechana theke ese teAmAdera dhare phelAra AzaGkA kareA nA evaM pAnite Duve yAoYAra bhaYa kareA nA|
ataHpara pherAuna tAra sainyavAhinI niYe tAdera pazcAddhAvana karala evaM samudra tAderake sampUrNarUpe nimajjata karala|
pheraAuna tAra sampradAYake vibhrAnta karechila evaM satpatha dekhAYani|

he vanI-isarAIla! Ami teAmAderake teAmAdera zakrura kavala theke uddhAra karechi, tura pAhAr3era dakSiNa pArzve teAmAderake pratizruti dAna karechi evaM teAmAdera kAche ‘mAnnA’ o ‘sAlaoYA’ nAyila karechi|
valechiH AmAra deYA pavitra vastusamUha khAo evaM ete sImAlaMghana kareA nA, tA hale teAmAdera upara AmAra kreAdha neme Asave evaM yAra upara AmAra kreAdha neme Ase se dhvaMsa haYe yAYa|
Ara ye taovA kare, ImAna Ane evaM satkarma kare ataHpara satpathe aTala thAke, Ami tAra prati avazyai kSamAzIla|
he mUsA, teAmAra sampradAYake pechane phele tumi tvarA karale kena?
tini valalenaH ei teA tArA AmAra pechane Asache evaM he AmAra pAlanakartA, Ami tAr3AtAr3i teAmAra kAche elAma, yAte tumi santuSTa hao|
valalenaH Ami teAmAra sampradAYake parIkSA karechi teAmAra para evaM sAmerI tAderake pathabhraSTa kareche|

ataHpara mUsA tA~ra sampradAYera kAche phire gelena kraddha o anutapta avasthAYa| tini valalenaH he AmAra sampradAYa, teAmAdera pAlanakartA ki teAmAderake ekaTi uttama pratizruti denani? tave ki pratizrutira samaYakAla teAmAdera kAche dIrgha haYeche, nA teAmarA ceYecha ye, teAmAdera upara teAmAdera pAlanakartAra kreAdha neme Asuka, ye kAraNe teAmarA AmAra sAthe kRta oYAdA bhaGga karale?

tArA valalaH AmarA teAmAra sAthe kRta oYAdA svecchAYa bhaGga karini; kintu AmAdera upara pheraunIdera alaMkArera veAjhA cApiYe deYA haYechila| ataHpara AmarA tA nikSepa kare diYechi| emani bhAve sAmerIo nikSepa kareche|
ataHpara se tAdera janya tairI kare vera karala ekaTi geA-vatsa, ekaTA deha, yAra madhye garura zavda chila| tArA valalaH eTA teAmAdera upAsya evaM mUsAra o upAsya, ataHpara mUsA bhule geche|
tArA ki dekhe nA ye, eTA tAdera keAna kathAra uttara deYa nA evaM tAre keAna kSati o upakAra karAra kSamatAo rAkhe nA?

hAruna tAderake purvei valechilenaH he AmAra kaoma, teAmarA teA ei geA-vatsa dvArA parIkSAYa nipatita haYecha evaM teAmAdera pAlanakartA daYAmaYa| ataeva, teAmarA AmAra anusaraNa kara evaM AmAra Adeza mene cala|
tArA valalaH mUsA AmAdera kAche phire AsA paryanta AmarA sadAsarvadA era sAthei saMyukta haYe vase thAkava|
mUsA valalenaH he hAruna, tumi yakhana tAderake patha bhraSTa hate dekhale, takhana teAmAke kise nivRtta karala?
AmAra padAGka anusaraNa karA theke? tave tumi ki AmAra Adeza amAnya karecha?

tini valalenaH he AmAra jananI-tanaYa, AmAra zmazru o mAthAra cula dhare AkarSaNa kareA nA; Ami AzaGkA karalAma ye, tumi valaveH tumi vanI-isarAIlera madhye vibheda sRSTi karecha evaM AmAra kathA smaraNe rAkhani|
mUsA valalena he sAmerI, ekhana teAmAra vyApAra ki?
se valalaH Ami dekhalAma yA anyerA dekheni| ataHpara Ami sei prerita vyaktira padacihne nIca theke eka muThi mATi niYe nilAma| ataHpara Ami tA nikSepa karalAma| AmAke AmAra mana ei mantraNAi dila|

mUsA valalenaH dUra ha, teAra janya sArA jIvana e zAstii raila ye, tui valavi; AmAke sparza kareA nA, evaM teAra janya ekaTi nirdiSTa oYAdA Ache, yAra vyatikrama have nA| tui teAra sei ilAhera prati lakSya kara, yAke tui ghire thAkati| AmarA seTi jAliYe devai| ataHpara eke vikSipta kare sAgare char3iYe devai|
teAmAdera ilAha teA kevala AllAhai, yini vyatIta anya keAna ilAha nei| sava viSaYa tA~ra jJAnera paridhibhukta|
emanibhAve Ami pUrve yA ghaTeche, tAra saMvAda ApanAra kAche varNanA kari| Ami AmAra kAcha theke ApanAke dAna karechi par3Ara grantha|
ye e theke mukha phiriYe neve, se keYAmatera dina veAjhA vahana karave|
tArA tAte cirakAla thAkave evaM keYAmatera dina ei veAjhA tAdera janye manda have|
yedina siGgAYa phUtkAra deYA have, sedina Ami aparAdhIderake samaveta karava nIla cakSu avasthAYa|
tArA cupisAre paraspare valAvali karaveH teAmarA mAtra daza dina avasthAna karechile|
tArA ki vale tA Ami bhAleAbhAve jAni| tAdera madhye ye, apekSAkRta uttama pathera anusArI se valaveH teAmarA mAtra ekadina avasthAna karechile|
tArA ApanAke pAhAr3a samparke prazna karA| ataeva, Apani valunaH AmAra pAlanakartA pahAr3asamUhake samUle utpATana kare vikSipta kare divena|
ataHpara pRthivIke masRNa samatalabhUmi kare chAr3avena|
tumi tAte meAr3a o TilA dekhave nA|
sei dina tArA AhavAnakArIra anusaraNa karave, yAra kathA edika-sedika have nA evaM daYAmaYa AllAhara bhaYe sava zavda kSINa haYe yAve| sutarAM mRdu guJjana vyatIta tumi kichui zunave nA|
daYAmaYa AllAha yAke anumati devena evaM yAra kathAYa santuSTa havena se chAr3A kArao supAriza sedina keAna upakAre Asave nA|
tini jAnena yA kichu tAdera sAmane o pazcAte Ache evaM tArA tAke jJAna dvArA AYatta karate pAre nA|
sei ciraJjIva cirasthAYIra sAmane sava mukhamanDala avanamita have evaM se vyartha have ye julumera veAjhA vahana karave|
ye ImAnadAra avasthAYa satkarma sampAdana kare, se juluma o kSatira AzaGkA karave nA|
emanibhAve Ami AravI bhASAYa keAraAna nAyila karechi evaM ete nAnAbhAve satarkavANI vyakta karechi, yAte tArA AllAhabhIru haYa athavA tAdera antare cintAra kheArAka yeAgAYa|

satyikAra adhIzvara AllAha mahAna| ApanAra prati AllAhara ohI sampurNa haoYAra pUrve Apani keAraAna grahaNera vyapAre tAr3Ahur3A karavena nA evaM valunaH he AmAra pAlanakartA, AmAra jJAna vRddhi karuna|
Ami itipUrve Adamake nirdeza diYechilAma| ataHpara se bhule giYechila evaM Ami tAra madhye dRr3hatA pAini|
yakhana Ami pherezatAderake valalAmaH teAmarA Adamake sejadA kara, takhana ivalIsa vyatIta savAi sejadA karala| se amAnya karala|
ataHpara Ami valalAmaH he Adama, e teAmAra o teAmAra strIra zatru, sutarAM se yena vera kare nA deYa teAmAdera jAnnAta theke| tAhale teAmarA kaSTe patita have|
teAmAke ei deYA hala ye, tumi ete kSudhArta have nA evaM vastrahINa have nA|
evaM teAmAra pipAsAo have nA evaM reৗdreo kaSTa pAve nA|
ataHpara zaYatAna tAke kumantranA dila, valalaH he Adama, Ami ki teAmAke vale diva anantakAla jIvita thAkAra vRkSera kathA evaM avinazvara rAjatvera kathA?

ataHpara tArA ubhaYei era phala bhakSaNa karala, takhana tAdera sAmane tAdera lajjAsthAna khule gela evaM tArA jAnnAtera vRkSa-patra dvArA nijederake AvRta karate zuru karala| Adama tAra pAlanakartAra avAdhyatA karala, phale se patha bhraSTha haYe gela|
erapara tAra pAlanakartA tAke maneAnIta karalena, tAra prati maneAyeAgI halena evaM tAke supathe AnaYana karalena|

tini valalenaH teAmarA ubhaYei ekhAna theke eka saGge neme yAo| teAmarA eke aparera zatru| erapara yadi AmAra pakSa theke teAmAdera kAche hedAYeta Ase, takhana ye AmAra varNita patha anusaraNa karave, se pathabhraSTha have nA evaM kaSTe patita have nA|
evaM ye AmAra smaraNa theke mukha phiriYe neve, tAra jIvikA saMkIrNa have evaM Ami tAke keYAmatera dina andha avasthAYa utthita karava|
se valaveH he AmAra pAlanakartA AmAke kena andha avasthAYa utthita karalena? Ami teA cakSumAna chilAma|
AllAha valavenaH emanibhAve teAmAra kAche AmAra AYAtasamUha esechila, ataHpara tumi seguleA bhule giYechile| temanibhAve Aja teAmAke bhule yAva|
emanibhAve Ami tAke pratiphala deva, ye sImAlaGghana kare evaM pAlanakartAra kathAYa vizvAsa sthApana nA kare| tAra parakAlera zAsti kaTheAratara evaM aneka sthAYI|
Ami edera pUrve aneka sampradAYake dhvaMsa karechi| yAdera vAsabhumite erA vicaraNa kare, eTA ki ederake satpatha pradarzana karala nA? nizcaYa ete vuddhimAnadera janye nidarzanAvalI raYeche|
ApanAra pAlanakartAra pakSa theke pUrva siddhAnta evaM ekaTi kAla nirdiSTa nA thAkale zAsti avazyambhAvI haYe yeta|

sutarAM erA yA vale se viSaYe dhairyya dhAraNa karuna evaM ApanAra pAlanakartAra prazaMsA pavitratA o mahimA gheASanA karuna sUryeAdaYera pUrve, sUryAstera pUrve evaM pavitratA o mahimA gheASanA karuna rAtrira kichu aMza o divAbhAge, sambhavataH tAte Apani santuSTa havena|

Ami edera vibhinna prakAra leAkake parIkSA karAra janye pArthivajIvanera seৗndarya svarUpa bheAga-vilAsera ye upakaraNa diYechi, Apani sei sava vastura prati dRSTi nikSepa karavena nA| ApanAra pAlanakartAra deYA riyika utkRSTa o adhika sthAYI|
Apani ApanAra parivArera leAkaderake nAmAyera Adeza dina evaM nijeo era opara avicala thAkuna| Ami ApanAra kAche keAna riyika cAi nA| Ami ApanAke riyika dei evaM AllAha bhIrutAra pariNAma zubha|
erA valeH se AmAdera kAche tAra pAlanakartAra kAcha theke keAna nidarzana AnaYana kare nA kena? tAdera kAche ki pramANa Aseni, yA pUrvavartI granthasamUhe Ache?

yadi Ami ederake itipUrve keAna zAsti dvArA dhvaMsa karatAma, tave erA valataH he AmAdera pAlanakartA, Apani AmAdera kAche ekajana rasUla preraNa karalena nA kena? tAhale teA AmarA apamAnita o heYa haoYAra pUrvei ApanAra nidarzana samUha mene calatAma|
valuna, pratyekei pathapAne ceYe Ache, sutarAM teAmarAo pathapAne ceYe thAka| adUra bhaviSyate teAmarA jAnate pArave ke sarala pathera pathika evaM ke satpatha prApta haYeche|
mAnuSera hisAva-kitAvera samaYa nikaTavartI; athaca tArA vekhavara haYe mukha phiriYe nicche|
tAdera kAche tAdera pAlanakartAra pakSa theke yakhanai keAna natuna upadeza Ase, tArA tA khelAra chale zravaNa kare|
tAdera antara thAke khelAYa matta| jAlemarA geApane parAmarza kare, se teA teAmAderai mata ekajana mAnuSa; ematAvasthAYa dekhe zune teAmarA tAra yAdura kavale kena par3a?
paYagamvara valalenaH nabheAmanDala o bhumanDalera kathAi AmAra pAlanakartA jAnena| tini savakichu zeAnena, savakichu jAnena|

echAr3A tArA Arao valeH alIka svapna; nA se mithyA udbhAvana kareche, nA se ekajana kavi| ataeva se AmAdera kAche keAna nidarzana AnaYana karuka, yemana nidarzana saha Agamana karechilena pUrvavartIgana|
tAdera pUrve yesava janapada Ami dhvaMsa kare diYechi, tArA vizvAsa sthApana kareni; ekhana erA ki vizvAsa sthApana karave?
ApanAra pUrve Ami mAnuSai preraNa karechi, yAdera kAche Ami ohI pAThAtAma| ataeva teAmarA yadi nA jAna tave yArA smaraNa rAkhe tAderake jijJesa kara|
Ami tAderake emana deha viziSTa karini ye, tArA khAdya bhakSaNa karata nA evaM tArA cirasthAYIo chila nA|
ataHpara Ami tAderake deYA AmAra pratizruti pUrNa karalAma sutarAM tAderake evaM yAderake icchA vA~ciYe dilAma evaM dhavaMsa kare chilAma sImAlaGghanakArIderake|
Ami teAmAdera prati ekaTi kitAva avartIrNa karechi; ete teAmAdera janye upadeza raYeche| teAmarA ki veAjha nA?
Ami kata janapadera dhvaMsa sAdhana karechi yAra adhivAsIrA chila pApI evaM tAdera para sRSTi karechi anya jAti|
ataHpara yakhana tArA AmAra AyAvera kathA Tera pela, takhanai tArA sekhAna theke palAYana karate lAgala|
palAYana kareA nA evaM phire esa, yekhAne teAmarA vilAsitAYa matta chile o teAmAdera AvAsagRhe; sambhavata; keu teAmAdera jijJesa karave|
tArA valalaH hAYa, durbheAga AmAdera, AmarA avazyai pApI chilAma|
tAdera ei ArtanAda sava samaYa chila, zeSa paryanta Ami tAderake kare dilAma yena kartita zasya o nirvApita agni|
AkAza pRthivI etadubhaYera madhye yA Ache, tA Ami krIr3Acchale sRSTi karini|
Ami yadi krIr3A upakaraNa sRSTi karate cAitAma, tave Ami AmAra kAche yA Ache tA dvArAi tA karatAma, yadi AmAke karate hata|

varaM Ami satyake mithyAra upara nikSepa kari, ataHpara satya mithyAra mastaka curNa-vicUrNa kare deYa, ataHpara mithyA tatkSaNAt nizcihna haYe yAYa| teAmarA yA valacha, tAra janye teAmAdera durbheAga|
nabheAmanDala o bhumanDale yArA Ache, tArA tA~rai| Ara yArA tA~ra sAnnidhye Ache tArA tA~ra ivAdate ahaMkAra kare nA evaM alasatAo kare nA|
tArA rAtridina tA~ra pavitratA o mahimA varNanA kare evaM klAnta haYa nA|
tArA ki mRttikA dvArA tairI upAsya grahaNa kareche, ye tArA tAderake jIvita karave?
yadi nabheAmanDala o bhumanDale AllAha vyatIta anyAnya upAsya thAkata, tave ubhaYera dhvaMsa haYe yeta| ataeva tArA yA vale, tA theke Arazera adhipati AllAha pavitra|
tini yA karena, tatsamparke tini jijJAsita havena nA evaM tAderake jijJesa karA have|

tArA ki AllAha vyatIta anyAnya upAsya grahaNa kareche? valuna, teAmarA teAmAdera pramANa Ana| eTAi AmAra saGgIdera kathA evaM eTAi AmAra purvavartIdera kathA| varaM tAdera adhikAMzai satya jAne nA; ataeva tArA TAlavAhAnA kare|
ApanAra pUrve Ami ye rAsUlai preraNa karechi, tAke e Adezai preraNa karechi ye, Ami vyatIta anya keAna upAsya nei| sutarAM AmArai evAdata kara|
tArA valalaH daYAmaYa AllAha santAna grahaNa kareche| tA~ra janya kakhanao ihA yeAgya naYa; varaM tArA teA tA~ra sammAnita vAndA|
tArA Age ver3e kathA valate pAre nA evaM tArA tA~ra Adezei kAja kare|
tAdera sammukhe o pazcAte yA Ache, tA tini jAnena| tArA zudhu tAdera janye supAriza kare, yAdera prati AllAha santuSTa evaM tArA tA~ra bhaYe bhIta|
tAdera madhye ye vale ye, tini vyatIta Amii upAsya, tAke Ami jAhAnnAmera zAsti deva| Ami jAlemaderake ebhAvei pratiphala diYe thAki|

kApherarA ki bheve dekhe nA ye, AkAzamanDalI o pRthivIra mukha vandha chila, ataHpara Ami ubhaYake khule dilAma evaM prANavanta savakichu Ami pAni theke sRSTi karalAma| eraparao ki tArA vizvAsa sthApana karave nA?
Ami pRthivIte bhArI veAjhA rekhe diYechi yAte tAderake niYe pRthivI jhu~ke nA par3e evaM tAte prazasta patha rekhechi, yAte tArA patha prApta haYa|
Ami AkAzake surakSita chAda karechi; athaca tArA AmAra AkAzastha nidarzanAvalI theke mukha phiriYe rAkhe|
tinii sRSTi karechena rAtri o dina evaM sUrya o candra| savAi Apana Apana kakSapathe vicaraNa kare|
ApanAra pUrveo keAna mAnuSake Ami ananta jIvana dAna karini| sutarAM ApanAra mRtyu hale tArA ki ciraJjIva have?
pratyekake mRtyura svAda AsvAdana karate have| Ami teAmAderake manda o bhAla dvArA parIkSA kare thAki evaM AmArai kAche teAmarA pratyAvartita have|

kApherarA yakhana ApanAke dekhe takhana ApanAra sAthe ThATTA karA chAr3A tAdera Ara keAna kAja thAke nA, eki sei vyakti, ye teAmAdera deva-devIdera samAleAcanA kare? evaM tArAi teA rahamAna’ era AleAcanAYa asvIkAra kare|
sRSTigata bhAve mAnuSa tvarApravaNa, Ami sattarai teAmAderake AmAra nidarzanAvalI dekhAva| ataeva AmAke zIghra karate valeA nA|
evaM tArA valeH yadi teAmarA satyavAdI hao tave ei oYAdA kave purNa have?
yadi kApherarA ai samaYaTi jAnata, yakhana tArA tAdera sammukha o pRSThadeza theke agni pratireAdha karate pArave nA evaM tArA sAhAyya prApta have nA|
varaM tA Asave tAdera upara atarkita bhAve, ataHpara tAderake tA hatavuddhi kare deve, takhana tArA tA reAdha karateo pArave nA evaM tAderake avakAzao deYA have nA|
ApanAra pUrveo aneka rAsUlera sAthe ThATTA-vidrUpa karA haYeche| ataHpara ye viSaYe tArA ThATTA karata tA ulTeA ThATTAkArIdera uparai Apatita haYeche|
valunaH ‘rahamAna’ theke ke teAmAderake hephAyata karave rAtre o dine| varaM tArA tAdera pAlanakartAra smaraNa theke mukha phiriYe rAkhe|
tave ki Ami vyatIta tAdera emana deva-devI Ache yArA tAderake rakSA karave? tArA teA nijederai sAhAyya karate sakSama naYa evaM tArA AmAra meAkAvelAYa sAhAyyakArIo pAve nA|

varaM Ami tAderake evaM tAdera vApa-dAdAke bheAgasamvAra diYechilAma, emanaki tAdera AYuskAlao dIrgha haYechila| tArA ki dekhe nA ye, Ami tAdera dezake caturdika theke hrAsa kare Anachi| eraparao ki tArA vijaYI have?
valunaH Ami teA kevala ohIra mAdhyamei teAmAderake satarka kari, kintu vadhiraderake yakhana satarka karA haYa, takhana tArA se satarkavANI zeAne nA|
ApanAra pAlanakartAra AyAvera kichumAtrao tAderake sparza karale tArA valate thAkave, hAYa AmAdera durbhAgya, AmarA avazyai pApI chilAma|

Ami keYAmatera dina nyAYavicArera mAnadanDa sthApana karava| sutarAM kArao prati juluma have nA| yadi keAna Amala sariSAra dAnA parimANao haYa, Ami tA upasthita karava evaM hisAva grahaNera janye Amii yatheSTa|
Ami mUsA o hAruNake dAna karechilAma mImAMsAkArI grantha, AleA o upadeza, AllAha bhIrudera janye
yArA nA dekhei tAdera pAlanakartAke bhaYa kare evaM keYAmatera bhaYe zaGkita|
evaM eTA ekaTA varakatamaYa upadeza, yA Ami nAyila karechi| ataeva teAmarA ki eke asvIkAra kara?
Ara, Ami itipUrve ivrAhImake tAra satpanthA dAna karechilAma evaM Ami tAra samparke samyaka parijJAta o chilAma|
yakhana tini tA~ra pitA o tA~ra sampradAYake valalenaH ei mUrtiguleA kI, yAdera teAmarA pUjArI haYe vase Acha|
tArA valalaH AmarA AmAdera vApa-dAdAke edera pujA karate dekhechi|
tini valalenaH teAmarA prakAzya geAmarAhIte Acha evaM teAmAdera vApa-dAdArAo|
tArA valalaH tumi ki AmAdera kAche satyasaha Agamana karecha, nA tumi keৗtuka karacha?
tini valalenaH nA, tinii teAmAdera pAlanakartA yini nabheAmanDala o bhumanDalera pAlanakartA, yini eguleA sRSTi karechena; evaM Ami ei viSaYerai sAkSyadAtA|
AllAhara kasama, yakhana teAmarA pRSTha pradarzana kare cale yAve, takhana Ami teAmAdera mUrtiguleAra vyApAre ekaTA vyavasthA avalamvana karava|
ataHpara tini seguleAke cUrNa-vicurNa kare dilena odera pradhAnaTi vyatItaH yAte tArA tA~ra kAche pratyAvartana kare|
tArA valalaH AmAdera upAsyadera sAthe erUpa vyavahAra ke karala? se teA nizcaYai keAna jAlima|
kataka leAke valalaH AmarA eka yuvakake tAdera samparke virUpa AleAcanA karate zunechi; tAke ivrAhIma valA haYa|
tArA valalaH tAke janasamakSe upasthita kara, yAte tArA dekhe|
tArA valalaH he ivrAhIma tumii ki AmAdera upAsyadera sAthe erUpa vyavahAra karecha?
tini valalenaH nA edera ei pradhAnai teA ekAja kareche| ataeva tAderake jijJesa kara, yadi tArA kathA valate pAre|
ataHpara mane mane cintA karala evaM valalaH leAka sakala; teAmarAi ve inasApha|
ataHpara tArA jhu~ke gela mastaka nata kare, tumi teA jAna ye, erA kathA vale nA
tini valalenaH teAmarA ki AllAhara parivarte emana kichura evAdata kara, yA teAmAdera keAna upakArao karate pAre nA evaM kSatio karate pAre nA?
dhika teAmAdera janye evaM teAmarA AllAha vyatIta yAderai evAdata kara, odera janye| teAmarA ki veAjha nA?
tArA valalaH eke pur3iYe dAo evaM teAmAdera upAsyadera sAhAyya kara, yadi teAmarA kichu karate cAo|
Ami valalAmaH he agni, tumi ivrAhImera upara zItala o nirApada haYe yAo|
tArA ivrAhImera viruddhe phandi A~Tate cAila, ataHpara Ami tAderakei sarvAdhika kSatigrastha kare dilAma|
Ami tA~ke o lUtake uddhAra kare sei deze pau~chiYe dilAma, yekhAne Ami vizvera janye kalyANa rekhechi|
Ami tAke dAna karalAma isahAka o puraskAra svarUpa dilAma iYAkuva evaM pratyekakei satkarma parAYaNa karalAma|

Ami tA~derake netA karalAma| tA~rA AmAra nirdeza anusAre patha pradarzana karatena| Ami tA~dera prati ohI nAyila karalAma satkarma karAra, nAmAya kAYema karAra evaM yAkAta dAna karAra| tA~rA AmAra evAdate vyApRta chila|
evaM Ami lUtake diYechilAma prajJA o jJAna evaM tA~ke ai janapada theke uddhAra karechilAma, yArA neAMrA kAje lipta chila| tArA manda o nApharamAna sampradAYa chila|
Ami tAke AmAra anugrahera antarbhukta karechilAma| se chila satkarmazIladera ekajana|
evaM smaraNa karuna nUhake; yakhana tini era pUrve AhvAna karechilena| takhana Ami tA~ra deAYA kavula karechilAma, ataHpara tA~ke o tA~ra parivAravargake mahA saMkaTa theke uddhAra karechilAma|
evaM Ami tA~ke ai sampradAYera vipakSe sAhAyya karechilAma, yArA AmAra nidarzanAvalIke asvIkAra karechila| nizcaYa, tArA chila eka manda sampradAYa| ataHpara Ami tAdera savAike nimajjata karechilAma|
evaM smaraNa karuna dAuda o sulAYamAnake, yakhana tA~rA zasyakSetra samparke vicAra karechilena| tAte rAtrikAle kichu leAkera meSa Dhuke par3echila| tAdera vicAra AmAra sammukhe chila|

ataHpara Ami sulAYamAnake se phAYasAlA vujhiYe diYechilAma evaM Ami ubhaYake prajJA o jJAna diYechilAma| Ami parvata o pakSIsamUhake dAudera anugata kare diYechilAma; tArA AmAra pavitratA o mahimA gheASaNA karata| ei samasta Amii karechilAma|
Ami tA~ke teAmAdera janye varma nirmAna zikSA diYechilAma, yAte tA yuddhe teAmAderake rakSA kare| ataeva teAmarA ki kRtajJa have?
evaM sulAYamAnera adhIna kare diYechilAma pravala vAYuke; tA tA~ra Adeze pravAhita hata ai dezera dike, yekhAne Ami kalyANa dAna karechi| Ami sava viSaYei samyaka avagata raYechi|
evaM adhIna karechi zaYatAnadera katakake, yArA tAra janye DuvurIra kAja karata evaM e chAr3A anya Arao aneka kAja karata| Ami tAderake niYantrana kare rAkhatAma|
evaM smaraNa karuna AiYyuvera kathA, yakhana tini tA~ra pAlanakartAke AhavAna kare valechilenaH Ami duHkhakaSTe patita haYechi evaM Apani daYAvAnadera cAiteo sarvazreSTa daYAvAna|

ataHpara Ami tA~ra AhavAne sAr3A dilAma evaM tA~ra duHkhakaSTa dUra kare dilAma evaM tA~ra parivarAvarga phiriYe dilAma, Ara tAdera sAthe tAdera samaparimANa Arao dilAma AmAra pakSa theke kRpAvazataH Ara eTA evAdata kArIdera janye upadeza svarUpa|
evaM isamAIla, i’drIsa o yulakiphalera kathA smaraNa karuna, tA~rA pratyekei chilena savarakArI|
Ami tA~derake AmAra rahamAtaprAptadera antarbhUkta karechilAma| tA~rA chilena satkarmaparAYaNa|

evaM mAchaoYAlAra kathA smaraNa karuna tini kruddha haYe cale giYechilena, ataHpara mane karechilena ye, Ami tA~ke dhRta karate pArava nA| ataHpara tini andhakArera madhye AhavAna karalenaH tumi vyatIta keAna upAsya nei; tumi nirdeASa Ami gunAhagAra|
ataHpara Ami tA~ra AhavAne sAr3A dilAma evaM tA~ke duzcintA theke mukti dilAma| Ami emani bhAve vizvavAsIderake mukti diYe thAki|
evaM yAkAriYAra kathA smaraNa karuna, yakhana se tAra pAlanakartAke AhavAna karechila; he AmAra pAlanakartA AmAke ekA rekheA nA| tumi teA uttama oYArisa|

ataHpara Ami tAra deAYA kavula karechilAma, tAke dAna karechilAma iYAhaiYA evaM tAra janye tAra strIke prasava yeAgya karechilAma| tArA satkarme jhA~piYe par3ata, tArA AzA o bhIti sahakAre AmAke DAkata evaM tArA chila AmAra kAche vinIta|
evaM sei nArIra kathA AleAcanA karuna, ye tAra kAmapravRttike vaze rekhechila, ataHpara Ami tAra madhye AmAra rUha phu~ke diYechilAma evaM tAke tAra putrake vizvavAsIra janya nidarzana karechilAma|
tArA sakalei teAmAdera dharmera; ekai dharme teA vizvAsI savAi evaM Amii teAmAdera pAlanakartA, ataeva AmAra vandegI kara|
evaM mAnuSa tAdera kAryakalApa dvArA pArasparika viSaYe bheda sRSTi kareche| pratyekei AmAra kAche pratyAvartita have|
ataHpara ye vizvAsI avasthAYa satkarma sampAdana kare, tAra praceSTA asvIkRta have nA evaM Ami tA lipivaddha kare rAkhi|
yesava janapadake Ami dhvaMsa kare diYechi, tAra adhivAsIdera phire nA AsA avadhArita|
ye paryanta nA iYAjuja o mAjujake vandhana mukta kare deYA have evaM tArA pratyeka uccabhumi theke druta chuTe Asave|
AmeAgha pratizruta samaYa nikaTavartI hale kApheradera cakSu ucce sthira haYe yAve; hAYa AmAdera dUrbhAgya, AmarA e viSaYe vekhavara chilAma; varaM AmarA geAnAhagarai chilAma|
teAmarA evaM AllAhara parivarte teAmarA yAdera pujA kara, seguleA deAyakhera indhana| teAmarAi tAte praveza karave|
ei mUrtirA yadi upAsya hata, tave jAhAnnAme praveza karata nA| pratyekei tAte cirasthAYI haYe par3e thAkave|
tArA sekhAne cItkAra karave evaM sekhAne tArA kichui zunate pAve nA|
yAdera janya prathama thekei AmAra pakSa theke kalyANa nirdhArita haYeche tArA deAyakha theke dUre thAkave|
tArA tAra kSINatama zavdao zunave nA evaM tArA tAdera manera vAsanA anuyAYI cirakAla vasavAsa karave|
mahA trAsa tAderake cintAnvita karave nA evaM pherezatArA tAderake abhyarthanA karaveH Aja teAmAdera dina, ye dinera oYAdA teAmAderake deYA haYechila|
sedina Ami AkAzake guTiYe neva, yemana guTAneA haYa likhita kAgajapatra| yebhAve Ami prathamavAra sRSTi karechilAma, sebhAve punarAYa sRSTi karava| AmAra oYAdA nizcita, AmAke tA pUrNa karatei have|
Ami upadezera para yavure likhe diYechi ye, AmAra satkarmaparAYaNa vAndAgaNa avazeSe pRthivIra adhikArI have|
ete evAdatakArI sampradAYera janye paryApta viSaYavastu Ache|
Ami ApanAke vizvavAsIra janye rahamata svarUpai preraNa karechi|
valunaH AmAke teA e Adezai deYA haYeche ye, teAmAdera upAsya ekamAtra upAsya| sutarAM teAmarA ki AjJAvaha have?
ataHpara yadi tArA mukha phiriYe neYa, tave vale dinaH Ami teAmAderake pariskAra bhAve satarka karechi evaM Ami jAni nA, teAmAderake ye oYAdA deYA haYeche, tA nikaTavartI nA dUravartI|
tini jAnena, ye kathA sazavde vala evaM ye kathA teAmarA geApana kara|
Ami jAni nA sambhavataH vilamvera madhye teAmAdera janye ekaTi parIkSA evaM eka samaYa paryanta bheAga karAra suyeAga|
paYagAmvara valalenaH he AmAra pAlanakartA, Apani nyAYAnuga phaYasAlA kare dina| AmAdera pAlanakartA teA daYAmaYa, teAmarA yA valacha, se viSaYe AmarA tA~ra kAchei sAhAyya prArthanA kari|
he leAka sakala! teAmAdera pAlanakartAke bhaYa kara| nizcaYa keYAmatera prakampana ekaTi bhaYaMkara vyApAra|

yedina teAmarA tA pratyakSa karave, sedina pratyeka stanyadhAtrI tAra dudhera zizuke vismRta have evaM pratyeka garbhavatI tAra garbhapAta karave evaM mAnuSake tumi dekhave mAtAla; athaca tArA mAtAla naYa vastutaH AllAhara AyAva sukaThina|
kataka mAnuSa ajJAnatAvazataH AllAha samparke vitarka kare evaM pratyeka avAdhya zaYatAnera anusaraNa kare|
zaYatAna samparke likhe deYA haYeche ye, ye keu tAra sAthI have, se tAke vibhrAnta karave evaM deAyakhera AyAvera dike paricAlita karave|

he leAkasakala! yadi teAmarA punarutthAnera vyApAre sandigdha hao, tave (bheve dekha-) Ami teAmAderake mRttikA theke sRSTi karechi| erapara vIrya theke, erapara jamATa rakta theke, erapara pUrNAkRtiviziSTa o apUrNAkRtiviziSTa mAMsapinDa theke, teAmAdera kAche vyakta karAra janye| Ara Ami eka nirdiSTa kAlera janye mAtRgarbhe yA icchA rekhe dei, erapara Ami teAmAderake zizu avasthAYa vera kari; tArapara yAte teAmarA yeৗvane padArpaNa kara| teAmAdera madhye keu keu mRtyumukhe patita haYa evaM teAmAdera madhye kAuke niSkarmA vaYasa paryanta peৗchAneA haYa, yAte se jAnAra para jJAta viSaYa samparke sajJAna thAke nA| tumi bhUmike patita dekhate pAo, ataHpara Ami yakhana tAte vRSTi varSaNa kari, takhana tA sateja o sphIta haYe yAYa evaM sarvaprakAra sudRzya udbhida utpanna kare|
eguleA e kAraNe ye, AllAha satya evaM tini mRtake jIvita karena evaM tini savakichura upara kSamatAvAna|
evaM e kAraNe ye, keYAmata avazyambhAvI, ete sandeha nei evaM e kAraNe ye, kavare yArA Ache, AllAha tAderake punarutthita karavena|
kataka mAnuSa jJAna; pramANa o ujjvala kitAva chAr3Ai AllAha samparke vitarka kare|
se pArzva parivartana kare vitarka kare, yAte AllAhara patha theke vibhrAnta kare deYa| tAra janye duniYAte lAJchanA Ache evaM keYAmatera dina Ami tAke dahana-yantraNA AsvAdana karAva|
eTA teAmAra dui hAtera karmera kAraNe, AllAha vAndAdera prati juluma karena nA|

mAnuSera madhye keu keu dvidhA-dvandve jar3ita haYe AllAhara evAdata kare| yadi se kalyANa prApta haYa, tave evAdatera upara kAYema thAke evaM yadi keAna parIkSAYa par3e, tave pUrvAvasthAYa phire yAYa| se ihakAle o parakAle kSatigrasta| eTAi prakAzya kSati
se AllAhara parivarte emana kichuke DAke, ye tAra apakAra karate pAre nA evaM upakArao karate pAre nA| eTAi carama pathabhraSTatA|
se emana kichuke DAke, yAra apakAra upakArera Age peৗche| kata manda ei vandhu evaM kata manda ei saGgI|
yArA vizvAsa sthApana kare o satkarma sampAdana kare, AllAha tAderake jAnnAte dAkhila karavena, yAra taladeza diYe nirjharaNIsamUha pravAhita haYa| AllAha yA icchA tAi karena|

se dhAraNA kare ye, AllAha kakhanai ihakAle o parakAle rAsUlake sAhAyya karavena nA, se ekaTi razi AkAza paryanta jhuliYe nika; erapara keTe dika; ataHpara dekhuka tAra ei keৗzala tAra AkreAza dUra kare kinA|
emanibhAve Ami suspaSTa AYAta rUpe keAraAna nAyila karechi evaM AllAha-i yAke icchA hedAYeta karena|
yArA musalamAna, yArA ihudI, sAveYI, khrISTAna, agnipujaka evaM yArA muzareka, keYAmatera dina AllAha avazyai tAdera madhye phAYasAlA kare devena| savakichui AllAhara dRSTira sAmane|

tumi ki dekhani ye, AllAhake sejadA kare yA kichu Ache nabheAmanDale, yA kichu Ache bhumanDale, sUrya, candra, tArakArAji parvatarAji vRkSalatA, jIvajantu evaM aneka mAnuSa| AvAra anekera upara avadhArita haYeche zAsti| AllAha yAke icchA lAJchita karena, tAke keu sammAna dite pAre nA| AllAha yA icchA tAi karena
ei dui vAdI vivAdI, tArA tAdera pAlanakartA samparke vitarka kare| ataeva yArA kAphera, tAdera janye Agunera peAzAka tairI karA haYeche| tAdera mAthAra upara phuTanta pAni Dhele deYA have|
phale tAdera peTe yA Ache, tA evaM carma gale vera haYe yAve|
tAdera janye Ache leAhAra hAtur3i|
tArA yakhanai yantranAYa atiSTha haYe jAhAnnAma theke vera hate cAive, takhanai tAderake tAte phiriYe deYA have| valA haveH dahana zAsti AsvAdana kara|

nizcaYa yArA vizvAsa sthApana kare evaM satkarma kare, AllAha tAderake dAkhila karavena udyAna samUhe, yAra taladeza diYe nirjhariNIsamUha pravAhita have| tAderake tathAYa svarNa-kaMkana o muktA dvArA alaMkRta karA have evaM tathAYa tAdera peAzAka have rezamI|
tArA pathapradarzita haYechila satvAkyera dike evaM paricAlita haYechila prazaMsita AllAhara pathapAne|

yArA kuphara kare o AllAhara pathe vAdhA sRSTi kare evaM sei masajide hArAma theke vAdhA deYa, yAke Ami prastuta karechi sthAnIYa o vahirAgata sakala mAnuSera janye samabhAve evaM ye masajide hArAme anyAYabhAve keAna dharmadreAhI kAja karAra icchA kare, Ami tAderake yantrAnAdAYaka zAsti AsvAdana karAva|

yakhana Ami ivrAhImake vAYatullAhara sthAna Thika kare diYechilAma ye, AmAra sAthe kAuke zarIka kareA nA evaM AmAra gRhake pavitra rAkha tAoYAphakArIdera janye, nAmAye danDAYamAnadera janye evaM raku sejadAkArIdera janye|
evaM mAnuSera madhye hajvera janye gheASaNA pracAra kara| tArA teAmAra kAche Asave pAYe he~Te evaM sarvaprakAra kRzakAYa uTera piThe saoYAra haYe dUra-dUrAnta theke|

yAte tArA tAdera kalyANera sthAna paryanta peৗche evaM nirdiSTa dinaguleAte AllAhara nAma smaraNa kare tA~ra deYA catuspada jantu yaveha karAra samaYa| ataHpara teAmarA tA theke AhAra kara evaM duHstha-abhAvagrasthake AhAra karAo|
erapara tArA yena daihika maYalA dUra kare deYa, tAdera mAnata pUrNa kare evaM ei susaMrakSita gRhera tAoYApha kare|

eTA zravaNayeAgya| Ara keu AllAhara sammAnayeAgya vidhAnAvalIra prati sammAna pradarzana karale pAlanakartAra nikaTa tA tAra janye uttama| ullekhita vyatikramaguleA chAr3A teAmAdera janye catuspada jantu hAlAla karA haYeche| sutarAM teAmarA mUrtidera apavitratA theke ve~ce thAka evaM mithyA kathana theke dUre sare thAka;

AllAhara dike ekaniSTa haYe, tA~ra sAthe zarIka nA kare; evaM ye keu AllAhara sAthe zarIka karala; se yena AkAza theke chiTake par3ala, ataHpara mRtabheAjI pAkhI tAke cheA~ mere niYe gela athavA vAtAsa tAke ur3iYe niYe keAna dUravartI sthAne nikSepa karala|
eTA zravaNayeAgya keu AllAhara nAmayukta vastusamuhera prati sammAna pradarzana karale tA teA tAra hRdaYera AllAhabhIti prasUta|
catuspada jantusamUhera madhye teAmAdera janye nirdiSTakAla paryanta upakAra raYeche| ataHpara eguleAke peৗchAte have mukta gRha paryanta|

Ami pratyeka ummatera janye keAravAnI nirdhAraNa karechi, yAte tArA AllAhara deYA catuspada jantu yaveha kArAra samaYa AllAhara nAma uccAraNa kare| ataeva teAmAdera AllAha teA ekamAtra AllAha sutarAM tA~rai AjJAdhIna thAka evaM vinaYIgaNake susaMvAda dAo;
yAdera antara AllAhara nAma smaraNa karA hale bhIta haYa evaM yArA tAdera vipadApade dhairyyadhAraNa kare evaM yArA nAmAya kAYema kare o Ami yA diYechi, tA theke vyaYa kare|

evaM kA’vAra janye utsargIkRta uTake Ami teAmAdera janye AllAhara anyatama nidarzana karechi| ete teAmAdera janye maGgala raYeche| sutarAM sArivaddhabhAve vA~dhA avasthAYa tAdera yaveha karAra samaYa teAmarA AllAhara nAma uccAraNa kara| ataHpara yakhana tArA kAta haYe par3e yAYa takhana tA theke teAmarA AhAra kara evaM AhAra karAo ye kichu yAcJA kare nA tAke evaM ye yAcJA kare tAke| emanibhAve Ami eguleAke teAmAdera vazIbhUta kare diYechi, yAte teAmarA kRtajJatA prakAza kara|

eguleAra geAzata o rakta AllAhara kAche pau~che nA, kintu pau~che tA~ra kAche teAmAdera manera tAkaoYA| emanibhAve tini eguleAke teAmAdera vaza kare diYechena, yAte teAmarA AllAhara mahattva gheASaNA kara e kAraNe ye, tini teAmAdera patha pradarzana karechena| sutarAM satkarmazIladera susaMvAda zuniYe dina|
AllAha muminadera theke zatruderake haTiYe devena| AllAha keAna vizvAsaghAtaka akRtajJake pachanda karena nA|
yuddhe anumati deYA hala tAderake yAdera sAthe kApherarA yuddha kare; kAraNa tAdera prati atyAcAra karA haYeche| AllAha tAderake sAhAyya karate avazyai sakSama|

yAderake tAdera ghara-vAr3I theke anyAYabhAve vahiskAra karA haYeche zudhu ei aparAdhe ye, tArA vale AmAdera pAlanakartA AllAha| AllAha yadi mAnavajAtira ekadalake apara dala dvArA pratihata nA karatena, tave (khrISTAnadera) nirjhana girjA, evAdata khAnA, (ihudIdera) upAsanAlaYa evaM masajidasamUha vidhvasta haYe yeta, yegulAte AllAhara nAma adhika smaraNa karA haYa| AllAha nizcaYai tAderake sAhAyya karavena, yArA AllAhara sAhAyya kare| nizcaYai AllAha parAkramazAlI zaktidhara|

tArA emana leAka yAderake Ami pRthivIte zakti-sAmartha dAna karale tArA nAmAya kAYema karave, yAkAta deve evaM satkAje Adeza o asatkAje niSedha karave| pratyeka karmera pariNAma AllAhara ekhatiYArabhUkta|
tArA yadi ApanAke mithyAvAdI vale, tave tAdera pUrve mithyAvAdI valeche kaome nUha, Ada, sAmuda,
ivrAhIma o lUtera sampradAYao|

evaM mAdaiYAnera adhivAsIrA evaM mithyAvAdI valA haYechila mUsAkeo| ataHpara Ami kApheraderake suyeAga diYechilAma erapara tAderake pAkar3Ao karechilAma ataeva ki bhISaNa chila AmAke asvIkRtira pariNAma|

Ami kata janapada dhvaMsa karechi ematAvasthAYa ye, tArA chila geAnAhagAra| ei sava janapada ekhana dhvaMsastupe pariNata haYeche evaM kata kUpa parityakta haYeche o kata sudRr3ha prAsAda dhvaMsa haYeche|
tArA ki ei uddezye deza bhramaNa kareni, yAte tArA samajhadAra hRdaYa o zravaNa zakti sampanna karNera adhikArI hate pAre? vastutaH cakSu teA andha haYa nA, kintu vakSa sthita antarai andha haYa|
tArA ApanAke AyAva tvarAnvita karate vale| athaca AllAha kakhanao tA~ra oYAdA bhaGga karena nA| ApanAra pAlanakartAra kAche ekadina teAmAdera gaNanAra eka hAjAra vacharera samAna|
evaM Ami kata janapadake avakAza diYechi ematAvasthAYa ye, tArA geAnAhagAra chila| erapara tAderake pAkar3Ao karechi evaM AmAra kAchei pratyAvartana karate have|
valunaH he leAka sakala! Ami teA teAmAdera janye spaSTa bhASAYa satarkakArI|
sutarAM yArA vizvAsa sthApana kareche evaM satkarma kareche, tAdera janye Ache pApa mArjanA evaM sammAnajanaka ruyI|
evaM yArA AmAra AYAtasamUhake vyartha karAra janye ceSTA kare, tArAi deAyakhera adhivAsI|

Ami ApanAra pUrve ye samasta rAsUla o navI preraNa karechi, tArA yakhanai kichu kalpanA kareche, takhanai zaYatAna tAdera kalpanAYa kichu mizraNa kare diYeche| ataHpara AllAha dUra kare dena zaYatAna yA mizraNa kare| erapara AllAha tA~ra AYAtasamUhake su-pratiSThita karena evaM AllAha jJAnamaYa, prajJAmaYa|
e kAraNe ye, zaYatAna yA mizraNa kare, tini tA parIkSAsvarUpa kare dena, tAdera janye, yAdera antare reAga Ache evaM yArA pASANahRdaYa| geAnAhagArarA dUravartI vireAdhitAYa lipta Ache|

evaM e kAraNeo ye, yAderake jJAnadAna karA haYeche; tArA yena jAne ye eTA ApanAra pAlanakartAra pakSa theke satya; ataHpara tArA yena ete vizvAsa stApana kare evaM tAdera antara yena era prati vijaYI haYa| AllAhai vizvAsa sthApanakArIke sarala patha pradarzana karena|
kApherarA sarvadAi sandeha peASana karave ye paryanta nA tAdera kAche AkasmikabhAve keYAmata ese par3e athavA ese par3e tAdera kAche emana divasera zAsti yA theke rakSAra upAYa nei|
rAjatva sedina AllAharai; tinii tAdera vicAra karavena| ataeva yArA vizvAsa sthApana kare evaM satkarma sampAdana kare tArA neYAmata pUrNa kAnane thAkave|
evaM yArA kuphari kare evaM AmAra AYAta samUhake mithyA vale tAdera janye lAJchanAkara zAsti raYeche|
yArA AllAhara pathe gRha tyAga kareche, erapara nihata haYeche athavA mare geche; AllAha tAderake avazyai utkRSTa jIvikA dAna karavena evaM AllAha sarveAtkRSTa riyika dAtA|
tAderake avazyai emana eka sthAne peৗchAvena, yAke tArA pachanda karave evaM AllAha jJAnamaYa, sahanazIla|
e teA zunale, ye vyakti nipIr3ita haYe nipIr3ana parimANe pratizeAdha grahaNa kare evaM punarAYa se nipIr3ita haYa, AllAha avazyai tAke sAhAyya karavena| nizcaYa AllAha mArjanAkArI kSamAzIla|
eTA e janye ye, AllAha rAtrike dinera madhye evaM dinake rAtrira madhya dAkhila kare dena evaM AllAha savakichu zeAnena, dekhena|
eTA e kAraNeo ye, AllAhai satya; Ara tA~ra parivarte tArA yAke DAke, tA asatya evaM AllAhai savAra ucce, mahAna|
tumi ki dekha nA ye, AllAha AkAza theke pAni varSaNa karena, ataHpara bhUpRSTa savuja-zyAmala haYe uThe| nizcaYa AllAha sukSadarzI, sarvaviSaYe khavaradAra|
nabheAmanDala o bhupRSThe yA kichu Ache, sava tA~rai evaM AllAhai abhAvamukta prazaMsAra adhikArI|

tumi ki dekha nA ye, bhUpRSTe yA Ache evaM samudre calamAna neৗkA tatsamudaYake AllAha nija Adeze teAmAdera adhIna kare diYechena evaM tini AkAza sthira rAkhena, yAte tA~ra Adeza vyatIta bhUpRSTe patita nA haYa| nizcaYa AllAha mAnuSera prati karuNAzIla, daYAvAna|
tinii teAmAderake jIvita karechena, ataHpara tinii teAmAderake mRtyudAna karavena o punarAYa jIvita karavena| nizcaYa mAnuSa var3a akRtajJa|

Ami pratyeka ummatera janye evAdatera ekaTi niYama-kAnuna nirdhAraNa kare diYechi, yA tArA pAlana kare| ataeva tArA yena e vyApAre ApanAra sAthe vitarka nA kare| Apani tAderake pAlanakartAra dike AhavAna karuna| nizcaYa Apani sarala pathei Achena|
tArA yadi ApanAra sAthe vitarka kare, tave vale dina, teAmarA yA kara, se sarmpake AllAha adhika jJAta|
teAmarA ye viSaYe matavireAdha karacha, AllAha kiYAmatera dina sei viSaYe teAmAdera madhye phAYasAlA karavena|
tumi ki jAna nA ye, AllAha jAnena yA kichu AkAze o bhumanDale Ache esava kitAve likhita Ache| eTA AllAhara kAche sahaja|
tArA AllAhara parivarte emana kichura pUjA kare, yAra keAna sanada nAyila karA haYani evaM se samparke tAdera keAna jJAna nei| vastutaH jAlemadera keAna sAhAyyakArI nei|

yakhana tAdera kAche AmAra suspaSTa AYAtasamUha AvRtti karA haYa, takhana tumi kApheradera ceAkhe mukhe asanteASera lakSaNa pratyakSa karate pArave| yArA tAdera kAche AmAra AYAta samUha pATha kare, tArA tAdera prati mAra mukheA haYe uThe| valuna, Ami ki teAmAderake tadapekSA manda kichura saMvAda deva? tA Aguna; AllAha kApheraderake era oYAdA diYechena| eTA katai nA nikRSTa pratyAvartanasthala|

he leAka sakala! ekaTi upamA varNanA karA haleA, ataeva teAmarA tA maneAyeAga diYe zeAna; teAmarA AllAhara parivarte yAdera pUjA kara, tArA kakhanao ekaTi mAchi sRSTi karate pArave nA, yadio tArA sakale ekatrita haYa| Ara mAchi yadi tAdera kAcha theke keAna kichu chiniYe neYa, tave tArA tAra kAcha theke tA uddhAra karate pArave nA, prArthanAkArI o yAra kAche prArthanA karA haYa, ubhaYei zaktihIna|
tArA AllAhara yathAyeAgya maryAdA veAjheni| nizcaYa AllAha zaktidhara, mahAparAkramazIla|
AllAha pherezatA o mAnuSera madhya theke rAsUla maneAnIta karena| AllAha sarvazreAtA, sarva draSTA!
tini jAnena yA tAdera sAmane Ache evaM yA pazcAte Ache evaM savakichu AllAhara dike pratyAvartita have|
he muminagaNa! teAmarA ruku kara, sejadA kara, teAmAdera pAlanakartAra evAdata kara evaM satkAja sampAdana kara, yAte teAmarA saphalakAma hate pAra|

teAmarA AllAhara janye zrama svIkAra kara yebhAve zrama svIkAra karA ucita| tini teAmAderake pachanda karechena evaM dharmera vyApAre teAmAdera upara keAna saMkIrNatA rAkhenani| teAmarA teAmAdera pitA ivrAhImera dharme kAYema thAka| tinii teAmAdera nAma musalamAna rekhechena pUrveo evaM ei keAraAneo, yAte rasUla teAmAdera janye sAkSyadAtA evaM teAmarA sAkSyadAtA hao mAnavamanDalira janye| sutarAM teAmarA nAmAya kAYema kara, yAkAta dAo evaM AllAhake zaktabhAve dhAraNa kara| tinii teAmAdera mAlika| ataeva tini kata uttama mAlika evaM kata uttama sAhAyyakArI|
muminagaNa saphalakAma haYe geche,
yArA nijedera nAmAye vinaYa-namra;
yArA anarthaka kathA-vArtAYa nirlipta,
yArA yAkAta dAna kare thAke
evaM yArA nijedera yeৗnAGgake saMyata rAkhe|
tave tAdera strI o mAlikAnAbhukta dAsIdera kSetre saMyata nA rAkhale tArA tiraskRta have nA|
ataHpara keu ederake chAr3A anyake kAmanA karale tArA sImAlaMghanakArI have|
evaM yArA AmAnata o aGgIkAra samparke huziYAra thAke|
evaM yArA tAdera nAmAyasamUhera khavara rAkhe|
tArAi uttarAdhikAra lAbha karave|
tArA zItala chAYAmaYa udyAnera uttarAdhikAra lAbha karave| tArA tAte cirakAla thAkave|
Ami mAnuSake mATira sArAMza theke sRSTi karechi|
ataHpara Ami tAke zukravindu rUpe eka saMrakSita AdhAre sthApana karechi|

erapara Ami zukravinduke jamATa raktarUpe sRSTi karechi, ataHpara jamATa raktake mAMsapinDe pariNata karechi, erapara sei mAMsapinDa theke asthi sRSTi karechi, ataHpara asthike mAMsa dvArA AvRta karechi, avazeSe tAke natuna rUpe dA~r3a kariYechi| nipuNatama sRSTikartA AllAha kata kalyANamaYa|
erapara teAmarA mRtyuvaraNa karave
ataHpara keYAmatera dina teAmarA punarutthita have|
Ami teAmAdera upara suptapatha sRSTi karechi evaM Ami sRSTi samvandhe anavadhAna nai|
Ami AkAza theke pAni varSaNa kare thAki parimANa mata ataHpara Ami jamine saMrakSaNa kari evaM Ami tA apasAraNao karate sakSama|
ataHpara Ami tA dvArA teAmAdera janye khejura o AGgurera vAgAna sRSTi karechi| teAmAdera janye ete pracura phala Ache evaM teAmarA tA theke AhAra kare thAka|
evaM ai vRkSa sRSTi karechi, yA sinAi parvate janmAYa evaM AhArakArIdera janye taila o vyaJjana utpanna kare|

evaM teAmAdera janye catuspada jantu samUhera madhye cintA karAra viSaYa raYeche| Ami teAmAderake tAdera udarasthita vastu theke pAna karAi evaM teAmAdera janye tAdera madhye pracura upakAritA Ache| teAmarA tAdera katakake bhakSaNa kara|
tAdera piThe o jalayAne teAmarA AreAhaNa kare calApherA kare thAka|
Ami nUhake tAra sampradAYera kAche preraNa karechilAma| se valechilaH he AmAra sampradAYa, teAmarA AllAhara vandegI kara| tini vyatIta teAmAdera keAna mAvuda nei| teAmarA ki bhaYa kara nA|

takhana tAra sampradAYera kAphera-pradhAnarA valechilaH e teA teAmAdera matai ekajana mAnuSa vai naYa| se teAmAdera upara netRtva karate cAYa| AllAha icchA karale pherezatAi nAyila karatena| AmarA AmAdera pUrvapuruSadera madhye erUpa kathA zunini|
se teA eka ummAda vyakti vai naYa| sutarAM kichukAla tAra vyApAre apekSA kara|
nUha valechilaH he AmAra pAlanakartA, AmAke sAhAyya kara; kenanA, tArA AmAke mithyAvAdI valache|

ataHpara Ami tAra kAche Adeza preraNa karalAma ye, tumi AmAra dRSTira sAmane evaM AmAra nirdeze neৗkA tairI kara| erapara yakhana AmAra Adeza Ase evaM cullI plAvita haYa, takhana neৗkAYa tule nAo, pratyeka jIvera eka eka jeAr3A evaM teAmAra parivAravargake, tAdera madhye yAdera vipakSe pUrve siddhAnta neYA haYeche tAdera chAr3A| evaM tumi jAlemadera samparke AmAke kichu valeA nA| nizcaYa tArA nimajjata have|
yakhana tumi o teAmAra saGgIrA neৗkAYa AreAhaNa karave, takhana valaH AllAhara zeAkara, yini AmAderake jAlema sampradAYera kavala theke uddhAra karechena|
Arao valaH pAlanakartA, AmAke kalyANakara bhAve nAmiYe dAo, tumi zreSTha avatAraNakArI|
ete nidarzanAvalI raYeche evaM Ami parIkSAkArI|
ataHpara anya eka sampradAYa Ami tAra sthalAbhiSikta karechilAma|
evaM tAderai ekajanake tAdera madhye rasUlarUpe preraNa karechilAma ei vale ye, teAmarA AllAhara vandegI kara| tini vyatIta teAmAdera anya keAna mAvuda nei| tavuo ki teAmarA bhaYa karave nA?

tA~ra sampradAYera pradhAnarA yArA kAphera chila, parakAlera sAkSAtake mithyA valata evaM yAderake Ami pArthiva jIvane sukha-svAcchandya diYechilAma, tArA valalaH eteA AmAdera matai ekajana mAnuSa vai naYa| teAmarA yA khAo, seo tAi khAYa evaM teAmarA yA pAna kara, seo tAi pAna kare|
yadi teAmarA teAmAdera matai ekajana mAnuSera Anugatya kara, tave teAmarA nizcitarUpei kSatigrasta have|
se ki teAmAderake ei oYAdA deYa ye, teAmarA mArA gele evaM mRttikA o asthite pariNata hale teAmAderake punarujjIvita karA have?
teAmAderake ye oYAdA deYA hacche, tA keAthAYa hate pAre?
AmAdera pArthivajIvanai ekamAtra jIvana| AmarA mari o vA~ci ekhAnei evaM AmArA punarutthita haveA nA|
se teA emana vyakti vai naYa, ye AllAha samvandhe mithyA udbhAvana kareche evaM AmarA tAke vizvAsa kari nA|
tini valalenaH he AmAra pAlanakartA, AmAke sAhAyya kara, kAraNa tArA AmAke mithyAvAdI valache|
AllAha valalenaH kichu dinera madhye tArA sakAla velA anutapta have|
ataHpara satya satyai eka bhaYaMkara zavda tAderake hatacakita karala evaM Ami tAderake vAtyA-tAr3ita AvarjanA sadRza kare dilAma| ataHpara dhvaMsa heAka pApI sampradAYa|
erapara tAdera pare Ami vahu sampradAYa sRSTi karechi|
keAna sampradAYa tAra nirdiSTa kAlera agre yete pAre nA| evaM pazcAteo thakAte pAre nA|

erapara Ami ekAdikrame AmAra rasUla preraNa karechi| yakhanai keAna ummatera kAche tA~ra rasUla Agamana karechena, takhanai tArA tA~ke mithyAvAdI valeche| ataHpara Ami tAdera ekera para eka dhvaMsa karechi evaM tAderake kAhinIra viSaYe pariNata karechi| sutarAM dhvaMsa heAka avizvAsIrA|
ataHpara Ami mUsA o hAruNake preraNa karechilAma AmAra nidarzanAvalI o suspaSTa sanadasaha,
pheraAuna o tAra amAtyadera kAche| ataHpara tArA ahaMkAra karala evaM tArA uddhata sampradAYa chila|
tArA valalaH AmarA ki AmAdera matai e dui vyaktite vizvAsa sthApana karava; athaca tAdera sampradAYa AmAdera dAsa?
ataHpara tArA ubhaYake mithyAvAdI valala| phale tArA dhvaMsa prApta hala|
Ami mUsAke kitAva diYechilAma yAte tArA satpatha pAYa|
evaM Ami mariYama tanaYa o tA~ra mAtAke eka nidarzana dAna karechilAma| evaM tAderake eka avasthAnayeAgya svaccha pAni viziSTa TilAYa AzraYa diYechilAma|
he rasUlagaNa, pavitra vastu AhAra karuna evaM satkAja karuna| ApanArA yA karena se viSaYe Ami parijJAta|
ApanAdera ei ummata sava teA ekai dharmera anusArI evaM Ami ApanAdera pAlanakartA; ataeva AmAke bhaYa karuna|
ataHpara mAnuSa tAdera viSaYake vahudhA vibhakta kare diYeche| pratyeka sampradAYa nija nija matavAda niYe Anandita hacche|
ataeva tAdera kichu kAlera janye tAdera ajJAnatAYa nimajjata thAkate dina|
tArA ki mane kare ye, Ami tAderake dhana-sampada o santAna-santati diYe yAcchi|
tAte kare tAderake druta maGgalera dike niYe yAcchi? varaM tArA veAjhe nA|
nizcaYa yArA tAdera pAlanakartAra bhaYe santrasta,
yArA tAdera pAlanakartAra kathAYa vizvAsa sthApana kare,
yArA tAdera pAlanakartAra sAthe kAuke zarIka kare nA
evaM yArA yA dAna karavAra, tA bhIta, kampita hRdaYe e kAraNe dAna kare ye, tArA tAdera pAlanakartAra kAche pratyAvartana karave,
tArAi kalyANa druta arjana kare evaM tArA tAte agragAmI|
Ami kAuke tAra sAdhyAtIta dAYitva arpana kari nA| AmAra eka kitAva Ache, yA satya vyakta kare evaM tAdera prati juluma karA have nA|
nA, tAdera antara e viSaYe ajJAnatAYa Acchanna, e chAr3A tAdera Arao kAja raYeche, yA tArA karache|
emanaki, yakhana Ami tAdera aizvaryazAlI leAkaderake zAsti dvArA pAkar3Ao karava, takhanai tArA cItkAra jur3e deve|
adya cItkAra kareA nA| teAmarA AmAra kAcha theke niskRti pAve nA|
teAmAderake AmAra AYAtasamUha zeAnAneA hata, takhana teAmarA ulTeA pAYe sare par3ate|
ahaMkAra kare e viSaYe arthahIna galpa-gujava kare yete|
ataeva tArA ki ei kAlAma samparke cintA-bhAvanA kare nA? nA tAdera kAche emana kichu eseche, yA tAdera pitRpuruSadera kAche Aseni?
nA tArA tAdera rasUlake cene nA, phale tArA tA~ke asvIkAra kare?
