nA tArA vale ye, tini pAgala? varaM tini tAdera kAche satya niYe Agamana karechena evaM tAdera adhikAMza satyake apachanda kare|

satya yadi tAdera kAche kAmanA-vAsanAra anusArI hata, tave nabheAmanDala o bhUmanDala evaM eguleAra madhyavartI savakichui vizRGkhala haYe par3ata| varaM Ami tAderake dAna karechi upadeza, kintu tArA tAdera upadeza anudhAvana kare nA|
nA Apani tAdera kAche keAna pratidAna cAna? ApanAra pAlanakartAra pratidAna uttama evaM tinii riyikadAtA|
Apani teA tAderake seAjA pathe dAoYAta dicchena;
Ara yArA parakAle vizvAsa kare nA, tArA seAjA patha theke vicyuta haYe geche|
yadi Ami tAdera prati daYA kari evaM tAdera kaSTa dUra kare dei, tavuo tArA tAdera avAdhyatAYa dizehArA haYe lege thAkave|
Ami tAderake zAsti dvArA pAkar3Ao karechilAma, kintu tArA tAdera pAlanakartAra sAmane nata hala nA evaM kAkuti-minutio karala nA|
avazeSe yakhana Ami tAdera janya kaThina zAstira dvAra khule deva, takhana tAte tAdera AzA bhaGga have|
tini teAmAdera kAna, ceAkha o antaHkaraNa sRSTi karechena; teAmarA khuvai alpa kRtajJatA svIkAra kare thAka|
tinii teAmAderake pRthivIte char3iYe rekhechena evaM tArai dike teAmAderake samaveta karA have|
tinii prANa dAna karena evaM mRtyu ghaTAna evaM divA-rAtrira vivartana tA~rai kAja, tavu o ki teAmarA vujhave nA?
varaM tArA vale yemana tAdera pUrvavartIrA valata|
tArA valeH yakhana AmarA mare yAva evaM mRttikA o asthite pariNata hava, takhanao ki AmarA punarutthita hava?
atIte AmAderake evaM AmAdera pitRpuruSaderake ei oYAdAi deYA haYeche| eTA teA pUrvavatIdera kalpa-kathA vai kichui naYa|
valuna pRthivI evaM pRthivIte yArA Ache, tArA kAra? yadi teAmarA jAna, tave vala|
ekhana tArA valaveH savai AllAhara| valuna, tavuo ki teAmarA cintA kara nA?
valunaH saptAkAza o mahA-Arazera mAlika ke?
ekhana tArA valaveH AllAha| valuna, tavuo ki teAmarA bhaYa karave nA?
valunaH teAmAdera jAnA thAkale vala, kAra hAte sava vastura kartRtva, yini rakSA karena evaM yAra kavala theke keu rakSA karate pAre nA?
ekhana tArA valaveH AllAhara| valunaH tAhale keAthA theke teAmAderake jAdu karA hacche?
kichui naYa, Ami tAdera kAche satya pau~chiYechi, Ara tArA teA mithyAvAdI|

AllAha keAna santAna grahaNa karenani evaM tA~ra sAthe keAna mAvuda nei| thAkale pratyeka mAvuda nija nija sRSTi niYe cale yeta evaM ekajana anyajanera upara pravala haYe yeta| tArA yA vale, tA theke AllAha pavitra|
tini dRzya o adRzyera jJAnI| tArA zarIka kare, tini tA theke urdhve|
valunaH he AmAra pAlanakartA! ye viSaYe tAderake oYAdA deYA haYeche tA yadi AmAke dekhAna,
he AmAra pAlanakartA! tave Apani AmAke geAnAhagAra sampradAYera antarbhUkta karavena nA|
Ami tAderake ye viSaYera oYAdA diYechi, tA ApanAke dekhAte avazyai sakSama|
mandera jaoYAve tAi valuna, yA uttama| tArA yA vale, Ami se viSaYe savizeSa avagata|
valunaH he AmAra pAlanakartA! Ami zaYatAnera prareAcanA theke ApanAra AzraYa prArthanA kari,
evaM he AmAra pAlanakartA! AmAra nikaTa tAdera upasthiti theke ApanAra AzraYa prArthanA kari|
yakhana tAdera kArao kAche mRtyu Ase, takhana se valeH 'he AmAra pAlaNakartA! AmAke punarAYa (duniYAte) preraNa karuna|
yAte Ami satkarma karate pAri, yA Ami karini'| kakhanai naYa, e teA tAra ekaTi kathAra kathA mAtra| tAdera sAmane pardA Ache punarutthAna divasa paryanta|
ataHpara yakhana ziMgAYa phutkAra deYA have, sedina tAdera pArasparika AtnIYatAra vandhana thAkave nA evaM eke aparake jijJAsAvAda karave nA|
yAdera pAllA bhArI have, tArAi have saphalakAma,
evaM yAdera pAllA hAlkA have tArAi nijedera kSatisAdhana kareche, tArA deAyakhei cirakAla vasavAsa karave|
Aguna tAdera mukhamanDala dagdha karave evaM tArA tAte vIbhatsa AkAra dhArana karave|
teAmAdera sAmane ki AmAra AYAta samUha paThita hata nA? teAmarA teA seguleAke mithyA valate|
tArA valaveH he AmAdera pAlanakartA, AmarA dUrbhAgyera hAte parAbhUta chilAma evaM AmarA chilAma vibhrAnta jAti|
he AmAdera pAlanakartA! e theke AmAderake uddhAra kara; AmarA yadi punarAYa tA kari, tave AmarA geAnAhagAra hava|
AllAha valavenaH teAmarA dhikRta avasthAYa ekhAnei par3e thAka evaM AmAra sAthe keAna kathA valeA nA|
AmAra vAndAdera ekadale valataH he AmAdera pAlanakartA! AmarA vizvAsa sthApana karechi| ataeva tumi AmAderake kSamA kara o AmAdera prati rahama kara| tumi teA daYAludera madhye zreSTha daYAlu|
ataHpara teAmarA tAderake ThATTAra pAtrarUpe grahaNa karate| emanaki, tA teAmAderake AmAra smaraNa bhuliYe diYechila evaM teAmarA tAderake dekhe parihAsa karate|
Aja Ami tAderake tAdera savarera kAraNe emana pratidAna diYechi ye, tArAi saphalakAma|
AllAha valavenaH teAmarA pRthivIte katadina avasthAna karale vacharera gaNanAYa?
tArA valave, AmarA ekadina athavA dinera kichu aMza avasthAna karechi| ataeva Apani gaNanAkArIderake jijJesa karuna|
AllAha valavenaH teAmarA tAte alpadinai avasthAna karecha, yadi teAmarA jAnate?
teAmarA ki dhAraNA kara ye, Ami teAmAderake anarthaka sRSTi karechi evaM teAmarA AmAra kAche phire Asave nA?
ataeva zIrSa mahimAYa AllAha, tini satyikAra mAlika, tini vyatIta keAna mAvuda nei| tini sammAnita Arazera mAlika|
ye keu AllAhara sAthe anya upAsyake DAke, tAra kAche yAra sanada nei, tAra hisAva tAra pAlaNakartAra kAche Ache| nizcaYa kApherarA saphalakAma have nA|
valUnaH he AmAra pAlanakartA, kSamA karuna o rahama karuna| rahamakArIdera madhye Apani zreSTa rahamakArI|
eTA ekaTA sUrA yA Ami nAyila karechi, evaM dAYitve aparihArya karechi| ete Ami suspaSTa AYAtasamUha avatIrNa karechi, yAte teAmarA smaraNa rAkha|

vyabhicAriNI nArI vyabhicArI puruSa; tAdera pratyekake ekaza’ kare vetrAghAta kara| AllAhara vidhAna kAryakara kAraNe tAdera prati yena teAmAdera mane daYAra udreka nA haYa, yadi teAmarA AllAhara prati o parakAlera prati vizvAsI haYe thAka| musalamAnadera ekaTi dala yena tAdera zAsti pratyakSa kare|
vyabhicArI puruSa kevala vyabhicAriNI nArI athavA muzarikA nArIkei viYe kare evaM vyabhicAriNIke kevala vyabhicArI athavA muzarika puruSai viYe kare evaM ederake muminadera janye hArAma karA haYeche|

yArA satI-sAdhvI nArIra prati apavAda AreApa kare ataHpara svapakSe cAra jana puruSa sAkSI upasthita kare nA, tAderake AziTi vetrAghAta karave evaM kakhanao tAdera sAkSya kavula karave nA| erAi nA’phAramAna|
kintu yArA erapara taovA kare evaM saMzeAdhita haYa, AllAha kSamAzIla, parama meheravAna|

evaM yArA tAdera strIdera prati apavAda AreApa kare evaM tArA nijerA chAr3A tAdera keAna sAkSI nei, erUpa vyaktira sAkSya ebhAve have ye, se AllAhara kasama kheYe cAravAra sAkSya deve ye, se avazyai satyavAdI|
evaM paJcamavAra valave ye, yadi se mithyAvAdI haYa tave tAra upara AllAhara lAnata|
evaM strIra zAsti rahita haYe yAve yadi se AllAhara kasama kheYe cAra vAra sAkSya deYa ye, tAra svAmI avazyai mithyAvAdI;
evaM paJcamavAra vale ye, yadi tAra svAmI satyavAdI haYa tave tAra opara AllAhara gayava neme Asave|
teAmAdera prati AllAhara anugraha o daYA nA thAkale evaM AllAha taovA kavula kArI, prajJAmaYa nA hale kata kichui ye haYe yeta|

yArA mithyA apavAda raTanA kareche, tArA teAmAderai ekaTi dala| teAmarA eke nijedera janye khArApa mane kareA nA; varaM eTA teAmAdera janye maGgalajanaka| tAdera pratyekera janye tataTuku Ache yataTuku se geAnAha kareche evaM tAdera madhye ye e vyApAre agraNI bhUmikA niYeche, tAra janye raYeche virATa zAsti|
teAmarA yakhana ekathA zunale, takhana ImAnadAra puruSa o nArIgaNa kena nijedera leAka samparke uttama dhAraNA karani evaM valani ye, eTA teA nirjalA apavAda?
tArA kena e vyApAre cAra jana sAkSI upasthita kareni; ataHpara yakhana tArA sAkSI upasthita kareni, takhana tArAi AllAhara kAche mithyAvAdI|
yadi ihakAle o parakAle teAmAdera prati AllAhara anugraha o daYA nA thAkata, tave teAmarA yA carcA karachile, tajjanye teAmAderake gurutara AyAva sparza karata|

yakhana teAmarA eke mukhe mukhe char3Acchile evaM mukhe emana viSaYa uccAraNa karachile, yAra keAna jJAna teAmAdera chila nA| teAmarA eke tuccha mane karachile, athaca eTA AllAhara kAche gurutara vyApAra chila|
teAmarA yakhana e kathA zunale takhana kena valale nA ye, e viSaYe kathA valA AmAdera ucita naYa| AllAha teA pavitra, mahAna| eTA teA eka gurutara apavAda|
AllAha teAmAderake upadeza dicchena, teAmarA yadi ImAnadAra hao, tave takhanao punarAYa e dharaNera AcaraNera punarAvRtti kareA nA|
AllAha teAmAdera janye kAjera kathA spaSTa kare varNanA karena| AllAha sarvajJa, prajJAmaYa|
yArA pachanda kare ye, ImAnadAradera madhye vyabhicAra prasAra lAbha karuka, tAdera janye ihAkAla o parakAle yantraNAdAYaka zAsti raYeche| AllAha jAnena, teAmarA jAna nA|
yadi teAmAdera prati AllAhara anugraha o daYA nA thAkata evaM AllAha daYAlu, meheravAna nA hatena, tave kata kichui haYe yeta|

he ImAnadAragaNa, teAmarA zaYatAnera padAGka anusaraNa kareA nA| ye keu zaYatAnera padAGka anusaraNa karave, takhana teA zaYatAna nirlajjatA o manda kAjerai Adeza karave| yadi AllAhara anugraha o daYA teAmAdera prati nA thAkata, tave teAmAdera keu kakhanao pavitra hate pArate nA| kintu AllAha yAke icchA pavitra karena| AllAha savakichu zeAnena, jAnena|

teAmAdera madhye yArA uccamaryAdA o Arthika prAcuryera adhikArI, tArA yena kasama nA khAYa ye, tArA AtnIYa-svajanake, abhAvagrastake evaM AllAhara pathe hijaratakArIderake kichui deve nA| tAdera kSamA karA ucita evaM deASakraTi upekSA karA ucita| teAmarA ki kAmanA kara nA ye, AllAha teAmAderake kSamA karena? AllAha kSamAzIla, parama karuNAmaYa|
yArA satI-sAdhvI, nirIha ImAnadAra nArIdera prati apavAda AreApa kare, tArA ihakAle o parakAle dhikRta evaM tAdera janye raYeche gurutara zAsti|
yedina prakAza kare deve tAdera jihvA, tAdera hAta o tAdera pA, yA kichu tArA karata;
sedina AllAha tAdera samucita zAsti pureApuri devena evaM tArA jAnate pArave ye, allAhai satya, spaSTa vyaktakArI|

duzcaritrA nArIkUla duzcaritra puruSakulera janye evaM duzcaritra puruSakula duzcaritrA nArIkulera janye| saccaritrA nArIkula saccaritra puruSakulera janye evaM saccaritra puruSakula saccaritrA nArIkulera janye| tAdera samparke leAke yA vale, tAra sAthe tArA samparkahIna| tAdera janye Ache kSamA o sammAnajanaka jIvikA|

he muminagaNa, teAmarA nijedera gRha vyatIta anya gRhe praveza kareA nA, ye paryanta AlApa-paricaYa nA kara evaM gRhavAsIderake sAlAma nA kara| eTAi teAmAdera janye uttama, yAte teAmarA smaraNa rAkha|

yadi teAmarA gRhe kAuke nA pAo, tave anumati grahaNa nA karA paryanta sekhAne praveza kareA nA| yadi teAmAderake valA haYa phire yAo, tave phire yAve| ete teAmAdera janye aneka pavitratA Ache evaM teAmarA yA kara, AllAha tA bhAleAbhAve jAnena|
ye gRhe keu vAsa kare nA, yAte teAmAdera sAmagrI Ache emana gRhe praveza karAte teAmAdera keAna pApa nei evaM AllAha jAnena teAmarA yA prakAza kara evaM yA geApana kara|
muminaderake valuna, tArA yena tAdera dRSTi nata rAkhe evaM tAdera yeৗnAGgara hephAyata kare| ete tAdera janya khuva pavitratA Ache| nizcaYa tArA yA kare AllAha tA avahita Achena|

ImAnadAra nArIderake valuna, tArA yena tAdera dRSTike nata rAkhe evaM tAdera yeৗna aGgera hephAyata kare| tArA yena yA sAdhAraNataH prakAzamAna, tA chAr3A tAdera seৗndarya pradarzana nA kare evaM tArA yena tAdera mAthAra or3anA vakSa deze phele rAkhe evaM tArA yena tAdera svAmI, pitA, zvazura, putra, svAmIra putra, bhrAtA, bhrAtusputra, bhagniputra, strIleAka adhikArabhukta vA~dI, yeৗnakAmanAmukta puruSa, o vAlaka, yArA nArIdera geApana aGga samparke ajJa, tAdera vyatIta kAreA Ache tAdera seৗndarya prakAza nA kare, tArA yena tAdera geApana sAja-sajjA prakAza karAra janya jeAre padacAraNA nA kare| muminagaNa, teAmarA savAi AllAhara sAmane taovA kara, yAte teAmarA saphalakAma hao|

teAmAdera madhye yArA vivAhahIna, tAdera vivAha sampAdana kare dAo evaM teAmAdera dAsa o dAsIdera madhye yArA satkarmaparAYana, tAderao| tArA yadi niHsva haYa, tave AllAha nija anugrahe tAderake sacchala kare devena| AllAha prAcuryamaYa, sarvajJa|

yArA vivAhe sAmartha naYa, tArA yena saMyama avalamvana kare ye paryanta nA AllAha nija anugrahe tAderake abhAvamukta kare dena| teAmAdera adhikArabhuktadera madhye yArA muktira janya likhita cukti karate cAYa, tAdera sAthe teAmarA likhita cukti kara yadi jAna ye, tAdera madhye kalyANa Ache| AllAha teAmAderake ye, artha-kar3i diYechena, tA theke tAderake dAna kara| teAmAdera dAsIrA nijedera pavitratA rakSA karate cAile teAmarA pArthiva jIvanera sampadera lAlasAYa tAderake vyabhicAre vAdhya kAreA nA| yadi keha tAdera upara jeAra-javaradasti kare, tave tAdera upara jeAra-javaradastira para AllAha tAdera prati kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|
Ami teAmAdera prati avatIrNa karechi suspaSTa AYAtasamUha, teAmAdera pUrvavartIdera kichu dRSTAnta evaM AllAha bhIrudera janye diYechi upadeza|

AllAha nabheAmanDala o bhUmanDalera jyeAti, tA~ra jyeAtira udAharaNa yena ekaTi kulaGgi, yAte Ache ekaTi pradIpa, pradIpaTi ekaTi kA~capAtre sthApita, kA~capAtraTi ujjvala nakSatra sadRzya| tAte putaHpavitra yaYatuna vRkSera taila prajvalita haYa, yA pUrvamukhI naYa evaM pazcimamukhIo naYa| agni sparza nA karaleo tAra taila yena AleAkita haoYAra nikaTavartI| jyeAtira upara jyeAti| AllAha yAke icchA patha dekhAna tA~ra jyeAtira dike| AllAha mAnuSera janye dRSTAntasamUha varNanA karena evaM AllAha sava viSaYe jJAta|
AllAha yesava gRhake maryAdAYa unnIta karAra evaM seguleAte tA~ra nAma uccAraNa karAra Adeza diYechena, sekhAne sakAla o sandhyAYa tA~ra pavitratA o mahimA gheASaNA kare;

emana leAkerA, yAderake vyavasA-vANijya o kraYa-vikraYa AllAhara smaraNa theke, nAmAya kAYema karA theke evaM yAkAta pradAna karA theke virata rAkhe nA| tArA bhaYa kare sei dinake, yedina antara o dRSTisamUha ulTe yAve|
(tArA AllAhara pavitratA gheASaNA kare) yAte AllAha tAdera utkRSTatara kAjera pratidAna dena evaM nija anugrahe Arao adhika dena| AllAha yAke icchA aparimita ruyI dAna karena|

yArA kAphera, tAdera karma marubhumira marIcikA sadRza, yAke pipAsArta vyakti pAni mane kare| emanaki, se yakhana tAra kAche yAYa, takhana kichui pAYa nA evaM pAYa sekhAne AllAhake, ataHpara AllAha tAra hisAva cukiYe dena| AllAha druta hisAva grahaNakArI|

athavA (tAdera karma) pramatta samudrera vuke gabhIra andhakArera nyAYa, yAke udvelita kare taraGgera upara taraGga, yAra upare ghana kAleA megha Ache| ekera upara eka andhakAra| yakhana se tAra hAta vera kare, takhana tAke ekevArei dekhate pAYa nA| AllAha yAke jyeAti dena nA, tAra keAna jyeAtii nei|

tumi ki dekha nA ye, nabheAmanDala o bhUmanDale yArA Ache, tArA evaM ur3anta pakSIkula tAdera pAkhA vistAra karataH AllAhara pavitratA o mahimA gheASaNA kare? pratyekei tAra yeAgya evAdata evaM pavitratA o mahimA gheASaNAra paddhati jAne| tArA yA kare, AllAha se viSaYe samyaka jJAta|
nabheAmanDala o bhUmanDalera sArvabheৗmatva AllAharai evaM tA~rai dike pratyAvartana karate have|

tumi ki dekha nA ye, AllAha meghamAlAke saJcAlita karena, ataHpara tAke puJjIbhUta karena, ataHpara tAke stare stare rAkhena; ataHpara tumi dekha ye, tAra madhya theke vAridhArA nirgata haYa| tini AkAzasthita zilAstupa theke zilAvarSaNa karena evaM tA dvArA yAke icchA AghAta karena evaM yAra kAcha theke icchA, tA anyadike phiriYe dena| tAra vidyutjhalaka dRSTizakti yena vilIna kare dite cAYa|
AllAha dina o rAtrira parivartana ghaTAna| ete arntadRSTi-sampannagaNera janye cintAra upakaraNa raYeche|

AllAha pratyeka calanta jIvake pAni dvArA sRSTi karechena| tAdera kataka vuke bhaYa diYe cale, kataka dui pAYe bhara diYe cale evaM kataka cAra pAYe bhara diYe cale; AllAha yA icchA sRSTi karena| nizcaYai AllAha savakichu karate sakSama|
Ami teA suspaSTa AYAta samUha avartIrNa karechi| AllAha yAke icchA sarala pathe paricAlanA karena|
tArA valeH AmarA AllAha o rasUlera prati vizvAsa sthApana karechi evaM Anugatya kari; kintu ataHpara tAdera ekadala mukha phiriYe neYa evaM tArA vizvAsI naYa|
tAdera madhye phaYasAlA karAra janya yakhana tAderake AllAha o rasUlera dike AhavAna karA haya takhana tAdera ekadala mukha phiriYe neYa|
satya tAdera svapakSe hale tArA vinItabhAve rasUlera kAche chuTe Ase|
tAdera antare ki reAga Ache, nA tArA dheA~kAYa par3e Ache; nA tArA bhaYa kare ye, AllAha o tA~ra rAsUla tAdera prati avicAra karavena? varaM tArAi teA avicArakArI?

muminadera vaktavya kevala e kathAi yakhana tAdera madhye phaYasAlA karAra janye AllAha o tA~ra rasUlera dike tAderake AhavAna karA haYa, takhana tArA valeH AmarA zunalAma o Adeza mAnya karalAma| tArAi saphalakAma|
yArA AllAha o tA~ra rasUlera Anugatya kare AllAhake bhaYa kare o tA~ra zAsti theke ve~ce thAke tArAi kRtakArya|

tArA dRr3habhAve AllAhara kasama kheYe vale ye, Apani tAderake Adeza karale tArA savakichu cher3e vera havei| valunaH teAmarA kasama kheYeA nA| niYamAnuyAYI teAmAdera Anugatya, teAmarA yA kichu kara nizcaYa AllAha se viSaYe jJAta|

valunaH AllAhara Anugatya kara evaM rasUlera Anugatya kara| ataHpara yadi teAmarA mukha phiriYe nAo, tave tAra upara nyasta dAYitvera janye se dAYI evaM teAmAdera upara nyasta dAYitvera janye teAmarA dAYI| teAmarA yadi tA~ra Anugatya kara, tave sat patha pAve| rasUlera dAYitva teA kevala suspaSTarUpe peৗche deYA|

teAmAdera madhye yArA vizvAsa sthApana kare o satkarma kare, AllAha tAderake oYAdA diYechena ye, tAderake avazyai pRthivIte zAsanakartRtva dAna karavena| yemana tini zAsanakartRtva dAna karechena tAdera pUrvavatIderake evaM tini avazyai sudRr3ha karavena tAdera dharmake, yA tini tAdera janye pachanda karechena evaM tAdera bhaYa-bhItira parivarte avazyai tAderake zAnti dAna karavena| tArA AmAra evAdata karave evaM AmAra sAthe kAuke zarIka karave nA| erapara yArA akRtajJa have, tArAi avAdhya|
nAmAya kAYema kara, yAkAta pradAna kara evaM rasUlera Anugatya kara yAte teAmarA anugraha prApta hao|
teAmarA kApheraderake pRthivIte parAkramazAlI mane kareA nA| tAdera ThikAnA agni| katai nA nikRSTa ei pratyAvartanasthala|

he muminagaNa! teAmAdera dAsadAsIrA evaM teAmAdera madhye yArA prApta vaYaska haYani tArA yena tina samaYe teAmAdera kAche anumati grahaNa kare, phajarera nAmAyera pUrve, dupure yakhana teAmarA vastra khule rAkha evaM ezAra nAmAyera para| ei tina samaYa teAmAdera deha kheAlAra samaYa| e samaYera para teAmAdera o tAdera janye keAna deASa nei| teAmAdera eke aparera kAche teA yAtAYAta karatei haYa, emani bhAve AllAha teAmAdera kAche suspaSTa AYAtasamUha vivRta karena| AllAha sarvajJa, prajJAmaYa|

teAmAdera santAna-santatirA yakhana vAYeAprApta haYa, tArAo yena tAdera pUrvavartIdera nyAYa anumati cAYa| emanibhAve AllAha tA~ra AYAtasamUha teAmAdera kAche varNanA karena| AllAha sarvajJa, prajJAmaYa|

vRddhA nArI, yArA vivAhera AzA rAkhe nA, yadi tArA tAdera saundaryya prakAza nA kare tAdera vastra khule rAkhe| tAdera janye deASa nei, tave e theke virata thAkAi tAdera janye uttama| AllAha sarvazreAtA, sarvajJa|

andhera janye deASa nei, khaJjera janye deASa nei, reAgIra janye deASa nei, evaM teAmAdera nijedera janyeo deASa nei ye, teAmarA AhAra karave teAmAdera gRhe athavA teAmAdera pitAdera gRhe athavA teAmAdera mAtAdera gRhe athavA teAmAdera bhrAtAdera gRhe athavA teAmAdera bhagiNIdera gRhe athavA teAmAdera pitRvyadera gRhe athavA teAmAdera phuphudera gRhe athavA teAmAdera mAmAdera gRhe athavA teAmAdera khAlAdera gRhe athavA sei gRhe, yAra cAvi Ache teAmAdera hAte athavA teAmAdera vandhudera gRhe| teAmarA ekatre AhAra kara athavA pRthakabhave AhAra kara, tAte teAmAdera keAna deASa nei| ataHpara yakhana teAmarA gRhe praveza kara, takhana teAmAdera svajanadera prati sAlAma valave| eTA AllAhara kAcha theke kalyANamaYa o pavitra deAYA| emanibhAve AllAha teAmAdera janye AYAtasamUha vizadabhAve varnanA karena, yAte teAmarA vujhe nAo|

mumina teA tArAi; yArA AllAhara o rasUlera prati vizvAsa sthApana kare evaM rasUlera sAthe keAna samaSTigata kAje zarIka hale tA~ra kAcha theke anumati grahaNa vyatIta cale yAYa nA| yArA ApanAra kAche anumati prArthanA kare, tArAi AllAha o tA~ra rasUlera prati vizvAsa sthApana kare| ataeva tArA ApanAra kAche tAdera keAna kAjera janye anumati cAile Apani tAdera madhye yAke icchA anumati dina evaM tAdera janye AllAhara kAche kSamA prArthanA karuna| AllAha kSamAzIla, meheravAna|

rasUlera AhavAnake teAmarA teAmAdera eke aparake AhvAnera mata gaNya kareA nA| AllAha tAderake jAnena, yArA teAmAdera madhye cupisAre sare par3e| ataeva yArA tA~ra Adezera viruddhAcaraNa kare, tArA e viSaYe satarka heAka ye, viparyaYa tAderake sparza karave athavA yantraNAdAYaka zAsti tAderake grAsa karave|

mane rekheA nabheAmanDala o bhUmanDale yA Ache, tA AllAharai| teAmarA ye avasthAYa Acha tA tini jAnena| yedina tArA tA~ra kAche pratyAvartita have, sedina tini vale devena tArA yA kareche| AllAha pratyeka viSaYai jAnena|
parama kalyANamaYa tini yini tA~ra vAndAra prati phaYasAlAra grantha avartINa karechena, yAte se vizvajagatera janye satarkakArI haYa,

tini halena yA~ra raYeche nabheAmanDala o bhUmanDalera rAjatva| tini keAna santAna grahaNa karenani| rAjatve tA~ra keAna aMzIdAra nei| tini pratyeka vastu sRSTi karechena, ataHpara tAke zeAdhita karechena parimitabhAve|

tArA tA~ra parivarte kata upAsya grahaNa kareche, yArA kichui sRSTi kare nA evaM tArA nijerAi sRSTa evaM nijedera bhAlao karate pAre nA, mandao karate pAre nA evaM jIvana, maraNa o punarujjIvanera o tArA mAlika naYa|
kApherarA vale, eTA mithyA vai naYa, yA tini udbhAvana karechena evaM anya leAkerA tA~ke sAhAyya kareche| avazyai tArA avicAra o mithyAra AzraYa niYeche|
tArA vale, eguleA teA purAkAlera rUpakathA, yA tini likhe rekhechena| eguleA sakAla-sandhyAYa tA~ra kAche zekhAneA haYa|
valuna, eke tinii avatIrNa karechena, yini nabheAmanDala o bhUmanDalera geApana rahasya avagata Achena| tini kSamAzIla, meheravAna|
tArA vale, e kemana rasUla ye, khAdya AhAra kare evaM hATe-vAjAre calApherA kare? tA~ra kAche kena keAna pherezatA nAyila karA hala nA ye, tA~ra sAthe satarkakArI haYe thAkata?
athavA tini dhana-bhAnDAra prApta halena nA kena, athavA tA~ra ekaTi vAgAna hala nA kena, yA theke tini AhAra karatena? jAlemarA vale, teAmarA teA ekajana jAdugrasta vyaktirai anusaraNa karacha|
dekhuna, tArA ApanAra kemana dRSTAnta varNanA kare! ataeva tArA pathabhraSTa haYeche, ekhana tArA patha pete pAre nA|
kalyAnamaYa tini, yini icchA karale ApanAke tadapekSA uttama vastu dite pArena-vAga-vAgicA, yAra taladeze nahara pravAhita haYa evaM dite pArena ApanAke prAsAdasamUha|
varaM tArA keYAmatake asvIkAra kare evaM ye keYAmatake asvIkAra kare, Ami tAra janye agni prastuta karechi|
agni yakhana dUra theke tAderake dekhave, takhana tArA zunate pAve tAra garjana o huGkAra|
yakhana eka zikale kaYekajana vA~dhA avasthAYa jAhAnnAmera keAna saMkIrNa sthAne nikSepa karA have, takhana sekhAne tArA mRtyuke DAkave|
valA have, Aja teAmarA eka mRtyuke DekeA nA aneka mRtyuke DAka|
valuna eTA uttama, nA cirakAla vasavAsera jAnnAta, yAra susaMvAda deYA haYeche muttAkIderake? seTA have tAdera pratidAna o pratyAvartana sthAna|
tArA cirakAla vasavAsarata avasthAYa sekhAne yA cAive, tAi pAve| ei prArthita oYAdA pUraNa ApanAra pAlanakartAra dAYitva|

sedina AllAha ekatrita karavena tAderake evaM tArA AllAhara parivarte yAdera evAdata karata tAderake, sedina tini upAsyaderake valavena, teAmarAi ki AmAra ei vAndAderake pathabhrAnta karechile, nA tArA nijerAi pathabhrAnta haYechila?

tArA valave-Apani pavitra, AmarA ApanAra parivarte anyake muruvvIrUpe grahaNa karate pAratAma nA; kintu Apanii teA tAderake evaM tAdera pitRpuruSaderake bheAgasambhAra diYechilena, phale tArA ApanAra smRti vismRta haYechila evaM tArA chila dhvaMsaprApta jAti|

AllAha muzarikaderake valavena, teAmAdera kathA teA tArA mithyA sAvyasta karala, ekhana teAmarA zAsti pratireAdha karate pArave nA evaM sAhAyyao karate pArave nA| teAmAdera madhye ye geAnAhagAra Ami tAke gurutara zAsti AsvAdana karAva|

ApanAra pUrve yata rasUla preraNa karechi, tArA savAi khAdya grahaNa karata evaM hATe-vAjAre calApherA karata| Ami teAmAdera ekake aparera janye parIkSAsvarUpa karechi| dekhi, teAmarA savara kara kinA| ApanAra pAlanakartA sava kichu dekhena|

yArA AmAra sAkSAt AzA kare nA, tArA vale, AmAdera kAche pherezatA avatIrNa karA hala nA kena? athavA AmarA AmAdera pAlanakartAke dekhi nA kena? tArA nijedera antare ahaMkAra peASaNa kare evaM gurutara avAdhyatAYa mete uTheche|
yedina tArA pherezatAderake dekhave, sedina aparAdhIdera janye keAna susaMvAda thAkave nA evaM tArA valave, keAna vAdhA yadi tA ATake rAkhata|
Ami tAdera kRtakarmera prati maneAniveza karava, ataHpara seguleAke vikSipta dhulikaNArUpe kare deva|
sedina jAnnAtIdera vAsasthAna have uttama evaM vizrAmasthala have maneArama|
sedina AkAza meghamAlAsaha vidIrNa have evaM sedina pherezatAdera nAmiYe deYA have,
sedina satyikAra rAjatva have daYAmaYa AllAhara evaM kApheradera pakSe dinaTi have kaThina|
jAlema sedina Apana hastadvaYa daMzana karate karate valave, hAYa AphaseAsa! Ami yadi rasUlera sAthe patha avalamvana karatAma|
hAYa AmAra dUrbhAgya, Ami yadi amukake vandhurUpe grahaNa nA karatAma|
AmAra kAche upadeza AsAra para se AmAke tA theke vibhrAnta karechila| zaYatAna mAnuSake vipadakAle dheA~kA deYa|
rasUla valalenaH he AmAra pAlanakartA, AmAra sampradAYa ei keAraAnake pralApa sAvyasta kareche|
emanibhAve pratyeka navIra janye Ami aparAdhIdera madhya theke zatru karechi| ApanAra janye ApanAra pAlanakartA pathapradarzaka o sAhAyyakArIrUpe yatheSTa|

satya pratyAkhAnakArIrA vale, tA~ra prati samagra keAraAna ekadaphAYa avatIrNa hala nA kena? Ami emanibhAve avatIrNa karechi evaM krame krame AvRtti karechi ApanAra antakaraNake majavuta karAra janye|
tArA ApanAra kAche keAna samasyA upasthApita karalei Ami ApanAke tAra saThika jaoYAva o sundara vyAkhyA dAna kari|
yAderake mukha thuvar3e par3e thAkA avasthAYa jAhAnnAmera dike ekatrita karA have, tAderai sthAna have nikRSTa evaM tArAi pathabhraSTa|
Ami teA mUsAke kitAva diYechi evaM tA~ra sAthe tA~ra bhrAtA hArunake sAhAyyakArI karechi|
ataHpara Ami valechi, teAmarA sei sampradAYera kAche yAo, yArA AmAra AYAtasamUhake mithyA abhihita kareche| ataHpara Ami tAderake samUle dhvaMsa kare diYechi|

nUhera sampradAYa yakhana rasUlagaNera prati mithyAreApa karala, takhana Ami tAderake nimajjata karalAma evaM tAderake mAnavamanDalIra janye nidarzana kare dilAma| jAlemadera janye Ami yantraNAdAYaka zAsti prastuta kare rekhechi|
Ami dhvaMsa karechi Ada, sAmuda, kapavAsI evaM tAdera madhyavartI aneka sampradAYake|
Ami pratyekera janyei dRSTAnta varNanA karechi evaM pratyekakei sampurNarUpe dhvaMsa karechi|
tArA teA sei janapadera upara diYei yAtAYAta kare, yAra opara varSita haYeche manda vRSTi| tave ki tArA tA pratyakSa kare nA? varaM tArA punarujjIvanera AzaGkA kare nA|
tArA yakhana ApanAke dekhe, takhana ApanAke kevala vidrupera pAtrarUpe grahaNa kare, vale, e-i ki se yAke AllAha ‘rasUla’ kare preraNa karechena?
se teA AmAderake AmAdera upAsyagaNera kAcha theke sariYei dita, yadi AmarA tAderake A~kar3e dhare nA thAkatAma| tArA yakhana zAsti pratyakSa karave, takhana jAnate pArave ke adhika pathabhraSTa|
Apani ki tAke dekhena nA, ye tArA pravRttike upAsyarUpe grahaNa kare? tavuo ki Apani tAra yimmAdAra havena?
Apani ki mane karena ye, tAdera adhikAMza zeAne athavA veAjhe? tArA teA catuspada jantura mata; varaM Arao pathabhrAnta
tumi ki teAmAra pAlanakartAke dekha nA, tini kibhAve chAYAke vilamvita karena? tini icchA karale eke sthira rAkhate pAratena| erapara Ami sUryake karechi era nirdezaka|
ataHpara Ami eke nijera dike dhIre dhIre guTiYe Ani|
tinii teA teAmAdera janye rAtrike karechena AvaraNa, nidrAke vizrAma evaM dinake karechena vAire gamanera janye|
tinii svIYa rahamatera prAkkAle vAtAsake susaMvAdavAhIrUpe preraNa karena| evaM Ami AkAza theke pavitratA arjanera janye pAni varSaNa kari|
taddvArA mRta bhUbhAgake saJjIvita karAra janye evaM AmAra sRSTa jIvajantu o aneka mAnuSera tRSNA nivAraNera janye|
evaM Ami tA tAdera madhye vibhinnabhAve vitaraNa kari, yAte tArA smaraNa kare| kintu adhikAMza leAka akRtajJatA chAr3A kichui kare nA|
Ami icchA karale pratyeka janapade ekajana bhaYa pradarzanakArI preraNa karate pAratAma|
ataeva Apani kApheradera Anugatya karavena nA evaM tAdera sAthe era sAhAyye kaTheAra saMgrAma karuna|
tinii samAntarAle dui samudra pravAhita karechena, eTi miSTa, tRSNA nivAraka o eTi leAnA, visvAda; ubhaYera mAjhakhAne rekhechena ekaTi antarAYa, ekaTi durbhedya Ar3Ala|
tinii pAni theke sRSTi karechena mAnavake, ataHpara tAke raktagata, vaMza o vaivAhika samparkazIla karechena| teAmAra pAlanakartA savakichu karate sakSama|
tArA evAdata kare AllAhara parivarte emana kichura, yA tAdera upakAra karate pAre nA evaM kSatio karate pAre nA| kAphera teA tAra pAlanakartAra prati pRSThapradarzanakArI|
Ami ApanAke susaMvAda o satarkakArIrUpei preraNa karechi|
valuna, Ami teAmAdera kAche era keAna vinimaYa cAi nA, kintu ye icchA kare, se tAra pAlanakartAra patha avalamvana karuka|
Apani sei ciraJjIvera upara bharasA karuna, yAra mRtyu nei evaM tA~ra prazaMsAsaha pavitratA gheASaNA karuna| tini vAndAra geAnAha samparke yatheSTa khavaradAra|
tini nabheAmanDala, bhUmanDala o etadubhaYera antarvartI savakichu chaYadine sRsTi karechena, ataHpara Araze samAsIna haYechena| tini parama daYAmaYa| tA~ra samparke yini avagata, tAke jijJesa kara|
tAderake yakhana valA haYa, daYAmaYake sejadA kara, takhana tArA vale, daYAmaYa AvAra ke? tumi kAuke sejadA karAra Adeza karalei ki AmarA sejadA karava? ete tAdera palAYanaparatAi vRddhi pAYa|
kalyANamaYa tini, yini nabheAmanDale rAzicakra sRSTi karechena evaM tAte rekhechena sUrya o dIptimaYa candra|
yArA anusandhAnapriYa athavA yArA kRtajJatApriYa tAdera janye tini rAtri o divasa sRSTi karechena parivartanazIlarUpe|
rahamAna-era vAndA tArAi, yArA pRthivIte namrabhAve calApherA kare evaM tAdera sAthe yakhana murkharA kathA valate thAke, takhana tArA vale, sAlAma|
evaM yArA rAtri yApana kare pAlanakartAra uddezye sejadAvanata haYe o danDAYamAna haYe;
evaM yArA vale, he AmAra pAlanakartA, AmAdera kAchatheke jAhAnnAmera zAsti haTiYe dAo| nizcaYa era zAsti nizcita vinAza;
vasavAsa o avasthAnasthala hiseve tA kata nikRSTa jAYagA|
evaM tArA yakhana vyaYa kare, takhana ayathA vyaYa kare nA kRpaNatAo kare nA evaM tAdera panthA haYa etadubhaYera madhyavartI|

evaM yArA AllAhara sAthe anya upAsyera evAdata kare nA, AllAha yAra hatyA avaidha karechena, saGgata kAraNa vyatIta tAke hatyA kare nA evaM vyabhicAra kare nA| yArA ekAja kare, tArA zAstira sammukhIna have|
keYAmatera dina tAdera zAsti dviguna have evaM tathAYa lAJchita avasthAYa cirakAla vasavAsa karave|
kintu yArA taovA kare vizvAsa sthApana kare evaM satkarma kare, AllAha tAdera geAnAhake punya dvArA parivartata kare evaM devena| AllAha kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|
ye taovA kare o satkarma kare, se phire AsAra sthAna AllAhara dike phire Ase|
evaM yArA mithyA kAje yeAgadAna kare nA evaM yakhana asAra kriYAkarmera sammukhIna haYa, takhana mAna rakSArthe bhadrabhAve cale yAYa|
evaM yAderake tAdera pAlanakartAra AYAtasamUha veAjhAneA hale tAte andha o vadhira sadRza AcaraNa kare nA|
evaM yArA vale, he AmAdera pAlanakartA, AmAdera strIdera pakSa theke evaM AmAdera santAnera pakSa theke AmAdera janye ceAkhera zItalatA dAna kara evaM AmAderake muttAkIdera janye AdarzasvarUpa kara|
tAderake tAdera savarera pratidAne jAnnAte kakSa deYA have evaM tAderake tathAYa deAYA o sAlAma sahakAre abhyarthanA karA have|
tathAYa tArA cirakAla vasavAsa karave| avasthAnasthala o vAsasthAna hiseve tA kata uttama|
valuna, AmAra pAlanakartA paraoYA karena nA yadi teAmarA tA~ke nA DAka| teAmarA mithyA valecha| ataeva satvara neme Asave anivArya zAsti|
tvA, sIna, mIma|
eguleA suspaSTa kitAvera AYAta|
tArA vizvAsa kare nA vale Apani haYateA marmavyathAYa AtnaghAtI havena|
Ami yadi icchA kari, tave AkAza theke tAdera kAche keAna nidarzana nAyila karate pAri| ataHpara tArA era sAmane nata haYe yAve|
yakhanai tAdera kAche rahamAna era keAna natuna upadeza Ase, takhanai tArA tA theke mukha phiriYe neYa|
ataeva tArA teA mithyAreApa karechei; sutarAM ye viSaYa niYe tArA ThATTA-vidrupa karata, tAra yathArtha svarUpa zIghrai tAdera kAche peৗchave|
tArA ki bhupRSThera prati dRSTipAta kare nA? Ami tAte sarvaprakAra vizeSa-vastu kata udagata karechi|
nizcaYa ete nidarzana Ache, kintu tAdera adhikAMzai vizvAsI naYa|
ApanAra pAlanakartA teA parAkramazAlI parama daYAlu|
yakhana ApanAra pAlanakartA mUsAke Deke valalenaH tumi pApiSTha sampradAYera nikaTa yAo;
pherAunera sampradAYera nikaTa; tArA ki bhaYa kare nA?
se valala, he AmAra pAlanakartA, AmAra AzaMkA hacche ye, tArA AmAke mithyAvAdI vale deve|
evaM AmAra mana hatavala haYe par3e evaM AmAra jihvA acala haYe yAYa| sutarAM hArunera kAche vArtA preraNa karuna|
AmAra viruddhe tAdera abhiyeAga Ache| ataeva Ami AzaMkA kari ye, tArA AmAke hatyA karave|
AllAha valena, kakhanai naYa teAmarA ubhaYe yAo AmAra nidarzanAvalI niYe| Ami teAmAdera sAthe theke zeAnava|
ataeva teAmarA pheraAunera kAche yAo evaM vala, AmarA vizvajagatera pAlanakartAra rasUla|
yAte tumi vanI-isarAIlake AmAdera sAthe yete dAo|
pherAuna valala, AmarA ki teAmAke zizu avasthAYa AmAdera madhye lAlana-pAlana karini? evaM tumi AmAdera madhye jIvanera vahu vachara kATiYecha|
tumi sei-teAmarA aparAdha yA karavAra karecha| tumi hale kRtaghna|
mUsA valala, Ami se aparAdha takhana karechi, yakhana Ami bhrAnta chilAma|
ataHpara Ami bhIta haYe teAmAdera kAcha theke palAYana karalAma| erapara AmAra pAlanakartA AmAke prajJA dAna karechena evaM AmAke paYagamvara karechena|
AmAra prati teAmAra ye anugrahera kathA valacha, tA ei ye, tumi vanI-isalAIlake geAlAma vAniYe rekhecha|
pherAuna valala, vizvajagatera pAlanakartA AvAra ki?
mUsA valala, tini nabheAmanDala, bhUmanDala o etadubhaYera madhyavartI savakichura pAlanakartA yadi teAmarA vizvAsI hao|
pherAuna tAra pariSadavargake valala, teAmarA ki zunacha nA?
mUsA valala, tini teAmAdera pAlanakartA evaM teAmAdera pUrvavartIderao pAlanakartA|
pherAuna valala, teAmAdera prati prerita teAmAdera rasUlaTi nizcaYai vaddha pAgala|
mUsA valala, tini pUrva, pazcima o etadubhaYera madhyavartI sava kichura pAlanakartA, yadi teAmarA veAjha|
pherAuna valala, tumi yadi AmAra parivarte anyake upAsyarUpe grahaNa kara tave Ami avazyai teAmAke kArAgAre nikSepa karava|
mUsA valala, Ami teAmAra kAche keAna spaSTa viSaYa niYe Agamana karaleo ki?
pherAuna valala, tumi satyavAdI hale tA upasthita kara|
ataHpara tini lAThi nikSepa karale muhUrtera madhye tA suspaSTa ajagara haYe gela|
Ara tini tAra hAta vera karalena, tatkSaNAt tA darzakadera kAche suzubhra pratibhAta haleA|
pherAuna tAra pariSadavargake valala, nizcaYa e ekajana sudakSa jAdukara|
se tAra jAdu vale teAmAderake teAmAdera deza theke vahiskAra karate cAYa| ataeva teAmAdera mata ki?
tArA valala, tAke o tAra bhAike kichu avakAza dina evaM zahare zahare gheASaka preraNa karuna|
tArA yena ApanAra kAche pratyekaTi dakSa jAdukara ke upasthita kare|
ataHpara eka nirdiSTa dine jAdukaraderake ekatrita karA hala|
evaM janagaNera madhye gheASaNA karA hala, teAmarAo samaveta hao|
yAte AmarA jAdukaradera anusaraNa karate pAri-yadi tArAi vijaYI haYa|
yakhana yAdukararA AgamaNa karala, takhana pheraAunake valala, yadi AmarA vijaYI hai, tave AmarA puraskAra pAva teA?
pherAuna valala, hA~ evaM takhana teAmarA AmAra naikaTyazIladera antarbhukta have|
mUsA (AH) tAderake valalena, nikSepa kara teAmarA yA nikSepa karave|
ataHpara tArA tAdera razi o lAThi nikSepa karala evaM valala, pherAunera iyayatera kasama, AmarAi vijaYI hava|
ataHpara mUsA tA~ra lAThi nikSepa karala, haThAt tA tAdera alIka kIrtiguleAke grAsa karate lAgala|
takhana jAdukararA sejadAYa nata haYe gela|
tArA valala, AmarA rAvvula AlAmInera prati vizvAsa sthApana karalAma|
yini mUsA o hArunera rava|

pherAuna valala, AmAra anumati dAnera pUrvei teAmarA ki tAke mene nile? nizcaYa se teAmAdera pradhAna, ye teAmAderake jAdu zikSA diYeche| zIghrai teAmarA pariNAma jAnate pArave| Ami avazyai teAmAdera hAta o pA viparIta dika theke kartana karava| evaM teAmAdera savAike zUle car3Ava|
tArA valala, keAna kSati nei| AmarA AmAdera pAlanakartAra kAche pratyAvartana karava|
AmarA AzA kari, AmAdera pAlanakartA AmAdera kraTi-vicyuti mArjanA karavena| kAraNa, AmarA vizvAsa sthApanakArIdera madhye agraNI|
Ami mUsAke Adeza karalAma ye, AmAra vAndAderake niYe rAtriyeAge vera haYe yAo, nizcaYa teAmAdera pazcAddhAvana karA have|
ataHpara pherAuna zahare zahare saMgrAhakaderake preraNa karala,
nizcaYa erA (vanI-isarAIlarA) kSudra ekaTi dala|
evaM tArA AmAdera kreAdhera udreka kareche|
evaM AmarA savAi sadA zaMkita|
ataHpara Ami pheraAunera dalake tAdera vAga-vAgicA o jharNAsamUha theke vahiSkAra karalAma|
evaM dhana-bhAnDAra o maneArama sthAnasamUha theke|
erUpai haYechila evaM vanI-isalAIlake kare dilAma esavera mAlika|
ataHpara suryeAdaYera samaYa tArA tAdera pazcAddhAvana karala|
yakhana ubhaYa dala parasparake dekhala, takhana mUsAra saGgIrA valala, AmarA ye dharA par3e gelAma|
mUsA valala, kakhanai naYa, AmAra sAthe Achena AmAra pAlanakartA| tini AmAke patha vale devena|
ataHpara Ami mUsAke Adeza karalAma, teAmAra lAThi dvArA samUdrake AghAta kara| phale, tA vidIrNa haYe gela evaM pratyeka bhAga vizAla parvatasadRza haYe gela|
Ami sethAYa apara dalake pau~chiYe dilAma|
evaM mUsA o tA~ra saMgIdera savAike vA~ciYe dilAma|
ataHpara apara dalaTike nimajjata kalalAma|
nizcaYa ete ekaTi nidarzana Ache evaM tAdera adhikAMzai vizvAsI chila nA|
ApanAra pAlanakartA avazyai parAkramazAlI, parama daYAlu|
Ara tAderake ivrAhImera vRttAnta zuniYe dina|
yakhana tA~ra pitAke evaM tA~ra sampradAYake valalena, teAmarA kisera evAdata kara?
tArA valala, AmarA pratimAra pUjA kari evaM sArAdina ederakei niSThAra sAthe A~kar3e thAki|
ivrAhIma (AH) valalena, teAmarA yakhana AhavAna kara, takhana tArA zeAne ki?
athavA tArA ki teAmAdera upakAra kiMvA kSati karate pAre?
tArA valalaH nA, tave AmarA AmAdera pitRpuruSaderake peYechi, tArA erUpai karata|
ivrAhIma valalena, teAmarA ki tAdera samparke bheve dekhecha, yAdera pUjA kare Asacha|
teAmarA evaM teAmAdera pUrvavartI pitRpuruSerA?
vizvapAlanakartA vyatIta tArA savAi AmAra zatru|
yini AmAke sRSTi karechena, ataHpara tinii AmAke pathapradarzana karena,
yini AmAke AhAra evaM pAnIYa dAna karena,
yakhana Ami reAgAkrAnta hai, takhana tinii AreAgya dAna karena|
yini AmAra mRtyu ghaTAvena, ataHpara punarjIvana dAna karavena|
Ami AzA kari tinii vicArera dine AmAra kraTi-vicyuti mApha karavena|
he AmAra pAlanakartA, AmAke prajJA dAna kara evaM AmAke satkarmazIladera antarbhukta kara
evaM AmAke paravartIdera madhye satyabhASI kara|
evaM AmAke neYAmata udyAnera adhikArIdera antarbhUkta kara|
evaM AmAra pitAke kSamA kara| se teA pathabhraSTadera anyatama|
evaM pUnarutthAna divase AmAke lAJchita kareA nA,
ye divase dhana-sampada o santAna santati keAna upakAre Asave nA;
kintu ye sustha antara niYe AllAhara kAche Asave|
jAnnAta AllAhabhIrudera nikaTavartI karA have|
evaM vipathagAmIdera sAmane ummeAcita karA have jAhAnnAma|
tAderake valA haveH tArA keAthAYa, teAmarA yAdera pUjA karate|
AllAhara parivarte? tArA ki teAmAdera sAhAyya karate pAre, athavA tArA pratizeAdha nite pAre?
ataHpara tAderake evaM pathabhraSTaderake AdheAmukhi kare nikSepa karA have jAhAnnAme|
evaM ivalIsa vAhinIra sakalake|
tArA tathAYa kathA kATAkATite lipta haYe valaveH
AllAhara kasama, AmarA prakAzya vibhrAntite lipta chilAma|
yakhana AmarA teAmAderake vizva-pAlanakartAra samatulya ganya karatAma|
AmAderake duSTakarmIrAi geAmarAha karechila|
ataeva AmAdera keAna supArizakArI nei|
evaM keAna sahRdaYa vandhu o nei|
hAYa, yadi keAnarupe AmarA pRthivIte pratyAvartanera suyeAga petAma, tave AmarA vizvAsa sthApanakArI haYe yetAma|
nizcaYa, ete nidarzana Ache evaM tAdera adhikAMzai vizvAsI naYa|
ApanAra pAlanakartA pravala parAkramazAlI, parama daYAlu|

yakhana tAdera bhrAtA nUha tAderake valalena, teAmAdera ki bhaYa nei?
Ami teAmAdera janya vizvasta vArtAvAhaka|
ataeva, teAmarA AllAhake bhaYa kara evaM AmAra Anugatya kara|
Ami teAmAdera kAche era janya keAna pratidAna cAi nA, AmAra pratidAna teA vizva-pAlanakartAi devena|
ataeva, teAmarA AllAhake bhaYa kara evaM AmAra Anugatya kara|
tArA valala, AmarA ki teAmAke mene neva yakhana teAmAra anusaraNa karache itarajanerA?

Ami muminagaNake tAr3iYe deYAra leAka nai|
Ami teA zudhu ekajana suspaSTa satarkakArI|
tArA valala, he nUha yadi tumi virata nA hao, tave tumi nizcitai prastarAghAte nihata have|
nUha valalena, he AmAra pAlanakartA, AmAra sampradAYa teA AmAke mithyAvAdI valache|
ataeva, AmAra o tAdera madhye keAna phaYasAlA kare dina evaM AmAke o AmAra saMgI muminagaNake rakSA karuna|
ataHpara Ami tA~ke o tA~ra saGgigaNake veAjhAi karA neৗkAYa rakSA karalAma|
erapara avaziSTa savAike nimajjata karalAma|
nizcaYa ete nidarzana Ache evaM tAdera adhikAMzai vizvAsI naYa|
nizcaYa ApanAra pAlanakartA pravala parAkramazAlI, parama daYAlu|
Ada sampradAYa paYagamvaragaNake mithyAvAdI valeche|
takhana tAdera bhAi huda tAderake valalenaH teAmAdera ki bhaYa nei?
Ami teAmAdera vizvasta rasUla|
ataeva, teAmarA AllAhake bhaYa kara evaM AmAra Anugatya kara|
Ami teAmAdera kAche era janye pratidAna cAi nA| AmAra pratidAna teA pAlanakartA devena|
teAmarA ki pratiTi uccasthAne ayathA nidarzana nirmAna karacha?
evaM var3a var3a prAsAda nirmANa karacha, yena teAmarA cirakAla thAkave?
yakhana teAmarA AghAta hAna, takhana jAlema o niSThurera mata AghAta hAna|
ataeva, AllAhake bhaYa kara evaM AmAra anugatya kara|
bhaYa kara tA~ke, yini teAmAderake sesava vastu diYechena, yA teAmarA jAna|
teAmAderake diYechena catuSpada jantu o putra-santAna,
evaM udyAna o jharaNA|
Ami teAmAdera janye mahAdivasera zAsti AzaMkA kari|
tArA valala, tumi upadeza dAo athavA upadeza nAi dAo, ubhaYai AmAdera janye samAna|
esava kathAvArtA pUrvavartI leAkadera abhyAsa vai naYa|
AmarA zAstiprApta hava nA|
ataeva, tArA tA~ke mithyAvAdI valate lAgala evaM Ami tAderake nipAta kare dilAma| ete avazyai nidarzana Ache; kintu tAdera adhikAMzai vizvAsI naYa|
evaM ApanAra pAlanakartA, tini teA pravala parAkramazAlI, parama daYAlu|
sAmuda sampradAYa paYagamvaragaNake mithyAvAdI valeche|
yakhana tAdera bhAi sAleha, tAderake valalena, teAmarA ki bhaYa kara nA?
Ami teAmAdera vizvasta paYagamvara|
ataeva, AllAhake bhaYa kara evaM AmAra Anugatya kara|
Ami era janye teAmAdera kAche keAna pratidAna cAi nA| AmAra pratidAna teA vizva-pAlanakartAi devena|
teAmAderake ki e jagatera bheAga-vilAsera madhye nirApade rekhe deYA have?
udyAnasamUhera madhye evaM jharaNAsamUhera madhye?
zasyakSetrera madhye evaM maJjurita khejura vAgAnera madhye?
teAmarA pAhAr3a keTe jA~ka jamakera gRha nirmANa karacha|
sutarAM teAmarA AllAhake bhaYa kara evaM AmAra anugatya kara|
evaM sImAlaMghanakArIdera Adeza mAnya kara nA;
yArA pRthivIte anartha sRSTi kare evaM zAnti sthApana kare nA;
tArA valala, tumi teA jAdugrasthadera ekajana|
tumi teA AmAdera matai ekajana mAnuSa vai nao| sutarAM yadi tumi satyavAdI hao, tave keAna nidarzana upasthita kara|
sAleha valalena ei uSTrI, era janye Ache pAni pAnera pAlA evaM teAmAdera janye Ache pAni pAnera pAlA nirdiSTa eka-eka dinera|
teAmarA eke keAna kaSTa dio nA| tAhale teAmAderake mahAdivasera AyAva pAkar3Ao karave|
tArA tAke vadha karala phale, tArA anutapta haYe gela|
erapara AyAva tAderake pAkar3Ao karala| nizcaYa ete nidarzana Ache| kintu tAdera adhikAMzai vizvAsI naYa|
ApanAra pAlanakartA pravala parAkramazAlI, parama daYAlu|
lUtera sampradAYa paYagamvaragaNake mithyAvAdI valeche|
yakhana tAdera bhAi lUta tAderake valalena, teAmarA ki bhaYa kara nA?
Ami teAmAdera vizvasta paYagamvara|
ataeva, teAmarA AllAhake bhaYa kara evaM AmAra Anugatya kara|
Ami era janye teAmAdera kAche keAna pratidAna cAi nA| AmAra pratidAna teA vizva-pAlanakartA devena|
sArA jAhAnera mAnuSera madhye teAmarAi ki purUSadera sAthe kukarma kara?
evaM teAmAdera pAlanakartA teAmAdera janye ye strIganake sRSTi karechena, tAderake varjana kara? varaM teAmarA sImAlaGghanakArI sampradAYa|
tArA valala, he lUta, tumi yadi virata nA hao, tave avazyai teAmAke vahiskRta karA have|
lUta valalena, Ami teAmAdera ei kAjake ghRNA kari|
he AmAra pAlanakartA, AmAke evaM AmAra parivAravargake tArA yA kare, tA theke rakSA kara|
ataHpara Ami tA~ke o tA~ra parivAravargake rakSA karalAma|
eka vRddhA vyatIta, se chila dhvaMsa prAptadera antarbhukta|
erapara anyaderake nipAta karalAma|
tAdera upara eka vizeSa vRSTi varSaNa karalAma| bhIti-pradarzita dera janye ei vRSTi chila kata nikRSTa|
nizcaYai ete nidarzana raYeche; kintu tAdera adhikAMzai vizvAsI naYa|
nizcaYai ApanAra pAlanakartA pravala parAkramazAlI, parama daYAlu|
vanera adhivAsIrA paYagamvaragaNake mithyAvAdI valeche|
yakhana zeA’AYava tAdera ke valalena, teAmarA ki bhaYa kara nA?
Ami teAmAdera vizvasta paYagamvara|
ataeva, teAmarA AllAhake bhaYa kara evaM AmAra Anugatya kara|
Ami teAmAdera kAche era janya keAna pratidAna cAi nA| AmAra pratidAna teA vizva-pAlanakartAi devena|
mApa pUrNa kara evaM yArA parimApe kama deYa, tAdera antarbhukta haYeA nA|
seAjA dA~r3i-pAllAYa ojana kara|
mAnuSake tAdera vastu kama dio nA evaM pRthivIte anartha sRSTi kare phireA nA|
bhaYa kara tA~ke, yini teAmAderake evaM teAmAdera pUrvavartI leAka-sampradAYake sRSTi karechena|
tArA valala, tumi teA jAdugrastadera anyatama|
tumi AmAdera mata mAnuSa vai teA nao| AmAdera dhAraNA-tumi mithyAvAdIdera antarbhukta|
ataeva, yadi satyavAdI hao, tave AkAzera keAna TukareA AmAdera upara phele dAo|
zeA’AYava valalena, teAmarA yA kara, se samparke AmAra pAlanakartA bhAlarUpe avahita|
ataHpara tArA tA~ke mithyAvAdI vale dila| phale tAderake meghAcchanna divasera AyAva pAkar3Ao karala| nizcaYa seTA chila eka mahAdivasera AyAva|
nizcaYa ete nidarzana raYeche; kintu tAdera adhikAMzai vizvAsa kare nA|
nizcaYa ApanAra pAlanakartA pravala parAkramazAlI, parama daYAlu|
ei keAraAna teA vizva-jAhAnera pAlanakartAra nikaTa theke avatIrNa|
vizvasta pherezatA eke niYe avataraNa kareche|
ApanAra antare, yAte Apani bhIti pradarzaNakArIdera antarbhukta hana,
suspaSTa AravI bhASAYa|
nizcaYa era ullekha Ache pUrvavartI kitAvasamUhe|
tAdera janye eTA ki nidarzana naYa ye, vanI-isarAIlera AlemagaNa eTA avagata Ache?
yadi Ami eke keAna bhinnabhASIra prati avatIrNa karatAma,
ataHpara tini tA tAdera kAche pATha karatena, tave tArA tAte vizvAsa sthApana karata nA|
emanibhAve Ami geAnAhagAradera antare avizvAsa saJcAra karechi|
tArA era prati vizvAsa sthApana karave nA, ye paryanta pratyakSa nA kare marmantuda AyAva|
ataHpara tA AkasmikabhAve tAdera kAche ese par3ave, tArA tA vujhate o pArave nA|
takhana tArA valave, AmarA ki avakAza pAva nA?
tArA ki AmAra zAsti druta kAmanA kare?
Apani bheve dekhuna teA, yadi Ami tAderake vacharera para vachara bheAga-vilAsa karate dei,
ataHpara ye viSaYe tAderake oYAdA deYA hata, tA tAdera kAche ese par3e|
takhana tAdera bheAga vilAsa tA tAdera ki keAna upakAre Asave?
Ami keAna janapada dhvaMsa karini; kintu ematAvasthAYa ye, tArA satarkakArI chila|
smaraNa karAneAra janye, evaM AmAra kAja anyAYAcaraNa naYa|
ei keAraAna zaYatAnarA avatIrNa kareni|
tArA e kAjera upayukta naYa evaM tArA era sAmarthyao rAkhe nA|
tAderake teA zravaNera jAYagA theke dUre rAkhA raYeche|
ataeva, Apani AllAhara sAthe anya upAsyake AhavAna karavena nA| karale zAstite patita havena|
Apani nikaTatama AtmIYaderake satarka kare dina|
evaM ApanAra anusArI muminadera prati sadaYa heAna|
yadi tArA ApanAra avAdhya kare, tave vale dina, teAmarA yA kara, tA theke Ami mukta|
Apani bharasA karuna parAkramazAlI, parama daYAlura upara,
yini ApanAke dekhena yakhana Apani nAmAye danDAYamAna hana,
evaM nAmAyIdera sAthe uThAvasA karena|
nizcaYa tini sarvazreAtA, sarvajJAnI|
Ami ApanAke valava ki kAra nikaTa zaYatAnarA avataraNa kare?
tArA avatIrNa haYa pratyeka mithyAvAdI, geAnAhagArera upara|
tArA zruta kathA ene deYa evaM tAdera adhikAMzai mithyAvAdI|
vibhrAnta leAkerAi kavidera anusaraNa kare|
tumi ki dekha nA ye, tArA prati maYadAnei udabhrAnta haYe phire?
evaM emana kathA vale, yA tArA kare nA|

tave tAdera kathA bhinna, yArA vizvAsa sthApana kare o satkarma kare evaM AllAha ke khuva smaraNa kare evaM nipIr3ita haoYAra para pratizeAdha grahaNa kare| nipIr3anakArIrA zIghrai jAnate pArave tAdera gantavyasthala kirUpa|
tvA-sIna; eguleA Ala-keAraAnera AYAta evaM AYAta suspaSTa kitAvera|
muminadera janye patha nirdeza o susaMvAda|
yArA nAmAya kAYema kare, yAkAta pradAna kare evaM parakAle nizcita vizvAsa kare|
yArA parakAle vizvAsa kare nA, Ami tAdera dRSTite tAdera karmakAnDake suzeAbhita kare diYechi| ataeva, tArA udabhrAnta haYe ghure ver3AYa|
tAdera janyei raYeche manda zAsti evaM tArAi parakAle adhika kSatigrasta|
evaM ApanAke keAraAna pradatta hacche prajJAmaYa, jJAnamaYa AllAhara kAcha theke|

yakhana mUsA tA~ra parivAravargake valalenaH Ami agni dekhechi, ekhana Ami sekhAna theke teAmAdera janye keAna khavara Anate pArava athavA teAmAdera janye jvalanta aGgAra niYe Asate pArava yAte teAmarA Aguna peAhAte pAra|
ataHpara yakhana tini Agunera kAche Asalena takhana AoYAja hala dhanya tini, yini Agunera sthAne Achena evaM yArA Agunera AzepAze Achena| vizva jAhAnera pAlanakartA AllAha pavitra o mahimAnvita|
he mUsA, Ami AllAha, pravala parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|

Apani nikSepa karuna ApanAra lAThi| ataHpara yakhana tini tAke sarpera nyAYa chuTAchuTi karate dekhalena, takhana tini viparIta dike chuTate lAgalena evaM pechana phireo dekhalena nA| he mUsA, bhaYa karavena nA| Ami ye raYechi, AmAra kAche paYagamvaragaNa bhaYa karena nA|
tave ye vAr3AvAr3i kare erapara manda karmera parivarte satkarma kare| nizcaYa Ami kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

ApanAra hAta ApanAra vagale DhukiYe dina, suzubhra haYe vera have nirdeASa avasthAYa| eguleA pherAuna o tAra sampradAYera kAche AnIta naYaTi nidarzanera anyatama| nizcaYa tArA chila pApAcArI sampradAYa|
ataHpara yakhana tAdera kAche AmAra ujjala nidarzanAvalI Agamana karala, takhana tArA valala, eTA teA suspaSTa jAdu|
tArA anyAYa o ahaMkAra kare nidarzanAvalIke pratyAkhyAna karala, yadio tAdera antara eguleA satya vale vizvAsa karechila| ataeva dekhuna, anarthakArIdera pariNAma kemana haYechila?
Ami avazyai dAuda o sulAYamAnake jJAna dAna karechilAma| tA~rA vale chilena, AllAhara prazaMsA, yini AmAderake tA~ra aneka mumina vAndAra upara zreSThatva dAna karechena|
sulAYamAna dAudera uttarAdhikArI haYechilena| valechilena, ‘he leAka sakala, AmAke ur3anta pakSIkUlera bhASA zikSA deYA haYeche evaM AmAke sava kichu deYA haYeche| nizcaYa eTA suspaSTa zreSThatva|’
sulAYamAnera sAmane tAra senAvAhinIke samaveta karA hala| jvina-mAnuSa o pakSIkulake, ataHpara tAderake vibhinna vyUhe vibhakta karA hala|

yakhana tArA pipIlikA adhyUSita upatyakAYa pau~chAla, takhana eka pipIlikA valala, he pipIlikAra dala, teAmarA teAmAdera gRhe praveza kara| anyathAYa sulAYamAna o tAra vAhinI ajJAtasAre teAmAderake piSTa kare phelave|

tAra kathA zune sulAYamAna mucaki hAsalena evaM valalena, he AmAra pAlanakartA, tumi AmAke sAmarthya dAo yAte Ami teAmAra sei niYAmatera kRtajJatA prakAza karate pAri, yA tumi AmAke o AmAra pitA-mAtAke dAna karecha evaM yAte Ami teAmAra pachandanIYa satkarma karate pAri evaM AmAke nija anugrahe teAmAra satkarmaparAYana vAndAdera antarbhukta kara|
sulAYamAna pakSIdera kheA~ja khavara nilena, ataHpara valalena, ki hala, hudahudake dekhachi nA kena? nAki se anupasthita?
Ami avazyai tAke kaTheAra zAsti deva kiMvA hatyA karava athavA se upasthita karave upayukta kAraNa|
kichukSaNa par3ei huda ese valala, Apani yA avagata nana, Ami tA avagata haYechi| Ami ApanAra kAche sAvA theke nizcita saMvAda niYe Agamana karechi|
Ami eka nArIke sAvAvAsIdera upara rAjatva karate dekhechi| tAke savakichui deYA haYeche evaM tAra ekaTA virATa siMhAsana Ache|

Ami tAke o tAra sampradAYake dekhalAma tArA AllAhara parivarte sUryake sejadA karache| zaYatAna tAdera dRSTite tAdera kAryAvalI suzeAbhita kare diYeche| ataHpara tAderake satpatha theke nivRtta kareche| ataeva tArA satpatha pAYa nA|
tArA AllAhake sejadA kare nA kena, yini nabheAmanDala o bhumanDalera geApana vastu prakAza karena evaM jAnena yA teAmarA geApana kara o yA prakAza kara|
AllAha vyatIta keAna upAsya nei; tini mahA Arazera mAlika|
sulAYamAna valalena, ekhana Ami dekhava tumi satya valacha, nA tumi mithyavAdI|
tumi AmAra ei patra niYe yAo evaM eTA tAdera kAche arpana kara| ataHpara tAdera kAcha theke sare par3a evaM dekha, tArA ki jaoYAva deYa|
vilakIsa valala, he pariSadavarga, AmAke ekaTi sammAnita patra deYA haYeche|
sei patra sulAYamAnera pakSa theke evaM tA eiH sasIma dAtA, parama daYAlu, AllAhara nAme zuru;
AmAra meAkAvelAYa zakti pradarzana kareA nA evaM vazyatA svIkAra kare AmAra kAche upasthita hao|
vilakIsa valala, he pariSadavarga, AmAke AmAra kAje parAmarza dAo| teAmAdera upasthiti vyatireke Ami keAna kAje siddhAnta grahaNa kari nA|
tArA valala, AmarA zaktizAlI evaM kaTheAra yeAddhA| ekhana siddhAnta grahaNera kSamatA ApanArai| ataeva Apani bheve dekhuna, AmAderake ki Adeza karavena|
se valala, rAjA vAdazArA yakhana keAna janapade praveza kare, takhana tAke viparyasta kare deYa evaM sekhAnakAra sambhrAnta vyaktivargake apadastha kare| tArAo erUpai karave|
Ami tA~ra kAche kichu upaDheৗkana pAThAcchi; dekhi prerita leAkerA ki jaoYAva Ane|

ataHpara yakhana dUta sulAYamAnera kAche Agamana karala, takhana sulAYamAna valalena, teAmarA ki dhanasampada dvArA AmAke sAhAyya karate cAo? AllAha AmAke yA diYechena, tA teAmAderake pradatta vastu theke uttama| varaM teAmarAi teAmAdera upaDheৗkana niYe sukhe thAka|

phire yAo tAdera kAche| ekhana avazyai Ami tAdera viruddhe eka sainyavAhinI niYe Asava, yAra meAkAvelA karAra zakti tAdera nei| Ami avazyai tAderake apadastha kare sekhAna theke vahiSkRta karava evaM tArA have lAJchita|
sulAYamAna valalena, he pariSadavarga, tArA AtnasamarpaNa kare AmAra kAche AsAra pUrve ke vilakIsera siMhAsana AmAke ene deve?
janaika daitya-jina valala, Apani ApanAra sthAna theke uThAra pUrve Ami tA ene deva evaM Ami ekAje zaktivAna, vizvasta|

kitAvera jJAna yAra chila, se valala, ApanAra dike ApanAra ceAkhera palaka phelAra pUrvei Ami tA ApanAke ene deva| ataHpara sulAYamAna yakhana tA sAmane rakSita dekhalena, takhana valalena eTA AmAra pAlanakartAra anugraha, yAte tini AmAke parIkSA karena ye, Ami kRtajJatA prakAza kari, nA akRtajJatA prakAza kari| ye kRtajJatA prakAza kare, se nijera upakArera janyei kRtajJatA prakAza kare evaM ye akRtajJatA prakAza kare se jAnuka ye, AmAra pAlanakartA abhAvamukta kRpAzIla|
sulAYamAna valalena, vilakIsera sAmane tAra siMhAsanera AkAra-AkRti vadaliYe dAo, dekhava se saThika vujhate pAre, nA se tAdera antarbhukta, yAdera dizA nei?
ataHpara yakhana vilakIsa ese gela, takhana tAke jijJAsA karA hala, teAmAra siMhAsana ki erUpai? se valala, mane haYa eTA seTAi| AmarA pUrvei samasta avagata haYechi evaM AmarA AjJAvahao haYe gechi|
AllAhara parivarte se yAra evAdata karata, sei tAke ImAna theke nivRtta karechila| nizcaYa se kAphera sampradAYera antarbhukta chila|

tAke valA hala, ei prAsAde praveza kara| yakhana se tAra prati dRSTipAta karala se dhAraNA karala ye, eTA svaccha gabhIra jalAzaYa| se tAra pAYera geAchA khule phelala| sulAYamAna valala, eTA teA svaccha sphaTika nirmita prAsAda| vilakIsa valala, he AmAra pAlanakartA, Ami teA nijera prati juluma karechi| Ami sulAYamAnera sAthe vizva jAhAnera pAlanakartA AllAhara kAche Atnasamarpana karalAma|
Ami sAmuda sampradAYera kAche tAdera bhAi sAlehake ei marme preraNa karechi ye, teAmarA AllAhara evAdata kara| ataHpara tArA dvidhAvibhakta haYe vitarke pravRtta hala|
sAleha valalena, he AmAra sampradAYa, teAmarA kalyANera pUrve druta akalyANa kAmanA karacha kena? teAmarA AllAhara kAche kSamA prArthanA karacha nA kena? sambhavataH teAmarA daYAprApta have|

tArA valala, teAmAke evaM teAmAra sAthe yArA Ache, tAderake AmarA akalyANera pratIka mane kari| sAleha valalena, teAmAdera maGgalAmaGgala AllAhara kAche; varaM teAmarA emana sampradAYa, yAderake parIkSA karA hacche|
Ara sei zahare chila emana ekajana vyakti, yArA dezamaYa anartha sRSTi kare ver3Ata evaM saMzeAdhana karata nA|

tArA valala, teAmarA paraspare AllAhara nAme zapatha grahaNa kara ye, AmarA rAtrikAle tAke o tAra parivAravargake hatyA karava| ataHpara tAra dAvIdArake vale deva ye, tAra parivAravargera hatyAkAnDa AmarA pratyakSa karini| AmarA nizcaYai satyavAdI|
tArA eka cakrAnta karechila evaM Amio eka cakrAnta karechilAma| kintu tArA vujhate pAreni|
ataeva, dekha tAdera cakrAntera parinAma, Ami avazrai tAderake evaM tAdera sampradAYake nAstanAvuda kare diYechi|
ei teA tAdera vAr3Ighara-tAdera avizvAsera kAraNe janazUnya avasthAYa par3e Ache| nizcaYa ete jJAnI sampradAYera janye nidarzana Ache|
yArA vizvAsa sthApana karechila evaM paraheyagAra chila, tAderake Ami uddhAra karechi|
smaraNa kara lUtera kathA, tini tA~ra kaomake valechilena, teAmarA kena azlIla kAja karacha? athaca era pariNatira kathA teAmarA avagata Acha!
teAmarA ki kAmatRptira janya nArIderake cher3e puruSe upagata have? teAmarA teA eka varvara sampradAYa|
uttare tA~ra kaoma zudhu e kathATii valaleA, lUta parivArake teAmAdera janapada theke vera kare dAo| erA teA emana leAka yArA zudhu pAkapavitra sAjate cAYa|
ataHpara tA~ke o tA~ra parivAravargake uddhAra karalAma tA~ra strI chAr3A| kenanA, tAra janye dhvaMsaprAptadera bhAgyai nirdhArita karechilAma|
Ara tAdera upara varSaNa karechilAma muSaladhAre vRSTi| sei satarkakRtadera upara katai nA mArAtnaka chila se vRSTi|
vala, sakala prazaMsAi AllAhara evaM zAnti tA~ra maneAnIta vAndAgaNera prati! zreSTha ke? AllAha nA orA-tArA yAderake zarIka sAvyasta kare|

vala teA ke sRSTi karechena nabheAmanDala o bhUmanDala evaM AkAza theke teAmAdera janye varSaNa karechena pAni; ataHpara tA dvArA Ami maneArama vAgAna sRSTi karechi| tAra vRkSAdi utpanna karAra zaktii teAmAdera nei| ataeva, AllAhara sAthe anya keAna upAsya Ache ki? varaM tArA satyavicyuta sampradAYa|

vala teA ke pRthivIke vAseApayeAgI karechena evaM tAra mAjhe mAjhe nada-nadI pravAhita karechena evaM tAke sthita rAkhAra janye parvata sthApana karechena evaM dui samudrera mAjhakhAne antarAYa rekhechena| ataeva, AllAhara sAthe anya keAna upAsya Ache ki? varaM tAdera adhikAMzai jAne nA|

vala teA ke niHsahAYera DAke sAr3A dena yakhana se DAke evaM kaSTa dUrIbhUta karena evaM teAmAderake pRthivIte purvavartIdera sthalAbhiSikta karena| sutarAM AllAhara sAthe anya keAna upAsya Ache ki? teAmarA ati sAmAnyai dhyAna kara|

vala teA ke teAmAderake jale o sthale andhakAre patha dekhAna evaM yini tA~ra anugrahera pUrve susaMvAdavAhI vAtAsa preraNa karena? ataeva, AllAhara sAthe anya keAna upAsya Ache ki? tArA yAke zarIka kare, AllAha tA theke aneka Urdhve|

vala teA ke prathamavAra sRSTi karena, ataHpara tAke punarAYa sRSTi karavena evaM ke teAmAderake AkAza o martya theke riyika dAna karena| sutarAM AllAhara sAthe anya keAna upAsya Ache ki? valuna, teAmarA yadi satyavAdI hao tave teAmAdera pramANa upasthita kara|
valuna, AllAha vyatIta nabheAmanDala o bhUmanDale keu gAYavera khavara jAne nA evaM tArA jAne nA ye, tArA kakhana punarujjIvita have|
varaM parakAla samparke tAdera jJAna niHzeSa haYe geche; varaM tArA e viSaYe sandeha peASana karache varaM e viSaYe tArA andha|
kApherarA vale, yakhana AmarA o AmAdera vApa-dAdArA mRttikA haYe yAva, takhanao ki AmAderake punarutthita karA have?
ei oYAdAprApta haYechi AmarA evaM pUrva thekei AmAdera vApa-dAdArA| eTA teA pUrvavartIdera upakathA vai kichu naYa|
valuna, pRthivI paribhramaNa kara evaM dekha aparAdhIdera pariNati ki haYeche|
tAdera kAraNe Apani duHkhita havena nA evaM tArA ye cakrAnta kareche ete manaHkSunna havena nA|
tArA vale, teAmarA yadi satyavAdI hao tave vala, ei oYAdA kakhana pUrNa have?
valuna, asambhava ki, teAmarA yata druta kAmanA karacha tAdera kiYadaMza teAmAdera piThera upara ese geche|
ApanAra pAlanakartA mAnuSera prati anugrahazIla, kintu tAdera adhikAMzai kRtajJatA prakAza kare nA|
tAdera antara yA geApana kare evaM yA prakAza kare ApanAra pAlanakartA avazyai tA jAnena|
AkAze o pRthivIte emana keAna geApana bheda nei, yA suspaSTa kitAve nA Ache|
ei keAraAna vaNI isarAIla yesava viSaYe matavireAdha kare, tAra adhikAMza tAdera kAche varNanA kare|
evaM nizcitai eTA muminadera janye hedAYeta o rahamata|
ApanAra pAlanakartA nija zAsanakSamatA anuyAYI tAdera madhye phaYasAlA kare devena| tini parAkramazAlI, suvijJa|
ataeva, Apani AllAhara upara bharasA karuna| nizcaYa Apani satya o spaSTa pathe Achena|
Apani AhavAna zeAnAte pAravena nA mRtaderake evaM vadhirakeo naYa, yakhana tArA pRSTha pradarzana kare cale yAYa|
Apani andhaderake tAdera pathabhraSTatA theke phiriYe satpathe Anate pAravena nA| Apani kevala tAderake zeAnAte pAravena, yArA AmAra AYAtasamUhe vizvAsa kare| ataeva, tArAi AjJAvaha|

yakhana pratizruti (keYAmata) samAgata have, takhana Ami tAdera sAmane bhUgarbha theke ekaTi jIva nirgata karava| se mAnuSera sAthe kathA valave| e kAraNe ye mAnuSa AmAra nidarzanasamUhe vizvAsa karata nA|
yedina Ami ekatrita karava ekekaTi dalake sesava sampradAYa theke, yArA AmAra AYAtasamUhake mithyA valata; ataHpara tAderake vibhinna dale vibhakta karA have|
yakhana tArA upasthita haYe yAve, takhana AllAha valavena, teAmarA ki AmAra AYAtasamUhake mithyA valechile? athaca eguleA samparke teAmAdera purNa jJAna chila nA| nA teAmarA anya kichu karachile?
julumera kAraNe tAdera kAche AyAvera oYAdA ese geche| ekhana tArA keAna kichu valate pArave nA|
tArA ki dekhe nA ye, Ami rAtri sRSTi karechi tAdera vizrAmera janye evaM dinake karechi AleAkamaYa| nizcaYa ete ImAnadAra sampradAYera janye nidarzanAvalI raYeche|

yedina siGgAYa phutkAra deoYA have, ataHpara AllAha yAderake icchA karavena, tArA vyatIta nabheAmanDale o bhUmanDale yArA Ache, tArA savAi bhItavihvala haYe par3ave evaM sakalei tA~ra kAche Asave vinIta avasthAYa|

tumi parvatamAlAke dekhe acala mane kara, athaca sedina eguleA meghamAlAra mata calamAna have| eTA AllAhara kArigarI, yini savakichuke karechena susaMhata| teAmarA yA kichu karacha, tini tA avagata Achena|
ye keu satkarma niYe Asave, se utkRSTatara pratidAna pAve evaM sedina tArA gurutara asthiratA theke nirApada thAkave|
evaM ye manda kAja niYe Asave, tAke agnite adhaHmUkhe nikSepa karA have| teAmarA yA karachile, tArai pratiphala teAmarA pAve|
Ami teA kevala ei nagarIra prabhura evAdata karate AdiSTa haYechi, yini eke sammAnita karechena| evaM sava kichu tA~rai| Ami Arao AdiSTa haYechi yena Ami AjJAvahadera ekajana hai|
evaM yena Ami keAraAna pATha kare zeAnAi| para ye vyakti satpathe cale, se nijera kalyANArthei satpathe cale evaM keu pathabhraSTa hale Apani vale dina, Ami teA kevala ekajana bhIti pradarzanakArI|

evaM Arao valuna, samasta prazaMsA AllAhara| satvarai tini tA~ra nidarzanasamUha teAmAderake dekhAvena| takhana teAmarA tA cinate pArave| evaM teAmarA yA kara, se samparke ApanAra pAlanakartA gAphela nana|
tvA-sIna-mIma|
eguleA suspaSTa kitAvera AYAta|
Ami ApanAra kAche mUsA o pherAunera vRttAnta satya sahakAre varNanA karachi ImAnadAra sampradAYera janye|

pherAuna tAra deze uddhata haYechila evaM se dezavAsIke vibhinna dale vibhakta kare tAdera ekaTi dalake dUrvala kare diYechila| se tAdera putra-santAnaderake hatyA karata evaM nArIderake jIvita rAkhata| nizcaYa se chila anartha sRSTikArI|
deze yAderake dUrvala karA haYechila, AmAra icchA hala tAdera prati anugraha karAra, tAderake netA karAra evaM tAderake dezera uttarAdhikArI karAra|
evaM tAderake dezera kSamatAYa AsIna karAra evaM pherAuna, hAmAna o tAdera sainya-vAhinIke tA dekhiYe deYAra, yA tArA sei dUrvala dalera tarapha theke AzaMkA karata|

Ami mUsA-jananIke Adeza pAThAlAma ye, tAke stanya dAna karate thAka| ataHpara yakhana tumi tAra samparke vipadera AzaMkA kara, takhana tAke dariYAYa nikSepa kara evaM bhaYa kareA nA, duHkhao kareA nA| Ami avazyai tAke teAmAra kAche phiriYe deva evaM tAke paYagamvaragaNera ekajana karava|
ataHpara pherAuna parivAra mUsAke kur3iYe nila, yAte tini tAdera zatru o duHkhera kAraNa haYe yAna| nizcaYa pherAuna, hAmAna, o tAdera sainyavAhinI aparAdhI chila|

pherAunera strI valala, e zizu AmAra o teAmAra naYanamaNi, tAke hatyA kareA nA| e AmAdera upakAre Asate pAre athavA AmarA tAke putra kare nite pAri| prakRtapakSe pariNAma samparke tAdera keAna khavara chila nA|

sakAle mUsA jananIra antara asthira haYe par3ala| yadi Ami tA~ra hRdaYake dRr3ha kare nA ditAma, tave tini mUsAjanita asthiratA prakAza karei ditena| dRr3ha karalAma, yAte tini thAkena vizvavAsIgaNera madhye|
tini mUsAra bhagiNIke valalena, tAra pechana pechana yAo| se tAdera ajJAtasAre aparicitA haYe tAke dekhe yete lAgala|

pUrva thekei Ami dhAtrIderake mUsA theke virata rekhechilAma| mUsAra bhaginI valala, Ami teAmAderake emana eka parivArera kathA valava ki, yArA teAmAdera janye eke lAlana-pAlana karave evaM tArA have tAra hitAkAGkSI?
ataHpara Ami tAke jananIra kAche phiriYe dilAma, yAte tAra cakSu jur3AYa evaM tini duHkha nA karena evaM yAte tini jAnena ye, AllAhara oYAdA satya, kintu aneka mAnuSa tA jAne nA|
yakhana mUsA yeৗvane padArpana karalena evaM pariNata vaYaska haYe gelena, takhana Ami tA~ke prajJA o jJAnadAna karalAma| emanibhAve Ami satkarmIderake pratidAna diYe thAki|

tini zahare praveza karalena, yakhana tAra adhivAsIrA chila vekhavara| tathAYa tini dui vyaktike lar3Airata dekhalena| edera ekajana chila tA~ra nija dalera evaM anya jana tA~ra zatru dalera| ataHpara ye tA~ra nija dalera se tA~ra zatru dalera leAkaTira viruddhe tA~ra kAche sAhAyya prArthanA karala| takhana mUsA tAke ghuSi mAralena evaM etei tAra mRtyu haYe gela| mUsA valalena, eTA zaYatAnera kAja| nizcaYa se prakAzya zatru, vibhrAntakArI|
tini valalena, he AmAra pAlanakartA, Ami teA nijera upara juluma kare phelechi| ataeva, AmAke kSamA karuna| AllAha tAke kSamA karalena| nizcaYa tini kSamAzIla, daYAlu|
tini valalena, he AmAra pAlanakartA, Apani AmAra prati ye anugraha karechena, erapara Ami kakhanao aparAdhIdera sAhAyyakArI hava nA|

ataHpara tini prabhAte uThalena se zahare bhIta-zaMkita avasthAYa| haThAt tini dekhalena, gatakalya ye vyakti tA~ra sAhAyya ceYechila, se citkAra kare tA~ra sAhAyya prArthanA karache| mUsA tAke valalena, tumi teA ekajana prakAzya pathabhraSTa vyakti|

ataHpara mUsA yakhana ubhaYera zatruke zAYestA karate cAilena, takhana se valala, gatakalya tumi yemana eka vyaktike hatyA karechile, se rakama AmAkeo ki hatyA karate cAo? tumi teA pRthivIte svairAcArI hate cAccha evaM sandhi sthApanakArI hate cAo nA|
esamaYa zaharera prAnta theke ekavyakti chuTe Asala evaM valala, he mUsA, rAjyera pariSadavarga teAmAke hatyA karAra paramarza karache| ataeva, tumi vera haYe yAo| Ami teAmAra hitAkAGkSI|
ataHpara tini sekhAna theke bhIta avasthAYa vera haYe par3alena patha dekhate dekhate| tini valalena, he AmAra pAlanakartA, AmAke jAlema sampradAYera kavala theke rakSA kara|
yakhana tini mAdaiYAna abhimukhe raoYAnA halena takhana valalena, AzA karA yAYa AmAra pAlanakartA AmAke sarala patha dekhAvena|

yakhana tini mAdaiYAnera kUpera dhAre peৗchalena, takhana kUpera kAche ekadala leAkake pelena tArA jantuderake pAni pAna karAneAra kAje rata| evaM tAdera pazcAte dU’jana strIleAkake dekhalena tArA tAdera jantuderake AgaliYe rAkhache| tini valalena, teAmAdera ki vyApAra? tArA valala, AmarA AmAdera jantuderake pAni pAna karAte pAri nA, ye paryanta rAkhAlarA tAdera jantuderake niYe sare nA yAYa| AmAdera pitA khuvai vRddha|
ataHpara mUsA tAdera jantuderake pAni pAna karAlena| ataHpara tini chAYAra dike sare gelena evaM valalena, he AmAra pAlanakartA, tumi AmAra prati ye anugraha nAyila karave, Ami tAra mukhApekSI|

ataHpara vAlikAdvaYera ekajana lajjAjar3ita padakSepe tA~ra kAche Agamana karala| valala, AmAra pitA ApanAke DAkachena, yAte Apani ye AmAderake pAni pAna kariYechena, tAra vinimaYe puraskAra pradAna karena| ataHpara mUsA yakhana tA~ra kAche gelena evaM samasta vRttAnta varNanA karalena, takhana tini valalena, bhaYa kareA nA, tumi jAlema sampradAYera kavala theke rakSA peYecha|
vAlikAdvaYera ekajana valala pitAH tAke cAkara niyukta karuna| kenanA, ApanAra cAkara hiseve se-i uttama have, ye zaktizAlI o vizvasta|

pitA mUsAke valalena, Ami AmAra ei kanyAdvaYera ekajanake teAmAra sAthe vivAhe dite cAi ei zarte ye, tumi ATa vachara AmAra cAkurI karave, yadi tumi daza vachara pUrNa kara, tA teAmAra icchA| Ami teAmAke kaSTa dite cAi nA| AllAha cAhena teA tumi AmAke satkarmaparAYaNa pAve|

mUsA valalena, AmAra o ApanAra madhye ei cukti sthira hala| du’Ti meYAdera madhya theke ye keAna ekaTi pUrNa karale AmAra viruddhe keAna abhiyeAga thAkave nA| AmarA yA valachi, tAte AllAhara upara bharasA|

ataHpara mUsA (AH) yakhana sei meYAda pUrNa karala evaM saparivAre yAtrA karala, takhana se tura parvatera dika theke Aguna dekhate pela| se tAra parivAravargake valala, teAmarA apekSA kara, Ami Aguna dekhechi| sambhavataH Ami sekhAna theke teAmAdera kAche keAna khavara niYe Asate pAri athavA keAna jvalanta kASThakhanDa Anate pAri, yAte teAmarA Aguna peAhAte pAra|
yakhana se tAra kAche peৗchala, takhana pavitra bhUmite avasthita upatyakAra DAna prAntera vRkSa theke tAke AoYAja deYA hala, he mUsA! Ami AllAha, vizva pAlanakartA|

Arao valA hala, tumi teAmAra lAThi nikSepa kara| ataHpara yakhana se lAThike sarpera nyAYa deৗr3Adeৗr3i karate dekhala, takhana se mukha phiriYe viparIta dike pAlAte lAgala evaM pechana phire dekhala nA| he mUsA, sAmane esa evaM bhaYa kareA nA| teAmAra keAna AzaMkA nei|

teAmAra hAta vagale rAkha| tA vera haYe Asave nirAmaYa ujjvala haYe evaM bhaYa hetu teAmAra hAta teAmAra upara cepe dhara| ei du’Ti pherAuna o tAra pariSadavargera prati teAmAra pAlanakartAra tarapha theke pramANa| nizcaYa tArA pApAcArI sampradAYa|
mUsA valala, he AmAra pAlanakartA, Ami tAdera eka vyaktike hatyA karechi| kAjei Ami bhaYa karachi ye, tArA AmAke hatyA karave|
AmAra bhAi hAruNa, se AmA apekSA prAJjalabhASI| ataeva, tAke AmAra sAthe sAhAyyera janye preraNa karuna| se AmAke samarthana jAnAve| Ami AzaMkA kari ye, tArA AmAke mithyAvAdI valave|

AllAha valalena, Ami teAmAra vAhu zaktizAlI karava teAmAra bhAi dvArA evaM teAmAdera pradhAnya dAna karava| phale, tArA teAmAra kAche peৗchAte pArave nA| AmAra nidarzanAvalIra jeAre teAmarA evaM teAmAdera anusArIrA pravala thAkave|
ataHpara mUsA yakhana tAdera kAche AmAra suspaSTa nidarzanAvalI niYe peৗchala, takhana tArA valala, eteA alIka jAdu mAtra| AmarA AmAdera pUrvapuruSadera madhye e kathA zunini|
mUsA valala, AmAra pAlanakartA samyaka jAnena ye tAra nikaTa theke hedAYetera kathA niYe Agamana kareche evaM ye prApta have parakAlera gRha| nizcaYa jAlemarA saphalakAma have nA|

pherAuna valala, he pariSadavarga, Ami jAni nA ye, Ami vyatIta teAmAdera keAna upAsya Ache| he hAmAna, tumi iTa peAr3Ao, ataHpara AmAra janye ekaTi prAsAda nirmANa kara, yAte Ami mUsAra upAsyake uki mere dekhate pAri| AmAra teA dhAraNA ei ye, se ekajana mithyAvAdI|
pherAuna o tAra vAhinI anyAYabhAve pRthivIte ahaMkAra karate lAgala evaM tArA mane karala ye, tArA AmAra kAche pratyAvartita have nA|
ataHpara Ami tAke o tAra vAhinIke pAkar3Ao karalAma, tatpara Ami tAderake samudre nikSepa karalAma| ataeva, dekha jAlemadera pariNAma ki haYeche|
Ami tAderake netA karechilAma| tArA jAhAnnAmera dike AhavAna karata| keYAmatera dina tArA sAhAyya prApta have nA|
Ami ei pRthivIte abhizApake tAdera pazcAte lAgiYe diYechi evaM keYAmatera dina tArA have durdazAgrasta|
Ami pUrvavartI aneka sampradAYake dhvaMsa karAra para mUsAke kitAva diYechi mAnuSera janye jJAnavartikA| hedAYeta o rahamata, yAte tArA smaraNa rAkhe|
mUsAke yakhana Ami nirdezanAmA diYechilAma, takhana Apani pazcima prAnte chilena nA evaM Apani pratyakSadarzIo chilena nA|

kintu Ami aneka sampradAYa sRSTi karechilAma, ataHpara tAdera aneka yuga ativAhita haYeche| Ara Apani mAdaiYAnavAsIdera madhye chilena nA ye, tAdera kAche AmAra AYAtasamUha pATha karatena| kintu Amii chilAma rasUla preraNakArI|

Ami yakhana mUsAke AoYAja diYechilAma, takhana Apani tura parvatera pArzve chilena nA| kintu eTA ApanAra pAlanakartAra rahamata svarUpa, yAte Apani emana eka sampradAYake bhIti pradarzana karena, yAdera kAche ApanAra pUrve keAna bhIti pradarzanakArI Agamana kareni, yAte tArA smaraNa rAkhe|

Ara e janya ye, tAdera kRtakarmera janye tAdera keAna vipada hale tArA valata, he AmAdera pAlanakartA, tumi AmAdera kAche keAna rasUla preraNa karale nA kena? karale AmarA teAmAra AYAtasamUhera anusaraNa karatAma evaM AmarA vizvAsa sthApanakArI haYe yetAma|

ataHpara AmAra kAcha theke yakhana tAdera kAche satya Agamana karala, takhana tArA valala, mUsAke yerUpa deYA haYechila, ei rasUlake serUpa deYA hala nA kena? pUrve mUsAke yA deYA haYechila, tArA ki tA asvIkAra kareni? tArA valechila, ubhaYai jAdu, paraspare ekAtma| tArA Arao valechila, AmarA ubhaYake mAni nA|
valuna, teAmarA satyavAdI hale ekhana AllAhara kAcha theke keAna kitAva Ana, yA etadubhaYa theke uttama pathapradarzaka haYa| Ami sei kitAva anusaraNa karava|

ataHpara tArA yadi ApanAra kathAYa sAr3A nA deYa, tave jAnavena, tArA zudhu nijera pravRttira anusaraNa kare| AllAhara hedAYetera parivarte ye vyakti nija pravRttira anusaraNa kare, tAra cAite adhika pathabhraSTa Ara ke? nizcaYa AllAha jAlema sampradAYake patha dekhAna nA|
Ami tAdera kAche uparyupari vANI peৗchiYechi| yAte tArA anudhAvana kare|
keAraAnera pUrve Ami yAderake kitAva diYechi, tArA ete vizvAsa kare|
yakhana tAdera kAche eTA pATha karA haYa, takhana tArA vale, AmarA era prati vizvAsa sthApana karalAma| eTA AmAdera pAlanakartAra pakSa theke satya| AmarA era pUrveo AjJAvaha chilAma|
tArA duivAra puraskRta have tAdera savarera kAraNe| tArA mandera jaoYAve bhAla kare evaM Ami tAderake yA diYechi, tA theke vyaYa kare|

tArA yakhana avAJcita vAje kathAvArtA zravaNa kare, takhana tA theke mukha phiriYe neYa evaM vale, AmAdera janye AmAdera kAja evaM teAmAdera janye teAmAdera kAja| teAmAdera prati sAlAma| AmarA ajJadera sAthe jar3ita hate cAi nA|
Apani yAke pachanda karena, tAke satpathe Anate pAravena nA, tave AllAha tA’AlAi yAke icchA satpathe AnaYana karena| ke satpathe Asave, se samparke tinii bhAla jAnena|

tArA vale, yadi AmarA ApanAra sAthe supathe Asi, tave AmarA AmAdera deza theke utkhAta hava| Ami ki tAdera janye ekaTi nirApada harama pratiSThita karini? ekhAne sarvaprakAra phala-mUla AmadAnI haYa AmAra deYA riyikasvarUpa| kintu tAdera adhikAMzai jAne nA|

Ami aneka janapada dhvaMsa karechi, yAra adhivAsIrA tAdera jIvana yApane madamatta chila| eguleAi ekhana tAdera ghara-vAr3I| tAdera para eguleAte mAnuSa sAmAnyai vasavAsa kareche| avazeSe Amii mAlika raYechi|

ApanAra pAlanakartA janapadasamUhake dhvaMsa karena nA, ye paryanta tAra kendrasthale rasUla preraNa nA karena, yini tAdera kAche AmAra AYAtasamUha pATha karena evaM Ami janapadasamUhake takhanai dhvaMsa kari, yakhana tAra vAsindArA juluma kare|
teAmAderake yA kichu deYA haYeche, tA pArthiva jIvanera bheAga o zeAbhA vai naYa| Ara AllAhara kAche yA Ache, tA uttama o sthAYI| teAmarA ki veAjha nA?
yAke Ami uttama pratizruti diYechi, yA se pAve, se ki ai vyaktira samAna, yAke Ami pArthiva jIvanera bheAga-sambhAra diYechi, ataHpara tAke keYAmatera dina aparAdhIrUpe hAyira karA have?
yedina AllAha tAderake AoYAja diYe valavena, teAmarA yAderake AmAra zarIka dAvI karate, tArA keAthAYa?

yAdera janye zAstira Adeza avadhArita haYeche, tArA valave, he AmAdera pAlanakartA| ederakei AmarA pathabhraSTa karechilAma| AmarA tAderake pathabhraSTa karechilAma, yemana AmarA pathabhraSTa haYechilAma| AmarA ApanAra sAmane dAYamukta hacchi| tArA kevala AmAderai evAdata karata nA|
valA have, teAmarA teAmAdera zarIkadera AhvAna kara| takhana tArA DAkave| ataHpara tArA tAdera DAke sAr3A dive nA evaM tArA AyAva dekhave| hAYa! tArA yadi satpatha prApta hata|
ye dina AllAha tAderake Deke valavena, teAmarA rasUlagaNake ki jaoYAva diYechile?
ataHpara tAdera kathAvArtA vandha haYe yAve evaM tArA eke aparake jijJAsAvAda karate pArave nA|
tave ye taovA kare, vizvAsa sthApana kare o satkarma kare, AzA karA yAYa, se saphalakAma have|
ApanAra pAlanakartA yA icchA sRSTi karena evaM pachanda karena| tAdera keAna kSamatA nei| AllAha pavitra evaM tArA yAke zarIka kare, tA theke urdhve|
tAdera antara yA geApana kare evaM yA prakAza kare, ApanAra pAlanakartA tA jAnena|
tinii AllAha tini vyatIta keAna upAsya nei| ihakAla o parakAle tA~rai prazaMsA| vidhAna tA~rai kSamatAdhIna evaM teAmarA tA~rai kAche pratyAvartita have|

valuna, bheve dekha teA, AllAha yadi rAtrike keYAmatera dina paryanta sthAYI karena, tave AllAha vyatIta emana upAsya ke Ache, ye teAmAderake AleAka dAna karate pAre? teAmarA ki tavuo karNapAta karave nA?

valuna, bheve dekha teA, AllAha yadi dinake keYAmatera dina paryanta sthAYI karena, tave AllAha vyatIta emana upAsya ke Ache ye, teAmAderake rAtri dAna karate pAre, yAte teAmarA vizrAma karave? teAmarA ki tavuo bheve dekhave nA?
tinii svIYa rahamate teAmAdera janye rAta o dina karechena, yAte teAmarA tAte vizrAma grahaNa kara o tA~ra anugraha anveSaNa kara evaM yAte teAmarA kRtajJatA prakAza kara|
yedina AllAha tAderake Deke valavena, teAmarA yAderake AmAra zarIka mane karate, tArA keAthAYa?

pratyeka sampradAYa theke Ami ekajana sAkSI AlAdA karava; ataHpara valava, teAmAdera pramANa Ana| takhana tArA jAnate pArave ye, satya AllAhara evaM tArA yA gar3ata, tA tAdera kAcha theke udhAo haYe yAve|

kAruna chila mUsAra sampradAYabhukta| ataHpara se tAdera prati duSTAmi karate Arambha karala| Ami tAke eta dhana-bhAnDAra dAna karechilAma yAra cAvi vahana karA kaYekajana zaktizAlI leAkera pakSe kaSTasAdhya chila| yakhana tAra sampradAYa tAke valala, dambha kareA nA, AllAha dAmbhikaderake bhAlavAsena nA|

AllAha teAmAke yA dAna karechena, tadvArA parakAlera gRha anusandhAna kara, evaM ihakAla theke teAmAra aMza bhUle yeYeA nA| tumi anugraha kara, yemana AllAha teAmAra prati anugraha karechena evaM pRthivIte anartha sRSTi karate praYAsI haYeA nA| nizcaYa AllAha anartha sRSTikArIderake pachanda karena nA|

se valala, Ami ei dhana AmAra nijasva jJAna-garimA dvArA prApta haYechi| se ki jAne nA ye, AllAha tAra pUrve aneka sampradAYake dhvaMsa karechena, yArA zaktite chila tAra cAite pravala evaM dhana-sampade adhika prAcuryazIla? pApIderake tAdera pApakarma samparke jijJesa karA have nA|

ataHpara kAruna jA~kajamaka sahakAre tAra sampradAYera sAmane vera hala| yArA pArthiva jIvana kAmanA karata, tArA valala, hAYa, kAruna yA prApta haYeche, AmAderake yadi tA deYA hata! nizcaYa se var3a bhAgyavAna|
Ara yArA jJAna prApta haYechila, tAra valala, dhika teAmAderake, yArA ImAnadAra evaM satkarmI, tAdera janye AllAhara deYA saoYAvai utkRSTa| eTA tArAi pAYa, yArA savarakArI|
ataHpara Ami kArunake o tAra prAsAdake bhUgarbhe vilIna kare dilAma| tAra pakSe AllAha vyatIta emana keAna dala chila nA, yArA tAke sAhAyya karate pAre evaM se nijeo AtmarakSA karate pArala nA|

gatakalya yArA tAra mata haoYAra vAsanA prakAza karechila, tArA pratyuSe valate lAgala, hAYa, AllAha tA~ra vAndAdera madhye yAra janye icchA riyika vardhita karena o hrAsa karena| AllAha AmAdera prati anugraha nA karale AmAderakeo bhUgarbhe vilIna kare ditena| hAYa, kApherarA saphalakAma have nA|
ei parakAla Ami tAdera janye nirdhArita kari, yArA duniYAra vuke auddhatya prakAza karate o anartha sRSTi karate cAYa nA| kheAdAbhIrudera janye zubha pariNAma|
ye satkarma niYe Asave, se tadapekSA uttama phala pAve evaM ye manda karma niYe Asave, erUpa manda karmIrA se manda karma parimAnei pratiphala pAve|
yini ApanAra prati keAraAnera vidhAna pAThiYechena, tini avazyai ApanAke svadeze phiriYe Anavena| valuna AmAra pAlanakartA bhAla jAnena ke hedAYeta niYe eseche evaM ke prakAzya vibhrAntite Ache|
Apani AzA karatena nA ye, ApanAra prati kitAva avartIrNa have| eTA kevala ApanAra pAlanakartAra rahamata| ataeva Apani kApheradera sAhAyyakArI havena nA|

kApherarA yena ApanAke AllAhara AYAta theke vimukha nA kare seguleA ApanAra prati avartIrNa haoYAra para Apani ApanAra pAlanakartAra prati dAoYAta dina evaM kichutei muzarikadera antarbhukta havena nA|
Apani AllAhara sAthe anya upAsyake AhvAna karavena nA| tini vyatIta anya keAna upAsya nei| AllAhara sattA vyatIta savakichu dhvaMsa have| vidhAna tA~rai evaM teAmarA tA~rai kAche pratyAvartita have|
Alipha-lAma-mIma|
mAnuSa ki mane kare ye, tArA ekathA valei avyAhati peYe yAve ye, AmarA vizvAsa kari evaM tAderake parIkSA karA have nA?
Ami tAderakeo parIkSA karechi, yArA tAdera pUrve chila| AllAha avazyai jene nevena yArA satyavAdI evaM nizcaYai jene nevena mithyukaderake|
yArA manda kAja kare, tArA ki mane kare ye, tArA AmAra hAta theke ve~ce yAve? tAdera phaYasAlA khuvai manda|
ye AllAhara sAkSAta kAmanA kare, AllAhara sei nirdhArita kAla avazyai Asave| tini sarvazreAtA, sarvajJAnI|
ye kaSTa svIkAra kare, se teA nijera janyei kaSTa svIkAra kare| AllAha vizvavAsI theke ve-paraoYA|
Ara yArA vizvAsa sthApana kare o satkarma kare, Ami avazyai tAdera manda kAja guleA miTiYe deva evaM tAderake karmera utkRSTatara pratidAna deva|

Ami mAnuSake pitA-mAtAra sAthe sadvyavahAra karAra jeAra nirdeza diYechi| yadi tArA teAmAke AmAra sAthe emana kichu zarIka karAra jeAra praceSTA cAlAYa, yAra samparke teAmAra keAna jJAna nei, tave tAdera Anugatya kareA nA| AmArai dike teAmAdera pratyAvartana| ataHpara Ami teAmAderake vale deva yA kichu teAmarA karate|
yArA vizvAsa sthApana kare o satkAja kare, Ami avazyai tAderake satkarmIdera antarbhukta karava|
