kataka leAka vale, AmarA AllAhara upara vizvAsa sthApana karechi; kintu AllAhara pathe yakhana tArA niryAtita haYa, takhana tArA mAnuSera niryAtanake AllAhara AyAvera mata mane kare| yakhana ApanAra pAlanakartAra kAcha theke keAna sAhAyya Ase takhana tArA valate thAke, AmarA teA teAmAdera sAthei chilAma| vizvavAsIra antare yA Ache, AllAha ki tA samyaka avagata nana?
AllAha avazyai jene nevena yArA vizvAsa sthApana kareche evaM nizcaYa jene nevena yArA munApheka|
kApherarA muminaderake vale, AmAdera patha anusaraNa kara| AmarA teAmAdera pApabhAra vahana karava| athaca tArA pApabhAra kichutei vahana karave nA| nizcaYa tArA mithyAvAdI|
tArA nijedera pApabhAra evaM tAra sAthe Arao kichu pApabhAra vahana karave| avazya tArA ye sava mithyA kathA udbhAvana kare, se samparke keYAmatera dina jijJAsita have|

Ami nUha (AH) ke tA~ra sampradAYera kAche preraNa karechilAma| tini tAdera madhye paJcAza kama eka hAjAra vachara avasthAna karechilena| ataHpara tAderake mahAplAvaNa grAsa karechila| tArA chila pApI|
ataHpara Ami tA~ke o neৗkAreAhIgaNake rakSA karalAma evaM neৗkAke nidarzana karalAma vizvavAsIra janye|
smaraNa kara ivrAhImake| yakhana tini tA~ra sampradAYake valalena; teAmarA AllAhara evAdata kara evaM tA~ke bhaYa kara| eTAi teAmAdera janye uttama yadi teAmarA veAjha|

teAmarA teA AllAhara parivarte kevala pratimArai pUjA karacha evaM mithyA udbhAvana karacha| teAmarA AllAhara parivarte yAdera evAdata karacha, tArA teAmAdera riyikera mAlika naYa| kAjei AllAhara kAche riyika tAlAza kara, tA~ra evAdata kara evaM tA~ra kRtajJatA prakAza kara| tA~rai kAche teAmarA pratyAvartita have|
teAmarA yadi mithyAvAdI vala, tave teAmAdera pUrvavartIrAo teA mithyAvAdI valeche| spaSTabhAve paYagAma peৗche deYAi teA rasUlera dAYitva|
tArA ki dekhe nA ye, AllAha kibhAve sRSTikarma zuru karena ataHpara tAke punarAYa sRSTi karavena? eTA AllAhara janye sahaja|
valuna, teAmarA pRthivIte bhramaNa kara evaM dekha, kibhAve tini sRSTikarma zuru karechena| ataHpara AllAha purnavAra sRSTi karavena| nizcaYa AllAha savakichu karate sakSama|
tini yAke icchA zAsti dena evaM yAra prati icchA rahamata karena| tA~rai dike teAmarA pratyAvartita have|
teAmarA sthale o antarIkSe AllAhake apAraga karate pArave nA evaM AllAha vyatIta teAmAdera keAna hitAkAGkhI nei, sAhAyyakArIo nei|
yArA AllAhara AYAta samUha o tA~ra sAkSAta asvIkAra kare, tArAi AmAra rahamata theke nirAza have evaM tAdera janyei yantraNAdAYaka zAsti raYeche|

takhana ivrAhImera sampradAYera echAr3A keAna jaoYAva chila nA ye tArA valala, tAke hatyA kara athavA agnidagdha kara| ataHpara AllAha tAke agni theke rakSA karalena| nizcaYa ete vizvAsI leAkadera janye nidarzanAvalI raYeche|

ivrAhIma valalena, pArthiva jIvane teAmAdera pArasparika bhAlavAsA rakSAra janye teAmarA AllAhara parivarte pratimAguleAke upAsyarUpe grahaNa karecha| erapara keYAmatera dina teAmarA eke aparake asvIkAra karave evaM eke aparake lAnata karave| teAmAdera ThikAnA jAhAnnAma evaM teAmAdera keAna sAhAyyakArI nei|
ataHpara tAra prati vizvAsa sthApana karalena lUta| ivrAhIma valalena, Ami AmAra pAlanakartAra uddeze dezatyAga karachi| nizcaYa tini parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|
Ami tAke dAna karalAma isahAka o iYAkuva, tA~ra vaMzadharadera madhye navuoYata o kitAva rAkhalAma evaM duniYAte tA~ke puraskRta karalAma| nizcaYa parakAle o se satleAkadara antarbhUkta have|
Ara preraNa karechi lUtake| yakhana se tAra sampradAYake valala, teAmarA emana azlIla kAja karacha, yA teAmAdera pUrve pRthivIra keu kareni|

teAmarA ki puMmaithune lipta Acha, rAhAjAni karacha evaM nijedera majalise garhita karma karacha? jaoYAve tA~ra sampradAYa kevala ekathA valala, AmAdera upara AllAhara AyAva Ana yadi tumi satyavAdI hao|
se valala, he AmAra pAlanakartA, duskRtakArIdera viruddhe AmAke sAhAyya kara|
yakhana AmAra prerita pherezatAgaNa susaMvAda niYe ivrAhImera kAche Agamana karala, takhana tArA valala, AmarA ei janapadera adhivAsIderake dhvaMsa karava| nizcaYa era adhivAsIrA jAlema|

se valala, ei janapade teA lUtao raYeche| tArA valala, sekhAne ke Ache, tA AmarA bhAla jAni| AmarA avazyai tAke o tA~ra parivAravargake rakSA karava tA~ra strI vyatIta; se dhvaMsaprAptadera antarbhUkta thAkave|

yakhana AmAra prerita pherezatAgaNa lUtera kAche Agamana karala, takhana tAdera kAraNe se viSanna haYe par3ala evaM tAra mana saMkIrNa haYe gela| tArA valala, bhaYa karavena nA evaM duHkha karavena nA| AmarA ApanAke o ApanAra parivAravargake rakSA karavai ApanAra strI vyatIta, se dhvaMsa prAptadera antarbhUkta thAkave|
AmarA ei janapadera adhivAsIdera upara AkAza theke AyAva nAjila karava tAdera pApAcArera kAraNe|
Ami vuddhimAna leAkadera janye ete ekaTi spaSTa nidarzana rekhe diYechi|
Ami mAdaiYAnavAsIdera prati tAdera bhAi zeAAYavake preraNa karechi| se valala, he AmAra sampradAYa teAmarA AllAhara evAdata kara, zeSa divasera AzA rAkha evaM pRthivIte anartha sRSTi kareA nA|
kintu tArA tA~ke mithyAvAdI valala; ataHpara tArA bhUmikampa dvArA AkrAnta hala evaM nijedera gRhe upur3a haYe par3e raila|

Ami A’da o sAmudake dhvaMsa kare diYechi| tAdera vAr3I-ghara thekei tAdera avasthA teAmAdera jAnA haYe geche| zaYatAna tAdera karmake tAdera dRSTite suzeAbhita karechila, ataHpara tAderake satpatha avalamvane vAdhA diYechila evaM tArA chila huziYAra|
Ami kAruna, pherAuna o hAmAnake dhvaMsa karechi| mUsA tAdera kAche suspaSTa nidarzanAvalI niYe Agamana karechila ataHpara tArA deze dambha karechila| kintu tArA jite yAYani|

Ami pratyekakei tAra aparAdhera kAraNe pAkar3Ao karechi| tAdera kArao prati preraNa karechi prastarasaha pracanDa vAtAsa, kAuke peYeche vajrapAta, kAuke Ami vilIna karechi bhUgarbhe evaM kAuke karechi nimajjata| AllAha tAdera prati yuluma karAra chilena nA; kintu tArA nijerAi nijedera prati yuluma kareche|
yArA AllAhara parivarte aparake sAhAyyakArIrUpe grahaNa kare tAdera udAharaNa mAkar3asA| se ghara vAnAYa| Ara sava gharera madhye mAkar3asAra gharai teA adhika durvala, yadi tArA jAnata|
tArA AllAhara parivarte yA kichuke DAke, AllAha tA jAnena| tini zaktizAlI, prajJAmaYa|
e sakala udAharaNa Ami mAnuSera janye dei; kintu jJAnIrAi tA veAjhe|
AllAha yathArtharUpe nabheAmanDala o bhUmanDala sRSTi karechena| ete nidarzana raYeche ImAnadAra sampradAYera janye|
Apani ApanAra prati pratyAdiSTa kitAva pATha karuna evaM nAmAya kAYema karuna| nizcaYa nAmAya azlIla o garhita kArya theke virata rAkhe| AllAhara smaraNa sarvazreSTha| AllAha jAnena teAmarA yA kara|

teAmarA kitAvadhArIdera sAthe tarka-vitarka karave nA, kintu uttama panthAYa; tave tAdera sAthe naYa, yArA tAdera madhye ve-inasApha| evaM vala, AmAdera prati o teAmAdera prati yA nAyila karA haYeche, tAte AmarA vizvAsa sthApana karechi| AmAdera upAsya o teAmAdera upAsya ekai evaM AmarA tA~rai AjJAvaha|

ebhAvei Ami ApanAra prati kitAva avartINa karechi| ataHpara yAdera ke Ami kitAva diYechilAma, tArA eke mene cale evaM ederao (makkAvAsIderao) keu keu ete vizvAsa rAkhe| kevala kApherarAi AmAra AYAtasamUha asvIkAra kare|
Apani teA era pUrve keAna kitAva pATha karenani evaM svIYa dakSiNa hasta dvArA keAna kitAva likhenani| erUpa hale mithyAvAdIrA avazyai sandeha peASaNa karata|
varaM yAderake jJAna deYA haYeche, tAdera antare ihA (keAraAna) teA spaSTa AYAta| kevala ve-inasApharAi AmAra AYAtasamUha asvIkAra kare|
tArA vale, tAra pAlanakartAra pakSa theke tAra prati kichu nidarzana avatIrNa hala nA kena? valuna, nidarzana teA AllAhara icchAdhIna| Ami teA ekajana suspaSTa satarkakArI mAtra|
eTAki tAdera janye yatheSTa naYa ye, Ami ApanAra prati kitAva nAyila karechi, yA tAdera kAche pATha karA haYa| ete avazyai vizvAsI leAkadera janye rahamata o upadeza Ache|
valuna, AmAra madhye o teAmAdera madhye AllAhai sAkSIrUpe yatheSTa| tini jAnena yA kichu nabheAmanDale o bhU-manDale Ache| Ara yArA mithyAYa vizvAsa kare o AllAhake asvIkAra kare, tArAi kSatigrasta|
tArA ApanAke AyAva tvarAnvita karate vale| yadi AyAvera samaYa nirdhArita nA thAkata, tave AyAva tAdera upara ese yeta| nizcaYai AkasmikabhAve tAdera kAche AyAva ese yAve, tAdera khavarao thAkave nA|
tArA ApanAke AyAva tvarAnvita karate vale; athaca jAhAnnAma kApheraderake gherAo karache|
yedina AyAva tAderake gherAo karave mAthAra upara theke evaM pAYera nIca theke| AllAha valalena, teAmarA yA karate, tAra svAda grahaNa kara|
he AmAra ImAnadAra vAndAgaNa, AmAra pRthivI prazasta| ataeva teAmarA AmArai evAdata kara|
jIvamAtrai mRtyura svAda grahaNa karave| ataHpara teAmarA AmArai kAche pratyAvartita have|

yArA vizvAsa sthApana kare o satkarma kare, Ami avazyai tAderake jAnnAtera suucca prAsAde sthAna deva, yAra taladeze prasravaNasamUha pravAhita| sekhAne tArA cirakAla thAkave| kata uttama puraskAra karmIdera|
yArA savara kare evaM tAdera pAlanakartAra upara bharasA kare|
emana aneka jantu Ache, yArA tAdera khAdya saJcita rAkhe nA| AllAhai riyika dena tAderake evaM teAmAderakeo| tini sarvazreAtA, sarvajJa|
yadi Apani tAderake jijJesa karena, ke nabheAmanDala o bhU-manDala sRSTi kareche, candra o sUryake karme niYeAjita kareche? tave tArA avazyai valave AllAha| tAhale tArA keAthAYa ghure ver3Acche?
AllAha tA~ra vAndAdera madhye yAra janya icchA riyika prazasta kare dena evaM yAra janya icchA hrAsa karena| nizcaYa, AllAha sarvaviSaYe samyaka parijJAta|

yadi Apani tAderake jijJesa karena, ke AkAza theke vAri varSaNa kare, ataHpara tA dvArA mRttikAke uhAra mRta haoYAra para saJjIvita kare? tave tArA avazyai valave, AllAha| valuna, samasta prazaMsA AllAharai| kintu tAdera adhikAMzai tA veAjhe nA|
ei pArthiva jIvana krIr3A-keৗtuka vai teA kichui naYa| parakAlera gRhai prakRta jIvana; yadi tArA jAnata|
tArA yakhana jalayAne AreAhaNa kare takhana ekaniSThabhAve AllAhake DAke| ataHpara tini yakhana sthale ene tAderake uddhAra karena, takhanai tArA zarIka karate thAke|
yAte tArA tAdera prati AmAra dAna asvIkAra kare evaM bheAga-vilAse Duve thAke| satvarai tArA jAnate pArave|

tArA ki dekhe nA ye, Ami ekaTi nirApada AzraYasthala karechi| athaca era catupArzve yArA Ache, tAdera upara AkramaNa karA haYa| tave ki tArA mithyAYai vizvAsa karave evaM AllAhara neYAmata asvIkAra karave?
ye AllAha samparke mithyA kathA gar3e athavA tAra kAche satya AsAra para tAke asvIkAra kare, tAra ki smaraNa rAkhA ucita naYa ye, jAhAnnAmai sesava kApherera AzraYasthala have?
yArA AmAra pathe sAdhanAYa AtmaniYeAga kare, Ami avazyai tAderake AmAra pathe paricAlita karava| nizcaYa AllAha satkarmaparAYaNadera sAthe Achena|
Alipha-lAma-mIma,
reAmakarA parAjita haYeche,
nikaTavartI elAkAYa evaM tArA tAdera parAjaYera para atisatvara vijaYI have,
kaYeka vacharera madhye| agra-pazcAtera kAja AllAhara hAtei| sedina muminagaNa Anandita have|
AllAhara sAhAyye| tini yAke icchA sAhAyya karena evaM tini parAkramazAlI, parama daYAlu|
AllAhara pratizruti haYe geche| AllAha tAra pratizruti khelApha karavena nA| kintu adhikAMza leAka jAne nA|
tArA pArthiva jIvanera vAhyika dika jAne evaM tArA parakAlera khavara rAkhe nA|

tArA ki tAdera mane bheve dekhe nA ye, AllAha nabheAmanDala, bhUmanDala o etadubhaYera madhyavartI savakichu sRSTi karechena yathAyatharUpe o nirdiSTa samaYera janya, kintu aneka mAnuSa tAdera pAlanakartAra sAkSAte avizvAsI|

tArA ki pRthivIte bhramaNa kare nA ataHpara dekhe nA ye; tAdera pUrvavartIdera pariNAma ki ki haYeche? tArA tAdera cAite zaktizAlI chila, tArA yamIna cASa karata evaM tAdera cAite vezI AvAda karata| tAdera kAche tAdera rasUlagaNa suspaSTa nirdeza niYe esechila| vastutaH AllAha tAdera prati julumakArI chilena nA| kintu tArA nijerAi nijedera prati juluma karechila|
ataHpara yArA manda karma karata, tAdera pariNAma haYeche manda| kAraNa, tArA AllAhara AYAtasamUhake mithyA valata evaM seguleA niYe ThATTA-vidrUpa karata|
AllAha prathamavAra sRSTi karena, ataHpara tini punarAYa sRSTi karavena| erapara teAmarA tA~rai dike pratyAvartita have|
ye dina keYAmata saMghaTita have, sedina aparAdhIrA hatAza haYe yAve|
tAdera devatA guleAra madhye keu tAdera supAriza karave nA| evaM tArA tAdera devatAke asvIkAra karave|
yedina keYAmata saMghaTita have, sedina mAnuSa vibhakta haYe par3ave|
yArA vizvAsa sthApana kareche o satkarma kareche, tArA jAnnAte samAdRta have;
Ara yArA kAphera evaM AmAra AYAtasamUha o parakAlera sAkSAtakArake mithyA valache, tAderakei AyAvera madhye upasthita karA have|
ataeva, teAmarA AllAhara pavitratA smaraNa kara sandhyAYa o sakAle,
evaM aparAhne o madhyAhne, nabheAmanDala o bhUmanDale, tA~rai prasaMsA|
tini mRta theke jIvitake vahirgata karena jIvita theke mRtake vahirgata karena, evaM bhUmira mRtyura para tAke punarujjIvita karena| ebhAve teAmarA utthita have|
tA~ra nidarzanAvalIra madhye eka nidarzana ei ye, tini mRttikA theke teAmAdera sRSTi karechena| ekhana teAmarA mAnuSa, pRthivIte char3iYe Acha|

Ara eka nidarzana ei ye, tini teAmAdera janye teAmAdera madhya theke teAmAdera saMginIdera sRSTi karechena, yAte teAmarA tAdera kAche zAntite thAka evaM tini teAmAdera madhye pArasparika samprIti o daYA sRSTi karechena| nizcaYa ete cintAzIla leAkadera janye nidarzanAvalI raYeche|
tA~ra Ara o eka nidarzana hacche nabheAmanDala o bhUmanDalera sRjana evaM teAmAdera bhASA o varNera vaicitra| nizcaYa ete jJAnIdera janye nidarzanAvalI raYeche|
tA~ra Arao nidarzanaH rAte o dine teAmAdera nidrA evaM tA~ra kRpA anveSaNa| nizcaYa ete maneAyeAgI sampradAYera janye nidarzanAvalI raYeche|

tA~ra Arao nidarzanaH tini teAmAderake dekhAna vidyut, bhaYa o bharasAra janye evaM AkAza theke pAni varSaNa karena, ataHpara taddvArA bhUmira mRtyura para tAke punarujjIvita karena| nizcaYa ete vuddhimAna leAkadera janye nidarzanAvalI raYeche|
tA~ra anyatama nidarzana ei ye, tA~rai Adeze AkAza o pRthivI pratiSThita Ache| ataHpara yakhana tini mRttikA theke uThAra janye teAmAdera DAka devena, takhana teAmarA uThe Asave|
nabheAmanDale o bhumanDale yA kichu Ache, sava tA~rai| savAi tA~ra AjJAvaha|
tinii prathamavAra sRSTike astitve AnaYana karena, ataHpara tini sRSTi karavena| eTA tA~ra janye sahaja| AkAza o pRthivIte sarveAcca maryAdA tA~rai evaM tinii parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|

AllAha teAmAdera janye teAmAderai madhya theke ekaTi dRSTAnta varNanA karechenaH teAmAdera Ami ye ruyI diYechi, teAmAdera adhikArabhukta dAsa-dAsIrA ki tAte teAmAdera samAna samAna aMzIdAra? teAmarA ki tAderake serUpa bhaYa kara, yerUpa nijedera leAkake bhaYa kara? emanibhAve Ami samajhadAra sampradAYera janye nidarzanAvalI vistArita varNanA kari|
varaM yArA ye-inasApha, tArA ajJAnatAvazataH tAdera kheYAla-khUzIra anusaraNa kare thAke| ataeva, AllAha yAke pathabhraSTa karena, tAke ke veAjhAve? tAdera keAna sAhAyyakArI nei|

tumi ekaniSTha bhAve nijeke dharmera upara pratiSThita rAkha| eTAi AllAhara prakRti, yAra upara tini mAnava sRSTi karechena| AllAhara sRSTira keAna parivartana nei| eTAi sarala dharma| kintu adhikAMza mAnuSa jAne nA|
savAi tA~ra abhimukhI hao evaM bhaYa kara, nAmAya kAYema kara evaM muzarikadera antarbhukta haYeA nA|
yArA tAdera dharme vibheda sRSTi kareche evaM aneka dale vibhakta haYe par3eche| pratyeka dalai nija nija matavAda niYe ullasita|

mAnuSake yakhana duHkha-kaSTa sparza kare, takhana tArA tAdera pAlanakartAke AhavAna kare tA~rai abhimukhI haYe| ataHpara tini yakhana tAderake rahamatera svAda AsvAdana karAna, takhana tAdera ekadala tAdera pAlanakartAra sAthe ziraka karate thAke,
yAte tArA asvIkAra kare yA Ami tAderake diYechi| ataeva, majA luTe nAo, satvarai jAnate pArave|
Ami ki tAdera kAche emana keAna dalIla nAyila karechi, ye tAderake AmAra zarIka karate vale?
Ara yakhana Ami mAnuSake rahamatera svAda AsvAdana karAi, tArA tAte Anandita haYa evaM tAdera kRtakarmera phale yadi tAderake keAna dudarzA pAYa, tave tArA hatAza haYe par3e|
tArA ki dekhe nA ye, AllAha yAra janye icchA riyika vardhita karena evaM hrAsa karena| nizcaYa ete vizvAsI sampradAYera janye nidarzanAvalI raYeche|
AtnIYa-svajanake tAdera prApya dina evaM misakIna o musAphiraderao| eTA tAdera janye uttama, yArA AllAhara santuSTi kAmanA kare| tArAi saphalakAma|

mAnuSera dhana-sampade teAmAdera dhana-sampada vRddhi pAve, ei AzAYa teAmarA sude yA kichu dAo, AllAhara kAche tA vRddhi pAYa nA| pakSAntare, AllAhara santuSTi lAbhera AzAYa pavitra antare yArA diYe thAke, ataeva, tArAi dviguNa lAbha kare|

AllAhai teAmAdera sRSTi karechena, ataHpara riyika diYechena, erapara teAmAdera mRtyu devena, erapara teAmAdera jIvita karavena| teAmAdera zarIkadera madhye emana keu Ache ki, ye esava kAjera madhye keAna ekaTio karate pArave? tArA yAke zarIka kare, AllAha tA theke pavitra o mahAna|
sthale o jale mAnuSera kRtakarmera daruna viparyaYa char3iYe par3eche| AllAha tAderake tAdera karmera zAsti AsvAdana karAte cAna, yAte tArA phire Ase|
valuna, teAmarA pRthivIte paribhramaNa kara evaM dekha teAmAdera purvavartIdera pariNAma ki haYeche| tAdera adhikAMzai chila muzarika|
ye divasa AllAhara pakSa theke pratyAhUta havAra naYa, sei divasera pUrve Apani sarala dharme nijeke pratiSThita karuna| sedina mAnuSa vibhakta haYe par3ave|
ye kupharI kare, tAra kupharera janye se-i dAYI evaM ye satkarma kare, tArA nijedera pathai zudhare nicche|
yArA vizvAsa kareche o satkarma kareche yAte, AllAha tA’AlA tAderake nija anugrahe pratidAna dena| nizcaYa tini kApheradera bhAlavAsena nA|

tA~ra nidarzanasamUhera madhye ekaTi ei ye, tini susaMvAdavAhI vAYu preraNa karena, yAte tini tA~ra anugraha teAmAdera AsvAdana karAna evaM yAte tA~ra nirdeze jAhAjasamUha vicaraNa kare evaM yAte teAmarA tA~ra anugraha tAlAza kara evaM tA~ra prati kRtajJa hao|

ApanAra pUrve Ami rasUlagaNake tA~dera nija nija sampradAYera kAche preraNa karechi| tA~rA tAdera kAche suspaSTa nidarzanAvalI niYe Agamana karena| ataHpara yArA pApI chila, tAdera Ami zAsti diYechi| muminadera sAhAyya karA AmAra dAYitva|

tini AllAha, yini vAYu preraNa karena, ataHpara tA meghamAlAke saJcArita kare| ataHpara tini meghamAlAke yebhAve icchA AkAze char3iYe dena evaM tAke stare stare rAkhena| erapara tumi dekhate pAo tAra madhya theke nirgata haYa vRSTidhArA| tini tA~ra vAndAdera madhye yAderake icchA pau~chAna; takhana tArA Anandita haYa|
tArA prathama thekei tAdera prati ei vRSTi varSita haoYAra pUrve nirAza chila|
ataeva, AllAhara rahamatera phala dekhe nAo, kibhAve tini mRttikAra mRtyura para tAke jIvita karena| nizcaYa tini mRtaderake jIvita karavena evaM tini sava kichura upara sarvazaktimAna|
Ami yadi emana vAYu preraNa kari yAra phale tArA zasyake halade haYe yete dekhe, takhana teA tArA avazyai akRtajJa haYe yAYa|
ataeva, Apani mRtaderake zeAnAte pAravena nA evaM vadhirakeo AhavAna zeAnAte pAravena nA, yakhana tArA pRSTha pradarzana kare|
Apani andhaderao tAdera pathabhraSTatA theke patha dekhAte pAravena nA| Apani kevala tAderai zeAnAte pAravena, yArA AmAra AYAtasamUhe vizvAsa kare| kArana tArA musalamAna|

AllAha tini dUrvala avasthAYa teAmAdera sRSTi karena ataHpara dUrvalatAra para zaktidAna karena, ataHpara zaktira para dena durvalatA o vArdhakya| tini yA icchA sRSTi karena evaM tini sarvajJa, sarvazaktimAna|
yedina keYAmata saMghaTita have, sedina aparAdhIrA kasama kheYe valave ye, eka muhurterao vezI avasthAna karini| emanibhAve tArA satyavimukha hata|
yAdera jJAna o ImAna deYA haYeche, tArA valave AmarA AllAhara kitAva mate punarutthAna divasa paryanta avasthAna karechi| eTAi punarutthAna divasa, kintu teAmarA tA jAnate nA|
sedina jAlemadera oyara-Apatti tAdera keAna upakAre Asave nA evaM taovA kare AllAhara santuSTi lAbhera suyeAgao tAdera deYA have nA|
Ami ei keAraAne mAnuSera janya sarvaprakAra dRSTAnta varNanA karechi| Apani yadi tAdera kAche keAna nidarzana upasthita karena, tave kApherarA avazyai valave, teAmarA savAi mithyApanthI|
emanibhAve AllAha jJAnahInadera hRdaYa meAharAGkita kare dena|
ataeva, Apani savara karuna| AllAhara oYAdA satya| yArA vizvAsI naYa, tArA yena ApanAke vicalita karate nA pAre|
Alipha-lAma-mIma|
eguleA prajJAmaYa kitAvera AYAta|
hedAYeta o rahamata satkarmaparAYaNadera janya|
yArA sAlAta kAYema kare, yAkAta deYa evaM AkherAta samparke dRr3ha vizvAsa rAkhe|
esava leAkai tAdera paraoYAradegArera tarapha theke Agata hedAYetera upara pratiSThita evaM erAi saphalakAma|

ekazreNIra leAka Ache yArA mAnuSake AllAhara patha theke geAmarAha karAra uddeze avAntara kathAvArtA saMgraha kare andhabhAve evaM uhAke niYe ThATTA-vidrUpa kare| edera janya raYeche avamAnanAkara zAsti|

yakhana odera sAmane AmAra AYatasamUha pATha karA haYa, takhana orA dambhera sAthe emanabhAve mukha phiriYe neYa, yena orA tA zunatei pAYani athavA yena odera du’kAna vadhira| sutarAM oderake kaSTadAYaka AyAvera saMvAda dAo|
yArA ImAna Ane Ara satkAja kare tAdera janya raYeche neYAmate bharA jAnnAta|
sekhAne tArA cirakAla thAkave| AllAhara oYAdA yathArtha| tini parAkramazAlI o prajJAmaYa|

tini khu~Ti vyatIta AkAzamanDalI sRSTi karechena; teAmarA tA dekhacha| tini pRthivIte sthApana karechena parvatamAlA, yAte pRthivI teAmAderake niYe Dhale nA par3e evaM ete char3iYe diYechena sarvaprakAra jantu| Ami AkAza theke pAni varSaNa karechi, ataHpara tAte udagata karechi sarvaprakAra kalyANakara udbhidarAji|
eTA AllAhara sRSTi; ataHpara tini vyatIta anyerA yA sRSTi kareche, tA AmAke dekhAo| varaM jAlemarA suspaSTa pathabhraSTatAYa patita Ache|
Ami leAkamAnake prajJA dAna karechi ei marme ye, AllAhara prati kRtajJa hao| ye kRtajJa haYa, se teA kevala nija kalyAnera janyai kRtajJa haYa| Ara ye akRtajJa haYa, AllAha abhAvamukta, prazaMsita|
yakhana leAkamAna upadezacchale tAra putrake valalaH he vatsa, AllAhara sAthe zarIka kareA nA| nizcaYa AllAhara sAthe zarIka karA mahA anyAYa|

Ara Ami mAnuSake tAra pitA-mAtAra sAthe sadvyavahArera jeAra nirdeza diYechi| tAra mAtA tAke kaSTera para kaSTa kare garbhe dhAraNa kareche| tAra dudha chAr3AneA du vachare haYa| nirdeza diYechi ye, AmAra prati o teAmAra pitA-matAra prati kRtajJa hao| avazeSe AmArai nikaTa phire Asate have|

pitA-mAtA yadi teAmAke AmAra sAthe emana viSaYake zarIka sthira karate pIr3ApIr3i kare, yAra jJAna teAmAra nei; tave tumi tAdera kathA mAnave nA evaM duniYAte tAdera sAthe sadbhAve sahaavasthAna karave| ye AmAra abhimukhI haYa, tAra patha anusaraNa karave| ataHpara teAmAdera pratyAvartana AmArai dike evaM teAmarA yA karate, Ami se viSaYe teAmAderake jJAta karaveA|

he vatsa, keAna vastu yadi sariSAra dAnA parimANao haYa ataHpara tA yadi thAke prastara garbhe athavA AkAze athavA bhU-garbhe, tave AllAha tAo upasthita karavena| nizcaYa AllAha geApana bheda jAnena, savakichura khavara rAkhena|
he vatsa, nAmAya kAYema kara, satkAje Adeza dAo, mandakAje niSedha kara evaM vipadApade savara kara| nizcaYa eTA sAhasikatAra kAja|
ahaMkAravaze tumi mAnuSake avajJA kareA nA evaM pRthivIte garvabhare padacAraNa kareA nA| nizcaYa AllAha keAna dAmbhika ahaMkArIke pachanda karena nA|
padacAraNAYa madhyavartitA avalamvana kara evaM kanThasvara nIcu kara| niHsandehe gAdhAra svarai sarvApekSA aprItikara|

teAmarA ki dekha nA AllAha nabheAmanDala o bhU-manDale yAkichu Ache, savai teAmAdera kAje niYeAjita kare diYechena evaM teAmAdera prati tA~ra prakAzya o aprakAzya neYAmatasamUha paripUrna kare diYechena? emana leAka o Ache; yArA jJAna, pathanirdeza o ujjala kitAva chAr3Ai AllAha samparke vAkavitanDA kare|

tAderake yakhana valA haYa, AllAha yA nAyila karechena, teAmarA tAra anusaraNa kara, takhana tArA vale, varaM AmarA AmAdera pUrvapuruSaderake ye viSaYera upara peYechi, tArai anusaraNa karava| zaYatAna yadi tAderake jAhAnnAmera zAstira dike dAoYAta deYa, tavuo ki?
ye vyakti satkarmaparAYaNa haYe svIYa mukhamanDalake AllAha abhimUkhI kare, se eka majavuta hAtala dhAraNa kare, sakala karmera pariNAma AllAhara dike|

ye vyakti kupharI kare tAra kupharI yena ApanAke cintita nA kare| AmArai dike tAdera pratyAvartana, ataHpara Ami tAdera karma samparke tAderake avahita karava| antare yA kichu raYeche, se samparke AllAha savizeSa parijJAta|
Ami tAderake svalpakAlera janye bheAgavilAsa karate deva, ataHpara tAderake vAdhya karava gurutara zAsti bheAga karate|
Apani yadi tAderake jijJesa karena, nabheAmanDala o bhU-manDala ke sRSTi kareche? tArA avazyai valave, AllAha| valuna, sakala prazaMsAi AllAhara| varaM tAdera adhikAMzai jJAna rAkhe nA|
nabheAmanDala o bhU-manDale yA kichu raYeche savai AllAhara| AllAha abhAvamukta, prazaMsita|
pRthivIte yata vRkSa Ache, savai yadi kalama haYa evaM samudrera sAtheo sAta samudra yukta haYe kAli haYa, tavuo tA~ra vAkyAvalI likhe zeSa karA yAve nA| nizcaYa AllAha parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|
teAmAdera sRSTi o punarutthAna ekaTi mAtra prANIra sRSTi o punarutthAnera samAna vai naYa| nizcaYa AllAha sava kichu zeAnena, savakichu dekhena|

tumi ki dekha nA ye, AllAha rAtrike divase praviSTa karena evaM divasake rAtrite praviSTa karena? tini candra o sUryake kAje niYeAjita karechena| pratyekei nirdiSTakAla paryanta paribhramaNa kare| tumi ki Arao dekha nA ye, teAmarA yA kara, AllAha tAra khavara rAkhena?
eTAi pramANa ye, AllAha-i satya evaM AllAha vyatIta tArA yAdera pUjA kare sava mithyA| AllAha sarveAcca, mahAna|

tumi ki dekha nA ye, AllAhara anugrahe jAhAja samudre calAcala kare, yAte tini teAmAderake tA~ra nidarzanAvalI pradarzana karena? nizcaYa ete pratyeka sahanazIla, kRtajJa vyaktira janye nidarzana raYeche|

yakhana tAderake meghamAlA sadRza taraMga AcchAdita kare neYa, takhana tArA khA~Ti mane AllAhake DAkate thAke| ataHpara tini yakhana tAderake sthalabhAgera dike uddhAra kare Anena, takhana tAdera keu keu sarala pathe cale| kevala mithyAcArI, akRtajJa vyaktii AmAra nidarzanAvalI asvIkAra kare|

he mAnava jAti! teAmarA teAmAdera pAlanakartAke bhaYa kara evaM bhaYa kara emana eka divasake, yakhana pitA putrera keAna kAje Asave nA evaM putrao tAra pitAra keAna upakAra karate pArave nA| niHsandehe AllAhara oYAdA satya| ataeva, pArthiva jIvana yena teAmAderake dheA~kA nA deYa evaM AllAha samparke pratAraka zaYatAnao yena teAmAderake pratArita nA kare|

nizcaYa AllAhara kAchei keYAmatera jJAna raYeche| tinii vRSTi varSaNa karena evaM garbhAzaYe yA thAke, tini tA jAnena| keu jAne nA AgAmIkalya se ki upArjana karave evaM keu jAne nA keAna deze se mRtyuvaraNa karave| AllAha sarvajJa, sarvaviSaYe samyaka jJAta|
Alipha-lAma-mIma|
e kitAvera avataraNa vizvapAlanakartAra nikaTa theke ete keAna sandeha nei|

tArA ki vale, eTA se mithyA racanA kareche? varaM eTA ApanAra pAlanakartAra tarapha theke satya, yAte Apani emana eka sampradAYake satarka karena, yAdera kAche ApanAra pUrve keAna satarkakArI Aseni| sambhavataH erA supatha prApta have|

AllAha yini nabheAmanDala, bhumanDala o etadubhaYera madhyavartI savakichu chaYa dine sRSTi karechena, ataHpara tini Araze virAjamAna haYechena| tini vyatIta teAmAdera keAna abhibhAvaka o supArizakArI nei| eraparao ki teAmarA vujhave nA?
tini AkAza theke pRthivI paryanta samasta karma paricAlanA karena, ataHpara tA tA~ra kAche peৗchave emana eka dine, yAra parimANa teAmAdera gaNanAYa hAjAra vacharera samAna|
tinii dRzya o adRzyera jJAnI, parAkramazAlI, parama daYAlu,
yini tA~ra pratyekaTi sRSTike sundara karechena evaM kAdAmATi theke mAnava sRSTira sUcanA karechena|
ataHpara tini tAra vaMzadhara sRSTi karena tuccha pAnira niryAsa theke|
ataHpara tini tAke suSama karena, tAte rUha saJcAra karena evaM teAmAderake dena karNa, cakSu o antaHkaraNa| teAmarA sAmAnyai kRtajJatA prakAza kara|
tArA vale, AmarA mRttikAYa mizrita haYe geleo punarAYa natuna kare sRjita hava ki? varaM tArA tAdera pAlanakartAra sAkSAtake asvIkAra kare|
valuna, teAmAdera prANa haraNera dAYitve niYeAjita pherezatA teAmAdera prANa haraNa karave| ataHpara teAmarA teAmAdera pAlanakartAra kAche pratyAvartita have|

yadi Apani dekhatena yakhana aparAdhIrA tAdera pAlanakartAra sAmane natazira haYe valave, he AmAdera pAlanakartA, AmarA dekhalAma o zravaNa karalAma| ekhana AmAderake pAThiYe dina, AmarA satkarma karava| AmarA dRr3havizvAsI haYe gechi|
Ami icchA karale pratyekake saThika dika nirdeza ditAma; kintu AmAra e ukti avadhArita satya ye, Ami jina o mAnava sakalake diYe avazyai jAhAnnAma pUrNa karava|
ataeva e divasake bhUle yAoYAra kAraNe teAmarA majA AsvAdana kara| Amio teAmAderake bhule gelAma| teAmarA teAmAdera kRtakarmera kAraNe sthAYI AyAva bheAga kara|
kevala tArAi AmAra AYAtasamUhera prati ImAna Ane, yArA AYAtasamUha dvArA upadezaprApta haYe sejadAYa luTiYe par3e evaM ahaMkAramukta haYe tAdera pAlanakartAra saprazaMsa pavitratA varNanA kare|
tAdera pArzva zayyA theke AlAdA thAke| tArA tAdera pAlanakartAke DAke bhaYe o AzAYa evaM Ami tAderake ye riyika diYechi, tA theke vyaYa kare|
keu jAne nA tAra janye kRtakarmera ki ki naYana-prItikara pratidAna lukkAYita Ache|
ImAnadAra vyakti ki avAdhyera anurUpa? tArA samAna naYa|
yArA ImAna Ane o satkarma kare, tAdera janye raYeche tAdera kRtakarmera ApyAYanasvarUpa vasavAsera jAnnAta|

pakSAntare yArA avAdhya haYa, tAdera ThikAnA jAhAnnAma| yakhanai tArA jAhAnnAma theke vera hate cAive, takhanai tAderake tathAYa phiriYe deYA have evaM tAderake valA have, teAmarA jAhAnnAmera ye AyAvake mithyA valate, tAra svAda AsvAdana kara|
guru zAstira pUrve Ami avazyai tAderake laghu zAsti AsvAdana karAva, yAte tArA pratyAvartana kare|
ye vyaktike tAra pAlanakartAra AYAtasamUha dvArA upadeza dAna karA haYa, ataHpara se tA theke mukha phiriYe neYa, tAra ceYe yAlema Ara ke? Ami aparAdhIderake zAsti deva|
Ami mUsAke kitAva diYechi, ataeva Apani keAraAna prAptira viSaYe keAna sandeha karavena nA| Ami eke vanI isarAIlera janye patha pradarzaka karechilAma|
tArA savara karata vidhAYa Ami tAdera madhya theke netA maneAnIta karechilAma, yArA AmAra Adeze patha pradarzana karata| tArA AmAra AYAtasamUhe dRr3ha vizvAsI chila|
tArA ye viSaYe mata vireAdha karache, ApanAra pAlanakartAi keYAmatera dina se viSaYe tAdera madhye phaYasAlA devena|
ete ki tAdera ceAkha kheAleni ye, Ami tAdera pUrve aneka sampradAYake dhvaMsa karechi, yAdera vAr3I-ghare erA vicaraNa kare| avazyai ete nidarzanAvalI raYeche| tArA ki zeAne nA?
tArA ki lakSya kare nA ye, Ami uSara bhUmite pAni pravAhita kare zasya udagata kari, yA theke bhakSaNa kare tAdera janturA evaM tArA ki dekhe nA?
tArA vale teAmarA satyavAdI hale vala; kave have ei phaYasAlA?
valuna, phaYasAlAra dine kApheradera ImAna tAdera keAna kAje Asave nA evaM tAderake avakAza o deYA have nA|
ataeva Apani tAdera theke mukha phiriYe nina evaM apekSA karuna, tArAo apekSA karache|
he navI! AllAhake bhaYa karuna evaM kAphera o kapaTa vizvAsIdera kathA mAnavena nA| nizcaYa AllAha sarvajJa, prajJAmaYa|
ApanAra pAlanakartAra pakSa theke yA avatIrNa haYa, Apani tAra anusaraNa karuna| nizcaYa teAmarA yA kara, AllAha se viSaYe khavara rAkhena|
Apani AllAhara upara bharasA karuna| kAryanirvAhIrUpe AllAhai yatheSTa|

AllAha keAna mAnuSera madhye duTi hRdaYa sthApana karenani| teAmAdera strIgaNa yAdera sAthe teAmarA yihAra kara, tAderake teAmAdera jananI karenani evaM teAmAdera peASyaputraderake teAmAdera putra karenani| eguleA teAmAdera mukhera kathA mAtra| AllAha nyAYa kathA valena evaM patha pradarzana karena|

teAmarA tAderake tAdera pitRparicaYe DAka| eTAi AllAhara kAche nyAYasaGgata| yadi teAmarA tAdera pitR-paricaYa nA jAna, tave tArA teAmAdera dharmIYa bhAi o vandhurUpe gaNya have| e vyApAre teAmAdera keAna vicyuti hale tAte teAmAdera keAna geAnAha nei, tave icchAkRta hale bhinna kathA| AllAha kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

navI muminadera nikaTa tAdera nijedera apekSA adhika ghaniSTha evaM tA~ra strIgaNa tAdera mAtA| AllAhara vidhAna anuyAYI mumina o muhAjiragaNera madhye yArA AtnIYa, tArA paraspare adhika ghaniSTha| tave teAmarA yadi teAmAdera vandhudera prati daYA-dAkSiNya karate cAo, karate pAra| eTA laohe-mAhaphuye likhita Ache|
yakhana Ami paYagamvaragaNera kAcha theke, ApanAra kAcha theke evaM nUha, ivrAhIma, mUsA o mariYama tanaYa IsAra kAcha theke aGgIkAra nilAma evaM aGgIkAra nilAma tAdera kAcha theke dRr3ha aGgIkAra|
satyavAdIderake tAdera satyavAditA samparke jijJAsA karAra janya| tini kApheradera janya yantraNAdAYaka zAsti prastuta rekhechena|

he muminagaNa! teAmarA teAmAdera prati AllAhara neYAmatera kathA smaraNa kara, yakhana zatruvAhinI teAmAdera nikaTavartI haYechila, ataHpara Ami tAdera viruddhe jhaJcAvAYu evaM emana sainyavAhinI preraNa karechilAma, yAderake teAmarA dekhate nA| teAmarA yA kara, AllAha tA dekhena|

yakhana tArA teAmAdera nikaTavartI haYechila ucca bhUmi o nimnabhUmi theke evaM yakhana teAmAdera dRSTibhrama hacchila, prANa kanThAgata haYechila evaM teAmarA AllAha samparke nAnA virUpa dhAraNA peASaNa karate zuru karachile|
se samaYe muminagaNa parIkSita haYechila evaM bhISaNabhAve prakampita hacchila|
evaM yakhana munAphika o yAdera antare reAga chila tArA valachila, AmAderake pradatta AllAha o rasUlera pratizruti pratAraNA vai naYa|

evaM yakhana tAdera ekadala valechila, he iYAsarevavAsI, eTA TikavAra mata jAYagA naYa, teAmarA phire cala| tAderai ekadala navIra kAche anumati prArthanA kare valechila, AmAdera vAr3I-ghara khAli, athaca seguleA khAli chila nA, palAYana karAi chila tAdera icchA|
yadi zatrupakSa caturdika theke nagare praveza kare tAdera sAthe milita hata, ataHpara vidreAha karate prareAcita karata, tave tArA avazyai vidreAha karata evaM tArA meATei vilamva karata nA|
athaca tArA pUrve AllAhara sAthe aGgIkAra karechila ye, tArA pRSTha pradarzana karave nA| AllAhara aGgIkAra samparke jijJAsA karA have|
valuna! teAmarA yadi mRtyu athavA hatyA theke palAYana kara, tave e palAYana teAmAdera kAje Asave nA| takhana teAmAderake sAmAnyai bheAga karate deYA have|

valuna! ke teAmAderake AllAha theke rakSA karave yadi tini teAmAdera amaGgala icchA karena athavA teAmAdera prati anukampAra icchA? tArA AllAha vyatIta nijedera keAna abhibhAvaka o sAhAyyadAtA pAve nA|
AllAha khuva jAnena teAmAdera madhye kArA teAmAderake vAdhA deYa evaM kArA tAdera bhAiderake vale, AmAdera kAche esa| tArA kamai yuddha kare|

tArA teAmAdera prati kunThAveAdha kare| yakhana vipada Ase, takhana Apani dekhavena mRtyubhaYe acetana vyaktira mata ceAkha ulTiYe tArA ApanAra prati tAkAYa| ataHpara yakhana vipada Tale yAYa takhana tArA dhana-sampada lAbhera AzAYa teAmAdera sAthe vAkacAturIte avatIrNa haYa| tArA mumina naYa| tAi AllAha tAdera karmasamUha nisphala kare diYechena| eTA AllAhara janye sahaja|

tArA mane kare zakravAhinI cale yAYani| yadi zakravAhinI AvAra ese par3e, tave tArA kAmanA karave ye, yadi tArA grAmavAsIdera madhya theke teAmAdera saMvAdAdi jene nita, tavei bhAla hata| tArA teAmAdera madhye avasthAna karaleo yuddha sAmAnyai karata|
yArA AllAha o zeSa divasera AzA rAkhe evaM AllAhake adhika smaraNa kare, tAdera janye rasUlullAhara madhye uttama namunA raYeche|

yakhana muminarA zakravAhinIke dekhala, takhana valala, AllAha o tA~ra rasUla erai oYAdA AmAderake diYechilena evaM AllAha o tA~ra rasUla satya valechena| ete tAdera ImAna o AtnasamarpaNai vRddhi pela|
muminadera madhye kataka AllAhara sAthe kRta oYAdA pUrNa kareche| tAdera keu keu mRtyuvaraNa kareche evaM keu keu pratIkSA karache| tArA tAdera saMkalpa meATei parivartana kareni|
eTA ejanya yAte AllAha, satyavAdIderake tAdera satyavAditAra kAraNe pratidAna dena evaM icchA karale munAphekaderake zAsti dena athavA kSamA karena| nizcaYa AllAha kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|
AllAha kApheraderake kruddhAvasthAYa phiriYe dilena| tArA keAna kalyANa pAYani| yuddha karAra janya AllAha muminadera janye yatheSTa haYe gechena| AllAha zaktidhara, parAkramazAlI|

kitAvIdera madhye yArA kApheradera pRSTapeASakatA karechila, tAderake tini tAdera dUrga theke nAmiYe dilena evaM tAdera antare bhIti nikSepa karalena| phale teAmarA ekadalake hatyA karacha evaM ekadalake vandI karacha|
tini teAmAderake tAdera bhUmira, ghara-vAr3Ira, dhana-sampadera evaM emana eka bhU-khanDera mAlika kare diYechena, yekhAne teAmarA abhiyAna karani| AllAha sarvaviSaYeApari sarvazaktimAna|
he navI, ApanAra patnIgaNake valuna, teAmarA yadi pArthiva jIvana o tAra vilAsitA kAmanA kara, tave Asa, Ami teAmAdera bheAgera vyavasthA kare dei evaM uttama panthAYa teAmAdera vidAYa nei|
pakSAntare yadi teAmarA AllAha, tA~ra rasUla o parakAla kAmanA kara, tave teAmAdera satkarmaparAYaNadera janya AllAha mahA puraskAra prastuta kare rekhechena|
he navI patnIgaNa! teAmAdera madhye keu prakAzya azlIla kAja karale tAke dviguNa zAsti deYA have| eTA AllAhara janya sahaja|
teAmAdera madhye ye keu AllAha o tA~ra rasUlera anugata have evaM satkarma karave, Ami tAke duvAra puraskAra deva evaM tAra janya Ami sammAna janaka riyika prastuta rekhechi|

he navI patnIgaNa! teAmarA anya nArIdera mata nao; yadi teAmarA AllAhake bhaYa kara, tave parapuruSera sAthe keAmala o AkarSanIYa bhaGgite kathA valeA nA, phale sei vyakti kuvAsanA kare, yAra antare vyAdhi raYeche teAmarA saGgata kathAvArtA valave|

teAmarA gRhAbhyantare avasthAna karave-mUrkhatA yugera anurUpa nijederake pradarzana karave nA| nAmAya kAYema karave, yAkAta pradAna karave evaM AllAha o tA~ra rasUlera Anugatya karave| he navI parivArera sadasyavarga| AllAha kevala cAna teAmAdera theke apavitratA dUra karate evaM teAmAderake pUrNarUpe pUta-pavitra rAkhate|
AllAhara AYAta o jJAnagarbha kathA, yA teAmAdera gRhe paThita haYa teAmarA seguleA smaraNa karave| nizcaYa AllAha sUkSnadarzI, sarvaviSaYe khavara rAkhena|

nizcaYa musalamAna puruSa, musalamAna nArI, ImAnadAra puruSa, ImAnadAra nArI, anugata puruSa, anugata nArI, satyavAdI puruSa, satyavAdI nArI, dhairyyazIla puruSa, dhairyyazIla nArI, vinIta puruSa, vinIta nArI, dAnazIla puruSa, dAnazIla nArI, reAyA pAlaNakArI puruSa, reAyA pAlanakArI nArI, yeৗnAGga hephAyatakArI puruSa,, yeৗnAGga hephAyatakArI nArI, AllAhara adhika yikarakArI puruSa o yikarakArI nArI-tAdera janya AllAha prastuta rekhechena kSamA o mahApuraSkAra|

AllAha o tA~ra rasUla keAna kAjera Adeza karale keAna ImAnadAra puruSa o ImAnadAra nArIra se viSaYe bhinna kSamatA nei ye, AllAha o tA~ra rasUlera Adeza amAnya kare se prakAzya pathabhraSTa tAYa patita haYa|

AllAha yAke anugraha karechena; Apanio yAke anugraha karechena; tAke yakhana Apani valechilena, teAmAra strIke teAmAra kAchei thAkate dAo evaM AllAhake bhaYa kara| Apani antare emana viSaYa geApana karachilena, yA AllAha pAka prakAza kare devena Apani leAkanindAra bhaYa karechilena athaca AllAhakei adhika bhaYa karA ucita| ataHpara yAYeda yakhana yaYanavera sAthe samparka chinna karala, takhana Ami tAke ApanAra sAthe vivAhavandhane Avaddha karalAma yAte muminadera peASyaputrarA tAdera strIra sAthe samparka chinna karale sesava strIke vivAha karAra vyApAre muminadera keAna asuvidhA nA thAke| AllAhara nirdeza kArye pariNata haYei thAke|
AllAha navIra janye yA nirdhAraNa karena, tAte tA~ra keAna vAdhA nei pUrvavartI navIgaNera kSetre eTAi chila AllAhara cirAcarita vidhAna| AllAhara Adeza nirdhArita, avadhArita|
sei navIgaNa AllAhara paYagAma pracAra karatena o tA~ke bhaYa karatena| tArA AllAha vyatIta anyakAuke bhaYa karatena nA| hisAva grahaNera janye AllAha yatheSTha|
muhAmmada teAmAdera keAna vyaktira pitA nana; varaM tini AllAhara rAsUla evaM zeSa navI| AllAha sava viSaYe jJAta|
muminagaNa teAmarA AllAhake adhika parimANe smaraNa kara|
evaM sakAla vikAla AllAhara pavitratA varNanA kara|
tinii teAmAdera prati rahamata karena evaM tA~ra pherezatAgaNao rahamatera deAYA karena-andhakAra theke teAmAderake AleAke vera karAra janya| tini muminadera prati parama daYAlu|
yedina AllAhara sAthe milita have; sedina tAdera abhivAdana have sAlAma| tini tAdera janye sammAnajanaka puraskAra prastuta rekhechena|
he navI! Ami ApanAke sAkSI, susaMvAda dAtA o satarkakArIrUpe preraNa karechi|
evaM AllAhara Adezakrame tA~ra dike AhavAYakarUpe evaM ujjvala pradIparUpe|
Apani muminaderake susaMvAda dina ye, tAdera janya AllAhara pakSa theke virATa anugraha raYeche|
Apani kAphera o munAphikadera Anugatya karavena nA evaM tAdera utpIr3ana upekSA karuna o AllAhara upara bharasA karuna| AllAha kAryanivArhIrUpe yatheSTa|

muminagaNa! teAmarA yakhana mumina nArIderake vivAha kara, ataHpara tAderake sparza karAra pUrve tAlAka diYe dAo, takhana tAderake iddata pAlane vAdhya karAra adhikAra teAmAdera nAi| ataHpara teAmarA tAderake kichu deve evaM uttama panthAYa vidAYa deve|

he navI! ApanAra janya ApanAra strIgaNake hAlAla karechi, yAderake Apani meAharAnA pradAna karena| Ara dAsIderake hAlAla karechi, yAderake AllAha ApanAra karAYatva kare dena evaM vivAhera janya vaidha karechi ApanAra cAcAteA bhagni, phuphAteA bhagni, mAmAteA bhagni, khAlAteA bhagnike yArA ApanAra sAthe hijarata kareche| keAna mumina nArI yadi nijeke navIra kAche samarpana kare, navI tAke vivAha karate cAile seo hAlAla| eTA vizeSa kare ApanArai janya-anya muminadera janya naYa| ApanAra asuvidhA dUrIkaraNera uddeze| muminagaNera strI o dAsIdera vyApAre yA nirdhArita karechi AmAra jAnA Ache| AllAha kSamAzIla, daYAlu|

Apani tAdera madhye yAke icchA dUre rAkhate pArena evaM yAke icchA kAche rAkhate pArena| Apani yAke dUre rekhechena, tAke kAmanA karale tAte ApanAra keAna deASa nei| ete adhika sambhAvanA Ache ye, tAdera cakSu zItala thAkave; tArA duHkha pAve nA evaM Apani yA dena, tAte tArA sakalei santuSTa thAkave| teAmAdera antare yA Ache, AllAha jAnena| AllAha sarvajJa, sahanazIla|

erapara ApanAra janye keAna nArI hAlAla naYa evaM tAdera parivarte anya strI grahaNa karAo hAlAla naYa yadio tAdera rUpalAvaNya ApanAke mugdha kare, tave dAsIra vyApAra bhinna| AllAha sarva viSaYera upara sajAga najara rAkhena|

he muminagaNa! teAmAderake anumati deYA nA hale teAmarA khAoYAra janya AhArya randhanera apekSA nA kare navIra gRhe praveza kareA nA| tave teAmarA Ahuta hale praveza kareA, tave ataHpara khAoYA zeSe ApanA Apani cale yeYeA, kathAvArtAYa mazagula haYe yeYeA nA| nizcaYa eTA navIra janya kaSTadAYaka| tini teAmAdera kAche saMkeAca veAdha karena; kintu AllAha satyakathA valate saMkeAca karena nA| teAmarA tA~ra patnIgaNera kAche kichu cAile pardAra Ar3Ala theke cAive| eTA teAmAdera antarera janye evaM tA~dera antarera janye adhikatara pavitratAra kAraNa| AllAhara rAsUlake kaSTa deYA evaM tA~ra ophAtera para tA~ra patnIgaNake vivAha karA teAmAdera janya vaidha naYa| AllAhara kAche eTA gurutara aparAdha|
teAmarA kheAlAkhuli kichu vala athavA geApana rAkha, AllAha sarva viSaYe sarvajJa|

navI-patnIgaNera janye tA~dera pitA putra, bhrAtA, bhrAtusputra, bhagni putra, sahadharminI nArI evaM adhikAra bhukta dAsadAsIgaNera sAmane yAoYAra vyApAre geAnAha nei| navI-patnIgaNa, teAmarA AllAhake bhaYa kara| nizcaYa AllAha sarva viSaYa pratyakSa karena|
AllAha o tA~ra pherezatAgaNa navIra prati rahamata preraNa karena| he muminagaNa! teAmarA navIra janye rahamatera tare deAYA kara evaM tA~ra prati sAlAma preraNa kara|
yArA AllAha o tA~ra rasUlake kaSTa deYa, AllAha tAdera prati ihakAle o parakAle abhisampAta karena evaM tAdera janye prastuta rekhechena avamAnanAkara zAsti|
yArA vinA aparAdhe mumina puruSa o mumina nArIderake kaSTa deYa, tArA mithyA apavAda o prakAzya pApera veAjhA vahana kare|

he navI! Apani ApanAra patnIgaNake o kanyAgaNake evaM muminadera strIgaNake valuna, tArA yena tAdera cAdarera kiYadaMza nijedera upara Tene neYa| ete tAderake cenA sahaja have| phale tAderake utyakta karA have nA| AllAha kSamAzIla parama daYAlu|

munAphikarA evaM yAdera antare reAga Ache evaM madInAYa gujava raTanAkArIrA yadi virata nA haYa, tave Ami avazyai tAdera viruddhe ApanAke uttejita karava| ataHpara ei zahare ApanAra prativezI alpai thAkave|
abhizapta avasthAYa tAderake yekhAnei pAoYA yAve, dharA have evaM prANe vadha karA have|
yArA pUrve atIta haYe geche, tAdera vyApAre eTAi chila AllAhara rIti| Apani AllAhara rItite kakhanao parivartana pAvena nA|
leAkerA ApanAke keYAmata samparke jijJAsA kare| valuna, era jJAna AllAhara kAchei| Apani ki kare jAnavena ye sambhavataH keYAmata nikaTei|
nizcaYa AllAha kApheraderake abhisampAta karechena evaM tAdera janye jvalanta agni prastuta rekhechena|
tathAYa tArA anantakAla thAkave evaM keAna abhibhAvaka o sAhAyyakArI pAve nA|
yedina agnite tAdera mukhamanDala olaTa pAlaTa karA have; sedina tArA valave, hAYa| AmarA yadi AllAhara Anugatya karatAma o rasUlera Anugatya karatAma|
tArA Arao valave, he AmAdera pAlanakartA, AmarA AmAdera netA o var3adera kathA menechilAma, ataHpara tArA AmAdera pathabhraSTa karechila|
he AmAdera pAlanakartA! tAderake dviguNa zAsti dina evaM tAderake mahA abhisampAta karuna|
he muminagaNa! mUsAke yArA kaSTa diYeche, teAmarA tAdera mata haYeA nA| tArA yA valechila, AllAha tA theke tA~ke nirdeASa pramANa karechilena| tini AllAhara kAche chilena maryAdAvAna|
he muminagaNa! AllAhake bhaYa kara evaM saThika kathA vala|
tini teAmAdera Amala-AcaraNa saMzeAdhana karavena evaM teAmAdera pApasamUha kSamA karavena| ye keu AllAha o tA~ra rasUlera Anugatya kare, se avazyai mahA sAphalya arjana karave|
Ami AkAza pRthivI o parvatamAlAra sAmane ei AmAnata peza karechilAma, ataHpara tArA eke vahana karate asvIkAra karala evaM ete bhIta hala; kintu mAnuSa tA vahaNa karala| nizcaYa se jAlema-ajJa|
yAte AllAha munAphika puruSa, munAphika nArI, muzarika puruSa, muzarika nArIderake zAsti dena evaM mumina puruSa o mumina nArIderake kSamA karena| AllAha kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|
samasta prazaMsA AllAhara, yini nabheAmanDale yA Ache evaM bhUmanDale yA Ache sava kichura mAlika evaM tA~rai prazaMsA parakAle| tini prajJAmaYa, sarvajJa|
tini jAnena yA bhUgarbhe praveza kare, yA sekhAna theke nirgata haYa, yA AkAza theke varSita haYa evaM yA AkAze utthita haYa| tini parama daYAlu kSamAzIla|

kApherarA vale AmAdera upara keYAmata Asave nA| valuna kena Asave nA? AmAra pAlanakartAra zapatha-avazyai Asave| tini adRzya samparke jJAta| nabheAmanDale o bhU-manDale tA~ra AgeAcare naYa aNu parimANa kichu, nA tadapekSA kSudra evaM nA vRhat-samastai Ache suspaSTa kitAve|
tini pariNAme yArA mumina o satkarma parAYaNa, tAderake pratidAna devena| tAdera janya raYeche kSamA o sammAna janaka riyika|
Ara yArA AmAra AYAta samUhake vyartha karAra janya uThe par3e lege yAYa, tAdera janye raYeche yantranAdAYaka zAsti|
yArA jJAnaprApta, tArA ApanAra pAlanakartAra nikaTa theke avartIrNa keAraAnake satya jJAna kare evaM eTA mAnuSake parAkramazAlI, prazaMsArha AllAhara patha pradarzana kare|
kApherarA vale, AmarA ki teAmAderake emana vyaktira sandhAna deva, ye teAmAderake khavara deYa ye; teAmarA sampurNa chinna-vicchinna haYe geleo teAmarA natuna sRjita have|
se AllAha samparke mithyA vale, nA haYa se ummAda evaM yArA parakAle avizvAsI, tArA AyAve o gheAra pathabhraSTatAYa patita Ache|

tArA ki tAdera sAmanera o pazcAtera AkAza o pRthivIra pratilakSya kare nA? Ami icchA karale tAdera saha bhUmi dhasiYe deva athavA AkAzera keAna khanDa tAdera upara patita karava| AllAha abhimukhI pratyeka vAndAra janya ete avazyai nidarzana raYeche|

Ami dAudera prati anugraha karechilAma ei Adeza marme ye, he parvatamAlA, teAmarA dAudera sAthe AmAra pavitratA gheASaNA kara evaM he pakSI sakala, teAmarAo| Ami tA~ra janya leৗhake narama kare chilAma|
evaM tAke Ami vale chilAma, prazasta varma tairI kara, kar3AsamUha yathAyathabhAve saMyukta kara evaM satkarma sampAdana kara| teAmarA yA kichu kara, Ami tA dekhi|

Ara Ami seAlAYamAnera adhIna karechilAma vAYuke, yA sakAle eka mAsera patha evaM vikAle eka mAsera patha atikrama karata| Ami tAra janye galita tAmAra eka jharaNA pravAhita karechilAma| kataka jina tAra sAmane kAja karata tAra pAlanakartAra Adeze| tAdera ye keu AmAra Adeza amAnya karave, Ami jvalanta agnira-zAsti AsvAdana karAva|

tArA seAlAYamAnera icchAnuyAYI durga, bhAskarya, hAuyasadRza vRhadAkAra pAtra evaM cullira upara sthApita vizAla Dega nirmANa karata| he dAuda parivAra! kRtajJatA sahakAre teAmarA kAja kare yAo| AmAra vAndAdera madhye alpasaMkhyakai kRtajJa|

yakhana Ami seAlAYamAnera mRtyu ghaTAlAma, takhana ghuNa peAkAi jinaderake tA~ra mRtyu samparke avahita karala| seAlAYamAnera lAThi kheYe yAcchila| yakhana tini mATite par3e gelena, takhana jinerA vujhate pArala ye, adRzya viSaYera jJAna thAkale tArA ei lAJchanApUrNa zAstite Avaddha thAkateA nA|

sAvAra adhivAsIdera janye tAdera vAsabhUmite chila eka nidarzana-duTi udyAna, ekaTi DAnadike, ekaTi vAmadike| teAmarA teAmAdera pAlanakartAra riyika khAo evaM tA~ra prati kRtajJatA prakAza kara| svAsthyakara zahara evaM kSamAzIla pAlanakartA|

ataHpara tArA avAdhyatA karala phale Ami tAdera upara preraNa karalAma pravala vanyA! Ara tAdera udyAnadvaYake parivartana kare dilAma emana dui udyAne, yAte udagata haYa visvAda phalamUla, jhAu gAcha evaM sAmAnya kulavRkSa|
eTA chila kupharera kAraNe tAdera prati AmAra zAsti| Ami akRtajJa vyatIta kAuke zAsti dei nA|

tAdera evaM yesava janapadera leAkadera prati Ami anugraha karechilama seguleAra madhyavartI sthAne aneka dRzyamAna janapada sthApana karechilAma evaM seguleAte bhramaNa nirdhArita karechilAma| teAmarA esava janapade rAtre o dine nirApade bhramaNa kara|

ataHpara tArA valala, he AmAdera pAlanakartA, AmAdera bhramaNera parisara vAr3iYe dAo| tArA nijedera prati juluma karechila| phale Ami tAderake upAkhyAne pariNata karalAma evaM sampUrNarUpe chinna-vicchinna kare dilAma| nizcaYa ete pratyeka dhairyazIla kRtajJera janye nidarzanAvalI raYeche|
Ara tAdera upara ivalIsa tAra anumAna satya hiseve pratiSThita karala| phale tAdera madhye muminadera ekaTi dala vyatIta sakalei tAra patha anusaraNa karala|
tAdera upara zaYatAnera keAna kSamatA chila nA, tave ke parakAle vizvAsa kare evaM ke tAte sandeha kare, tA prakAza karAi chila AmAra uddezya| ApanAra pAlanakartA sava viSaYe tattvAvadhAYaka|

valuna, teAmarA tAderake AhavAna kara, yAderake upAsya mane karate AllAha vyatIta| tArA nabheAmanDala o bhU-manDalera anu parimANa keAna kichura mAlika naYa, ete tAdera keAna aMzao nei evaM tAdera keu AllAhara sahAYakao naYa|

yAra janye anumati deYA haYa, tAra janye vyatIta AllAhara kAche kArao supAriza phalaprasU have nA| yakhana tAdera mana theke bhaYa-bhIti dUra haYe yAve, takhana tArA paraspare valave, teAmAdera pAlanakartA ki valalena? tArA valave, tini satya valechena evaM tinii savAra upare mahAna|
valuna, nabheAmanDala o bhU-manDala theke ke teAmAdera ke riyika deYa| valuna, AllAha| AmarA athavA teAmarA satpathe athavA spaSTa vibhrAntite Achi o Acha?
valuna, AmAdera aparAdhera janye teAmarA jijJAsita have nA evaM teAmarA yA kichu kara, se samparke AmarA jijJAsita hava nA|
valuna, AmAdera pAlanakartA AmAderake samaveta karavena, ataHpara tini AmAdera madhye saThikabhAve phaYasAlA karavena| tini phaYasAlAkArI, sarvajJa|
valuna, teAmarA yAderake AllAhara sAthe aMzIdArarUpe saMyukta karecha, tAderake ene AmAke dekhAo| varaM tinii AllAha, parAkramazIla, prajJAmaYa|
Ami ApanAke samagra mAnavajAtira janye susaMvAdAtA o satarkakArI rUpe pAThiYechi; kintu adhikAMza mAnuSa tA jAne nA|
tArA vale, teAmarA yadi satyavAdI hao, tave vala, e oYAdA kakhana vAstavAYita have?
valuna, teAmAdera janye ekaTi dinera oYAdA raYeche yAke teAmarA eka mahUrtao vilamvita karate pArave nA evaM tvarAnvita o karate pArave nA|

kApherarA vale, AmarA kakhanao e keAraAne vizvAsa karava nA evaM era pUrvavartI kitAveo naYa| Apani yadi pApiSThaderake dekhatena, yakhana tAderake tAdera pAlanakartAra sAmane dA~r3a karAneA have,, takhana tArA paraspara kathA kATAkATi karave| yAderake durvala mane karA hata, tArA ahaMkArIderake valave, teAmarA nA thAkale AmarA avazyai mumina hatAma|
ahaMkArIrA durvalake valave, teAmAdera kAche hedAYeta AsAra para AmarA ki teAmAderake vAdhA diYechilAma? varaM teAmarAi teA chile aparAdhI|

durvalarA ahaMkArIderake valave, varaM teAmarAi teA divArAtri cakrAnta kare AmAderake nirdeza dite yena AmarA AllAhake nA mAni evaM tA~ra aMzIdAra sAvyasta kari tArA yakhana zAsti dekhave, takhana manera anutApa manei rAkhave| vastutaH Ami kApheradera galAYa ver3I parAva| tArA se pratiphalai peYe thAke yA tArA karata|
keAna janapade satarkakArI preraNa karA halei tAra vittazAlI adhivAsIrA valate zuru kareche, teAmarA ye viSaYasaha prerita haYecha, AmarA tA mAni nA|
tArA Arao valeche, AmarA dhane-jane samRddha, sutarAM AmarA zAstiprApta hava nA|
valuna, AmAra pAlanakartA yAke icchA riyika vAr3iYe dena evaM parimita dena| kintu adhikAMza mAnuSa tA veAjhe nA|

teAmAdera dhana-sampada o santAna-santati teAmAderake AmAra nikaTavartI karave nA| tave yArA vizvAsa sthApana kare o satkarma kare, tArA tAdera karmera vahuguNa pratidAna pAve evaM tArA suucca prAsAde nirApade thAkave|
Ara yArA AmAra AYAtasamUhake vyartha karAra apapraYAse lipta haYa, tAderake AyAve upasthita karA have|
valuna, AmAra pAlanakartA tA~ra vAndAdera madhye yAke icchA riyika vAr3iYe dena evaM sImita parimANe dena| teAmarA yA kichu vyaYa kara, tini tAra vinimaYa dena| tini uttama riyika dAtA|
yedina tini tAdera savAike ekatrita karavena evaM pherezatAderake valavena, erA ki teAmAderai pUjA karata?
pherezatArA valave, Apani pavitra, AmarA ApanAra pakSe, tAdera pakSe nai, varaM tArA jinadera pUjA karata| tAdera adhikAMzai zaYatAne vizvAsI|
ataeva Ajakera dine teAmarA eke aparera keAna upakAra o apakAra karAra adhikArI have nA Ara Ami jAlemaderake valava, teAmarA Agunera ye zAstike mithyA valate tA AsvAdana kara|

yakhana tAdera kAche AmAra suspaSTa AYAta samUha telAoYAta karA haYa, takhana tArA vale, teAmAdera vApa-dAdArA yAra evAdata karata e leAkaTi ye tA theke teAmAderake vAdhA dite cAYa| tArA Arao vale, eTA managar3A mithyA vai naYa| Ara kApheradera kAche yakhana satya Agamana kare, takhana tArA vale, eteA eka suspaSTa yAdu|
Ami tAderake keAna kitAva deini, yA tArA adhyaYana karave evaM ApanAra pUrve tAdera kAche keAna satarkakArI preraNa karini|
tAdera pUrvavartIrAo mithyA AreApa kareche| Ami tAderake yA diYechilAma, erA tAra eka dazamAMzao pAYani| eraparao tArA AmAra rAsUlaganake mithyA valeche| ataeva kemana haYeche AmAra zAsti|

valuna, Ami teAmAderake ekaTi viSaYe upadeza dicchiH teAmarA AllAhara nAme eka ekajana kare o du, du jana kare dA~r3Ao, ataHpara cintA-bhAvanA kara-teAmAdera saGgIra madhye keAna ummAdanA nei| tini teA Asanna kATheAra zAsti samparke teAmAderake satarka karena mAtra|
valuna, Ami teAmAdera kAche keAna pArizramika cAi nA varaM tA teAmarAi rAkha| AmAra puraskAra teA AllAhara kAche raYeche| pratyeka vastui tA~ra sAmane|
valuna, AmAra pAlanakartA satya dvIna avataraNa karechena| tini Alemula gAYava|
valuna, satya Agamana kareche evaM asatya nA pAre natuna kichu sRjana karate evaM nA pAre pUnaH pratyAvartita hate|

valuna, Ami pathabhraSTa hale nijera kSatira janyei pathabhraSTa hava; Ara yadi Ami satpatha prApta hai, tave tA e janye ye, AmAra pAlanakartA AmAra prati ohI preraNa karena| nizcaYa tini sarvazreAtA, nikaTavartI|
yadi Apani dekhatena, yakhana tArA bhItasastrasta haYe par3ave, ataHpara pAliYeo vA~cate pArave nA evaM nikaTavartI sthAna theke dharA par3ave|
tArA valave, AmarA satye vizvAsa sthApana karalAma| kintu tArA etadUra theke tAra nAgAla pAve kemana kare?
athaca tArA pUrva theke satyake asvIkAra karachila| Ara tArA satya hate dUre theke ajJAta viSaYera upara mantavya karata|
tAdera o tAdera vAsanAra madhye antarAla haYe geche, yemana-tAdera satIrthadera sAtheo erUpa karA haYeche, yArA tAdera pUrve chila| tArA chila vibhrAntikara sandehe patita|

samasta prazaMsA AllAhara, yini AsamAna o yamInera sraSTA evaM pherezatAgaNake karechena vArtAvAhaka-tArA dui dui, tina tina o cAra cAra pAkhAviziSTa| tini sRSTi madhye yA icchA yeAga karena| nizcaYa AllAha sarvaviSaYe sakSama|
AllAha mAnuSera janya anugrahera madhya theke yA khule dena, tA pherAvAra keu nei evaM tini yA vAraNa karena, tA keu preraNa karate pAre nA tini vyatita| tini parAkramazAlI prajJAmaYa|

he mAnuSa, teAmAdera prati AllAhara anugraha smaraNa kara| AllAha vyatIta emana keAna sraSTA Ache ki, ye teAmAderake AsamAna o yamIna theke riyika dAna kare? tini vyatIta keAna upAsya nei| ataeva teAmarA keAthAYa phire yAccha?
tArA yadi ApanAke mithyAvAdI vale, tave ApanAra pUrvavartI paYagamvaragaNakeo teA mithyAvAdI valA haYechila| AllAhara pratii yAvatIYa viSaYa pratyAvartita haYa|
he mAnuSa, nizcaYa AllAhara oYAdA satya| sutarAM, pArthiva jIvana yena teAmAderake pratAraNA nA kare| evaM sei pravaJcaka yena kichutei teAmAderake AllAha samparke pravaJcita nA kare|
zaYatAna teAmAdera zatru; ataeva tAke zatru rUpei grahaNa kara| se tAra dalavalake AhavAna kare yena tArA jAhAnnAmI haYa|
yArA kuphara kare tAdera janye raYeche kaTheAra AyAva| Ara yArA ImAna Ane o satkarma kare, tAdera janye raYeche kSamA o mahA puraskAra|

yAke mandakarma zeAbhanIYa kare dekhAneA haYa, se tAke uttama mane kare, se ki samAna ye mandake manda mane kare| nizcaYa AllAha yAke icchA pathabhraSTa karena evaM yAke icchA satpatha pradarzana karena| sutarAM Apani tAdera janye anutApa kare nijeke dhvaMsa karavena nA| nizcaYai AllAha jAnena tArA yA kare|

AllAhai vAYu preraNa karena, ataHpara se vAYu meghamAlA saJcArita kare| ataHpara Ami tA mRta bhU-khanDera dike paricAlita kari, ataHpara tadvArA se bhU-khanDake tAra mRtyura para saJjIvita kare dei| emanibhAve have punarutthAna|

keu sammAna cAile jene rAkhuna, samasta sammAna AllAharai janye| tA~rai dike AreAhaNa kare satvAkya evaM satkarma tAke tule neYa| yArA manda kAryera cakrAnte lege thAke, tAdera janye raYeche kaTheAra zAsti| tAdera cakrAnta vyartha have|

AllAha teAmAderake sRSTi karechena mATi theke, ataHpara vIrya theke, tArapara karechena teAmAderake yugala| keAna nArI garbhadhAraNa kare nA evaM santAna prasava kare nA; kintu tA~ra jJAtasAre| keAna vaYaska vyakti vaYasa pAYa nA| evaM tAra vaYasa hrAsa pAYa nA; kintu tA likhita Ache kitAve| nizcaYa eTA AllAhara pakSe sahaja|

du’Ti samudra samAna haYa nA-ekaTi miThA o tRSNAnivAraka evaM aparaTi leAnA| UbhaYaTi thekei teAmarA tAjA geAzata (matsa) AhAra kara evaM paridhAne vyavahArya gaYanAgATi AharaNa kara| tumi tAte tAra vuka cire jAhAja calate dekha, yAte teAmarA tAra anugraha anveSaNa kara evaM yAte teAmarA kRtajJatA prakAza kara|

tini rAtrike divase praviSTa karena evaM divasake rAtrite praviSTa karena| tini sUrya o candrake kAje niYeAjita karechena| pratyekaTi Avartana kare eka nirdiSTa meYAda paryanta| ini AllAha; teAmAdera pAlanakartA, sAmrAjya tA~rai| tA~ra parivarte teAmarA yAderake DAka, tArA tuccha khejura A~Tirao adhikArI naYa|

teAmarA tAderake DAkale tArA teAmAdera se DAka zune nA| zunaleo teAmAdera DAke sAr3A deYa nA| keYAmatera dina tArA teAmAdera zeraka asvIkAra karave| vastutaH AllAhara nyAYa teAmAke keu avahita karate pArave nA|
he mAnuSa, teAmarA AllAhara galagraha| Ara AllAha; tini abhAvamukta, prazaMsita|
tini icchA karale teAmAderake vilupta kare eka natuna sRSTira udbhava karavena|
eTA AllAhara pakSe kaThina naYa|

keu aparera veAjhA vahana karave nA| keu yadi tAra gurutara bhAra vahana karate anyake AhavAna kare keu tA vahana karave nA-yadi se nikaTavartI AtnIYao haYa| Apani kevala tAderake satarka karena, yArA tAdera pAlanakartAke nA dekheo bhaYa kare evaM nAmAya kAYema kare| ye keu nijera saMzeAdhana kare, se saMzeAdhana kare, svIYa kalyANera janyei AllAhara nikaTai sakalera pratyAvartana|
dRSTimAna o dRSTihIna samAna naYa|
samAna naYa andhakAra o AleA|
samAna naYa chAYA o taptareAda|
Arao samAna naYa jIvita o mRta| AllAha zravaNa karAna yAke icchA| Apani kavare zAYitaderake zunAte sakSama nana|
Apani teA kevala ekajana satarkakArI|
Ami ApanAke satyadharmasaha pAThiYechi saMvAdadAtA o satarkakArIrUpe| emana keAna sampradAYa nei yAte satarkakArI Aseni|
tArA yadi ApanAra prati mithyAreApa kare, tAdera pUrvavartIrAo mithyAreApa karechila| tAdera kAche tAdera rasUlagaNa spaSTa nidarzana, sahIphA evaM ujjala kitAvasaha esechilena|
ataHpara Ami kApheraderake dhRta karechilAma| kemana chila AmAra AyAva!

tumi ki dekhani AllAha AkAza theke vRSTivarSaNa karena, ataHpara taddvArA Ami vibhinna varNera phala-mUla udagata kari| parvatasamUhera madhye raYeche vibhinna varNera giripatha-sAdA, lAla o nikaSa kAleA kRSNa|
anurUpa bhAve vibhinna varNera mAnuSa, jantu, catuspada prANI raYeche| AllAhara vAndAdera madhye jJAnIrAi kevala tA~ke bhaYa kare| nizcaYa AllAha parAkramazAlI kSamAmaYa|
yArA AllAhara kitAva pATha kare, nAmAya kAYema kare, evaM Ami yA diYechi, tA theke geApane o prakAzye vyaYa kare, tArA emana vyavasA AzA kara, yAte kakhanao leAkasAna have nA|
pariNAme tAderake AllAha tAdera saoYAva pureApuri devena evaM nija anugrahe Arao vezI devena| nizcaYa tini kSamAzIla, guNagrAhI|
Ami ApanAra prati ye kitAva pratyAdeza karechi, tA satya-pUrvavartI kitAvera satyAYana kArI nizcaYa AllAha tA~ra vAndAdera vyApAre sava jAnena, dekhena|

ataHpara Ami kitAvera adhikArI karechi tAderake yAderake Ami AmAra vAndAdera madhya theke maneAnIta karechi| tAdera keu keu nijera prati atyAcArI, keu madhyapanthA avalamvanakArI evaM tAdera madhye keu keu AllAhara nirdezakrame kalyANera pathe egiYe geche| eTAi mahA anugraha|
tArA praveza karave vasavAsera jAnnAte| tathAYa tArA svarNanirmita, meAti khacita kaMkana dvArA alaMkRta have| sekhAne tAdera peAzAka have rezamera|

ataeva tAdera kathA yena ApanAke duHkhita nA kare| Ami jAni yA tArA geApane kare evaM yA tArA prakAzye kare|
mAnuSa ki dekhe nA ye, Ami tAke sRSTi karechi vIrya theke? ataHpara takhanai se haYe gela prakAzya vAkavitanDAkArI|
