evaM tAra vaMzadharaderakei Ami avaziSTa rekhechilAma|
Ami tAra janye paravartIdera madhye e viSaYa rekhe diYechi ye,
vizvavAsIra madhye nUhera prati zAnti varSita heAka|
Ami ebhAvei satkarma parAYanaderake puraskRta kare thAki|
se chila AmAra ImAnadAra vAndAdera anyatama|
ataHpara Ami aparApara savAike nimajjata karechilAma|
Ara nUha panthIderai ekajana chila ivrAhIma|
yakhana se tAra pAlanakartAra nikaTa suSThu citte upasthita haYechila,
yakhana se tAra pitA o sampradAYake valechilaH teAmarA kisera upAsanA karacha?
teAmarA ki AllAha vyatIta mithyA upAsya kAmanA karacha?
vizvajagatera pAlanakartA samparke teAmAdera dhAraNA ki?
ataHpara se ekavAra tArakAdera prati lakSya karala|
evaM valalaH Ami pIr3ita|
ataHpara tArA tAra prati piTha phiriYe cale gela|
ataHpara se tAdera devAlaYe, giYe Dhukala evaM valalaH teAmarA khAccha nA kena?
teAmAdera ki hala ye, kathA valacha nA?
ataHpara se pravala AghAte tAdera upara jhA~piYe par3ala|
takhana leAkajana tAra dike chuTe eleA bhIta-santrasta pade|
se valalaH teAmarA svahasta nirmita pAtharera pUjA kara kena?
athaca AllAha teAmAderake evaM teAmarA yA nirmANa karacha savAike sRSTi karechena|
tArA valalaH era janye ekaTi bhita nirmANa kara evaM ataHpara tAke Agunera stupe nikSepa kara|
tArapara tArA tAra viruddhe mahA Sar3ayantra A~Tate cAila, kintu Ami tAderakei parAbhUta kare dilAma|
se valalaH Ami AmAra pAlanakartAra dike calalAma, tini AmAke pathapradarzana karavena|
he AmAra paraoYAradegAra! AmAke eka satputra dAna kara|
sutarAM Ami tAke eka sahanazIla putrera susaMvAda dAna karalAma|

ataHpara se yakhana pitAra sAthe calApherA karAra vaYase upanIta hala, takhana ivrAhIma tAke valalaH vatsa! Ami svapne dekhiye, teAmAke yaveha karachi; ekhana teAmAra abhimata ki dekha| se valalaH pitAH! ApanAke yA Adeza karA haYeche, tAi karuna| AllAha cAhe teA Apani AmAke savarakArI pAvena|
yakhana pitA-putra ubhaYei Anugatya prakAza karala evaM ivrAhIma tAke yaveha karAra janye zAYita karala|
takhana Ami tAke Deke valalAmaH he ivrAhIma,
tumi teA svapnake satye pariNata kare dekhAle! Ami ebhAvei satkarmIderake pratidAna diYe thAki|
nizcaYa eTA eka suspaSTa parIkSA|
Ami tAra parivarte dilAma yaveha karAra janye eka mahAna jantu|
Ami tAra janye e viSaYaTi paravartIdera madhye rekhe diYechi ye,
ivrAhImera prati sAlAma varSita heAka|
emanibhAve Ami satkarmIderake pratidAna diYe thAki|
se chila AmAra vizvAsI vAndAdera ekajana|
Ami tAke susaMvAda diYechi isahAkera, se satkarmIdera madhya theke ekajana navI|
tAke evaM isahAkake Ami varakata dAna karechi| tAdera vaMzadharadera madhye kataka satkarmI evaM kataka nijedera upara spaSTa julumakArI|
Ami anugraha karechilAma mUsA o hArunera prati|
tAderake o tAdera sampradAYake uddhAra karechi mahA saMkaTa theke|
Ami tAderake sAhAyya karechilAma, phale tArAi chila vijaYI|
Ami ubhaYake diYechilAma suspaSTa kitAva|
evaM tAderake sarala patha pradarzana karechilAma|
Ami tAdera janye paravartIdera madhye e viSaYa rekhe diYechi ye,
mUsA o hArunera prati sAlAma varSita heAka|
ebhAve Ami satkarmIderake pratidAna diYe thAki|
tArA ubhaYei chila AmAra vizvAsI vAndAdera anyatama|
nizcaYai iliYAsa chila rasUla|
yakhana se tAra sampradAYake valalaH teAmarA ki bhaYa kara nA?
teAmarA ki vA’Ala devatAra evAdata karave evaM sarveAttama sraSTAke parityAga karave|
yini AllAha teAmAdera pAlanakartA evaM teAmAdera pUrvapuruSadera pAlanakartA?
ataHpara tArA tAke mithyA pratipanna karala| ataeva tArA avazyai grephatAra haYe Asave|
kintu AllAha tA’AlAra khA~Ti vAndAgaNa naYa|
Ami tAra janye paravartIdera madhye e viSaYe rekhe diYechi ye,
iliYAsera prati sAlAma varSita heAka!
ebhAvei Ami satkarmIderake pratidAna diYe thAki|
se chila AmAra vizvAsI vAndAdera antarbhUkta|
nizcaYa lUta chilena rasUlagaNera ekajana|
yakhana Ami tAkeo tAra parivArera savAike uddhAra karechilAma;
kintu eka vRddhAke chAr3A; se anyAnyadera saGge theke giYechila|
ataHpara avaziSTaderake Ami samUle utpATita karechilAma|
teAmarA teAmAdera dhvaMsa stupera upara diYe gamana kara bheAra velAYa
evaM sandhyAYa, tAra pareo ki teAmarA veAjha nA?
Ara iunusao chilena paYagamvaragaNera ekajana|
yakhana pAliYe tini veAjhAi neৗkAYa giYe pau~chechilena|
ataHpara laTArI (surati) karAle tini deASI sAvyasta halena|
ataHpara ekaTi mAcha tA~ke gile phelala, takhana tini aparAdhI gaNya haYechilena|
yadi tini AllAhara tasavIha pATha nA karatena,
tave tA~ke keYAmata divasa paryanta mAchera peTei thAkate hata|
ataHpara Ami tA~ke eka vistIrNa-vijana prAntare nikSepa karalAma, takhana tini chilena rugna|
Ami tA~ra upara eka latAviziSTa vRkSa udagata karalAma|
evaM tA~ke, lakSa vA tateAdhika leAkera prati preraNa karalAma|
tArA vizvAsa sthApana karala ataHpara Ami tAderake nirdhArita samaYa paryanta jIvaneApabheAga karate dilAma|
evAra tAderake jijJesa karuna, teAmAra pAlanakartAra janye ki kanyA santAna raYeche evaM tAdera janye ki putra-santAna|
nA ki Ami tAdera upasthitite pherezatAgaNake nArIrUpe sRSTi karechi?
jeneA, tArA managar3A ukti kare ye,
AllAha santAna janma diYechena| nizcaYa tArA mithyAvAdI|
tini ki putra-santAnera sthale kanyA-santAna pachanda karechena?
teAmAdera ki hala? teAmAdera e kemana sindhAnta?
teAmarA ki anudhAvana kara nA?
nA ki teAmAdera kAche suspaSTa keAna dalIla raYeche?
teAmarA satyavAdI hale teAmAdera kitAva Ana|
tArA AllAha o jvinadera madhye samparka sAvyasta kareche, athaca jvinerA jAne ye, tArA grephatAra haYe Asave|
tArA yA vale tA theke AllAha pavitra|
tave yArA AllAhara niSThAvAna vAndA, tArA grephatAra haYe Asave nA|
ataeva teAmarA evaM teAmarA yAdera upAsanA kara,
tAdera kAukei teAmarA AllAha samparke vibhrAnta karate pArave nA|
zudhumAtra tAdera chAr3A yArA jAhAnnAme peৗchAve|
AmAdera pratyekera janya raYeche nirdiSTa sthAna|
evaM AmarAi sArivaddhabhAve danDAYamAna thAki|
evaM AmarAi AllAhara pavitratA gheASaNA kari|
tArA teA valataH
yadi AmAdera kAche pUrvavartIdera keAna upadeza thAkata,
tave AmarA avazyai AllAhara maneAnIta vAndA hatAma|
vastutaH tArA ei keAraAnake asvIkAra kareche| ekhana zIghrai tArA jene nite pArave,
AmAra rAsUla o vAndAgaNera vyApAre AmAra ei vAkya satya haYeche ye,
avazyai tArA sAhAyya prApta haYa|
Ara AmAra vAhinIi haYa vijaYI|
ataeva Apani kichukAlera janye tAderake upekSA karuna|
evaM tAderake dekhate thAkuna| zIghrai tArAo era pariNAma dekhe neve|
AmAra AyAva ki tArA druta kAmanA kare?
ataHpara yakhana tAdera AGginAYa AyAva nAyila have, takhana yAderake satarka karA haYechila, tAdera sakAla velATi have khuvai manda|
Apani kichukAlera janye tAderake upekSA karuna|
evaM dekhate thAkuna, zIghrai tArAo era pariNAma dekhe neve|
pavitra ApanAra paraoYAradegArera sattA, tini sammAnita o pavitra yA tArA varNanA kare tA theke|
paYagamvaragaNera prati sAlAma varSita heAka|
samasta prazaMsA vizvapAlaka AllAhara nimitta|
cheAYAda| zapatha upadezapUrNa keAraAnera,
varaM yArA kAphera, tArA ahaMkAra o vireAdhitAYa lipta|
tAdera Age Ami kata janageASThIke dhvaMsa karechi, ataHpara tArA ArtanAda karate zuru kareche kintu tAdera niSkRti lAbhera samaYa chila nA|
tArA vismaYaveAdha kare ye, tAderai kAche tAdera madhye theke ekajana satarkakArI Agamana karechena| Ara kApherarA vale e-teA eka mithyAcArI yAdukara|
se ki vahu upAsyera parivarte eka upAsyera upAsanA sAvyasta kare diYeche| nizcaYa eTA eka vismaYakara vyApAra|
tAdera katipaYa viziSTa vyakti ekathA vale prasthAna kare ye, teAmarA cale yAo evaM teAmAdera upAsyadera pUjAYa dRr3ha thAka| nizcaYai e vaktavya keAna vizeSa uddezye praNeAdita|
AmarA sAveka dharme e dharanera kathA zunini| eTA managar3A vyApAra vai naYa|
AmAdera madhya theke zudhu ki tArai prati upadeza vAnI avatIrNa hala? vastutaH orA AmAra upadeza samparke sandihAna; varaM orA ekhanao AmAra mAra AsvAdana kareni|
nA ki tAdera kAche ApanAra parAkrAnta daYAvAna pAlanakartAra rahamatera keAna bhAnDAra raYeche?
nAki nabheAmanDala, bhUmanDala o etadubhaYera madhyavartI savakichura upara tAdera sAmrAjya raYeche? thAkale tAdera AkAze AreAhaNa karA ucita razi jhuliYe|
ekSetre vahu vAhinIra madhye oderao eka vAhinI Ache, yA parAjita have|
tAdera pUrveo mithyAreApa karechila nUhera sampradAYa, Ada, kIlaka viziSTa pherAuna,
sAmuda, lUtera sampradAYa o AikAra leAkerA| erAi chila vahu vAhinI|
edera pratyekei paYagamvaragaNera prati mithyAreApa kareche| phale AmAra AyAva pratiSThita haYeche|
kevala ekaTi mahAnAdera apekSA karache, yAte dama phelAra avakAza thAkave nA|
tArA vale, he AmAdera paraoYAradegAra, AmAdera prApya aMza hisAva divasera Agei diYe dAo|
tArA yA vale tAte Apani savara karuna evaM AmAra zaktizAlI vAndA dAudake smaraNa karuna| se chila AmAra prati pratyAvartanazIla|
Ami parvatamAlAke tAra anugAmI kare diYechilAma, tArA sakAla-sandhyAYa tAra sAthe pavitratA gheASaNA karata;
Ara pakSIkulakeo, yArA tAra kAche samaveta hata| savAi chila tA~ra prati pratyAvartanazIla|
Ami tA~ra sAmrAjyake sudRr3ha karechilAma evaM tA~ke diYechilAma prajJA o phaYasAlAkArI vAgnItA|
ApanAra kAche dAvIdAradera vRttAnta peৗcheche, yakhana tArA prAcIra DiGgIYe evAdata khAnAYa praveza karechila|

yakhana tArA dAudera kAche anupraveza karala, takhana se santrasta haYe par3ala| tArA valalaH bhaYa karavena nA; AmarA vivadamAna duTi pakSa, eke aparera prati vAr3AvAr3i karechi| ataeva, AmAdera madhye nyAYavicAra karuna, avicAra karavena nA| AmAderake sarala patha pradarzana karuna|
se AmAra bhAi, se nirAnavvai dumvAra mAlika Ara Ami mAlika ekaTi mAdI dumvAra| eraparao se valeH eTio AmAke diYe dAo| se kathAvArtAYa AmAra upara vala praYeAga kare|

dAuda valalaH se teAmAra dumvATike nijera dumvAguleAra sAthe saMyukta karAra dAvI kare teAmAra prati avicAra kareche| zarIkadera anekei eke aparera prati juluma kare thAke| tave tArA kare nA, yArA AllAhara prati vizvAsI o satkarma sampAdanakArI| avazya emana leAkera saMkhyA alpa| dAudera kheYAla hala ye, Ami tAke parIkSA karachi| ataHpara se tAra pAlanakartAra kAche kSamA prArthanA karala, sejadAYa luTiYe par3ala evaM tA~ra dike pratyAvartana karala|
Ami tAra se aparAdha kSamA karalAma| nizcaYa AmAra kAche tAra janye raYeche ucca martavA o sundara AvAsasthala|

he dAuda! Ami teAmAke pRthivIte pratinidhi karechi, ataeva, tumi mAnuSera mAjhe nyAYasaGgatabhAve rAjatva kara evaM kheYAla-khuzIra anusaraNa kareA nA| tA teAmAke AllAhara patha theke vicyuta kare deve| nizcaYa yArA AllAhara patha theke vicyuta haYa, tAdera janye raYeche kaTheAra zAsti, e kAraNe ye, tArA hisAvadivasake bhUle yAYa|
Ami AsamAna-yamIna o etadubhaYera madhyavartI keAna kichu ayathA sRSTi karini| eTA kApheradera dhAraNA| ataeva, kApheradera janye raYeche dUrbheAga arthAt jAhAnnAma|
Ami ki vizvAsI o satkarmIderake pRthivIte viparyaYa sRSTikArI kApheradera samatulya kare deva? nA kheAdAbhIruderake pApAcArIdera sammAna kare deva|
eTi ekaTi varakatamaYa kitAva, yA Ami ApanAra prati varakata hiseve avatIrNa karechi, yAte mAnuSa era AYAtasUha lakSya kare evaM vuddhimAnagaNa yena tA anudhAvana kare|
Ami dAudake seAlAYamAna dAna karechi| se ekajana uttama vAndA| se chila pratyAvartanazIla|
yakhana tAra sAmane aparAhne utkRSTa azvarAji peza karA hala,
takhana se valalaH Ami teA AmAra paraoYAradegArera smaraNe vismRta haYe sampadera mahavvate mugdha haYe par3echi-emanaki sUrya Duve geche|
eguleAke AmAra kAche phiriYe Ana| ataHpara se tAdera pA o galadeza chedana karate zuru karala|
Ami seAlAYamAnake parIkSA karalAma evaM rekhe dilAma tAra siMhAsanera upara ekaTi nisprANa deha| ataHpara se ruju hala|
seAlAYamAna valalaH he AmAra pAlanakartA, AmAke mApha karuna evaM AmAke emana sAmrAjya dAna karuna yA AmAra pare Ara keu pete pArave nA| nizcaYa Apani mahAdAtA|
takhana Ami vAtAsake tAra anugata kare dilAma, yA tAra hukume avAdhe pravAhita hata yekhAne se peৗchAte cAita|
Ara sakala zaYatAnake tAra adhIna kare dilAma arthat, yArA chila prAsAda nirmANakArI o DuvurI|
evaM anya Arao anekake adhIna kare dilAma, yArA Avaddha thAkata zRGkhale|
eguleA AmAra anugraha, ataeva, eguleA kAuke dAo athavA nije rekhe dAo-era keAna hiseva dite have nA|
nizcaYa tAra janye AmAra kAche raYeche maryAdA o zubha pariNati|
smaraNa karuNa, AmAra vAndA AiYyuvera kathA, yakhana se tAra pAlanakartAke AhavAna kare valalaH zaYatAna AmAke yantraNA o kaSTa peৗchiYeche|
tumi teAmAra pA diYe bhUmite AghAta kara| jharaNA nirgata hala geAsala karAra janye zItala o pAna karAra janye|
Ami tAke dilAma tAra parijanavarga o tAdera mata Arao aneka AmAra pakSa theke rahamatasvarUpa evaM vuddhimAnadera janye upadezasvarUpa|
tumi teAmAra hAte eka muTheA tRNazalA nAo, tadvArA AghAta kara evaM zapatha bhaGga kareA nA| Ami tAke pelAma savarakArI| camatkAra vAndA se| nizcaYa se chila pratyAvartanazIla|
smaraNa karuna, hAta o ceAkhera adhikArI AmAra vAndA ivrAhIma, isahAka o iYAkuvera kathA|
Ami tAdera eka vizeSa guNa tathA parakAlera smaraNa dvArA svAtantrya dAna karechilAma|
Ara tArA AmAra kAche maneAnIta o satleAkadera antarbhukta|
smaraNa karuNa, isamAIla, Ala iYAsA o yulakiphalera kathA| tArA pratyekei gunIjana|
e eka mahat AleAcanA| kheAdAbhIrudera janye raYeche uttama ThikAnA-
tathA sthAYI vasavAsera jAnnAta; tAdera janye tAra dvAra ummukta raYeche|
sekhAne tArA helAna diYe vasave| tArA sekhAne cAive aneka phala-mUla o pAnIYa|
tAdera kAche thAkave AnatanaYanA samavaYaskA ramaNIgaNa|
teAmAderake erai pratizruti deYA hacche vicAra divasera janye|
eTA AmAra deYA riyika yA zeSa have nA|
eTAteA zunale, ekhana duSTadera janye raYeche nikRSTa ThikAnA
tathA jAhAnnAma| tArA sekhAne praveza karave| ataeva, kata nikRSTa sei AvAsa sthala|
eTA uttapta pAni o pu~ja; ataeva tArA eke AsvAdana karuka|
e dharanera Arao kichu zAsti Ache|
ei teA ekadala teAmAdera sAthe praveza karache| tAdera janye abhinandana nei tArA teA jAhAnnAme praveza karave|
tArA valave, teAmAdera janye o teA abhinandana nei| teAmarAi AmAderake e vipadera sammukhIna karecha| ataeva, eTi katai nA ghRNya AvAsasthala|
tArA valave, he AmAdera pAlanakartA, ye AmAderake era sammukhIna kareche, Apani jAhAnnAme tAra zAsti dviguNa kare dina|
tArA Arao valave, AmAdera ki hala ye, AmarA yAderake manda leAka vale gaNya karatAma, tAderake ekhAne dekhachi nA|
AmarA ki ahetuka tAderake ThATTAra pAtra kare niYechilAma, nA AmAdera dRSTi bhula karache?
eTA arthAt jAhAnnAmIdera pArasparika vAka-vitanDA avazyambhAvI|
valuna, Ami teA ekajana satarkakArI mAtra evaM eka parAkramazAlI AllAha vyatIta keAna upAsya nei|
tini AsamAna-yamIna o etadubhaYera madhyavartI sava kichura pAlanakartA, parAkramazAlI, mArjanAkArI|
valuna, eTi eka mahAsaMvAda,
yA theke teAmarA mukha phiriYe niYecha|
Urdhva jagat samparke AmAra keAna jJAna chila nA yakhana pherezatArA kathAvArtA valachila|
AmAra kAche e ohIi Ase ye, Ami ekajana spaSTa satarkakArI|
yakhana ApanAra pAlanakartA pherezatAgaNake valalena, Ami mATira mAnuSa sRSTi karava|
yakhana Ami tAke suSama karava evaM tAte AmAra rUha phu~ke deva, takhana teAmarA tAra sammukhe sejadAYa nata haYe yeYeA|
ataHpara samasta pherezatAi ekayeAge sejadAYa nata hala,
kintu ivalIsa; se ahaMkAra karala evaM asvIkArakArIdera antarbhukta haYe gela|
AllAha valalena, he ivalIsa, Ami svahaste yAke sRSTi karechi, tAra sammukhe sejadA karate teAmAke kise vAdhA dila? tumi ahaMkAra karale, nA tumi tAra ceYe ucca maryAdA sampanna?
se valalaH Ami tAra ceYe uttama Apani AmAke Agunera dvArA sRSTi karechena, Ara tAke sRSTi karechena mATira dvArA|
AllAha valalenaH vera haYe yA, ekhAna theke| kAraNa, tui abhizapta|
teAra prati AmAra e abhizApa vicAra divasa paryanta sthAYI have|
se valalaH he AmAra pAlanakartA, Apani AmAke punarutthAna divasa paryanta avakAza dina|
AllAh‌ valalenaH teAke avakAza deYA hala|
se samaYera dina paryanta yA jAnA|
se valala, ApanAra iyayatera kasama, Ami avazyai tAdera savAike vipathagAmI kare deva|
tave tAdera madhye yArA ApanAra khA~Ti vAndA, tAderake chAr3A|
AllAha valalenaH tAi Thika, Ara Ami satya valachi-
teAra dvArA Ara tAdera madhye yArA teAra anusaraNa karave tAdera dvArA Ami jAhAnnAma pUrNa karava|
valuna, Ami teAmAdera kAche keAna pratidAna cAi nA Ara Ami leৗkikatAkArIo nai|
eTA teA vizvavAsIra janye eka upadeza mAtra|
teAmarA kichu kAla pare era saMvAda avazyai jAnate pArave|
kitAva avatIrNa haYeche parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa AllAhara pakSa theke|
Ami ApanAra prati e kitAva yathArtharUpe nAyila karechi| ataeva, Apani niSThAra sAthe AllAhara evAdata karuna|

jene rAkhuna, niSThApUrNa evAdata AllAharai nimitta| yArA AllAha vyatIta aparake upAsyarUpe grahaNa kare rekheche evaM vale ye, AmarA tAdera evAdata e janyei kari, yena tArA AmAderake AllAhara nikaTavartI kare deYa| nizcaYa AllAha tAdera madhye tAdera pArasparika vireAdhapUrNa viSaYera phaYasAlA kare devena| AllAha mithyAvAdI kApherake satpathe paricAlita karena nA|
AllAha yadi santAna grahaNa karAra icchA karatena, tave tA~ra sRSTira madhya theke yA kichu icchA maneAnIta karatena, tini pavitra| tini AllAha, eka parAkramazAlI|

tini AsamAna o yamIna sRSTi karechena yathAyathabhAve| tini rAtrike divasa dvArA AcchAdita karena evaM divasake rAtri dvArA AcchAdita karena evaM tini surya o candrake kAje niyukta karechena pratyekei vicaraNa kare nirdiSTa samaYakAla paryanta| jene rAkhuna, tini parAkramazAlI, kSamAzIla|

tini sRSTi karechena teAmAderake ekai vyakti theke| ataHpara tA theke tAra yugala sRSTi karechena evaM tini teAmAdera janye ATa prakAra catuSpada jantu avatIrNa karechena| tini teAmAderake sRSTi karechena teAmAdera mAtRgarbhe paryAYakrame ekera para eka trividha andhakAre| tini AllAha teAmAdera pAlanakartA, sAmrAjya tA~rai| tini vyatIta keAna upAsya nei| ataeva, teAmarA keAthAYa vibhrAnta haccha?

yadi teAmarA asvIkAra kara, tave AllAha teAmAdera theke veparaoYA| tini tA~ra vAndAdera kAphera haYe par3A pachanda karena nA| pakSAntare yadi teAmarA kRtajJa hao, tave tini teAmAdera janye tA pachanda karena| ekera pApa bhAra anye vahana karave nA| ataHpara teAmarA teAmAdera pAlanakartAra kAche phire yAve| tini teAmAderake teAmAdera karma samvandhe avahita karavena| nizcaYa tini antarera viSaYa samparkeo avagata|

yakhana mAnuSake duHkha-kaSTa sparza kare, takhana se ekAgracitte tAra pAlanakartAke DAke, ataHpara tini yakhana tAke neYAmata dAna karena, takhana se kaSTera kathA vismRta haYe yAYa, yAra janye pUrve Dekechila evaM AllAhara samakakSa sthira kare; yAte kare aparake AllAhara patha theke vibhrAnta kare| valuna, tumi teAmAra kuphara sahakAre kichukAla jIvaneApabheAga kare nAo| nizcaYa tumi jAhAnnAmIdera antarbhUkta|

ye vyakti rAtrikAle sejadAra mAdhyame athavA dA~r3iYe evAdata kare, parakAlera AzaMkA rAkhe evaM tAra pAlanakartAra rahamata pratyAzA kare, se ki tAra samAna, ye erUpa kare nA; valuna, yArA jAne evaM yArA jAne nA; tArA ki samAna hate pAre? cintA-bhAvanA kevala tArAi kare, yArA vuddhimAna|

valuna, he AmAra vizvAsI vAndAgaNa! teAmarA teAmAdera pAlanakartAke bhaYa kara| yArA e duniYAte satkAja kare, tAdera janye raYeche puNya| AllAhara pRthivI prazasta| yArA savarakArI, tArAi tAdera puraskAra pAYa agaNita|
valuna, Ami niSThAra sAthe AllAhara evAdata karate AdiSTa haYechi|
Arao AdiSTa haYechi, sarva prathama nirdeza pAlanakArI haoYAra janye|
valuna, Ami AmAra pAlanakartAra avAdhya hale eka mahAdivasera zAstira bhaYa kari|
valuna, Ami niSThAra sAthe AllAha tA’AlArai evAdata kari|

ataeva, teAmarA AllAhara parivarte yAra icchA tAra evAdata kara| valuna, keYAmatera dina tArAi vezI kSatigrasta have, yArA nijedera o parivAravargera tarapha theke kSatigrasta have| jene rAkha, eTAi suspaSTa kSati|
tAdera janye upara dika theke evaM nIcera dika theke Agunera meghamAlA thAkave| e zAsti dvArA AllAha tA~ra vAndAderake satarka karena ye, he AmAra vAndAgaNa, AmAke bhaYa kara|
yArA zaYatAnI zaktira pUjA-arcanA theke dUre thAke evaM AllAha abhimukhI haYa, tAdera janye raYeche susaMvAda| ataeva, susaMvAda dina AmAra vAndAderake|
yArA maneAniveza sahakAre kathA zune, ataHpara yA uttama, tAra anusaraNa kare| tAderakei AllAha satpatha pradarzana karena evaM tArAi vuddhimAna|
yAra janye zAstira hukuma avadhArita haYe geche Apani ki se jAhAnnAmIke mukta karate pAravena?

kintu yArA tAdera pAlanakartAke bhaYa kare, tAdera janye nirmita raYeche prAsAdera upara prAsAda| eguleAra taladeze nadI pravAhita| AllAha pratizruti diYechena| AllAha pratizrutira khelApha karena nA|

tumi ki dekhani ye, AllAha AkAza theke pAni varSaNa karechena, ataHpara se pAni yamInera jharNAsamUhe pravAhita karechena, erapara taddvArA vibhinna raGera phasala utpanna karena, ataHpara tA zukiYe yAYa, phale teAmarA tA pItavarNa dekhate pAo| erapara AllAha tAke khar3a-kuTAYa pariNata kare dena| nizcaYa ete vuddhimAnadera janye upadeza raYeche|

AllAha yAra vakSa isalAmera janye ummukta kare diYechena, ataHpara se tAra pAlanakartAra pakSa theke Agata AleAra mAjhe raYeche| (se ki tAra samAna, ye erUpa naYa) yAdera antara AllAha smaraNera vyApAre kaTheAra, tAdera janye dUrbheAga| tArA suspaSTha geAmarAhIte raYeche|

AllAha uttama vANI tathA kitAva nAyila karechena, yA sAmaJjasyapUrNa, pUnaH pUnaH paThita| ete tAdera leAma kA~TA diYe uThe cAmar3Ara upara, yArA tAdera pAlanakartAke bhaYa kare, erapara tAdera cAmar3A o antara AllAhara smaraNe vinamra haYa| eTAi AllAhara patha nirdeza, era mAdhyame AllAha yAke icchA patha pradarzana karena| Ara AllAha yAke geAmarAha karena, tAra keAna pathapradarzaka nei|
ye vyakti keYAmatera dina tAra mukha dvArA azubha AyAva ThekAve evaM erUpa jAlemaderake valA have, teAmarA yA karate tAra svAda AsvAdana kara,-se ki tAra samAna, ye erUpa naYa?
tAdera pUrvavartIrAo mithyAreApa karechila, phale tAdera kAche AyAva emanabhAve Asala, yA tArA kalpanAo karata nA|
ataHpara AllAha tAderake pArthiva jIvane lAJchanAra svAda AsvAdana karAlena, Ara parakAlera AyAva have Arao gurutara, yadi tArA jAnata!
Ami e keAraAne mAnuSera janye sava dRSTAntai varNanA karechi, yAte tArA anudhAvana kare;
AravI bhASAYa e keAraAna vakratAmukta, yAte tArA sAvadhAna haYe cale|

AllAha eka dRSTAnta varNanA karechenaH ekaTi leAkera upara paraspara vireAdhI kaYajana mAlika raYeche, Areka vyaktira prabhu mAtra ekajana-tAdera ubhaYera avasthA ki samAna? samasta prazaMsA AllAhara| kintu tAdera adhikAMzai jAne nA|
nizcaYa teAmArao mRtyu have evaM tAderao mRtyu have|
ataHpara keYAmatera dina teAmarA savAi teAmAdera pAlanakartAra sAmane kathA kATAkATi karave|
ye vyakti AllAhara viruddhe mithyA vale evaM tAra kAche satya Agamana karAra para tAke mithyA sAvyasta kare, tAra ceYe adhika yAlema Ara ke have? kApheradera vAsasthAna jAhAnnAme naYa ki?
yArA satya niYe Agamana karache evaM satyake satya mene niYeche; tArAi teA kheAdAbhIru|
tAdera janye pAlanakartAra kAche tAi raYeche, yA tArA cAive| eTA satkarmIdera puraskAra|
yAte AllAha tAdera manda karmasamUha mArjanA karena evaM tAdera uttama karmera puraskAra tAderake dAna karena|
AllAha ki tA~ra vAndAra pakSe yatheSTa nana? athaca tArA ApanAke AllAhara parivarte anyAnya upAsyadera bhaYa dekhAYa| AllAha yAke geAmarAha karena, tAra keAna pathapradarzaka nei|
Ara AllAha yAke pathapradarzana karena, tAke pathabhraSTakArI keu nei| AllAha ki parAkramazAlI, pratizeAdha grahaNakArI nana?

yadi Apani tAderake jijJesa karena, AsamAna o yamIna ke sRSTi kareche? tArA avazyai valave-AllAha| valuna, teAmarA bheve dekhecha ki, yadi AllAha AmAra aniSTa karAra icchA karena, tave teAmarA AllAha vyatIta yAderake DAka, tArA ki se aniSTa dUra karate pArave? athavA tini AmAra prati rahamata karAra icchA karale tArA ki se rahamata reAdha karate pArave? valuna, AmAra pakSe AllAhai yatheSTa| nirbharakArIrA tA~rai upara nirbhara kare|
valuna, he AmAra kaoma, teAmarA teAmAdera jAYagAYa kAja kara, Amio kAja karachi| sattvarai jAnate pArave|
kAra kAche avamAnanAkara AyAva evaM cirasthAYI zAsti neme Ase|

Ami ApanAra prati satya dharmasaha kitAva nAyila karechi mAnuSera kalyANakalpe| ataHpara ye satpathe Ase, se nijera kalyANera janyei Ase, Ara ye pathabhraSTa haYa, se nijerai aniSTera janye pathabhraSTa haYa| Apani tAdera janye dAYI nana|

AllAha mAnuSera prANa haraNa karena tAra mRtyura samaYa, Ara ye mare nA, tAra nidrAkAle| ataHpara yAra mRtyu avadhArita karena, tAra prANa chAr3ena nA evaM anyAnyadera cher3e dena eka nirdiSTa samaYera janye| nizcaYa ete cintAzIla leAkadera janye nidarzanAvalI raYeche|
tArA ki AllAha vyatIta supArizakArI grahaNa kareche? valuna, tAdera keAna ekhatiYAra nA thAkaleo evaM tArA nA vujhaleo?
valuna, samasta supAriza AllAharai kSamatAdhIna, AsamAna o yamIne tA~rai sAmrAjya| ataHpara tA~rai kAche teAmarA pratyAvartita have|

yakhana khA~TibhAve AllAhara nAma uccAraNa karA haYa, takhana yArA parakAle vizvAsa kare nA, tAdera antara saMkucita haYe yAYa, Ara yakhana AllAha vyatIta anya upAsyadera nAma uccAraNa karA haYa, takhana tArA Anande ullasita haYe uThe|
valuna, he AllAha AsamAna o yamInera sraSTA, dRzya o adRzyera jJAnI, Apanii ApanAra vAndAdera madhye phaYasAlA karavena, ye viSaYe tArA mata vireAdha karata|

yadi geAnAhagAradera kAche pRthivIra savakichu thAke evaM tAra sAthe samaparimANa Arao thAke, tave avazyai tArA keYAmatera dina se savakichui niskRti pAoYAra janye muktipana hiseve diYe deve| athaca tArA dekhate pAve, AllAhara pakSa theke emana zAsti, yA tArA kalpanAo karata nA|
Ara dekhave, tAdera duskarmasamUha evaM ye viSaYe tArA ThATTA-vidrupa karata, tA tAderake ghire neve|

mAnuSake yakhana duHkha-kaSTa sparza kare, takhana se AmAke DAkate zuru kare, erapara Ami yakhana tAke AmAra pakSa theke neYAmata dAna kari, takhana se vale, eTA teA Ami pUrvera jAnA matei prApta haYechi| athaca eTA eka parIkSA, kintu tAdera adhikAMzai veAjhe nA|
tAdera pUrvavartIrAo tAi valata, ataHpara tAdera kRtakarma tAdera keAna upakAre Aseni|
tAdera duskarma tAderake vipade pheleche, edera madhyeo yArA pApI, tAderakeo ati sattvara tAdera duskarma vipade phelave| tArA tA pratihata karate sakSama have nA|
tArA ki jAneni ye, AllAha yAra janye icchA riyika vRddhi karena evaM parimita dena| nizcaYa ete vizvAsI sampradAYera janye nidarzanAvalI raYeche|
valuna, he AmAra vAndAgaNa yArA nijedera upara yuluma karecha teAmarA AllAhara rahamata theke nirAza haYeA nA| nizcaYa AllAha samasta geAnAha mApha karena| tini kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|
teAmarA teAmAdera pAlanakartAra abhimUkhI hao evaM tA~ra AjJAvaha hao teAmAdera kAche AyAva AsAra pUrve| erapara teAmarA sAhAyyaprApta have nA;
teAmAdera prati avatIrNa uttama viSaYera anusaraNa kara teAmAdera kAche atarkite o ajJAtasAre AyAva AsAra pUrve,
yAte keu nA vale, hAYa, hAYa, AllAha sakAze Ami kartavye avahelA karechi evaM Ami ThATTA-vidrupakArIdera antarbhUkta chilAma|
athavA nA vale, AllAha yadi AmAke pathapradarzana karatena, tave avazyai Ami paraheyagAradera ekajana hatAma|
athavA AyAva pratyakSa karAra samaYa nA vale, yadi keAnarUpe ekavAra phire yete pAri, tave Ami satkarmaparAYaNa haYe yAva|
hA~, teAmAra kAche AmAra nirdeza esechila; ataHpara tumi tAke mithyA valechile, ahaMkAra karechile evaM kApheradera antarbhUkta haYe giYechile|
yArA AllAhara prati mithyA AreApa kare, keYAmatera dina Apani tAdera mukha kAla dekhavena| ahaMkArIdera AvAsasthala jAhAnnAme naYa ki?
Ara yArA ziraka theke ve~ce thAkata, AllAha tAderake sAphalyera sAthe mukti devena, tAderake aniSTa sparza karave nA evaM tArA cintitao have nA|
AllAha sarvakichura sraSTA evaM tini savakichura dAYitva grahaNa karena|
AsamAna o yamInera cAvi tA~rai nikaTa| yArA AllAhara AYAtasamUhake asvIkAra kare, tArAi kSatigrasta|
valuna, he murkharA, teAmarA ki AmAke AllAha vyatIta anyera evAdata karate Adeza karacha?
ApanAra prati evaM ApanAra pUrvavartIdera prati pratyAdeza haYeche, yadi AllAhara zarIka sthira karena, tave ApanAra karma niSphala have evaM Apani kSatigrastadera ekajana havena|
varaM AllAharai evAdata karuna evaM kRtajJadera antarbhukta thAkuna|

tArA AllAhake yathArtharUpe veAjheni| keYAmatera dina geATA pRthivI thAkave tA~ra hAtera muTheAte evaM AsamAna samUha bhA~ja karA avasthAYa thAkave tA~ra DAna hAte| tini pavitra| Ara erA yAke zarIka kare, tA theke tini aneka urdhve|

ziMgAYa phu~ka deYA have, phale AsamAna o yamIne yArA Ache savAi vehu~za haYe yAve, tave AllAha yAke icchA karena| ataHpara AvAra ziMgAYa phu~ka deYA have, tatkSaNAt tArA danDAYamAna haYe dekhate thAkave|
pRthivI tAra pAlanakartAra nUre udbhAsita have, AmalanAmA sthApana karA have, paYagamvaragaNa o sAkSIgaNake AnA have evaM sakalera madhye nyAYa vicAra karA have-tAdera prati juluma karA have nA|
pratyeke yA kareche, tAra pUrNa pratiphala deYA have| tArA yA kichu kare, se samparke AllAha samyaka avagata|

kApheraderake jAhAnnAmera dike dale dale hA~kiYe neYA have| tArA yakhana sekhAne peৗchAve, takhana tAra darajAsamUha khule deYA have evaM jAhAnnAmera rakSIrA tAderake valave, teAmAdera kAche ki teAmAdera madhya theke paYagamvara Aseni, yArA teAmAdera kAche teAmAdera pAlanakartAra AYAtasamUha AvRtti karata evaM satarka karata e dinera sAkSAtera vyApAre? tArA valave, hA~, kintu kApheradera prati zAstira hukumai vAstavAYita haYeche|
valA have, teAmarA jAhAnnAmera darajA diYe praveza kara, sekhAne cirakAla avasthAnera janye| kata nikRSTa ahaMkArIdera AvAsasthala|

yArA tAdera pAlanakartAke bhaYa karata tAderake dale dale jAnnAtera dike niYe yAoYA have| yakhana tArA ummukta darajA diYe jAnnAte peৗchAve evaM jAnnAtera rakSIrA tAderake valave, teAmAdera prati sAlAma, teAmarA sukhe thAka, ataHpara sadAsarvadA vasavAsera janye teAmarA jAnnAte praveza kara|

tArA valave, samasta prazaMsA AllAhara, yini AmAdera prati tA~ra oYAdA pUrNa karechena evaM AmAderake e bhUmira uttarAdhikArI karechena| AmarA jAnnAtera yekhAne icchA vasavAsa karava| mehanatakArIdera puraskAra katai camatkAra|

Apani pherezatAgaNake dekhavena, tArA Arazera cAra pAza ghire tAdera pAlanakartAra pavitratA gheASanA karache| tAdera savAra mAjhe nyAYa vicAra karA have| valA have, samasta prazaMsA vizvapAlaka AllAhara|
hA-mIma|
kitAva avatIrNa haYeche AllAhara pakSa theke, yini parAkramazAlI, sarvajJa|
pApa kSamAkArI, taovA kavulakArI, kaTheAra zAstidAtA o sAmarthyavAna tini vyatIta keAna upAsya nei| tA~rai dike have pratyAvartana|
kApherarAi kevala AllAhara AYAta samparke vitarka kare| kAjei nagarIsamUhe tAdera vicaraNa yena ApanAke vibhrAntite nA phele|

tAdera pUrve nUhera sampradAYa mithyAreApa karechila, Ara tAdera pare anya aneka dala o pratyeka sampradAYa nija nija paYagamvarake AkramaNa karAra icchA karechila evaM tArA mithyA vitarke pravRtta haYechila, yena satyadharmake vyartha kare dite pAre| ataHpara Ami tAderake pAkar3Ao karalAma| kemana chila AmAra zAsti|
ebhAve kApheradera velAYa ApanAra pAlanakartAra e vAkya satya hala ye, tArA jAhAnnAmI|

yArA Araza vahana kare evaM yArA tAra cArapAze Ache, tArA tAdera pAlanakartAra saprazaMsa pavitratA varNanA kare, tAra prati vizvAsa sthApana kare evaM muminadera janye kSamA prArthanA kare vale, he AmAdera pAlanakartA, ApanAra rahamata o jJAna savakichute parivyApta| ataeva, yArA taovA kare evaM ApanAra pathe cale, tAderake kSamA karuna evaM jAhAnnAmera AyAva theke rakSA karuna|

he AmAdera pAlanakartA, Ara tAderake dAkhila karuna cirakAla vasavAsera jAnnAte, yAra oYAdA Apani tAderake diYechena evaM tAdera vApa-dAdA, pati-patnI o santAnadera madhye yArA satkarma kare tAderake| nizcaYa Apani parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|
evaM Apani tAderake amaGgala theke rakSA karuna| Apani yAke sedina amaGgala theke rakSA karavena, tAra prati anugrahai karavena| eTAi mahAsAphalya|

yArA kAphera tAderake uccaHsvare valA have, teAmAdera nijedera prati teAmAdera Ajakera e kSeAbha apekSA AllAra kSeAbha adhika chila, yakhana teAmAderake ImAna Anate valA haYechila, ataHpara teAmarA kupharI karachila|
tArA valave he AmAdera pAlanakartA! Apani AmAderake du’vAra mRtyu diYechena evaM du’ vAra jIvana diYechena| ekhana AmAdera aparAdha svIkAra karachi| ataHpara ekhana o niskRtira keAna upAYa Ache ki?

teAmAdera e vipada e kAraNe ye, yakhana eka AllAhake DAkA hata, takhana teAmarA kAphera haYe yete yakhana tAra sAthe zarIkake DAkA hata takhana teAmarA vizvAsa sthApana karate| ekhana Adeza tAi, yA AllAha karavena, yini sarveAcca, mahAna|
tinii teAmAderake tA~ra nidarzanAvalI dekhAna evaM teAmAdera janye AkAza theke nAyila karena ruyI| cintA-bhAvanA tArAi kare, yArA AllAhara dike ruju thAke|
ataeva, teAmarA AllAhake khA~Ti vizvAsa sahakAre DAka, yadio kApherarA tA apachanda kare|
tinii suucca maryAdAra adhikArI, Arazera mAlika, tA~ra vAndAdera madhye yAra prati icchA tattvapUrNa viSaYAdi nAyila karena, yAte se sAkSAtera dina samparke sakalake satarka kare|
yedina tArA vera haYe par3ave, AllAhara kAche tAdera kichui geApana thAkave nA| Aja rAjatva kAra? eka pravala parAkrAnta AllAhara|
Aja pratyekei tAra kRtakarmera pratidAna pAve| Aja yuluma nei| nizcaYa AllAha druta hisAva grahaNakArI|

Apani tAderake Asanna dina samparke satarka karuna, yakhana prANa kanThAgata have, dama vandha haoYAra upakrama have| pApiSThadera janye keAna vandhu nei evaM supArizakArIo nei; yAra supAriza grAhya have|
ceAkhera curi evaM antarera geApana viSaYa tini jAnena|
AllAha phaYasAlA karena saThikabhAve, AllAhara parivarte tArA yAderake DAke, tArA kichui phaYasAlA kare nA| nizcaYa AllAha savakichu zunena, savakichu dekhena|

tArA ki deza-videza bhramaNa kare nA, yAte dekhata tAdera pUrvasuridera ki pariNAma haYeche? tAdera zakti o kIrti pRthivIte edera apekSA adhikatara chila| ataHpara AllAha tAderake tAdera geAnAhera kAraNe dhRta karechilena evaM AllAha theke tAderake rakSAkArI keu haYani|

era kAraNa ei ye, tAdera kAche tAdera rasUlagaNa suspaSTa nidarzanAvalI niYe Agamana karata, ataHpara tArA kAphera haYe yAYa, takhana AllAha tAdera dhRta karena| nizcaYa tini zaktidhara, kaTheAra zAstidAtA|
Ami AmAra nidarzanAvalI o spaSTa pramANasaha mUsAke preraNa karechi|
pherAuna, hAmAna o kAruNera kAche, ataHpara tArA valala, se teA jAdukara, mithyAvAdI|

ataHpara mUsA yakhana AmAra kAcha theke satyasaha tAdera kAche pau~chAla; takhana tArA valala, yArA tAra saGgI haYe vizvAsa sthApana kareche, tAdera putra santAnaderake hatyA kara, Ara tAdera nArIderake jIvita rAkha| kApheradera cakrAnta vyarthai haYeche|
pherAuna valala; teAmarA AmAke chAr3a, mUsAke hatyA karate dAo, DAkuka se tAra pAlanakartAke! Ami AzaMkA kari ye, se teAmAdera dharma parivartana kare deve athavA se dezamaYa viparyaYa sRSTi karave|
mUsA valala, yArA hisAva divase vizvAsa kare nA emana pratyeka ahaMkArI theke Ami AmAra o teAmAdera pAlanakartAra AzraYa niYe niYechi|

pherAuna geAtrera eka mumina vyakti, ye tAra ImAna geApana rAkhata, se valala, teAmarA ki ekajanake ejanye hatyA karave ye, se vale, AmAra pAlanakartA AllAha, athaca se teAmAdera pAlanakartAra nikaTa theke spaSTa pramANasaha teAmAdera nikaTa Agamana kareche? yadi se mithyAvAdI haYa, tave tAra mithyAvAditA tAra uparai cApave, Ara yadi se satyavAdI haYa, tave se ye zAstira kathA valache, tAra kichu nA kichu teAmAdera upara par3avei| nizcaYa AllAha sImAlaMghanakArI, mithyAvAdIke patha pradarzana karena nA|

he AmAra kaoma, Aja edeze teAmAderai rAjatva, dezamaYa teAmarAi vicaraNa karacha; kintu AmAdera AllAhara zAsti ese gele ke AmAderake sAhAyya karave? pherAuna valala, Ami yA vujhi, teAmAderake tAi veAjhAi, Ara Ami teAmAderake maGgalera pathai dekhAi|
se mumina vyakti valalaH he AmAra kaoma, Ami teAmAdera janye pUrvavartI sampradAYasamUhera matai vipadasaGkula dinera AzaMkA kari|
yemana, kaome nUha, Ada, sAmuda o tAdera paravartIdera avasthA haYechila| AllAha vAndAdera prati keAna yuluma karAra icchA karena nA|
he AmAra kaoma, Ami teAmAdera janye pracanDa hA~ka-DAkera dinera AzaMkA kari|
yedina teAmarA pechane phire palAYana karave; kintu AllAha theke teAmAderake rakSAkArI keu thAkave nA| AllAha yAke pathabhraSTa karena, tAra keAna pathapradarzaka nei|

itipUrve teAmAdera kAche iusupha suspaSTa prAmANAdisaha Agamana karechila, ataHpara teAmarA tAra AnIta viSaYe sandehai peASaNa karate| avazeSe yakhana se mArA gela, takhana teAmarA valate zuru karale, AllAha iusuphera pare Ara kAuke rasUlarUpe pAThAvena nA| emanibhAve AllAha sImAlaMghanakArI, saMzaYI vyaktike pathabhraSTa karena|

yArA nijedera kAche Agata keAna dalIla chAr3Ai AllAhara AYAta samparke vitarka kare, tAdera ekajana AllAha o muminadera kAche khuvai asanteASajanaka| emanibhAve AllAha pratyeka ahaMkArI-svairAcArI vyaktira antare meAhara e~Te dena|
pherAuna valala, he hAmAna, tumi AmAra janye ekaTi suucca prAsAda nirmANa kara, haYateA Ami pau~che yete pArava|

AkAzera pathe, ataHpara u~ki mere dekhava mUsAra AllAhake| vastutaH Ami teA tAke mithyAvAdIi mane kari| ebhAvei pherAunera kAche suzeAbhita karA haYechila tAra manda karmake evaM seAjA patha theke tAke virata rAkhA haYechila| pherAunera cakrAnta vyartha haoYArai chila|
mumina leAkaTi valalaH he AmAra kaoma, teAmarA AmAra anusaraNa kara| Ami teAmAderake satpatha pradarzana karava|
he AmAra kaoma, pArthiva e jIvana teA kevala upabheAgera vastu, Ara parakAla hacche sthAYI vasavAsera gRha|
ye manda karma kare, se kevala tAra anurUpa pratiphala pAve, Ara ye, puruSa athavA nArI mumina avasthAYa satkarma kare tArAi jAnnAte praveza karave| tathAYa tAderake ve-hisAva riyika deYA have|
he AmAra kaoma, vyApAra ki, Ami teAmAderake dAoYAta dei muktira dike, Ara teAmarA AmAke dAoYAta dAo jAhAnnAmera dike|

teAmarA AmAke dAoYAta dAo, yAte Ami AllAhake asvIkAra kari evaM tA~ra sAthe zarIka kari emana vastuke, yAra keAna pramANa AmAra kAche nei| Ami teAmAderake dAoYAta dei parAkramazAlI, kSamAzIla AllAhara dike|
ete sandeha nei ye, teAmarA AmAke yAra dike dAoYAta dAo, haikAle o parakAle tAra keAna dAoYAta nei! AmAdera pratyAvartana AllAhara dike evaM sImA laMghakArIrAi jAhAnnAmI|
Ami teAmAderake yA valachi, teAmarA ekadina tA smaraNa karave| Ami AmAra vyApAra AllAhara kAche samarpaNa karachi| nizcaYa vAndArA AllAhara dRSTite raYeche|
ataHpara AllAha tAke tAdera cakrAntera aniSTa theke rakSA karalena evaM pherAuna geAtrake zeAcanIYa AyAva grAsa karala|
sakAle o sandhyAYa tAderake Agunera sAmane peza karA haYa evaM yedina keYAmata saMghaTita have, sedina Adeza karA have, pherAuna geAtrake kaThinatara AyAve dAkhila kara|

yakhana tArA jAhAnnAme paraspara vitarka karave, ataHpara dUrvalarA ahaMkArIderake valave, AmarA teAmAdera anusArI chilAma| teAmarA ekhana jAhAnnAmera Agunera kichu aMza AmAdera theke nivRta karave ki?
ahaMkArIrA valave, AmarA savAi teA jAhAnnAme Achi| AllAha tA~ra vAndAdera phaYasAlA kare diYechena|
yArA jAhAnnAme Ache, tArA jAhAnnAmera rakSIderake valave, teAmarA teAmAdera pAlanakartAke vala, tini yena AmAdera theke ekadinera AyAva lAghava kare dena|
rakSIrA valave, teAmAdera kAche ki suspaSTa pramANAdisaha teAmAdera rasUla Asenani? tArA valave hA~| rakSIrA valave, tave teAmarAi deAYA kara| vastutaH kApheradera deAYA nisphalai haYa|
Ami sAhAyya karava rasUlagaNake o muminagaNake pArthiva jIvane o sAkSIdera danDAYamAna haoYAra divase|
se dina yAlemadera oyara-Apatti keAna upakAre Asave nA, tAdera janye thAkave abhizApa evaM tAdera janye thAkave manda gRha|
nizcaYa Ami mUsAke hedAYeta dAna karechilAma evaM vanI isarAIlake kitAvera uttarAdhikArI karechilAma|
vuddhimAnadera janye upadeza o hedAYeta svarUpa|
ataeva, Apani savara karuna nizcaYa AllAhara oYAdA satya| Apani ApanAra geAnAhera janye kSamA prarthanA karuna evaM sakAla-sandhyAYa ApanAra pAlanakartAra prazaMsAsaha pavitratA varNanA karuna|

nizcaYa yArA AllAhara AYAta samparke vitarka kare tAdera kAche Agata keAna dalIla vyatireke, tAdera antare Ache kevala AtnambharitA, yA arjane tArA saphala have nA| ataeva, Apani AllAhara AzraYa prArthanA karuna| nizcaYa tini savakichu zunena, savakichu dekhena|
mAnuSera sRSTi apekSA nabheAmanDala o bhU-manDalera sRSTi kaThinatara| kintu adhikAMza mAnuSa veAjhe nA|
andha o cakSuSmAna samAna naYa, Ara yArA vizvAsa sthApana kare o satkarma kare evaM kukarmI| teAmarA alpai anudhAvana kare thAka|
keYAmata avazyai Asave, ete sandeha nei; kinta adhikAMza leAka vizvAsa sthApana kare nA|
teAmAdera pAlanakartA valena, teAmarA AmAke DAka, Ami sAr3A deva| yArA AmAra evAdate ahaMkAra kare tArA satvarai jAhAnnAme dAkhila have lAJchita haYe|
tinii AllAha yini rAtra sRSTi karechena teAmAdera vizrAmera janye evaM divasake karechena dekhAra janye| nizcaYa AllAha mAnuSera prati anugrahazIla, kintu adhikAMza mAnuSa kRtajJatA svIkAra kare nA|
tini AllAha, teAmAdera pAlanakartA, sava kichura sraSTA| tini vyatIta keAna upAsya nei| ataeva teAmarA keAthAYa vibhrAnta haccha?
emanibhAve tAderake vibhrAnta karA haYa, yArA AllAhara AYAtasamUhake asvIkAra kare|

AllAha, pRthivIke karechena teAmAdera janye vAsasthAna, AkAzake karechena chAda evaM tini teAmAderake AkRti dAna karechena, ataHpara teAmAdera AkRti sundara karechena evaM tini teAmAderake dAna karechena paricchanna riyika| tini AllAha, teAmAdera pAlanakartA| vizvajagatera pAlanakartA, AllAha varakatamaYa|
tini ciraJjIva, tini vyatIta keAna upAsya nei| ataeva, tA~ke DAka tA~ra khA~Ti evAdatera mAdhyame| samasta prazaMsA vizvajagatera pAlanakartA AllAhara|

valuna, yakhana AmAra kAche AmAra pAlanakartAra pakSa theke spaSTa pramANAdi ese geche, takhana AllAha vyatIta teAmarA yAra pUjA kara, tAra evAdata karate AmAke niSedha karA haYeche| AmAke Adeza karA haYeche vizva pAlanakartAra anugata thAkate|

tini teA teAmAdera sRSTi karechena mATira dvArA, ataHpara zukravindu dvArA, ataHpara jamATa rakta dvArA, ataHpara teAmAderake vera karena zizurUpe, ataHpara teAmarA yeৗvane padarpaNa kara, ataHpara vArdhakye upanIta hao| teAmAdera kArao kArao era pUrvei mRtyu ghaTe evaM teAmarA nirdhArita kAle pau~cha evaM teAmarA yAte anudhAvana kara|
tinii jIvita karena evaM mRtyu dena| yakhana tini keAna kAjera Adeza karena, takhana ekathAi valena, haYe yA’-tA haYe yAYa|
Apani ki tAderake dekhenani, yArA AllAhara AYAta samparke vitarka kare, tArA keAthAYa phirache?
yArA kitAvera prati evaM ye viSaYa diYe Ami paYagamvaragaNake preraNa karechi, se viSaYera prati mithyAreApa kare| ataeva, satvarai tArA jAnate pArave|
yakhana ver3io zRGkhala tAdera galadeze par3ave| tAderake Tene niYe yAoYA have|
phuTanta pAnite, ataHpara tAderake Agune jvAlAneA have|
ataHpara tAderake valA have, keAthAYa gela yAderake teAmarA zarIka karate|
AllAha vyatIta? tArA valave, tArA AmAdera kAcha theke udhAo haYe geche; varaM AmarA teA itipUrve keAna kichura pUjAi karatAma nA| emani bhAve AllAha kApheraderake vibhrAnta karena|
eTA ekAraNe ye, teAmarA duniYAte anyAYabhAve Ananda-ullAsa karate evaM e kAraNe ye, teAmarA auddhatya karate|
praveza kara teAmarA jAhAnnAmera darajA diYe sekhAne cirakAla vasavAsera janye| kata nikRSTa dAmbhikadera AvAsasthala|

ataeva Apani savara karuna| nizcaYa AllAhara oYAdA satya| ataHpara Ami kApheraderake ye zAstira oYAdA dei, tAra kiYadaMza yadi ApanAke dekhiYe dei athavA ApanAra prANa haraNa kare nei, sarvAvasthAYa tArA teA AmArai kAche phire Asave|

Ami ApanAra pUrve aneka rasUla preraNa karechi, tAdera kArao kArao ghaTanA ApanAra kAche vivRta karechi evaM kArao kArao ghaTanA ApanAra kAche vivRta karini| AllAhara anumati vyatIta keAna nidarzana niYe AsA keAna rasUlera kAja naYa| yakhana AllAhara Adeza Asave, takhana nyAYa saGgata phaYasAlA haYe yAve| sekSetre mithyApanthIrA kSatigrasta have|
AllAha teAmAdera janye catuspada jantu sRSTi karechena, yAte keAna keAnaTii vAhana hisAve vyavahAra kara evaM keAna keAnaTike bhakSaNa kara|

tAte teAmAdera janye aneka upakAritA raYeche Ara ejanye sRSTi karechena; yAte seguleAte AreAhaNa kare teAmarA teAmAdera abhISTa praYeAjana pUrNa karate pAra| eguleAra upara evaM neৗkAra upara teAmarA vAhita hao|
tini teAmAderake tA~ra nidarzanAvalI dekhAna| ataeva, teAmarA AllAhara keAna keAna nidarzanake asvIkAra karave?

tArA ki pRthivIte bhramaNa kareni? karale dekhata, tAdera pUrvavartIdera ki pariNAma haYeche| tArA tAdera ceYe saMkhyAYa vezI evaM zakti o kIrtite adhika pravala chila, ataHpara tAdera karma tAderake keAna upakAra deYani|

tAdera kAche yakhana tAdera rasUlagaNa spaSTa pramANAdisaha Agamana karechila, takhana tArA nijedera jJAna-garimAra dambha prakAza karechila| tArA ye viSaYa niYe ThATTAvidrupa karechila, tAi tAderake grAsa kare niYechila|
tArA yakhana AmAra zAsti pratyakSa karala, takhana valala, AmarA eka AllAhara prati vizvAsa karalAma evaM yAderake zarIka karatAma, tAderake parihAra karalAma|

ataHpara tAdera e ImAna tAdera keAna upakAre Asala nA yakhana tArA zAsti pratyakSa karala| AllAhara e niYamai pUrva theke tA~ra vAndAdera madhye pracalita haYeche| sekSetre kApherarA kSatigrasta haYa|
hA-mIma|
eTA avatIrNa parama karuNAmaYa, daYAlura pakSa theke|
eTA kitAva, era AYAtasamUha vizadabhAve vivRta AravI keAraAnarUpe jJAnI leAkadera janya|
susaMvAdadAtA o satarkakArIrUpe, ataHpara tAdera adhikAMzai mukha phiriYe niYeche, tArA zune nA|

tArA vale Apani ye viSaYera dike AmAdera ke dAoYAta dena, se viSaYe AmAdera antara AvaraNe AvRta, AmAdera karNe Ache veAjhA evaM AmAdera o ApanAra mAjhakhAne Ache antarAla| ataeva, Apani ApanAra kAja karuna evaM AmarA AmAdera kAja kari|

valuna, Amio teAmAdera matai mAnuSa, AmAra prati ohI Ase ye, teAmAdera mAvuda ekamAtra mAvuda, ataeva tA~ra dikei seAjA haYe thAka evaM tA~ra kAche kSamA prArthanA kara| Ara muzarikadera janye raYeche durbheAga,
yArA yAkAta deYa nA evaM parakAlake asvIkAra kare|
nizcaYa yArA vizvAsa sthApana kare o satkarma kare, tAdera janye raYeche aphuranta puraskAra|
valuna, teAmarA ki se sattAke asvIkAra kara yini pRthivI sRSTi karechena du’dine evaM teAmarA ki tA~ra samakakSa sthIra kara? tini teA samagra vizvera pAlanakartA|
tini pRthivIte uparibhAge aTala parvatamAlA sthApana karechena, tAte kalyANa nihita rekhechena evaM cAra dinera madhye tAte tAra khAdyera vyavasthA karechena-pUrNa hala jijJAsudera janye|
ataHpara tini AkAzera dike maneAyeAga dilena yA chila dhumrakuJja, ataHpara tini tAke o pRthivIke valalena, teAmarA ubhaYe Asa icchAYa athavA anicchAYa| tArA valala, AmarA svecchAYa AsalAma|

ataHpara tini AkAzamanDalIke du’dine sapta AkAza kare dilena evaM pratyeka AkAze tAra Adeza preraNa karalena| Ami nikaTavartI AkAzake pradIpamAlA dvArA suzeAbhita o saMrakSita karechi| eTA parAkramazAlI sarvajJa AllAhara vyavasthApanA|
ataHpara yadi tArA mukha phiriYe neYa, tave valuna, Ami teAmAderake satarka karalAma eka kaTheAra AyAva samparke Ada o sAmudera AyAvera mata|

yakhana tAdera kAche rasUlagaNa esechilena sammukha dika theke evaM pichana dika theke e kathA valate ye, teAmarA AllAha vyatIta kArao pUjA kareA nA| tArA valechila, AmAdera pAlanakartA icchA karale avazyai pherezatA preraNa karatena, ataeva, AmarA teAmAdera AnIta viSaYa amAnya karalAma|

yArA chila Ada, tArA pRthivIte ayathA ahaMkAra karala evaM valala, AmAdera apekSA adhika zaktidhara ke? tArA ki lakSya kareni ye, ye AllAha tAderake sRSTi karechena, tini tAdera apekSA adhika zaktidhara? vastutaH tArA AmAra nidarzanAvalI asvIkAra karata|

ataHpara Ami tAderake pArthiva jIvane lAJchanAra AyAva AsvAdana karAneAra janye tAdera upara preraNa karalAma jhaJjhAvAYu veza katipaYa azubha dine| Ara parakAlera AyAva teA Arao lAJchanAkara ematAvasthAYa ye, tArA sAhAyyaprApta have nA|

Ara yArA sAmUda, Ami tAderake pradarzana karechilAma, ataHpara tArA satpathera parivarte andha thAkAi pachanda karala| ataHpara tAdera kRtakarmera kAraNe tAderake avamAnanAkara AyAvera vipada ese dhRta karala|
yArA vizvAsa sthApana karechila o sAvadhAne calata, Ami tAderake uddhAra karalAma|
yedina AllAhara zatruderake agnikunDera dike Thele neoYA have| evaM odera vinyasta karA have vibhinna dale|
tArA yakhana jAhAnnAmera kAche pau~chAve, takhana tAdera kAna, cakSu o tvaka tAdera karma samparke sAkSya deve|

tArA tAdera tvakake valave, teAmarA AmAdera vipakSe sAkSya dile kena? tArA valave, ye AllAha sava kichuke vAkazakti diYechena, tini AmAderakeo vAkazakti diYechena| tinii teAmAderake prathamavAra sRSTi karechena evaM teAmarA tA~rai dike pratyAvartita have|

teAmAdera kAna, teAmAdera cakSu evaM teAmAdera tvaka teAmAdera vipakSe sAkSya deve nA dhAraNAra vazavartI haYe teAmarA tAdera kAche kichu geApana karate nA| tave teAmAdera dhAraNA chila ye, teAmarA yA kara tAra aneka kichui AllAha jAnena nA|
teAmAdera pAlanakartA samvandhe teAmAdera e dhAraNAi teAmAderake dhvaMsa kareche| phale teAmarA kSatigrastadera antarbhukta haYe gecha|
ataHpara yadi tArA savara kare, tavuo jAhAnnAmai tAdera AvAsasthala| Ara yadi tArA oyarakhAhI kare, tave tAdera oyara kavula karA have nA|

Ami tAdera pechane saGgI lAgiYe diYechilAma, ataHpara saGgIrA tAdera agra-pazcAtera Amala tAdera dRSTite zeAbhanIYa kare diYechila| tAdera vyApAreo zAstira Adeza vAstavAYita hala, yA vAstavAYita haYechila tAdera pUrvavatI jina o mAnuSera vyApAre| nizcaYa tArA kSatigrasta|
Ara kApherarA vale, teAmarA e keAraAna zravaNa kareA nA evaM era AvRttite haJjageAla sRSTi kara, yAte teAmarA jaYI hao|
Ami avazyai kApheraderake kaThina AyAva AsvAdana karAva evaM Ami avazyai tAderake tAdera manda o hIna kAjera pratiphala deva|
eTA AllAhara zatrudera zAsti-jAhAnnAma| tAte tAdera janye raYeche sthAYI AvAsa, AmAra AYAtasamUha asvIkAra karAra pratiphalasvarUpa|
kApherarA valave, he AmAdera pAlanakartA! yesava jina o mAnuSa AmAderake pathabhraSTa karechila, tAderake dekhiYe dAo, AmarA tAderake padadalita karava, yAte tArA yatheSTa apamAnita haYa|

nizcaYa yArA vale, AmAdera pAlanakartA AllAha, ataHpara tAtei avicala thAke, tAdera kAche pherezatA avatIrNa haYa evaM vale, teAmarA bhaYa kareA nA, cintA kareA nA evaM teAmAdera pratizruta jAnnAtera susaMvAda zeAna|
ihakAle o parakAle AmarA teAmAdera vandhu| sekhAne teAmAdera janya Ache yA teAmAdera mana cAYa evaM sekhAne teAmAdera janye Ache teAmarA dAvI kara|
eTA kSamAzIla karunAmaYera pakSa theke sAdara ApyAYana|
ye AllAhara dike dAoYAta deYa, satkarma kare evaM vale, Ami ekajana AjJAvaha, tAra kathA apekSA uttama kathA Ara kAra?
samAna naYa bhAla o manda| jaoYAve tAi valuna yA utkRSTa| takhana dekhavena ApanAra sAthe ye vyaktira zutrutA raYeche, se yena antaraGga vandhu|
e caritra tArAi lAbha kare, yArA savara kare evaM e caritrera adhikArI tArAi haYa, yArA atyanta bhAgyavAna|
yadi zaYatAnera pakSa theke Apani kichu kumantraNA anubhava karena, tave AllAhara zaraNApanna heAna| nizcaYa tini sarvazreAtA, sarvajJa|

tA~ra nidarzanasamUhera madhye raYeche divasa, rajanI, sUrya o candra| teAmarA sUryake sejadA kareA nA, candrakeo nA; AllAhake sejadA kara, yini eguleA sRSTi karechena, yadi teAmarA niSThAra sAthe zudhumAtra tA~rai evAdata kara|
ataHpara tArA yadi ahaMkAra kare, tave yArA ApanAra pAlanakartAra kAche Ache, tArA divArAtri tA~ra pavitratA gheASaNA kare evaM tArA klAnta haYa nA|

tA~ra eka nidarzana ei ye, tumi bhUmike dekhave anurvara par3e Ache| ataHpara Ami yakhana tAra upara vRSTi varSaNa kari, takhana se zasyazyAmala o sphIta haYa| nizcaYa yini eke jIvita karena, tini jIvita karavena mRtaderakeo| nizcaYa tini savakichu karate sakSama|

nizcaYa yArA AmAra AYAtasamUhera vyApAre vakratA avalamvana kare, tArA AmAra kAche geApana naYa| ye vyakti jAhAnnAme nikSipta have se zreSTha, nA ye keYAmatera dina nirApade Asave? teAmarA yA icchA kara, nizcaYa tini dekhena yA teAmarA kara|
nizcaYa yArA keAraAna AsAra para tA asvIkAra kare, tAdera madhye cintA-bhAvanAra abhAva raYeche| eTA avazyai eka sammAnita grantha|
ete mithyAra prabhAva nei, sAmanera dika thekeo nei evaM pechana dika thekeo nei| eTA prajJAmaYa, prazaMsita AllAhara pakSa theke avatIrNa|
ApanAke teA tAi valA haYa, yA valA hata pUrvavartI rasUlaganake| nizcaYa ApanAra pAlanakartAra kAche raYeche kSamA evaM raYeche yantraNAdAYaka zAsti|

Ami yadi eke anArava bhASAYa keAraAna karatAma, tave avazyai tArA valata, era AYAtasamUha pariskAra bhASAYa vivRta haYani kena? ki Azcarya ye, kitAva anArava bhASAYa Ara rasUla AravI bhASI! valuna, eTA vizvAsIdera janya hedAYeta o reAgera pratikAra| yArA mumina naYa, tAdera kAne Ache chipi, Ara keAraAna tAdera janye andhatva| tAderake yena dUravartI sthAna theke AhavAna karA haYa|

Ami mUsAke kitAva diYechilAma, ataHpara tAte matabheda sRSTi haYa| ApanAra pAlanakartAra pakSa theke pUrva siddhAnta nA thAkale tAdera madhye phaYasAlA haYe yeta| tArA keAraAna samandhe eka asvastikara sandehe lipta|
ye satkarma kare, se nijera upakArera janyei kare, Ara ye asatkarma kare, tA tAra uparai vartAve| ApanAra pAlanakartA vAndAdera prati meATei yuluma karena nA|

keYAmatera jJAna ekamAtra tA~rai jAnA| tA~ra jJAnera vAire keAna phala AvaraNamukta haYa nA| evaM keAna nArI garbhadhAraNa o santAna prasava kare nA| yedina AllAha tAderake Deke valavena, AmAra zarIkarA keAthAYa? sedina tArA valave, AmarA ApanAke vale diYechi ye, AmAdera keu eTA svIkAra kare nA|
pUrve tArA yAdera pUjA karata, tArA udhAo haYe yAve evaM tArA vujhe neve ye, tAdera keAna niskRti nei|
mAnuSa unnati kAmanAYa klAnta haYa nA; yadi tAke amaGgala sparza kare, tave se sampUrNa rUpe nirAza haYe par3e|

vipadApada sparza karAra para Ami yadi tAke AmAra anugraha AsvAdana karAi, takhana se valate thAke, eTA ye AmAra yeAgya prApya; Ami mane kari nA ye, keYAmata saMghaTita have| Ami yadi AmAra pAlanakartAra kAche phire yAi, tave avazyai tAra kAche AmAra janya kalyANa raYeche| ataeva, Ami kApheraderake tAdera karma samparke avazyai avahita karava evaM tAderake avazyai AsvAdana karAva kaThina zAsti|
Ami yakhana mAnuSera prati anugraha kari takhana se mukha phiriYe neYa evaM pArzva parivartana kare| Ara yakhana tAke aniSTa sparza kare, takhana sudIrgha deAYA karate thAke|
valuna, teAmarA bheve dekhecha ki, yadi eTA AllAhara pakSa theke haYa, ataHpara teAmarA eke amAnya kara, tave ye vyakti gheAra vireAdhitAYa lipta, tAra cAite adhika pathabhraSTa Ara ke?

ekhana Ami tAderake AmAra nidarzanAvalI pradarzana karAva pRthivIra digante evaM tAdera nijedera madhye; phale tAdera kAche phuTe uThave ye, e keAraAna satya| ApanAra pAlanakartA sarvaviSaYe sAkSyadAtA, eTA ki yatheSTa naYa?
zune rAkha, tArA tAdera pAlanakartAra sAthe sAkSAtera vyApAre sandehe patita raYeche| zune rAkha, tini savakichuke pariveSTana kare raYechena|
hA-mIma|
Aina, sIna kvA-pha|
emanibhAve parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa AllAha ApanAra prati o ApanAra pUrvavartIdera prati ohI preraNa karena|
nabheAmanDale yA kichu Ache evaM bhUmanDale yA kichu Ache, samastai tA~ra| tini samunnata, mahAna|

AkAza upara theke pheTe par3Ara upakrama haYa Ara takhana pherezatAgaNa tAdera pAlanakartAra prazaMsAsaha pavitratA varNanA kare evaM pRthivIvAsIdera janye kSamA prArthanA kare| zune rAkha, AllAhai kSamAzIla, parama karunAmaYa|
yArA AllAha vyatIta aparake abhibhAvaka hisAve grahaNa kare, AllAha tAdera prati lakSya rAkhena| ApanAra upara naYa tAdera dAYa-dAYitva|

emani bhAve Ami ApanAra prati AravI bhASAYa keAraAna nAyila karechi, yAte Apani makkA o tAra Aza-pAzera leAkadera satarka karena evaM satarka karena samAvezera dina samparke, yAte keAna sandeha nei| ekadala jAnnAte evaM ekadala jAhAnnAme praveza karave|
AllAha icchA karale samasta leAkake eka dale pariNata karate pArena| kintu tini yAke icchA svIYa rahamate dAkhila karena| Ara yAlemadera keAna abhibhAvaka o sAhAyyakArI nei|
tArA ki AllAha vyatIta aparake abhibhAvaka sthira kareche? parantu AllAhai teA ekamAtra abhibhAvaka| tini mRtaderake jIvita karena| tini sarvaviSaYe kSamatAvAna|
teAmarA ye viSaYei matabheda kara, tAra phaYasAlA AllAhara kAche seAparda| inii AllAha AmAra pAlanakartA Ami tA~rai upara nirbhara kari evaM tA~rai abhimukhI hai|

tini nabheAmanDala o bhUmanDalera sraSTA| tini teAmAdera madhya theke teAmAdera janye yugala sRSTi karechena evaM catuspada jantudera madhya theke jeAr3A sRSTi karechena| ebhAve tini teAmAdera vaMza vistAra karena| keAna kichui tA~ra anurUpa naYa| tini sava zunena, sava dekhena|
AkAza o pRthivIra cAvi tA~ra kAche| tini yAra janye icchA riyika vRddhi karena evaM parimita karena| tini sarva viSaYe jJAnI|

tini teAmAdera janye dvInera kSetre se pathai nidhArita karechena, yAra Adeza diYechilena nUhake, yA Ami pratyAdeza karechi ApanAra prati evaM yAra Adeza diYechilAma ivrAhIma, mUsA o IsAke ei marme ye, teAmarA dvInake pratiSThita kara evaM tAte anaikya sRSTi kareA nA| Apani mUzarekaderake ye viSaYera prati AmantraNa jAnAna, tA tAdera kAche duHsAdhya vale mane haYa| AllAha yAke icchA maneAnIta karena evaM ye tA~ra abhimukhI haYa, tAke patha pradarzana karena|

tAdera kAche jJAna AsAra parai tArA pArasparika vibhedera kAraNe matabheda kareche| yadi ApanAra pAlanakartAra pakSa theke nirdiSTa samaYa paryanta avakAzera pUrva siddhAnta nA thAkata, tave tAdera phaYasAlA haYe yeta| tAdera para yArA kitAva prApta haYeche, tArA asvastikara sandehe patita raYeche|

sutarAM Apani era pratii dAoYAta dina evaM hukuma anuyAYI avicala thAkuna; Apani tAdera kheYAlakhuzIra anusaraNa karavena nA| valuna, AllAha ye kitAva nAyila karechena, Ami tAte vizvAsa sthApana karechi| Ami teAmAdera madhye nyAYa vicAra karate AdiSTa haYechi| AllAha AmAdera pAlanakartA o teAmAdera pAlanakartA| AmAdera janye AmAdera karma evaM teAmAdera janye teAmAdera karma| AmAdera madhye o teAmAdera madhye vivAda nei| AllAha AmAderake samaveta karavena evaM tA~rai dike pratyAvartaNa have|
AllAhara dvIna mene neYAra para yArA se samparke vitarke pravRtta haYa, tAdera vitarka tAdera pAlanakartAra kAche vAtila, tAdera prati AllAhara gayava evaM tAdera janye raYeche kaTheAra AyAva|
AllAhai satyasaha kitAva o inasAphera mAnadanDa nAyila karechena| Apani ki jAnena, sambhavataH keYAmata nikaTavartI|

yArA tAte vizvAsa kare nA tArA tAke tar3it kAmanA kare| Ara yArA vizvAsa kare, tArA tAke bhaYa kare evaM jAne ye, tA satya| jene rAkha, yArA keYAmata samparke vitarka kare, tArA dUravartI patha bhraSTatAYa lipta raYeche|
AllAha tA~ra vAndAdera prati daYAlu| tini yAke icchA, riyika dAna karena| tini pravala, parAkramazAlI|
ye keu parakAlera phasala kAmanA kare, Ami tAra janye sei phasala vAr3iYe dei| Ara ye ihakAlera phasala kAmanA kare, Ami tAke tAra kichu diYe dei evaM parakAle tAra keAna aMza thAkave nA|

tAdera ki emana zarIka devatA Ache, yArA tAdera janye se dharma siddha kareche, yAra anumati AllAha denani? yadi cur3Anta sindhAnta nA thAkata, tave tAdera vyApAre phaYasAlA haYe yeta| nizcaYa yAlemadera janye raYeche yantraNAdAYaka zAsti|

Apani kApheraderake tAdera kRtakarmera janye bhItasantrasta dekhavena| tAdera karmera zAsti avazyai tAdera upara patita have| Ara yArA mumina o satkarmI, tArA jAnnAtera udyAne thAkave| tArA yA cAive, tAi tAdera janye tAdera pAlanakartAra kAche raYeche| eTAi var3a puraskAra|

erai susaMvAda dena AllAha tAra sesava vAndAke, yArA vizvAsa sthApana kare o satkarma kare| valuna, Ami AmAra dAoYAtera janye teAmAdera kAche kevala AtnIYatAjanita seৗhArda cAi| ye keu uttama kAja kare, Ami tAra janye tAte puNya vAr3iYe dei| nizcaYa AllAha kSamAkArI, guNagrAhI|

nAki tArA ekathA vale ye, tini AllAhara viruddhe mithyA raTanA karechena? AllAha icchA karale ApanAra antare meAhara e~Te ditena| vastutaH tini mithyAke miTiYe dena evaM nija vAkya dvArA satyake pratiSThita karena| nizcaYa tini antarnihita viSaYa samparke sarvizeSa jJAta|
tini tA~ra vAndAdera taovA kavula karena pApasamUha mArjanA karena evaM teAmAdera kRta viSaYa samparke avagata raYechena|
tini mumina o satkarmIdera deAYA zeAnena evaM tAdera prati svIYa anugraha vAr3iYe dena| Ara kApheradera janye raYeche kaTheAra zAsti|

yadi AllAha tA~ra sakala vAndAke pracura riyika ditena, tave tArA pRthivIte viparyaYa sRSTi karata| kintu tini ye parimANa icchA se parimANa nAyila karena| nizcaYa tini tA~ra vAndAdera khavara rAkhena o savakichu dekhena|
mAnuSa nirAza haYe yAoYAra pare tini vRSTi varSaNa karena evaM svIYa rahamata char3iYe dena| tinii kAryanirvAhI, prazaMsita|
tA~ra eka nidarzana nabheAmanDala o bhUmanDalera sRSTi evaM etadubhaYera madhye tini yesava jIva-jantu char3iYe diYechena| tini yakhana icchA eguleAke ekatrita karate sakSama|
teAmAdera upara yesava vipada-Apada patita haYa, tA teAmAdera karmerai phala evaM tini teAmAdera aneka geAnAha kSamA kare dena|
teAmarA pRthivIte palAYana kare AllAhake akSama karate pAra nA evaM AllAha vyatIta teAmAdera keAna kAryanirvAhI nei, sAhAyyakArIo nei|
samudre bhAsamAna parvatasama jAhAjasamUha tA~ra anyatama nidarzana|
tini icchA karale vAtAsake thAmiYe dena| takhana jAhAjasamUha samudrapRSThe nizcala haYe par3e yena pAhAr3a| nizcaYa ete pratyeka savarakArI, kRtajJera janye nidarzanAvalI raYeche|
athavA tAdera kRtakarmera janye seguleAke dhvaMsa kare dena evaM anekake kSamAo kare dena|
evaM yArA AmAra kSamatA samparke vitarka kare, tArA yena jAne ye, tAdera keAna palAYanera jAYagA nei|

ataeva, teAmAderake yA deYA haYeche tA pArthiva jIvanera bheAga mAtra| Ara AllAhara kAche yA raYeche, tA utkRSTa o sthAYI tAdera janye yArA vizvAsa sthApana kare o tAdera pAlanakartAra upara bharasA kare|
yArA var3a geAnAha o azlIla kArya theke ve~ce thAke evaM kreAdhAmvita haYeo kSamA kare,
yArA tAdera pAlanakartAra Adeza mAnya kare, nAmAya kAYema kare; pArasparika parAmarzakrame kAja kare evaM Ami tAderake ye riyika diYechi, tA theke vyaYa kare,
yArA AkrAnta hale pratizeAdha grahaNa kare|
Ara mandera pratiphala teA anurUpa mandai| ye kSamA kare o ApeASa kare tAra puraskAra AllAhara kAche raYeche; nizcaYa tini atyAcArIderake pachanda karena nAi|
nizcaYa ye atyAcArita haoYAra para pratizeAdha grahaNa kare, tAdera viruddheo keAna abhiyeAga nei|
abhiyeAga kevala tAdera viruddhe, yArA mAnuSera upara atyAcAra cAlAYa evaM pRthivIte anyAYabhAve vidreAha kare ver3AYa| tAdera janye raYeche yantraNAdAYaka zAsti|
avazyai ye savara kare o kSamA kare nizcaYa eTA sAhasikatAra kAja|

AllAha yAke patha bhraSTa karena, tAra janye tini vyatIta keAna kAryanirvAhI nei| pApAcArIrA yakhana AyAva pratyakSa karave, takhana Apani tAderake dekhavena ye, tArA valache AmAdera phire yAoYAra keAna upAYa Ache ki?

jAhAnnAmera sAmane upasthita karAra samaYa Apani tAderake dekhavena, apamAne avanata evaM ardha nimIlita dRSTite tAkAYa| muminarA valave, keYAmatera dina kSatigrasta tArAi, yArA nijedera o tAdera parivAra-parijanera kSati sAdhana kareche| zune rAkha, pApAcArIrA sthAYI AyAve thAkave|
AllAha tA’AlA vyatIta tAdera keAna sAhAyyakArI thAkave nA, ye tAderake sAhAyya karave| AllAha tA’AlA yAke pathabhraSTa karena, tAra keAna gati nei|
AllAha tA’AlAra pakSa theke avazyambhAvI divasa AsAra pUrve teAmarA teAmAdera pAlanakartAra Adeza mAnya kara| sedina teAmAdera keAna AzraYasthala thAkave nA evaM tA nireAdhakArI keu thAkave nA|

yadi tArA mukha phiriYe neYa, tave ApanAke Ami tAdera rakSaka kare pAThAini| ApanAra kartavya kevala pracAra karA|Ami yakhana mAnuSake AmAra rahamata AsvAdana karAi, takhana se ullasita, Ara yakhana tAdera kRtakarmera kAraNe tAdera keAna aniSTa ghaTe, takhana mAnuSa khuva akRtajJa haYe yAYa|
nabheAmanDala o bhUmanDalera rAjatva AllAha tA’AlArai| tini yA icchA, sRSTi karena, yAke icchA kanyA-santAna evaM yAke icchA putra santAna dAna karena|
athavA tAderake dAna karena putra o kanyA ubhaYai evaM yAke icchA vandhyA kare dena| nizcaYa tini sarvajJa, kSamatAzIla|

keAna mAnuSera janya emana haoYAra naYa ye, AllAha tAra sAthe kathA valavena| kintu ohIra mAdhyame athavA pardAra antarAla theke athavA tini keAna dUta preraNa karavena, ataHpara AllAha yA cAna, se tA tA~ra anumatikrame pau~che deve| nizcaYa tini sarveAcca prajJAmaYa|

emanibhAve Ami ApanAra kAche eka pherezatA preraNa karechi AmAra Adezakrame| Apani jAnatena nA, kitAva ki evaM ImAna ki? kintu Ami eke karechi nUra, yAddvArA Ami AmAra vAndAdera madhya theke yAke icchA patha pradarzana kari| nizcaYa Apani sarala patha pradarzana karena-
AllAhara patha| nabheAmanDala o bhUmanDala yA kichu Ache, sava tA~rai| zune rAkha, AllAha tA’AlAra kAchei sava viSaYe pau~che|
hA-mIma|
zapatha suspaSTa kitAvera,
Ami eke karechi keAraAna, AravI bhASAYa, yAte teAmarA vujha|
nizcaYa e keAraAna AmAra kAche samunnata aTala raYeche laohe mAhaphuye|
teAmarA sImAtikramakArI sampradAYa-e kAraNe ki Ami teAmAdera kAcha theke keAraAna pratyAhAra kare neva?
pUrvavartI leAkadera kAche Ami aneka rasUlai preraNa karechi|
yakhanai tAdera kAche keAna rasUla Agamana karechena, takhanai tArA tA~ra sAthe ThATTA-vidrupa kareche|
sutarAM Ami tAdera ceYe adhika zakti sampannaderake dhvaMsa kare diYechi| pUrvavartIdera e ghaTanA atIta haYe geche|
Apani yadi tAderake jijJAsA karena ke nabheAmanDala o bhU-manDala sRSTi kareche? tArA avazyai valave, eguleA sRSTi karechena parAkramazAlI sarvajJa AllAha|
yini teAmAdera janye pRthivIke karechena vichAnA evaM tAte teAmAdera janye karechena patha, yAte teAmarA gantavyasthale pau~chate pAra|
evaM yini AkAza theke pAni varSaNa karechena parimita| AtaHpara taddvArA Ami mRta bhU-bhAgake punarujjIvita karechi| teAmarA emanibhAve utthita have|
evaM yini savakichura yugala sRSTi karechena evaM neৗkA o catuspada jantuke teAmAdera janye yAnavAhane pariNata karechena,

yAte teAmarA tAdera piThera upara AreAhaNa kara| ataHpara teAmAdera pAlanakartAra neYAmata smaraNa kara evaM vala pavitra tini, yini ederake AmAdera vazIbhUta kare diYechena evaM AmarA ederake vazIbhUta karate sakSama chilAma nA|
AmarA avazyai AmAdera pAlanakartAra dike phire yAva|
tArA AllAhara vAndAdera madhya theke AllAhara aMza sthira kareche| vAstavika mAnuSa spaSTa akRtajJa|
tini ki tA~ra sRSTi theke kanyA santAna grahaNa karechena evaM teAmAdera janya maneAnIta karechena putra santAna?
tArA rahamAna AllAhara janye ye, kanyA-santAna varNanA kare, yakhana tAdera kAuke tAra saMvAda deYA haYa, takhana tAra mukhamanDala kAleA haYe yAYa evaM bhISaNa manastApa bheAga kare|
tArA ki emana vyaktike AllAhara janye varNanA kare, ye alaMkAre lAlita-pAlita haYa evaM vitarke kathA valate akSama|
tArA nArI sthira kare pherezatAgaNake, yArA AllAhara vAndA| tArA ki tAdera sRSTi pratyakSa kareche? ekhana tAdera dAvI lipivaddha karA have evaM tAdera jijJAsA karA have|
tArA vale, rahamAna AllAha icchA nA karale AmarA odera pUjA karatAma nA| e viSaYe tArA kichui jAne nA| tArA kevala anumAne kathA vale|
Ami ki tAderake keAraAnera pUrve keAna kitAva diYechi, ataHpara tArA tAke A~kar3e rekheche?
varaM tArA vale, AmarA AmAdera pUrvapuruSaderake peYechi eka pathera pathika evaM AmarA tAderai padAMka anusaraNa kare pathaprApta|

emanibhAve ApanAra pUrve Ami yakhana keAna janapade keAna satarkakArI preraNa karechi, takhanai tAdera vittazAlIrA valeche, AmarA AmAdera pUrvapuruSaderake peYechi eka pathera pathika evaM AmarA tAderai padAMka anusaraNa kare calachi|

se valata, teAmarA teAmAdera pUrvapuruSaderake ye viSaYera upara peYecha, Ami yadi tadapekSA uttama viSaYa niYe teAmAdera kAche ese thAki, tavuo ki teAmarA tAi valave? tArA valata teAmarA ye viSaYasaha prerita haYecha, tA AmarA mAnava nA|
ataHpara Ami tAdera kAcha theke pratizeAdha niYechi| ataeva dekhuna, mithyAreApakArIdera pariNAma kirUpa haYeche|
yakhana ivrAhIma tAra pitA o sampradAYake valala, teAmarA yAdera pUjA kara, tAdera sAthe AmAra keAna samparka nei|
tave AmAra samparka tA~ra sAthe yini AmAke sRSTi karechena| ataeva, tinii AmAke satpatha pradarzana karavena|
e kathATike se akSaYa vANIrUpe tAra santAnadera madhye rekhe geche, yAte tArA AllAhara dikei AkRSTa thAke|
paranta Amii ederake o edera pUrvapuruSaderake jIvaneApabheAga karate diYechi, avazeSe tAdera kAche satya o spaSTa varNanAkArI rasUla Agamana kareche|
yakhana satya tAdera kAche Agamana karala, takhana tArA valala, eTA yAdu, AmarA eke mAni nA|
tArA vale, keAraAna kena dui janapadera keAna pradhAna vyaktira upara avatIrNa hala nA?

tArA ki ApanAra pAlanakartAra rahamata vanTana kare? Ami tAdera madhye tAdera jIvikA vanTana karechi pArthiva jIvane evaM ekera maryAdAke aparera upara unnIta karechi, yAte eke aparake sevaka rUpe grahaNa kare| tArA yA saJcaYa kare, ApanAra pAlanakartAra rahamata tadapekSA uttama|

yadi sava mAnuSera eka matAvalamvI haYe yAoYAra AzaMkA nA thAkata, tave yArA daYAmaYa AllAhake asvIkAra kare Ami tAderake ditAma tAdera gRhera janye reৗpya nirmita chAda o si~r3i, yAra upara tArA car3ata|
evaM tAdera gRhera janye darajA ditAma evaM pAlaMka ditAma yAte tArA helAna diYe vasata|
evaM svarNanirmitao ditAma| eguleA savai teA pArthiva jIvanera bheAga sAmagrI mAtra| Ara parakAla ApanAra pAlanakartAra kAche tA~dera janyei yArA bhaYa kare|
ye vyakti daYAmaYa AllAhara smaraNa theke ceAkha phiriYe neYa, Ami tAra janye eka zaYatAna niYeAjita kare dei, ataHpara se-i haYa tAra saGgI|
zaYatAnarAi mAnuSake satpathe vAdhA dAna kare, Ara mAnuSa mane kare ye, tArA satpathe raYeche|
avazeSe yakhana se AmAra kAche Asave, takhana se zaYatAnake valave, hAYa, AmAra o teAmAra madhye yadi pUrva-pazcimera dUratva thAkata| kata hIna saGgI se|
teAmarA yakhana kuphara karachile, takhana teAmAdera Ajakera AyAve zarIka haoYA keAna kAje Asave nA|
Apani ki vadhirake zeAnAte pAravena? athavA ye andha o ye spaSTa patha bhraSTatAYa lipta, tAke patha pradarzaNa karate pAravena?
ataHpara Ami yadi ApanAke niYe yAi, tavu Ami tAdera kAche theke pratizeAdha neva|
athavA yadi Ami tAderake ye AyAvera oYAdA diYechi, tA ApanAke dekhiYe dei, tavu tAdera upara AmAra pUrNa kSamatA raYeche|
ataeva, ApanAra prati ye ohI nAyila karA haYa, tA dRr3habhAve avalamvana karuna| niHsandehe Apani sarala pathe raYechena|
eTA ApanAra o ApanAra sampradAYera janye ullekhita thAkave evaM zIghrai ApanArA jijJAsita havena|
ApanAra pUrve Ami yesava rasUla preraNa karechi, tAderake jijJesa karuna, daYAmaYa AllAha vyatIta Ami ki keAna upAsya sthira karechilAma evAdatera janye?
Ami mUsAke AmAra nidarzanAvalI diYe pherAuna o tAra pariSadavargera kAche preraNa karechilAma, ataHpara se valechila, Ami vizva pAlanakartAra rasUla|
ataHpara se yakhana tAdera kAche AmAra nidarzanAvalI upasthApana karala, takhana tArA hAsyavidrupa karate lAgala|
Ami tAderake ye nidarzanai dekhAtAma, tAi hata pUrvavartI nidarzana apekSA vRhat evaM Ami tAderake zAsti dvArA pAkar3Ao karalAma, yAte tArA phire Ase|
tArA valala, he yAdukara, tumi AmAdera janye teAmAra pAlanakartAra kAche se viSaYa prArthanA kara, yAra oYAdA tini teAmAke diYechena; AmarA avazyai satpatha avalamvana karava|
ataHpara yakhana Ami tAdera theke AyAva pratyAhAra kare nilAma, takhanai tArA aGgIkAra bhaGga karate lAgaleA|
pherAuna tAra sampradAYake Deke valala, he AmAra kaoma, Ami ki misarera adhipati nai? ei nadI guleA AmAra nimnadeze pravAhita haYa, teAmarA ki dekha nA?
Ami ye zreSTa e vyakti theke, ye nIca evaM kathA valateo sakSama naYa|
tAke kena svarNavalaYa paridhAna karAneA hala nA, athavA kena Asala nA tAra saGge pherezatAgaNa dala ve~dhe?
ataHpara se tAra sampradAYake veAkA vAniYe dila, phale tArA tAra kathA mene nila| nizcaYa tArA chila pApAcArI sampradAYa|
ataHpara yakhana AmAke rAgAmvita karala takhana Ami tAdera kAcha theke pratizeAdha nilAma evaM nimajjata karalAma| tAdera savAike|
ataHpara Ami tAderake kare dilAma atIta leAka o dRSTAnta paravartIdera janye|
yakhanai mariYama tanaYera dRSTAnta varNanA karA hala, takhanai ApanAra sampradAYa haJjageAla zuru kare dila
evaM valala, AmAdera upAsyarA zreSTha, nA se? tArA ApanAra sAmane ye udAharaNa upasthApana kare tA kevala vitarkera janyei kare| vastutaH tArA hala eka vitarkakArI sampradAYa|
se teA eka vAndAi vaTe Ami tAra prati anugraha karechi evaM tAke karechi vaNI-isarAIlera janye Adarza|
Ami icchA karale teAmAdera theke pherezatA sRSTi karatAma, yArA pRthivIte ekera para eka vasavAsa karata|
sutarAM tA hala keYAmatera nidarzana| kAjei teAmarA keYAmate sandeha kareA nA evaM AmAra kathA mAna| eTA eka sarala patha|
zaYatAna yena teAmAderake nivRtta nA kare| se teAmAdera prakAzya zutru|

IsA yakhana spaSTa nidarzanasaha Agamana karala, takhana valala, Ami teAmAdera kAche prajJA niYe esechi evaM teAmarA ye, keAna keAna viSaYe matabheda karacha tA vyakta karAra janye esechi, ataeva, teAmarA AllAhake bhaYa kara evaM AmAra kathA mAna|
nizcaYa AllAhai AmAra pAlanakartA o teAmAdera pAlanakartA| ataeva, tA~ra evAdata kara| eTA hala sarala patha|
ataHpara tAdera madhye theke vibhinna dala matabheda sRSTi karala| sutarAM yAlemadera janye raYeche yantraNAdAYaka divasera AyAvera durbheAga|
tArA kevala keYAmaterai apekSA karache ye, AkasmikabhAve tAdera kAche ese yAve evaM tArA khavara o rAkhave nA|
vandhuvarga sedina eke aparera zatru have, tave kheAdAbhIrurA naYa|
he AmAra vAndAgaNa, teAmAdera Aja keAna bhaYa nei evaM teAmarA duHkhitao have nA|
teAmarA AmAra AYAtasamUhe vizvAsa sthApana karechile evaM teAmarA AjJAvaha chile|
jAnnAtera praveza kara teAmarA evaM teAmAdera vivigaNa sAnande|
tAdera kAche parivezana karA have svarNera thAlA o pAnapAtra evaM tathAYa raYeche mane yA cAYa evaM naYana yAte tRpta haYa| teAmarA tathAYa cirakAla avasthAna karave|
ei ye, jAnnAtera uttarAdhikArI teAmarA haYecha, eTA teAmAdera karmera phala|
tathAYa teAmAdera janye Ache pracura phala-mUla, tA theke teAmarA AhAra karave|
nizcaYa aparAdhIrA jAhAnnAmera AyAve cirakAla thAkave|
tAdera theke AyAva lAghava karA have nA evaM tArA tAtei thAkave hatAza haYe|
Ami tAdera prati juluma karini; kintu tArAi chila jAlema|
tArA Deke valave, he mAleka, pAlanakartA AmAdera kisasAi zeSa kare dina| se valave, nizcaYa teAmarA cirakAla thAkave|
Ami teAmAdera kAche satyadharma pau~chiYechi; kintu teAmAdera adhikAMzai satyadharme nispRha!
tArA ki keAna vyavasthA cur3Anta kareche? tAhale Amio eka vyavasthA cur3Anta karechi|
tArA ki mane kare ye, Ami tAdera geApana viSaYa o geApana parAmarza zuni nA? hA~, zuni| AmAra pherezatAgaNa tAdera nikaTe theke lipivaddha kare|
valuna, daYAmaYa AllAhara keAna santAna thAkale Ami sarva prathama tAra evAdata karava|
tArA yA varNanA kare, tA theke nabheAmanDala o bhUmanDalera pAlanakartA, Arazera pAlanakartA pavitra|
ataeva, tAderake vAkacAturI o krIr3A-keৗtuka karate dina sei divasera sAkSAta paryanta, yAra oYAdA tAderake deYA haYa|
tinii upAsya nabheAmanDale evaM tinii upAsya bhumanDale| tini prajJAmaYa, sarvajJa,
varakatamaYa tinii, nabheAmanDala, bhUmanDala o etadubhaYera madhyavartI savakichu yAra| tA~rai kAche Ache keYAmatera jJAna evaM tA~rai dike teAmarA pratyAvartita have|
tini vyatIta tArA yAdera pujA kare, tArA supArizera adhikArI have nA, tave yArA satya svIkAra karata o vizvAsa karata|
yadi Apani tAderake jijJAsA karena, ke tAderake sRSTi karechena, tave avazyai tArA valave, AllAha, ataHpara tArA keAthAYa phire yAcche?
rasUlera ei uktira kasama, he AmAra pAlanakartA, e sampradAYa teA vizvAsa sthApana kare nA|
ataeva, Apani tAdera theke mukha phiriYe nina evaM valuna, ‘sAlAma’| tArA zIghrai jAnate pArave|
hA-mIma|
zapatha suspaSTa kitAvera|
Ami eke nAyila karechi| eka varakatamaYa rAte, nizcaYa Ami satarkakArI|
e rAte pratyeka prajJApUrNa viSaYa sthirIkRta haYa|
AmAra pakSa theke Adezakrame, Amii preraNakArI|
ApanAra pAlanakartAra pakSa theke rahamatasvarUpa| tini sarvazreAtA, sarvajJa|

tini vyatIta keAna upAsya nei| tini jIvana dAna karena o mRtyu dena| tini teAmAdera pAlanakartA evaM teAmAdera pUrvavartI pitR-puruSaderao pAlanakartA|
etadasattveo erA sandehe patita haYe krIr3A-keৗtuka karache|
ataeva Apani sei dinera apekSA karuna, yakhana AkAza dhUYAYa cheYe yAve|
yA mAnuSake ghire phelave| eTA yantraNAdAYaka zAsti|
he AmAdera pAlanakartA AmAdera upara theke zAsti pratyAhAra karuna, AmarA vizvAsa sthApana karachi|
tArA ki kare vujhave, athaca tAdera kAche esechilena spaSTa varNanAkArI rasUla|
ataHpara tArA tAke pRSThapradarzana kare evaM vale, se teA ummAda-zikhAneA kathA vale|
Ami teAmAdera upara theke AyAva kichuTA pratyAhAra karava, kintu teAmarA punarAYa punarvasthAYa phire yAve|
yedina Ami pravalabhAve dhRta karava, sedina pureApuri pratizeAdha grahaNa karavai|

ei marme ye, AllAhara vAndAderake AmAra kAche arpaNa kara| Ami teAmAdera janya prerIta vizvasta rasUla|
Ara teAmarA AllAhara viruddhe auddhatya prakAza kareA nA| Ami teAmAdera kAche prakAzya pramANa upasthita karachi|
teAmarA yAte AmAke prastaravarSaNe hatyA nA kara, tajjanye Ami AmAra pAlanakartA o teAmAdera pAlanakartAra zaranApanna haYechi|
teAmarA yadi AmAra prati vizvAsa sthApana nA kara, tave AmAra kAcha theke dUre thAka|

tAhale tumi AmAra vAndAderake niYe rAtrivelAYa vera haYe par3a| nizcaYa teAmAdera pazcAddhavana karA have|
evaM samudrake acala thAkate dAo| nizcaYa orA nimajjata vAhinI|
tArA cher3e giYechila kata udyAna o prasravana,
kata zasyakSetra o sUramya sthAna|
kata sukhera upakaraNa, yAte tArA kheAzagalpa karata|
emanii haYechila evaM Ami oguleAra mAlika karechilAma bhinna sampradAYake|
tAdera janye krandana kareni AkAza o pRthivI evaM tArA avakAzao pAYani|
Ami vanI-isarAIlake apamAnajanaka zAsti theke uddhAra karachi|
pherAuna se chila sImAlaMghanakArIdera madhye zIrSasthAnIYa|
Ami jenezune tAderake vizvavAsIdera upara zreSThatva diYechilAma|
evaM Ami tAderake emana nidarzanAvalI diYechilAma yAte chila spaSTa sAhAyya|
kApherarA valei thAke,
prathama mRtyura mAdhyamei AmAdera savakichura avasAna have evaM AmarA punarutthita hava nA|

parAkrAnta, prajJAmaYa AllAhara pakSa theke avatIrNa e kitAva|
nizcaYa nabheAmanDala o bhU-manDale muminadera janye nidarzanAvalI raYeche|
Ara teAmAdera sRSTite evaM cAradike char3iYe rAkhA jIva jantura sRjanera madhyeo nidarzanAvalI raYeche vizvAsIdera janya|

divArAtrira parivartane, AllAha AkAza theke ye riyika (vRSTi) varSaNa karena ataHpara pRthivIke tAra mRtyura para punarujjIvita karena, tAte evaM vAYura parivartane vuddhimAnadera janye nidarzanAvalI raYeche|
eguleA AllAhara AYAta, yA Ami ApanAra kAche AvRtti kari yathAyatharUpe| ataeva, AllAha o tA~ra AYAtera para tArA keAna kathAYa vizvAsa sthApana karave|
pratyeka mithyAvAdI pApAcArIra durbheAga|
se AllAhara AYAtasamUha zune, ataHpara ahaMkArI haYe jeda dhare, yena se AYAta zuneni| ataeva, tAke yantraNAdAYaka zAstira susaMvAda dina|
yakhana se AmAra keAna AYAta avagata haYa, takhana tAke ThATTArUpe grahaNa kare| edera janyai raYeche lAJchanAdAYaka zAsti|
tAdera sAmane raYeche jAhAnnAma| tArA yA upArjana kareche, tA tAdera keAna kAje Asave nA, tArA AllAhara parivarte yAderake vandhurUpe grahaNa kareche tArAo naYa| tAdera janye raYeche mahAzAsti|
eTA satpatha pradarzana, Ara yArA tAdera pAlanakartAra AYAtasamUha asvIkAra kare, tAdera janye raYeche kaTheAra yantraNAdAYaka zAsti|
tini AllAha yini samudrake teAmAdera upakArArthe AYatvAdhIna kare diYechena, yAte tA~ra Adezakrame tAte jAhAja calAcala kare evaM yAte teAmarA tA~ra anugraha tAlAza kara o tA~ra prati kRtajJa hao|
evaM AYattvAdhIna kare diYechena teAmAdera, yA Ache nabheAmanDale o yA Ache bhUmanDale; tA~ra pakSa theke| nizcaYa ete cintAzIla sampradAYera janye nidarzanAvalI raYeche|
muminaderake valuna, tArA yena tAderake kSamA kare, yArA AllAhara se dinaguleA samparke vizvAsa rAkhe nA yAte tini keAna sampradAYake kRtakarmera pratiphala dena|
ye satkAja karache, se nijera kalyANArthei tA karache, Ara ye asatkAja karache, tA tAra uparai vartAve| ataHpara teAmarA teAmAdera pAlanakartAra dike pratyAvartita have|
Ami vanI isarAIlake kitAva, rAjatva o navuoYata dAna karechilAma evaM tAderake paricchanna riyika diYechilAma evaM vizvavAsIra upara zreSThatva diYechilAma|

Arao diYechilAma tAderake dharmera suspaSTa pramANAdi| ataHpara tArA jJAna lAbha karAra para zudhu pArasparika jedera vazavartI haYe matabheda sRSTi kareche| tArA ye viSaYe matabheda karata, ApanAra pAlanakartA keYAmatera dina tAra phaYasAlA kare devena|
erapara Ami ApanAke rekhechi dharmera eka vizeSa zarIYatera upara| ataeva, Apani era anusaraNa karuna evaM ajJAnadera kheYAla-khuzIra anusaraNa karavena nA|
AllAhara sAmane tArA ApanAra keAna upakAre Asave nA| yAlemarA eke aparera vandhu| Ara AllAha paraheyagAradera vandhu|
eTA mAnuSera janye jJAnera kathA evaM vizvAsI sampradAYera janya hedAYeta o rahamata|

AllAha nabheAmanDala o bhU-manDala yathAyathabhAve sRSTi karechena, yAte pratyeka vyakti tAra upArjanera phala pAYa| tAdera prati yuluma karA have nA|

Apani ki tAra prati lakSya karechena, ye tAra kheYAla-khuzIke svIYa upAsya sthira kareche? tArA vale, AmAdera pArthiva jIvanai teA zeSa; AmarA mari o vA~ci mahAkAlai AmAderake dhvaMsa kare| tAdera kAche e vyApAre keAna jJAna nei| tArA kevala anumAna kare kathA vale|
