hA-mIma|
ei kitAva parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa AllAhara pakSa theke avatIrNa|

nabheAmanDala, bhU-manDala o etadubhaYera madhyavartI savakichu Ami yathAyathabhAvei evaM nirdiSTa samaYera janyei sRSTi karechi| Ara kApherarA ye viSaYe tAderake satarka karA haYeche, tA theke mukha phiriYe neYa|

valuna, teAmarA AllAha vyatIta yAdera pUjA kara, tAdera viSaYe bheve dekhecha ki? dekhAo AmAke tArA pRthivIte ki sRSTi kareche? athavA nabheAmanDala sRjane tAdera ki keAna aMza Ache? era pUrvavartI keAna kitAva athavA parasparAgata keAna jJAna AmAra kAche upasthita kara, yadi teAmarA satyavAdI hao|
ye vyakti AllAhara parivarte emana vastura pUjA kare, ye keYAmata paryantao tAra DAke sAr3A deve nA, tAra ceYe adhika pathabhraSTa Ara ke? tArA teA tAdera pujA samparkeo vekhavara|
yakhana mAnuSake hAzare ekatrita karA have, takhana tArA tAdera zatru have evaM tAdera evAdata asvIkAra karave|
yakhana tAderake AmAra suspaSTa AYAtasamUha pATha kare zunAneA haYa, takhana satya Agamana karAra para kApherarA vale, e teA prakAzya jAdu|

tArA ki vale ye, rasUla eke racanA kareche? valuna, yadi Ami racanA kare thAki, tave teAmarA AllAhara zAsti theke AmAke rakSA karAra adhikArI nao| teAmarA e samparke yA AleAcanA kara, se viSaYe AllAha samyaka avagata| AmAra o teAmAdera madhye tini sAkSI hisAve yatheSTa| tini kSamAzIla, daYAmaYa|
valuna, Ami teA keAna natuna rasUla nai| Ami jAni nA, AmAra o teAmAdera sAthe ki vyavahAra karA have| Ami kevala tArai anusaraNa kari, yA AmAra prati ohI karA haYa| Ami spaSTa satarka kArI vai nai|

valuna, teAmarA bheve dekhecha ki, yadi eTA AllAhara pakSa theke haYa evaM teAmarA eke amAnya kara evaM vanI isarAIlera ekajana sAkSI era pakSe sAkSya diYe ete vizvAsa sthApana kare; Ara teAmarA ahaMkAra kara, tave teAmAdera ceYe avivecaka Ara ke have? nizcaYa AllAha avivecakaderake patha dekhAna nA|

Ara kApherarA muminadera valate lAgala ye, yadi e dvIna bhAla hata tave erA AmAderake pechane phele egiYe yete pArata nA| tArA yakhana era mAdhyame supatha pAYani, takhana zIghrai valave, e teA eka purAtana mithyA|
era Age mUsAra kitAva chila pathapradarzaka o rahamatasvarUpa| Ara ei kitAva tAra samarthaka AravI bhASAYa, yAte yAlemaderake satarka kare evaM satkarmaparAYaNaderake susaMvAda deYa|
nizcaYa yArA vale, AmAdera pAlanakartA AllAha ataHpara avicala thAke, tAdera keAna bhaYa nei evaM tArA cintita have nA|
tArAi jAnnAtera adhikArI! tArA tathAYa cirakAla thAkave| tArA ye karma karata, eTA tArai pratiphala|

Ami mAnuSake tAra pitA-mAtAra sAthe sadvyavahArera Adeza diYechi| tAra jananI tAke kaSTasahakAre garbhe dhAraNa kareche evaM kaSTasahakAre prasava kareche| tAke garbhe dhAraNa karate o tAra stanya chAr3ate legeche triza mAsa| avazeSe se yakhana zakti-sAmarthyera vaYase o calliza vachare peৗcheche, takhana valate lAgala, he AmAra pAlanakartA, AmAke erUpa bhAgya dAna kara, yAte Ami teAmAra neYAmatera zeAkara kari, yA tumi dAna karecha AmAke o AmAra pitA-mAtAke evaM yAte Ami teAmAra pachandanIYa satkAja kari| AmAra santAnaderake satkarmaparAYaNa kara, Ami teAmAra prati taovA karalAma evaM Ami AjJAvahadera anyatama|
Ami emana leAkadera sukarmaguleA kavula kari evaM mandakarmaguleA mArjanA kari| tArA jAnnAtIdera tAlikAbhukta sei satya oYAdAra kAraNe yA tAderake deoYA hata|

Ara ye vyakti tAra pitA-mAtAke vale, dhika teAmAderake, teAmarA ki AmAke khavara dAo ye, Ami punarutthita hava, athaca AmAra pUrve vahu leAka gata haYe geche? Ara pitA-mAtA AllAhara kAche phariyAda kare vale, durbheAga teAmAra tumi vizvAsa sthApana kara| nizcaYa AllAhara oYAdA satya| takhana se vale, eTA teA pUrvavartIdera upakathA vai naYa|
tAdera pUrve ye sava jvina o mAnuSa gata haYeche, tAdera madhye e dharanera leAkadera pratio zAstivAnI avadhArita haYe geche| nizcaYa tArA chila kSatigrastha|
pratyekera janye tAdera kRtakarma anuyAYI vibhinna stara raYeche, yAte AllAha tAdera karmera pUrNa pratiphala dena| vastutaH tAdera prati yuluma karA have nA|

yedina kApheraderake jAhAnnAmera kAche upasthita karA have sedina valA have, teAmarA teAmAdera sukha pArthiva jIvanei niHzeSa karecha evaM seguleA bheAga karecha sutarAM Aja teAmAderake apamAnakara AyAvera zAsti deYA have; kAraNa, teAmarA pRthivIte anyAYa bhAve ahaMkAra karate evaM teAmarA pApAcAra karate|

A’da sampradAYera bhAiYera kathA smaraNa karuna, tAra pUrve o pare aneka satarkakArI gata haYechila se tAra sampradAYake vAlukAmaYa ucca upatyakAYa e marme satarka karechila ye, teAmarA AllAha vyatIta kArao evAdata kareA nA| Ami teAmAdera janye eka mahAdivasera zAstira AzaMkA kari|
tArA valala, tumi ki AmAderake AmAdera upAsya deva-devI theke nivRtta karate Agamana karecha? tumi satyavAdI hale AmAderake ye viSaYera oYAdA dAo, tA niYe Asa|
se valala, e jJAna teA AllAhara kAchei raYeche| Ami ye viSaYasaha prerita haYechi, tA teAmAdera kAche pau~chAi| kintu Ami dekhachi teAmarA eka murkha sampradAYa|

(ataHpara) tArA yakhana zAstike megharUpe tAdera upatyakA abhimukhI dekhala, takhana valala, e teA megha, AmAderake vRSTi deve| varaM eTA sei vastu, yA teAmarA tAr3AtAr3i ceYechile| eTA vAYu ete raYeche marmantuda zAsti|

tAra pAlanakartAra Adeze se sava kichuke dhvaMsa kare deve| ataHpara tArA bheAra velAYa emana haYe gela ye, tAdera vasatiguleA chAr3A kichui dRSTigeAcara hala nA| Ami aparAdhI sampradAYake emanibhAve zAsti diYe thAki|

Ami tAderake emana viSaYe kSamatA diYechilAma, ye viSaYe teAmAderake kSamatA deini| Ami tAdera diYechilAma, karNa, cakSu o hRdaYa, kintu tAdera karNa, cakSu o hRdaYa tAdera keAna kAje Asala nA, yakhana tArA AllAhara AYAtasamUhake asvIkAra karala evaM tAderake sei zAsti grAsa kare nila, yA niYe tArA ThATTA vidrupa karata|
Ami teAmAdera AzapAzera janapada samUha dhvaMsa kare diYechi evaM vAra vAra AYAtasamUha zuniYechi, yAte tArA phire Ase|

ataHpara AllAhara parivarte tArA yAderake sAnnidhya lAbhera janye upAsyarUpe grahaNa karechila, tArA tAderake sAhAyya karala nA kena? varaM tArA tAdera kAcha theke udhAo haYe gela| eTA chila tAdera mithyA o managar3A viSaYa|

yakhana Ami ekadala jinake ApanAra prati AkRSTa karechilAma, tArA keAraAna pATha zunachila| tArA yakhana keAraAna pAThera jAYagAYa upasthita hala, takhana paraspara valala, cupa thAka| ataHpara yakhana pATha samApta hala, takhana tArA tAdera sampradAYera kAche satarkakArIrUpe phire gela|

tArA valala, he AmAdera sampradAYa, AmarA emana eka kitAva zunechi, yA mUsAra para avartINa haYeche| e kitAva pUrvavartI sava kitAvera pratyAYana kare, satyadharma o saralapathera dike paricAlita kare|
he AmAdera sampradAYa, teAmarA AllAhara dike AhavAnakArIra kathA mAnya kara evaM tA~ra prati vizvAsa sthApana kara| tini teAmAdera geAnAha mArjanA karavena|

Ara ye vyakti AllAhara dike AhavAnakArIra kathA mAnave nA, se pRthivIte AllAhake apAraka karate pArave nA evaM AllAha vyatIta tAra keAna sAhAyyakArI thAkave nA| e dharanera leAkai prakAzya pathabhraSTatAYa lipta|

tArA ki jAne nA ye, AllAha yini nabheAmanDala o bhUmanDala sRSTi karechena evaM eguleAra sRSTite keAna klAntiveAdha karenani, tini mRtake jIvita karate sakSama? kena naYa, nizcaYa tini sarva viSaYe sarvazaktimAna|

yedina kApheraderake jAhAnnAmera sAmane peza karA have, sedina valA have, eTA ki satya naYa? tArA valave, hA~ AmAdera pAlanakartAra zapatha| AllAha valavena, AyAva AsvAdana kara| kAraNa, teAmarA kupharI karate|

ataeva, Apani savara karuna, yemana ucca sAhasI paYagamvaragaNa savara karechena evaM odera viSaYe tar3ighar3i karavena nA| oderake ye viSaYe oYAdA deYA hata, tA yedina tArA pratyakSa karave, sedina tAdera mane have yena tArA dinera eka muhurtera vezI pRthivIte avasthAna kareni| eTA suspaSTa avagati| ekhana tArAi dhvaMsaprApta have, yArA pApAcArI sampradAYa|
yArA kupharI kare evaM AllAhara pathe vAdhA sRSTi kare, AllAha tAdera sakala karma vyartha kare dena|

Ara yArA vizvAsa sthApana kare, satkarma sampAdana kare evaM tAdera pAlanakartAra pakSa theke muhAmmadera prati avatIrNa satye vizvAsa kare, AllAha tAdera manda karmasamUha mArjanA karena evaM tAdera avasthA bhAla kare dena|

eTA e kAraNe ye, yArA kAphera, tArA vAtilera anusaraNa kare evaM yArA vizvAsI, tArA tAdera pAlanakartAra nikaTa theke Agata satyera anusaraNa kare| emanibhAve AllAha mAnuSera janye tAdera dRSTAntasamUha varNanA karena|

ataHpara yakhana teAmarA kApheradera sAthe yuddhe avatIrNa hao, takhana tAdera gardAra mAra, avazeSe yakhana tAderake pUrNarUpe parAbhUta kara takhana tAderake zakta kare vedhe phela| ataHpara haYa tAdera prati anugraha kara, nA haYa tAdera nikaTa hate muktipaNa lao| teAmarA yuddha cAliYe yAve ye paryanta nA zatrupakSa astra samarpaNa karave! ekathA zunale| AllAha icchA karale tAdera kAcha theke pratizeAdha nite pAratena| kintu tini teAmAdera katakake katakera dvArA parIkSA karate cAna| yArA AllAhara pathe zahIda haYa, AllAha kakhanai tAdera karma vinaSTa karavena nA|
tini tAderake patha pradarzana karavena evaM tAdera avasthA bhAla karavena|
ataHpara tini tAderake jAnnAte dAkhila karavena, yA tAderake jAniYe diYechena|
he vizvAsIgaNa! yadi teAmarA AllAhake sAhAyya kara, AllAha teAmAderake sAhAyya karavena evaM teAmAdera pA dRr3hapratiSTha karavena|
Ara yArA kAphera, tAdera janye Ache durgati evaM tini tAdera karma vinaSTa kare divena|
eTA ejanye ye, AllAha yA nAyila karechena, tArA tA pachanda kare nA| ataeva, AllAha tAdera karma vyartha kare divena|
tArA ki pRthivIte bhramaNa kareni ataHpara dekheni ye, tAdera pUrvavartIdera pariNAma ki haYeche? AllAha tAderake dhvaMsa kare diYechena evaM kApheradera avasthA erUpai have|
eTA ejanye ye, AllAha muminadera hitaiSI vandhu evaM kApheradera keAna hitaiSI vandhu nAi|

yArA vizvAsa kare o satkarma kare, AllAha tAderake jAnnAte dAkhila karavena, yAra nimnadeze nirjhariNIsamUha pravAhita haYa| Ara yArA kAphera, tArA bheAga-vilAse matta thAke evaM catuspada jantura mata AhAra kare| tAdera vAsasthAna jAhAnnAma|
ye janapada ApanAke vahiskAra kareche, tadapekSA kata zaktizAlI janapadake Ami dhvaMsa karechi, ataHpara tAderake sAhAyya karAra keu chila nA|
ye vyakti tAra pAlanakartAra pakSa theke Agata nidarzana anusaraNa kare, se ki tAra samAna, yAra kAche tAra manda karma zeAbhanIYa karA haYeche evaM ye tAra kheYAla-khuzIra anusaraNa kare|

paraheyagAraderake ye jAnnAtera oYAdA deYA haYeche, tAra avasthA nimnarUpaH tAte Ache pAnira nahara, nirmala dudhera nahara yArA svAda aparivartanIYa, pAnakArIdera janye susvAdu zarAvera nahara evaM parizeAdhita madhura nahara| tathAYa tAdera janye Ache rakamAri phala-mUla o tAdera pAlanakartAra kSamA| paraheyagArarA ki tAdera samAna, yArA jAhAnnAme anantakAla thAkave evaM yAderake pAna karate deYA have phuTanta pAni ataHpara tA tAdera nAr3ibhU~r3i chinna vicchinna kare deve?

tAdera madhye kataka ApanAra dike kAna pAte, ataHpara yakhana ApanAra kAcha theke vAire yAYa, takhana yArA zikSita, tAderake valeH eimAtra tini ki valalena? edera antare AllAha meAhara mere diYechena evaM tArA nijedera kheYAla-khuzIra anusaraNa kare|
yArA satpathaprApta haYeche, tAdera satpathaprApti Arao ver3e yAYa evaM AllAha tAderake tAkaoYA dAna karena|
tArA zudhu ei apekSAi karache ye, keYAmata akasmAt tAdera kAche ese par3uka| vastutaH keYAmatera lakSaNasamUha teA esei par3eche| sutarAM keYAmata ese par3ale tArA upadeza grahaNa karave kemana kare?
jene rAkhuna, AllAha vyatIta keAna upAsya nei| kSamAprArthanA karuna, ApanAra kraTira janye evaM mumina puruSa o nArIdera janye| AllAha, teAmAdera gatividhi o avasthAna samparke jJAta|

yArA mumina, tArA valeH ekaTi sUrA nAyila haYa nA kena? ataHpara yakhana keAna dvyarthahIna sUrA nAyila haYa evaM tAte jehAdera ullekha karA haYa, takhana yAdera antare reAga Ache, Apani tAderake mRtyubhaYe mUrchAprApta mAnuSera mata ApanAra dike tAkiYe thAkate dekhavena| sutarAM dhvaMsa tAdera janye|
tAdera Anugatya o miSTa vAkya jAnA Ache| ataeva, jehAdera sindhAnta hale yadi tArA AllAhara prati padatta aMgIkAra pUrNa kare, tave tAdera janye tA maGgalajanaka have|
kSamatA lAbha karale, sambhavataH teAmarA pRthivIte anartha sRSTi karave evaM AtnIYatA vandhana chinna karave|
edera pratii AllAha abhisampAta karena, ataHpara tAderake vadhira o dRSTizaktihIna karena|
tArA ki keAraAna samparke gabhIra cintA kare nA? nA tAdera antara tAlAvaddha?
nizcaYa yArA seAjA patha vyakta haoYAra para tatprati pRSThapradarzana kare, zaYatAna tAdera janye tAdera kAjake sundara kare dekhAYa evaM tAderake mithyA AzA deYa|
eTA ejanya ye, tArA tAderake vale, yArA AllAhara avatIrNa kitAva apachanda kareH AmarA keAna keAna vyApAre teAmAdera kathA mAnya karava| AllAha tAdera geApana parAmarza avagata Achena|
pherezatA yakhana tAdera mukhamanDala o pRSThadeze AghAta karate karate prANa haraNa karave, takhana tAdera avasthA kemana have?
eTA ejanye ye, tArA sei viSaYera anusaraNa kare, yA AllAhara asanteASa sRSTi kare evaM AllAhara santuSTike apachanda kare| phale tini tAdera karmasamUha vyartha kare dena|
yAdera antare reAga Ache, tArA ki mane kare ye, AllAha tAdera antarera vidveSa prakAza kare devena nA?

Ami icchA karale ApanAke tAdera sAthe paricita kare ditAma| takhana Apani tAdera cehArA dekhe tAderake cinate pAratena evaM Apani avazyai kathAra bhaGgite tAderake cinate pAravena| AllAha teAmAdera karmasamUhera khavara rAkhena|
Ami avazyai teAmAderake parIkSA karava ye paryanta nA phuTiYe tuli teAmAdera jehAdakArIderake evaM savarakArIderake evaM yatakSaNa nA Ami teAmAdera avasthAna samUha yAcAi kari|

nizcaYa yArA kAphera evaM AllAhara patha theke mAnuSake phiriYe rAkhe evaM nijedera janye satpatha vyakta haoYAra para rasUlera (saH) vireAdhitA kare, tArA AllAhara keAnai kSati karate pArave nA evaM tini vyartha kare divena tAdera karmasamUhake|
he muminagaNa! teAmarA AllAhara Anugatya kara, rasUlera (sAH) Anugatya kara evaM nijedera karma vinaSTa kareA nA|
nizcaYa yArA kAphera evaM AllAhara patha theke mAnuSake phiriYe rAkhe, ataHpara kAphera avasthAYa mArA yAYa, AllAha kakhanai tAderake kSamA karavena nA|
ataeva, teAmarA hInavala haYeA nA evaM sandhira AhavAna jAnio nA, teAmarAi have pravala| AllAhai teAmAdera sAthe Achena| tini kakhanao teAmAdera karma hrAsa karavena nA|
pArthiva jIvana teA kevala khelAdhulA, yadi teAmarA vizvAsI hao evaM saMyama avalamvana kara, AllAha teAmAderake teAmAdera pratidAna devena evaM tini teAmAdera dhana-sampada cAivena nA|
tini teAmAdera kAche dhana-sampada cAile ataHpara teAmAderake atiSTha karale teAmarA kArpaNya karave evaM tini teAmAdera manera saMkIrNatA prakAza kare devena|

zuna, teAmarAi teA tArA, yAderake AllAhara pathe vyaYa karAra AhavAna jAnAneA hacche, ataHpara teAmAdera keu keu kRpaNatA karache| yArA kRpaNatA karache, tArA nijedera pratii kRpaNatA karache| AllAha abhAvamukta evaM teAmarA abhAvagrastha| yadi teAmarA mukha phiriYe nAo, tave tini teAmAdera parivarte anya jAtike pratiSThita karavena, erapara tArA teAmAdera mata have nA|
nizcaYa Ami ApanAra janye emana ekaTA phaYasAlA kare diYechi, yA suspaSTa|
yAte AllAha ApanAra atIta o bhaviSyata truTisamUha mArjanA kare dena evaM ApanAra prati tA~ra neYAmata pUrNa karena o ApanAke sarala pathe paricAlita karena|
evaM ApanAke dAna karena valiSTha sAhAyya|
tini muminadera antare prazAnti nAyila karena, yAte tAdera ImAnera sAthe Arao ImAna ver3e yAYa| nabheAmanDala o bhUmanDalera vAhinIsamUha AllAharai evaM AllAha sarvajJa, prajJAmaYa|

ImAna ejanye ver3e yAYa, yAte tini ImAnadAra puruSa o ImAnadAra nArIderake jAnnAte praveza karAna, yAra taladeze nadI pravAhita| sethAYa tArA cirakAla vasavAsa karave evaM yAte tini tAdera pApa meAcana karena| eTAi AllAhara kAche mahAsAphalya|

evaM yAte tini kapaTa vizvAsI puruSa o kapaTa vizvAsinI nArI evaM aMzIvAdI puruSa o aMzIvAdinI nArIderake zAsti dena, yArA AllAha samparke manda dhAraNA peASana kare| tAdera janya manda parinAma| AllAha tAdera prati kruddha haYechena, tAderake abhizapta karechena| evaM tAhAdera janye jAhAnnAma prastuta rekhechena| tAdera pratyAvartana sthala atyanta manda|
nabheAmanDala o bhUmanDalera vAhinIsamUha AllAharai| AllAha parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|
Ami ApanAke preraNa karechi avasthA vyaktakArIrUpe, susaMvAdadAtA o bhaYa pradarzanakArIrUpe|
yAte teAmarA AllAha o rasUlera prati vizvAsa sthApana kara evaM tA~ke sAhAyya o sammAna kara evaM sakAla-sandhyAYa AllAhara pavitratA gheASaNA kara|

yArA ApanAra kAche Anugatyera zapatha kare, tArA teA AllAhara kAche Anugatyera zapatha kare| AllAhara hAta tAdera hAtera upara raYeche| ataeva, ye zapatha bhaGga kare; ati avazyai se tA nijera kSatira janyei kare evaM ye AllAhara sAthe kRta aGgIkAra pUrNa kare; AllAha sattvarai tAke mahApuraskAra dAna karavena|

maruvAsIdera madhye yArA gRhe vase raYeche, tArA ApanAke valaveH AmarA AmAdera dhana-sampada o parivAra-parijanera kAje vyasta chilAma| ataeva, AmAdera pApa mArjanA karAna| tArA mukhe emana kathA valave, yA tAdera antare nei| valunaH AllAha teAmAdera kSati athavA upakAra sAdhanera icchA karale ke tAke virata rAkhate pAre? varaM teAmarA yA kara, AllAha se viSaYa paripUrNa jJAta|

varaM teAmarA dhAraNa karechile ye, rasUla o muminagaNa tAdera vAr3I-ghare kichutei phire Asate pArave nA evaM ei dhAraNA teAmAdera janye khuvai sukhakara chila| teAmarA manda dhAraNAra vazavartI haYechile| teAmarA chile dhvaMsamukhI eka sampradAYa|
yArA AllAha o tA~ra rasUle vizvAsa kare nA, Ami sesava kApherera janye jvalanta agni prastuta rekhechi|
nabheAmanDala o bhUmanDalera rAjatva AllAharai| tini yAke icchA kSamA karena evaM yAke icchA zAsti dena| tini kSamAzIla, parama meheravAna|

teAmarA yakhana yuddhalavdha dhana-sampada saMgrahera janya yAve, takhana yArA pazcAte theke giYechila, tArA valaveH AmAderakeo teAmAdera saGge yete dAo| tArA AllAhara kAlAma parivartana karate cAYa| valunaH teAmarA kakhanao AmAdera saGge yete pArave nA| AllAha pUrva thekei erUpa vale diYechena| tArA valaveH varaM teAmarA AmAdera prati vidveSa peASaNa karacha| parantu tArA sAmAnyai veAjhe|

gRhe avasthAnakArI maruvAsIderake vale dinaH AgAmIte teAmarA eka pravala parAkrAnta jAtira sAthe yuddha karate Ahuta have| teAmarA tAdera sAthe yuddha karave, yatakSaNa nA tArA musalamAna haYe yAYa| takhana yadi teAmarA nirdeza pAlana kara, tave AllAha teAmAderake uttama puraskAra divena| Ara yadi pRSThapradarzana kara yemana itipUrve pRSThapradarzana karecha, tave tini teAmAderake yantranAdAYaka zAsti divena|

andhera janye, khaJjera janye o rugnera janye keAna aparAdha nAi evaM ye keu AllAha o tA~ra rasUlera anugatya karave tAke tini jAnnAte dAkhila karavena, yAra taladeze nadI pravAhita haYa| pakSAntare ye, vyakti pRSThapradarzana karave, tAke yantraNAdAYaka zAsti divena|

AllAha muminadera prati santuSTa halena, yakhana tArA vRkSera nIce ApanAra kAche zapatha karala| AllAha avagata chilena yA tAdera antare chila| ataHpara tini tAdera prati prazAnti nAyila karalena evaM tAderake Asanna vijaYa puraskAra dilena|
evaM vipula parimANe yuddhalavdha sampada, yA tArA lAbha karave| AllAha parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|

AllAha teAmAderake vipula parimANa yuddhalavdha sampadera oYAdA diYechena, yA teAmarA lAbha karave| tini tA teAmAdera janye tvarAnvita karavena| tini teAmAdera theke zatrudera stavda kare diYechena-yAte eTA muminadera janye eka nidarzana haYa evaM teAmAderake sarala pathe paricAlita karena|
Ara o ekaTi vijaYa raYeche yA ekhanao teAmAdera adhikAre Aseni, AllAha tA veSTana kare Achena| AllAha sarvaviSaYe kSamatAvAna|
yadi kApherarA teAmAdera meAkAvelA karata, tave avazyai tArA pRSThapradarzana karata| takhana tArA keAna abhibhAvaka o sAhAyyakArI peta nA|
eTAi AllAhara rIti, yA pUrva theke cAlu Ache| tumi AllAhara rItite keAna parivartana pAve nA|
tini makkA zahare tAdera hAta teAmAdera theke evaM teAmAdera hAta tAdera theke nivArita karechena tAdera upara teAmAderake vijaYI karAra para| teAmarA yA kichu kara, AllAha tA dekhena|

tArAi teA kupharI kareche evaM vAdhA diYeche teAmAderake masajide hArAma theke evaM avasthAnarata keAravAnIra jantuderake yathAsthAne peৗchate| yadi makkAYa kichusaMkhyaka ImAnadAra puruSa o ImAnadAra nArI nA thAkata, yAderake teAmarA jAnate nA| arthAt tAdera piSTa haYe yAoYAra AzaMkA nA thAkata, ataHpara tAdera kAraNe teAmarA ajJAtasAre kSatigrasta hate, tave sava kichu cukiYe deYA hata; kintu e kAraNe cukAneA haYani, yAte AllAha tA’AlA yAke icchA svIYa rahamate dAkhila kare nena| yadi tArA sare yeta, tave Ami avazyai tAdera madhye yArA kAphera tAderake yantranAdAYaka zasti ditAma|

kenanA, kApherarA tAdera antare mUrkhatAyugera jeda peASaNa karata| ataHpara AllAha tA~ra rasUla o muminadera upara svIYa prazAnti nAyila karalena evaM tAdera janye saMyamera dAYitva aparihArya kare dilena| vastutaH tArAi chila era adhikatara yeAgya o upayukta| AllAha sarvaviSaYe samyaka jJAta|

AllAha tA~ra rasUlake satya svapna dekhiYechena| AllAha cAhena teA teAmarA avazyai masajide hArAme praveza karave nirApade mastakamunDita avasthAYa evaM keza kartita avasthAYa| teAmarA kAuke bhaYa karave nA| ataHpara tini jAnena yA teAmarA jAna nA| echAr3Ao tini diYechena teAmAderake ekaTi Asanna vijaYa|
tinii tA~ra rasUlake hedAYeta o satya dharmasaha preraNa karechena, yAte eke anya samasta dharmera upara jaYayukta karena| satya pratiSThAtArUpe AllAha yatheSTa|

muhAmmada AllAhara rasUla evaM tA~ra sahacaragaNa kApheradera prati kaTheAra, nijedera madhye paraspara sahAnubhUtizIla| AllAhara anugraha o santuSTi kAmanAYa Apani tAderake ruku o sejadArata dekhavena| tAdera mukhamanDale raYeche sejadAra cihna | taorAte tAdera avasthA erUpa evaM iJjile tAdera avasthA yemana ekaTi cArA gAcha yA theke nirgata haYa kizalaYa, ataHpara tA zakta o majavuta haYa evaM kAnDera upara dA~r3AYa dRr3habhAve-cASIke Anande abhibhuta kare-yAte AllAha tAdera dvArA kApheradera antarjAlA sRSTi karena| tAdera madhye yArA vizvAsa sthApana kare evaM satkarma kare, AllAha tAderake kSamA o mahApuraskArera oYAdA diYechena|
muminagaNa! teAmarA AllAha o rasUlera sAmane agraNI haYeA nA evaM AllAhake bhaYa kara| nizcaYa AllAha savakichu zunena o jAnena|

muminagaNa! teAmarA navIra kanThasvarera upara teAmAdera kanThasvara u~cu kareA nA evaM teAmarA eke aparera sAthe yerUpa u~cusvare kathA vala, tA~ra sAthe serUpa u~cusvare kathA valeA nA| ete teAmAdera karma nisphala haYe yAve evaM teAmarA Terao pAve nA|
yArA AllAhara rasUlera sAmane nijedera kanThasvara nIcu kare, AllAha tAdera antarake ziSTAcArera janye zeAdhita karechena| tAdera janye raYeche kSamA o mahApuraskAra|
yArA prAcIrera Ar3Ala theke ApanAke ucusvare DAke, tAdera adhikAMzai avujha|
yadi tArA ApanAra vera haYe tAdera kAche AsA paryanta savara karata, tave tA-i tAdera janye maGgalajanaka hata| AllAha kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

muminagaNa! yadi keAna pApAcArI vyakti teAmAdera kAche keAna saMvAda AnaYana kare, tave teAmarA parIkSA kare dekhave, yAte ajJatAvazataH teAmarA keAna sampradAYera kSatisAdhane pravRtta nA hao evaM pare nijedera kRtakarmera janye anutapta nA hao|

teAmarA jene rAkha teAmAdera madhye AllAhara rasUla raYechena| tini yadi aneka viSaYe teAmAdera AvadAra mene nena, tave teAmarAi kaSTa pAve| kintu AllAha teAmAdera antare ImAnera mahavvata sRSTi kare diYechena evaM tA hRdaYagrAhI kare diYechena| pakSAntare kuphara, pApAcAra o nApharamAnIra prati ghRNA sRSTi kare diYechena| tArAi satpatha avalamvanakArI|
eTA AllAhara kRpA o niYAmataH AllAha sarvajJa prajJAmaYa|

yadi muminadera dui dala yuddhe lipta haYe par3e, tave teAmarA tAdera madhye mImAMsA kare dive| ataHpara yadi tAdera ekadala apara dalera upara car3Ao haYa, tave teAmarA AkramaNakArI dalera viruddhe yuddha karave; ye paryanta nA tArA AllAhara nirdezera dike phire Ase| yadi phire Ase, tave teAmarA tAdera madhye nyAYAnuga panthAYa mImAMsA kare dive evaM inachApha karave| nizcaYa AllAha inachAphakArIderake pachanda karena|
muminarA teA paraspara bhAi-bhAi| ataeva, teAmarA teAmAdera dui bhAiYera madhye mImAMsA karave evaM AllAhake bhaYa karave-yAte teAmarA anugrahaprApta hao|

muminagaNa, keu yena apara kAuke upahAsa nA kare| kenanA, se upahAsakArI apekSA uttama hate pAre evaM keAna nArI apara nArIkeo yena upahAsa nA kare| kenanA, se upahAsakAriNI apekSA zreSTha hate pAre| teAmarA eke aparera prati deASAreApa kareA nA evaM eke aparake manda nAme DekeA nA| keu vizvAsa sthApana karale tAdera manda nAme DAkA geAnAha| yArA ehena kAja theke taovA nA kare tArAi yAlema|

muminagaNa, teAmarA aneka dhAraNA theke ve~ce thAka| nizcaYa kataka dhAraNA geAnAha| evaM geApanIYa viSaYa sandhAna kareA nA| teAmAdera keu yena kArao pazcAte nindA nA kare| teAmAdera keu ki tArA mRta bhrAtAra mAMsa bhakSaNa karA pachanda karave? vastutaH teAmarA teA eke ghRNAi kara| AllAhake bhaYa kara| nizcaYa AllAha taovA kavulakArI, parama daYAlu|

he mAnava, Ami teAmAderake eka puruSa o eka nArI theke sRSTi karechi evaM teAmAderake vibhinna jAti o geAtre vibhakta karechi, yAte teAmarA paraspare pariciti hao| nizcaYa AllAhara kAche se-i sarvAdhika sambhrAnta ye sarvAdhika paraheyagAra| nizcaYa AllAha sarvajJa, savakichura khavara rAkhena|

maruvAsIrA valeH AmarA vizvAsa sthApana karechi| valunaH teAmarA vizvAsa sthApana karani; varaM vala, AmarA vazyatA svIkAra karechi| ekhanao teAmAdera antare vizvAsa janmeni| yadi teAmarA AllAha o tA~ra rasUlera Anugatya kara, tave teAmAdera karma vindumAtrao nisphala karA have nA| nizcaYa, AllAha kSamAzIla, parama meheravAna|
tArAi mumina, yArA AllAha o tA~ra rasUlera prati ImAna AnAra para sandeha peASaNa kare nA evaM AllAhara pathe prANa o dhana-sampada dvArA jehAda kare| tArAi satyaniSTha|
valunaH teAmarA ki teAmAdera dharma parAYaNatA samparke AllAhake avahita karacha? athaca AllAha jAnena yA kichu Ache bhUmanDale evaM yA kichu Ache nabheAmanDale| AllAha sarvaviSaYe samyaka jJAta|

tArA musalamAna haYe ApanAke dhanya kareche mane kare| valuna, teAmarA musalamAna haYe AmAke dhanya karecha mane kareA nA| varaM AllAha ImAnera pathe paricAlita kare teAmAderake dhanya karechena, yadi teAmarA satyaniSTha haYe thAka|
AllAha nabheAmanDala o bhUmanDalera adRzya viSaYa jAnena, teAmarA yA kara AllAha tA dekhena|
kvApha! sammAnita keAraAnera zapatha;
varaM tArA tAdera madhya thekei ekajana bhaYa pradarzanakArI Agamana kareche dekhe vismaYa veAdha kare| ataHpara kApherarA valeH eTA Azcaryera vyApAra|
AmarA mare gele evaM mRttikAYa pariNata haYe geleo ki punarutthita hava? e pratyAvartana sudUraparAhata|
mRttikA tAdera kataTuku grAsa karave, tA AmAra jAnA Ache evaM AmAra kAche Ache saMrakSita kitAva|
varaM tAdera kAche satya Agamana karAra para tArA tAke mithyA valache| phale tArA saMzaYe patita raYeche|
tArA ki tAdera uparasthita AkAzera pAne dRSTipAta kare nA Ami kibhAve tA nirmANa karechi evaM suzeAbhita karechi? tAte keAna chidrao nei|
Ami bhUmike vistRta karechi, tAte parvatamAlAra bhAra sthApana karechi evaM tAte sarvaprakAra naYanAbhirAma udbhida udagata karechi|
eTA jJAna AharaNa o smaraNa karAra mata vyApAra pratyeka anurAgI vAndAra janye|
Ami AkAza theke kalyANamaYa vRSTi varSaNa kari evaM tadvArA vAgAna o zasya udagata kari, yeguleAra phasala AharaNa karA haYa|
evaM lamvamAna kharjura vRkSa, yAte Ache guccha guccha kharjura,
vAndAdera jIvikAsvarUpa evaM vRSTi dvArA Ami mRta janapadake saJjIvita kari| emanibhAve punarutthAna ghaTave|
tAdera pUrve mithyAvAdI valeche nUhera sampradAYa, kupavAsIrA evaM sAmuda sampradAYa|
Ada, pherAuna, o lUtera sampradAYa,
vanavAsIrA evaM teAvvA sampradAYa| pratyekei rasUlagaNake mithyA valeche, ataHpara AmAra zAstira yeAgya haYeche|
Ami ki prathamavAra sRSTi karei klAnta haYe par3echi? varaM tArA natuna sRSTira vyApAre sandeha peASana kareche|
Ami mAnuSa sRSTi karechi evaM tAra mana nibhRte ye kucintA kare, se samvandheo Ami avagata Achi| Ami tAra grIvAsthita dhamanI thekeo adhika nikaTavartI|
yakhana dui pherezatA DAne o vAme vase tAra Amala grahaNa kare|
se ye kathAi uccAraNa kare, tAi grahaNa karAra janye tAra kAche sadA prastuta praharI raYeche|
mRtyuyantraNA nizcitai Asave| e thekei tumi TAlavAhAnA karate|
evaM ziGgAYa phu~tkAra deYA have eTA have bhaYa pradarzanera dina|
pratyeka vyakti Agamana karave| tAra sAthe thAkave cAlaka o karmera sAkSI|
tumi teA ei dina samparke udAsIna chile| ekhana teAmAra kAcha theke yavanikA sariYe diYechi| phale Aja teAmAra dRSTi sutIkSna|
tAra saGgI pherezatA valaveH AmAra kAche ye, AmalanAmA chila, tA ei|
teAmarA ubhaYei nikSepa kara jAhAnnAme pratyeka akRtajJa viruddhavAdIke,
ye vAdhA dita maGgalajanaka kAje, sImAlaGghanakArI, sandeha peASaNakArIke|
ye vyakti AllAhara sAthe anya upAsya grahaNa karata, tAke teAmarA kaThina zAstite nikSepa kara|
tAra saGgI zaYatAna valaveH he AmAdera pAlanakartA, Ami tAke avAdhyatAYa lipta karini| vastutaH se nijei chila sudUra pathabhrAntite lipta|
AllAha valavenaH AmAra sAmane vAkavitanDA kareA nA Ami teA pUrvei teAmAderake AyAva dvArA bhaYa pradarzana karechilAma|
AmAra kAche kathA radavadala haYa nA evaM Ami vAndAdera prati julumakArI nai|
yedina Ami jAhAnnAmake jijJAsA karava; tumi ki pUrNa haYe gecha? se valaveH Arao Ache ki?
jAnnAtake upasthita karA have kheAdAbhIrudera adUre|
teAmAdera pratyeka anurAgI o smaraNakArIke erai pratizruti deYA haYechila|
ye nA dekhe daYAmaYa AllAha tA’AlAke bhaYa karata evaM vinIta antare upasthita hata|
teAmarA ete zAntite praveza kara| eTAi anantakAla vasavAsera janya praveza karAra dina|
tArA tathAYa yA cAive, tAi pAve evaM AmAra kAche raYeche Arao adhika|
Ami tAdera pUrve vahu sampradAYake dhvaMsa karechi, tArA edera apekSA adhika zaktizAlI chila evaM deze-videze vicaraNa kare phirata| tAdera keAna palAYana sthAna chila nA|
ete upadeza raYeche tAra janye, yAra anudhAvana karAra mata antara raYeche| athavA se niviSTa mane zravaNa kare|
Ami nabheAmanDala, bhUmanDala o etadubhaYera madhyavartI savakichu chaYadine sRSTi karechi evaM AmAke keAnarUpa klAnti sparza kareni|
ataeva, tArA yA kichu vale, tajjanye Apani chavara karuna evaM, sUryeAdaYa o sUryAstera pUrve ApanAra pAlanakartAra saprazaMsa pavitratA gheASaNA karuna|
rAtrira kichu aMze tA~ra pavitratA gheASaNA karuna evaM nAmAyera pazcAteo|
zuna, ye dina eka AhavAnakArI nikaTavartI sthAna theke AhavAna karave|
yedina mAnuSa nizcita sei bhaYAvaha AoYAja zunate pAve, sedinai punaratthAna divasa|
Ami jIvana dAna kari, mRtyu ghaTAi evaM AmArai dike sakalera pratyAvartana|
yedina bhUmanDala vidIrNa haYe mAnuSa chuTAchuTi kare vera haYe Asave| eTA emana samaveta karA, yA AmAra janye ati sahaja|
tArA yA vale, tA Ami samyaka avagata Achi| Apani tAdera upara jeArajavarakArI nana| ataeva, ye AmAra zAstike bhaYa kare, tAke keAraAnera mAdhyame upadeza dAna karuna|
kasama jhaJjhAvAYura|
ataHpara veAjhA vahanakArI meghera|
ataHpara mRdu calamAna jalayAnera,
ataHpara karma vanTanakArI pherezatAgaNera,
teAmAdera pradatta oYAdA avazyai satya|
inasApha avazyambhAvI|
pathaviziSTa AkAzera kasama,
teAmarA teA vireAdhapUrNa kathA valacha|
ye bhraSTa, sei e theke mukha phirAYa,
anumAnakArIrA dhvaMsa heAka,
yArA udAsIna, bhrAnta|
tArA jijJAsA kare, keYAmata kave have?
yedina tArA agnite patita have,
teAmarA teAmAdera zAsti AsvAdana kara| teAmarA ekei tvarAnvita karate ceYechila|
kheAdAbhIrurA jAnnAte o prasravaNe thAkave|
ematAvasthAYa ye, tArA grahaNa karave yA tAdera pAlanakartA tAderake devena| nizcaYa itipUrve tArA chila satkarmaparAYaNa,
tArA rAtrira sAmAnya aMzei nidrA yeta,
rAtera zeSa prahare tArA kSamAprArthanA karata,
evaM tAdera dhana-sampade prArthI o vaJcitera haka chila|
vizvAsakArIdera janye pRthivIte nidarzanAvalI raYeche,
evaM teAmAdera nijedera madhyeo, teAmarA ki anudhAvana karave nA?
AkAze raYeche teAmAdera riyika o pratizruta savakichu|
nabheAmanDala o bhUmanDalera pAlanakartAra kasama, teAmAdera kathAvArtAra matai eTA satya|
ApanAra kAche ivrAhImera sammAnita mehamAnadera vRttAnta eseche ki?
yakhana tArA tA~ra kAche upasthita haYe valalaH sAlAma, takhana se valalaH sAlAma| erA teA aparicita leAka|
ataHpara se grahe gela evaM ekaTi ghRtepakka meATA geAvatsa niYe hAyira hala|
se geAvatsaTi tAdera sAmane rekhe valalaH teAmarA AhAra karacha nA kena?
ataHpara tAdera samparke se mane mane bhIta halaH tArA valalaH bhIta havena nA| tArA tA~ke ekaTa jJAnIguNI putra santAnera susaMvAda dila|
ataHpara tA~ra strI cItkAra karate karate sAmane ela evaM mukha cApar3iYe valalaH Ami teA vRddhA, vandhyA|
tArA valalaH teAmAra pAlanakartA erUpai valechena| nizcaYa tini prajJAmaYa, sarvajJa|
ivrAhIma valalaH he prerita pherezatAgaNa, teAmAdera uddezya ki?
tArA valalaH AmarA eka aparAdhI sampradAYera prati prerita haYechi,
yAte tAdera upara mATira DhilA nikSepa kari|
yA sImAtikramakArIdera janye ApanAra pAlanakartAra kAche cihnita Ache|
ataHpara sekhAne yArA ImAnadAra chila, Ami tAderake uddhAra karalAma|
evaM sekhAne ekaTi gRha vyatIta keAna musalamAna Ami pAini|
yArA yantraNAdAYaka zAstike bhaYa kare, Ami tAdera janye sekhAne ekaTi nidarzana rekhechi|
evaM nidarzana raYeche mUsAra vRttAnte; yakhana Ami tAke suspaSTa pramANasaha pherAunera kAche preraNa karechilAma|
ataHpara se zaktivale mukha phiriYe nila evaM valalaH se haYa yAdukara, nA haYa pAgala|
ataHpara Ami tAke o tAra senAvAhinIke pAkar3Ao karalAma evaM tAderake samudre nikSepa karalAma| se chila abhiyukta|
evaM nidarzana raYeche tAdera kAhinIte; yakhana Ami tAdera upara preraNa karechilAma azubha vAYu|
ei vAYu yAra upara diYe pravAhita haYechilaH tAkei curNa-vicurNa kare diYechila|
Arao nidarzana raYeche sAmUdera ghaTanAYa; yakhana tAderake valA haYechila, kichukAla majA luTe nAo|
ataHpara tArA tAdera pAlanakartAra Adeza amAnya karala evaM tAdera prati vajraghAta hala ematAvasthAYa ye, tArA tA dekhechila|
ataHpara tArA dA~r3Ate sakSama hala nA evaM keAna pratikArao karate pArala nA|
Ami itipUrve nUhera sampradAYake dhvaMsa karechi| nizcitai tArA chila pApAcArI sampradAYa|
Ami svIYa kSamatAvale AkAza nirmANa karechi evaM Ami avazyai vyApaka kSamatAzAlI|
Ami bhUmike vichiYechi| Ami kata sundarabhAvei nA vichAte sakSama|
Ami pratyeka vastu jeAr3AYa jeAr3AYa sRSTi karechi, yAte teAmarA hRdaYaGgama kara|
ataeva, AllAhara dike dhAvita hao| Ami tA~ra tarapha theke teAmAdera janye suspaSTa satarkakArI|
teAmarA AllAhara sAthe keAna upAsya sAvyasta kareA nA| Ami tA~ra pakSa theke teAmAdera janya suspaSTa satarkakArI|
emanibhAve, tAdera pUrvavartIdera kAche yakhanai keAna rasUla Agamana kareche, tArA valacheH yAdukara, nA haYa ummAda|
tArA ki eke aparake ei upadezai diYe geche? vastutaH orA duSTa sampradAYa|
ataeva, Apani odera theke mukha phiriYe nina| ete Apani aparAdhI havena nA|
