tArA tathAYa rezamera AstaraviziSTa vichAnAYa helAna diYe vasave| ubhaYa udyAnera phala tAdera nikaTa jhulave|
ataeva, teAmarA ubhaYe teAmAdera pAlanakartAra keAna keAna avadAnake asvIkAra karave?
tathAYa thAkave AnatanaYana ramanIgana, keAna jina o mAnava pUrve yAdera vyavahAra kareni|
ataeva, teAmarA ubhaYe teAmAdera pAlanakartAra keAna keAna avadAnake asvIkAra karave?
pravAla o padmarAga sadRza ramaNIgaNa|
ataeva, teAmarA ubhaYe teAmAdera pAlanakartAra keAna keAna avadAnake asvIkAra karave?
satkAjera pratidAna uttama puraskAra vyatIta ki hate pAre?
ataeva, teAmarA ubhaYe teAmAdera pAlanakartAra keAna keAna avadAnake asvIkAra karave?
ei du’Ti chAr3A Arao du’Ti udyAna raYeche|
ataeva, teAmarA ubhaYe teAmAdera pAlanakartAra keAna keAna avadAnake asvIkAra karave?
kAleAmata ghana savuja|
ataeva, teAmarA ubhaYe teAmAdera pAlanakartAra keAna keAna avadAnake asvIkAra karave?
tathAYa Ache udvelita dui prasravaNa|
ataeva, teAmarA ubhaYe teAmAdera pAlanakartAra keAna keAna avadAnake asvIkAra karave?
tathAYa Ache phala-mUla, kharjura o AnAra|
ataeva, teAmarA ubhaYe teAmAdera pAlanakartAra keAna keAna avadAnake asvIkAra karave?
sekhAne thAkave saccaritrA sundarI ramaNIgaNa|
ataeva, teAmarA ubhaYe teAmAdera pAlanakartAra keAna keAna avadAnake asvIkAra karave?
tA~vute avasthAnakAriNI huragaNa|
ataeva, teAmarA ubhaYe teAmAdera pAlanakartAra keAna keAna avadAnake asvIkAra karave?
keAna jina o mAnava pUrve tAderake sparza kareni|
ataeva, teAmarA ubhaYe teAmAdera pAlanakartAra keAna keAna avadAnake asvIkAra karave?
tArA savuja masanade evaM utkRSTa mUlyavAna vichAnAYa helAna diYe vasave|
ataeva, teAmarA ubhaYe teAmAdera pAlanakartAra keAna keAna avadAnake asvIkAra karave?
kata pUNyamaYa ApanAra pAlanakartAra nAma, yini mahimAmaYa o mahAnubhava|
yakhana kiYAmatera ghaTanA ghaTave,
yAra vAstavatAYa keAna saMzaYa nei|
eTA nIcu kare deve, samunnata kare deve|
yakhana pravalabhAve prakampita have pRthivI|
evaM parvatamAlA bheGge curamAra haYe yAve|
ataHpara tA haYe yAve utkSipta dhUlikaNA|
evaM teAmarA tinabhAve vibhakta haYe par3ave|
yArA DAna dike, kata bhAgyavAna tArA|
evaM yArA vAmadike, kata hatabhAgA tArA|
agravartIgaNa teA agravartIi|
tArAi naikaTyazIla,
avadAnera udyAnasamUhe,
tArA ekadala pUrvavartIdera madhya theke|
evaM alpasaMkhyaka paravartIdera madhye theke|
svarNa khacita siMhAsana|
tArA tAte helAna diYe vasave paraspara mukheAmukhi haYe|
tAdera kAche gheArApherA karave cira kizeArerA|
pAnapAtra ku~jA o khA~Ti sUrApUrNa peYAlA hAte niYe,
yA pAna karale tAdera ziraHpIr3A have nA evaM vikAragrasta o have nA|
Ara tAdera pachandamata phala-mula niYe,
evaM rucimata pAkhIra mAMsa niYe|
tathAYa thAkave AnatanaYanA huragaNa,
AvaraNe rakSita meAtira nyAYa,
tArA yA kichu karata, tAra puraskArasvarUpa|
tArA tathAYa avAntara o keAna khArApa kathA zunave nA|
kintu zunave sAlAma Ara sAlAma|
yArA DAna dike thAkave, tArA kata bhAgyavAna|
tArA thAkave kA~TAvihIna vadarikA vRkSe|
evaM kA~di kA~di kalAYa,
evaM dIrgha chAYAYa|
evaM pravAhita pAnite,
o pracura phala-mUle,
yA zeSa havAra naYa evaM niSiddha o naYa,
Ara thAkave samunnata zayyAYa|
Ami jAnnAtI ramaNIgaNake vizeSarUpe sRSTi karechi|
ataHpara tAderake karechi cirakumArI|
kAminI, samavaYaskA|
DAna dikera leAkadera janye|
tAdera ekadala have pUrvavartIdera madhya theke|
evaM ekadala paravartIdera madhya theke|
vAmapArzvastha leAka, kata nA hatabhAgA tArA|
tArA thAkave prakhara vASpe evaM uttapta pAnite,
evaM dhumrakuJjera chAYAYa|
yA zItala naYa evaM ArAmadAYakao naYa|
tArA itipUrve svAcchandyazIla chila|
tArA sadAsarvadA gheAratara pApakarme Duve thAkata|
tArA valataH AmarA yakhana mare asthi o mRttikAYa pariNata haYe yAva, takhanao ki punarutthita hava?
evaM AmAdera pUrvapuruSagaNao!
valunaH pUrvavartI o paravartIgaNa,
savAi ekatrita have eka nirdiSTa dinera nirdiSTa samaYe|
ataHpara he pathabhraSTa, mithyAreApakArIgaNa|
teAmarA avazyai bhakSaNa karave yAkkuma vRkSa theke,
ataHpara tA dvArA udara pUrNa karave,
ataHpara tAra upara pAna karave uttapta pAni|
pAna karave pipAsita uTera nyAYa|
keYAmatera dina eTAi have tAdera ApyAYana|
Ami sRSTi karechi teAmAderake| ataHpara kena teAmarA tA satya vale vizvAsa kara nA|
teAmarA ki bheve dekhecha, teAmAdera vIryapAta samparke|
teAmarA tAke sRSTi kara, nA Ami sRSTi kari?
Ami teAmAdera mRtyukAla nirdhArita karechi evaM Ami akSama nai|
e vyApAre ye, teAmAdera parivarte teAmAdera mata leAkake niYe Asi evaM teAmAderake emana kare dei, yA teAmarA jAna nA|
teAmarA avagata haYecha prathama sRSTi samparke, tave teAmarA anudhAvana kara nA kena?
teAmarA ye vIja vapana kara, se samparke bheve dekhecha ki?
teAmarA tAke utpanna kara, nA Ami utpannakArI?
Ami icchA karale tAke khar3akuTA kare dite pAri, ataHpara haYe yAve teAmarA vismaYAviSTa|
valaveH AmarA teA RNera cApe par3e gelAma;
varaM AmarA hUta sarvasva haYe par3alAma|
teAmarA ye pAni pAna kara, se samparke bheve dekhecha ki?
teAmarA tA megha theke nAmiYe Ana, nA Ami varSana kari?
Ami icchA karale tAke leAnA kare dite pAri, ataHpara teAmarA kena kRtajJatA prakAza kara nA?
teAmarA ye agni prajjvalita kara, se samparke bheve dekhecha ki?
teAmarA ki era vRkSa sRSTi karecha, nA Ami sRSTi karechi?
Ami sei vRkSake karechi smaraNikA evaM maruvAsIdera janya sAmagrI|
ataeva, Apani ApanAra mahAna pAlanakartAra nAme pavitratA gheASaNA karuna|
ataeva, Ami tArakArAjira astAcalera zapatha karachi,
nizcaYa eTA eka mahA zapatha-yadi teAmarA jAnate|
nizcaYa eTA sammAnita keAraAna,
yA Ache eka geApana kitAve,
yArA pAka-pavitra, tArA vyatIta anya keu eke sparza karave nA|
eTA vizva-pAlanakartAra pakSa theke avatIrNa|
tavuo ki teAmarA ei vANIra prati zaithilya padarzana karave?
evaM eke mithyA valAkei teAmarA teAmAdera bhUmikAYa pariNata karave?
ataHpara yakhana kArao prANa kanThAgata haYa|
evaM teAmarA tAkiYe thAka,
takhana Ami teAmAdera apekSA tAra adhika nikaTe thAki; kintu teAmarA dekha nA|
yadi teAmAdera hisAva-kitAva nA haoYAi Thika haYa,
tave teAmarA ei AtmAke phirAo nA kena, yadi teAmarA satyavAdI hao?
yadi se naikaTyazIladera ekajana haYa;
tave tAra janye Ache sukha, uttama riyika evaM neYAmate bharA udyAna|
Ara yadi se DAna pArzvasthadera ekajana haYa,
tave tAke valA haveH teAmAra janye DAnapArzvasasthadera pakSa theke sAlAma|
Ara yadi se pathabhraSTa mithyAreApakArIdera ekajana haYa,
tave tAra ApyAYana have uttapta pAni dvArA|
evaM se nikSipta have agnite|
eTA dhruva satya|
ataeva, Apani ApanAra mahAna pAlanakartAra nAme pavitratA gheASaNA karuna|
nabheAmanDala o bhUmanDale yA kichu Ache, savAi AllAhara pavitratA gheASaNA kare| tini zaktidhara; prajJAmaYa|
nabheAmanDala o bhUmanDalera rAjatva tA~rai| tini jIvana dAna karena o mRtyu ghaTAna| tini savakichu karate sakSama|
tinii prathama, tinii sarvazeSa, tinii prakAzamAna o aprakAzamAna evaM tini sava viSaYe samyaka parijJAta|

tini nabheAmanDala o bhU-manDala sRSTi karechena chaYadine, ataHpara Arazera upara samAsIna haYechena| tini jAnena yA bhUmite praveza kare o yA bhUmi theke nirgata haYa evaM yA AkAza theke varSita haYa o yA AkAze utthita haYa| tini teAmAdera sAthe Achena teAmarA yekhAnei thAka| teAmarA yA kara, AllAha tA dekhena|
nabheAmanDala o bhUmanDalera rAjatva tA~rai| savakichu tA~rai dike pratyAvartana karave|
tini rAtrike divase praviSTa karena evaM divasake praviSTa karena rAtrite| tini antarera viSaYAdi samparkeo samyaka jJAta|

teAmarA AllAha o tA~ra rasUlera prati vizvAsa sthApana kara evaM tini teAmAderake yAra uttarAdhikArI karechena, tA theke vyaYa kara| ataeva, teAmAdera madhye yArA vizvAsa sthApana kare o vyaYa kare, tAdera janye raYeche mahApuraskAra|

teAmAdera ki hala ye, teAmarA AllAhara prati vizvAsa sthApana karacha nA, athaca rasUla teAmAderake teAmAdera pAlanakartAra prati vizvAsa sthApana karAra dAoYAta dicchena? AllAha teA pUrvei teAmAdera aGgIkAra niYechena-yadi teAmarA vizvAsI hao|
tinii tA~ra dAsera prati prakAzya AYAta avatIrNa karena, yAte teAmAderake andhakAra theke AleAke AnaYana karena| nizcaYa AllAha teAmAdera prati karuNAmaYa, parama daYAlu|

teAmAderake AllAhara pathe vyaYa karate kise vAdhA deYa, yakhana AllAhai nabheAmanDala o bhUmanDalera uttarAdhikArI? teAmAdera madhye ye makkA vijaYera pUrve vyaYa kareche o jehAda kareche, se samAna naYa| erUpa leAkadera maryadA var3a tAdera apekSA, yAra pare vyaYa kareche o jehAda kareche| tave AllAha ubhaYake kalyANera oYAdA diYechena| teAmarA yA kara, AllAha se samparke samyaka jJAta|
ke sei vyakti, ye AllAhake uttama dhAra dive, erapara tini tAra janye tA vahuguNe vRddhi karavena evaM tAra janye raYeche sammAnita puraskAra|

yedina Apani dekhavena ImAnadAra puruSa o ImAnadAra nArIderake, tAdera sammukha bhAge o DAnapArzve tAdera jyeAti chuTeAchuTi karave valA haveH Aja teAmAdera janye susaMvAda jAnnAtera, yAra taladeze nadI pravAhita, tAte tArA cirakAla thAkave| eTAi mahAsAphalya|

yedina kapaTa vizvAsI puruSa o kapaTa vizvAsinI nArIrA muminaderake valaveH teAmarA AmAdera janye apekSA kara, AmarAo kichu AleA niva teAmAdera jyeAti theke| valA haveH teAmarA pichane phire yAo o AleAra kheA~ja kara| ataHpara ubhaYa dalera mAjhakhAne khAr3A karA have ekaTi prAcIra, yAra ekaTi darajA have| tAra abhyantare thAkave rahamata evaM vAire thAkave AyAva|

tArA muminaderake Deke valaveH AmarA ki teAmAdera sAthe chilAma nA? tArA valaveH hA~ kintu teAmarA nijerAi nijederake vipadagrasta karecha| pratIkSA karecha, sandeha peASaNa karecha evaM alIka AzAra pechane vibhrAnta haYecha, avazeSe AllAhara Adeza pau~cheche| ei savai teAmAderake AllAha samparke pratArita kareche|

ataeva, Aja teAmAdera kAcha theke keAna muktipana grahaNa karA have nA| evaM kApheradera kAcha thekeo naYa| teAmAdera savAra AvAsthala jAhAnnAma| seTAi teAmAdera saGgI| katai nA nikRSTa ei pratyAvartana sthala|

yArA mumina, tAdera janye ki AllAhara smaraNe evaM ye satya avartIrNa haYeche, tAra kAraNe hRdaYa vigalita haoYAra samaYa Aseni? tArA tAdera mata yena nA haYa, yAderake pUrve kitAva deYA haYechila| tAdera upara sudIrghakAla atikrAnta haYeche, ataHpara tAdera antaHkaraNa kaThina haYe geche| tAdera adhikAMzai pApAcArI|
teAmarA jene rAkha, AllAhai bhU-bhAgake tAra mRtyura para punarujjIvita karena| Ami pariskArabhAve teAmAdera janye AYAtaguleA vyakta karechi, yAte teAmarA veAjha|
nizcaYa dAnazIla vyakti o dAnazIlA nArI, yArA AllAhake uttamarUpe dhAra deYa, tAderake deYA have vahuguNa evaM tAdera janye raYeche sammAnajanaka puraskAra|

Ara yArA AllAha o tA~ra rasUlera prati vizvAsa sthApana kare tArAi tAdera pAlanakartAra kAche siddIka o zahIda vale vivecita| tAdera janye raYeche puraskAra o jyeAti evaM yArA kAphera o AmAra nidarzana asvIkArakArI tArAi jAhAnnAmera adhivAsI have|

teAmarA jene rAkha, pArthiva jIvana krIr3A-keৗtuka, sAja-sajjA, pArasparika ahamikA evaM dhana o janera prAcurya vyatIta Ara kichu naYa, yemana eka vRSTira avasthA, yAra savuja phasala kRSakaderake camatkRta kare, erapara tA zukiYe yAYa, phale tumi tAke pItavarNa dekhate pAo, erapara tA khar3akuTA haYe yAYa| Ara parakAle Ache kaThina zAsti evaM AllAhara kSamA o santuSTi| pArthiva jIvana pratAraNAra upakaraNa vai kichu naYa|

teAmarA agre dhAvita hao teAmAdera pAlanakartAra kSamA o sei jAnnAtera dike, yA AkAza o pRthivIra mata prazasta| eTA prastuta karA haYeche AllAha o tA~ra rasUlagaNera prati vizvAsasthApanakArIdera janye| eTA AllAhara kRpA, tini yAke icchA, eTA dAna karena| AllAha mahAna kRpAra adhikArI|
pRthivIte evaM vyaktigatabhAve teAmAdera upara keAna vipada Ase nA; kintu tA jagata sRSTira pUrvei kitAve lipivaddha Ache| nizcaYa eTA AllAhara pakSe sahaja|
eTA ejanye valA haYa, yAte teAmarA yA hArAo tajjanye duHkhita nA hao evaM tini teAmAderake yA diYechena, tajjanye ullasita nA hao| AllAha keAna uddhata ahaMkArIke pachanda karena nA,
yArA kRpaNatA kare evaM mAnuSake kRpaNatAra prati utsAha deYa, ye mukha phiriYe neYa, tAra jAnA ucita ye, AllAha abhAvamukta, prazaMsita|

Ami AmAra rasUlagaNake suspaSTa nidarzanasaha preraNa karechi evaM tA~dera sAthe avatIrNa karechi kitAva o nyAYanIti, yAte mAnuSa inasApha pratiSThA kare| Ara Ami nAyila karechi leৗha, yAte Ache pracanDa raNazakti evaM mAnuSera vahuvidha upakAra| eTA ejanye ye, AllAha jene nivena ke nA dekhe tA~ke o tA~ra rasUlagaNake sAhAyya kare| AllAha zaktidhara, parAkramazAlI|
Ami nUha o ivrAhImake rasUlarUpe preraNa karechi evaM tAdera vaMzadharera madhye navuoYata o kitAva avyAhata rekhechi| ataHpara tAdera kataka satpathaprApta haYeche evaM adhikAMzai haYeche pApAcArI|

ataHpara Ami tAdera pazcAte preraNa karechi AmAra rasUlagaNake evaM tAdera anugAmI karechi mariYama tanaYa IsAke o tAke diYechi iJjila| Ami tAra anusArIdera antare sthApana karechi namratA o daYA| Ara vairAgya, se teA tArA nijerAi udbhAvana kareche; Ami eTA tAdera upara pharaja karini; kintu tArA AllAhara santuSTi lAbhera janye eTA avalamvana kareche| ataHpara tArA yathAyathabhAve tA pAlana kareni| tAdera madhye yArA vizvAsI chila, Ami tAderake tAdera prApya puraskAra diYechi| Ara tAdera adhikAMzai pApAcArI|

muminagaNa, teAmarA AllAhake bhaYa kara evaM tA~ra rasUlera prati vizvAsa sthApana kara| tini nije anugrahera dviguNa aMza teAmAderake divena, teAmAderake divena jyeAti, yAra sAhAyye teAmarA calave evaM teAmAderake kSamA karavena| AllAha kSamAzIla, daYAmaYa|
yAte kitAvadhArIrA jAne ye, AllAhara sAmAnya anugrahera upara o tAdera keAna kSamatA nei, daYA AllAharai hAte; tini yAke icchA, tA dAna karena| AllAha mahA anugrahazIla|

ye nArI tAra svAmIra viSaYe ApanAra sAthe vAdAnuvAda karache evaM abhiyeAga peza karache AllAhara daravAre, AllAha tAra kathA zunechena| AllAha ApanAdera ubhaYera kathAvArtA zunena| nizcaYa AllAha savakichu zunena, savakichu dekhena|

teAmAdera madhye yArA tAdera strIgaNake mAtA vale phele, tAdera strIgaNa tAdera mAtA naYa| tAdera mAtA kevala tArAi, yArA tAderake janmadAna kareche| tArA teA asamIcIna o bhittihIna kathAi vale| nizcaYa AllAha mArjanAkArI, kSamAzIla|

yArA tAdera strIgaNake mAtA vale phele, ataHpara nijedera ukti pratyAhAra kare, tAdera kAphaphArA ei eke aparake sparza karAra pUrve ekaTi dAsake mukti dive| eTA teAmAdera janye upadeza have| AllAha khavara rAkhena teAmarA yA kara|

yAra e sAmarthya nei, se eke aparake sparza karAra pUrve ekAdikrame dui mAsa reAyA rAkhave| ye eteo akSama haYa se SATa jana misakInake AhAra karAve| eTA ejanye, yAte teAmarA AllAha o tA~ra rasUlera prati vizvAsa sthApana kara| eguleA AllAhara nirdhArita zAsti| Ara kApheradera janye raYeche yantraNA dAYaka AyAva|

yArA AllAhara tA~ra rasUlera viruddhAcaraNa kare, tArA apadastha haYeche, yemana apadastha haYeche tAdera pUrvavartIrA| Ami suspaSTa AYAtasamUha nAyila karechi| Ara kApheradera janye raYeche apamAnajanaka zAsti|

sedina smaraNIYa; yedina AllAha tAdera sakalake punarutthita karavena, ataHpara tAderake jAniYe divena yA tArA karata| AllAha tAra hisAva rekhechena, Ara tArA tA bhule geche| AllAhara sAmane upasthita Ache sava vastui|

Apani ki bheve dekhenani ye, nabheAmanDala o bhUmanDale yA kichu Ache, AllAha tA jAnena| tina vyaktira emana keAna parAmarza haYa nA yAte tini caturtha nA thAkena evaM pA~ca janerao haYa nA, yAte tini SaSTha nA thAkena tArA etadapekSA kama heAka vA vezI heAka tArA yekhAnei thAkuka nA kena tini tAdera sAthe Achena, tArA yA kare, tini keYAmatera dina tA tAderake jAniYe divena| nizcaYa AllAha sarvaviSaYe samyaka jJAta|

Apani ki bheve dekhenani, yAderake kAnAghuSA karate niSedha karA haYechila ataHpara tArA niSiddha kAjerai punarAvRtti kare evaM pApAcAra, sImAlaMghana evaM rasUlera avAdhyatAra viSaYei kAnAghuSA kare| tArA yakhana ApanAra kAche Ase, takhana ApanAke emana bhASAYa sAlAma kare, yaddvArA AllAha ApanAke sAlAma karenani| tArA mane mane valeH AmarA yA vali, tajjanye AllAha AmAderake zAsti dena nA kena? jAhAnnAmai tAdera janye yatheSTa| tArA tAte praveza karave| katai nA nikRSTa sei jAYagA|

muminagaNa, teAmarA yakhana kAnAkAni kara, takhana pApAcAra, sImAlaMghana o rasUlera avAdhyatAra viSaYe kAnAkAni kareA nA varaM anugraha o kheAdAbhItira vyApAre kAnAkAni kareA| AllAhake bhaYa kara, yA~ra kAche teAmarA ekatrita have|
ei kAnAghuSA teA zaYatAnera kAja; muminaderake duHkha deYAra deYAra janye| tave AllAhara anumati vyatIta se tAdera keAna kSati karate pArave nA| muminadera ucita AllAhara upara bharasA karA|

muminagaNa, yakhana teAmAderake valA haYaH majalise sthAna prazasta kare dAo, takhana teAmarA sthAna prazasta kare dio| AllAhara janye teAmAdera janya prazasta kare divena| yakhana valA haYaH uThe yAo, takhana uThe yeYeA| teAmAdera madhye yArA ImAnadAra evaM yArA jJAnaprApta, AllAha tAdera maryAdA ucca kare divena| AllAha khavara rAkhena yA kichu teAmarA kara|

muminagaNa, teAmarA rasUlera kAche kAnakathA valate cAile tatpUrve sadakA pradAna karave| eTA teAmAdera janye zreYaH o pavitra haoYAra bhAla upAYa| yadi tAte sakSama nA hao, tave AllAha kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

teAmarA ki kAnakathA valAra pUrve sadakA pradAna karate bhIta haYe gele? ataHpara teAmarA yakhana sadakA dite pArale nA evaM AllAha teAmAderake mApha kare dilena takhana teAmarA nAmAya kAYema kara, yAkAta pradAna kara evaM AllAha o rasUlera Anugatya kara| AllAha khavara rAkhena teAmarA yA kara|

Apani ki tAdera prati lakSya karenani, yArA AllAhara gayave nipatita sampradAYera sAthe vandhutva kare? tArA musalamAnadera dalabhukta naYa evaM tAderao dalabhUkta naYa| tArA jenezune mithyA viSaYe zapatha kare|
AllAha tAdera janye kaTheAra zAsti prastuta rekhechena| nizcaYa tArA yA kare, khuvai manda|
tArA tAdera zapathake DhAla kare rekhechena, ataHpara tArA AllAhara patha theke mAnuSake vAdhA pradAna kare| ataeva, tAdera janya raYeche apamAnajanaka zAsti|
AllAhara kavala theke tAdera dhana-sampada o santAna-santati tAderake meATei vA~cAte pAravenA| tArAi jAhAnnAmera adhivAsI tathAYa tArA cirakAla thAkave|

yedina AllAha tAdera sakalake punarutthita karavena| ataHpara tArA AllAhara sAmane zapatha karave, yemana teAmAdera sAmane zapatha kare| tArA mane karave ye, tArA kichu satpathe Ache| sAvadhAna, tArAi teA Asala mithyAvAdI|
zaYatAna tAderake vazIbhUta kare niYeche, ataHpara AllAhara smaraNa bhUliYe diYeche| tArA zaYatAnera dala| sAvadhAna, zaYatAnera dalai kSatigrasta|
nizcaYa yArA AllAha o tA~ra rasUlera viruddhAcAraNa kare, tArAi lAJchitadera dalabhUkta|
AllAha likhe diYechenaH Ami evaM AmAra rasUlagaNa avazyai vijaYI hava| nizcaYa AllAha zaktidhara, parAkramazAlI|

yArA AllAha o parakAle vizvAsa kare, tAderake Apani AllAha o tA~ra rasUlera viruddhAcaraNakArIdera sAthe vandhutva karate dekhavena nA, yadio tArA tAdera pitA, putra, bhrAtA athavA jJAti-geASThI haYa| tAdera antare AllAha ImAna likhe diYechena evaM tAderake zaktizAlI karechena tA~ra adRzya zakti dvArA| tini tAderake jAnnAte dAkhila karavena, yAra taladeze nadI pravAhita| tArA tathAYa cirakAla thAkave| AllAha tAdera prati santuSTa evaM tArA AllAhara prati santuSTa| tArAi AllAhara dala| jene rAkha, AllAhara dalai saphalakAma have|
nabheAmanDala o bhUmanDale yA kichu Ache, savai AllAhara pavitratA varNanA kare| tini parAkramazAlI mahAjJAnI|

tinii kitAvadhArIdera madhye yArA kAphera, tAderake prathamavAra ekatrita kare tAdera vAr3I-ghara theke vahiskAra karechena| teAmarA dhAraNAo karate pArani ye, tArA vera have evaM tArA mane karechila ye, tAdera dUrgaguleA tAderake AllAhara kavala theke rakSA karave| ataHpara AllAhara zAsti tAdera upara emanadika theke Asala, yAra kalpanAo tArA kareni| AllAha tAdera antare trAsa saJcAra kare dilena| tArA tAdera vAr3I-ghara nijedera hAte evaM musalamAnadera hAte dhvaMsa karachila| ataeva, he cakSuSmAna vyaktigaNa, teAmarA zikSA grahaNa kara|
AllAha yadi tAdera janye nirvAsana avadhArita nA karatena, tave tAderake duniYAte zAsti ditena| Ara parakAle tAdera janye raYeche jAhAnnAmera AyAva|
eTA e kAraNe ye, tArA AllAha o tA~ra rasUlera viruddhAcaraNa kareche| ye AllAhara viruddhAcaraNa kare, tAra jAnA ucita ye, AllAha kaTheAra zAstidAtA|
teAmarA ye kichu kichu kharjura vRkSa keTe diYecha evaM kataka nA keTe cher3e diYecha, tA teA AllAharai Adeza evaM yAte tini avAdhyaderake lAJchita karena|

AllAha vanu-vanuyAYarera kAcha theke tA~ra rasUlake ye dhana-sampada diYechena, tajjanye teAmarA gheAr3AYa kiMvA uTe car3e yuddha karani, kintu AllAha yAra upara icchA, tA~ra rasUlagaNake prAdhAnya dAna karena| AllAha savakichura upara sarvazaktimAna|

AllAha janapadavAsIdera kAcha theke tA~ra rasUlake yA diYechena, tA AllAhara, rasUlera, tA~ra AtnIYa-svajanera, iYAtImadera, abhAvagrastadera evaM musAphiradera janye, yAte dhanaizvaryya kevala teAmAdera vittazAlIdera madhyei puJjIbhUta nA haYa| rasUla teAmAderake yA dena, tA grahaNa kara evaM yA niSedha karena, tA theke virata thAka evaM AllAhake bhaYa kara| nizcaYa AllAha kaTheAra zAstidAtA|

ei dhana-sampada dezatyAgI niHsvadera janye, yArA AllAhara anugraha o santuSTilAbhera anveSaNe evaM AllAha tA~ra rasUlera sAhAyyArthe nijedera vAstubhiTA o dhana-sampada theke vahiskRta haYeche| tArAi satyavAdI|

yArA muhAjiradera Agamanera pUrve madInAYa vasavAsa karechila evaM vizvAsa sthApana karechila, tArA muhAjiradera bhAlavAse, muhAjiraderake yA deYA haYeche, tajjanye tArA antare IrSApeASaNa kare nA evaM nijerA abhAvagrasta haleo tAderake agrAdhikAra dAna kare| yArA manera kArpaNya theke mukta, tArAi saphalakAma|

Ara ei sampada tAdera janye, yArA tAdera pare Agamana kareche| tArA valeH he AmAdera pAlanakartA, AmAderake evaM ImAne AgrahI AmAdera bhrAtAgaNake kSamA kara evaM ImAnadAradera viruddhe AmAdera antare keAna vidveSa rekheA nA| he AmAdera pAlanakartA, Apani daYAlu, parama karuNAmaYa|

Apani ki munAphikaderake dekhena ni? tArA tAdera kitAvadhArI kAphera bhAiderake valeH teAmarA yadi vahiskRta hao, tave AmarA avazyai teAmAdera sAthe deza theke vera haYe yAva evaM teAmAdera vyApAre AmarA kakhanao kArao kathA mAnava nA| Ara yadi teAmarA AkrAnta hao, tave AmarA avazyai teAmAderake sAhAyya karava| AllAha tA’AlA sAkSya dena ye, orA nizcaYai mithyAvAdI|

yadi tArA vahiskRta haYa, tave munAphikarA tAdera sAthe dezatyAga karave nA Ara yadi tArA AkrAnta haYa, tave tArA tAderake sAhAyya karave nA| yadi tAderake sAhAyya kare, tave avazyai pRSThapradarzana kare palAYana karave| erapara kApherarA keAna sAhAyya pAve nA|
nizcaYa teAmarA tAdera antare AllAha tA’AlA apekSA adhikatara bhaYAvaha| eTA e kAraNe ye, tArA eka nirveAdha sampradAYa|

tArA saMghavaddhabhAveo teAmAdera viruddhe yuddha karate pArave nA| tArA yuddha karave kevala surakSita janapade athavA durga prAcIrera Ar3Ala theke| tAdera pArasparika yuddhai pracanDa haYe thAke| Apani tAderake aikyavaddha mane karavena; kintu tAdera antara zatadhAvicchinna| eTA e kAraNe ye, tArA eka kAnDajJAnahINa sampradAYa|
tArA sei leAkadera mata, yArA tAdera nikaTa atIte nijedera karmera zAstibheAga kareche| tAdera janye raYeche yantraNAdAYaka zAsti|
tArA zaYatAnera mata, ye mAnuSake kAphera hate vale| ataHpara yakhana se kAphera haYa, takhana zaYatAna valeH teAmAra sAthe AmAra keAna samparka nei| Ami vizvapAlanakartA AllAha tA’AlAke bhaYa kari|
ataHpara ubhaYera pariNati have ei ye, tArA jAhAnnAme yAve evaM cirakAla tathAYa vasavAsa karave| eTAi jAlemadera zAsti|

muminagaNa, teAmarA AllAha tA’AlAke bhaYa kara| pratyeka vyaktira ucita, AgAmI kAlera janye se ki preraNa kare, tA cintA karA| AllAha tA’AlAke bhaYa karate thAka| teAmarA yA kara, AllAha tA’AlA se samparke khavara rAkhena|
teAmarA tAdera mata haYeA nA, yArA AllAha tA’AlAke bhule geche| phale AllAha tA’AlA tAderake Atna vismRta kare diYechena| tArAi avAdhya|
jAhAnnAmera adhivAsI evaM jAnnAtera adhivAsI samAna hate pAre nA| yArA jAnnAtera adhivAsI, tArAi saphalakAma|

yadi Ami ei keAraAna pAhAr3era upara avatIrNa karatAma, tave tumi dekhate ye, pAhAr3a vinIta haYe AllAha tA’AlAra bhaYe vidIrNa haYe geche| Ami esava dRSTAnta mAnuSera janye varNanA kari, yAte tArA cintA-bhAvanA kare|
tinii AllAha tA’AlA, tini vyatIta keAna upAsya nei; tini dRzya o adRzyake jAnena tini parama daYAlu, asIma dAtA|

tinii AllAha tini vyatita keAna upAsya nei| tinii ekamAtra mAlika, pavitra, zAnti o nirApattAdAtA, AzraYadAtA, parAkrAnta, pratApAnvita, mAhAtmyazIla| tArA yAke aMzIdAra kare AllAha tA’ AlA tA theke pavitra|
tinii AllAha tA’AlA, sraSTA, udbhAvaka, rUpadAtA, uttama nAma samUha tA~rai| nabheAmanDale o bhUmanDale yA kichu Ache, savai tA~ra pavitratA gheASaNA kare| tini parAkrAnta prajJAmaYa|

muminagaNa, teAmarA AmAra o teAmAdera zatruderake vandharUpe grahaNa kareA nA| teAmarA teA tAdera prati vandhutvera vArtA pAThAo, athaca tArA ye satya teAmAdera kAche Agamana kareche, tA asvIkAra karache| tArA rasUlake o teAmAderake vahiskAra kare ei aparAdhe ye, teAmarA teAmAdera pAlanakartAra prati vizvAsa rAkha| yadi teAmarA AmAra santuSTilAbhera janye evaM AmAra pathe jehAda karAra janye vera haYe thAka, tave kena tAdera prati geApane vandhutvera paYagAma preraNa karacha? teAmarA yA geApana kara evaM yA prakAza kara, ta Ami khuva jAni| teAmAdera madhye ye eTA kare, se saralapatha theke vicyuta haYe yAYa|
teAmAderake karatalagata karate pArale tArA teAmAdera zatru haYe yAve evaM manda uddezye teAmAdera prati vAhu o rasanA prasArita karave evaM cAive ye, keAnarUpe teAmarA o kAphera haYe yAo|
teAmAdera svajana-parijana o santAna-santati kiYAmatera dina keAna upakAre Asave nA| tini teAmAdera madhye phaYasAlA karavena| teAmarA yA kara, AllAha tA dekhena|

teAmAdera janye ivrAhIma o tA~ra saGgIgaNera madhye camatkAra Adarza raYeche| tArA tAdera sampradAYake valechilaH teAmAdera sAthe evaM teAmarA AllAhara parivarte yAra evAdata kara, tAra sAthe AmAdera keAna samparka nei| AmarA teAmAdera mAni nA| teAmarA eka AllAhara prati vizvAsa sthApana nA karale teAmAdera madhye o AmAdera madhye cirazatrutA thAkave| kintu ivrAhImera ukti tA~ra pitAra uddeze ei Adarzera vyatikrama| tini valechilenaH Ami avazyai teAmAra janya kSamAprArthanA karava| teAmAra upakArera janye AllAhara kAche AmAra Ara kichu karAra nei| he AmAdera pAlanakartA! AmarA teAmArai upara bharasA karechi, teAmArai dike mukha karechi evaM teAmArai nikaTa AmAdera pratyAvartana|
he AmAdera pAlanakartA! tumi AmAderake kApheradera janya parIkSAra pAtra kareA nA| he AmAdera pAlanakartA! AmAdera kSamA kara| nizcaYa tumi parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|
teAmarA yArA AllAha o parakAla pratyAzA kara, teAmAdera janya tAdera madhye uttama Adarza raYeche| Ara ye mukha phiriYe neYa, tAra jAnA ucita ye, AllAha veparaoYA, prazaMsAra mAlika|
yArA teAmAdera zatru AllAha tAdera madhye o teAmAdera madhye sambhavataH vandhutva sRSTi kare devena| AllAha savai karate pArena evaM AllAha kSamAzIla, karuNAmaYa|

dharmera vyApAre yArA teAmAdera viruddhe lar3Ai kareni evaM teAmAderake deza theke vahiskRta kareni, tAdera prati sadAcaraNa o inasApha karate AllAha teAmAderake niSedha karena nA| nizcaYa AllAha inasAphakArIderake bhAlavAsena|

AllAha kevala tAdera sAthe vandhutva karate niSedha karena, yArA dharmera vyApAre teAmAdera viruddhe yuddha kareche, teAmAderake deza theke vahiskRta kareche evaM vahiskArakArye sahAYatA kareche| yArA tAdera sAthe vandhutva kare tArAi jAlema|

muminagaNa, yakhana teAmAdera kAche ImAnadAra nArIrA hijarata kare Agamana kare, takhana tAderake parIkSA kara| AllAha tAdera ImAna samparke samyaka avagata Achena| yadi teAmarA jAna ye, tArA ImAnadAra, tave Ara tAderake kApheradera kAche pherata pAThio nA| erA kApheradera janye hAlAla naYa evaM kApherarA edera janye hAlAla naYa| kApherarA yA vyaYa kareche, tA tAdera diYe dAo| teAmarA, ei nArIderake prApya meAharAnA diYe vivAha karale teAmAdera aparAdha have nA| teAmarA kAphera nArIdera sAthe dAmpatya samparka vajAYa rekheA nA| teAmarA yA vyaYa karecha, tA ceYe nAo evaM tArAo ceYe nive yA tArA vyaYa kareche| eTA AllAhara vidhAna; tini teAmAdera madhye phaYasAlA karena| AllAha sarvajJa prajJAmaYa|

teAmAdera strIdera madhye yadi keu hAtachAr3A haYe kApheradera kAche theke yAYa, ataHpara teAmarA suyeAga pAo, takhana yAdera strI hAtachAr3A haYe geche, tAderake tAdera vyaYakRta arthera samaparimANa artha pradAna kara evaM AllAhake bhaYa kara, yAra prati teAmarA vizvAsa rAkha|

he navI, ImAnadAra nArIrA yakhana ApanAra kAche ese Anugatyera zapatha kare ye, tArA AllAhara sAthe kAuke zarIka karave nA, curi karave nA, vyabhicAra karave nA, tAdera santAnaderake hatyA karave nA, jAraja santAnake svAmIra aurasa theke Apana garbhajAta santAna vale mithyA dAvI karave nA evaM bhAla kAje ApanAra avAdhyatA karave nA, takhana tAdera Anugatya grahaNa karuna evaM tAdera janye AllAhara kAche kSamA prArthanA karuna| nizcaYa AllAha kSamAzIla atyanta daYAlu|
muminagaNa, AllAha ye jAtira prati ruSTa, teAmarA tAdera sAthe vandhutva kareA nA| tArA parakAla samparke nirAza haYe geche yemana kavarastha kApherarA nirAza haYe geche|
nabheAmanDale o bhUmanDale yA kichu Ache, savai AllAhara pavitratA gheASaNA kare| tini parAkrAnta prajJAvAna|
muminagaNa! teAmarA yA kara nA, tA kena vala?
teAmarA yA kara nA, tA valA AllAhara kAche khuvai asanteASajanaka|
AllAha tAderake bhAlavAsena, yArA tA~ra pathe sArivaddhabhAve lar3Ai kare, yena tArA sIsAgAlAneA prAcIra|

smaraNa kara, yakhana mUsA (AH) tA~ra sampradAYake valalaH he AmAra sampradAYa, teAmarA kena AmAke kaSTa dAo, athaca teAmarA jAna ye, Ami teAmAdera kAche AllAhara rasUla| ataHpara tArA yakhana vakratA avalamvana karala, takhana AllAha tAdera antarake vakra kare dilena| AllAha pApAcArI sampradAYake pathapradarzana karena nA|

smaraNa kara, yakhana mariYama-tanaYa IsA (AH) valalaH he vanI isarAila! Ami teAmAdera kAche AllAhara prerita rasUla, AmAra pUrvavartI taorAtera Ami satyAYanakArI evaM Ami emana ekajana rasUlera susaMvAdadAtA, yini AmAra pare Agamana karavena| tA~ra nAma Ahamada| ataHpara yakhana se spaSTa pramANAdi niYe Agamana karala, takhana tArA valalaH e teA eka prakAzya yAdu|
ye vyakti isalAmera dike Ahuta haYeo AllAha samparke mithyA vale; tAra cAite adhika yAlema Ara ke? AllAha yAlema sampradAYake patha pradarzana karena nA|
tArA mukhera phu~tkAre AllAhara AleA nibhiYe dite cAYa| AllAha tA~ra AleAke pUrNarUpe vikazita karavena yadio kApherarA tA apachanda kare|
tini tA~ra rasUlake patha nirdeza o satyadharma niYe preraNa karechena, yAte eke savadharmera upara pravala kare dena yadio muzarikarA tA apachanda kare|
muminagaNa, Ami ki teAmAderake emana eka vAnijyera sandhAna diva, yA teAmAderake yantraNAdAYaka zAsti theke mukti deve?
tA ei ye, teAmarA AllAha o tA~ra rasUlera prati vizvAsa sthApana karave evaM AllAhara pathe nijedera dhana-sampada o jIvanapaNa kare jehAda karave| eTAi teAmAdera janye uttama; yadi teAmarA veAjha|
tini teAmAdera pAparAzi kSamA karavena evaM emana jAnnAte dAkhila karavena, yAra pAdadeze nadI pravAhita evaM vasavAsera jAnnAte uttama vAsagRhe| eTA mahAsAphalya|
evaM Arao ekaTi anugraha divena, yA teAmarA pachanda kara| AllAhara pakSa theke sAhAyya evaM Asanna vijaYa| muminaderake era susaMvAda dAna karuna|

muminagaNa, teAmarA AllAhara sAhAyyakArI haYe yAo, yemana IsA ivane-mariYama tAra ziSyavargake valechila, AllAhara pathe ke AmAra sAhAyyakArI have? ziSyavarga valechilaH AmarA AllAhara pathe sAhAyyakArI| ataHpara vanI-isarAIlera ekadala vizvAsa sthApana karala evaM ekadala kAphera haYe gela| yArA vizvAsa sthApana karechila, Ami tAderake tAdera zatrudera meAkAvelAYa zakti yeAgAlAma, phale tArA vijaYI hala|
rAjyAdhipati, pavitra, parAkramazAlI o prajJAmaYa AllAhara pavitratA gheASaNA kare, yA kichu Ache nabheAmanDale o yA kichu Ache bhUmanDale|

tinii nirakSaradera madhya theke ekajana rasUla preraNa karechena, yini tAdera kAche pATha karena tAra AYAtasamUha, tAderake pavitra karena evaM zikSA dena kitAva o hikamata| itipUrve tArA chila gheAra pathabhraSTatAYa lipta|
ei rasUla prerita haYechena anya Arao leAkadera janye, yArA ekhanao tAdera sAthe milita haYani| tini parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|
eTA AllAhara kRpA, yAke icchA tini tA dAna karena| AllAha mahAkRpAzIla|

yAderake taorAta deYA haYechila, ataHpara tArA tAra anusaraNa kareni, tAdera dRSTAnta sei gAdhA, ye pustaka vahana kare, yArA AllAhara AYAtasamUhake mithyA vale, tAdera dRSTAnta kata nikRSTa| AllAha jAlema sampradAYake patha pradarzana karena nA|
valuna he ihudIgaNa, yadi teAmarA dAvI kara ye, teAmarAi AllAhara vandhu-anya keAna mAnava naYa, tave teAmarA mRtyu kAmanA kara yadi teAmarA satyavAdI hao|
tArA nijedera kRtakarmera kAraNe kakhanao mRtyu kAmanA karave nA| AllAha jAlemadera samparke samyaka avagata Achena|

valuna, teAmarA ye mRtyu theke palAYanapara, sei mRtyu avazyai teAmAdera mukhAmukhi have, ataHpara teAmarA adRzya, dRzyera jJAnI AllAhara kAche upasthita have| tini teAmAderake jAniYe divena sesava karma, yA teAmarA karate|
muminagaNa, jumaAra dine yakhana nAmAyera AyAna deYA haYa, takhana teAmarA AllAhara smaraNera pAne tvarA kara evaM vecAkenA vandha kara| eTA teAmAdera janye uttama yadi teAmarA vujha|
ataHpara nAmAya samApta hale teAmarA pRthivIte char3iYe par3a evaM AllAhara anugraha tAlAza kara o AllAhake adhika smaraNa kara, yAte teAmarA saphalakAma hao|

tArA yakhana keAna vyavasAYera suyeAga athavA krIr3Akeৗtuka dekhe takhana ApanAke dA~r3AneA avasthAYa rekhe tArA sedike chuTe yAYa| valunaH AllAhara kAche yA Ache, tA krIr3Akeৗtuka o vyavasAYa apekSA utkRSTa| AllAha sarveAttama riyikadAtA|

munAphikarA ApanAra kAche ese valeH AmarA sAkSya dicchi ye Apani nizcaYai AllAhara rasUla| AllAha jAnena ye, Apani avazyai AllAhara rasUla evaM AllAha sAkSya dicchena ye, munAphikarA avazyai mithyAvAdI|
tArA tAdera zapathasamUhake DhAlarUpe vyavahAra kare| ataHpara tArA AllAhara pathe vAdhA sRSTi kare| tArA yA karache, tA khuvai manda|
eTA ejanya ye, tArA vizvAsa karAra para punarAYa kAphera haYeche| phale tAdera antare meAhara mere deYA haYeche| ataeva tArA vujhe nA|

Apani yakhana tAderake dekhena, takhana tAdera dehAvaYava ApanAra kAche prItikara mane haYa| Ara yadi tArA kathA vale, tave Apani tAdera kathA zunena| tArA prAcIre ThekAneA kAThasadRzya| pratyeka zeArageAlake tArA nijedera viruddhe mane kare| tArAi zatru, ataeva tAdera samparke satarka heAna| dhvaMsa karuna AllAha tAderake| tArA keAthAYa vibhrAnta hacche?

yakhana tAderake valA haYaH teAmarA esa, AllAhara rasUla teAmAdera janya kSamAprArthanA karavena, takhana tArA mAthA ghuriYe neYa evaM Apani tAderake dekhena ye, tArA ahaMkAra kare mukha phiriYe neYa|
Apani tAdera janye kSamAprArthanA karuna athavA nA karuna, ubhaYai samAna| AllAha kakhanao tAderake kSamA karavena nA| AllAha pApAcArI sampradAYake pathapradarzana karena nA|
tArAi valeH AllAhara rAsUlera sAhacarye yArA Ache tAdera janye vyaYa kareA nA| pariNAme tArA ApanA-Apani sare yAve| bhU o nabheAmanDalera dhana-bhAnDAra AllAharai kintu munAphikarA tA veAjhe nA|
tArAi valeH AmarA yadi madInAYa pratyAvartana kari tave sekhAna theke savala avazyai durvalake vahiskRta karave| zakti teA AllAha tA~ra rasUla o muminaderai kintu munAphikarA tA jAne nA|
muminagaNa! teAmAdera dhana-sampada o santAna-santati yena teAmAderake AllAhara smaraNa theke gAphela nA kare| yArA e kAraNe gAphela haYa, tArAi teA kSatigrasta|

Ami teAmAderake yA diYechi, tA theke mRtyu AsAra Agei vyaYa kara| anyathAYa se valaveH he AmAra pAlanakartA, AmAke Arao kichukAla avakAza dile nA kena? tAhale Ami sadakA karatAma evaM satkarmIdera antarbhukta hatAma|
pratyeka vyaktira nirdhArita samaYa yakhana upasthita have, takhana AllAha kAuke avakAza devena nA| teAmarA yA kara, AllAha se viSaYe khavara rAkhena|
nabheAmanDala o bhUmanDale yA kichu Ache, savai AllAhara pavitratA gheASaNA kare| rAjatva tA~rai evaM prazaMsA tA~rai| tini sarvaviSaYe sarvazaktimAna|
tinii teAmAderake sRSTi karechena, ataHpara teAmAdera madhye keu kAphera evaM keu mumina| teAmarA yA kara, AllAha tA dekhena|
tini nabheAmanDala o bhUmanDalake yathAyathabhAve sRSTi karechena evaM teAmAderake AkRti dAna karechena, ataHpara sundara karechena teAmAdera AkRti| tA~rai kAche pratyAvartana|
nabheAmanDala o bhUmanDale yA Ache, tini tA jAnena| tini Arao jAnena teAmarA yA geApane kara evaM yA prakAzye kara| AllAha antarera viSaYAdi samparke samyaka jJAta|
teAmAdera purve yArA kAphera chila, tAdera vRttAnta ki teAmAdera kAche peৗcheni? tArA tAdera karmera zAsti AsvAdana kareche, evaM tAdera janye raYeche yantraNAdAYaka zAsti|

eTA e kAraNe ye, tAdera kAche tAdera rasUlagaNa prakAzya nidarzanAvalIsaha Agamana karale tArA valataH mAnuSai ki AmAderake pathapradarzana karave? ataHpara tArA kAphera haYe gela evaM mukha phiriYe nila| ete AllAhara kichu Ase yAYa nA| AllAha amukhApekSI prazaMsita|

kApherarA dAvI kare ye, tArA kakhanao punarutthita have nA| valuna, avazyai have, AmAra pAlanakartAra kasama, teAmarA nizcaYa purutthita have| ataHpara teAmAderake avahita karA have yA teAmarA karate| eTA AllAhara pakSe sahaja|
ataeva teAmarA AllAha tA~ra rasUla evaM avatIrna nUrera prati vizvAsa sthApana kara| teAmarA yA kara, se viSaYe AllAha samyaka avagata|

sedina arthAt, samAvezera dina AllAha teAmAderake samaveta karavena| e dina hAra-jitera dina| ye vyakti AllAhara prati vizvAsa sthApana kare evaM satkarma sampAdana kare, AllAha tAra pApasamUha meAcana karavena evaM tAke jAnnAte dAkhila karavena| yAra taladeze nirjharinIsamUha pravAhita have, tArA tathAYa cirakAla vasavAsa karave| eTAi mahAsAphalya|
Ara yArA kAphera evaM AmAra AYAtasamUhake mithyA vale, tArAi jAhAnnAmera adhivAsI, tArA tathAYa anantakAla thAkave| katai nA manda pratyAvartanasthala eTA|
AllAhara nirdeza vyatireke keAna vipada Ase nA evaM ye AllAhara prati vizvAsa kare, tini tAra antarake satpatha pradarzana karena| AllAha sarvaviSaYe samyaka parijJAta|
teAmarA AllAhara Anugatya kara evaM rasUlullAhara Anugatya kara| yadi teAmarA mukha phiriYe nAo, tave AmAra rasUlera dAYitva kevala kheAlAkhuli peৗche deYA|
AllAha tini vyatIta keAna mAvuda nei| ataeva muminagaNa AllAhara upara bharasA karuka|

he muminagaNa, teAmAdera keAna keAna strI o santAna-santati teAmAdera duzamana| ataeva tAdera vyApAre satarka thAka| yadi mArjanA kara, upekSA kara, evaM kSamA kara, tave AllAha kSamAzIla, karunAmaYa|
teAmAdera dhana-sampada o santAna-santati teA kevala parIkSAsvarUpa| Ara AllAhara kAche raYeche mahApuraskAra|
ataeva teAmarA yathAsAdhya AllAhake bhaYa kara, zuna, Anugatya kara evaM vyaYa kara| eTA teAmAdera janye kalyANakara| yArA manera kArpanya theke mukta, tArAi saphalakAma|
yadi teAmarA AllAhake uttama RNa dAna kara, tini teAmAdera janye tA dviguNa kare devena evaM teAmAderake kSamA karavena| AllAha guNagrAhI, sahanazIla|
tini dRzya o adRzyera jJAnI, parAkrAnta, prajJAmaYa|

he navI, teAmarA yakhana strIderake tAlAka dite cAo, takhana tAderake tAlAka diYeA iddatera prati lakSya rekhe evaM iddata gaNanA kareA| teAmarA teAmAdera pAlanakartA AllAhake bhaYa kareA| tAderake tAdera gRha theke vahiskAra kareA nA evaM tArAo yena vera nA haYa yadi nA tArA keAna suspaSTa nirlajja kAje lipta haYa| eguleA AllAhara nirdhArita sImA| ye vyakti AllAhara sImAlaMghana kare, se nijerai aniSTa kare| se jAne nA, haYateA AllAha ei tAlAkera para keAna natuna upAYa kare devena|

ataHpara tArA yakhana tAdera iddatakAle pau~che, takhana tAderake yatheApayukta panthAYa rekhe deve athavA yatheApayukta panthAYa cher3e deve evaM teAmAdera madhya theke du’jana nirbharayeAgya leAkake sAkSI rAkhave| teAmarA AllAhara uddezye sAkSya dive| etaddvArA ye vyakti AllAha o parakAle vizvAsa kare, tAke upadeza deYA hacche| Ara ye AllAhake bhaYa kare, AllAha tAra janye niskRtira patha kare devena|

evaM tAke tAra dhAraNAtIta jAYagA theke riyika devena| ye vyakti AllAhara upara bharasA kare tAra janye tinii yatheSTa| AllAha tAra kAja pUrNa karavena| AllAha savakichura janye ekaTi parimANa sthira kare rekhechena|

teAmAdera strIdera madhye yAdera RtuvartI haoYAra AzA nei, tAdera vyApAre sandeha hale tAdera iddata have tina mAsa| Ara yArA ekhanao Rtura vaYase pau~cheni, tAderao anurUpa iddatakAla have| garbhavartI nArIdera iddatakAla santAnaprasava paryanta| ye AllAhake bhaYa kare, AllAha tAra kAja sahaja kare dena|
eTA AllAhara nirdeza, yA tini teAmAdera prati nAyila karechena| ye AllAhake bhaYa kare, AllAha tAra pApa meAcana karena evaM tAke mahApuraskAra dena|

teAmarA teAmAdera sAmarthyanuyAYI yerUpa gRhe vAsa kara, tAderakeo vasavAsera janye serUpa gRha dAo| tAderake kaSTa diYe saMkaTApanna kareA nA| yadi tArA garbhavatI haYa, tave santAnaprasava paryanta tAdera vyaYabhAra vahana karave| yadi tArA teAmAdera santAnaderake stanyadAna kare, tave tAderake prApya pArizramika deve evaM e samparke paraspara saMyatabhAve parAmarza karave| teAmarA yadi paraspara jeda kara, tave anya nArI stanyadAna karave|

vittazAlI vyakti tAra vitta anuyAYI vyaYa karave| ye vyakti sImita parimANe riyikaprApta, se AllAha yA diYechena, tA theke vyaYa karave| AllAha yAke yA diYechena, tadapekSA vezI vyaYa karAra Adeza kAuke karena nA| AllAha kaSTera para sukha devena|
aneka janapada tAdera pAlanakartA o tA~ra rasUlagaNera Adeza amAnya karechila, ataHpara Ami tAderake kaTheAra hisAve dhRta karechilAma evaM tAderake bhISaNa zAsti diYechilAma|
ataHpara tAdera karmera zAsti AsvAdana karala evaM tAdera karmera pariNAma kSatii chila|
AllAha tAdera janye yantraNAdAYaka zAsti prastata rekhechena ataeva, he vuddhimAnagaNa, yArA ImAna enecha, teAmarA AllAhake bhaYa kara| AllAha teAmAdera prati upadeza nAyila karechena|

ekajana rasUla, yini teAmAdera kAche AllAhara suspaSTa AYAtasamUha pATha karena, yAte vizvAsI o satkarmaparAYaNadera andhakAra theke AleAte AnaYana karena| ye AllAhara prati vizvAsa sthApana kare o satkarma sampAdana kare, tini tAke dAkhila karavena jAnnAte, yAra taladeze nadI pravAhita, tathAYa tArA cirakAla thAkave| AllAha tAke uttama riyika devena|
AllAha saptAkAza sRSTi karechena evaM pRthivIo sei parimANe, esavera madhye tA~ra Adeza avatIrNa haYa, yAte teAmarA jAnate pAra ye, AllAha sarvazaktimAna evaM savakichu tA~ra geAcarIbhUta|
he navI, AllAha ApanAra janye yA hAlAla karachena, Apani ApanAra strIderake khuzI karAra janye tA nijera janye hArAma karechena kena? AllAha kSamAzIla, daYAmaYa|
AllAha teAmAdera janye kasama theke avyahati lAbhera upAYa nirdhAraNa kare diYechena| AllAha teAmAdera mAlika| tini sarvajJa, prajJAmaYa|

yakhana navI tA~ra ekajana strIra kAche ekaTi kathA geApane valalena, ataHpara strI yakhana tA vale dila evaM AllAha navIke tA jAniYe dilena, takhana navI se viSaYe strIke kichu valalena evaM kichu valalena nA| navI yakhana tA strIke valalena, takhana strI valalenaH ke ApanAke e samparke avahita karala? navI valalenaH yini sarvajJa, oYAkiphahAla, tini AmAke avahita karechena|

teAmAdera antara anyAYera dike jhu~ke par3eche vale yadi teAmarA ubhaYe taovA kara, tave bhAla kathA| Ara yadi navIra viruddhe eke aparake sAhAyya kara, tave jene rekha AllAha jivarAIla evaM satkarmaparAYaNa muminagaNa tA~ra sahAYa| uparantuta pherezatAgaNao tA~ra sAhAyyakArI|

yadi navI teAmAdera sakalake parityAga karena, tave sambhavataH tA~ra pAlanakartA tA~ke parivarte divena teAmAdera cAite uttama strI, yArA have AjJAvaha, ImAnadAra, nAmAyI taovAkAriNI, evAdatakAriNI, reAyAdAra, akumArI o kumArI|

muminagaNa, teAmarA nijederake evaM teAmAdera parivAra-parijanake sei agni theke rakSA kara, yAra indhana have mAnuSa o prastara, yAte niYeAjita Ache pASANa hRdaYa, kaTheArasvabhAva pherezatAgaNa| tArA AllAha tA’AlA yA Adeza karena, tA amAnya kare nA evaM yA karate Adeza karA haYa, tAi kare|
he kAphera sampradAYa, teAmarA Aja oyara peza kareA nA| teAmAderake tArai pratiphala deYA have, yA teAmarA karate|

muminagaNa! teAmarA AllAha tA’AlAra kAche taovA kara-Antarika taovA| AzA karA yAYa, teAmAdera pAlanakartA teAmAdera manda karmasamUha meAcana kare devena evaM teAmAderake dAkhila karavena jAnnAte, yAra taladeze nadI pravAhita| sedina AllAha navI evaM tA~ra vizvAsI sahacaraderake apadastha karavena nA| tAdera nUra tAdera sAmane o DAnadike chuTeAchuTi karave| tArA valaveH he AmAdera pAlanakartA, AmAdera nUrake pUrNa kare dina evaM AmAderake kSamA karuna| nizcaYa Apani savakichura upara sarva zaktimAna|
he navI! kAphera o munAphikadera viruddhe jehAda karuna evaM tAdera prati kaTheAra heAna| tAdera ThikAnA jAhAnnAma| seTA katai nA nikRSTa sthAna|

AllAha tA’AlA kApheradera janye nUha-patnI o lUta-patnIra dRSTAnta varNanA karechena| tArA chila AmAra dui dharmaparAYaNa vAndAra gRhe| ataHpara tArA tAdera sAthe vizvAsaghAtakatA karala| phale nUha o lUta tAderake AllAha tA’AlAra kavala theke rakSA karate pArala nA evaM tAderake valA halaH jAhAnnAmIdera sAthe jAhAnnAme cale yAo|

AllAha tA’AlA muminadera janye pherAuna-patnIra dRSTAnta varNanA karechena| se valalaH he AmAra pAlanakartA! ApanAra sannikaTe jAnnAte AmAra janye ekaTi gRha nirmANa karuna, AmAke pherAuna o tAra duskarma theke uddhAra karuna evaM AmAke yAlema sampradAYa theke mukti dina|

Ara dRSTAnta varNanA karechena emarAna-tanaYA mariYamera, ye tAra satItva vajAYa rekhechila| ataHpara Ami tAra madhye AmAra pakSa theke jIvana phu~ke diYechilAma evaM se tAra pAlanakartAra vAnI o kitAvake satye pariNata karechila| se chila vinaYa prakAzakArInIdera ekajana|
pUNyamaYa tini, yA~ra hAte rAjatva| tini savakichura upara sarvazaktimAna|
yini sRSTi karechena maraNa o jIvana, yAte teAmAderake parIkSA karena-ke teAmAdera madhye karme zreSTha? tini parAkramazAlI, kSamAmaYa|
tini sapta AkAza stare stare sRSTi karechena| tumi karuNAmaYa AllAha tA’AlAra sRSTite keAna taphAta dekhate pAve nA| AvAra dRSTipherAo; keAna phATala dekhate pAo ki?
ataHpara tumi vAra vAra tAkiYe dekha-teAmAra dRSTi vyartha o parizrAnta haYe teAmAra dike phire Asave|
Ami sarvanimna AkAzake pradIpamAlA dvArA susajjata karechi; seguleAke zaYatAnadera janye kSepaNAstravat karechi evaM prastuta kare rekhechi tAdera janye jalanta agnira zAsti|
yArA tAdera pAlanakartAke asvIkAra kareche tAdera janye raYeche jAhAnnAmera zAsti| seTA katai nA nikRSTa sthAna|
yakhana tArA tathAYa nikSipta have, takhana tAra utkSipta garjana zunate pAve|
kreAdhe jAhAnnAma yena pheTe par3ave| yakhanai tAte keAna sampradAYa nikSipta have takhana tAderake tAra sipAhIrA jijJAsA karave| teAmAdera kAche ki keAna satarkakArI Agamana kareni?

tArA valaveH hyA~ AmAdera kAche satarkakArI Agamana karechila, ataHpara AmarA mithyAreApa karechilAma evaM valechilAmaH AllAha tA’AlA keAna kichu nAjila karenani| teAmarA mahAvibhrAntite par3e raYecha|
tArA Arao valaveH yadi AmarA zunatAma athavA vuddhi khATAtAma, tave AmarA jAhAnnAmavAsIdera madhye thAkatAma nA|
ataHpara tArA tAdera aparAdha svIkAra karave| jAhAnnAmIrA dUra heAka|
nizcaYa yArA tAdera pAlanakartAke nA dekhe bhaYa kare, tAdera janye raYeche kSamA o mahApuraskAra|
teAmarA teAmAdera kathA geApane vala athavA prakAzye vala, tini teA antarera viSaYAdi samparke samyaka avagata|
yini sRSTi karechena, tini ki kare jAnavena nA? tini sUkSnajJAnI, samyaka jJAta|
tini teAmAdera janye pRthivIke sugama karechena, ataeva, teAmarA tAra kA~dhe vicaraNa kara evaM tA~ra deYA riyika AhAra kara| tA~rai kAche punarujjIvana have|
teAmarA ki bhAvanAmukta haYe gecha ye, AkAze yini Achena tini teAmAderake bhUgarbhe vilIna kare devena, ataHpara tA kA~pate thAkave|
nA teAmarA nizcinta haYe gecha ye, AkAze yini Achena, tini teAmAdera upara prastara vRSTi varSaNa karavena, ataHpara teAmarA jAnate pArave kemana chila AmAra satarkavANI|
tAdera pUrvavartIrA mithyAreApa karechila, ataHpara kata kaTheAra haYechila AmAra asvIkRti|
tArA ki lakSya kare nA, tAdera mAthAra upara ur3anta pakSIkulera prati pAkhA vistArakArI o pAkhA saMkeAcanakArI? rahamAna AllAha-i tAderake sthira rAkhena| tini sarva-viSaYa dekhena|
rahamAna AllAha tA’AlA vyatIta teAmAdera keAna sainya Ache ki, ye teAmAderake sAhAyya karave? kApherarA vibhrAntitei patita Ache|
tini yadi riyika vandha kare dena, tave ke Ache, ye teAmAderake riyika dive varaM tArA avAdhyatA o vimukhatAYa Duve raYeche|
ye vyakti upur3a haYe mukhe bhara diYe cale, se-i ki sat pathe cale, nA se vyakti ye seAjA haYe saralapathe cale?
valuna, tinii teAmAderake sRSTi karechena evaM diYechena karNa, cakSu o antara| teAmarA alpai kRtajJatA prakAza kara|
valuna, tinii teAmAderake pRthivIte vistRta karechena evaM tA~rai kAche teAmarA samaveta have|
kApherarA valeH ei pratizruti kave have, yadi teAmarA satyavAdI hao?
valuna, era jJAna AllAha tA’AlAra kAchei Ache| Ami teA kevala prakAzya satarkakArI|
yakhana tArA sei pratizrutike Asanna dekhave takhana kApheradera mukhamanDala malina haYe par3ave evaM valA haveH eTAi teA teAmarA cAite|
valuna, teAmarA ki bheve dekhecha-yadi AllAha tA’AlA AmAke o AmAra saMgIderake dhvaMsa karena athavA AmAdera prati daYA karena, tave kApheraderake ke yantraNAdAYaka zAsti theke rakSA karave?
valuna, tini parama karuNAmaYa, AmarA tAte vizvAsa rAkhi evaM tA~rai upara bharasA kari| sattvarai teAmarA jAnate pArave, ke prakAzya patha-bhraSTatAYa Ache|
valuna, teAmarA bheve dekhecha ki, yadi teAmAdera pAni bhUgarbhera gabhIre cale yAYa, tave ke teAmAderake saravarAha karave pAnira sreAtadhArA?
nUna| zapatha kalamera evaM sei viSaYera yA tArA lipivaddha kare,
ApanAra pAlanakartAra anugrahe Apani ummAda nana|
ApanAra janye avazyai raYeche azeSa puraskAra|
Apani avazyai mahAna caritrera adhikArI|
sattvarai Apani dekhe nivena evaM tArAo dekhe nive|
ke teAmAdera madhye vikAragrasta|
ApanAra pAlanakartA samyaka jAnena ke tA~ra patha theke vicyuta haYeche evaM tini jAnena yArA satpatha prApta|
ataeva, Apani mithyAreApakArIdera Anugatya karavena nA|
tArA cAYa yadi Apani namanIYa hana, tave tArAo namanIYa have|
ye adhika zapatha kare, ye lAJchita, Apani tAra Anugatya karavena nA|
ye pazcAte nindA kare ekera kathA aparera nikaTa lAgiYe phire|
ye bhAla kAje vAdhA deYa, se sImAlaMghana kare, se pApiSTha,
kaTheAra svabhAva, tadupari kukhyAta;
e kAraNe ye, se dhana-sampada o santAna santatira adhikArI|
tAra kAche AmAra AYAta pATha karA hale se vale; sekAlera upakathA|
Ami tAra nAsikA dAgiYe diva|
Ami tAderake parIkSA karechi, yemana parIkSA karechi udyAnaoYAlAdera, yakhana tArA zapatha karechila ye, sakAle vAgAnera phala AharaNa karave,
inazAAllAha nA vale|
ataHpara ApanAra pAlanakartAra pakSa theke vAgAne eka vipada ese patita haleA| yakhana tArA nidrita chila|
phale sakAla paryanta haYe gela chinnavicchinna tRNasama|
sakAle tArA eke aparake Deke valala,
teAmarA yadi phala AharaNa karate cAo, tave sakAla sakAla kSete cala|
ataHpara tArA calala phisaphisa kare kathA valate valate,
adya yena keAna misakIna vyakti teAmAdera kAche vAgAne praveza karate nA pAre|
tArA sakAle lAphiYe lAphiYe sajeAre raoYAnA hala|
ataHpara yakhana tArA vAgAna dekhala, takhana valalaH AmarA teA patha bhUle gechi|
varaM AmarA teA kapAlapeAr3A,
tAdera uttama vyakti valalaH Ami ki teAmAderake valini? ekhanao teAmarA AllAha tA’AlAra pavitratA varNanA karacheA nA kena?
tArA valalaH AmarA AmAdera pAlanakartAra pavitratA gheASaNA karachi, nizcitai AmarA sImAlaMghanakArI chilAma|
